description.zh:
本課程旨在教導學生一個簡潔、廣泛又清楚的教育哲學架構，課程包 括三大部份，第一部份探討哲學的基本課題與哲學和教育的關係；第 二部份探討傳統和當代教育哲學所面對的基本問題，以及它們對教育 實務所能提供的回應之道；第三部份涉及發展個人教育哲學之重要，方法與推行時可能受到的挑戰。 
教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en:
The goal of this course is to offer a conceptual frame of educational philosophy. The course is divided into three sections. Part I deals with basic issuers in philosophy and the relationship between philosophy and education. Part II is a survey of how traditional and modern philosophies have faced the basic philosophic issuers, and the alternatives they have developed for educational practice. Part III discusses the need for developing personal philosophy of education, some ways of building such a philosophy, and some of the challenges involved in implementing that philosophy.
Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在教導學生建構清楚的教育哲學架構，課程包括三大部分，第一部分探討哲學的基本課題與哲學和教育的關係；第 二部分探討傳統和當代教育哲學所面對的基本問題，以及它們對教育實務所能提供的回應之道；第三部分涉及發展個人教育哲學之重要，方法與推行時可能受到的挑戰。

本課程擬培養之教師專業素養指標：
1-1了解有關教育目的和價值的主要理論或思想，以建構自身的教育理念與信念。
5-1思辨與認同教師專業倫理，以維護學生福祉。
syllabi.schedule:
第1週 課程介紹
第2週 哲學與教育的本質
第3週 教育哲學的思想方法（一）
第4週 教育哲學的思想方法（二）
第5週 教育中的哲學課題—形而上學
第6週 教育中的哲學課題—知識論
第8週 教育中的哲學課題—倫理學
第9週 期中考週(哲學電影賞析)
第10週批判理論與批判教育學
第11-17週  （當代教育哲學-學生分組報告開始） 
第18週 期末考週（作業繳交截止日）
syllabi.assessment:
1.平時課堂討論及隨堂考試占40﹪、分組報告（含口頭及書面）、繪製心智圖及考古題5-10題占40％、活動心得20％
2.請假請務必以Email1或Messenger辦理，缺課及請假次數若達本校學則規定者（含請假不得超過6次），該科即不予通過。
⊙上課中除查閱本課程資料外，請勿使用筆電、智慧型手機、PAD等行動載具從事非本課堂之活動。
⊙須加入fb成立的「112學年度第2學期教育哲學」群組，自第2週起所有授課資料即不再提供紙本，含分組報告ppt、心智圖及考古題及心得亦請上傳fb。 
⊙期中分組報告方式：
1.請以ppt檔呈現，並應於報告前2天先寄電子檔給老師審閱。
2. ppt內容應包括：
(1)請於首頁敘明貴組成員工作分配分工。
(2)主要理論介紹（包含此思潮產生之時代背景、代表人物、重要理念及主張、對該思潮論點對教育的啟示或影響等），並請繪製心智圖。
(3) 至少3題題討論提綱、延伸閱讀建議書單及5-10題單選考古題。
⊙影片心得：報告至少A4一頁(600字以上)，檔名為：「110-2師培教育哲學電影心得○○○(學號姓名)」

description.zh:
本課程目標如下:(一)充實學生各種激發快樂學習、健康成長的學識，以培養適任的優良教師；(二)提供學生班級教學及班級導師工作的實務經驗與做法，使具備有效處理教學與班級事務的良好技能﹔(三)奠定學生熱忱積極經營班級之理念，養成學生教育專業精神，使其在從事教育工作時能發揮愛心與熱忱來欣賞及參與班級的各種活動。
教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en:
The objectives of this course are as follows: (1) to enrich students' knowledge of various subjects that stimulate happy learning and healthy growth in order to cultivate suitable and excellent teachers; (2) to provide students with practical experience and practices in classroom teaching and classroom teacher work, so that they can have good skills in handling teaching and classroom affairs effectively; (3) to establish students' enthusiasm and enthusiasm in running their classes and to develop their educational professionalism so that they can appreciate and participate in various activities in their classes with love and enthusiasm in their educational work. 
Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

syllabi.outline:
本課程目標如下:(一)充實學生各種激發快樂學習、健康成長的學識，以培養適任的優良教師；（二）提供學生班級教學及班級導師工作的實務經驗與做法，使具備有效處理教學與班級事務的良好技能﹔(三)奠定學生熱忱積極經營班級之理念，養成學生教育專業精神，使其在從事教育工作時能發揮愛心與熱忱來欣賞及參與班級的各種活動。 本課程的內容涵蓋班級經營的學理基礎;班級經營的目標、計劃與評鑑;教學、行政之經營;導師的任務與素養;學生自治活動、教學情境佈置;班級氣氛與學習;班級的評量設計;有關安置、生活、學習、行為等方面的問題與對策等 本課程利用講授法、小組討論法、發表法等方式進行教學，盡量在教學過程中探討教室內各種發生的狀況尋求最佳解決方式，且進行發展積極、和諧、快樂的師生互動模式之探討以利學生在未來擔任教師時能駕輕就熟於班級經營工作，而達成本課程之目標 
本課程擬培養之教師專業素養指標：4-1應用正向支持原理，共創安全、友善及對話的班級與學習環境，以養成學生良好品格及有效學習。
syllabi.schedule:
第一週：課程內容與評量方式介紹
第二週：班級經營序論
第三週：班級經營的模式
第四週：新學年開始的工作
第五週：教室物質環境的布置與管理
第六週：教學活動的管理
第七週：不當行為的發生與預防
第八週：班級常規與程序的建立與教學
第九週：期中考
第十週：違反常規及程序的處置
第十一週：強化正向行為的策略
第十二週：嚴重不當行為的處置
第十三週：建立良好的師生關係
第十四週：營造正向同儕關係(課程調整至5/17上午補課)
第十五週：親師合作與溝通
第十六週：教學演示
第十七週：教學演示
第十八週：期末考

出席情形：20%
課堂參與：20%
期中考：20%
教學演示：20%
期末考：20%

name.zh: 土木與建築群教學實習
name.en: Teaching Practicum for the Area of Civil Engineering and Architecture Subjects

description.zh:
本課程的目標是教導有志從事土木與建築群教學工作的學生，使其能熟悉土木與建築群課程綱要，準備分析及運用教材，練習教案的編製與運用，練習靈活運用教學法，教學技術，熟知學校常規，設計與指定作業以及練習教學評鑑與學習評量，使從參與行動中接觸各種實際經驗，以便畢業後能須利適應教學情境。 
教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en:
The object of this course is to lead the students to know how to be a good instructor with good instructional methods and skills learned from this course. For achieving this goal, this course presents the students with basic theories of instructions, makes them study from demonstration in high school and among themselves, directs them to practices the making of instructing plans. After finishing this course, the students should have learned how to make sure of the standard of the subjects they are going to teach; how to prepare, analyze and skillfully use the teaching material, how to make and skillfully use the instructing plans, how to actively use instructing methods and skills, how to will know and use the school or class rules, how to design and assign exercise, how to evaluate instruction and learning.Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link: 
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

syllabi.outline: 本課程的目標是培養有志從事教學工作的學生，運用過去所修習的教育相關科目、教學理論、教學方法、及教學媒體製作等知識，嘗試練習教案的編製與運用，藉由教學演示練習靈活運用教學法，教學技術，同時藉由觀摩同學的教學過程，練習教學評鑑與學習評量，以及教學後的綜合檢討等歷程，加強在編寫教案、教學策略、教學評量、及其他教學方面的能力，使從參與行動中接觸各種實際經驗，以便以後能須利適應教學情境。

https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en:
The object of this course is to lead the students to know how to be a good instructor with good instructional methods and skills learned from this course. For achieving this goal, this course presents the students with basic theories of instructions, makes them study from demonstration in high school and among themselves, directs them to practices the making of instructing plans. After finishing this course, the students should have learned how to make sure of the standard of the subjects they are going to teach; how to prepare, analyze and skillfully use the teaching material, how to make and skillfully use the instructing plans, how to actively use instructing methods and skills, how to will know and use the school or class rules, how to design and assign exercise, how to evaluate instruction and learning. Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

description.en:
The object of this course is to lead the students to know how to be a good instructor with good instructional methods and skills learned from this course. For achieving this goal, this course presents the students with basic theories of instructions, makes them study from demonstration in high school and among themselves, directs them to practices the making of instructin plans. After finishing this course, the students should have learned how to make sure of the standard of the subjects they are going to teach; how to prepare, analyze and skillfully use the teaching material, how to make and skillfully use the instructing plans, how to actively use instructing methods and skills, how to will know and use the school or class rules, how to design and assign exercise, how to evaluate instruction and learning. description.zh:
一、本課程凡十六學分，供學生前四年修習之用。
二、本課程教學目標旨在透過適當選文，增進學生閱讀、鑑賞與寫作能力，誘使學生對我國重要典籍及傳統文化有一粗淺認識，並從而培植其人文素養，啟發其愛國、愛家、愛人之情操。
三、本課程所選範文，類別遍於經史子集，時代該及古今。編者於每篇選文，除有生字、難詞、典故之註釋，提意、出處、著作背景之說明，而作者生平、作品、風格及其地位、事功，亦有簡要之評述。
四、本課程亦講授公文及書信。公文之內容包括函、簽、公告、報告等各類常用公文的作法與寫作要領，並兼及處理公文之注意事項。書信之內容包括傳統及現代書信的寫法與寫作要領，並兼及便條與做為便條使用之名片的寫法。
description.en:
a) The course is designed for the students to study in the first four years, with a sum total of 16 credit hours. 
b) Course Objective: Through proper readings, the students will increase their ability to read, write and even appreciate literary works, and better understand significant books of ancient times and of traditional culture. With better development of humanity, they are likely to have more sense of loving the country, family and people. 
c) The Readings are adopted from a diversity of sources, including Classics, History Books, individual writings and literary anthology-ancient or modern. In addition to the explanation and discussion of vocabulary items, difficult words, classic allusions, main ideas, origin and the time background of the articles, a brief comment is also made on the authors' life, their works, literary styles/status. 
d)The course is to teach students how to write and handle official correspondences and social letters.

syllabi.outline:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 此專科英文課程共四年：專一、專二、專三、專四。其課程目標為培養學生獨立閱讀、進階寫作與口語溝通能力，並培育學生逐漸成為獨立的語言學習者。教學採符合溝通互動取向與全語言哲學的教學法，並依學生特點和課堂文化做適當教學調整與輔助。學生經由大量閱讀具知識性、趣味性、適合其程度的作品，經由經常參與角色扮演、分組討論、口頭報告與短文寫作等學習活動，逐漸提昇語言溝通能力與善用學習策略來解決問題的能力。
description.en: This junior-college English program consists of four-year English courses, with the purposes to develop fluency in reading and writing, and to improve listening and speaking abilities. The communicative approach and the whole language philosophy are thus adopted to implement the curriculum. In these courses, students have plenty of opportunities to take part in role-plays, oral presentations, pair work, small-group discussions and whole-class discussions for communicative purposes; they have good opportunities to express their feelings and thoughts in their essays and journal entries. A variety of reading, writing, and oral communication tasks are provided with a view to developing students' reading, writing, and oral communication skills, and to facilitating their using appropriate, effective learning strategies to accomplish learning tasks. In a word, the purpose of this curriculum is to motivate students to learn English, and to help them gradually become confident and competent use

description.zh: 本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。 課程內容：包含四大階段 （一）勞作教育理念介紹：選取勞作教育相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含勞作教育意義、勞作教育前測作業說明 （二）勞作教育實作階段：勞作課程分三項不同情境施作。 （三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須於各實作階段課程進行討論與反思，並撰寫心得報告、完成後測作業。 （四）期末成果分享：勞作教育期末成果分享，並辦理獎勵工作。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

syllabi.outline: 期望學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，並從實作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，同時建立學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹機器視覺之基本觀念與系統設計、組成機器視覺系統 之元件 (攝影機、鏡頭及照明設備等)、重要之照像幾何學與立體測量法，同時介紹視覺對準法則、相機校正法、計算視覺與打光技術等重要基礎知識，配合影像處理演算法之介紹，使學員建立完整之機器視覺基礎並進行實作演練。
description.en: This course mainly introduces the basic concepts and system design of machine vision, the components that make up the machine vision system, the important photogrammetry and stereo measurement methods. Meanwhile, the visual alignment rules and camera calibration methods are also introduced. Fundamental knowledge, such as visual and lighting techniques, and the introduction of image processing algorithms, enable students to establish a complete machine vision basic knowledge and conduct practical exercises.

description.zh: 物聯網的重點是參與連結之物品會適時產生資訊且都須具備有通訊連結能力，這些物品或裝置的感測元件可以提供系統許多的資訊，因此感測元件與網路通訊技術自然就成為了物聯網的核心。常見的感測元件包含:溫溼度測器、酒精感測器、一氧化碳感測器、空氣品質感測器、超音波感測器、紅外線感測器、腦波感測器等。
description.en: The contents of Internet of Things (IOT) are the connected devices could carry out the information and communicate with system and each other, due to the equipped sensors on these devices. Therefore, sensors and network communication technology become the center of IOT. The most utilized sensors include temperature/humility sensor, alcohol sensor, CO sensor, air quality sensor, ultrasonic sensor, infrared (IR) sensor and brain waves sensor, etc.

syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Course Introduction and Overview

    Introduction to Numerical Methods
    Overview of the course, expectations, and resources
    Introduction to mathematical modeling and problem-solving with computers

Week 2: Foundations of Numerical Computing

    Introduction to numerical computing languages
    Basics of floating-point arithmetic and representation on computers

Week 3: Mathematical Modeling Techniques

    Translating real-world problems into mathematical models
    Introduction to simple numerical algorithms

Week 4: Error Analysis

    Understanding numerical accuracy, stability, and round-off errors
    Significance and impact of errors in computational methods

Week 5: Linear Algebra - Basic Concepts

    Overview of matrix operations and their computational aspects
    Introduction to systems of linear equations

Week 6: Linear Algebra - Advanced Concepts

    Direct and iterative methods for solving linear systems
    Eigenvalue problems and decompositions

Week 7: Interpolation and Approximation

    Polynomial and spline interpolation
    Approximation theory and practice

Week 8: Numerical Integration and Differentiation

    Techniques and methods for numerical integration
    Numerical differentiation and its applications

Week 9: Solving Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs)

    Overview of ODEs and numerical methods for solving them
    Initial value problems and boundary value problems

Week 10: Solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs)

    Introduction to PDEs and numerical methods for solving them
    Finite difference and finite element methods

Week 11: Monte Carlo Methods

    Introduction to Monte Carlo simulations
    Applications in physical sciences and engineering

Week 12: Numerical Optimization

    Basic concepts in optimization
    Gradient-based and gradient-free optimization methods

Week 13: Advanced Topics in Numerical Linear Algebra

    Sparse matrix techniques
    Advanced decomposition methods and their applications

Week 14: Numerical Methods in Data Science

    Numerical techniques in data fitting and regression
    Introduction to machine learning algorithms

Week 15: High-Performance Numerical Computing

    Understanding parallel computing and its use in numerical methods
    Introduction to GPUs and distributed computing

Week 16: Review and Project Work

    Comprehensive review of course material
    Guidance and consultation for final projects

Note: Week 16(2026.06.12): Online class and accessment 線上預錄課程(please go to microsoft teams)

Week 17: Final Project Presentations

    Presentation of final projects by students
    Peer review and feedback sessions

Note: Online and remote class please record and present online.(線上課程)

Week 18: Course Wrap-up and Examination

    Final examination covering the entire course content
    Feedback and course closure

Each week will include lectures, readings from the recommended texts, and practical assignments or problem sets to reinforce the concepts taught.

description.zh: 全球化製造體系的形成，使得合約製造商必須以更積極的態度，從策略面出發，藉由各種電腦與網路的技術，整合內部與外部的流程與資訊，打造數位工廠。數位製造的目的，是希望藉由資訊透明化，提升整個製造體系的競爭優勢。課程的設計，是以概念介紹的方式，說明數位製造的應用現況與相關技術。本課程的內容包括：數位製造概論、數位製造實例說明、商業模型分析、企業知識入口網站、產品資料管理、交易系統、資料倉儲、企業資訊入口網站。
description.en: Brief: Globalization has lead contract manufactures more active on seeking new strategies to survive. To increase competition, new technologies, such as computer and network technology, have applied. Computer and network technology can integrate internal and external information to establish a so-called "e-factory." This course covers different issues related to e-Manufacturing, such as Concept of e-Manufacturing, Case Study, Business Model Analysis, Knowledge Management, Enterprise Knowledge Portal (EKP), Product Data Management (PDM), Concept of Trading Systems, Concept of Data Warehousing, Enterprise Information Portal (EIP), Workflow Management, State of the Art Technologies, etc

name.en: Practice in electrical engineering technology patent application

description.zh: 本課程將以案例研討為討論基礎，準備實際電機技術(元件、電路、方法)之專利申請案，讓同學模擬實際申請專利的過程，首先是進行專利檢索與分析，討論專利佈局的策略；接著讓同學進行專利說明書(含申請專利範圍)撰寫實習，模擬實際上申請各國專利之程序，然後討論專利申請後的答辯、領證繳費及後續維護事宜。
description.en: In this course, we will focus on the practice of the patent application in   electrical engineering technology. Students will learn how to do patent search and analysis, write specification/drawings/claims, and reply office action responses. In addition, the practical aspects of international patent application are presented. The patent filing and maintenance strategies will be also discussed in this class.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將以案例研討為討論基礎，以實際電子電機產品或相關技術，讓同學以產業發展觀點模擬實際申請專利的過程，課程內容包含相關電機相關產品與技術服務發展需考量的相關法規、專利檢索、分析及布局策略、專利說明書撰寫實習、專利申請程序探討、專利答辯、領證繳費及維護事宜。

description.zh: 本課程不同於一般的日文課，主要講解如何讀懂日文科技文章，著重於讀及科技文章的內容，教授內容以讀懂科技日文所需的基礎與概念，本課程介紹從基礎的五十音、助詞、動詞變化、形容詞變化等，到語法結構、長句讀解、常用語法句型進行系統性解說，以期建立修讀者自行解讀科技日文的能力與技巧。
description.en: This is not an entry level Japanese course; therefore, prerequisites of basic Japanese will be required. This lecture will focus on teaching students to read scientific or technological Japanese papers. In the lecture, students will be taught the knowledge and technology on reading Japanese papers, such as basic letters, auxiliary preposition, elementary grammars, sentence structures and the reading of long sentences, which are often appeared in Japanese scientific papers, as well as generally used sentence patterns in scientific Japanese. After learned this lecture, the students are expected to have the abilities and skills for reading scientific articles by themselves.

syllabi.outline:

description.en: Overview of Optical MEMS and NEMS,MicrosystemsWorking Principles of Optical MicrosystemsOverview of Optical MEMSOptical Microsystems DesignOptical Microsystems PackagingOptical Microsystems Testing.

syllabi.outline:
四個主要的目的：

獲得傳感器 ( 包含感測器與致動器 ) 相關的關鍵跨領域知識。讀者必須可以分析簡單的機電元件的主要性能，以及了解關於特殊設計工作的選擇與挑戰。 

使同學獲得充實的微製造技術之背景知識，以使得不具 MEMS 相關背景的讀者也可以瞭解傳統 MEMS 製程，以及許多新的應用新開發之 MEMS 製程。 

透過許多典型實例之研讀，使讀者對於 MEMS 一般的實務設計與製造流程有經驗。 

獲得分析與實務上的知識以評估設計、製造、性能、強健性與價格之間的關聯點，進而成功地開發積體化的 MEMS 元件。 

Overview of Optical MEMS and NEMS,MicrosystemsWorking Principles of Optical MicrosystemsOverview of Optical MEMSOptical Microsystems DesignOptical Microsystems PackagingOptical Microsystems Testing.

name.en: Electronic Packaging Technology for Semiconductor Devices

description.zh: 隨著積體電路的微小化及系統功能的整合化趨勢，元件構裝是將微小的積體電路、光電半導體等元件，依照設計密封於一小的空間內，來發揮最佳的工作效能。元件構裝將是未來發展高精密攜帶式微電子及光電產品的主要核心技術，本課程將介紹構裝設計、及其相關技術、與工業現況。
description.en: Electronic packaging technology is the techniques to encapsulate the chips and optoelectronic devices into a small volume with protective materials, mounted with other components in hybrid or multichip modules, or connected directly onto a printed circuit board. It will be one of the important technologies on developing the portable electronic and optoelectronic products. This course will introduce the basis of package design, related package technologies and current industry status.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹現代電子與半導體元件構裝（Electronic/Device Packaging）的基本原理、材料特性與製程技術。課程內容涵蓋由晶片（die）至系統層級（system-level）的構裝架構，說明封裝在電性、熱管理、機械可靠度與系統整合中的關鍵角色。
學生將學習各類封裝形式（如 wire bonding、flip chip、BGA、CSP、2.5D/3D IC 等），並理解常用構裝材料（如金屬、介電層、封裝樹脂、基板材料）之物理、化學與熱機械特性。
此外，課程亦介紹先進封裝趨勢，包括晶圓級封裝（WLP/FOWLP）、中介層（interposer）、Through-Silicon Via (TSV)／Through-Glass Via (TGV)、異質整合（heterogeneous integration）與可靠度測試方法。
syllabi.schedule:
第 1 週
課程介紹與元件構裝概論：電子產品發展趨勢、封裝在半導體產業中的角色

第 2 週
半導體元件與封裝層級：晶片（Die）、封裝（Package）、基板（Substrate）與系統整合

第 3 週
傳統封裝技術（一）：Wire Bonding 封裝原理、材料與應用

第 4 週
傳統封裝技術（二）：Flip Chip、BGA、CSP 封裝結構比較

第 5 週
封裝用材料（一）：金屬材料（Cu、Al、Au）與互連機制

第 6 週
封裝用材料（二）：介電層、封裝樹脂（EMC）與基板材料

第 7 週
封裝製程流程：Die attach、RDL、Underfill、Molding 製程介紹

第 8 週
晶圓級封裝（WLP）與扇出型晶圓級封裝（FOWLP）技術

第 9 週
期中考週

第 10 週
2.5D/3D IC 封裝概念：中介層（Interposer）與異質整合

第 11 週
垂直互連技術：Through-Silicon Via（TSV）製程與材料議題

第 12 週
新興互連技術：Through-Glass Via（TGV）與玻璃基板應用

第 13 週
熱管理與散熱設計：封裝中之熱傳機制與材料選擇

第 14 週
封裝可靠度（一）：熱應力、CTE 不匹配與失效機制

第 15 週
封裝可靠度（二）：可靠度測試方法（Thermal Cycling、HTOL 等）

第 16 週
先進封裝趨勢：Chiplet、CoWoS、異質整合封裝案例介紹

第 17 週
產業案例分析與技術發展趨勢討論

第 18 週
期末考週或專題報告

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋高分子化學的相關知識及系統設計概念。其內容包括：(1)基礎高分子原理(2)步進式合成機制(3)彈性體系統介紹(4)鏈成長反應機制(5)精密控制鏈成長反應高分子(6)前瞻高分子材料設計與應用。
description.en: This course covers the relevant knowledge of polymer chemistry and system design concepts. The contents include:(1) Basic polymer principles (2) Mechanisms of step-growth polymerization (3) Introduction of elastomer systems (4) Mechanisms of chain-growth polymerization (5) Polymers from precisely controlled chain-growth polymerization (6) Designs and applications of advanced polymer materials.

syllabi.outline: Teach the basic concepts and various reaction mechanisms of polymer materials, and introduce related application examples. Students can systematically understand the molecular design and application directions of polymer systems.

     week)

description.zh: 以纖維材料與複合材料的知識為基礎，實際應用於纖維系複合材料實習；並利用各種現有之機械與電氣性質檢測儀器，對其性能加以評估。其實習內容包括熱可塑與熱固性樹脂之製備；單軸向、雙軸向與三軸向複合材料之加工等之實習;及複合材料機械與電氣性質等之實習。
description.en: On the basis of knowledge from the fiber and composites, various experiments are carried out.  Different measuring instruments are also used to measure and evaluate their mechanical and electrical properties.  The practice includes thermoplastic and thermosetting resin preparation, fiber prepreg preparation, 1-D, 2-D, and 3-D composites processing methods are included. Such as filament winding, hand lay-up, molding compounds, autoclave and vacuum bag method, injection molding, compression molding, SMC, and BMC, pultrusion etc. Otherwise, the mechanical and electrical properties of the composites are also studied.

description.zh: 本課程將引導學生了解語音辨識在人機互動應用上所牽涉的各種技術，包括語音訊號分析、音素/音節辨識、字詞辨識、連續語音辨識、語意辨識、語者辨識、語言辨識、語音合成等，其中也介紹動態時間伸縮與音高比對方法、隱藏式馬可夫模型、類神經網路與深度學習、語者與環境調適、語言模型等方法理論，配合「問題導向學習」之教學模式，進行分組討論、實作練習、企業參訪、與成果觀摩及報告，激發學生之創造與創新能力。
description.en: This course guides students to learn the techniques involved in the human-machine interaction based on speech recognition, including speech signal analysis, phoneme/syllable recognition, word recognition, continuous speech recognition, semantic recognition, speaker recognition, language recognition, speech synthesis. The theoretical fundamentals on dynamic time warping, hidden Markov model, neural network/deep learning, speaker and environment adaptation, language modeling, etc. are also introduced. In addition, the course is designed with the Problem-Based Learning (PBL) method, which includes  group discussion and collaboration on working projects, corporate visit, and project presentation, etc., so that students' capabilities of creativity and innovation can be developed or enhanced.

description.zh: 本課程為線性代數的深化與廣化。以理論的深化而言，本課程由高斯消去法談起，解釋四個向量空間，進而說明矩陣的正交性與投影。接著，本課程闡述行列式、特徵值與特徵向量、矩陣的乘冪與指數、頻譜分解，最終收尾於奇異值分解，以此定理統整這一學期的所有內容。以應用的廣化而言，本課程在上述理論說明之外，還會特別介紹科學、工程的應用實例，例如迴歸分析、線性規劃、圖論與網路、主成份分析。

syllabi.outline: This course is the deepening and broadening of linear algebra. In terms of deepening the theory, this course starts with the Gaussian elimination method, explaining the four vector spaces. Next, it explains the orthogonality and projection of matrices. In addition, this course explains the determinants, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, powers and exponents of matrices, and spectral decomposition, finally concluding with singular value decomposition, which is the theorem that unifies all the contents in this semester. In terms of broadening applications, this course introduces scientific and engineering applications, such as regression analysis, linear programming, graph theory and networks, and principal component analysis.

description.zh:
本課程介紹環境之物理及人因相關因素對人員生理及肌肉骨骼系統之影響。內容包括噪音與噪音防治、氣溫等大氣狀況、振動與加速度、環境照明、人體計測與工作/工作空間設計等相關內容。課程目的在使修課學生了解工業環境與作業負荷對於人員之影響，進而於職場建立有效之因應對策。使學生能夠
a. 瞭解工作場所主要人因工程危害因子(包括採光照明、噪音振動、極端溫濕環境、異常氣壓等物理因子及肌肉骨骼危害因子)、法規要求、量測/計算方法、評估與控制策略、以及相對應的預防措施。
b. 具有評估及分析工業環境物理性與肌肉骨骼危害因子及擬訂其控制及預防對策的能力。
description.en: This course introduces physical and musculoskeletal effects of various environmental and ergonomic factors on humans. Lectures cover topics of noise and noise control, environmental temperature, vibration and acceleration measurements, environmental illumination, and work design. This course aims to cultivate students to identify different types of ergonomic risk factors (e.g. luminance, extreme temperatures, abnormal pressure, noise, vibration, musculoskeletal hazards) that can present in the work environment and to learn the related regulation requirements, risk assessment tools, and hazard control strategies.

description.zh: 機器視覺檢測乃結合光學設備 ` 影像處理 ` 與電腦輔助計算處理 , 藉由擷取受測物影像之特徵進行後續各種應用(如檢測 ` 辯識等)。 為確保機器視覺應用之精確度及速度,受測物影像必須依用途進行不同前處理以突顯特徵 , 後以不同之演算法則判斷之擷取特徵是否符合應用要求。 機器視覺近年來大量使用於各產業,除提昇製造業之產品品質外,對人身安全認證之生物科技亦功不可沒 。
description.en: Machine vision has been extensively used in inspection and biometrics in recent years. This course provides the fundamentals and practical applications of machine vision for graduate students. Increasing the knowledge and capability in machine vision for a well-trained industrial engineer is the final goal of this course.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技四年級下學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In second semester, Senior students also can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit.  For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in.  Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 以專題設計方式，訓練學生獨立企劃、分析、評斷、組織、歸納與創新之思考，並實際演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組或獨自完成一設計主題，設計成果須經公開展示且展覽形式需事前提送系所審核通過。上學期課程以題目界定、資料收集、分析調查、結論定義、構想發展及草模提交等為教學內容，下學期則進行細部設計、模型製作、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容,以培養專業設計之能力。
description.en: Studio in product design for the senior. Students are expected to exhibit a full range of professional competence and facility in designing advanced products and component complexes of broad scope. The design results must be publicly displayed and the exhibition format must be submitted to the department for review and approval. All phases of each project design are brought to a professional level under supervision of the director. This course puts emphasis on presentation techniques, including verbal, visual, and written. A project report is required.

description.zh: 以專題設計方式，訓練學生獨立企劃、分析、評斷、組織、歸納與創新之思考，並實際演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組或獨自完成一設計主題，設計成果須經公開展示且展覽形式需事前提送系所審核通過。上學期課程以題目界定、資料收集、分析調查、結論定義、構想發展及草模提交等為教學內容，下學期則進行細部設計、模型製作、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容,以培養專業設計之能力。
description.en: Studio in product design for the senior. Students are expected to exhibit a full range of professional competence and facility in designing advanced products and component complexes of broad scope. The design results must be publicly displayed and the exhibition format must be submitted to the department for review and approval. All phases of each project design are brought to a professional level under supervision of the director. This course puts emphasis on presentation techniques, including verbal, visual, and written. A project report is required.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技四年級下學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In second semester, Senior students also can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit.  For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in.  Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
description.en:
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

syllabi.outline:
本課程(Thesis Design)以研究式設計(Research Design)為基礎，於設計中對空間、環境、構築進行反思，提出不同之空間想像與落實方案，並積極參與實質空間之運作過程，促進與實務領域之相互參照。

本課程除了做為畢業生的空間技術專業的總體檢，也透過畢業設計中以自由意識主動發現空間機會的具體設計作為，以培養學生未來邁入職場的倫理觀與態度，包含邁向專業實踐應具備的毅力，對空間、環境與社會的關懷與理解力，以及探索空間契機與挖掘技術問題解決方案之能力。課程期盼學生畢業後具備創造美好而正義的空間的能力，朝向空間專業者與行動者。

syllabi.notes:
1. 本課程修課資格為大三上下學期建築設計皆通過始取得修課資格。
2. 本課程為小組指導制，鑑於成績考核的公平性和客觀性，制定嚴謹的成績考核辦法（分為設計專業能力，以及專業紀律與倫理領部分），於每學年開學召開課程公開說明會說明之，辦法如有不周或疑義，交由指導老師召開教學會議決議之。
3. 本課程所有有關課程公告，皆發布於專用社群平台-FB社團上，修課同學需隨時關注社團動態。
4. 本課程以一整學年進行完整的畢業設計（從自選命題和分析研究、設計目的、空間計畫擬定、至自選基地與設計條件制定、設計方法建構、和設計策略和建築設計發展等）：
4.1 上、下學期為連續性設計操作，上學期不及格則無法續修下學期。
4.2 如上、下學期中任何一學期未能及格，於新學年皆需從上學期開始參與整年全部的教學活動內容，包括重新選定指導老師、擬定畢業設計題目、交評圖......等等所有上課與教學活動。
5. 如上學期表現不理想，而以60分及格通過的學生（於上學期末會收到總召老師的私訊通知），於下學期開學週的評圖仍未達預定進展和品質，經正式教學會議討論為不具有繼續發展畢業設計程度者，將予以勸導退選下學期建築設計課程。

本課程(Thesis Design)以研究式設計(Research Design)為核心，於設計中對空間、環境、構築進行反思，提出不同之空間想像與落實方案，並積極參與實質空間之運作過程，促進與實務領域之相互參考。 
本課程除了做為畢業生的空間技術專業的總體檢，也透過畢業設計中以自由意識主動發現空間機會的具體設計作為，以培養學生未來邁入職場的倫理觀與態度，包含邁向專業實踐應具備的毅力，對空間、環境與社會的關懷與理解力，以及探索空間契機與挖掘技術問題解決方案之能力。課程期盼學生畢業後具備創造美好而正義的空間的能力，朝向空間專業者與行動者。
課程之成果為具備建築或空間意義之設計作品，其格式不限某種既定框架。內容應包含時空脈絡分析、議題探討、設計策略、研究或方法論、特定媒材之設計成果。
Taking Research Design as the core, the course, Thesis Design, revisits space, environment, and construction, for proposing different imagination for places and relative implementation, so as to help students participate in the operation of physical space, as well as enhance cross-reference between the field of practice and academic training. 
In addition to a final examination of spatial techniques in professional program, this course breeds ethics and passionate attitudes into students for further professional practice, through the specific form of thesis design in which freedom of conscious initiative is provoked to find opportunities for certain spaces. Those that should be equipped with students through this course are the perseverance towards professional practice, the ability to program the space, to understand the society and environment, as well as to explore spatial opportunity and strategies for problem solving.

本課程除了做為畢業生的空間技術專業的總體檢，也透過畢業設計中以自由意識主動發現空間機會的具體設計作為，以培養學生未來邁入職場的倫理觀與態度，包含邁向專業實踐應具備的毅力，對空間、環境與社會的關懷與理解力，以及探索空間契機與挖掘技術問題解決方案之能力。課程期盼學生畢業後具備創造美好而正義的空間的能力，朝向空間專業者與行動者。
課程之成果為具備建築或空間意義之設計作品，其格式不限某種既定框架。內容應包含時空脈絡分析、議題探討、設計策略、研究或方法論、特定媒材之設計成果。
Taking Research Design as the core, the course, Thesis Design, revisits space, environment, and construction, for proposing different imagination for places and relative implementation, so as to help students participate in the operation of physical space, as well as enhance cross-reference between the field of practice and academic training. 
In addition to a final examination of spatial techniques in professional program, this course breeds ethics and passionate attitudes into students for further professional practice, through the specific form of thesis design in which freedom of conscious initiative is provoked to find opportunities for certain spaces. Those that should be equipped with students through this course are the perseverance towards professional practice, the ability to program the space, to understand the society and environment, as well as to explore spatial opportunity and strategies for problem solving. 
The outcome of this course is expected to be an instinct desig

syllabi.outline:
本課程(Thesis Design)以研究式設計(Research Design)為基礎，於設計中對空間、環境、構築進行反思，提出不同之空間想像與落實方案，並積極參與實質空間之運作過程，促進與實務領域之相互參照。

本課程除了做為畢業生的空間技術專業的總體檢，也透過畢業設計中以自由意識主動發現空間機會的具體設計作為，以培養學生未來邁入職場的倫理觀與態度，包含邁向專業實踐應具備的毅力，對空間、環境與社會的關懷與理解力，以及探索空間契機與挖掘技術問題解決方案之能力。課程期盼學生畢業後具備創造美好而正義的空間的能力，朝向空間專業者與行動者。

課程之成果為具備建築或空間意義之設計作品，其格式不限某種既定框架。內容應包含時空脈絡分析、議題探討、設計策略、研究或方法論、特定媒材之設計成果。

由於本課程為四年制建築系的最後一年，整合建築學與建築設計式課程最為關鍵的核心能力，並培養學生自主的建築關照、探索和執行能力，涵蓋 :
1.  指認建築命題、並學習如何透過該命題的研究和探究進行個人建築專業的思辨和論述。	
2.  認識建築物質與非物質之建構邏輯，以及如何發展出回應命題的個人建構建築的邏輯。	
3.  導入相關課程(建築史、建築理論、結構和構造、環境控制、景觀和都市設計等等)的知能，以建築設計整合相關建築學範疇。
4.  具有回應特定命題所需的獨立發展與建構設計過程的能力。
5.  具備關照和改善建築實質環境的能力，包括建築的社會性、產業內涵和審美的內涵。        

透過上述建築專業的素養養成，培養學生擁有對於使用的建築工具、設計方法、策略、和實務的評斷和執行能力，養成具有對建築專業省思和發展的實務能力。	

本課程一年的成果以校外公開展覽的形式，創造與建築實務、社會大眾和其他相關建築系的對話，學生透過展覽過程從企劃案、策展論述、工作流程與方法、經費、資源、與人力規劃、時程管控、展場軟硬體的規劃、到展場設計和施作、各種設備和空間介面整合、以及作品的呈現和溝通方式等等，一整年學生除了進行個人設計創作，同時學習團隊工作過程的溝通協調和磨合的合作技巧。而透過展覽，以作品作為和實務界和社會大眾對話的基礎，展現出四年的建築學習成果。

syllabi.notes:
1. 本課程修課資格為大三上下學期建築設計皆通過始取得修課資格。
2. 本課程為小組指導制，鑑於成績考核的公平性和客觀性，制定嚴謹的成績考核辦法（分為設計專業能力，以及專業紀律與倫理領部分），於每學年開學召開課程公開說明會說明之，辦法如有不周或疑義，交由指導老師召開教學會議決議之。
3. 本課程所有有關課程公告，皆發布於專用社群平台-FB社團上，修課同學需隨時關注社團動態。
4. 本課程以一整學年進行完整的畢業設計（從自選命題和分析研究、設計目的、空間計畫擬定、至自選基地與設計條件制定、設計方法建構、和設計策略和建築設計發展等）：  
    4.1   上、下學期為連續性設計操作，上學期不及格則無法續修下學期。
    4.2   如上、下學期中任何一學期未能及格，於新學年皆需從上學期開始參與整年全部的教學活動內容，包括重新選定指導老師、擬定畢業設計題目、交評圖......等等所有上課與教學活動。
5. 如上學期表現不理想，而以60分及格通過的學生（於上學期末會收到總召老師的私訊通知），於下學期開學週的評圖仍未達預定進展和品質，經正式教學會議討論為不具有繼續發展畢業設計程度者，將予以勸導退選下學期建築設計課程。

syllabi.outline:
本課程(Thesis Design)以研究式設計(Research Design)為核心，於設計中對空間、環境、構築進行反思，提出不同之空間想像與落實方案，並積極參與實質空間之運作過程，促進與實務領域之相互參考。 
本課程除了做為畢業生的空間技術專業的總體檢，也透過畢業設計中以自由意識主動發現空間機會的具體設計作為，以培養學生未來邁入職場的倫理觀與態度，包含邁向專業實踐應具備的毅力，對空間、環境與社會的關懷與理解力，以及探索空間契機與挖掘技術問題解決方案之能力。課程期盼學生畢業後具備創造美好而正義的空間的能力，朝向空間專業者與行動者。
課程之成果為具備建築或空間意義之設計作品，其格式不限某種既定框架。內容應包含時空脈絡分析、議題探討、設計策略、研究或方法論、特定媒材之設計成果。
Taking Research Design as the core, the course, Thesis Design, revisits space, environment, and construction, for proposing different imagination for places and relative implementation, so as to help students participate in the operation of physical space, as well as enhance cross-reference between the field of practice and academic training. 
In addition to a final examination of spatial techniques in professional program, this course breeds ethics and passionate attitudes into students for further professional practice, through the specific form of thesis design in which freedom of conscious initiative is provoked to find opportunities for certain spaces. Those that should be equipped with students through this course are the perseverance towards professional practice, the ability to program the space, to understand the society and environment, as well as to explore spatial opportunity and strategies for problem solving.

syllabi.outline:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

syllabi.outline:
本課程(Thesis Design)以研究式設計(Research Design)為核心，於設計中對空間、環境、構築進行反思，提出不同之空間想像與落實方案，並積極參與實質空間之運作過程，促進與實務領域之相互參考。 
本課程除了做為畢業生的空間技術專業的總體檢，也透過畢業設計中以自由意識主動發現空間機會的具體設計作為，以培養學生未來邁入職場的倫理觀與態度，包含邁向專業實踐應具備的毅力，對空間、環境與社會的關懷與理解力，以及探索空間契機與挖掘技術問題解決方案之能力。課程期盼學生畢業後具備創造美好而正義的空間的能力，朝向空間專業者與行動者。
課程之成果為具備建築或空間意義之設計作品，其格式不限某種既定框架。內容應包含時空脈絡分析、議題探討、設計策略、研究或方法論、特定媒材之設計成果。
Taking Research Design as the core, the course, Thesis Design, revisits space, environment, and construction, for proposing different imagination for places and relative implementation, so as to help students participate in the operation of physical space, as well as enhance cross-reference between the field of practice and academic training. 
In addition to a final examination of spatial techniques in professional program, this course breeds ethics and passionate attitudes into students for further professional practice, through the specific form of thesis design in which freedom of conscious initiative is provoked to find opportunities for certain spaces. Those that should be equipped with students through this course are the perseverance towards professional practice, the ability to program the space, to understand the society and environment, as well as to explore spatial opportunity and strategies for problem solving. 
The outcome of this course is expected to be an instinct desig

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技四年級下學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In second semester, Senior students also can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit.  For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in.  Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 本課程探討應用物件導向方法從事軟體設計的過程與步驟, 透過課程專題製作, 學者將學習以UML記載分析與設計之結果, 並使用一個物件導向語言(如Java或C++)實作之. 課程內容: 1. 物件導向模型 -- UML介紹 2. 物件導向程式語言與環境 3. 物件導向軟體發展週期 3.1 物件導向分析 - 需求分析, 使用個案, 觀念模型, 有限狀態模型 3.2 物件導向設計 - 實際使用個案, 合作圖, 類別圖, 設計模板, 3.3 程式撰寫 - 設計與程式之應對 4. 專題
description.en: This course familiarizes the students with the principles and techniques for object-oriented software development. The students will use UML and an object-oriented language such as Java or C++ to complete a term programming project. Course contents: 1. Object-oriented modeling with UML 2. Object-oriented languages and environments 3. Object-oriented software development process 3.1 Object-oriented analysis - requirement analysis, use case analysis, conceptual models, finite state machine models 3.2 Object-oriented design - real use cases, collaboration diagrams, class design diagrams, design patterns 3.3 Construction - mapping design to codes 4. Term project.

syllabi.schedule:
1. This course covers object-oriented modeling for software development. Materials covered include class models, state models, and interaction models in UML, a reference process model based on Unified process, implementation issues, and software engineering principles. This course is thinking and programming-intensive.
2. Students are required to complete a non-trivial software project. Only object-oriented languages such as C++/Java/C# are allowed. A project team may have 1-4 students. A single person team is allowed but is not encouraged.
3. There will be no exams; instead, there are 7 homework assignments, several in-class exercises, and two project reviews. All assignments turned in must be typed (handwriting will not be accepted).

name.en: Data Science Principles with Applications on Educational Data

description.zh: 資料科學是個跨領域的重要興新學科，其基本知識含括資訊、線性代數、機率與統計等，相關技術可應用在許多領域上，包含教育領域。本課程從學科整體介紹開始，討論資料科學中各主要階段的相關議題：包含資料搜尋擷取、資料整理與問題發想、數理知識回顧與討論、資料分析建模與方法、資料呈現與視覺化等。除課堂上講授與討論外，課程亦著重如何實際應用所學，將使用教育資料並以小組方式進行議題發想與分析實作的學期專題。此外，為強化健全資料視覺呈現課題，在實作專題中課程亦著重學生報告能力的培養，希望培育出全方位的資料科學人才。
description.en: Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce the valuable knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The topics include data processing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. The course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with fundamental related knowledge and the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation-collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The course training is toward equipping students with the mindset and the ability to solve problems with the learned techniques on educational data. In addition, students need to practice the presentation for the findings of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually.

syllabi.outline:
資料科學是個跨領域的重要興新學科，其基本知識含括資訊、線性代數、機率與統計等，相關技術可應用在許多領域上，包含教育領域。本課程從學科整體介紹開始，討論資料科學中各主要階段的相關議題：包含資料搜尋擷取、資料整理與問題發想、數理知識回顧與討論、資料分析建模與方法、資料呈現與視覺化等。除課堂上講授與討論外，課程亦著重如何實際應用所學，將使用教育資料並以小組方式進行議題發想與分析實作的學期專題。此外，為強化健全資料視覺呈現課題，在實作專題中課程亦著重學生報告能力的培養，希望培育出全方位的資料科學人才。
Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce or create the valuable information and knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The related topics include data processing and computing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. This course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with the fundamental related knowledge as well as the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation- collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The training of this course is toward equipping students with the general mindset and the ability to solve problems practically with the learned techniques on educational data with project groups. In addition, the students also need to practice the presentation for the findings and results of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually. The major objective of this course is to cultivate talents in data science.

name.en: The Marketing and Management of Cultural Industry

description.zh: 本課程旨在以文化事業發展為目標，將品牌價值極大化作為核心，分析新創品牌之經營策略，進而設計與執行品牌之行銷方案，以及創造出文化產業中的優勢品牌與品牌資產。
description.en: The course is designed to target the culture vocational development, emphasize the maximum of a brand value, decompose the strategy of a new brand value, design and implement its marketing programs, and then create the advantages of the brand equity in the cultural industry.

syllabi.outline:
本課程配合USR計畫，以文化事業發展為核心目標，結合理論基礎、實務案例與產業觀察，探討文化事業價值極大化之策略與方法。課程將分析文化事業之經營與管理模式，並引導學生規劃、設計與執行品牌行銷方案，進而形塑文化產業中的競爭優勢品牌與品牌資產，培養學生於文化產業領域之企劃、分析與簡報能力。
This course, aligned with the University Social Responsibility (USR) initiative, aims to promote the development of cultural enterprises as its core objective. By integrating theoretical foundations, practical case studies, and industry observations, it explores strategies and approaches for maximizing the value of cultural enterprises. The course analyzes the operational and managerial models of cultural enterprises and guides students in planning, designing, and implementing brand marketing strategies. Through this process, students will develop competitive brands and brand equity within the cultural industries, while cultivating their capabilities in project planning, analysis, and professional presentation.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹人工智慧（AI）領域包含各種機器學習的開發與實作，特別關注如何使用Python進行模型的開發與部屬。課程將涵蓋深度學習的基本概念、常見的AI框架（如TensorFlow、Keras），並深入探討如何利用Python編程語言來設計、訓練與優化AI模型。此外，課程也將重點討論人工智慧在開發與部屬過程中需要考量的安全性問題，從資料安全與可稽核性，AI透明度，模型加密與攻擊防範等，提供學生一套全面的安全檢核框架。學生將學習如何確保AI系統在實際應用中具備高度的安全性與可靠性，並瞭解如何在AI部屬的不同階段識別與解決潛在的安全風險。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the development and implementation of various machine learning techniques in the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI), with a particular focus on how to use Python for model development and deployment. The course will cover the fundamental concepts of deep learning, popular AI frameworks (such as TensorFlow and Keras), and will delve into how to use the Python programming language to design, train, and optimize AI models. Additionally, the course will emphasize the security considerations necessary during the development and deployment of AI systems, including data security and auditability, AI transparency, model encryption, and attack prevention. Students will be provided with a comprehensive security framework to evaluate these concerns. They will also learn how to ensure the high security and reliability of AI systems in practical applications, and how to identify and mitigate potential security risks at various stages of AI deployment.

description.zh: 本課程旨在以專題設計方式，訓練學生確認並建立需求、發展設計選擇方案、製作設計的互動形式、設計評估的專業知能，並以設計專案方式演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組合作或獨自創作完成一媒體設計主題。上學期課程以題目釐定、資料蒐集、分析調查、設計定義、構想發展、程式設計、雛型製作等活動為教學內容；下學期則進行觀察測試、使用性評估、程式調校、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容，以培養學生具備互動設計專題製作之專業知能。
description.en: Through project design, the course prepares students to confirm the needs of design, develop alternatives of media design projects, create interactive modes, and evaluate design performance through independent study or cooperative learning. In the first semester, learning materials of the course include subject clarification, data collection, analysis and investigation, design definition, concept development, programming, and prototyping. In the second semester, learning materials of the course include observation and testing, usability evaluation, programming debug, report editing, exhibition and design report submission. Accordingly, students will be ready for professional competencies of interaction design projects.

This course applies design and programming into interaction design projects relating to media design. To achieve this goal, students will familiarize the theories, methodology and implications of interactive media design in this course. By interaction design issues, students create and implement ideas by brainstorming through independent study or cooperative learning. For competition without any gap, industry-academic cooperation is one way to prepare student’s critical competencies same as the desired competencies required by the industry.

description.zh: 本課程旨在以專題設計方式，訓練學生確認並建立需求、發展設計選擇方案、製作設計的互動形式、設計評估的專業知能，並以設計專案方式演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組合作或獨自創作完成一視覺傳達設計主題。上學期課程以題目釐定、資料蒐集、分析調查、設計定義、構想發展、程式設計、雛型製作等活動為教學內容；下學期則進行觀察測試、使用性評估、程式調校、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容，以培養學生具備互動設計專題製作之專業知能。
description.en: Through project design, the course prepares students to confirm the needs of design, develop alternatives of visual communication design projects, create interactive modes, and evaluate design performance through independent study or cooperative learning. In the first semester, learning materials of the course include subject clarification, data collection, analysis and investigation, design definition, concept development, programming, and prototyping. In the second semester, learning materials of the course include observation and testing, usability evaluation, programming debug, report editing, exhibition and design report submission. Accordingly, students will be ready for professional competencies of interaction design projects.

description.zh: 本課程旨在規劃設計創業的可行方向與有效管理運作創意產業，當今文創的數位內容產業，其中App與微電影的盛行，使更多文創工作者願意出來創業，此等微型工作室或小型SOHO族公司，正可滿足創業者實現其夢想與抱負的機會。因此，有效執行與管理創立的事業，並能夠永續經營與運作，為一重要課題。本課程包括創業條件分析、創業風險、財務控管、設計品質、設計溝通與策略、設計行銷與設計聯盟等。本課程之評量是以分組討論與創業企劃報告為標準。
description.en: This course intends to plan directions and manage a design firm in creative industries. So far, the digital content industries attract a lot of small company or SOHO workers to run their own office in order to develop App or Microcinema. This kind of working model can satisfy with their dream and ambition. Therefore, venturing and managing a design firm becomes a significant issue while students will face with their career development once they graduated. This course concludes venturing condition and analysis, venture risk, financial control, design quality, design communication and strategy, design marketing and design alliances. The assessment of this course depends upon the group discussion and venture planning report.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技四年級下學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。

description.en: Through project design, the course prepares students to confirm the needs of design, develop alternatives of design projects, create interactive modes, and evaluate design performance through independent study or cooperative learning. In the first semester, learning materials of the course include subject clarification, data collection, analysis and investigation, design definition, concept development, programming, and prototyping. In the second semester, learning materials of the course include observation and testing, usability evaluation, programming debug, report editing, exhibition and design report submission. Accordingly, students will be ready for professional competencies of interaction design projects.

syllabi.outline: The purpose of this course is to train students to independently plan, analyze, evaluate, summarize, and think creatively through the use of project design. Through an in-depth exploration of life styles, current trends, and technological developments, students will practice the process of project design and become familiar with the knowledge and techniques of integrating design and technology. In this program, students work in groups to complete an integrated media design theme, and finally present their work in both on-campus and off-campus public exhibitions.

description.en: This course intends to plan directions and manage a design firm in creative industries. So far, the digital content industries attract a lot of small company or SOHO workers to run their own office in order to develop App or Microcinema. This kind of working model can satisfy with their dream and ambition. Therefore, venturing and managing a design firm becomes a significant issue while students will face with their career development once they graduated. This course concludes venturing condition and analysis, venture risk, financial control, design quality, design communication and strategy, design marketing and design alliances. The assessment of this course depends upon the group discussion and venture planning report.

description.zh:
一、本課程凡十六學分，供學生前四年修習之用。
二、本課程教學目標旨在透過適當選文，增進學生閱讀、鑑賞與寫作能力，誘使學生對我國重要典籍及傳統文化有一粗淺認識，並從而培植其人文素養，啟發其愛國、愛家、愛人之情操。
三、本課程所選範文，類別遍於經史子集，時代該及古今。編者於每篇選文，除有生字、難詞、典故之註釋，提意、出處、著作背景之說明，而作者生平、作品、風格及其地位、事功，亦有簡要之評述。
四、本課程亦講授公文及書信。公文之內容包括函、簽、公告、報告等各類常用公文的作法與寫作要領，並兼及處理公文之注意事項。書信之內容包括傳統及現代書信的寫法與寫作要領，並兼及便條與做為便條使用之名片的寫法。
description.en:
a) The course is designed for the students to study in the first four years, with a sum total of 16 credit hours. 
b) Course Objective: Through proper readings, the students will increase their ability to read, write and even appreciate literary works, and better understand significant books of ancient times and of traditional culture. With better development of humanity, they are likely to have more sense of loving the country, family and people. 
c) The Readings are adopted from a diversity of sources, including Classics, History Books, individual writings and literary anthology-ancient or modern. In addition to the explanation and discussion of vocabulary items, difficult words, classic allusions, main ideas, origin and the time background of the articles, a brief comment is also made on the authors' life, their works, literary styles/status. 
d)The course is to teach students how to write and handle official correspondences and social letters.

description.en: This junior-college English program consists of four-year English courses, with the purposes to develop fluency in reading and writing, and to improve listening and speaking abilities. The communicative approach and the whole language philosophy are thus adopted to implement the curriculum. In these courses, students have plenty of opportunities to take part in role-plays, oral presentations, pair work, small-group discussions and whole-class discussions for communicative purposes; they have good opportunities to express their feelings and thoughts in their essays and journal entries. A variety of reading, writing, and oral communication tasks are provided with a view to developing students' reading, writing, and oral communication skills, and to facilitating their using appropriate, effective learning strategies to accomplish learning tasks. In a word, the purpose of this curriculum is to motivate students to learn English, and to help them gradually become confident and competent use

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。五專一、二、三年級實施普通班體育正課教學。五專四年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、網球、太極拳、體適能、足球等。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: The teaching goal is to establish students’ healthy lifestyle, sportsmanship, teamwork and exercise habit. In First, Second, and Third grade students are taught many sport skills in the same class. In Fourth grade, we are offering specific sports to the students, like Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Tennis, Tai Chi Chuan, Physical Fitness and martial arts. Students can choose they are interested.

syllabi.outline:
一、 課程目標
技能發展：使學生掌握籃球、排球、撞球及羽球之基礎運動技能與正確動作機制。
規則認知：深入了解各項球類之比賽規則、裁判法及實戰戰術運用。
體能促進：透過系統化教學與體能檢測（如 140 公尺折返跑），提升學生心肺適能與敏捷性。
素養培育：建立良好的運動精神、團隊合作意識，並養成器材搬運與場地維護之責任感。

二、 教學核心內容
本課程採取「模組化教學」，各項運動依序進行訓練：
籃球模組：提升個人技術（運球上籃、BEEF 投籃機制）與小組配合。
排球模組：建立團隊防守觀念（低高手傳球、攔網）與六人制對抗。
撞球模組：專注於擊球姿勢、架桿穩定度、瞄準原理及基本桿法應用。
羽球模組：強化握拍步法與控球技術（長球、殺球、挑球）。

三、 課堂要求與安全守則
服裝規範：上課須穿著運動服裝及運動鞋（撞球課亦同），未符規定者依平時成績扣分。
安全宣導：嚴禁在無教師指導下進行高強度對抗；撞球教學時嚴禁揮舞球桿。
場地維護：課程前後需協助器材搬運與清點，維持運動場地（及撞球布面）整潔。
特殊狀況：如遇生理期、受傷或身體不適，應於課前主動告知老師，以安排替代學習。

description.en: The primary focus of Workplace Learning Curriculum is to provide students with introductory units on communication, collaboration, analytical thinking, leadership and responsibility, self-management, curiosity and motivation. The 7 skills are a framework for talking about professional skills within the P-TECH model. We are calling out these skills for the IBM P-TECH schools in hopes that our students will begin to develop fluency in discussing them, which will be highly valuable in distinguishing their readiness for internships and?? jobs from their competition.

先修要求：
『""強烈建議""』修課同學須具備基礎50音、助詞使用及動詞變化原理(日檢程度約N5~N4)，以利跟上授課節奏。
本課程旨在培養學生閱讀日文科技文獻的實務能力。課程設計循序漸進，從基礎的輸入法工具與線上查詢技巧切入，進而系統性解析助詞、動詞變化在科技文章中的應用。透過拆解常用句型與長難句，並輔以科技文化的介紹，期使修讀者能掌握自行解讀說明書、技術報告與專業文獻的關鍵技巧。

description.zh: 本課程介紹基本的金屬切削原理及其實務應用。本課程包含以下各項主題：(1)工具機與加工操作，(2)基本切削力學，(3)金屬切削溫度，(4)刀具壽命與刀具材料，(5)切削液與切削表面粗度，(6)金屬切削操作經濟學，(7)切屑控制，(8)研磨加工，(9)金屬切削實驗方法，(10)CAD/CAM與數控加工，(11)精密切削技術等。
description.en: This course is an introduction to basic metal-cutting principles and their practical applications. This course includes the following topics: (1) machine tools and machining operations, (2) fundamental metal-cutting mechanics, (3) temperature effect in metal machining, (4) tool lifetime and tool materials, (5) cutting coolants and surface roughness, (6) economics of meta-cutting operations, (7) chip control, (8) grinding, (9) experimental methods on metal machining, (10) CAD/CAM and numerical control (NC) machining, (11) techniques for precision machining.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹綠色科技及其在二十一世紀對人類生活的影響，內容包括現今幾個最重要的「潔能」與「節能」科技，以及一些「環保」相關科技。「潔能科技」包括風力能、太陽能、水力能、地球內部能源、生質能、路面能、聲音能、燃料電池、電動車等；「節能科技」包括節能住宅、變頻空調等；「環保科技」則包括碳回收主題。介紹內容包括各項技術原理介紹及其發展概況。
description.en: This course aims to introduce green technologies and their influences on human life in the 21st century. The contents consist of the most important topics about the clean energy and energy conservation technologies. The clean energy technology consists of wind energy, solar energy, hydraulic energy, earth interior energy, bioenergy, roadway energy, sound energy, fuel cell, electric vehicles, and so on. The energy conservation technology consists energy save buildings, variable frequency air-condition, etc.. The environmental protesting technology includes carbon recapture etc.. This course will talk the technical principles and their general developing situations.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在探討綠色科技的發展趨勢及其對人類社會與環境的深遠影響。課程核心不僅涵蓋核心再生能源（如風能、太陽能、水力能、生質能與地熱能）與節能減碳技術之工程原理與發展概況，更導入「設計思考 (Design Thinking)」與聯合國永續發展目標 (SDGs)。本課程將帶領學生跳脫純技術框架，透過跨域工作坊、在地場域走讀與問題導向學習 (PBL)，引導學生從真實的使用者需求出發，將工程與綠色技術轉化為具備防災韌性之實體解決方案。期許能培育出具備永續思維、創新實作能力與社會責任的跨域工程專才。

description.en: This course is one of the advanced core courses for the Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The aim of this course is, via the introduction of advanced intelligent rail system, to have the students realize thoroughly the development trend of futuristic rail industry, and subsequently, to encourage the students into the research and development of various application systems for intelligent railway. This course is a joint lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors to our participant students include R&D experts from relevant fields in intelligent rail industry. In their term reports, the students will have to demonstrate the prototypes of their projects and to be reviewed by the invited senior professionals from rail industry. The prerequisites for taking this course will be determined based on the background of students with different majors.

description.zh: 本課程設計的是鏈結AOI與雷射加工產業，與智能廠接軌共同來解決產業實際應產業之問題與需求。設計課程分成三階段，分別為課程講授、業師實作討論、業師實務專題，三階段前後銜接，循序漸進課程讓學全接觸AOI與雷射加工技術。第一部分課程講授主要為基礎之理論傳授，訂立實驗目標、計畫實驗過程、課後評量，予以教學反饋；第二部分實作與討論，採讓學進雷射相關的實驗設計與操作，融會貫通所學理論，培育其實作技能，藉由組與業師討論，練習規劃實驗，實驗安排由簡入深，從認識機台種類系統之光路架設、最終參數的調整等，並藉由組討論記錄表，予以教學回饋；第三部分為企業命題之實務專題，請業師提供產業實務問題，並由產業負責專題內容，讓學了解前業界發展向、業界現況與製程瓶頸等，將理論課程更實務鏈結到雷射應，期末進實務成果發表展與評選，培育其解決實務問題之能。
description.en: The first part of the course, classroom instruction, primarily focuses on imparting foundational theory, setting experimental objectives, planning the experimental process, conducting post-assessments, and providing instructional feedback. The second part involves hands-on practical work and discussions. Students engage in experimental design and operations related to laser technology, integrating the theoretical knowledge acquired earlier. Through group discussions with industry experts, they learn to plan experiments, starting with understanding different types of machinery, optical path configurations, and parameter adjustments. syllabi.outline:
本課程涵蓋兩部分: 基礎知識講解與實驗課程
基礎知識講解包含:
1. 現代半導體製程：本課程旨在讓學生建立半導體製程的基礎知識，並深入了解晶圓製造過程中的關鍵技術，包括微影製程、蝕刻技術、熱製程、化學氣相沉積、摻雜技術及金屬化與互連技術。
2. 電子散熱溫控技術：本課程旨在介紹目前電子散熱溫控技術的基本原理與模擬應用。學生將學習電子散熱、控制機制及其在熱管理中的應用。
實驗課程包含:
1. 雷射加工技術應用於雷射鑽孔，使用五軸高精密飛秒雷射設備於晶圓後段檢測量測元件之微孔加工。
2. 半導體製程中的應用，特別是與微氣泡技術和氮氧化物（NOx）去除技術的結合。

description.en: ASTM Committee F42 on Additive Manufacturing Technologies was formed in 2009. The myriad process names into seven standardized terms. description.zh: 介紹各種車輛使用先進駕駛輔助系統(Advanced Driver Assistance Systems, ADAS)、自駕車及車聯網設備的感測器及其應用。自駕車及車聯網亦需要多種感測器之支援，皆需要對應的感測器系統。同時也介紹先進工業儀器設備的感測器及其連結網路，包含運動控制相關感測器、視覺相關感測器、力量相關感測器與製程監控相關感測器四大主軸。
description.en: This course introduces the sensors used in Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS), autonomous vehicle and car-interconnected devices. These systems need the corresponding sensors in the real implementation. The sensors used in the industrial instruments, for motion, vision, force detection and process monitor, are also included in this course.

syllabi.outline:
本課程共分為八個主題，包含簡述感測器之分類及近年技術發展趨勢，及六大常見感測器類別之介紹(如光電感測器、磁感測器、濕度感測器、溫度感測器、超音波感測器、及壓力感測器等)，此外也將講述MEMS技術於微型感測器之應用及電子感官分析裝置。
This course is divided into eight topics, including an overview of sensor classifications and recent technological development trends, as well as an introduction to six common types of sensors (such as photoelectric sensors, magnetic sensors, humidity sensors, temperature sensors, ultrasonic transducers, and pressure sensors). Additionally, the course will cover the application of MEMS technology in micro-sensors, electronic sensory analysis devices, and smart sensing applications integrated with IoT technology.

Introduction to Photoelectric Sensors (including photodiodes, phototransistors, photoresistors, infrared sensors, optocouplers, optical interrupters, and encoders).

03/16	光電式感測器介紹(光二極體、光電晶體、光敏電阻、紅外光感測器、光耦合器、光斷路器、編碼器等)
Introduction to Photoelectric Sensors (including photodiodes, phototransistors, photoresistors, infrared sensors, optocouplers, breakers, and encoders).
Week 5
03/23	磁感測器與微機電感測器(霍爾元件、磁阻元件、渦電流式近接感測器、差動變壓器、SQUID、磁抗效應感測器、磁柵尺)
Magnetic Sensors and MEMS Sensors (including Hall elements, magnetoresistive elements, eddy current proximity sensors, differential transformers, SQUIDs, magneto-impedance sensors, and magnescale).

Magnetic Sensors and MEMS Sensors (including Hall elements, magnetoresistive elements, eddy current proximity sensors, differential transformers, SQUIDs, magneto-impedance sensors, and magnescale).
Week 7

Week 11

Ultrasonic transducers and Piezoelectric Sensors (Ultrasonic Principles, Piezoelectric Effect, Ultrasonic Oscillation Circuits, and Receiving Circuits).
Week 12
05/11	壓力感測器(半導體型壓力感測器、驅動電路、放大電路、加速度感測器)
Pressure Sensors (Semiconductor Pressure Sensors, Drive Circuits, Amplifier Circuits, and Accelerometers).

Pressure Sensors (Semiconductor Pressure Sensors, Drive Circuits, Amplifier Circuits, and Accelerometers).
Week 14

Smart Sensing System Planning and Practical Design.

Case Studies of Smart Sensing and IoT Applications (Railway System Applications).
Week 17

PLC課程：本課程主要說明可程式邏輯控制器(PLC)之基本操作原理與實務應用；課程內容包括：PLC基本概念、PLC系統介面、以及常用致動器與感測器等PLC關鍵組件與整合應用。藉由PLC專案模擬，使得修習本課程同學們可深刻體會PLC之設計與應用，並且培養與建立PLC機電控制系統設計之基礎能力。

description.en:
Course Title:Automatic Control Practice
Description:This course is first to introduce the basic concepts of
control systems and the mathematical background, second, state the
transfer function, block diagram and signal  flow graph, third,
discuss the mathematical modeling of control systems and elements, and
forth, describe the time-domain analysis, root locus techniques and
frequency-domain of control systems, and then to measure the character
of control systems, Finally, the design of control system will be
introduced.

syllabi.outline:
Feedback control is an interdisciplinary field in that control is applied to systems in every conceivable area of engineering.  Consequently, control is an active field of research and hence there is a steady influx of new concepts, ideas, and techniques.  Some of these elements develop to the point where they join the list of things every control engineer must know.  This is the course where students, especially EE majors, begin to acquire both traditional and modern topics in the field of control systems.  The core material covered in this course is to provide ample motivation, insight, and understanding in classical control.
The goals of the course can be summarized as below:
	Master design as well as analysis techniques.  Find good feedback control design with clear understanding.  Moreover, seeing them used.
	Learn to solve problems by constructing effective algorithms in computer languages like Matlab and Simulink.
The course is presented in a standard format of lectures, readings, and problem sets.  In addition to a midterm and a final examination, there will be a number of homework  quizzes equally spaced over the term, all in-class.  The quiz questions are based on assigned problem sets in the textbook.  All quizzes/examinations will be closed book.  Class participation is evaluated through attendance (7 points) and class interactions (3 points).  Full attendance students get 7 points.  One point deduction per missing lecture.  Each class interaction with correct answer gets 1 point.  Maximum 3 points for class interactions.  The lecture will be based mainly, but not entirely, on material in the textbook.  Students are especially encouraged to read related textbooks in the field of control systems in addition to lecture notes of the course.

Remarks 備註：
	Course lectures are offered in Chinese. 本課程為中文授課，惟教科書、講義、試題皆以英語呈現。
	Textbook should be purchased asap as it is a very good reference for study in robotics. 教科書應儘快購買。
	Course lecture notes can only be downloaded via iStudy website and are protected under the Intellectual Property law.  Lecture notes are NOT freely distributed. 課程講義可於iStudy網站下載，請尊重智慧財產權，不可散布課程相關檔案及文件。
	All announcements will be made via iStudy website. Class group via Line will be established in the first class. 所有課程相關訊息將公告於北科i學園+、並於第一週上課時成立課程Line群組。

description.zh: 數學基礎簡介，轉換函數，訊號流程圖，實際系統數學模式之求得，狀態方程式，線性系統之穩定度分析，控制系統之時域分析，根值軌跡圖，控制系統之頻域分析，時域及頻域下之控制器設計。
description.en:
Course Title:Automatic Control Practice
Description:This course is first to introduce the basic concepts of
control systems and the mathematical background, second, state the
transfer function, block diagram and signal  flow graph, third,
discuss the mathematical modeling of control systems and elements, and
forth, describe the time-domain analysis, root locus techniques and
frequency-domain of control systems, and then to measure the character
of control systems, Finally, the design of control system will be
introduced.

syllabi.outline:
數學基礎簡介，轉換函數，訊號流程圖，實際系統數學模式之求得，狀態方程式，線性系統之穩定度分析，控制系統之時域分析，根值軌跡圖，控制系統之頻域分析，時域及頻域下之控制器設計。
Teaching Topics: Transfer function, time response, equivalent systems, stability, steady-state errors, root locus techniques, frequency response techniques, controller design, and state space approach

Week 9: Midterm Exam
Week 10: Steady-State Errors (Ch. 7)
Week 11-13: Root Locus Techniques & Design (Ch. 8-9)
Week 14-16: Frequency Response Techniques & Design (Ch. 10-11)
Week 17: State Space Approach (Ch. 3, 12)
Week 18: Final Exam

description.en:
Course Title:Automatic Control Practice
Description:This course is first to introduce the basic concepts of
control systems and the mathematical background, second, state the
transfer function, block diagram and signal  flow graph, third,
discuss the mathematical modeling of control systems and elements, and
forth, describe the time-domain analysis, root locus techniques and
frequency-domain of control systems, and then to measure the character
of control systems, Finally, the design of control system will be
introduced.

讓學生學習文獻之蒐集方法與整理，以便瞭解學術論文製作方式，培養學生獨立自主探討一個理論或技術上的問題，並經由實驗設計及資料之判讀更深入專業領域。
A course allows students collect and oranize literature information and them design their own experiments. An independent research capability can be developed through out this learning process.
syllabi.schedule:
主題選擇與討論：

第1至2週：介紹課程目標與內容，引導學生選擇研究主題，討論各種可能的研究方向。
文獻回顧：

第3至6週：教導學生如何進行文獻回顧，搜尋相關文獻，閱讀與理解先前研究的成果，並撰寫文獻回顧部分。
研究方法與設計：

第7至10週：介紹不同的研究方法與設計，包括定量、定性、實驗、問卷調查等，指導學生選擇適合的方法，並撰寫研究方法部分。
資料收集與分析：

第11至14週：指導學生進行資料收集，例如實地調查、實驗執行、問卷調查等，並學習適當的資料分析技術，如統計分析、質性分析等。
結果呈現與討論：

第15至18週：引導學生分析研究結果，撰寫研究結果報告，討論研究發現的意義與影響，並與文獻回顧部分進行比較與討論。
撰寫與終稿：

第19至20週：指導學生進行專題研究報告的撰寫，包括引言、文獻回顧、研究方法、結果與討論、結論等部分，並完成最終版本的報告。
成果展示：

第21至22週：安排學生進行成果展示，例如口頭報告、海報展示等，分享他們的研究成果與發現。
評量與評分：

整個學期：根據學生的參與度、作業完成情況、研究報告品質等進行評量與評分。
課程進度可以根據學校的學期長度和每週上課時數進行調整，同時要考慮到彈性，以應對可能出現的延遲或加速的情況。

description.zh: 分子生物學為現代生物科技尤其是基因工程的基礎學問。課程內容深入探討生物的四大類分子：DNA及RNA，蛋白質，脂質，以及醣類分子。並且詳細探討現代分子生物學之中心思想，包含DNA 複製、轉錄、轉譯等。
description.en: Molecular biology is the fundamental of modern biotechnology, especially genetic engineering. Students learn what are DNA, RNA, protein, lipid, and carbohydrate and how do they work in this course. The central dogma of modern molecular biology, including DNA replication, transcription, and translation, is the major topic of this course.

syllabi.outline:
Special Notice:
同學好，今年由於系上有教師休假，併班上課的原因，這一班的人數比較多。加上我不聘助教，會親自處理同學的修課事務，便無法再加簽同學，以影響教學品質。請同學諒解，並盡早改加簽其他班級。若個人選課上有時間衝突，請洽各班導師或系上排課職員協助，謝謝。

This course provides an in-depth exploration of mass transfer and its applications in unit operations, drawing heavily from the foundational concepts and methodologies presented in Cussler's Diffusion: Mass Transfer in Fluid Systems. Students will gain a thorough understanding of diffusion, convective mass transfer, and interfacial phenomena, as well as the design and analysis of mass transfer equipment such as distillation columns, absorbers, and membrane systems. Emphasis will be placed on practical problem-solving and the integration of theoretical principles with engineering applications in chemical and biochemical processes.

This course is designed to bridge the gap between theory and practice, preparing students for advanced study or professional roles in industries requiring expertise in mass transfer and related operations.

syllabi.outline:
讓學生學習文獻之蒐集方法與整理，以便瞭解學術論文製作方式，培養學生獨立自主探討一個理論或技術上的問題，並經由實驗設計及資料之判讀更深入專業領域。
A course allows students collect and oranize literature information and them design their own experiments. An independent research capability can be developed through out this learning process.
syllabi.schedule:
主題選擇與討論：

第1至2週：介紹課程目標與內容，引導學生選擇研究主題，討論各種可能的研究方向。
文獻回顧：

第3至6週：教導學生如何進行文獻回顧，搜尋相關文獻，閱讀與理解先前研究的成果，並撰寫文獻回顧部分。
研究方法與設計：

第7至10週：介紹不同的研究方法與設計，包括定量、定性、實驗、問卷調查等，指導學生選擇適合的方法，並撰寫研究方法部分。
資料收集與分析：

第11至14週：指導學生進行資料收集，例如實地調查、實驗執行、問卷調查等，並學習適當的資料分析技術，如統計分析、質性分析等。
結果呈現與討論：

第15至18週：引導學生分析研究結果，撰寫研究結果報告，討論研究發現的意義與影響，並與文獻回顧部分進行比較與討論。
撰寫與終稿：

第19至20週：指導學生進行專題研究報告的撰寫，包括引言、文獻回顧、研究方法、結果與討論、結論等部分，並完成最終版本的報告。
成果展示：

第21至22週：安排學生進行成果展示，例如口頭報告、海報展示等，分享他們的研究成果與發現。
評量與評分：

整個學期：根據學生的參與度、作業完成情況、研究報告品質等進行評量與評分。
課程進度可以根據學校的學期長度和每週上課時數進行調整，同時要考慮到彈性，以應對可能出現的延遲或加速的情況。

description.zh: 分子生物學為現代生物科技尤其是基因工程的基礎學問。課程內容深入探討生物的四大類分子：DNA及RNA，蛋白質，脂質，以及醣類分子。並且詳細探討現代分子生物學之中心思想，包含DNA 複製、轉錄、轉譯等。
description.en: Molecular biology is the fundamental of modern biotechnology, especially genetic engineering. Students learn what are DNA, RNA, protein, lipid, and carbohydrate and how do they work in this course. The central dogma of modern molecular biology, including DNA replication, transcription, and translation, is the major topic of this course.

description.zh: 本課程內容包括控制閥、控制器之介紹，程序動態應答分析，閉還路控制系統分析，控制器調諧，頻率應答分析及串級控制系統之介紹
description.en: This course contents the introduction of control valve and controller, process dynamics, close loop control system, tuning of feedback controller, frequency response techniques, and cascade control system.

syllabi.outline: The purpose of this course is to apply the key concepts of automatic control and instrumentation to process plants. Material and energy balances are used to model unsteady state (dynamic) process systems where control algorithms are required to bring the process back to equilibrium. Laplace Transforms are used as a means to conveniently solve ordinary differential equations, which are used when describing process control systems. Control loops are developed to represent industrial processes enabling appropriate control approaches to be elucidated. Commonly used sensing, transmission and final control elements are described . At the end of the course, the students will have an appreciation of the fundamental importance of control systems for the safe and sustainable operation of process plants.

11-12 week: Basic concept of control
13-14 week: Stability Analysis 
15 week: PID Controller I
16 week: Final Exam
17 week: PID Controller II
18 week: Discussion Class

syllabi.outline:
讓學生學習文獻之蒐集方法與整理，以便瞭解學術論文製作方式，培養學生獨立自主探討一個理論或技術上的問題，並經由實驗設計及資料之判讀更深入專業領域。
A course allows students collect and oranize literature information and them design their own experiments. An independent research capability can be developed through out this learning process.
syllabi.schedule:
主題選擇與討論：

第1至2週：介紹課程目標與內容，引導學生選擇研究主題，討論各種可能的研究方向。
文獻回顧：

第3至6週：教導學生如何進行文獻回顧，搜尋相關文獻，閱讀與理解先前研究的成果，並撰寫文獻回顧部分。
研究方法與設計：

第7至10週：介紹不同的研究方法與設計，包括定量、定性、實驗、問卷調查等，指導學生選擇適合的方法，並撰寫研究方法部分。
資料收集與分析：

第11至14週：指導學生進行資料收集，例如實地調查、實驗執行、問卷調查等，並學習適當的資料分析技術，如統計分析、質性分析等。
結果呈現與討論：

第15至18週：引導學生分析研究結果，撰寫研究結果報告，討論研究發現的意義與影響，並與文獻回顧部分進行比較與討論。
撰寫與終稿：

第19至20週：指導學生進行專題研究報告的撰寫，包括引言、文獻回顧、研究方法、結果與討論、結論等部分，並完成最終版本的報告。
成果展示：

第21至22週：安排學生進行成果展示，例如口頭報告、海報展示等，分享他們的研究成果與發現。
評量與評分：

整個學期：根據學生的參與度、作業完成情況、研究報告品質等進行評量與評分。
課程進度可以根據學校的學期長度和每週上課時數進行調整，同時要考慮到彈性，以應對可能出現的延遲或加速的情況。

description.zh: 分子生物學為現代生物科技尤其是基因工程的基礎學問。課程內容深入探討生物的四大類分子：DNA及RNA，蛋白質，脂質，以及醣類分子。並且詳細探討現代分子生物學之中心思想，包含DNA 複製、轉錄、轉譯等。
description.en: Molecular biology is the fundamental of modern biotechnology, especially genetic engineering. Students learn what are DNA, RNA, protein, lipid, and carbohydrate and how do they work in this course. The central dogma of modern molecular biology, including DNA replication, transcription, and translation, is the major topic of this course.

description.zh: 材料實習(四)是配合課堂理論，使學生在實習過程中探索有關於材料方面之化學性質，進而啟發學生對於材料方面之設計與開發之興趣。實習內容包括：材料之熱分析、磁性材料之特性、掃描式電子顯微鏡觀察、材料之結晶構造分析等。實驗內容主要分成兩大類，材料之化學特性及製程 A.為材料化學特性分析，包含化學儀器分析(AA、UV、ICP)、材料之熱分析…等，及B.為材料電化學製程，包含電化學表面處理技術、電鍍、鋁合金陽極處理、電池之原理及測試…等。
description.en: This lab course is designed to correspond mainly with the chemical analyses and processing of materials for stimulating the students the interest to understand the chemical and structural aspects of materials. The course includes thermal analysis, magnetic properties, scanning electron microscopy, and crystal structure analyses of materials. The experiments include two parts: A. chemical analyses including AA, UV, ICP, and thermal analyses; and B. electro-chemical processes, such as surface processing, electro-plating, anodic oxidation of aluminum, and principles and testing of batteries.

syllabi.outline: 材料實習(三)是配合課堂理論，使學生在實習過程中探索有關於金屬方面之物理性，進而發學生對於材料方面之設計與開發之興趣。實習內容包括：管狀爐之設計與製作、熱傳導係數之測定、陶瓷粉末之真比重測定、材料之熱分析、磁性材料之磁滯曲線特性、蓋爾文及惠斯登電橋、掃描式電子顯微鏡觀察、材料之結晶構造分析等。

實驗九、電池之原理及測試、應力腐蝕試驗。

description.zh: 固態元件簡介,功能電子陶瓷(functional ceramics); 同時可對某些物理量如壓 ,力,音, 濕度, 溫度, 氣體等產生響應, 故其亦可稱為感測陶瓷(sensing ceramics). 精密電子陶瓷課程內容將對日常生活常見之介電陶瓷, 壓電陶瓷, 焦電陶瓷, 半導體陶瓷及磁性陶瓷等部分作深入淺出介紹.
description.en: It may also be called as Solid-state Devices and "functional ceramics" because of the special function applied in practical circuits; through the responses caused by pressure, force, sound, moisture, temperature and different gas, the fine electronic ceramics may also be called "sensing ceramics". In this course, the dielectric ceramics, piezoelectric ceramics, pyroelectric ceramics, semiconducting ceramics and magnetic ceramics will be introduced with their applications.

syllabi.outline: 本課程介紹半導體元件物理的基本概念，深入淺出介紹材料物理性質到半導體元件操作原理與應用，建立學生對半導體領域與產業發展的認識。

Chapter 14: Optical Devices

description.zh: 本課程介紹X射線特性、繞射原理及X射線繞射在材料科學上之應用。內容包括X射線之產生，X射線之性質，X射線之繞射理論，材料之晶體結構與繞射條件。在X射線繞射方法方面則介紹Laue照相法，粉末法，繞射儀及光譜儀等。應用方面則包括晶體結構之鑑定，晶格常數之量測，相圖測定，序化一非序化轉換及化學成分分析等。
description.en:
Introduction to the following topics: 
1. Properties of X-Ray
2. Geometry of Crystals
3. Principles of X-Ray Diffraction
4. Experimental Methods
 (Diffractometer Measurements, Powder Photographs, and Laue Photographs)
5. Applications of X-ray Diffraction on Materials Science 
(Orientation and Quality of Single Crystal, Determine of Crystal Structure and Precise Parameter Measurements, Chemical Analysis, Phase Transformations etc.)

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技三年級下學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In second semester, Junior students also can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. description.zh: 資源處理的主要對象為礦物，但其他有些固體與固體間或固體與液體間之分離與純化也包括在本工程之內，採用的方法：凡是各分離物間不同之物理及化學性質，皆可設法加以利用。本課程則針對其應用方法加以介紹，以期學生對資源處理有一初步及完整的認識。授課內容包括：粉粒體之簡介、篩及篩分、碎礦機之種類及應用、磨礦機之種類及應用、分級及分級機、重液選礦、浮游選礦、磁選機之種類及應用等。
description.en:
Mineral processing uses various techniques to perform 
solid-solid and soild-liguid separation and concentration 
by using physical and chemical properties between different 
minerals.  The separation and concentration methods include 
particle size analysis, screening, crushing, grinding, 
pulverizing, classification, heavy medium separation, 
flotation, magnetic separation, etc.
