name.zh: 人工智慧跨域資安之應用
name.en: Artificial Intelligence Cross-domain Applications in Information Security

description.zh: 本課程旨在探討人工智慧在跨域資安上的應用。課程將從零信任安全、人工智慧安全、個人資料與隱私保護、人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測、人工智慧在舞弊的偵測、人工智慧輔助電腦稽核、人工智慧輔助數位鑑識以及API安全等議題進行深入探討。首先，在零信任安全的概念上，探討如何使用此方法來保障資料安全，接著探討人工智慧安全的基礎知識，包括機器學習、深度學習等技術，並介紹如何將這些技術應用於資安領域。此外，在人工智慧在安全的應用上，將導入人工智慧在入侵偵測、漏洞掃描、安全威脅評估等方面的應用案例，以及如何使用人工智慧技術進行網路安全防禦。在人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測方面，將介紹如何使用人工智慧技術檢測網路攻擊，包括異常檢測、入侵檢測等技術。最後，課程還將介紹API安全，包括API安全的風險與漏洞、API保護措施等方面的內容，並介紹如何使用人工智慧技術保護API的安全性。
description.en: This course aims to explore the application of artificial intelligence in cross-domain cybersecurity. First, the course will introduce the concept of zero-trust security and discuss how this method can be used to safeguard data security. In addition, the course will also explore the application of AI in security, including case studies in intrusion detection, vulnerability scanning, security threat assessment, and how AI can be used for network security defense and protect personal data and privacy. In addition, the use of AI technology for detecting cybersecurity incidents, including detecting network attacks using techniques such as anomaly detection and intrusion detection. It will also explore fraud detection using AI, such as credit card fraud or malicious top-up fraud. Lastly, the course will introduce API security, including risks and vulnerabilities, API protection measures, and how to use AI technology to protect API security.

syllabi.outline: 人工智慧的技術不斷地推陳出新及影響、應用於各領域，特別是資訊安全的相關應用，對於真實世界的影響甚鉅。本課程旨在探討人工智慧在跨域資安上的應用。將帶領學生深入探討人工智慧（AI）與機器學習（ML）技術在資訊安全領域的雙面刃特性，期望學生修畢本課程後能達成以下目標：1.掌握核心概念：理解人工智慧、機器學習技術的基礎，及其應用於資訊安全領域的基本原理。2.建構防禦能力（AI for Security）：學習如何運用 AI 技術開發或強化資安防護機制，包含惡意程式偵測、網路入侵偵測（NIDS）、以及使用者行為分析（UEBA）。3.理解新型威脅（Security of AI）：認識針對 AI 模型本身的攻擊手法（如對抗性攻擊、資料下毒、模型萃取），並學習對應的防禦與強健性（Robustness）提升策略。4.探索生成式 AI 的資安衝擊：評估大型語言模型（LLMs）在自動化社交工程攻擊、程式碼漏洞挖掘上的風險，以及如何利用生成式 AI 輔助資安維運（SecOps）。5.具備實務動手能力：透過開源工具與實機操作（Lab），具備運用 Python 及 ML 框架解決基礎資安問題的實作能力。

description.zh: 藝術與新意的遇合，一切就從分享開始! 不論黑白彩色、平面立體、抽象具象、靜態動感，藝術一向變化多端，不論抒發情感、宣揚宗教、服務政治或是傳達思想，藝術從來不缺理由，別說你不懂藝術!因為在二十一世紀裡，藝術已不僅是貴婦們的權力，身為未來設計師與建築師的您們，應該積極讓藝術存在於你生活的週遭，不論分享美感經驗、探討觀點流派、解析藝術風格、從事文化創意設計，亦或是批判現今藝術社群，你都擁有發聲的權力。而此系列講座中的十場演講，都是在不同藝術領域中，從事創作多年的佼佼者，透過大師講座的平台，讓大師們進入校園，與全校師生一同分享這藝術與新意的無限饗宴。
description.en: When art meets innovation, everything starts from sharing! No matter art is black or white, flat or three-dimensional, abstract or concrete, motionless or active, it has always been protean. When art is used to express feelings, advocate religions, propagandizing politics, or transmitting thoughts, it never needs any reason. Don't say that you don't know what art is! In the 21st century, art is no longer the privilege of wealthy ladies. But you all, the future designers and architects, should work harder to make yourself inseparable with art. When you are sharing your own experience about esthetics, exploring different art sects, analyzing art styles, engaging in cultural creative design, or criticizing the contemporary art sects, you have the right to speak up. The ten speeches in this series will be delivered by many experts from different fields. It would be our honor to have them in the campus and share their fruition of art with all of the staff and students.

syllabi.outline:
藝術與新意的遇合，一切就從分享開始! 不論黑白彩色、平面立體、抽象具象、靜態動感，藝術一向變化多端，不論抒發情感、宣揚宗教、服務政治或是傳達思想，藝術從來不缺理由，別說你不懂藝術!因為在二十一世紀裡，藝術已不僅是貴婦們的權力，身為未來設計師的您們，應該積極讓藝術存在於你生活的週遭，不論分享美感經驗、探討觀點流派、解析藝術風格、從事文化創意設計，亦或是批判現今藝術社群，你都擁有發聲的權力。在不同藝術領域中，透過實際參訪與講座，與大家一同分享這藝術與新意的無限饗宴。
When art meets innovation, everything starts from sharing! No matter art is black or white, flat or three-dimensional, abstract or concrete, motionless or active, it has always been protean. When art is used to express feelings, advocate religions, propagandizing politics, or transmitting thoughts, it never needs any reason. Don't say that you don't know what art is! In the 21st century, art is no longer the privilege of wealthy ladies. But you all, the future designers and architects, should work harder to make yourself inseparable with art. When you are sharing your own experience about esthetics, exploring different art sects, analyzing art styles, engaging in cultural creative design, or criticizing the contemporary art sects, you have the right to speak up. 
In various artistic domains, through actual visits and lectures, let's share together the endless feast of art and innovation.

syllabi.outline:
本學期課程將為四年級的畢業製作，進行正式的定向與展開，結合上學期對於所利用關鍵技術運用範圍的掌控，於熟練的基礎上再進行精緻化且結合不同內容變數的探索。而在技術與內容間的調節與創作過程中，對於互動媒體本身應有的可調整、置換的優勢，系統化工法與模組化的運用極為重要。
畢業製作將維持超過一年的創作期，製作期間必會遇到多次的調整與優化。有效率的模組化設計，可帶來流暢的創作過程，與強大的內容擴張性。因此，模組化的設計與工法將為這次的訓練重心，其中包含的四種優勢特性，將為學員磨練與評分之目標與重點指標。其為模組化系統下之：組件化、易更替性、延伸擴展性、多樣化。
期末將以實體作品展演形式，創作型態不限於藝術、運用、與體驗，概念上之原型假設透過下列手法示範。
1. 設計互動─ 規劃流暢操作與吸引人的體驗性。
2. 限縮技術─ 確定運用技術之掌控性，並掌握其對承載內容所影響之核心要素。
3. 擴展議題─ 例舉各種所傳達代表主體下，強調運用面與內容搭配的變化。
學習過程將鍛鍊如何駕馭特定經轉化之模擬手法，加強相關研究與探索能力，以擴展其內容之契合度，進而完備其技術特性與傳達內容的整合性。可先請各指導老師安排組員能力的規畫，以達成創作能量的最佳化。
明確的創作發展由各組與指導老師依各人專長領域自行訂定。配合期末展覽，以每四至六人為一共同創作組，作品之完整度及展示性將為製作重點。命題方式是以朔源與重整概念的方式，使創作邏輯能站在形式對內容之交互關係出發，並作出以輕巧的互動機制，卻具影響效力於不同關注面向或議題的創作，讓學員探究能影響所關心面向的根本要素，使創作的影響力能從掌握主要因子展開。整個課程的施做分為四個階段: 初部提案-重新思考核心技術的掌控度，分析其內容之契合度與其運用層面變數；進階報告-技術本質之聚焦與強化，凸顯其互動設計及搭配相應內容之動態運行方式；實作進度討論與講評；創作成果驗收總評。

syllabi.outline:
本學期課程將為四年級的畢業製作，進行正式的定向與展開，結合上學期對於所利用關鍵技術運用範圍的掌控，於熟練的基礎上再進行精緻化且結合不同內容變數的探索。而在技術與內容間的調節與創作過程中，對於互動媒體本身應有的可調整、置換的優勢，系統化工法與模組化的運用極為重要。
畢業製作將維持超過一年的創作期，製作期間必會遇到多次的調整與優化。有效率的模組化設計，可帶來流暢的創作過程，與強大的內容擴張性。因此，模組化的設計與工法將為這次的訓練重心，其中包含的四種優勢特性，將為學員磨練與評分之目標與重點指標。其為模組化系統下之：組件化、易更替性、延伸擴展性、多樣化。
期末將以實體作品展演形式，創作型態不限於藝術、運用、與體驗，概念上之原型假設透過下列手法示範。
1. 設計互動─ 規劃流暢操作與吸引人的體驗性。
2. 限縮技術─ 確定運用技術之掌控性，並掌握其對承載內容所影響之核心要素。
3. 擴展議題─ 例舉各種所傳達代表主體下，強調運用面與內容搭配的變化。
學習過程將鍛鍊如何駕馭特定經轉化之模擬手法，加強相關研究與探索能力，以擴展其內容之契合度，進而完備其技術特性與傳達內容的整合性。可先請各指導老師安排組員能力的規畫，以達成創作能量的最佳化。
明確的創作發展由各組與指導老師依各人專長領域自行訂定。配合期末展覽，以每四至六人為一共同創作組，作品之完整度及展示性將為製作重點。命題方式是以朔源與重整概念的方式，使創作邏輯能站在形式對內容之交互關係出發，並作出以輕巧的互動機制，卻具影響效力於不同關注面向或議題的創作，讓學員探究能影響所關心面向的根本要素，使創作的影響力能從掌握主要因子展開。整個課程的施做分為四個階段: 初部提案-重新思考核心技術的掌控度，分析其內容之契合度與其運用層面變數；進階報告-技術本質之聚焦與強化，凸顯其互動設計及搭配相應內容之動態運行方式；實作進度討論與講評；創作成果驗收總評。

description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度，切入虛擬實境產業的各種可能性。從教育應用、設計工具以及虛擬實境遊戲設計、虛擬實境互動式動畫製作等，進行探討。
description.en: The main objective of the program, is taking from the application and design perspective, cut into the possibilities of virtual reality industry. Exploring from the educational applications, design tools and virtual reality games, to virtual reality interactive animation, etc.

syllabi.outline:
Virtual reality (VR) is a fusion of art and technology, widely applied across various fields, including transportation simulators (driver training), BIM-integrated applications (building maintenance training), immersive gaming (next-generation sports, rehabilitation), immersive storytelling (film, animation), factory simulation, museums, and product previews. This course on VR applications focuses on the impact of VR on future technology and daily life, while also exploring the interplay between immersion, imagination, interaction, and human cognitive perception. The course covers the concepts, principles, and implementation methods of VR/AR and interactive haptic technologies, including an introduction to computer vision techniques, to help students understand sensory perception and interaction mechanisms in virtual environments. To enhance practical VR applications, students will be guided in developing innovative and practical multimedia human-computer interaction systems, exploring and evaluating immersive interaction models. Through a combination of theoretical instruction and hands-on practice, this course aims to equip students with core VR/AR technologies, fostering innovation, cross-disciplinary integration, and creative applications, enabling them to contribute to the future development and advancement of immersive technology.

虛擬實境是一種藝術與科技的整合，廣泛運用在不同屬性的領域，如交通模擬器(司機員訓練)、BIM整合應用(建築養護訓練)、沈浸式遊戲(新型態科技運動、復健)、沈浸式敘事(電影、動畫)、工廠模擬、博物館、成品預覽等。本虛擬實境應用之課程內容，將專注於虛擬實境應用對於未來科技、生活等不同層面的影響，同時探討沈浸、想像、互動與人類心理認知的相互關係。課程內容涵蓋VR/AR 及其互動體感技術的概念、原理與實現方法(電腦視覺技術簡介)，幫助學生理解虛擬環境中的感知與互動機制。為強化 VR 技術的實務應用，本課程將帶領學生開發創新且實用的多媒體人機互動系統，探索與評估沉浸式的操作模式。透過理論講解與實作練習，本課程將培養學生掌握 VR/AR 核心技術，並培育其創新應用與跨領域整合能力，使其在未來科技發展中發揮創造力與影響力。

description.zh: 生成式人工智慧(GAI) 的快速發展已經徹底改變了多媒體設計，AI生成的影片、圖像和文本已達到專業水準。本課程從神經網路的基礎理論開始，例如線性回歸、分類器、遞歸神經網路(RNN)、自編碼器(AE) 以及變分自編碼器(VAE)，最終涵蓋兩項關鍵技術的核心知識及多樣應用：大型語言模型(LLM)和擴散模型(Diffusion Model)。通過使用開源工具如Llama和Stable Diffusion進行實作練習，學生將深入了解AI的運作方式，並學習如何高效地創作高品質且具創意的 AI 內容。掌握這些技術後，學生將能將AI生成的內容整合至資訊系統中，提升系統功能、美感和用戶體驗。這門課程將幫助學生培養與AI共同創作超媒體內容的核心技能。
description.en: The rapid advancement of Generative AI (GAI) has revolutionized multimedia design, with AI-generated videos, images, and text now reaching professional standards. This course begins with foundational neural network theories such as linear regression, classifiers, RNN, AE, and VAE, and progresses to core concepts and applications of two major technologies: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Diffusion Models. Through hands-on practice with open-source tools like Llama and Stable Diffusion, students will gain a deep understanding of AI operation and learn efficient techniques for creating high-quality, innovative AI content. By mastering these technologies, students will be able to integrate AI-generated content into information systems, enhancing both functionality and user experience. The course prepares students with the essential skills for human-AI co-creation in hypermedia content.

syllabi.outline:
生成式人工智慧（Generative AI, GAI）的快速發展，已深刻影響內容創作、互動設計與資訊系統的建構方式。本課程以實務導向為核心，聚焦於生成式 AI 在實際專案中的應用與系統整合，強調透過程式化方式調用生成式 AI API，將生成能力轉化為可控制、可重現且可整合的系統功能。
課程依循真實專案開發流程，先以 Google AI Studio 建立生成式 AI 的快速原型與 Prompt 設計基礎，理解文字、圖像與多模態內容的生成特性，接著透過 Python 與 Gemini API 將生成流程轉化為程式模組，實作可實際部署與延伸的生成式服務，最後結合 Ollama 與 LangChain，探討本地端與雲端模型混合應用的系統架構與實務取捨。
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
The rapid development of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) has profoundly transformed content creation, interaction design, and information system development. This course adopts a practice-oriented approach, focusing on the application and system integration of generative AI in real-world projects. Emphasis is placed on programmatic interaction with generative AI through APIs, enabling students to transform generative capabilities into controllable, reproducible, and integrable system functions.
Following a realistic project development workflow, the course begins with Google AI Studio to support rapid prototyping and prompt design, allowing students to understand the characteristics of text, image, and multimodal content generation. The course then moves to Python-based implementation using the Gemini API, where students develop modular and reusable generative AI services suitable for system integration and deployment. In the later stage, Ollama and LangChain are introduced to explore hybrid architectures that combine local and cloud-based language models, highlighting practical considerations such as system design, performance, cost, and data privacy.
This course adopts a project-based learning approach in which students continuously develop and refine a single project throughout the semester. Weekly deliverables are incrementally integrated into the final outcome, which is expected to demonstrate real-world applicability, technical completeness, and presentation readiness. Through this process, students will also address key issues including generation quality, cost control, ethical considerations, and commercial feasibility, thereby developing the ability to effectively deploy generative AI technologies within information systems and digital services.

syllabi.assessment:
一、每週專案產出（40%）
學生需依每週課程進度完成對應之專案成果，包含 Prompt 設計、生成式 AI API 串接、生成模組實作、多模態整合與系統流程建構。各週產出將持續累積，作為期末專案的重要基礎。

二、期中整合報告（20%）
期中評量以專案整合展示為主，學生需說明目前已完成之系統功能、生成流程與技術應用，並透過簡報或示範方式呈現專案進度與整體架構。

三、期末專案成果（30%）
期末評量以完整專案成果為主，評估專案之功能完整度、生成內容品質、系統整合程度與實際應用可行性，並進行成果展示與說明。

四、課堂參與（10%）
評量學生之課堂出席情形、實作參與度、討論互動與對同儕專案之回饋表現。
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Weekly Project Deliverables (40%)
Students are required to complete weekly project outputs aligned with the course schedule, including prompt design, generative AI API integration, implementation of generation modules, multimodal integration, and system workflow construction. These deliverables are accumulated as the foundation of the final project.

2. Midterm Project Integration (20%)
The midterm assessment focuses on project integration. Students present the current status of their project, demonstrating implemented system functions, generative workflows, and technical approaches through presentations or demonstrations.

3. Final Project Outcome (30%)
The final assessment evaluates the completed project in terms of functional completeness, quality of generated content, level of system integration, and real-world applicability. A final presentation and demonstration are required.

4. Class Participation (10%)
Students are assessed based on attendance, participation in hands-on activities, engagement in class discussions, and constructive feedback provided to peers.

description.en: This course presents three elements of corporate identity system, which are mind identity system (MI, MIS), behavior identity system (BI, BIS) and visual identity system (VI, VIS). Students will be introduced to all systems and learn about how these systems work together.

syllabi.outline:
This course explores the three pillars of Corporate Identity System: Mind Identity System (MIS), Behavior Identity System (BIS), and Visual Identity System (VIS). It aims to equip students with the knowledge and skills to create effective logo designs that embody an organization's ethos, behavior, and visual identity.
Course Objectives
1.Understand the principles of MIS, BIS, and VIS in the context of logo design.
2.Learn to integrate conceptual thinking with practical design skills.
3.Develop logos that effectively communicate a brand's identity.
4.Analyze real-world examples of successful corporate identity systems.

Case studies analysis

Aligning brand values with behavior
Workshop: Developing a BIS strategy
Week 10-12: Mastering Visual Identity System (VIS)

Software and tools for logo creation
Week 13-15: Integrated CIS Approach in Logo Design
Synthesizing MIS, BIS, and VIS in logo creation
Project: Designing a logo with a comprehensive CIS approach
Peer reviews and critiques
Week 16: Final Project and Presentation
Develop a complete CIS for a hypothetical or real company
Present the project, highlighting the integration of MIS, BIS, and VIS

description.zh: 中文課程共分四年三階段授課。 第一、二年以華語教學為主，授課重點為：（一）華語基本句型句法；（二）華語基本會話；（三）生活語言；（四）標音系統。第三年(一學期)，除延續第一、二年華語授課重點外，以段落朗讀和基本認字為主要訓練，並給與中國文字書寫訓練。 第四年(一學期)，加強會話能力，認字與閱讀能力，並傳授中國文化。
description.en: The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on: (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year (one semester), the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

By interaction design issues, students create and implement ideas by brainstorming through independent study or cooperative learning. For competition without any gap, industry-academic cooperation is one way to prepare student’s critical competencies same as the desired competencies required by the industry.

syllabi.outline:
Course Objectives:
Understand the fundamental principles and applications of interactive design.
Develop creative design skills to complete individual or group interactive design projects.
Foster teamwork and communication skills.
Explore the applications of various interactive design media and platforms.
Teaching Methods: Lectures, group discussions, hands-on guidance, case studies, and project presentations.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Course Introduction
Overview of the course and expected outcomes.
Introduction to the fundamentals of interactive design with case studies.
Student introductions and group assignments.
Week 2: Interactive Design Theories and Tools Overview
User experience design and human-computer interaction theories.
Introduction to commonly used tools (e.g., Figma, Unity, Processing).
Week 3: Topic Selection and Requirement Analysis
Guide students in selecting their interactive design topics.
User research and goal setting.
Week 4: Creative Brainstorming and Concept Development
Brainstorming activities.
Each group presents initial concept sketches.
Week 5: Storytelling and User Journey Design
Crafting user stories and journey mapping.
Group feedback and discussions.
Week 6: Technical Experimentation and Prototype Testing
Guide students in creating low-fidelity prototypes using design tools.
Test user interaction experiences and record feedback.
Week 7: Design Refinement
Provide guidance to further refine interactive designs.
Discuss visual design and technical details.
Week 8: Midterm Review
Groups present their design progress.
Feedback and improvement suggestions from the instructor and peers.
Week 9: Motion and Responsive Design
Teach principles of animation and interaction effects.
Apply these concepts to student projects.
Week 10: Multisensory Interaction Design
Explore the application of sensory elements such as sound and touch.
Group experiments and sharing.
Week 11: Technical Integration
Guide students in integrating various technologies into their projects.
Solve technical challenges and difficulties.
Week 12: Mid-Stage Testing and User Feedback
Groups showcase their interim results.
Conduct simulated user testing and collect improvement suggestions.

description.en: This course presents three elements of corporate identity system, which are mind identity system (MI, MIS), behavior identity system (BI, BIS) and visual identity system (VI, VIS). Students will be introduced to all systems and learn about how these systems work together.

syllabi.outline:
This course explores the three pillars of Corporate Identity System: Mind Identity System (MIS), Behavior Identity System (BIS), and Visual Identity System (VIS). It aims to equip students with the knowledge and skills to create effective logo designs that embody an organization's ethos, behavior, and visual identity.
Course Objectives
1.Understand the principles of MIS, BIS, and VIS in the context of logo design.
2.Learn to integrate conceptual thinking with practical design skills.
3.Develop logos that effectively communicate a brand's identity.
4.Analyze real-world examples of successful corporate identity systems.

description.zh: 生成式人工智慧(GAI) 的快速發展已經徹底改變了多媒體設計，AI生成的影片、圖像和文本已達到專業水準。本課程從神經網路的基礎理論開始，例如線性回歸、分類器、遞歸神經網路(RNN)、自編碼器(AE) 以及變分自編碼器(VAE)，最終涵蓋兩項關鍵技術的核心知識及多樣應用：大型語言模型(LLM)和擴散模型(Diffusion Model)。通過使用開源工具如Llama和Stable Diffusion進行實作練習，學生將深入了解AI的運作方式，並學習如何高效地創作高品質且具創意的 AI 內容。掌握這些技術後，學生將能將AI生成的內容整合至資訊系統中，提升系統功能、美感和用戶體驗。這門課程將幫助學生培養與AI共同創作超媒體內容的核心技能。
description.en: The rapid advancement of Generative AI (GAI) has revolutionized multimedia design, with AI-generated videos, images, and text now reaching professional standards. This course begins with foundational neural network theories such as linear regression, classifiers, RNN, AE, and VAE, and progresses to core concepts and applications of two major technologies: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Diffusion Models. Through hands-on practice with open-source tools like Llama and Stable Diffusion, students will gain a deep understanding of AI operation and learn efficient techniques for creating high-quality, innovative AI content. By mastering these technologies, students will be able to integrate AI-generated content into information systems, enhancing both functionality and user experience. The course prepares students with the essential skills for human-AI co-creation in hypermedia content.

syllabi.outline:
The rapid development of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) has profoundly transformed content creation, interaction design, and information system development. This course adopts a practice-oriented approach, focusing on the application and system integration of generative AI in real-world projects. Emphasis is placed on programmatic interaction with generative AI through APIs, enabling students to transform generative capabilities into controllable, reproducible, and integrable system functions.
Following a realistic project development workflow, the course begins with Google AI Studio to support rapid prototyping and prompt design, allowing students to understand the characteristics of text, image, and multimodal content generation. The course then moves to Python-based implementation using the Gemini API, where students develop modular and reusable generative AI services suitable for system integration and deployment. In the later stage, Ollama and LangChain are introduced to explore hybrid architectures that combine local and cloud-based language models, highlighting practical considerations such as system design, performance, cost, and data privacy.
This course adopts a project-based learning approach in which students continuously develop and refine a single project throughout the semester. Weekly deliverables are incrementally integrated into the final outcome, which is expected to demonstrate real-world applicability, technical completeness, and presentation readiness. Through this process, students will also address key issues including generation quality, cost control, ethical considerations, and commercial feasibility, thereby developing the ability to effectively deploy generative AI technologies within information systems and digital services.

Week 2 (Mar 2): Google AI Studio and prompt design fundamentals (text generation)

Week 4 (Mar 16): Application scenarios and generative AI service prototyping using Google AI Studio

Week 6 (Mar 30): Python integration with the Imagen API (image generation module)
Week 7 (Apr 6): Tomb-Sweeping Day make-up holiday (no class)
Week 8 (Apr 13): Python-based multimodal integration (text-driven image generation pipeline)
Week 9 (Apr 20): Midterm project integration and presentation
Week 10 (Apr 27): Ollama and local large language model implementation
Week 11 (May 4): LangChain fundamentals and generative AI workflow design
Week 12 (May 11): LangChain with RAG (project data integration and retrieval-augmented generation)
Week 13 (May 18): Hybrid architecture design with cloud and local models (Gemini and Ollama)
Week 14 (May 25): Generation quality, ethics, commercial feasibility, testing, cost control, and system stability
Week 15 (Jun 1): Project integration and presentation interface design

Week 18 (Jun 22): Final project presentation
syllabi.assessment:
1. Weekly Project Deliverables (40%)
Students are required to complete weekly project outputs aligned with the course schedule, including prompt design, generative AI API integration, implementation of generation modules, multimodal integration, and system workflow construction. These deliverables are accumulated as the foundation of the final project.

2. Midterm Project Integration (20%)
The midterm assessment focuses on project integration. Students present the current status of their project, demonstrating implemented system functions, generative workflows, and technical approaches through presentations or demonstrations.

3. Final Project Outcome (30%)
The final assessment evaluates the completed project in terms of functional completeness, quality of generated content, level of system integration, and real-world applicability. A final presentation and demonstration are required.

4. Class Participation (10%)
Students are assessed based on attendance, participation in hands-on activities, engagement in class discussions, and constructive feedback provided to peers.

description.en: The main objective of the program, is taking from the application and design perspective, cut into the possibilities of virtual reality industry. Exploring from the educational applications, design tools and virtual reality games, to virtual reality interactive animation, etc.

syllabi.outline:
Virtual reality (VR) is a fusion of art and technology, widely applied across various fields, including transportation simulators (driver training), BIM-integrated applications (building maintenance training), immersive gaming (next-generation sports, rehabilitation), immersive storytelling (film, animation), factory simulation, museums, and product previews. This course on VR applications focuses on the impact of VR on future technology and daily life, while also exploring the interplay between immersion, imagination, interaction, and human cognitive perception. The course covers the concepts, principles, and implementation methods of VR/AR and interactive haptic technologies, including an introduction to computer vision techniques, to help students understand sensory perception and interaction mechanisms in virtual environments. To enhance practical VR applications, students will be guided in developing innovative and practical multimedia human-computer interaction systems, exploring and evaluating immersive interaction models. Through a combination of theoretical instruction and hands-on practice, this course aims to equip students with core VR/AR technologies, fostering innovation, cross-disciplinary integration, and creative applications, enabling them to contribute to the future development and advancement of immersive technology.

虛擬實境是一種藝術與科技的整合，廣泛運用在不同屬性的領域，如交通模擬器(司機員訓練)、BIM整合應用(建築養護訓練)、沈浸式遊戲(新型態科技運動、復健)、沈浸式敘事(電影、動畫)、工廠模擬、博物館、成品預覽等。本虛擬實境應用之課程內容，將專注於虛擬實境應用對於未來科技、生活等不同層面的影響，同時探討沈浸、想像、互動與人類心理認知的相互關係。課程內容涵蓋VR/AR 及其互動體感技術的概念、原理與實現方法(電腦視覺技術簡介)，幫助學生理解虛擬環境中的感知與互動機制。為強化 VR 技術的實務應用，本課程將帶領學生開發創新且實用的多媒體人機互動系統，探索與評估沉浸式的操作模式。透過理論講解與實作練習，本課程將培養學生掌握 VR/AR 核心技術，並培育其創新應用與跨領域整合能力，使其在未來科技發展中發揮創造力與影響力。

description.zh:
一、本課程凡十六學分，供學生前四年修習之用。
二、本課程教學目標旨在透過適當選文，增進學生閱讀、鑑賞與寫作能力，誘使學生對我國重要典籍及傳統文化有一粗淺認識，並從而培植其人文素養，啟發其愛國、愛家、愛人之情操。
三、本課程所選範文，類別遍於經史子集，時代該及古今。編者於每篇選文，除有生字、難詞、典故之註釋，提意、出處、著作背景之說明，而作者生平、作品、風格及其地位、事功，亦有簡要之評述。
四、本課程亦講授公文及書信。公文之內容包括函、簽、公告、報告等各類常用公文的作法與寫作要領，並兼及處理公文之注意事項。書信之內容包括傳統及現代書信的寫法與寫作要領，並兼及便條與做為便條使用之名片的寫法。
description.en:
a) The course is designed for the students to study in the first four years, with a sum total of 16 credit hours. 
b) Course Objective: Through proper readings, the students will increase their ability to read, write and even appreciate literary works, and better understand significant books of ancient times and of traditional culture. With better development of humanity, they are likely to have more sense of loving the country, family and people. 
c) The Readings are adopted from a diversity of sources, including Classics, History Books, individual writings and literary anthology-ancient or modern. In addition to the explanation and discussion of vocabulary items, difficult words, classic allusions, main ideas, origin and the time background of the articles, a brief comment is also made on the authors' life, their works, literary styles/status. 
d)The course is to teach students how to write and handle official correspondences and social letters.

description.zh: 此專科英文課程共四年：專一、專二、專三、專四。其課程目標為培養學生獨立閱讀、進階寫作與口語溝通能力，並培育學生逐漸成為獨立的語言學習者。教學採符合溝通互動取向與全語言哲學的教學法，並依學生特點和課堂文化做適當教學調整與輔助。學生經由大量閱讀具知識性、趣味性、適合其程度的作品，經由經常參與角色扮演、分組討論、口頭報告與短文寫作等學習活動，逐漸提昇語言溝通能力與善用學習策略來解決問題的能力。
description.en: This junior-college English program consists of four-year English courses, with the purposes to develop fluency in reading and writing, and to improve listening and speaking abilities. The communicative approach and the whole language philosophy are thus adopted to implement the curriculum. In these courses, students have plenty of opportunities to take part in role-plays, oral presentations, pair work, small-group discussions and whole-class discussions for communicative purposes; they have good opportunities to express their feelings and thoughts in their essays and journal entries. A variety of reading, writing, and oral communication tasks are provided with a view to developing students' reading, writing, and oral communication skills, and to facilitating their using appropriate, effective learning strategies to accomplish learning tasks. In a word, the purpose of this curriculum is to motivate students to learn English, and to help them gradually become confident and competent use

此專科英文課程共四年：專一、專二、專三、專四。其課程目標為培養學生獨立閱讀、進階寫作與口語溝通能力，並培育學生逐漸成為獨立的語言學習者。教學採符合溝通互動取向與全語言哲學的教學法，並依學生特點和課堂文化做適當教學調整與輔助。學生經由大量閱讀具知識性、趣味性、適合其程度的作品，經由經常參與角色扮演、分組討論、口頭報告與短文寫作等學習活動，逐漸提昇語言溝通能力與善用學習策略來解決問題的能力。
This junior-college English program consists of four-year English courses, with the purposes to develop fluency in reading and writing, and to improve listening and speaking abilities. The communicative approach and the whole language philosophy are thus adopted to implement the curriculum. In these courses, students have plenty of opportunities to take part in role-plays, oral presentations, pair work, small-group discussions and whole-class discussions for communicative purposes; they have good opportunities to express their feelings and thoughts in their essays and journal entries. A variety of reading, writing, and oral communication tasks are provided with a view to developing students' reading, writing, and oral communication skills, and to facilitating their using appropriate, effective learning strategies to accomplish learning tasks. In a word, the purpose of this curriculum is to motivate students to learn English, and to help them gradually become confident and competent use

syllabi.outline:
一、 課程目標
技能發展：使學生掌握籃球、排球、撞球及羽球之基礎運動技能與正確動作機制。
規則認知：深入了解各項球類之比賽規則、裁判法及實戰戰術運用。
體能促進：透過系統化教學與體能檢測（如 140 公尺折返跑），提升學生心肺適能與敏捷性。
素養培育：建立良好的運動精神、團隊合作意識，並養成器材搬運與場地維護之責任感。

二、 教學核心內容
本課程採取「模組化教學」，各項運動依序進行訓練：
籃球模組：提升個人技術（運球上籃、BEEF 投籃機制）與小組配合。
排球模組：建立團隊防守觀念（低高手傳球、攔網）與六人制對抗。
撞球模組：專注於擊球姿勢、架桿穩定度、瞄準原理及基本桿法應用。
羽球模組：強化握拍步法與控球技術（長球、殺球、挑球）。

三、 課堂要求與安全守則
服裝規範：上課須穿著運動服裝及運動鞋（撞球課亦同），未符規定者依平時成績扣分。
安全宣導：嚴禁在無教師指導下進行高強度對抗；撞球教學時嚴禁揮舞球桿。
場地維護：課程前後需協助器材搬運與清點，維持運動場地（及撞球布面）整潔。
特殊狀況：如遇生理期、受傷或身體不適，應於課前主動告知老師，以安排替代學習。

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為五專部工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週4小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en:
The course is aimed directly at the five-year-degree-program students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to
emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester, and 4 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. description.zh: 本課程適用於P-TECH學校。透過多元化的課程設計，透過教學培養學生職場中所需具備的技能及軟實力，為將來進入職場提前做好準備。其課程涵蓋七大主題：協同合作(collaboration)、溝通技巧(communication)、分析式思維(analytical thinking)、自我管理能力(self-management)、激勵(motivation)、領導力(leadership)、專責(responsibility)、好奇心(curiosity)等課程，並搭配企業參訪(worksite visits)、實習課程及企業導師等安排，培養具備職場技能及競爭力的學生。
description.en: The primary focus of Workplace Learning Curriculum is to provide students with introductory units on communication, collaboration, analytical thinking, leadership and responsibility, self-management, curiosity and motivation. The 7 skills are a framework for talking about professional skills within the P-TECH model. We are calling out these skills for the IBM P-TECH schools in hopes that our students will begin to develop fluency in discussing them, which will be highly valuable in distinguishing their readiness for internships and?? jobs from their competition.

description.zh: 本程式設計課程以C語言為基礎，先介紹程式設計的觀念與方法，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入C++程式語言物件導向概念。內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練以應付各類工程上之應用，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計專業之基礎。
description.en: To familiarize the student with basic computer programming concepts. Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer solutions, as well as an introduction into the syntax and semantics of the C and C++ programming language. An important objective of the course is to present effective methods of program design using modular construction and structured programming notions of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

syllabi.outline: This course will introduce the mathematical principles in engineering, including following topics: Matrices, Vectors, Linear Systems, Determinants, and Matrix Eigenvalue Problems in Linear Algebra; Vector Differential and Integral Calculus; Fourier Series and Fourier Integral; and Partial Differential Equations and Boundary Value Problems.
syllabi.schedule:
1	Course introduction & Review. Matrices and Vectors.  
2	Matrix Multiplication & Linear Systems of Equations. 
3	Linear Independence & Solutions of Linear Systems. 
4	Second- and Third-Order Determinants & Determinants.
5	Inverse of a Matrix & Vector Spaces.
6	In-class quiz 1. The Matrix Eigenvalue Problem & Their Applications.
7	Symmetric, Skew-Symmetric, and Orthogonal Matrices & Eigenbases.
8	Vectors in 2-Space and 3-Space & Inner Product & Vector Product.
9	Vector and Scalar Functions and Their Fields. Mid-term exam. 
10	Curves & Gradient of a Scalar Field.
11	Divergence of a Vector Field & Curl of a Vector Field.
12	Line Integrals & Path Independence of Line Integrals & Green’s Theorem in the Plane.
13	Surfaces for Surface Integrals & Surface Integrals & Triple Integrals.
14	In-class quiz 2. Fourier Series & For Arbitrary Period.
15	Even and Odd Functions in Fourier Series & Fourier Integral. 
16	Basic Concepts of PDEs & Vibrating String, Wave Equation Modelling. 
17	Solution of PDEs by Fourier Series.
18	Final exam.

syllabi.outline: Fluid mechanics delves into the static and dynamic behavior of fluid motion. This course covers fundamental properties and principal concepts of fluids, such as pressure distribution, and conservation laws for mass, momentum, and energy. Applications involving internal and external flow will also be given. This course equips students with the ability to analyze and design fluid systems based on appropriate theoretical model.

description.zh: 人工智慧(Artificial Intelligence)正以現在進行式，廣泛應用於大眾日常生活，改善人類生產力，影響我們文明價值。人工智慧領域中，最核心的技術就是深度學習 (Deep Learning, DL)，它是從機械學習 (Machine Learning, ML) 的基本概念，延伸到深度神經網路 (Deep Neural Network, DNN) 的原理和應用技術，具自動地萃取特徵的功能，是當今科技界最熱門的研究項目。本課程介紹深度學習的基礎概念、數學模型演算法，與工程實作原理，瞭解深度學習與TensorFlow開源框架(Open Source Framework)的關鍵實作技術。課程建置TensorFlow運作框架環境，利用精簡程式碼及模型描述文件，設計一個完整的神經網路系統，進而深入淺出進行深度學習技術的實作與應用。本課程涵蓋原理介紹及實作實習，包含: 1.)機械學習、深度學習及神經網路原理介紹, 2.)TensorFlow框架特性及安裝實習, 3.)常用的數學模型演算法 CNN、RNN、及RBM實作, 4.)強化學習介紹, 5.)深度學習應用範例實習。
description.en: This course introduces the basic concepts of DL, mathematical model algorithms, and engineering implementation principles, and understands the key implementation techniques of DL with the TensorFlow Open Source Framework (OSF). The course experiment builds the TensorFlow development environment with streamlined codes and model description files to design a complete DNN. This course introduces the principles and practical aspects of: 1.) ML, DL and DNN, 2.) The features of TensorFlow and OSF installation, 3.) Implementation of Convolution Neural Network (CNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM), 4.) Introduction of Reinforcement Learning, 5.) DL application practices.

syllabi.outline:
本課程包含深度學習簡介，內容講述深度學習概述、應用領域、深度學習與傳統機器學習的區別。
1.	TensorFlow介紹：TensorFlow簡介、TensorFlow環境搭建、TensorFlow基礎操作。
2.	神經網路模型：多層感知器（Multilayer Perceptron）、卷積神經網路（Convolutional Neural Network, CNN）、循環神經網路（Recurrent Neural Network, RNN）等。
3.	訓練與評估：模型訓練、超參數調整、評估技巧。
4.	深度學習實戰：使用TensorFlow實現數據分類、影像分類、語音識別等深度學習應用實例。
5.	深度學習進階：深度學習進階技巧，包括半監督學習、生成對抗網路（Generative Adversarial Network, GAN）、強化學習等。
I. Introduction to Deep Learning
Definition and history of deep learning
Overview of deep learning applications
Types of neural networks (Feedforward, Convolutional, Recurrent)
II. Neural Network Basics
Neurons and activation functions
Cost functions and optimization algorithms
Overfitting and regularization
III. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)
Convolution operation
Pooling layers
Transfer learning with pre-trained models
Applications of CNNs (image classification, object detection, segmentation)
IV. Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs)
Time-series data and sequential modeling
Types of RNNs (Simple RNN, LSTM, GRU)
Applications of RNNs (text classification, language translation, speech recognition)
V. Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)
Definition and principles of GANs
Generator and discriminator networks
Applications of GANs (image synthesis, style transfer)
VI. TensorFlow
Overview of TensorFlow
Building and training neural networks in TensorFlow
Advanced TensorFlow features (custom layers, GPU acceleration, TensorBoard)
VII. Case Studies and Projects
Hands-on projects using TensorFlow and deep learning
Case studies from various industries (computer vision, natural language processing, recommendation systems)
VIII. Conclusion
Recap of key concepts and deep learning techniques
Discussion of current trends and future directions in deep learning
Preparing for a career in deep learning and AI.

syllabi.outline:
微處理器為各類高效能電子產品中的核心關鍵元件，其相關技術對電機與電子工程領域的工程師而言已愈發重要。本課程旨在系統性介紹近代微處理器的發展脈絡與基礎原理，內容涵蓋微處理器架構、軟體開發環境、C 語言程式設計，以及周邊電路之設計與應用。課程將以 TI（Texas Instruments）微處理器為教學範例，透過整合性的方式說明微處理器的通用運作原理與設計概念。修課學生完成本課程後，將能舉一反三，將所學原理應用至其他類型的微處理器或嵌入式系統之開發與設計。

Microprocessors are one of the core components in a wide range of high-performance electronic products, and microprocessor technologies have become increasingly important for electrical and electronic engineers. This course aims to provide a systematic introduction to modern microprocessors, covering their historical development and fundamental principles. The course content includes microprocessor architectures, software development environments, C language programming, and peripheral circuit design. Texas Instruments (TI) microprocessors are used as representative examples throughout the course. Through an integrated instructional approach, the general operating principles and design concepts of microprocessors are introduced. Upon completion of this course, students will be able to apply the acquired knowledge and principles to other types of microprocessors or embedded processing systems.

description.zh: 以數學與物理的方法來探討化學之原理，物質之結構與性質，內容包括由氣體動力論衍導熱力學之基本定律，物理平衡（相平衡）、化學平衡、溶液論、電化學、反應動力學、量子力學、光譜學、表面現象、輸送性質等。
description.en: This course deals with the principle of chemistry, structure and properties of matter by the matter matical and physical methods. Topics include the kinetic theory of gases, basis laws of thermodgnamics, physical equilibria (phase equilibria ), chemical equilibria, solutions, electrochemistry, chemical kinetics, quantum mechanics, spectroscopy, surface phenomena and transport properties etc.

syllabi.outline: In the second semester, this course first introduces the physical behavior in a simple mixture system and describes the chemical equilibrium by physical variables and state function. In addition to learning thermodynamics, we will also give the knowledge of chemical kinetics at the end of the semester.

Week 1. Rules -Course Introduction and Phase equilibrium in one component system (CH4)
Week 2. Phase equilibrium in one component system (CH4)
Week 3. Phase equilibrium in two-component system (CH4)
Week 4. Thermodynamics of mixing (CH5) and QUIZ (I)
Week 5. The Thermodynamic of the ideal solution (CH5)
Week 6. Mid-term Exam
Week 7. The Thermodynamic of real solution (CH5)
Week 8. Phase diagram (1/2) (CH5)
Week 9. Phase diagram (2/2) (CH5)
Week 10. Ionic solution (CH5) and QUIZ (II)
Week 11. Colligative Properties (CH5)
Week 12. Midterm exam
Week 13. Chemical transformation, Equilibrium constant (CH6) 
Week 14. Electrochemical cell chemical cells (CH6)
Week 15. Chemical kinetics (CH17)
Week 16. Chemical kinetics (CH17)
Week 17. Chemical kinetics (CH17)
18. Final exam

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 以數學與物理的方法來探討化學之原理，物質之結構與性質，內容包括由氣體動力論衍導熱力學之基本定律，物理平衡（相平衡）、化學平衡、溶液論、電化學、反應動力學、量子力學、光譜學、表面現象、輸送性質等。
description.en: This course deals with the principle of chemistry, structure and properties of matter by the matter matical and physical methods. Topics include the kinetic theory of gases, basis laws of thermodgnamics, physical equilibria (phase equilibria ), chemical equilibria, solutions, electrochemistry, chemical kinetics, quantum mechanics, spectroscopy, surface phenomena and transport properties etc.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. description.zh: 以數學與物理的方法來探討化學之原理，物質之結構與性質，內容包括由氣體動力論衍導熱力學之基本定律，物理平衡（相平衡）、化學平衡、溶液論、電化學、反應動力學、量子力學、光譜學、表面現象、輸送性質等。
description.en: This course deals with the principle of chemistry, structure and properties of matter by the matter matical and physical methods. Topics include the kinetic theory of gases, basis laws of thermodgnamics, physical equilibria (phase equilibria ), chemical equilibria, solutions, electrochemistry, chemical kinetics, quantum mechanics, spectroscopy, surface phenomena and transport properties etc.

syllabi.outline: In the second semester, this course first introduces the physical behavior in a simple mixture system and describes the chemical equilibrium by physical variables and state function. In addition to learning thermodynamics, we will also give the knowledge of chemical kinetics at the end of the semester.

2. Phase equilibrium in one component system (CH4)
3. Phase equilibrium in two-component system (CH4)
4. Thermodynamics of mixing (CH5)
5. The Thermodynamic of the ideal solution (CH5)
6. Mid-term Exam
7. The Thermodynamic of real solution (CH5)
8. Phase diagram (1/2) (CH5)
9. Phase diagram (2/2) (CH5)
10. Ionic solution (CH5)
11. Colligative Properties (CH5)
12. Midterm exam
13. Chemical transformation, Equilibrium constant (CH6) 
14. Electrochemical cell chemical cells (CH6)
15. Chemical kinetics (CH17)
16. Chemical kinetics (CH17)
17. Reaction dynamics (CH18)
18. Final exam

description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 使學生認識陶瓷製造的基本過程及測試陶瓷基本性質，包括陶瓷材料之物理，機械，及電導性質。除配合國內產業結構外，本實習課程將另介紹對新陶瓷的製程技術概念。實驗內容主要分成兩大類，A.為陶瓷材料製程加工，包含手拉胚實作 捏陶實作、釉藥配置，上釉，釉燒、坩鍋上釉料、燒結等。B.為陶瓷基本性質測試、進階性質分析，包含陶瓷材料之物理，機械，及電熱性質分析。
description.en: This course allows students to understand the basic manufacturing processes and properties of ceramics under test, including their physical, mechanical, and electricity conductivity properties. This lab course is designed to meet the needs of local ceramics industry, and  the concepts of new manufacturing techniques for advanced ceramics are also introduced. Part A for hands-on practices will include hand-made pottery, glazing, glaze-firing, and sintering processes. Part B for ceramic properties will cover physical, mechanical, and electrical-thermal properties of ceramic materials.

description.zh:
材料科學為工程教育的重要科技，材料的性質與特性，為現代工程
設計中佔有相當重要的地位，金屬材料的各種性質，都基於其內部
構造的變化，其內部原子聚集成規則的結晶構造，亦或聚集成非結
晶構造，其所形成的各種物理特性，由最基本的結晶構造開始了解。電子顯微鏡，破壞力學，超導性，電傳導，超塑性，動態回復，動態時效應變。差排理論、結晶核的形成與成長，合金相理論，晶界自由度，鑄造物的成核與均質化，硬化現象，固體擴散現象，破壞現象及理論，潛變的形成與原因等，充分了解金屬材料特性上的理論基礎與變化軌跡。
description.en:
Properties and characteristics of materials play important role in modern engineering design.Each property of materials is based on its transformation at inner structure,
its atoms inside converge either a regulated crystal structure or a noncrystal structure,
their physical property should be understood from the most fundamental crystalline
structure, such as electronic microscope, destructive dynamics, super-conductivity,
electronic conductivity, super-plasticity, dynamic recovery, dynamic aging strain
, dislocation theory, the formation and growth of crystalline nucleus, alloy phase
theory, crystal boundary free degree, nucleus and homogenization of casting product,
hardening phenomenon, solid diffusion phenomenon, destructive phenomenon and
theory, creep formation and its reason, all of these make student fully understand
the theory basis and change record of the metallic material characteristics.

description.zh: 將熱力學定律應用於計算凝結相之化學位能與其平衡，逸壓和活性因素，溶液熱力學，多元金屬溶液，相圖和相變化，運用電腦模擬相反應和相圖，及研擬冶金數學模式。
description.en: It applies the theory of thermaldynamics to calculate chemical potential energy and its equilibrium of condensed phase, released pressure and activated factors, solution thermaldynamics, complex metal solution , phase diagram and phase change, computer-aided phase reaction and phase diagram simulation, and planning a mathmatics model of metallurgy.

syllabi.outline:
This course covers the three Laws of Thermodynamics. Thermodynamic functions are introduced to calculate chemical potential energy of matters. Concepts of materials solutions, phase transformation, and activity of condensed phases are covered. The formation of phase diagrams and calculations for equilibrium of chemical reactions are discussed and evaluated.


將熱力學定律應用於計算凝結相之化學位能與其平衡，逸壓和活性因素，溶液熱力學，多元金屬溶液，相圖和相變化，運用電腦模擬相反應和相圖，及研擬冶金數學模式。

description.zh: 如何應用熱處理之手段使材料達到所求之特性。對於各種熱處理之原理、解析及實際的應用作詳盡的介紹。隨著科技之發達，機械工業之進步、構造物之增大及精密化、迷你化之趨勢，金屬材料所要求之性質需要更進一步之強化，為滿足此一要求，除調整合金元素之外，必須賴適當的熱處理，才能發揮材料本身含有合金元素之功能，亦可滿足吾人所需之各種用途，本課程為使學生瞭解這些處理方法，由理論上說明熱處理與變態理論，及熱處理對強化機構上之理論根據，及熱處理之方法等，本熱處理課程內容有：1.金屬熱處理之基礎，各種組織與變態，平衡圖在熱處理上之應用，連續冷卻，恆溫冷卻，在熱處理之應用、鋼之淬火變態舉動，合金元素在材料上之影響，結晶粒之大小性質對熱處理之影響，鋼之硬化能之應用及計算方法。2.熱處理技術、鋼之加熱及各種熱處理方法。3.鋼之光輝熱處理，保護爐氣之種類及其管理方法。4.鋼之表面硬化熱處理。5.淬火零件之設計及材料之選擇。6.工具模具鋼、不銹鋼、鑄鐵、銅及鋁合金之熱處理。7.熱處理發生不良原因及其防止方法。

description.zh: 本課程乃針對材料工程中金屬材料領域開立之專業課程。本課程藉由熱力學，電化學，物理冶金等基礎課程，依各類不同金屬材料的冶鍊與合金製作過程進行介紹。課程內容包括鋼鐵合金之冶鍊，非鐵材料包括銅、鋁、鈦、鎳、鎂、鋅、矽及貴金屬等材質之火法或濕法冶鍊製程，以上金屬合金之配置特性與特殊製程設備，以及各類合金特性與應用之領域。
description.en: The course is designated for undergraduate students who are interested in developing skills in metallic materials-related fields. Based on the concepts of thermodynamics, electrochemistry, and physical metallurgy, the course introduces the extraction metallurgy of metallic elements and their alloying processes. The course discusses: metallurgy of ferrous alloys, metallurgy and hydrometallurgy of Cu, Al, Ti, Ni, Mg, Zn, Si, and noble metals, and the specialty processes for preparing alloys of the above. Properties and applications of the above alloys are also covered.

description.zh: 本課程以訓練學生對陶瓷材料性質認識，並進而介紹陶瓷材料基本製程。課程重點在陶瓷粉体製備成形方法，燒結及燒結理論，除加強學生認識傳統陶瓷外，並對結構陶瓷與電子陶瓷之應用，作有系統的介紹。
description.en:
This course aims at training the knowledge of ceramics materials and to introduce
the basic manufacturing process of ceramics materials.The focus of this course is
the formation method of ceramics powder, sintering and sintering theory. Except
for strengthening the perception of traditonal ceramics, it also has a systematic
introduction to the application of structural ceramics and electronic ceramics..

description.zh: 各學院指定向度學分規定如下： 機電學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 電資學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 工程學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 管理學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分。 設計學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 人社學院：社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 修完學院指定向度課程12學分，剩餘6學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業18學分。
description.en: The dimension credits stipulated by each college are as follows： College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. College of Engineering： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. College of Management： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the nature and science curriculum. College of Design： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 本課程主要目標在介紹與實際問題相關之數學領域，以模擬解題及詮釋等方式，將數學方法應用在工程問題上。課程內容有常微分方程，線性代數，向量微積分，Fourier 分析及偏微分方程式等章節，訓練同學在理論，計算及實驗間建立正確的認知及意義。內容將繼續介紹複數分析及數值方法等章節，尤其對計算機的概念及演算法乃給予較多的強調，對實際問題亦有簡化討論。另外，在應用解決問題構想，練習例題及理論間，更有相輔相成的效果。至於線性規化，圖形組合，機率理論及數學機率等內容亦有概略介紹，務使同學有正確的認知。
description.en: The course*s main taget is to introduce math region which is relating to practical questions with simulate solution and interpretation, it applies the math method to engineering questions. The course content includes ordinary differential equation, linear algebra, vector calculus, Fourier analysis and partial differencial equation partial differential equation, with the aim to train students in establishing an exact perception to the meaning of theory, calculation and experimentation. it also introduces complex number analysis and numeric method, especially put more emphasis at the computer concept and algorithm, a simplified discussion to the practical problem as well. Besides, it has a mutual supporting effect in solving question concepts, practising model question and theory. As to the linear programming, graphs and combinatorial optimization, probability theory and mathmetical probability, this course also has a brief introduction, its target is to let all the students

syllabi.outline: This course introduces mathematical methods commonly used in engineering applications. Through problem solving and interpretation, students will learn to apply mathematical tools to address engineering challenges. The curriculum covers: (1) series solutions, (2) matrices and vectors, (3) vector calculus, (4) Fourier analysis, and (5) partial differential equations. The course aims to train students to establish an understanding of the connections and significance between theory and practice.

description.zh: 主要授課內容包括結晶形態、結晶構造、x-射線分析、礦物之物理、化學、光學性質、礦物之生成及產狀、礦物各論等。
description.en: 1.Introduction. 2.Crystallography (external form and internal order). 3.Crystal chemistry. 4.Crystal structures and structure analysis. 5.Physical properties. 6.Chemical properties. 7.Mineral stability diagrams. 8.Descriptive mineralogy: (1)Native elements,Sulfides and Sulfosalts. (2)Oxides,Hydroxides, and Halides. (3)Carbonates,Nitrates,Borates,Sulfates,Chromates, Tungstates,Molybdates,Phosphates,Arsenates,and Vanadates. (4)Silicates.

syllabi.outline:
理解礦物生成之物理及化學因素及其晶體結構與物理性質間之關係，並瞭解如何將礦物學應用於地球科學與晶體材料之合成與生長，其大綱內容如下：
1.	礦物相平衡與相變化：相圖、Polymorphic reactions, Exsolusion processes, Polytype
2.	雙晶、結構缺陷
3.	物理性質：顏色、電性、磁性、放射性
4.	晶體結構：幾何結晶學、結晶形態、原子排列與對稱、空間群
5.	礦物分析：礦物相與化學成份分析

description.zh: 實習課程主要講述材料試驗的目的，各種材料試驗設備的構造及操作使用方法，內容涵蓋抗拉、彎曲、壓縮、衝擊及各種不同之硬度試驗機等，使學生能充分熟悉使用操作，以達熟練之程度。並配合其他課程，判斷分析材料特性。
description.en: The objectives of this lab course are to introduce the various material testing equipment and their operations. The equipment covered includes tensile, bending, compression, impact, and hardness testing machines. In completing this course, students will be able to operate these equipment and measure the mechanical properties of materials which are discussed in other in-class courses.

description.zh: 本課程主要針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原 理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺 陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物 理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度 、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變），材料之強化機構與方法。

description.zh: 本課程藉由基本化學原理及化學反應探討化學物質在各環境介質中的反應、機制與流布，瞭解人類活動對環境所可能產生的影響，並進而探討各種環境保護技術之原理與應用，以鏈結化學與環境保護的關聯性。
description.en: This course explores the reaction, mechanism and distribution of chemical substances in various environmental media through the basic chemical principles and chemical reactions, understands the possible impact of human activities on the environment, and then discusses the principles and applications of various environmental protection technologies. Relevance of junction chemistry and environmental protection.

description.zh: 材料科學為工程教育的重要科技，材料的性質與特性，為現代工程設計中佔有相當重要的地位，金屬材料的各種性質，都基於其內部構造的變化，其內部原子聚集成規則的結晶構造，亦或聚集成非結晶構造，其所形成的各種物理特性，由最基本的結晶構造開始了解。電子顯微鏡，破壞力學，超導性，電傳導，超塑性，動態回復，動態時效應變。差排理論、結晶核的形成與成長，合金相理論，晶界自由度，鑄造物的成核與均質化，硬化現象，固體擴散現象，破壞現象及理論，潛變的形成與原因等，充分了解金屬材料特性上的理論基礎與變化軌跡。
description.en: Properties and characteristics of materials play important role in modern engineering design.Each property of materials is based on its transformation at inner structure, its atoms inside converge either a regulated crystal structure or a noncrystal structure, their physical property should be understood from the most fundamental crystalline structure, such as electronic microscope, destructive dynamics, super-conductivity, electronic conductivity, super-plasticity, dynamic recovery, dynamic aging strain , dislocation theory, the formation and growth of nucleus, alloy phase theory, degree of freedom of crystal boundary , nucleation and homogenization of casting product, hardening phenomenon, solid diffusion phenomenon, destructive phenomenon and theory, creep formation and its reason, all of these make student fully understand the theory basis and change record of the metallic material characteristics.

syllabi.outline:
本學期課程集中在物理冶金與擴散有關之章節, 包括擴散, 凝固, 析出與退火，幫助學生建立材料科學之基礎知識。此課程為以課堂授課為主，並將另外安排教學助理時間，針對作業進行討論。 

This course focus on the discussion of the diffusion in physical metallurgy. Including diffusion, solidification, precipitation, and annealing. The objective of this course is to establish the basic knowledge of materials science for the students and to further connect the knowledge to related future researches. This course is a lecture-oriented course. Teaching assistant’s time will be arranged for the discussion of homework.

W6-10 凝固 (solidification)
W11-15 析出硬化 (precipitation hardening)
W16-20 退火 (annealing)

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 使同學瞭解土壤之基本物理性質、土壤分類及土壤之力學行為。課程內容為土壤成因、土壤基本物理性質、阿太堡限度及粒徑分析、土壤分類、土壤滲透及及滲流、土壤之壓縮及密壓作用、土壤剪力強度及剪力變形、土壤之夯實。

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在使同學理解土壤的基本物理性質、分類方法及力學行為，內容涵蓋土壤的來源與粒徑、重量體積關係、土壤的塑性與結構、土壤的工程分類、土壤夯實、土壤的滲透性與滲流、現場應力、土體中的應力、土壤的壓縮性，以及土壤的剪力強度等主題，建立土壤力學與工程應用的核心知識基礎。

description.zh: 了解土木工程以及其他各種領域的流體動力學。 學習使用控制體積分析來建立基本方程式並解決問題。 理解並使用微分方程式來確定內部和外部流動的壓力和速度變化。 了解黏度的概念以及黏度在實際流動中的重要性。 學習結合使用方程式和實驗數據來確定流動系統中的損失。 學習使用量綱分析來設計物理或數值實驗並應用動態相似性。
description.en: Develop an understanding of fluid dynamics in civil engineering as well as a variety of other fields. Learn to use control volume analysis to develop basic equations and solve problems. Understand and use differential equations to determine pressure and velocity variations in internal and external flows. Understand the concept of viscosity and its significance in real flows. Learn to use equations in combination with experimental data to determine losses in flow systems. Learn to use dimensional analysis to design physical or numerical experiments and to apply dynamic similarity.

syllabi.outline: Develop an understanding of fluid dynamics in aerospace engineering as well as a variety of other fields. Learn to use control volume analysis to develop basic equations and to solve problems. Understand and use differential equations to determine pressure and velocity variations in internal and external flows. Understand the concept of viscosity and where viscosity is important in real flows. Learn to use equations in combination with experimental data to determine losses in flow systems. Learn to use dimensional analysis to design physical or numerical experiments and to apply dynamic similarity.

B.	Continuity and conservation of mass.

6.	Dimensional analysis.

description.zh: 建築資訊塑模（Building Information Modeling, BIM）在臺灣近年的營建產業蓬勃發展，已逐漸取代傳統的3D繪圖方式而成為土木建築領域的顯學。其能進行2D圖面出圖、3D展示，並且可透過客製化的API程式進行各種應用諸如數量計算、衝突檢測及施工模擬，使協同作業能夠充份的發揮效率，以提升工程的施工品質、效率與安全，減少設計錯誤，並降低施工成本。本課程透過課堂講授與案例實作，讓學生理解BIM技術的發展與應用潛力，並能熟習Autodesk Revit軟體之基礎操作，實際應用BIM技術於工程案例當中。
description.en: Building Information Modeling (BIM) is an innovative process in Architecture/Engineering/Construction industry. It can integrate various   information into a 3D model. With such a characteristic, to compare with a traditional 3D model, a BIM model can achieve more possible applications, such as quantity takeoff, clash detection, and 4D simulation. In addition, the characteristic of BIM also enables parametric modeling, which make modeling process easier and more efficient. This course aims to introduce the basic concept of BIM, and train the enrolled students to develop the basic skills of BIM modeling and applications.

Building Information Modeling (BIM) is an innovative process in Architecture/Engineering/Construction industry. It can integrate various   information into a 3D model. With such a characteristic, to compare with a traditional 3D model, a BIM model can achieve more possible applications, such as quantity takeoff, clash detection, and 4D simulation. In addition, the characteristic of BIM also enables parametric modeling, which make modeling process easier and more efficient. This course aims to introduce the basic concept of BIM, and train the enrolled students to develop the basic skills of BIM modeling and applications.

syllabi.outline:
1. 首先在訓練學生基本數學思惟及推理的能力，另外也銜接基礎數學及微積分的課程，以奠定各專業領域所需的數學基礎。 
2. 課程內容以教導學生具有分析處理實際工程問題所需之基本數學觀念及能力為主。 
3. 強調理論基礎、運算技巧及實際應用領域，另特別增強解題技巧及演算能力，使對將來繼續深造能預作準備。 
4. 使學生具備未來成為頂尖工程師或科學家所需要之入門工具。
5. 本學期課程以向量微積分、線性代數為主

Environmental Science is an interdisciplinary learning, including the knowledge about the biological and non-biological science on the earth and the interactions between human beings and the environment. Human live in the earth environment and use all the natural resources to meet their living needs. Therefore, the basic knowledge about the earth and the resources on it are necessary. With the correct knowledge, the interactions between human and the environment are able to sustain peacefully. This course is a beginning and is aimed to learn the all components about the earth. Moreover, to precious and to conserve the nature is the most important message in this course. The contents of this course include ecosystem, earth science, water resources, energy, food resources, environmental ethics, and environmental justices.

description.zh: 了解土木工程以及其他各種領域的流體動力學。 學習使用控制體積分析來建立基本方程式並解決問題。 理解並使用微分方程式來確定內部和外部流動的壓力和速度變化。 了解黏度的概念以及黏度在實際流動中的重要性。 學習結合使用方程式和實驗數據來確定流動系統中的損失。 學習使用量綱分析來設計物理或數值實驗並應用動態相似性。
description.en: Develop an understanding of fluid dynamics in civil engineering as well as a variety of other fields. Learn to use control volume analysis to develop basic equations and solve problems. Understand and use differential equations to determine pressure and velocity variations in internal and external flows. Understand the concept of viscosity and its significance in real flows. Learn to use equations in combination with experimental data to determine losses in flow systems. Learn to use dimensional analysis to design physical or numerical experiments and to apply dynamic similarity.

syllabi.outline: Develop an understanding of fluid dynamics in aerospace engineering as well as a variety of other fields. Learn to use control volume analysis to develop basic equations and to solve problems. Understand and use differential equations to determine pressure and velocity variations in internal and external flows. Understand the concept of viscosity and where viscosity is important in real flows. Learn to use equations in combination with experimental data to determine losses in flow systems. Learn to use dimensional analysis to design physical or numerical experiments and to apply dynamic similarity.

A.	Fluid dynamics.
B.	Continuity and conservation of mass.
C.	The Bernoulli equation.
D.	The Momentum equation.
4.	Viscous flow in pipes.
5.	Flow measurements. 
6.	Dimensional analysis.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

name.en: Textile materials and principles of textile Technology

description.zh:
1. 本課程主要說明各種紡織材料之組成和成形, 基本性質, 各種加工與應用。 
2. 本課程主要簡介紡織科技所包含之原料與製程, 製品和評估，同時訓練學生了解基本的紡織辭彙。
description.en:
1. Introduction to textile compositions, properties, spinning, processings and applications. 
2. Textile materials and related processes are introduced, and technical used are learned as well.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要是教授紡織上的基本概念，對於整體紡織從原料到成紗、織布、染色、整理加工及成衣與行銷貿易等皆有普遍性認識，以建立未來學習紡織專業知識的良好基礎。上學期其主要內容為討論紡織原料的種類與製造方法及各種纖維之特性及適用性，其中包括天然纖維諸如棉、毛、絲、麻等，以及人造纖維諸如再生纖維（嫘縈），半合成纖維（醋酸纖維）與合成纖維（尼龍、聚酯、聚丙烯晴、聚烯烴及其他工業用纖維等）。有關上述纖維之化學性質與物理特性皆在課程中詳加說明介紹，並針對纖維物性之差異性從微細構造方面予以簡單闡述解說，以建立將來相關課程之基礎。
This course mainly teaches the basic concepts of textiles for a general understanding of the overall textile from raw materials to yarn, weaving, dyeing, finishing, clothing and marketing trade, etc., to establish the future of learning professional textile knowledge. The main content of the last semester was to discuss the types and manufacturing methods of textile materials and the characteristics and applicability of various fibers, including natural fibers such as cotton, wool, silk, hemp, etc., and man-made fibers such as regenerated fibers (rayon), semi-synthetic fiber (acetate fiber) and synthetic fibers (nylon, polyester, polyacrylonitrile, polyolefin, and other industrial fibers, etc.). The chemical properties and physical properties of the fibers mentioned above are explained in detail in the course. The differences in the fibers' physical properties are briefly described in terms of the microstructure to establish future related studies.

Week 11-14: Regenerated Fiber (再生纖維)
Week 15: Midterm exam (期中考)
Week 16-18 Final oral presentation (期末口頭報告)

description.zh: 本課程將數學應用於生活環境中，根據基礎理論公式，來表示具週期性現象，例如：地球運轉、聲波、馬達等，這種級數的表示稱為傅立葉級數，而非週期性的現象，衍生傅立葉積分與傅立葉轉換。此外，拉普拉斯轉換處理，能夠將機械的或電氣的驅動力有不連續、脈衝的複雜週期性問題簡化，將工程數學導入實際應用。
description.en: Mathematics can be applied to the living environment in the course. According to basic theoretical formulas, it represents periodic phenomena, such as: earth movement, sound waves, motors, etc. This series of expressions is called Fourier series. However, Fourier integral and Fourier transform are non-periodic phenomena. In addition, the Laplace transform process can simplify the complicated periodic problems of mechanical or electrical driving forces with discontinuous and impulsive phenomena. The class introduce engineering mathematics into practical applications.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以講述物理化學上，尤其是量子化學上，必須用到的數學為主。內容主要涵蓋三大部分。第一部分為基本線性代數，包含向量，矩陣，以及行列式等，第二部分為特殊函數，第三部分則為傅立葉轉換。

The course is designed to provide the mathematic background for physical chemistry especially for quantum chemistry. The teaching materials will include Laplace transform, Basic Linear Algebra, Differential Equation, Fourier Analysis, and special functions.

Outline: 
1.	Series Solutions of Differential Equation
2.	Linear Algebra :  Vector, Matrix, Determinants, Eigenvalues, Eigenvectors, Diagonalization
3.	Laplace transformation
4.	Fourier Series, Fourier Transformation
5.	Special function : Hermite polynomials, Laguerre polynomials, Legendre polynominals

description.en: The aim of this course is to introduce a series of biotechniques. To amplify a certain DNA fragment by using PCR and to clone DNA by using Recombinant DNA technology. Different restriction enzymes can cleave at double strand DNA at specific sites, T4 DNA ligase does link 5’and 3’ of DNA. The amplified DNA were inserted onto plasmid and then transformed into host cells and culture the cell. Learning how to express protein and analyze function as well as to grow crystal.

description.en: In inorganic chemistry (II), solid-state chemistry is introduced about crystal structure, semiconductors, and superconductors. Moreover, the chemical properties of main group elements and coordination chemistry are also described in the course. It is focus on structure and isomers, bonding, electronic spectra, and reaction mechanisms. In addition, the novel applications are shown in the course.

syllabi.outline: 本課程介紹機率學的基本概念與應用，包括集合、排列組合、機率理論、條件機率、隨機變數、累積分佈函數、期望值與變異數等內容。課程涵蓋離散型與連續型機率分配、聯合分配、隨機變數的函數變換，以及順序統計量與基礎統計量的介紹。此外，學生將學習柴比雪夫不等式、大數定律與中央極限定理等重要定理，並透過期中考試與期末考試進行學習評估。This course introduces fundamental concepts and applications of probability, including sets, permutations and combinations, probability theory, conditional probability, random variables, cumulative distribution functions, and measures such as expectations and variances. The course covers discrete and continuous probability distributions, joint distributions, transformations of random variables, order statistics, and basic statistical measures. Additionally, students will study Chebyshev’s inequality, the law of large numbers, and the central limit theorem, with learning progress assessed through midterm and final examinations.
syllabi.schedule:
第1週	集合與排列組合	Sets, Permutations, and Combinations
第2週	機率概論與條件機率	Introduction to Probability and Conditional Probability
第3週	條件機率與獨立性，隨機變數的概念	Conditional Probability, Independence, and Random Variables
第4週	隨機變數與累積分佈函數	Random Variables and Cumulative Distribution Functions
第5週	期望值、變異數與動差生成函數	Expectation, Variance, and Moment Generating Functions
第6週	特徵函數與隨機變數的函數變換	Characteristic Functions and Transformations of Random Variables
第7週	離散型機率分配 (Part 1)	Discrete Probability Distributions (Part 1)
第8週	離散型機率分配 (Part 2)	Discrete Probability Distributions (Part 2)
第9週	期中考試	Midterm Exam
第10週	連續型機率分配 (Part 1)	Continuous Probability Distributions (Part 1)
第11週	連續型機率分配 (Part 2)	Continuous Probability Distributions (Part 2)
第12週	聯合機率分配與條件分配	Joint Probability Distributions and Conditional Distributions
第13週	期望值的性質	Properties of Expectation
第14週	期望值性質與二元常態分配	Properties of Expectation and Bivariate Normal Distribution
第15週	二維隨機變數的函數變換	Transformations of Bivariate Random Variables
第16週	順序統計量與基本統計量	Order Statistics and Basic Statistical Measures
第17週	柴比雪夫不等式、大數定律與中央極限定理	Chebyshev's Inequality, Law of Large Numbers, and Central Limit Theorem
第18週	期末考試	Final Exam

description.en: This course is mainly aimed at introducing the data  structures commonly used in programming languages, including: (1) the concept of ADT (abstract data type) and computational complexity, (2) static structures and their storage representations , (3) recursion, stacks, and prefix, infix, and posfix expressions, (4) queues, (5) lists and linked lists, (6) trees, binary trees, height balanced trees, and heaps,  (7) graphs, (8) soring, and (9) searching and hashing.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將主要介紹資料結構(Data Structure)基本概念，輔以C語言作為實作練習之程式語言，課程內容包含：堆疊(Stack)、佇列(Queue)、串列(Linked List)、樹(Tree)、圖(Graph)...等抽象資料型態(Abstract Data Type，ADT)的介紹與實作練習，其次，介紹程式撰寫常用演算法(Algorithm)，包含：排序(Sorting)、搜尋(Search)...等演算法的介紹與實作練習。

1.	修課學生可從本課程學習常見資料結構(Data Structure)。
2.	修課學生可從本課程學習常見演算法(Algorithm)。
3.	修課學生可從本課程練習C語言實現上述資料結構與演算法。

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。
The purpose of this course is to train the students who can be familiar with the statistics approaches and theories. Besides, they will be able to employ the collected data to analyze the unknown environments. The main focus of the class will be on statistical analysis and graphics in Minitab. Students will cover basic statistical concepts and various statistical methods such as estimation, hypothesis tests, regression analysis, and ANOVA.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 Introduction to statistics, data Summary, and presentation
Week 2 Probability, Bayesian theorem, correlation
Week 3 Decision making for a single sample – Estimation, hypothesis testing
Week 4 Decision making for a single sample – Inference on the mean of a population
Week 5 Decision making for a single sample – Inference on the variance of a normal population
Week 6 Decision making for a single sample – Inference on a population proportion
Week 7 Decision making for a single sample – Goodness of fit test
Week 8 Quiz, independent Study
Week 9 Midterm exam (In-class, 1 Cheat Sheet, Calculator)
Week 10 Decision making for two samples – Inference on the means of two populations (Part I)
Week 11 Decision making for two samples – Inference on the means of two populations (Part II)
Week 12 Decision making for two samples – Paired t-test, inference on the ratio of variances of two normal populations
Week 13 Decision making for two samples – Inference on two population proportions
Week 14 Building Empirical Models – Simple Linear Regression (Part I)
Week 15 Building Empirical Models – Simple Linear Regression (Part II)
Week 16 Building Empirical Models – Simple Linear Regression (Part III)
Week 17 Quiz, independent Study
Week 18 Final exam (In-Class, 1 Cheat sheet, Calculator)

description.zh:
隨著網際網路的盛行，電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，使得傳統的商店與行銷環境受到衝擊。資訊科技改變了消費習慣與行銷通路，電子商務的效應已經開始影響商業活動的每個層面，從新產品的開發、銷售、到售後服務均受影響，為企業帶來了無限商機。根據資策會的報告顯示，網際購物市場目前正進入高成長期。網際網路的消費觀念逐漸普及，消費者端的網路交易市集，亦成為未來重要的網路商機。不僅B2C市場（企業對消費者）極具潛力，網友個體戶的開店創業風潮（C2C）更是在蓬勃發中。
面對網路商業的來臨，有著大量的網路商業的人才需求。只要有正確的網路商業經營獲利模式，網路是一個可以賺到大錢的管道，尤其低門檻、低成本的網路拍賣場更是最佳踏板。本課程講授網路創業及網路商業的必要實務經營能力，讓同學在本課程裡學得如何快速的以最少成本來DIY速成個人事業及就業的能力。
description.en: Following the prevailing of the internet, the vigorous development e-commerce has given great impacts on traditional tangible stores and the whole marketing environments. Information Technology has not only changed our lives, but also changed consumers' behavior and marketing channels; and the e-commerce effect has already started to permeate into every stratum of business activities, including the exploitation, marketing, and after-sales service of new products, brings the industries infinite business chances. According to the reports of Institute for Information Industry, the market of internet shopping is going into its high development period, and there are a lot of chances to establish a new enterprise on the internet. So this course will teach about the internet entrepreneurial management.

Following the widespread adoption of the internet, the rapid development of e-commerce has had a profound impact on traditional brick-and-mortar stores and the broader marketing landscape. Information Technology has not only changed our lives but also altered consumers' behavior and marketing channels. The e-commerce effect has already begun to permeate every stratum of business activities, including the development, marketing, and after-sales service of new products, bringing industries infinite business opportunities. According to the Institute for Information Industry's reports, the internet shopping market is entering a high-growth period, presenting numerous opportunities to establish a new internet-based enterprise. This course will teach you about internet entrepreneurial management.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to train the students who can be familiar with the statistics approaches and theories. Besides, they will be able to employ the collected data to analyze the unknown environments. The course includes probability theory, testing, regression analysis and variance analysis.

syllabi.outline:
課程目的在於培養學生運用統計軟體進行資料分析與統計推論的實務能力，並透過實作與討論深化對統計方法的理解。課程強調以互動、說明與同儕學習作為學習歷程的一部分，鼓勵學生透過解釋、提問與討論來建構統計思維。課程內容配合統計推論之核心概念，透過 Python 與 R 進行操作、模擬、診斷與結果解讀。

The course aims to develop students’ ability to apply statistical tools for data analysis and statistical inference through hands-on practice. Learning emphasizes interaction, explanation, and peer learning as integral parts of the process. Students are encouraged to build statistical understanding by discussing, explaining, and questioning methods and results. Course activities align with core concepts of statistical inference and are implemented using Python and R for computation, simulation, diagnostics, and interpretation.

Week 11: Simple linear regression

Week 13: Introduction to multiple regression
Week 14: Integrated simulation and inference practice
Week 15: Comprehensive lab practice
Weeks 16–18: Flexible use for review or assessment

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在培養學生運用統計推論分析資料變異與不確定性的能力，以支援分析、評估與決策過程。課程重視推論邏輯、假設條件與結果詮釋，強調統計方法在資料分析與系統性問題解決中的應用。課程內容涵蓋統計推論之核心理論與方法，並透過概念說明、課堂討論、小組解題、案例分析與引導式活動，協助學生建立完整的統計思維。

This course aims to develop students’ ability to analyze data variability and uncertainty using statistical inference to support analysis, evaluation, and decision-making. The course emphasizes inferential logic, assumptions, and interpretation. It highlights the role of statistical methods in data analysis and systematic problem solving. Course content covers core theories and methods of statistical inference, delivered through conceptual explanations, discussions, guided problem-solving, case analysis, and structured in-class activities.

Weeks 5–6: Common joint distributions and functions of random variables
Weeks 7–8: Descriptive statistics and data visualization
Weeks 9–10: Point estimation and sampling distributions
Weeks 11–12: Confidence intervals
Weeks 13–14: Hypothesis testing
Weeks 15–16: Statistical inference for two samples
Week 17-18: Regression analysis (simple and multiple)
