description.zh: 課程介紹電腦基本常識、人工智慧相關應用、程式設計簡介，內容包含資料型態、流程控制、函式、副程式、陣列與字串、檔案、應用程式設計以及類神經網路與深度學習簡介。
description.en: The course introduces basic computer concept, AI-related applications and programming technique. The contents include data types, flow control, functions, subroutine, arrays, strings, files, neural networks, deep learning and their applications.

syllabi.outline:
課程介紹電腦基本常識、人工智慧相關應用、程式設計簡介，內容包含資料型態、流程控制、函式、副程式、陣列與字串、檔案、應用程式設計以及類神經網路與深度學習簡介。
了解了生成式人工智慧的技術基礎、應用與挑戰。深入解說生成對抗網路（GAN）、深度學習、自然語言處理（NLP）等技術，並知道這些技術如何在文字、圖像、音訊、影片等多模態數據中應用。
不僅詳細剖析了從文本生成圖像、自動生成簡報等具體應用，還探討了生成式AI在創意設計、商業、教育和醫療等領域的廣泛影響。此外，讓學生對生成式AI的倫理與社會影響進行深刻反思，提醒學生在技術進步的同時，也要謹慎看待潛在風險與挑戰。

This course introduces basic computer knowledge, artificial intelligence applications, and an overview of programming, covering data types, flow control, functions, subroutines, arrays and strings, files, application programming, and an introduction to neural networks and deep learning.

It provides an understanding of the technological foundations, applications, and challenges of generative artificial intelligence. It delves into technologies such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), deep learning, and Natural Language Processing (NLP), demonstrating how these technologies are applied to multimodal data including text, images, audio, and video.

The course not only analyzes specific applications such as generating images from text and automatically generating presentations, but also explores the broad impact of generative AI in creative design, business, education, and healthcare. Furthermore, it encourages students to reflect deeply on the ethical and social impacts of generative AI, reminding them to be cautious about potential risks and challenges while pursuing technological advancements.

description.zh: 本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

syllabi.outline:
本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

description.zh: 本課程主要針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變），材料之強化機構與方法。

description.zh:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
description.en:

Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings

■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

syllabi.assessment:
第一次分組：45 % (week01-10)
- 設計練習 #01：20%
- 設計練習 #02：15%
- 指導老師平時分數：10%
第二次分組：35 % (week10-18)
- 設計練習 #03：25%
- 指導老師平時分數：10%
助教平時成績：15 %

評分配比：
（含環境打掃與整潔度、評圖點名與秩序、各階段配合度...等）- 助教不定期公告不配合之學生名單
- 被登記3次以上之同學，設計平時成績以不及格計
- 評圖時會有不定期抽點名
作品集成績：5 % (由第二次分組的指導老師指導評分，屆時由助教提供雲端硬碟彙整各組電子檔) - 評圖後須將各階段模型拍照，並製作作品集電子檔（含排版與美編）。規則另訂。
- 公告成績級距（以A~E之形式），成績為D~E為預警名單 *

syllabi.outline:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

syllabi.outline: 數位技術的應用已成為設計與視覺化溝通上重要的一環。然而數位輔助工具的使用，仍需操作者能以立體的方式去形容所要建構的物件或空間。因此培養學生三維觀察、思考、與想像視覺化的能力依舊是現在設計教育所不可或缺的。本課程便是藉由徒手繪與數位操作的平行訓練，來培養學生在設計上所需要的三維思考想像與傳達呈現的能力。

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹程式設計的基本概念和技術，以及人工智慧的發展和應用。課程內容涵蓋程式語言的基本語法，以及人工智慧的基礎觀念與理論，並藉由編程練習及AI工具操作來進一步了解人工智慧應用以及程式設計的潛在應用。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the fundamental concepts and techniques of programming, as well as the development and application of artificial intelligence. The course content covers basic syntax for the programming languages, along with the fundamental concept theories of artificial intelligence. Through programming practices and AI tool manipulations, the students can gain a further understanding of the artificial intelligence application and the potential application via programming.

description.zh: 本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

description.zh: 本課程內容分二部分進行授課，第一個部份以小組進行校園建築進行實測後，繪製平、立、剖面圖，以加強學生團隊合作，並透過實際量測與繪製建築平、立、剖面圖，使學生感受實體與練習之關係；由於目前臺灣多以集合住宅建照申請居多，且住宅為空間尺度之根本；因此，第二個部份之課堂操作，依序為浴廁、臥室、廚房、餐廳、客廳單元等不同空間尺度練習後，聚焦於住宅平面圖之練習；接著，透過住宅平面圖之練習，衍伸至立面圖與剖面圖與透視圖練習。課程亦將藉由同學上述二個部分之練習，延續第一學期建築製圖基本常識、觀念與技法之傳授，以確實增進學生建築製圖能力。 本課程符合系教育目標如下： 1. 訓練學生建築設計與工程基礎專業能力； 2. 透過實作方式彙整建築設計與建築構造之技能； 3. 引導建立建築專業道德倫理態度； 4. 整合建築理論與實務提升就業競爭力。

description.zh: 本課程主要在教導學生對西方(歐洲及西亞)認識歷史建築之演進過程與思考涵構，並使學生具備西方文化歷史與思想的相關知識，其主要授課內容如下：1.在範圍上--自古埃及、西亞、而收至古典建築、基督教建築、中世紀的大教堂時代以至文藝復興及17、18世紀的建築歷史。2.在思想上--自希臘的文化與哲學思想談起，以至各時代之政治、宗教與社會文明之演進，瞭解歷史涵構及其對建築的表現。3.在建築上─針對每一時期的建築表現，瞭解其構造方法、材料應用及相關細部特徵。
description.en: This course is mainly to teach students the evolution process and connotation of historical buildings in the West (Europe and West Asia), and to equip students with relevant knowledge of Western culture, history and thought. The main teaching contents are as follows: 1. In terms of scope-- From ancient Egypt, West Asia, and the collection to classical architecture, Christian architecture, medieval cathedral era, Renaissance and the architectural history of the 17th and 18th centuries. 2. In terms of ideology-from the Greek culture and philosophical thought, to the evolution of politics, religion and social civilization in various eras, understand the historical connotation and its expression on architecture. 3. In architecture—according to the architectural performance of each period, understand its construction method, material application and related detail features.

description.zh:
設計的溝通扮演著如何將設計理念成功地傳達以及讓使用者清楚的理解設計本意的重要角色。
本課程將透過設計思考過程藉由文字、口說、圖面等達到設計溝通之目的及訓練，經由了解設計領域應用之文字搭配口說及圖面進而增進設計者說明設計概念的溝通能力。
課程內容包含設計溝通的基本原則、技巧及策略，以及如何利用不同的溝通媒介及工具來傳達設計理念。
課程操作包含案例分析搭配實際的簡報演練及口說訓練讓同學們累積應用經驗。
description.en:
Design Communication plays an important role in how to successfully deliver design concepts and have users understand the design intention clearly. 
This course will practice and reach the goal of design communication through design thinking by vocabulary uses, verbal speeches, and image presentations.  From understanding the proper application of design language including vocabularies and diagrams in various design fields, designers may improve their skills of concept presentation and communication.  
The course content includes basic principles, techniques, and strategies in design communication as well as how to use different media and tools to deliver design concepts.
Course activities include case studies with presentation practice and oral speech to help students have experiences in actual application.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程主要以人文學的研究方法為主，使修課者對人文學科之研究方法有基本的認識，熟悉資料蒐集、分析與詮釋的方式，以及培養研究的能力，並應用所學，在課程期間完成一份研究報告。以歷史學門為例，其課程內容包括學科的定義、史料的蒐集與辨別能力，歷史的詮釋，及歷史研究的侷限性等等問題。
description.en: This course is primarily based on the research methods of humanities. Students who select this course will have a basic understanding of the research methods of humanities. Besides, they will be familiar with the mode of data collection, analysis and interpretation, moreover, their capacity of doing research will be trained up. They have to finish a research report by applying what they have learned during this course. Take the history as an example, this course includes the definition of the subject, the interpretation of the history, and the limits of historical research. Besides, students will also learn how to collect and identify historical data in the course.

description.zh: 本課程旨在讓學生瞭解管理學基本概念，奠定紮實的理論根基，使其具備分析、處理實際問題以及開創的能力，進而能應用於文化事業經營，以利往後修習進階課程訓練的基礎。本課程主要內容包含管理學概論、管理在企業組織的功能、現代化的組織設計、組織領導與策略規劃、執行與績效考核、企業經營職能、企業的e化管理、非營利事業管理、企業的外在環境(政府文化創意產業政策)、創業管理、企業的社會責任等。本課程特色在於進行每個單元時，均輔以國內外文化創意產業有關的個案，以利學生理解。
description.en: This course presents the basic concepts and processes of management for students with cultural vocation development majors. Topics will include: the introduction to management, managing and the manager's job in an organization, modern organizational design, leadership and strategic planning, implementing and controlling , organizational effectiveness and performance, function roles of organization, e-business management, non-for-profit business management, external context of business (the government policy on cultural and creative industries), entrepreneurship management, corporate social responsibility etc. Students will develop skills and knowledge related to the manager function and required in the field of cultural creative industries. This course can also provide a basis for understanding the managerial implication of related cases in cultural creative industries. The featured course: each unit of this course will be facilitated by cultural and creative industries-related cases.

description.zh: 本課程是為大一學生所開的課程，它同時結合了美學與藝術史的討論。美學是一門研究人類感性知識的學科，與藝術史的發展息息相關。本課程嘗試在東西方平面藝術及其作品的討論中，融入東西方美學思想和審美意識，使美學與藝術史能夠相互印證。並希望課堂上的同學們能將課堂的內容化為文化創意的元素。
description.en: This course is for first-year students, combines aesthetic and art discussions. Aesthetics is a discipline that studies human perceptual knowledge and closely related to the development of art history. This course attempts to integrate Eastern and Western aesthetic ideas and aesthetic consciousness into the discussion of Eastern and Western art and its product, so that aesthetics and art history can corroborate each other. Expect that students in the classroom can turn the content of the class into cultural and creative elements.

syllabi.outline:
本課程為大一學生所設計，旨在介紹美學與藝術史的基礎概念，並培養學生的觀察能力、視覺分析技巧與脈絡理解。課程不僅探討為何要學習美學與藝術史，也將引導學生如何觀察、分析與詮釋藝術作品。課程將探討美學思想如何影響我們觀看、理解與評論藝術作品，並引導學生將藝術作品置於不同的歷史、文化與社會背景中加以詮釋。透過作品觀察、文本閱讀、課堂討論、美術館參訪與小組討論，學生將學習分析藝術作品的形式、內容與意義，並嘗試將美學思考與藝術史知識應用於當代策展與文化創意實踐之中。

This course is designed for first-year students and introduces the fundamental concepts of aesthetics and art history. It focuses not only on why aesthetics and art history matter, but also on how to observe, analyze, and interpret artworks. Students will explore how aesthetic ideas shape the ways we see, interpret, and evaluate artworks across different historical, cultural, and social contexts. Through close looking, readings, class discussions, museum visits, and group projects, students will develop skills in analyzing form, content, and meaning, and will be encouraged to apply aesthetic thinking and art historical knowledge to contemporary curatorial, cultural, and creative practices.

description.zh: 文化史課程以台灣各地的文化變遷為主。本課程授課內容，是透過物質生活(衣、食、住、行)，集體生活(社會、政治組織)，精神生活(文學、藝術、哲學、宗教信仰)等之介紹，讓學生對台灣文化有更進一步的認識與了解。授課方式以口頭講授為主，討論及書面報告為輔，使得上課方式更為生動與活潑。
description.en: The course of History and Culture mainly focuses on the evolution in terms of culture that takes place in every part of Taiwan. The contents of this course including the introduction of material life (clothing, food, housing and transportation), collective life (society, politics, and organization), and spiritual life (literature, art, philosophy and religious belief). Students will obtain further cognition and acquaintance about Taiwanese culture. The teaching mode is by giving students a lecture orally, and students have to discuss and hand in written reports. The teaching style is more vivacious.

description.zh: 本課程旨在探究文化與科技的關係，以及科技社會結構如何影響我們的思考。在科技與社會快速變化的過程中，課程將帶領學生發掘科技創新的可能性，這也促使許多文化實踐需重新思考，以適應此刻以媒體驅動的社會，以及如何將它們被應用於策展、文化活動和相關的創作中。本課程亦涉及科技本質上的探索，以了解它如何與文化變革密切相關，包括人文、社會科學、虛擬創作、人工智慧、數位典藏、媒體藝術和媒體傳播等面向上。
description.en: The course examines the relationship between culture and technology and how tech-social structure works to shape our ideas. Exploring the possibilities of technological innovation in rapid change, many cultural practices need to be rethought and reworked for a further media-driven society and how they are adopted into curating exhibitions, cultural events, and related productions. The course also addresses the nature of technology in general to understand how it is linked closely with cultural change, in terms of humanities, social sciences, virtual contents, artificial intelligence, digital archives, media art, and media communication.

description.zh: 本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

description.zh: 學習邏輯思考的目的在於幫助我們培養一種邏輯能力，使我們能夠邏輯理性地以語言進行思考。要達成上述目的，我們首先要了解語言做為一種符號的內在邏輯架構。我們要明白什麼是概念、與概念所指涉的對象、與概念具備的意義和觀念；然後，語句的性質，包含其真假值，它們與字詞和概念的關係。之後，如何用語句去建構論證。為了建構論證，我們要學習傳統的歸納法、三段論法、自然演繹法的基本推論規則與自然語言和形式語言之間的翻譯。總之，我們要會在生活中如何理性地思辨問題並有效地與他人溝通。課程講授將配合一些心理測驗、課堂遊戲與電影教學。
description.en: The purpose of learning “Logical Thinking” is to help us acquiring a kind of ability in virtue of which we will be able to think logically and rationally.  To achieve that goal, we need to know the innate logical structure of our language.  That means, we will need first to grasp the essence of concepts including their reference, meaning, and ideas. Then, we shall study the essence of sentences including their truth-value and the relations with words and concepts.  After that, we shall learn how to establish a sound argument. For that purpose, we plan to study induction, syllogism, basic rules of inference in the method of natural deduction in quantificational logic, and translation between natural and formal language.  In a word, we will be able to speculate problems in our life rationally and communicate with others effectively.   The lecturing of the course will mix with psychological texts, games and practices in the classroom, and scientific films or regular movies.

本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 學習經濟理論的基本觀念，涵蓋個體與總體經濟學相關議題，包括市場如何運作，市場與福利，公共部門經濟學，廠商行為與產業組織，勞動市場經濟學，總體經濟學資料，長期實質經濟，長期貨幣與物價，開放體系的總體經濟學，短期經濟波動等主題。
description.en: This course provides the basic concept of economic theory, including microeconomics and macroeconomics. The topics are as follows: how markets work, markets and welfare, the economics of the public sector, firm behavior and the organization of industry, the economics of the labor market, the data of macroeconomics, the real economy in the long run, money and prices in the long run, the macroeconomics of open economics, and short-run economic fluctuations.

description.zh: 本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。課程內容包含（一）勞作教育理念介紹。（二）勞作教育實作。（三）課堂討論與反思。（四）期末成果分享。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程旨在瞭解設計的基本要素與美的形式原理，應用各種媒材的特性與構成，從平面及立體的構成的實作練習中，激發出設計美感與創造力。透過「使用者—產品—環境」三者間互動關係的深入探討，掌握住視覺傳達與多媒體的基本語彙，作為互動設計的基礎，創造出全新的體驗與感受。
description.en: The course is to prepare students for understanding the basic elements of design and the form and principle of art. To achieve these goals, the course provides opportunities for students to apply characteristics and compositions of diverse media for the form of two-dimension and three-dimension in practice. Also, the course arouses student’s design aesthetics and creativity. description.zh: 本課程旨在為互動媒體脈絡提供學生創意思考與企劃故事腳本，使學生瞭解互動媒體實務運作時，最前端的構思與規劃所需要的知識與技能，以及與不同領域專業的溝通表達。本課程包括一系列的腳本企劃、使用者體驗、創意呈現，以及互動媒體企劃實務案例探討。本課程之評量是以分組討論與腳本企劃報告為主。
description.en: This course is to provide the creative thinking and story-script with the context of interactive media by which students can understand the practice of interactive media, and learn the knowledge and skill for planning and creation. The contents include a series of script planning, user experience, creative representatives and the case study of interactive media. The assessment of this course depends upon the group discussion and script planning report.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在講授互動媒體腳本廣告的規劃與製作原理，包括互動媒體的特性、廣告製作可如何掌握、發揮互動式媒體的特性，以及建置、設計、發展、與維護互動媒體所需的相關概念、科技與技能。本課程亦教導同學如何應用電腦影像（computer imaging）與多媒體的科技與技術，來製作互動媒體作品。
This course aims to introduce the principles of planning and producing interactive media advertising scripts. It covers the characteristics of interactive media, how to effectively manage and execute advertising production, and how to leverage the unique features of interactive media. Students will also learn the essential concepts, technologies, and skills required for the development, design, implementation, and maintenance of interactive media systems.

description.zh: 本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

syllabi.outline:
本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

description.en: In the electronic age, text, image, sound, and video are all widely used; organizing this data has become an important issue. This course focuses on the definition, origin, and background of cultural creativity. The curriculum includes building a basic understanding of digital products, explaining the process and procedures of how digital products are designed, and introducing the design methods for digital products.

syllabi.outline:
The major goal of this class aims to give students basic 3d modeling and rendering techniques meanwhile help them to have abilities to realize the design from concept to final output. In the class we will provide the tutorial of Blender. Blender now is the most useful tools for interior design and have been widely used in different practices. Through practicing the commands and techniques with multiple exercises and practices, students will have general understanding about how the software works meanwhile get the fundamental abilities to get into design industries.
  Student will be asked to finish a complete conceptual design project in the end of semester, it should be drawings, renderings, animations and one 3d model included. Students’ learning outcome must be showed in this package and will be the critical criteria of semester grading.

description.zh: 中文課程共分四年三階段授課。 第一、二年以華語教學為主，授課重點為：（一）華語基本句型句法；（二）華語基本會話；（三）生活語言；（四）標音系統。第三年(一學期)，除延續第一、二年華語授課重點外，以段落朗讀和基本認字為主要訓練，並給與中國文字書寫訓練。 第四年(一學期)，加強會話能力，認字與閱讀能力，並傳授中國文化。
description.en: The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on: (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year (one semester), the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

description.zh: 本課程旨在瞭解設計的基本要素與美的形式原理，應用各種媒材的特性與構成，從平面及立體的構成的實作練習中，激發出設計美感與創造力。透過「使用者—產品—環境」三者間互動關係的深入探討，掌握住視覺傳達與多媒體的基本語彙，作為互動設計的基礎，創造出全新的體驗與感受。

To explore the context of user-product-environment, students understand visual communication and multimedia language as a basis of interaction design toward completely new experiences and sensation.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹程式設計的基本概念和技術，以及人工智慧的發展和應用。課程內容涵蓋程式語言的基本語法，以及人工智慧的基礎觀念與理論，並藉由編程練習及AI工具操作來進一步了解人工智慧應用以及程式設計的潛在應用。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the fundamental concepts and techniques of programming, as well as the development and application of artificial intelligence. The course content covers basic syntax for the programming languages, along with the fundamental concept theories of artificial intelligence. Through programming practices and AI tool manipulations, the students can gain a further understanding of the artificial intelligence application and the potential application via programming.

syllabi.outline:
The major goal of this class aims to give students basic 3d modeling and rendering techniques meanwhile help them to have abilities to realize the design from concept to final output. In the class we will provide the tutorial of Blender. Blender now is the most useful tools for interior design and have been widely used in different practices. Through practicing the commands and techniques with multiple exercises and practices, students will have general understanding about how the software works meanwhile get the fundamental abilities to get into design industries.
  Student will be asked to finish a complete conceptual design project in the end of semester, it should be drawings, renderings, animations and one 3d model included. Students’ learning outcome must be showed in this package and will be the critical criteria of semester grading.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is aimed directly at the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。課程內容包含（一）勞作教育理念介紹。（二）勞作教育實作。（三）課堂討論與反思。（四）期末成果分享。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

syllabi.outline:
期望學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，並從實作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，同時建立學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。

Students are expected to understand the concept of labor education through campus environment maintenance and cleaning activities. Through hands-on courses, students will develop an entrepreneurial spirit of not fearing hardship, difficulty, or dirt. Additionally, the activities aim to instill the values of diligent work, care for belongings, and the simultaneous use of both hands and mind. These experiences will help cultivate well-rounded character, correct values, and a strong work ethic in students.
syllabi.schedule:

由授課教師於課堂上講述勞作教育的意義及學期課程內容。
第二階段：實作體驗及反思
透過校園及外圍環境整理，讓同學們體驗不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的精神，並於體驗後進行討論及撰寫反思單，啟發同學多元思考。
第三階段：期末成果分享
學期末彙整學期課程剪影，並回顧反思學習成果。

name.zh: 電機控制系統設計與模擬
name.en: Design and Simulation of Electric Machine Control Systems

description.zh: 此課程包含以下主題：(1)直流馬達、伺服馬達、及永磁交流馬達的建模、控制系統設計與模擬，(2)馬達速度及位置觀測器設計與模擬，(3)數位控制及驅動器設計與模擬。
description.en: The contents of this course include: (1) Modeling, control system design, and simulation of DC motor, servo motor and permanent magnet synchronous motor. (2) Motor speed and position estimator design and simulation. (3) Digital control and driver design and simulation.

syllabi.outline:
本課程的主要目的在使用Matlab/Simulink軟體，建立馬達及其控制系統的模型，以模擬的方式學習馬達控制系統設計的方法。控制的馬達包含直流馬達、永磁交流馬達、及無刷直流馬達等三種。系統設計的主題包含：(1)位置、速度及電流控制，(2)數位控制，(3)觀測器設計，(4)直接轉矩控制，(5)脈寬調變模，(6)交流-直流轉換。

The objectives of this course are using Matlab/Simulink software as the simulation tool to learn practical control schemes for electric machines. Three types of machines are studied: DC Machine, permanent magnetic synchronous machines (PMSM), and brushless DC (BLDC). Control projects include: (1) position, velocity, and current control, (2) digital control, (3) estimators, (4) direct torque control, (5) pulse width modulation (PWM), (6) AC-DC conversion.
syllabi.schedule:
1. Introduction of Matlab/Simulink, DC motor model, speed control (lab1)
2. PMSM model and V/H control (lab2)
3. Control systems and frequency response measurement (lab3)
4. Digital control and velocity estimator (lab4)
5. DC-AC Inverter (SPWM, SVPWM) (lab5)
6. Position and velocity estimation with extended back-EMF (lab6)
7. Sensorless vector control with extended back-EMF (lab7)
8. Sensorless vector with square voltage HFVI (lab8)
9. Mid-term exam.
10. PMSM control with Simscape (lab9)
11. AC-DC input with dynamic braking (lab10)
12. DC-DC input converter (lab11)
13. Direct torque control lecture (lab12)
14. Direct torque control, sensor based (lab13)
15. Sensorless direct torque control (lab14)
16. Direct torque control with switching table (lab15)
17. Review
18. Final exam.
syllabi.assessment:
Lab:60% (出席+完成)
Final exam: 40%

2. Control System Design Guide, 3th Editions, George Ellis, Elsevier-Academic Press.
3. Observers in Control Systems, George Ellis, Elsevier-Academic Press, 2010.

syllabi.outline:
Advanced Robotics Lab (ARLab) course is offered with all experimental in-class projects, same as its previous version “Advanced Robotics and Automation Applications (ARAA)”.  Compared with Advanced Robotics Manipulation (ARM) course, this Advanced Robotics Lab (ARLab) course is offered for graduate students with programming experience, but no particular prerequisites, such as Advanced Robotics Manipulation (ARM), are required.  ARLab focuses on projects in the areas of mobile robotics, manipulators, visual servoing, SLAM, and automation. 

The goals of the course can be summarized as below: [Projects will be arranged based on available equipment]
1.	Mobile Robot Control Project: Visual Tracking, Eye-in-Hand, Eye-to-Hand
2.	Mobile Robot Navigation Project: Manual Mapping, Autonomous Mapping, Localization and Navigation, SLAM and Navigation
3.	Manipulator Control Project: Workpiece Picking & Placing, Visual Tracking, Eye-in-Hand, Eye-to-Hand

Course handouts will be available via iStudy web.  In addition to homework assignments, all projects must be completed and evaluated in class under supervision of Professor and TAs with particular attention to equipment operation safety.

description.en: Students will learn to use multichannel beamformer techniques and Matlab for speech enhancement. Students will learn: 1. Spatial sampling concept. 2. Delay-and-sum (DAS) beamforming technique. 3. Minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) beamforming technique. 4. Linearly constraint minimum variance (LCMV) beamforming technique. 5. Generalized sidelobe canceller (GSC) beamforming technique. 6. Multichannel Wiener filtering for denoising and dereverberation. 7. Integrated sidelobe cancellation and linear prediction Kalman filter (ISCLP)

syllabi.outline:
培養學生使用多通道波束形成器技術應用在降噪、降混響，並使用Matlab撰寫多通道語音增強演算法。學生可以學習到: 1. 空間取樣概念。2. 延遲相加波束形成器技術。3. 最小變異無失真響應波束形成器技術。4. 線性限制最小變異波束形成器技術。5. 廣義旁辦消除波束形成器技術。6. 多通道維也納濾波器降噪降混響技術。7. 線性卡爾曼濾波器結和廣義旁辦消除波束形成器技術。
Students will learn to use multichannel beamformer techniques and MATLAB for speech enhancement. Students will learn: 1. The Spatial sampling concept. 2. Delay-and-sum (DAS) beamforming technique. 3. Minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) beamforming technique. 4. Linearly constrained minimum variance (LCMV) beamforming technique. 5. Generalized sidelobe canceller (GSC) beamforming technique. 6. Multichannel Wiener filtering for denoising and dereverberation. 7. Integrated sidelobe cancellation and linear prediction Kalman filter (ISCLP)
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Course introduction
Weeks. 2-4: Review of STFT and classical optimal filtering (Homework 1)
Weeks. 5-8: Spatial filtering introduction: DAS, LCMP, LCMV, GSC, MPDR, MVDR algorithms (Homework 2)
Weeks. 9-12: Multichannel Wiener filtering (MWF), BMWF, ISCLP algorithms introduction (Homework 3)
Weeks. 13-16: Subspace-based methods for source counting (Homework 4)
Weeks. 17-18: Final presentation

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
最後，透過對於ESG與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

syllabi.outline:
課程旨在帶領學生於全球化多元的商業環境下，思維倫理在複雜的企業決策過程中所扮演之重要角色。引導學生認識企業倫理的內涵，並透過自編教材、教科書內容與個案探討，啟發學生對相關主題的興趣，體認企業倫理確實於日常生活中頻繁出現，而不僅為形而上的哲學觀。本課程擬藉由課堂的情境移轉，培養具有企業倫理的企業經理人。
本課程的目的將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任（如：產品綠化與環境保護），（2）消費者的保護（如：產品的安全性），（3）員工的權益（如：職業健康），（4）員工對公司的責任（如：利益衝突），（5）雇主與員工關係（如：性別平等）。
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate Social Responsibility (e.g., Green product and environmental protection), (2) Consumer protection (e.g., Product safety), (3) Employee's rights and benefits (e.g., Occupational health), (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms (e.g., Conflict of interest), and (5) Employer-employee relations (e.g., Gender equity).

description.zh: 此課程旨在以人為本，研究互動系統之設計與評估。使學生了解人類認知過程之理論與模式以及其工作與環境之特性，並使學生能應用設計程序與評估方法來提升系統之績效。
description.en: This course focuses on the design and evaluation of interactive systems from a human centric perspective. Students will learn about the theories and models of human cognitive processing with the consideration of task and enviroment characteristics; and students will learn how to apply design processes and evaluation techniques for improving system performance.

syllabi.outline: 此課程旨在以人為本，研究人機互動系統之設計與評估。從了解與採集使用者的需求開始，評估工作姿勢與工作台合適性，最終提出可能的改善方案來提高使用者的效率與舒適性。本次課程將與USR計劃結合，場域設定在偏鄉小琉球，當地因氣候關係合適芒果樹的生長，為了經濟效益，多數年長者將會製作芒果青作為補貼家用，但由於缺乏系統化的流程、工作環境的評估、注重工作姿勢的危害預防等，導致年長者無法有效率的生產以及可能因姿勢不良產生肌肉骨骼傷害問題。因此，期望讓學生在課程中學習相關評估老年人需求與行為活動力之方法、人機互動原則、3D人體掃描、人機匹配評估與肌肉骨骼傷害風險評估等知識，搭配專家演講、工作坊與實際參與人因工程相關實驗與儀器操作，並且至真實場域進行實際的訪談與工作姿勢數據採集、工作流程紀錄等，讓學生了解離島年長者工作時的人機匹配行為模式需求與不良姿勢肌肉骨骼不適評估等，最終應用人體計測資料與創意思解，提出可能的改善方案或人機尺寸設計建議回饋於場域與社會，落實以人為本，改善不舒適、提高生活品質與社會福祉之功效。除此之外，也介紹人機互動知識的相關應用案例，透過分享國際刊物論文，了解人機互動前沿研究。透過規劃小組實驗實作，藉此了解人因工程實驗的進行與後續設計應用，以提升人的舒適與安全。

description.zh: 機器視覺檢測乃結合光學設備 ` 影像處理 ` 與電腦輔助計算處理 , 藉由擷取受測物影像之特徵進行後續各種應用(如檢測 ` 辯識等)。 為確保機器視覺應用之精確度及速度,受測物影像必須依用途進行不同前處理以突顯特徵 , 後以不同之演算法則判斷之擷取特徵是否符合應用要求。 機器視覺近年來大量使用於各產業,除提昇製造業之產品品質外,對人身安全認證之生物科技亦功不可沒 。
description.en: Machine vision has been extensively used in inspection and biometrics in recent years. This course provides the fundamentals and practical applications of machine vision for graduate students. Increasing the knowledge and capability in machine vision for a well-trained industrial engineer is the final goal of this course.

description.zh: 這是一門研究所課程，內容包括多元數據分析和高等回歸應用。本課程的目標是確保工業工程與管理領域的研究生能夠解釋、實現和操作幾種不同類型的基本回歸分析。本課程主要致力於高等回歸分析。重點是發展一個嚴格的微積分計算及矩陣代數為基礎的最小平方法(OLS)、違反回歸假設、假說檢定及一般線性模型。此外，本課程的重點是協助學生理解分析技術這部分的領域知識，如:統計的基本概念(描述和推理統計，概率分佈)，簡單線性回歸、多元線性回歸、邏輯回歸及對數線性模型之應用。
description.en: This course covers multivariate data analysis as well as advanced regression applications. The course is primarily devoted to advanced regression analysis. Th? emphasis is on developing a rigorous calculus and matrix algebra-based understanding of ordinary least squares (OLS), violations of regression assumptions, hypothesis testing, and the general linear model. In addition, the emphasis of this course is on the acquisition and understanding of analytical techniques such as basic concepts of statistics (descriptive and inferential statistics, probability distributions), simple linear regression, multiple linear regression, logistic regression, log-linear model.

description.en:
The course objective is to introduce students about key principles of project management and the use of project scheduling software.
This course discusses the factors necessary for the successful project management.  Topics include project management concepts, needs identification, the project manager, teams, project organizations, project communications, project planning, scheduling, control and associated costs.  Project management software tools will be an integral part of the course.

name.zh: 材料特性與熱管理實務應用

description.zh: 在諸多工程應用實例中，如LED、晶片之散熱問題、流體在能源系統中之熱交換、燃料電池衍生之熱問題等，都與材料之規格選用、處理方法、加工方式、製造過程有明顯的相關性。本門課程主要針對材料工程與熱管理相關的技術問題，提出探討與對策，期使學生對熱管理在材料與系統工程上的應用提供適當的專業知識。
description.en: In engineering applications, such as LED, chip cooling, heat exchange in energy systems, fuel cells, are always comes with the problems of thermal generation. Meanwhile, manufacturing process and heat treatment of these products are also strongly dependent of the selection of material specifications. The purpose of this course would like to employ practical problems and lead the students in finding appropriate solutions or technical approaches to solve the related problems they could meet.

syllabi.outline:

syllabi.schedule:
本課程關注板金成形(全英語授課)。第一部分主要探討2系列與7系列鋁合金之材料特性，及其於潛變時效成形熱處理之析出硬化機制及變形行為。第二部分為探討鋼鐵材料於熱衝壓成型過程之材料特性及熱管理。
修課前提:須具備基礎材料科學及材料力學知識、及能解基本偏微分方程式之能力、基礎matlab程式語言能力、有限元素軟體(Forge)操作。

syllabi.outline:
With an aging population driving significant growth in healthcare-related industries, Electrical Medical Engineering has emerged as a crucial interdisciplinary field. Combining engineering principles and technologies, this discipline contributes to biological research and the advancement of medical science. The primary focus is to provide insights beneficial for diagnosing, treating, and preventing diseases.

This course specifically emphasizes laser medicine, a specialization within Electrical Medical Engineering. Recognized as one of the 20th century’s greatest inventions, laser technology has revolutionized various medical fields, offering innovative solutions for both clinical applications and research.

This course will delve into the following topics:

1. Introduction to Medical Electrical Engineering
2. Basic principles of laser
3. Diverse applications of laser in medicine
4. Laser applications in dentistry
5. PBM PhotoBioModulation applications in Medicine and Dentistry
6. Advanced thesis writing in laser medicine

description.zh: 顆粒物質充斥在日常生活且廣泛應用在許多工業問題中，例如筒倉、流體化床以及積層製造等等。本概論式課程將提供學生顆粒物質流的基礎概念以及模擬方法，並對其實際應用問題能有更深入的了解。課程將從顆粒物質的基本流動特性開始介紹，進而介紹顆粒物質流的離散模擬方法。此課程最後一部分將實際展示在工程上以及工業上所遇到的顆粒物質流問題。
description.en: Granular materials are ubiquitous in our daily lives and have attracted growing interest in many industrial applications, such as silo storage, fluidized bed, additive manufacturing, etc. This course is an introductory course to provide the general concepts and simulation methods of granular material flows, and a comprehensive understanding for its applications. The course will start from the basic flow characteristics of granular materials, and then move to the discrete simulation approaches. The final part of this course will demonstrate the practical engineering and industrial problems of granular material flows.

syllabi.outline: Granular material flows commonly occur in many industrial applications and nature hazards, such as fluidized beds, additive manufacturing, and debris avalanche. To provide a comprehensive understanding of granular materials flows, this course will be divided into three parts. First, we will explore the fundamental flow characteristics of granular materials and their rheological models. Next, we will examine simulation techniques for granular material flows, focusing on discrete element method (DEM). Finally, we will introduce the two-phase suspension system, followed by an exploration of practical industrial and geophysical applications of these complex flows.

description.zh:
積層製造技術(又稱三維列印)在近十年來試圖改變整個製造技術的生態，已不再是原型的製造與小量生產，它已經達到符合經濟生產效益的經濟規模製造方法。雖然積層製造以加工方法可分為七大分類，但以工程材料分類則以金屬為最具經濟價值與工業應用最為廣泛。因此，本課程主要以金屬積層製造的方法為出發點，說明可以列印金屬的加工方法，以縮短學術與工業應用的距離。在本課程中，也說明金屬三維列印件的材料選用、列印件的設計考量、加工參數優化、列印件的使用壽命檢測、與數值模擬等。
修習本課程後，學生可以了解:
1.金屬積層製造方法的原理與材料限制
2.金屬列印件的設計考量、前處理與後處理
3.各種列印方法的加工參數設定與其對列印件的影響
4.ASTM規範金屬列印件的巨觀測試方法與微觀檢測方法
5.金屬列印件的輕量化拓樸結構優化設計與分析
6.金屬積層製造的數值分析方法

Additive manufacturing technology, also known as 3D printing, has attempted to revolutionize the entire manufacturing ecosystem over the past decade. It has evolved beyond prototyping and small-scale production, reaching an economically viable scale for mass production. The topic covers fundamental heat transfer, including conduction in steady-state and transient scenarios, natural and forced convection, and radiative heat transfer.

description.zh: 本課程之目標為依人力職能需求，參考國內外之先行經驗，整合智能化生產所需之知識與技能訓練，以淬鍊出一套務實之智能化生產課程。本課程將涵蓋工業4.0-智能化生產所需相關基礎技術之教學與實作課程，包括物聯網基礎技術與應用實例、雲端服務系統與資訊安全技術、巨量資料管理、分析、及應用實例、智慧化企業與工廠管理系統與應用、自動化與機器人技術及應用等等。
description.en: The goal of this course is to meet the needs of the manpower function, with reference to the previous experiences from domestic and abroad groups. This course will cover the topics related to the basic technology required for intelligent production, including the basic technology and application examples of the Internet of Things, the cloud service system and information security technology, the huge amount of data management, Intelligent enterprise and factory management systems and applications, automation and robot technology and applications, and so on.

syllabi.outline: This course covers a wide range of fundamental technologies pertinent to Industry 4.0-Intelligent production, including a brief history of the industrial revolution, artificial intelligence algorithms, technologies and application examples of the Internet of Things, cloud service systems and information security technologies, big data management, analysis, and application examples, intelligent enterprise and factory management systems and applications, automation and robotics technology and applications, etc.

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹奈米結構材料之合成及其製程技術。內容大綱包括三部分：第一、奈米材料基本物理與化學特性，第二、奈米粉末和薄膜結構材料之化學合成，物理合成製程原理與特性，奈米塊體材料的性能與製備，第三、奈米結構材料應用。
description.en: This course is divided into three sections. The first four chapters deal with those chapters which are the principles of nanostructured Material. The next two chapters describe the engineering options currently available for the synthesis, processing and fabrication of nanostructured materials. The last two chapters deal with different application of nanostructured materials.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要分為二部分：
一、奈米科技介紹(奈米材料之結構、形貌與機械性質，奈米材料之製造技術如氣相法、液相法與微影技術)；
二、奈米檢測(顯微鏡、光譜分析)
The course is divided into two parts:
Part 1: Introduction of nanotechnology (Microstructure and characteristics of nanomaterials, manufacturing process including vapor deposition, wet-chemical approach and lithography)
Part 2: Examination of nanomaterials (Microscopy, spectrographic analyses)

name.en: Introduction to Random Vibration and Time-Frequency-Domain Analysis

description.zh: 本門科目主要為介紹隨機震動學基本理論、頻譜分析與小波分析理論。主要的授課內容涵蓋基本統計理論、隨機訊號定義、期望值與相關函數、傅立葉轉換及快速傅立葉、功率頻譜密度函數、頻譜分析、非定常訊號判斷、基礎小波分析等。配合結構動力學，本科目亦講授結構系統受到隨機外力作用而產生之結構反應的頻率域動力分析應用及小波分析應用等範例。
description.en: This course is designed to introduce the basics of random vibration, spectral and wavelet analysis. The schedule includes those topics such as fundamental theories of statistics, definition of random signals, expectation and correlation functions, Fourier transform and F.F.T., power spectral density, spectral analysis, non-stationarity judgement, and basic theories of wavelet analysis. To harmony with Dynamics of Structures, this course also introduces examples of dynamic analysis of structural systems excited by random loadings in the frequency domain and applications of wavelet analysis.

syllabi.outline: The subject is designed to include two professional realms – random vibration and time-frequency domain analysis. The fundamentals of random vibration include statistics, correlation analysis, spectrum estimation, spectral analysis of the SDF system, and so on. The time-frequency domain analysis includes the FFT technique, Hilbert Transform, short-time Fourier Transform, and Wavelet analysis, and so on.

name.zh: 資訊檢索與人工智慧應用

description.zh:
資訊檢索（Information Retrieval）是搜尋引擎背後的技術基礎，以給定的查詢詞彙找出帶有相關資訊的文件，能夠處理與比較未結構化或半結構化的文字資料。在人工智慧與機器學習技術飛越成長的當代，自然語言處理（Natural Language Processing）及文本探勘（Text Mining）輔助人們在散亂的文本當中發掘有意義的資訊。傳統的資訊檢索理論在文本探勘的任務當中則扮演了重要的輔助角色，其賦與將文件以向量表達的基礎，亦即使諸多人工智慧應用能夠順利的與文本探勘任務接軌。

本課程將教導修課同學資訊檢索、自然語言處理與資料探勘的理論基礎，以及各種新穎的人工智慧與機器學習應用如何取代傳統方法。並且訓練修課同學使用現成的程式語言套件來分析自己手邊的文本資料。
description.en:
Information Retrieval (IR) is the process that retrieves the information which is relevant to a specific information need from a data collection. Search engine systems provides a famous example of IR applications. In recent years, with the growth of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Natural Language Processing (NLP), many of the AI applications can help discover useful information in unstructured or semi-structured text collections, such a process is called Text Mining. The traditional IR technique also play an important role to support the AI applications. It can vectorize the texts and make it possible to compare the similarities between different pieces of text.

This course aims to train the enrolled students to learn the basic concept of IR, NLP, and AI applications which are relevant to Text Mining tasks. In addition, this course also trains the enrolled students to use existing tools and software packages which can support the AI applications.

description.en: The focus of this course is the application of the basic principles of rock mechanics.  Three types of applications are to be covered in this semester-long course: rock slopes, rock foundations, and rock tunnels.  The students are expected to complete assignments in each of the above three categories.  To prepare students with no previous academic work in rock mechanics, this course will review the classification systems of rock masses (such as the RMR and the Q systems).  Also, the stereographic projection is a required tool, which will be introduced in this course.

name.zh: 集水區水文暨水質模擬
name.en: Watershed-Scaled Hydrologic and Water Quality Modeling

description.zh: 本課程專為有興趣透過數理模擬方法來提升集水區管理技能的學生而設計。課程內容提供了對集水區水文系統內水文過程和水質模擬所使用的原理機制和方法的全面理解。修習本課程需具備水文學和環境科學及工程的基礎知識。學生將探索多種數理模擬工具和技術，以模擬水文和水質對不同環境條件和土地利用衝擊的回應。此外，學生還需學習一些盛行的水文和水質模式並將其應用到現實場景中，以實施有效的水資源管理。本課程旨在使學生掌握必要的知識和技能，以模擬和分析水文過程及水質動態，這對於有效的水資源管理至關重要。
description.en: This course, designed for students who are interested in watershed management, will enhance their skills through modeling analysis.  It provides a comprehensive understanding of the principles and methodologies used in hydrologic processes and water quality modeling within watershed hydrologic system.  Fundamentals and basics of hydrologic and environmental science and engineering is prerequired for taking the course.  Students will explore various modeling tools and techniques that simulate hydrologic and water quality responses to different environmental conditions and land-use practices.  In addition, students are expected to learn and apply some prevailing hydrologic and water quality models to real-world scenarios for effective water resource management.  This course aims to equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary to model and analyze hydrologic processes and water quality dynamics, which are critical for effective water resource management.

description.zh: 在現代的工程設計與分析中，普遍應用到相關的電腦模式。儘管大部份工程應用電腦模式均以定率式的物理關係作為基礎，但引用電腦模式進行設計，必須考慮隱含在模式輸入與控制參數的不確定性，及其所產生模式輸出的不確定性。因此，適當的評估模式輸出的不確定性應包含在基本的設計當中。
description.en: In modern engineering designs and analyses, computer models are frequently used. Despite the fact that deterministic relationships are used in most compiterized models for engineering,the model outputs are indeterministic due to the uncertain and stochastic nature of the model inputs and parameters. All the uncertainty may contribute to the stochsticity of the input parameters of a corresponding model which, in turn, result in output uncertainty. Therefore,proper assessment of model outout uncertainty is essential.

description.zh: 為涵養水量、維護水質以及保育水土資源，對於集水區內土地的使用，應有適當的規劃與管理牽涉的問題，一般以水資源利用、水質控制、管理計畫等課題加以涵括。因此本課程包含水資源情勢分析、水利法規、水權管理、點源及非點源污染管理、地下水規劃與管理、民眾參與及生態工法於集水區治理工程之應用等，俾提供適度發展及兼顧自然生態機能的集水區社區總體生活，達成「水、土、林、人」四贏之水資源保育總體目標。
description.en: In order to preserve water quantity, to protect water quality, and to conserve soil and water resources, it is necessary to institute appropriate land use regulations in a watershed. In general, it is included water resources utilization, water quality control and management. Therefore the major topics are water resources tendency, water law, water right, point and non-point sources pollution control, ground water management, public participation, ecological working method, etc. With appropriate public participation, the government can work together with people in community development in a manner which will enrich local cultural characteristics, and provide ideas for a sustainable growth, which would lead to a high quality of life and also would protect the watershed's ecology . The ultimate goal of making these efforts is to achieve a " water-soil-trees-men ", four-win situation.

syllabi.outline:
In order to preserve water quantity, to protect water quality, and to conserve soil and water resources, it is necessary to institute appropriate land use regulations in a watershed. In general, it is included water resources utilization, water quality control and management. Therefore the major topics are water resources tendency, water law, water right, point and non-point sources pollution control, ground water management, public participation, ecological working method, etc. With appropriate public participation, the government can work together with people in community development in a manner which will enrich local cultural characteristics, and provide ideas for a sustainable growth, which would lead to a high quality of life and also would protect the watershed's ecology . The ultimate goal of making these efforts is to achieve a " water-soil-trees-men ", four-win situation.

description.zh: 地表和地下水的非點源污染，已經成為全世界各地區相當嚴重的環境問題。非點源污染本身複雜的特性導致集水區內污染物承載推估與污染源之標定非常困難。本課程之目的以介紹非點源污染之污染源特性及傳輸途徑為起點，教導學生學習使用最新的科技與工具，去建立最有效可行的最佳管理作業(Best Management Practice, BMP)之配置計劃，以達到集水區內非點源污染之削減目標。學生們將學習應用與統合地理資訊系統、遙測資料、水文暨水質數理模式、以及專家系統去解決集水區內非點源污染的控制問題。
description.en: Nonpoint source (NPS) pollution of streams, lakes, and estuaries has been a critical concern throughout the world.  The difficulty in both identifying and assessing nonpoint source pollution resides precisely in the complex nature of NPS.  This course aims to expose students to state-of-the-art tools and techniques for developing effective Best Management Practice (BMP) allocation plans to control NPS pollution at the watershed scale.  The foundations of this course will be focused on definition of NPS pollution, NPS pollutant dynamics in bioenvironmental systems, watershed hydrology and NPS pollutant transport, as well as BMPs for NPS pollution control.  Students will next learn how to apply Geographic Information System (GIS), Remote Sensing (RS), hydrologic modeling and Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies to the solutions of NPS pollution problems in watersheds.  The tools and techniques presented are flexible and students will be able to apply them to solve NPS type of proble

description.zh: 水文系統監測主要目的為了解水文過程，其所收集到的水質與水量資料可作為水資源規劃及管理的主要依據。本課程的主要目的為介紹水文系統中所需觀次之項目、監測方法及觀測儀器的原理及使用方法，因此主要的主題包含大氣監測(溫度、濕度、壓力、日照、降水、風速、蒸散、蒸發散)、地表水監測(水位、流速、流量計算、泥沙、率訂曲線)及地下水(土壤濕度、入滲、地下水)。此外，亦將介紹相關的水質監測。
description.en: Hydrological measurements are made to obtain data on hydrological processes. They are essential for the interpretation of quality and quantity data for water resource planning and management. The main topics include: measurement of atmospheric water (temperature, pressure, moisture, precipitation, wind velocity, evaporation, evapotanspiration), measurement of surface water (water stage, flow velocity, discharge computation, sediment, rating curve), and measurement of subsurface water (soil moisture, infiltration, ground water). The water quality monitoring will also introduced in this course.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title: Engineering Optimization Methods and Applications
The course focuses on the fundamental theory and concepts of "Engineering Optimization Methods," "Linear Programming," "Nonlinear Programming," "Multi-objective Function Optimization," "Modern Mathematical Planning Methods," and "Cross-Attribute System Optimization." Hands-on practices using optimization software and term projects are some key elements. Students will report their term projects at the end of the semester. Throughout the semester, students can better understand the optimization principle and apply it to their daily activities. The University Social Responsibility (USR) concept will be brought into the class this semester. Guide students to apply the optimization method in their term projects, vehicle designs, and research applications.
syllabi.schedule:
Course Title: Engineering Optimization Methods and Applications
a. Week,   b. Topic
1、	Outline of teaching syllabus and design (Chapter 1)--A general overview of the course. The USR program is introduced into the class. Students are encouraged to use the vehicles used in USR as the course term project. Guide students to apply optimal methods in the USR vehicles.
2、	Formulation of the optimization design problem (Chapter 2).
3、	Formulation of the optimization design problem (Chapter 2). 
4、	Optimizing design by drawing method (Chapter 3). Introduce the lightweight design concept by using fewer materials and still satisfying the design requirements. 
5、	The basic concept of optimal design (Chapter 4) (Use USR simplified 3D printing model for lightweight design optimization exercises.)
6、	Optimal Design Concepts: Global Optimization and Lagrange multipliers (Chapter 4).
7、	Optimal Design Concepts: KKT (Chapter 5). (Introduce the general design concept for electric vehicles. Use the vehicle of the USR project as an example for design improvement.) 
8、	Linear Programming: Initial Basic Feasible Solution (Chapter 6).
9、	Midterms, Solving Linear Programming (Chapter 6) & Semester Project planning.
10、	Linear Programming: Duality (Chapter 7); Numerical Methods for Unconstrained Optimal Design (Chapter 8)
11、	Numerical Methods for Unconstrained Optimal Design (Chapters 8 and 9)
12、	Numerical methods for unconstrained optimal design (Chapter 9). 
13、	Numerical Methods for Constrained Optimal Design (Chapter 10). (Introduce the design optimization software and use the USR vehicle as an example to conduct various design analyses and optimization.)
14、	Numerical Methods for Constrained Optimal Design (Chapters 10 and 11).
15、	Numerical Methods for Constrained Optimal Design (Chapter 11).
16、	Other physical applications. Report on term projects/USR vehicle project design optimization.
17、	Report on project/USR optimal and lightweight design for different systems, and/or sub-systems. 
18、	Final exam.

description.zh: 本課程之目的為訓練學生計算冷凍空調設備之蒸發器、冷凝器之熱傳與壓損的能力，以提升冷凍空調設備之設計能力。內容包括兩相流之流譜分析與動量方程式、兩相介面之表面張力作用、熱沸騰與冷凝等相變化之基本現象、兩相流之沸騰與冷凝熱傳性能之計算與分析、兩相流之流力現象分析與壓損之計算、蒸發器與冷凝器之熱傳增強技術等。
description.en: This course offers traning of advanced design techniques of evaporators and condensers in the HVAC & R applications.  The subjects in this course are: the two phase flow regime, analysis of momentum and energy equations for two phase flow, method of prediction of pressure drop of two phase flow, fundamental phenomena of condensation and evaporation, calculation of heat transfer coefficient of convective condensation or evaporation, heat transfer enhancement techniques for condensation and evaporation.

description.en: This course comprises four parts. Part one is fundamentals of finite-difference methods. Part 2 is the application of finite-difference methods to the equations of fluid mechanics and heat transfer. Part 3 is finite-volume method. Part 4 is grid generation.

description.en: The concepts of thermal energy and electrical energy will be included in the Energy Engineering; the different energy system which will be introduced is as follows: renewable energy, traditional thermal power plant and cogeneration power system.

syllabi.outline:
ENERGY ENGINEERING is a branch of Engineering science that deals with production, transformation, transmission, storage and use of energy and is the most recent engineering disciplines to emerge. 
This course 'ENERGY ENGINEERING’ is a basic course taught entirely in English. 
The aim of this course is to provide introductory knowledge to students who have not studied Environmental Energy Science as a subject. 
Students can gain basic knowledge about Energy sources, production of energy, Energy Management, and most importantly about Bioenergy Engineering. 
This deals with sustainable methods of producing clean energy and thereby preventing hazardous environmental issues through significant energy efficiency improvements and sustainable use of resources.
This course also has an important objective of motivating non-native students to improve their English language skills like conversing, discussing and writing assignments in English.
These practices will help them deliver better English presentations and also enhance their thesis and paper writing abilities.

description.zh: 這是一門旨在介紹基礎統計原理和方法的課程，並包括R語言的教學。本課程的總體目標是建立研究生在單變量統計的知識與技術。本課程著重概念理解應用，不涉及公式推導。主題包括單變量和雙變量分佈的介紹，數據展示，描述統計，標準常態分佈，學生t分佈，用於測試平均值的推斷統計方法，相關性，以及簡單/多元線性回歸。本課程還向學生介紹R數據分析系統。本課程無先修課程的要求。
description.en: This is a course designed to provide an introduction to the principles and methods of statistics using R. The overall goal of the course is to provide graduate students with a foundation to quantitative data analysis that will allow them to build future skills. This course provides an applied approach to statistical analysis for research. Topics include introduction to univariate and bivariate distributions, data displays, descriptive statistics, the standard normal distribution, student’s t-distribution, inferential statistical methods for testing means, correlation, and simple/multiple linear regression. This course also introduces the student to the R data analysis system. No formal course prerequisites.

syllabi.outline: This is a course designed to provide an introduction to the principles and methods of statistics using R. The overall goal of the course is to provide graduate students with a foundation for quantitative data analysis that will allow them to build future skills. This course provides an applied approach to statistical analysis for research. Topics include an introduction to univariate and bivariate distributions, data displays, descriptive statistics, the standard normal distribution, student’s t distribution, inferential statistical methods for testing means, correlation, simple/multiple linear regression, and mediation. This course also introduces the student to the R data analysis system. No formal course prerequisites.

name.en: Philosophy of Technological and Vocational Education

description.zh: 本課程在探究技職教育的本質、目標、歷史發展及相關哲學思潮，期培養學生發展批判思考能力分析技職教育相關議題。
description.en: This course is designed to investigate the purpose, essence, history,    and related philosophical thinking of Vocational and Technological Technical Education (VTE)；to develop students forming critical thinking to analyze the current issues in VTE.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹技職教育之歷史發展與相關哲學思潮，綜採行歷史學、社會學、哲學與比較教育學的觀點，以專題討論的方式進行。期達成以下目標-
一、使學生瞭解技職教育的歷史發展與哲學理念
二、使學生瞭解台灣技職教育的變遷
三、使學生能比較及分析國內外技職教育之差異
四、使學生能以宏觀的視野與脈絡來透視技職教育問題並提出改革建議。

7.中國古代科技思想對技職教育的啟示

10.戰後台灣的技職教育發展（三）1988-迄今
11.全球化對技職教育研究的啟示
12.其他技職教育史哲相關文獻評論

description.en: The course aims to (1) understand the definition, essence, and function of human resources development, (2) cultivate the fundamental capability of human resource development. It covers the definition and essence of human resources development, demand evaluation of human resource development, planning of human resource, learning theories, training method; curriculum designing and compilation, evaluation of training development, and international human resource development. The course is conducted through lectures, discussions, field trip activities, and colloquia.
