description.zh: 本課程以理論及個案為出發點，透過組織內外部條件及資源分析，審視組織學習方案之規劃發展、實施、評鑑，分析知識管理的基本概念、知識管理在實務上的應用、知識管理在策略上的重要性，以及企業如何進行知識管理。課程主題包括，組織學習，組織創新，市場導向理論，知識管理概論，知識創造與轉移，知識管理個案，知識管理與資訊技術。
description.en: This course will use case study to analysis how knowledge management impacts on the competitive advantage and its method of implementation. This curriculum examines the development, employment, and the evaluation of the learning organization project through the analysis of the inner and outer condition and the resources of the organization. It will include the followings: organizational learning, innovation, market-orientation, knowledge creation, knowledge transferring, knowledge diffusion, and information technology impact on knowledge management.

syllabi.outline: The objective of this course is to prepare students to understand the current theories, practices, tools and techniques in knowledge management (KM) to deal with the challenges with the organization and management of knowledge. This course addresses contemporary issues in managing knowledge, intellectual capital and other intangible assets by discussing the fundamental concepts of knowledge and its creation, acquisition, representation, dissemination, use and re-use, the role and use of knowledge in organizations and institutions, KM systems and its application in knowledge generation and transfer, and in the representation, organization, and exchange of knowledge, knowledge codification and system development, its testing, KM tools and portals, and finally ethical, managerial and legal issues in knowledge management.
syllabi.schedule:
Topics:

FOUNDATION (Weeks 1-2)
Week 1: Course Introduction & Introduction to Knowledge Management

*Overview of KM as a discipline
*Introduction to the Dalkir Meta-KM Process framework

Week 2: Knowledge Management Models & The KM Cycle

*Theoretical frameworks
*Understanding the create-share-use cycle
*R Lab intro: Setting up R environment, basic text data handling

PHASE 1: CREATE OR CAPTURE (Weeks 3-5)

Week 3: Independent Research: Knowledge Capture and Codification (Self-Study)

*Tacit vs. explicit knowledge
*Documentation strategies
*Knowledge elicitation techniques

Week 4: Knowledge Capture (R Lab I)

*R Lab: Text mining basics - extracting knowledge from documents
*Word frequencies, tf-idf, document similarity (tm, tidytext)

Week 5: Knowledge Discovery & Topic Modeling

*R Lab: Topic modeling with LDA - discovering knowledge domains
*Identifying hidden themes in organizational documents (topicmodels, stm)

PHASE 2: SHARE AND DISSEMINATE (Weeks 6-8)
Week 6: Organizational Culture, Motivation, and Knowledge Sharing

*Organizational culture as enabler/barrier to knowledge sharing
*Motivational factors (goal orientations) in knowledge contribution and knowledge hoarding 
*Achievement goal theory applied to KM behaviors
*Reward systems and cultural dimensions

Week 7: Measuring Culture, Motivation & Sharing Behaviors

*R Lab: Survey analysis & psychometrics
*Measuring organizational culture for KM
*Knowledge sharing attitudes and motivation scales
*Reliability analysis, CFA validation (lavaan, psych)

Week 8: Knowledge Sharing Networks & Communities of Practice

*Social capital and network perspectives
*Communities of practice frameworks
*R Lab: Social Network Analysis I & II
*Mapping knowledge sharing behaviors
*Network density, centrality, community detection (igraph, tidygraph, ggraph)

MID-TERM (Week 9)
Week 9: Mid-term Presentation

*ASSESS: Knowledge Mining & Discovery (Weeks 10-12)

Week 10: Knowledge Mining I - Pattern Discovery

*Association rules in organizational knowledge
*Finding expertise patterns*
*R Lab: Association rules mining (arules, arulesViz)

Week 11: Knowledge Mining II - Expertise Mapping

*Identifying subject matter experts
*Knowledge flow analysis
*R Lab: Combining text mining + SNA for expertise identification

Week 12: Sentiment Analysis & Knowledge Communication

*Analyzing organizational communication patterns
*Understanding knowledge sharing tone and effectiveness
*R Lab: Sentiment analysis of emails, documents, collaboration tools (tidytext, syuzhet)

PHASE 3: USE, APPLY AND RE-USE (Weeks 13-14)
Week 13: Knowledge Application & Organizational Learning

*Knowledge reuse strategies
*Learning from experience
*Lessons learned systems
*R Lab: Document clustering - organizing knowledge for reuse (K-means, hierarchical)

Week 14: Organizational Memory & Knowledge Retention

*Memory systems and repositories
*Knowledge loss prevention
*R Lab: Time-based analysis - tracking knowledge evolution and retention patterns

Week 15: Knowledge Management Strategy & Measurement

*KM strategy alignment with business goals
*Measuring KM value and ROI
*KM metrics and dashboards
*R Lab: Integration project - combining multiple analytical methods

CONTEXTUALIZE: Technology & Implementation (Week 16)
Week 16: KM Tools, Technology Infrastructure & The KM Team

*ICT infrastructure for KM
*KM governance and team roles
*Implementation challenges and change management
*R Lab: Building KM dashboards and final project support

LOOKING FORWARD & FINAL (Weeks 17-18)
Week 17: Future Challenges for KM & Emerging Trends

*AI and machine learning in KM
*Remote work and distributed knowledge

Week 18: Final

description.zh: 本課程旨在提供社會科學領域背景的碩博士研究生熟悉並掌握機器學習的分析技術，並能將其運用在分析巨量的結構(數字)或非結構數據資料(文字、圖像、社群關係)。課程內容將以python作為數據分析的軟體，並介紹如何使用網絡爬蟲以及API服務擷取並整理所需要的目標數據，此外將介紹包括知識圖譜的繪製、肢體動作圖像辨識、自然語言處理的技術以及應用等。由於本課程需要大量的程式編寫作業，並須有一定的程式與統計基礎，學生須先修過教育統計學和校務研究，始可修習本課程。另曾修習多變量分析課程者尤佳。
description.en: This course is tailored for graduate students majoring in social sciences, equipping them with the skills to proficiently employ machine learning in their big data analysis endeavors. The applications of machine learning encompass both structured and unstructured data analysis. The course will include instruction on Python programming. Topics covered will encompass web scraping, data acquisition via API services, science mapping, motion detection, and natural language processing. This course places a high demand on both programming skills and a solid foundation in statistics. Prerequisite courses for enrollment in this course include educational statistics and institutional research. And taking multivariate analysis before this course is highly recommend although it is not requirement.

description.en: This course is designed for students who have taken one-year undergraduate organic chemistry course. It is divided into the three fundamental aspects of the study of organic chemistry:reactions, mechanisms and structure. A student who has completed this course should be able to approach the literature directry, with a sound knowledge of modern basic organic chemistry.

description.zh:
本課程以高分子加工時所遇到之問題，分單元講述，其內容包括：
(I) 高分子加工學之基礎(a)輸送現象(b)高分子黏彈學(c)高分子混煉。
(II)高分子加工學之應用(a)壓模法(b)沖模法(c)反應沖模法(d)絲線成形  等專題。
description.en:
The course focuses on the "trouble shooting" in the polymer processing . Both theoretical and practical topics will be included. The main contents are devided into the following units :
(I)Fundamental Studies:(a)Transport Phenomena (b)Viscoelastic Properties of  Polymer Melt (c)Polymer Compounding and Blending.
(II)Practical Studies:(a)Compression Molding (b)Injection Molding (c)Reaction Injection Molding (d)Fiber Formation (e)Membrane
      Formation.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹各種高分子加工成型技術及其相關知識，使同學瞭解各種高分子加工技術的特性，加工原理及方法。主要講授內容為高分子材料的特性、高分子製品各種性質的檢驗方法、高分子材料的流變性質、高分子材料的混合與摻合問題、介紹塑膠材料的各種加工成型技術及介紹纖維成型技術。
	This course aims to introduce various polymer processing and molding technologies and related knowledge to understand the characteristics of various polymer processing technologies, processing principles, and methods of suitable polymer materials. The main lectures are the characteristics of polymer materials, the inspection methods of various properties of polymer products, the rheological properties of polymer materials, the mixing and blending of polymer materials, the introduction of different processing and molding technologies of plastic materials, and the introduction of fibers processing technology.

description.en: Two major goals of this course are spectroscopy and separation methods. Spectroscopy methods include ultraviolet, visible, infrared, nuclear magnetic, and x-ray spectroscopies.Election and mass spectrometry are also included. Separation methods are: gas, liquid, and gel chromatographies. In addition, GC-MS,LC-MS, GC-IR, etc. will be studied.

description.zh: 本課內容包括高分子鏈之統計力學、高分子之界面作用力及Flory-Huggin理論。 對於紡織技術學程的規劃，本課程會注重紡織纖維的合成技術，例如用奈米技術加在Nylon纖維上，例如以clay加強Nylon的強度及磨耗性質，用理論的探討例如用Halpin-Tsai equation去預測紡織纖維的楊氏係數，另外也會加強高分子物理化學在紡織纖維成型過程中所扮演的角色。
description.en: The course includes; statistics of polymer chain, interfacial polymer force, Florry-Huggun theory. A major objective of this course is to provide a background in polymerizations, polymer structures and polymer properties. The material in this course also covers polymer characterization, polymer rheology and polymer processing. In addition, structures, properties, usages and products of rubbers, plastics and fibers are emphasized and compared. The object of this course is also to provide a background in fiber compositions, synthesis, spinning and characterization. A second goal is to introduce factors that influence fiber compositions, formation and properties.

syllabi.outline: Teach the basic concepts and various reaction mechanisms of polymer materials, and introduce related application examples. Students can systematically understand the molecular design and application directions of polymer systems.

description.en: This course explores the principles of sustainable development in green chemistry technologies, including renewable resources, minimizing waste, and employing eco-friendly processes. Students will acquire the skills to design innovative materials with a diminished environmental footprint, delve into green synthesis   and green energy.

description.zh: 本課程針對在不同物理和化學機制下顏色產生的原因，如振動和簡單的激發解釋了白熾（如：火焰）、氣體激發（如：霓虹管、極光）和震動與旋轉（如：藍冰和水）的顏色等，以及染料和顏料之化學結構、製造方式和基本化性予以闡述，以便對色料的相關應用有較為明晰的瞭解。
description.en: This course targets at the color derived from a variety of physical and chemical mechanisms are summarized. Includes vibrations and simple excitations to explain the colors of incandescence (e.g., flames), gas excitations (neon tube, aurora), and vibrations and rotations (blue ice and water). And also chemical structure, manufacturing and properties of main dyes and pigments are studied. Further applications of the color stuff are explained.

syllabi.outline:

description.en: The course is designed to teach upper level graduate students about the recent advances in protein science and glycobiology with specific application in medical and biotechnological industries. The prerequisite classes for this course are: general organic chemistry, biochemistry, protein structure and glycobiology. Students are expected to learn the structure, biosynthesis, chemistry and cell biology in related to bioactive protein and glycconjugates.

syllabi.outline:
The course is designed to teach upper level undergraduate students and graduate students about the recent advances in protein science and glycobiology with specific application in medical and biotechnological industries. This course provides a comprehensive understanding of proteomics, emphasizing the revolutionary impact of AlphaFold on protein structure prediction. Students will explore proteomics techniques, data analysis, and practical applications, with hands-on experience using AlphaFold.

Course Goals includes:
1. Understand the principles of proteomics and protein biochemistry.
2. Gain proficiency in experimental and computational proteomics techniques.
3. Explore the functionalities and applications of AlphaFold in predicting protein structures.
4. Apply knowledge to real-world biological problems.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要以對於當代建築具有啟發性和創新性的建築經典著作 (或文學、哲學) 為範圍，透過修課者的精讀、研討交流、對話，以窺探形塑當代建築的重要觀念與內涵，結合與之相對應的建築作品進行作品的閱讀與詮釋。

        本課程希望訓練建築研究者理解建築學的物質和非物質面兩者係互為一體，培養研究生進一步的建築抽象性思考和分析能力，並期望研究生藉此拓展建築觀念。

        課程非以授課方式進行，而由修課者每周進行指定或非指定的閱讀，於上課時間進行閱讀報告與心得之討論，授課老師進行導讀，並就討論內容提出分析比較與歸納。

description.zh: 本課程區分為四個實習，共一學年之都市設計實習，每學期應從事幾項實習，依該學期之情況而定：(一)大型基地開發之建築規劃與都市設計實習：參照台北市都市發展局擬定之「都市設計與土地使用開發許可」之審議標準，練習建築、敷地與都市設計三者整合關係之設計實習。(二)都市更新地區都市設計實習：以台北市更新地區為範例，選定基地範圍從事都市更新地區之改造，建立地區未來像，並擬定都市設計準則。(三)都市計畫通盤檢討地區都市設計實習：依據都市計畫通盤檢討第八條規定，都市計畫通盤檢討地區必須依據該地區之交通、產業、文化、生態及基地等因素，擬定都市設計準則；以台北市都市計畫通盤檢討為例，練習都市設計準則之訂定，或以都市計畫細部計畫為例，研擬土地使用分區管制與設計準則。(四)新發展區都市設計實習：選定一個地區，可能是擴大都市發展地區或新市鎮、新社區之規劃設計實習。

syllabi.outline: 本課程主要目的為透過真實的場域案例，連結本所其他專題課程涵蓋之理論與台灣規劃實務的各個面向，讓學生熟悉都市設計的操作。本學期課程內容結合USR計畫，將基地訂於「台北市北投中繼市場與其週邊社區」，預計透過「食農教育移動廚房」的設計、製作、使用者回饋，深入思考將大尺度都市發展策略落實於社區實作的操作模式。期待經由門課，一方面讓學生於真實場域實習社區尺度的都市設計操作，一方面實踐大學社會責任（USR）的參與精神，產生對社會/區實質的貢獻。

description.zh: 臺灣建築史的發展大約可分成受到漢民族影響的傳統建築，以及日本和西方世界影響的近現代建築，本課程主要探究臺灣近現代建築發展的歷程。本課程係以時間為軸，將台灣近現代建築分為三個主題：(1) 臺灣近現代建築的背景、(2) 臺灣殖民時期、(3) 二次大戰之後的臺灣建築。
description.en: This course mainly discusses the development of modern Taiwanese architecture since the Japanese colonial period. The historical development of Taiwanese architecture could be divided into traditional Han architecture and modern architecture with Japanese and western influences. Based on the timeline, three themes will be introduced: (1) the background of Taiwanese modern architecture, (2) Taiwanese architecture during the colonial period, (3) Taiwanese architecture after the Second World War.

Theme 1 background

Theme 3 Post-war to the Present

13.	3-3 Modernism after the Second World War with Western influences
14.	3-4 Modernism after the Second World War with Japanese influences

syllabi.assessment:
1. Attendance 20% (students will not get the score of attendance if the number of absence is more than 4.)
2. Participation 30%
3. Mid-term Presentation 20%
4. Research thesis 30%

2.	Detail of "Participation"
Each participant needs to prepare a brief introduction to the (non-architectural) social background of one cultural period of time. This will be the tuned in of the class of the day for 20 minutes.
(Week 02) Dutch and Spanish Empires in the 17th Century (relationship with the world)
(Week 03) 17th. C. to 19th. C. China (relationship with the rest of the world)
(Week 04) Japan before 1895 (westernization)
(Week 05) Japanese colonial power in Taiwan and China 
(Week 10) social background in the first half of the 20th-century China
(Week 11) Japanese architecture after WWII 
(Week 12) global modernist architecture esp. after WWII
(Week 13) ideology of Chinese origin before and after 1945 (from 1940s to 1960s)
(Week 14) global trends of architectural regionalism
(Week 16) from postmodern architecture to Deconstructivism in the world

3.	Detail of "	Mid-term presentation": proposal for the final report 20%
In the first half of the courses, students have to outline their interests of Taiwanese architecture in certain approaches. They might be architectural styles (ex. Regionalism, modernism, etc.), structural systems, materials (ex. Brick, RC, etc.), particular types of architecture, one or two individual architects, etc. Students should present their plans of their final reports in the mid-term class about 10 minutes, in order to collect some feedback from colleagues and class instructor for further develop to achieve the final report.

4.	Detail of "	Research thesis": 30%
One should submit his/her thesis by 6/25 12:00pm to Dr. Wu. The words of the thesis should not be less than 3000 words. It should be in thesis format (word) instead of brief presentation format (power point).
The final report should present the development and influences from the past to the present (or particular period).

name.en: Disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage

description.zh:
我國古蹟與歷史建築之文化遺產防災計畫實施現況，至今因欠缺有系統之調查研究，因此難以了解問題點所在。此外台灣現有之古蹟與歷史建築多為日治時期所遺留下來，而日本至今已有相當多具有良好防災計畫之古蹟與歷史建築案例，應可作為我國相關研究參考，但國內對此課題亦缺少有系統之調查。
本課程的授課內容如下：1.概論 2.文化遺產防災之重要性3.文化遺產防災之基本策略4. 文化遺產防災之進行方式5.文化遺產之災害種類與對策。
description.en:
Due to the lack of systematic research work carried out in Taiwan, it is difficult to find out the problems of the current disaster prevention plans for the cultural heritage. Taiwan has many existing vestiges and relics from Japanese colonial period at the moment. Despite the fact that there are numerous excellent examples of disaster prevention plans in Japan for us to consult and to research, little systematic work regarded the subject can be found in the literature in our own country. 
The course content about followings: 
1. Introduction
2. Importance of disaster prevention of cultural heritage
3. Disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage 
4. Approach of disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage
5. Type of cultural heritage disaster and guideline

name.en: The Evaluation for Bulding’s Carbon Footprint

description.zh: 國際能源署(IEA)呼籲全球國家訂定淨零碳排路徑，國內也發佈「台灣 2050 淨零路徑及策略」，具體宣告了淨零碳排的目標期程與行動方案，針對建築部門納入低碳(低蘊含碳)建築評估(Low Embodied-carbon Building Rating System, LBERS)，藉由標準化、透明化的建築資訊來剖析建築生命週期各階段對環境的影響，以培養永續淨零概念並具備評估整棟建築生命週期的碳足跡、甚進一步提出減碳熱點，了解建築物的節碳潛力所在。了解國內外淨零碳排路徑策略、具備建築物生命週期的整體流程概念、具備建築碳足跡計算操作能力。
description.en: IEA (The International Energy Agency) proposes to set a global net carbon emission roadmap, and domestically launch a net target and action plan, targeting the building sector, the Low Embodied-carbon Building Rating System(LBERS) a simple and effective assessment tool to evaluates the carbon footprint of a building's life cycle through standardized and transparent building information, the impact of various stages of the building life cycle on the environment is analyzed step by step. This course not only evaluates the carbon footprint of the entire building life cycle but also further identifies carbon hotspots and provides carbon reduction strategies, hence understanding carbon savings potential of buildings.

name.zh: 人工智慧於語言教育之應用

description.zh: 本課程為英語教學相關領域之研究生設計，適合師資培育中的職前教師、現職英語教師，以及有志於成為語言教師之學習者選修。課程全面探討人工智慧(AI)於語言教學與學習中的理論基礎與應用實務，旨在增進教師的AI素養（AI literacy），使學員能理解並善用AI 技術於課堂教學與評量之中，並且協助學生理解AI在語言學習中的理論架構。
description.en: This course is designed for pre-service English teachers, in-service educators, and those interested in becoming language teachers. It explores both the theoretical foundations and practical applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in language teaching and learning, with a focus on English language education. A core component of the course is developing AI literacy, enabling students to critically understand, evaluate, and responsibly use AI tools in educational settings. Students will engage with key learning theories that inform the integration of AI into language education. These theories support informed decision-making about how AI technologies are used to enhance teaching and learning.

description.zh: 本課程提供關於語料庫應用的介紹，包含語料庫分析工具、分析方法、語料庫設計與建構，及語料庫為本的研究方法等；同時，本課程亦探討其在英語教學上的應用。主要的主題涵蓋字彙教學與學習、詞組分析、中介語分析、教材分析、言談分析，及電腦輔助語言學習等。修課學生將學習如何針對不同研究主題，收集語料、構建小型語料庫，並運用所學之語料庫軟體進行語料分析等。
description.en: This course offers an introduction to corpus linguistics, including the corpus analytical tools, techniques, corpus design and construction, and methodologies for doing corpus-based studies. We will also discuss its applications in English language teaching and learning. Major topics include vocabulary teaching and learning, analysis of chunks, teaching materials analysis, interlanguage analysis, discourse analysis, and computer-assisted language learning. Students are expected to learn to collect corpora data, create a small corpus, run and analyze corpora data according to different research topics.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to introduce to students the basic concepts, issues and skills of corpus linguistics, including types of corpora, corpus design and construction, corpus analytical tools and techniques, and methodologies for corpus-based studies. It will discuss the major uses of corpora and the applications of corpus linguistics in English language teaching and learning. In the class, students will read and discuss previous studies, and will be given hands-on activities to use corpora and corpus tools.

name.en: Legends in Movies: Anime and Games

description.zh: 亞瑟王與圓桌武士、聖杯、龍和公主一直以現代書籍及電影的方式流傳至今。本課程將探討弔詭的現代中世紀現象，亦即現代西方如何以多樣的手段去詮釋、改寫或紀念中古世紀，使得這種千年前的文化在現代重生。本課程同時也將討論日本動畫家及漫畫家是如何以動漫的方式將西方中世紀故事及元素巧妙的融合進現代日本流行文化。
description.en: Stories of Arthur and his knights, the Holy Grail, dragons and princesses – continue to be retold and enjoyed in modern books and films. This course will examine the paradoxical phenomenon of modern medievalism, looking at the varied ways the modern West has borrowed, celebrated, and rewritten its medieval past, a culture strangely as alive now as it was a thousand years ago. We will consider, too, how western medieval stories and images are also being cleverly adapted and transformed in modern Japanese pop culture by anime and manga artists.

syllabi.outline: In literary studies, when we encounter the term "legend", it is often understood as stories that center on human protagonists rather than supernatural beings - as differentiated from "myth" - such as the stories of King Arthur and his knights, the search for the Holy Grail, and the dragon-slaying in medieval literature. This course, however, will not be limited by the scope of the Middle Age and will extend the definition of "legend" by examining the prominent archetypes in Western literature. The course will explore how these archetypes not only form the basis of classic literature, but also pervade and enrich our popular culture including films, operas, anime, and video games.

1.	高效率實驗室管理術 (作者: 劉如熹、黃文澤、莫誠康)
《高效率實驗室管理術》由臺大化學系 - 劉如熹教授帶領兩位學生 -   黃文澤博士及莫誠康博士耗時多年集結、編寫而成的心血結晶。
本書是一本關於實驗室管理的實用指南，深入探討了如何打造一個高效、創新且可持續發展的實驗室，並對研究管理與行政管理兩大核心進行了詳細剖析。
主要內容包括：
• 研究管理：如何建立明確的願景，提升研究品質與效率，並運用週報、月報等方式追蹤進度。

name.zh: 植入物與矯具生物力學

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意。
生物力學是一門整合醫學與工學的學科。本課程介紹並討論十大主題：(1)脊椎生物力學、(2)關節生物力學、(3)骨折生物力學、(4)復健生物力學、(5)運動生物力學、(6)心血管生物力學、(7)植入物設計原理、(8)手術器械設計原理、(9)矯具設計原理與(10)病床與輪椅設計原理。
description.en: Biomechanics is a multi-discipline branch incorporating medicine and mechanics. Ten topics are introduced and discussed in this class: (1) spinal biomechanics, (2) joint biomechanics, (3) trauma biomechanics, (4) rehabilitation biomechanics, (5) sport biomechanics, (6) cardiovascular biomechanics, (7) implant design, (8) instrument design, (9) orthotice design, and (10) sickbed and wheelchair design.

syllabi.outline:
生物力學是一門整合生物醫學與力學的學科。本課程涵蓋生物力學基礎概念與理論之介紹，並分別討論以下各主題：(1)生物力學概論、(2)植入物與矯具、(3) 骨骼生物力學、(4) 髖關節生物力學、(5) 膝關節生物力學、(6)足部生物力學、(7) 脊椎生物力學、(8) 牙科生物力學、(9) 人體動作分析、(10)電腦輔助工程分析在生物力學之應用。各主題中亦將介紹各式植入物與輔具於臨床醫學上之應用。

Biomechanics is a multi-disciplinary science which integrates biomedical and mechanical subjects. This course covers the basic principles of biomechanics and its applications in the following topics: (1) Introduction to biomechanics; (2) Prosthetics and orthotics; (3) Bone mechanics; (4) Hip joint biomechanics; (5) Knee joint biomechanics; (6) Biomechanics of foot and footwear; (7) Spine biomechanics; (8) Dental biomechanics; (9) Human motion analysis; (10) Applications of CAE in biomechanics. The related prothetic and orthotic devices will also be introduced in selected topics.

description.zh: 本課程分三單元，包括：(1)奈米薄膜製程與檢測技術：奈米薄膜之定義、種類，奈米薄膜特性與應用，奈米薄膜製程，物理蒸鍍法，化學蒸鍍法，超微結構之觀察、微區/微量之化學組成分析，微奈米材料之機械性質檢測，微奈米材料之磁性、光、電性檢測，微奈米材料檢測所需試片之加工技術。(2)奈米生物科技：細胞生物學，分子細胞生物學，病毒，DNA與蛋白質操控，光電生物技術，奈微米製程技術，生物高分子監測系統整合實例介紹，專題報告。(3)矽奈米電子元件：奈米矽技術簡介，奈米矽元件前瞻物理，各種奈米電子元件可能之應用，奈米矽元件之電特性量測，專題報告。

description.zh: 彈性力學為固體力學的重要分支，研究彈性物體在外力和其他外界因素（包括外力、溫度、電磁場等）作用下產生的變形和內力。彈性力學廣泛應用於建築、機械、化工、航太等工程領域，是學習有限元素法、複合材料力學、破裂力學和疲勞等的基礎課程，對於培養學生的專業基礎，思維方法和獨立工作能力有著重要意義。
description.en: Elasticity is a branch of Solid mechanics that deals with determination of the stress, strain, and displacement distribution in an elastic solid under the influence of external forces. This subject has applications in many engineering and scientific fields such as civil engineering, mechanical engineering, materials engineering, and aeronautical and aerospace engineering. The subject also provides the basis for more advanced work in finite element analysis, mechanics of composite materials, fracture mechanics.

name.en: Foundations and Advances in Artificial Intelligence II

description.zh:
本課程深入探討人工智慧領域的基礎知識和最新技術，包括機器學習、深度學習、自然語言處理、生成對抗網絡等領域。課程還介紹了最新的AI技術趨勢，包括注意力機制、自監督學習、大型AI通用模型和元學習等，並提供了相關領域的案例研究和實習操作。
課程運作模式：學員將參與課堂討論和小組活動，以促進想法交流和知識分享。學生可根據課程選擇進階專題研究，深入探討特定主題並提交最終報告。最後三週專題研究將被評估並可獲得額外獎勵，學生可在學期中向授課教師報名參與專題研究。
description.en:
Course Overview: This course delves into the fundamentals and latest advancements in the field of artificial intelligence, covering topics such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and generative adversarial networks. The course also introduces the latest trends in AI technology, including attention mechanisms, self-supervised learning, large-scale AI models, and meta-learning, and provides case studies and hands-on exercises in related areas.
Course Execution: Participants will engage in classroom discussions and group activities to facilitate idea exchange and knowledge sharing. Students may choose to undertake advanced research projects on specific topics of course and submit final reports. The final three weeks of research projects will be assessed and eligible for additional rewards. Students can sign up for research projects with the course instructor during the semester.

description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

In the era of technological & social growth at an exponential speed, more than ever, business leaders across the globe are facing even more challenging issues, not just economic aspects but also legal and ethical aspects.  In this elite IMBA program of NTUT, this course is specifically designed for developing future leaders for corporations & organizations in various business domains.  
How to simultaneously achieve the corporate objectives and fulfill the ethical responsibilities without compromising fundamental principles and standards of conduct when facing dilemma is imperative for us to learn and ponder upon. 
With this vision and mission in mind, the lecturer is committed to inspire the students’ talent within as in all the other executive management programs.  
This IMBA course will equip all participating international students with multiple pillars of those grounds in being great leaders in the future, including building fundamental mindset and value system for managing challenging issues both economically and ethically, framework of strategic thinking and organizational structuring, and practical cross-cultural business cases and simulations. 
All IMBA students who participate in this course will be expected to be well-prepared with passionate learning attitude to JOIN proactively group discussions, cross-cultural idea brainstorming, business scenario simulation, deductive-and-inductive reasoning practice, individual and team projects, and business case studies.

name.zh: 網路行銷研究與資料分析

description.zh: 網際網路與相關應用程式從根本上改變了消費者日常生活的各個方面。行銷從業人員也已經將他們的工作轉移到了網路上。本課程的目的在於幫助學生認識網路資料分析在數位行銷領域中的作用，並實際應用網路分析工具和技術來監控網路行銷活動的績效。課程主題包括：Web數據分析與行銷簡介、Web日誌分析、網站表現指標和關鍵績效指標、網站監控和趨勢分析、網路廣告及網路分析的未來趨勢。
description.en: The Internet and web applications have fundamentally changed nearly every aspect of our daily lives. Marketing practitioners have shifted their efforts online. This module aims to help students recognise the role of web analytics within the digital marketing landscape, and practically apply web analytics tools and technologies to monitor performance of web based marketing activities. Topics to be covered include: Introduction to web analytics and web data driven marketing; Web server log analysis; Web metrics and key web performance Indicators; Web monitoring and trends analysis; Dashboard design; Navigation analysis; Online advertising; Future trends of web analytics.

3.數據經理人實務經驗分享。

2. Students interpret and analyze data to gain consumption and marketing insights;
3. Data managers share their practical experience.

syllabi.outline: 以消費者為重心已蔚為目前市場行銷的重要潮流。了解消費者決策過程也成為行銷領域研究的主流。一般而言，消費者的購買決策制定過程決定產品與服務的購買結果，主要包括五個階段：(1)問題察覺、(2)資訊搜尋、(3)方案評估、(4)購買選擇、(5)購後過程。消費者的購買決策制定過程深受各種不同因素之影響。本課程強調如何藉由理論概念、實例討論與實作方式進一步了解消費者，並將此知識應用於行銷策略上。此外網際網路為一整合媒體,有別於傳統之行銷環境,在網際網路上消費者與媒體可以產生高度的互動,並且也可能產生虛擬經驗.本課程也從消費者行為理論出發,探討在網際網路環境下之消費者行為。課程以哈佛式個案討論為主。

description.zh: 本課程將介紹基於神經網路的深度學習技術及其在商情預測上之應用， 主要內容包括：（1）深度學習和神經網路的基本概念和演算法；（2）深度學習的主流結構、啟動函數及正則化技術；（3）電腦視覺與自然語言處理技術應用案例；（4）深度學習主流結構的商情預測應用。通過課程的學習，同學們可瞭解神經網路基本概念；掌握深度學習中主要網路結構的基本概念和相關演算法；瞭解具體應用領域的背景知識；應用相關深度學習技術於商情預測。
description.en: This course will give a full picture of deep learning techniques and its application in business forecasting. Content includes: (1) basic concepts and algorithms of deep learning and neural networks; (2) popular network structures, activation functions, and regularization techniques; (3) principle and applications of computer vision and natural language processing. (4) applications of popular network structures in business forecasting. By learning this course, students will consolidate the basic concepts of neural networks; master the basic concepts and related algorithms of the main network structure in deep learning; understand the background knowledge of deep learning techniques with specific application fields; and understanding how to apply the main network structure in business forecasting.

description.zh:
本課程介紹了創新的本質、企業創新的原因以及如何管理創新。課程內容程涵蓋有關創新管理的一系列主題，包括創新動機、企業如何利用知識產權（如專利和商標）保護其創新、“研究與開發”（R&D )、創意人員、流程和團隊的管理，產品、服務和體驗創新的管理，“開放式創新”的採用和使用，以及創新中模塊化的採用和使用。
本課程在科技管理的部分主要介紹科技管理廠商層次(micro-level)與總體層次(macro-level)的相關理論，研究的領域與相關學術期刊。廠商層次介紹開放式創新、創業管理、智慧財產管理、資源論、技術搜尋、產業組織論等。在總體層次介紹科技政策的範疇與相關理論，包括技術典範與軌跡、國家、產業與區域創新系統、服務創新、科技計量與指標與產學合作政策等。
課程內容包括以案例研究為重點的討論，其中混合使用虛實的公司來討論管理創新的各個面向。這些討論與課程中涵蓋的主題互補，並以加強用予實際應用的想法。透過本課程，學生可以對碩/博士論文的研究課題，能有正確且有效地構建文獻探討的能力。
description.en:
This course introduces the nature of innovation, why firms innovate, and how innovation can be managed. The lectures cover a range of topics concerning the management of innovation, including motivations for innovating, how firms can protect their innovations using intellectual property rights (such as patents and trademarks), the nature and organization and management of “research and development” (R&D), the management of creative people, processes and teams, the management of product, service and experience innovations, the adoption and use of “open innovation”, and the adoption and use of modularity in innovation.  
This course introduces the micro-level and macro-level of technology management with respect to related theories, research field and academic journal. description.zh: 本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to train student and to provide a background in the theory and methodology of general statistical issues. Topic includes: probability theory, inference, hypothesis testing, regression analysis and variance analysis.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：SPSS資料輸入、資料視覺化、常態分配、假設檢定、型I 誤與型II誤、T 檢定、因素分析、區別分析等。

課程目標為:

01. 如何選擇正確(合適)的統計方法來回答研究問題與假設？

02. 如何使用SPSS 統計軟體進行分析？

03. 如何正確的解釋與呈現統計分析的結果在學術期刊上？

description.zh: 設計是一個相當多元的領域，是技術的化身、美學的表現和文化的象徵。它是社會、經濟、技術、藝術、心理學和生理學的結合。本課程旨在構建學生對設計原理和理論的認識，提高學生對美感和設計作品的鑑賞能力，並為他們提供專業術語。這些知識構成了幫助年輕從業者實現其藝術目標並在高專業水平上執行項目工作的核心。本課程基於對現代設計行業的概述，期望建立一個關於設計思維主題的全景視角。
description.en: Design is a quite multiplex domain, technical incarnation, esthetics performance and cultural symbol. And it is the union of the social, economics, technology, arts, psychology, and physiology. The course aims to structure students’ knowledge about the principles and theories of design, improve their abilities to appreciate the aesthetic sense and design works, and provide them with professional terminology. This knowledge constitutes the core which helps young practitioners to attain their artistic objectives and perform project work on a high professional level. This course is based on an overview of the modern design industry, expect to establish a panorama perspective on the subject of design thinking.

description.zh: 本課程關注空間、物件與感官體驗的設計，探討如何透過材料、形態、質地、聲音、氣味、光影與動線規劃等元素，營造沉浸式的體驗。課程內容涵蓋環境與空間體驗(Environmental & SpatialExperience)、五感設計(Multi-sensory Design)、氛圍塑造（Atmosphere Design)與物件互動(Object Interaction)等。學生將透過實地體驗與設計實作，學習如何運用空間與物件傳遞情感與故事，並發展能夠與人產生深層連結的設計概念。
description.en: This course focuses on designing experiences through space, objects, and sensory elements. It explores how material, form, texture, sound, scent, lighting, and movement influence immersive experiences. Topics include environmental and spatial experience, multi-sensory design, atmosphere creation, and object interaction. Through hands-on design exercises and real-world experience studies, students will learn how to use space and objects to convey emotions and narratives, creating designs that establish deep connections with people.

syllabi.schedule:
1. This course covers object-oriented modeling for software development. Materials covered include class models, state models, and interaction models in UML, a reference process model based on Unified process, implementation issues, and software engineering principles. This course is thinking and programming-intensive.
2. Students are required to complete a non-trivial software project. Only object-oriented languages such as C++/Java/C# are allowed. A project team may have 1-4 students. A single person team is allowed but is not encouraged.
3. There will be no exams; instead, there are 7 homework assignments, several in-class exercises, and two project reviews. All assignments turned in must be typed (handwriting will not be accepted).

syllabi.outline: This course aims to give students both a theoretical and a practical foundation in software testing. In the particular, students will learn about  software quality assurance concepts, test planning, test analysis and design, test execution, test result analysis, and test documentation. The course will cover the fundamental subjects on software testing, including testing concepts and principles, testing process, testing techniques, test coverage criteria, testing tools, and regression testing. The course will also cover several testing techniques for specific applications, including object-oriented software, web applications, and Android Apps.

description.zh:
安全程式設計是資訊安全領域中的關鍵技術。不良的「程式設計習慣」和「不考慮安全保護的程式設計」很容易導致可有心人士所利用。
本課程除了建立安全程式設計的基礎知識外，特別著重於同學的實務能力、漏洞測試、與安全程式開發能力。同時，透過分享最新的論文研究與相關技術報告，協助研究生在研究階段獲取最新的領域知識。
description.en:
Security programming is a key technology in the field of information security. “Bad programming habits” and “programming without security consideration” can easily lead to the use of malicious people. Four major themes will be explored.
In addition to establishing the basic knowledge of security programming, this course focuses on student's practical ability, vulnerability testing, and security programming development ability. At the same time, by sharing novel research papers and related technical reports, the students can obtain the newest and complete domain knowledge in their research stage.

description.zh: 能源在日常生活中以很多型態呈現，大量的能源使用於汽車動力、食物與用水加熱、產品製造、發電及其他不同事務。使用傳統能源會排放空氣污染物，因而引起鄰近地區、區域、跨國境空氣污染問題，甚至是全球的環境衝擊效應。本課程將檢視能源使用現況及其衍生的環境議題，並且探討能源使用之趨勢。傳統能源(如煤、石油、天然氣、核能等)、及再生能源(如太陽能、水力、風能、地熱能等)及能源效率等內容，都將於課程中介紹
description.en: Energy enters our everyday lives in many ways. Prodigious amounts of energy are used to power automobiles, heat food and water, manufacture products, generate electricity, and perform various other tasks. The use of traditional energy will emit air pollutants that may result in regional air pollution problem as well as global effects. In this course we will look at the current energy situation, its environmental implications, and try to determine the patterns of energy use. We will look at energy use as coal, petroleum, natural gas, nuclear energy, and renewable energy, such as solar energy, hydroelectric

syllabi.outline: Knowing the principle and development of each renewable energy, including solar energy, wind energy, ocean energy (wave energy, tide energy, ocean thermal energy, ocean salinity gradient energy), hydro energy, geothermal energy, biomass energy, and fuel cell. Realizing their potential, impact on the environment, and future perspective.
syllabi.schedule: 1.Course introduction, 2.Energy overview, 3.Solar energy(1), 4.Solar energy(2), 5.Wine energy(1), 6.Wine energy(2), 7.Ocean energy(1), 8.Ocean energy(2), 9.Midterm report, 10.Hydro energy, 11.Geothermal rnergy, 12.Biomass energy(1), 13.Biomass energy(2), 14.Hydrogen/Fuel cell, 15.Energy storage and transportation(1), 16.Energy storage and transportation(2), 17.Fossil energy, 18.Final report

name.en: Green House Gas Management and Practice

description.zh:
氣候變遷儼然已為全球邁入21世紀所面對最嚴峻國際環保課題，對非聯合國氣候變化綱要公約締約國及屬於外銷型新興工業國家的台灣，正處在發展轉捩點上，為維持國家競爭力，國內應擬訂更積極之節能減碳政策，並著手研擬調適衝擊方案，同時加強與國際間合作，進行減碳政策、技術與經驗交流，以推動碳市場之國際接軌，並確保環境、經濟、社會之永續發展。
本課程將介紹溫室氣體與氣候變遷之關連性、國際溫室氣體管制相關公約、我國溫室氣體管理現況、溫室氣體減量政策與經濟工具、及溫室氣體衝擊調適與節能新技術等，期藉由本課程使之瞭解全球暖化成因與後果與國內外溫室氣體管理現況與法規要求，以提升我國於氣候變遷因應之認知。
description.en: This class introduces scientific, economic, and ecological issues about the threat of global climate change, and the Policy Instruments of greenhouse gas management.  This course examines the interconnections of international politics and climate change.  It includes Green House Gas inventory, carbon tax and emission trading, Voluntary approach and other greenhouse gas management policy tools.  It explores an integrated approach to analysis the benefits of greenhouse gas and air pollution reduction measures, and related model development.

電腦運動控制課程包含下列課題：(1) 命令產生器設計 (2)運動本體與回授系統介紹 (3)基礎迴授控制器設計 (4)前饋控制器設計 (5)估測器設計

description.en: The course of computerized motion control includes the following topics:  (1) Command generator design (2) Introduction of motion control plant and feedback system (3) Feedback control loop design (4) Feedforward control loop design (5) Observer design (6) Multi-axis contouring control (7) Case study: semiconductor/LCD equipment。 The student will understand how to develop a PC_based motion control system by this course.

syllabi.outline:
電腦運動控制課程包含下列課題：(1) 命令產生器設計， (2)運動本體與回授系統介紹， (3)基礎迴授控制器設計， (4)前饋控制器設計， (5)估測器設計，(6)多軸路徑控制， (7) 案例探討 -- 半導體、LCD設備與機器人。學生從這門課程中可學到運動控制的理論與如何利用硬體控制平台去完成一套運動控制系統。

This course is a graduate-level introductory course to the fundamentals of computerized motion control. The topics of this course include: (1) command generation, (2) devices of motion control , (3) feedback control, (4) feedforward control, (5) observer design, (6) multi-axis control, (7) case study. Students can understand the techniques used in the field of computerized motion control. In addition, students will be using the above techniques to implement a real motion control system.

description.zh: 本課程將會介紹「非限制最佳化問題、線性規劃、非線性限制最佳化問題」。這些問題將會由數學推導與MATLAB模擬得到解決。對於解決非限制最佳化問題，一維搜尋法、梯度法、牛頓共軛方向法、擬牛頓法會將在本課程介紹及使用；線性規劃問題會利用單形法來解決；拉格朗日及KKT乘數則用來解決非線性限制最佳化問題。
description.en: Course Description：In this course, unconstrained optimization problems, linear programming, and nonlinear constrained optimization problems are presented. Mathematical derivations and MATLAB simulations are used to analyze and obtain the solutions to these problems.  For unconstrained optimization problems, one-dimensional search, gradient, Newton's, conjugate direction, quasi-Newton methods are presented. For linear programming problems, simplex method is introduced. Last, Lagrange and Karush-Kuhn-Tucker multipliers are presented for solving nonlinear constrained optimization problems.

description.zh: 演化計算最佳化與傳統最佳化的最主要差別在於演化式計算係透過迭代方式逼近最佳解。由於所使用的目標函數可以容忍對問題的不確定性，不精確性，部分正確性以及類似性，因此更適合處理實務的工程問題。演化式計算緣起於演化式規劃，基因演算法則透過數學模型的推導，驗證其可以使用在解決最佳化問題。本課程主要針對基因演算法(GA)與演進歸化法(EP/ES)進行討論，其他的方法如粒子群集(PSO)，模擬退火法(SA)也在本課程介紹之列。
description.en: The differences between Evolutionary Computing and conventional computing in that it obtains the near optimal solution through iterations. Because of the characteristics of the fitness functions, the evolutionary computation is more tolerable for imprecision, uncertainty, partial truth, and approximation to achieve tractability, robustness and low solution cost.  As a result, the evolutionary computation can be more suitable for solving engineering problems. The origin of the evolutionary computation is from the Evolutionary Planning.  Through a formal mathematic modeling, the Genetic Algorithm is proved to be used to solve optimization problems. The main focus of this course will be in Genetic Algorithm (GA) and Evolutionary Programming/Evolutionary Strategy (EP/ES). Other methods such as Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Simulated Anneal (SA) will also be discussed.

syllabi.outline:
This course presents analytic concepts in soft computing techniques. It is designed for the beginning graduate students who are interesting in application of soft computing techniques to engineer problems. Students should have a mathematical maturity typical of undergraduate curricula in science and engineering, including calculus and discrete mathematics.

The teaching approach in this course emphasizes modeling, analysis and design principles of soft computing techniques. The subject material includes genetic algorithm, Ant Colony Optimization and Particle Swarm Optimization. Case studies include several engineering applications.

syllabi.outline:
介紹光纖有線電視固網信號傳輸系統在次世代通訊架構下對區域和廣域網路連接設定的目標演進規劃下，如何深入瞭解理論及關鍵實務技術，並深化時空背景，分析核心要素。如何應用回傳鏈路整合核心網路及射頻網路、並進階對SD-WAN網路規劃和資安議題重要性提出建議方案。最後以專題研析提出多元異質網路整合應用服務的挑戰及應對措施。
Fiber-Based CATV Networks in Next-Generation Architectures
1;Next-Generation Fixed Network Transmission Architecture

name.en: Theory and Application of Diffractive Optics with Lab practice

description.zh:
繞射光學是基於光波繞射的原理，研究如何利用繞射現象設計光學元件來實現各種光學功能。繞射光學元件可以應用在改良光學系統的像差，為特定的波長實現聚光、分光等功能以取代傳統的光學透鏡、分光鏡等，此外利用傅光原理製作出傳統的光學元件無法實現的功能，在近代的光學系統、此類的微光學系統佔有極重要的地位。本課程中，我們將討論其基本原理、設計方法、以及應用。主要課程內容為：
1.光學繞射原理
2.傅式光學
3.繞射光學元件之設計方法
4.繞射光學元件之應用
5.繞射光學元件之實現與製作
description.en: This course is designed to introduce the principle of diffraction of optical wave and study the means of using the diffraction to perform optical setups in modern optical systems. Diffractive optical element (DOE) can be applied to correct aberrations, light focusing, light splitting, and other novel functions that traditional optical components difficultly or impossibly perform. DOE plays an important role in modern optical technology. The content of this course includes: 1. Principle of optical diffraction, 2. Fourier optics, 3. Design methods of DOE, 4. Applications of DOEs, and 5. Implementation of DOEs.

description.zh: 「仿生工程」是生物學到工程技術的觀念轉移，生物系統在上億年的演化驗證後已經達到高效且永續的精緻成果，本課程將介紹仿生工程之最新發展，師法自然將其應用於工程上將帶來革命性的突破。課程內容包含四大主題: (1)仿生概述、(2)生物製造技術、(3)生物高分子與(4)生物材料於仿生技術上的應用。
description.en: “Biomimetic Engineering” is a kind of knowledge transferring from biology to engineering technology. After billions of years of evolution, it has been proven that the biological system is highly efficient and sustainable. In this course, the latest progress in Biomimetic Engineering will be introduced. It will bring us revolutionary breakthroughs if we learn from nature and apply it to technology. The topics covered in this course will include (1) an introduction to bioinspiration, (2) biofabrication, (3) biomacromolecules, and (4) biomaterials and their application in bioinspired engineering.

description.zh: 本課程的目的是提升學生的科技英文技能和協助他們進階職場的實用英語需求. 此課程著重於科技英語之閱讀、聽力、口語、寫作、理解、語法規則、詞彙,發音,對話,商務溝通,和專業演講技巧. 本課程包括撰寫履歷, 面試技巧, 軟技能如溝通技巧, 職場禮節; email及電話技巧,出差英語, 判斷力,了解國際科技職場環境及工作需求,專業項目策劃及執行.輔導學生如何展現自己優勢及作好個人職業規劃,從而順利邁向成功目標.
description.en: This course aims to educate students in Information Technology English and prepare students for their career advancement. This course focuses on IT science and technology English reading, listening, speaking, writing, comprehension, grammar rules, vocabulary, pronunciation, conversation, communication, and professional presentation skills. This course also covers soft skills such as interview tips, communication, business etiquette, travel English, email English, decision making, understanding international business, global working environment, project management planning and execution. In addition, this course offers personal development for students to discover their personal advantage and perform their career planning for achieving career goals.

description.zh:
本課程之目的在於介紹一些廣泛、基本及實際的微電子材料（其中最主要者為積體電路之材料）。首先說明製造方法上之三個主要部分：擴散（diffusion）、平版照相術（lithography）及薄膜沉積（thin-film deposition）然後再介紹這些方法如何應用在各種元件所需之物理特性及元件設計有關之訊息後者則需要了解各種製造策略之目的及限制時再隨時給予介紹。
1 .半導體物理特性基本概念，2.半導體製程初論，3 .薄膜製程原理，4 .擴散原理，5 .黃光製 程原理，6 .蝕刻製程原理，7 .晶片封裝，8 積體電路製程整合。

description.zh: 本課程目的在了解「為何」與「如何」以電腦模擬方式進行材料科學研究。課程內容提及量子化學、固態物理與密度泛函理論(DFT)。而後將實際演練基本的材料模擬計算，內容包括結構最佳化、電子性質、光學性質、機械性質等，並將透過Python進行資料處理。學生可透過此課程學到材料模擬的基本原理、工作流程與實際操作，得以以理論觀點/微觀尺度評估材料議題。
description.en: The main purpose of the course is to understand “why to do” and “how to do” researches in materials science by using computer simulations. The background theory of quantum chemistry, solid-state physics and density functional theory (DFT) will be briefly introduced. The common tasks of materials simulations, including structural optimizations, electronic properties, optical properties, mechanical properties, etc., will be then demonstrated and employed. Basic commands of Python will also be introduced in doing data processing for analyses. Students will learn about basic principles, workflows and practices of materials simulations, being capable to evaluate materials’ issues from theoretical and microscopic viewpoints.

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
最後，透過對於ESG與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

syllabi.schedule:
In the era of technological & social growth at an exponential speed, more than ever, business leaders across the globe are facing even more challenging issues, not just economic aspects but also legal and ethical aspects.  In this elite IMBA program of NTUT, this course is specifically designed for developing future leaders for corporations & organizations in various business domains.  
How to simultaneously achieve the corporate objectives and fulfill the ethical responsibilities without compromising fundamental principles and standards of conduct when facing dilemma is imperative for us to learn and ponder upon. 
With this vision and mission in mind, the lecturer is committed to inspire the students’ talent within as in all the other executive management programs.  
This IMBA course will equip all participating international students with multiple pillars of those grounds in being great leaders in the future, including building fundamental mindset and value system for managing challenging issues both economically and ethically, framework of strategic thinking and organizational structuring, and practical cross-cultural business cases and simulations. 
All IMBA students who participate in this course will be expected to be well-prepared with passionate learning attitude to JOIN proactively group discussions, cross-cultural idea brainstorming, business scenario simulation, deductive-and-inductive reasoning practice, individual and team projects, and business case studies. 
It Is My Since Wish and Mission to develop You, to become great leaders of the future for bettering our world humanity advancement!  This course is specifically designed to develop and enhance all the wonderful qualities essential for You.

description.en: This course deals with management accounting and control both within a micro-behavioural and within an organisational theory perspective. The aim is to provide an understanding of the developments in management accounting and control theory and practice and the implications of critical variables that affect the design, development and operation of management accounting and control systems. Practical aspects of management accounting are mainly examined through computer assisted learning (CAL). Students are expected to cover the prescribed reading on their own, and to perceive the taught seminars as the opportunity to ask questions and to offer their views at any time.

description.zh: 本課程的目的是幫助學生在 21 世紀準備行銷業務並為之做出貢獻。無論是打算在企業、政府還是非營利組織工作，有效營銷的概念、策略和技術都是相關的。本課程是：從基本概念到與營銷相關，再到營銷在組織中的策略運用；儘早關注營銷的全球性。強調消費者營銷和企業營銷之間的相同點和不同點。將需求預測與其市場區隔、目標定位和市場定位相結合，在接觸消費者和商業市場以及市場區格之後，涵蓋市場營銷研究。在學生掌握市場營銷的含義後，整合規劃、實施和評估以提供眾向的行銷策略。
description.en:
The purpose of this course is try to help students prepare to operate in and contribute to the 21st century. Regardless of whether a person intends to work in a business, for the government, or in a nonprofit organization, the concepts, strategies, and techniques of effective marketing are relevant. This course is:
Providing from fundamental concepts through the major tasks associated with marketing to the strategic role of marketing in an organization.
Bringing early attention to the global nature of marketing.
Emphasizing the similarities as well as the differences between consumer and business marketing.
Combining demand forecasting with its logical antecedents-segmentation, targeting, and position.
Covering marketing research, after students have been exposed to consumer and business markets and segmentation.
Integrating planning, implementation, and evaluation to provide a broad strategic context after students have a grasp of what marketing entails.

The purpose of this course is try to help students prepare to operate in and contribute to the 21st century. Regardless of whether a person intends to work in a business, for the government, or in a nonprofit organization, the concepts, strategies, and techniques of effective marketing are relevant. This course is:

More-so, providing from fundamental concepts through the major tasks associated with marketing to the strategic role of marketing in an organization.
Bringing early attention to the global nature of marketing. Emphasizing the similarities as well as the differences between consumer and business marketing.

Combining demand forecasting with its logical antecedents-segmentation, targeting, and position.

The Learning objectives are as follows:
1.	To learn key content/context /concept about Marketing in theory and in real-world application. And understand the change of marketing concept and definition to adopt the idea that Marketing is the art and science combination, 
2.	This course will also entail the main types of marketers and markets, and how do they prospect into the marketplace. While in the marketplace, how the sellers and buyers are connected, and extend in target markets in a holistic approach.
3.	With corporate core value proposition, students will appropriate the key elements with course process to design a suggested proper Semester-Long marketing plan project. 
4.	Topics to pay attention: the Core Marketing Concepts, Marketing Environment , both inside and outside the organization, TPS, Brands and offering, Value and Satisfaction, Societal forces, Marketing Channel, Supply Chain, and other competition watch, which may affect the marketing result.

Notes to Students---Important information for weekly process:
work for weekly plan: 
1-Defining Marketing for the New Realities	Group formation and begin the process of selecting the product or service
2-	Developing Marketing Strategies and Plans	Formation of groups; first presentation of “product” to instructor for approval.
3	Gathering Information and Forecasting Demand	Competitive information and environmental scanning project(s) completed and presented for instructor’s review.
4	Conducting Marketing Research 	Initial marketing research parameters completed; demand forecasted, and target market selections defined.
5	Creating Customer Value, Satisfaction, and Loyalty	Students should have completed their value proposition for the fictional product, defined how they will deliver satisfaction, and maintain customer loyalty.
6	Analyzing Consumer Markets	Definitive data on the consumer for the product/service including all demographic and other pertinent information obtained and ready for instructor’s approval.
7	Analyzing Business Markets	No report due for this chapter; allows students and instructor to “catch up” on the project.
8	Identifying Market Segments and Targets	Specific market segmentation, targeting, and positioning statements by the students due.
9	Creating Brand Equity	Students are to have their “branding” strategy developed for their project. Include brand name, equity position, and the decisions in brand strategy.
10	Crafting the Brand Positioning	In the semester projects, student should be completed to include their fictional product or service’s brand positioning. students should have delineated and designed a differentiated brand positioning for their project.

description.en: Logistics management includes management planning for the efficient flow and storage of goods and related information from raw materials to consumers in accordance with customer needs. The aim of the course is to help the students understand how to perform logistics activities so as to make products and services available to customers at the time place, and in the condition and from desired in the most profitable or cost-effective way. The content of the course description: 1. Logistics management & Strategy 2. Transportation 3. Inventory maintenance 4. Order processing 5. Purchasing 6.Warehousing & packaging 7. Materials handling 8. Logistics costs 9. Logistics customer service 10. Productivity measurement. 11. Case study.

description.en: This course focuses on the fundamental and advanced aspects of management of start-up with theories, practices, industry analyses, and case studies. description.zh: 一個數據模式是可以用來解釋結構性資料在商業環境下所代表的意義，而數據模組的建立，則是現實世界知訊管理系統中的自然而然產生的普遍結果。上述共同構成了我們當今被稱為數據分析系統，此系統是一種管理工具，提供用於評估及製定決策。本課程旨在介紹基礎數據模組的工具和使用方法以及相關主題，並會包含與強調在商業上的應用，其重點在不確定性模組建立與評估，理解決策的本質，有效利用數據和有限的信息來模擬複雜系統以及優化分配資源。
description.en: A data model describes how structured data is represented in a business environment. Data modeling is a natural consequence of the prevalence of management information systems in the real world. Together they form what in our days has become known as a Data Analytics system that provides management tools to evaluate performance and make decisions. The course aims to introduce the fundamentals of data models tools and methods and related topics. Business applications of the topics covered will be highlighted. The emphasis will be on modeling and evaluating uncertainty, understanding the nature of decision-making, using data and limited information efficiently simulating complex systems, and optimally allocating resources.

syllabi.outline: This course is an introduction to statistical computing and will be taught in Python. Python is widely used not only in the engineering but also in natural science, medicine, biology, physics, and business. This course will introduce you to a vibrant and growing community of open source data analysts that is pushing the state of the art in data analysis and presentation. (Another benefit to you as students is that open source software is free!) This course’s main objective is to: learn how to take raw data, explore it, and present the results in a useful way. Thus, in this course, you will learn all of the basic skills needed to do each of these steps with the statistical language Python.

description.en: This course contains the medium access control layer(MAC) and physical layer(PHY) of the mose recent IEEE 802.11 standards for wireless local area networks. Thechniques employed by the standards, e.g.,craier sense multiple access/collision avoidance (CSMA/CA),orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDA), will be discussed in details.

description.en:
This course aims to guide students understanding cloud environments and IoT systems and their corresponding security requirements. In addition to introducing basic concepts of cloud environment and IoT system, the course contents will focus on OWASP's cloud security and IoT security. All practical techniques will be explained. Students are able to analyze various potential security threats in the cloud and Internet of Things environments, and to learn security protection capabilities for cloud and IoT systems. Course contents including:

●	Introduction to cloud technologies
●	Introduction to cloud security
●	Security standards for cloud services 
●	Introduction to IoT technologies
●	Potential threats of industrial IoT systems
●	Industrial Cyber Security introduction
●	IoT security detection
●	IoT security standards
●	Information security and privacy protection

syllabi.outline:
This course will introduce Google Cloud Computing related technologies and provide students with a comprehensive understanding of Google Cloud platform, architecture, services, and programming through the application of machine learning and IoT in railway systems. The course content includes: 1. Google cloud system architecture, storage network and virtualization technology, 2. Google cloud storage technology, 3. Google cloud scheduling technology, performance and security, 4. Google virtualized data center construction, 5. Google cloud services and enterprise applications, 6. Introduction to IoT technology 7. IoT standards and applications 8. Introduction to Industrial IoT network 9. IoT security and privacy protection 10. IoT internship courses and special projects. Therefore, before the midterm exam, we will mainly introduce the Google cloud system architecture. After the midterm exam, we will start to introduce the Internet of Things and its development trends. In the 11th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security issues and trends. In the 12th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security detection technology. In the 13th week, we will make a special topic at the end of the 14th week. In the 15th week, we will make a special topic at the end of the 16th week. In the 17th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security detection technology and practice. In the 18th week, we will make a special topic report at the end.

description.zh: 實現計算已從傳統地本地端機器獨立完成，進而委託上雲端等服務提供者協力完成。然而隨著資料或應用的授權，相關的計算安全性必須重新被探討。本課程將會從資料的隱密性出發，探討如何使用同態加密法輕鬆完成一個安全的授權計算，進而利用其他輕量化元件(混淆電路、私密分享)來取代同態加密並重新設計授權計算協定。接著會轉往定義資料的隱私性，並介紹k匿名等去識別化技術，最終帶入現今最嚴謹的差分隱私。透過上述之保有隱私與安全方法，將著名的人工智慧與機器學習演算法導入授權計算之中，重構不同情境的新型態安全計算框架。
description.en: The implementation of computation has been completed independently from the local machine, and then outsourced to the cloud (or some service providers) to complete it. However, with the delegation of data or applications, accordingly the security of such computation must be revisited. This course will start from the data confidentiality, discuss how to use homomorphic encryption to easily complete a secure outsourced computation, and then use other lightweight components (garbled circuit, secret sharing) to replace homomorphic encryption and redesign the secure protocols. Then it will move to define the privacy of data, introduce de-identification techniques such as k-anonymity, and finally bring the most rigorous notion of differential privacy. Through the above-mentioned methods of preserving privacy and security, artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms are introduced into the outsourced computation to reconstruct a new type of the framework for different scenarios.

description.zh: 資料科學是個跨領域的重要興新學科，其基本知識含括資訊、線性代數、機率與統計等，相關技術可應用在許多領域上，包含教育領域。本課程從學科整體介紹開始，討論資料科學中各主要階段的相關議題：包含資料搜尋擷取、資料整理與問題發想、數理知識回顧與討論、資料分析建模與方法、資料呈現與視覺化等。除課堂上講授與討論外，課程亦著重如何實際應用所學，將使用教育資料並以小組方式進行議題發想與分析實作的學期專題。此外，為強化健全資料視覺呈現課題，在實作專題中課程亦著重學生報告能力的培養，希望培育出全方位的資料科學人才。
description.en: Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce the valuable knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The topics include data processing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. The course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with fundamental related knowledge and the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation-collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The course training is toward equipping students with the mindset and the ability to solve problems with the learned techniques on educational data. In addition, students need to practice the presentation for the findings of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually.

Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce or create the valuable information and knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The related topics include data processing and computing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. This course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with the fundamental related knowledge as well as the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation- collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The training of this course is toward equipping students with the general mindset and the ability to solve problems practically with the learned techniques on educational data with project groups. In addition, the students also need to practice the presentation for the findings and results of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually. The major objective of this course is to cultivate talents in data science.

description.zh:
專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。本課程將從專利範圍解讀開始，熟悉專利的權利範圍，然後介紹專利策略以及佈局的方向，提供專利佈局與專利策略理論及實務經驗。本課程的綱要如下：
1.專利權利項解讀
2.專利侵權分析流程
3.專利迴避設計要件
4.專利策略分析
5.專利佈局實務
6.案例研究

syllabi.outline: 專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。因此本課程主要強調專利策略與專利布局分析在企業界的運用；值得強調的是，本課程內容完全與國考無關，係針對『專利技術分析』、『專利佈局』、『專利策略』與『科技管理』等主題作討論，故課程的設計會閱讀相關外文文獻，所以份量頗重，預期每星期均會花很多時間閱讀paper與課堂討論，所以較適合未來擬以相關主題作為論文研究方向之同學修習。

description.zh: 本課程主要以實務案例之解析為內容，並結合商標法理論剖析之教學方式，來深入介紹我國商標實務上之重要爭議，讓同學了解司法實務中，如何具體適用法律、判決或學說等。此外，本課程亦將分別介紹國外相關學說理論及著名司法案例，期望同學透過本課程之修習，來培養對國內外商標法案例思辨及評析之能力。
description.en: Primary contents of this course are focused on case analyses, and its teaching method is trademark legal theories analyses in order to further introduce significant disputes about Taiwan trademark practices. Thus, students could understand how to concretely apply laws, precedents, or theories to judicial practices. In addition, this course will also introduce relevant foreign theories and well-known judicial cases to develop students’ abilities of examining and analyzing domestic/foreign trademark cases when students take this course.

syllabi.outline:
商標法係為保障商標權及消費者利益，維護市場公平競爭，促進工商企業正常發展所制定之法律。商標得以文字、圖形、記號、顏色、聲音、 立體形狀或其聯合式所組成，並應足以使商品或服務之相關消費者認識其為表彰商品或服務之標識，藉以與他人之商品或服務相區別。凡因表 彰自己之商品或服務，欲取得商標權者，應依該法申請註冊。本課程將兼顧實例與理論進行探討，來深化同學對於商標法的瞭解。事實上，本課程之進行，20%以英文講授、80%以中文講授，而且課堂教材以中文案例為主。
Trademark Act is formulated to safeguard trademark rights and consumers' interest, maintain fair competitions of markets, and facilitate normal development of industries and commerce. A trademark may be composed of a word, design, symbol, color, sound, three-dimensional shape or a combination thereof. A trademark as defined above shall be distinctive enough for relevant consumers of the goods or services to recognize it as identification to those goods or services and to differentiate such goods or services from those offered by others. A person who wishes to obtain trademark rights in order to distinguish its goods or services shall apply for trademark registration as provided under this Act. The discussion in the course covers theory and examples to enhance a deeper understanding of Trademark Act for the students. In fact, the class lectures will be in English 20% and in Chinese 80%, and the class materials are cases in Chinese.

description.zh: 本課程下學期亦以智慧財產局頒布之「專利審查基準」為藍本，先介紹專利申請之特殊分割程序與改請程序，再就專利申請之「實體審查」部分依序說明先申請原則、發明單一性、優先權、說明書及圖式之補充與修正、更正、以及分割改請。
description.en: This course will be based on the "Patent Examination Guidelines" issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office, and introduces the special procedure for patent division application and patent conversion application according to the principle of "formality before substantive examination". Then, in the "substantive examination" section, topics such as the first-to-file rule, unity of invention, the priority of a patent application, amendments of description, claims and drawings,  division of a patent and conversion of a patent will be sequentially discussed.

description.en: In this course, we will focus on the practices of the patent application in   electrical engineering technology. In addition, the practical aspects of international patent application are presented. The patent filing and maintenance strategies will be also discussed in class.

name.en: The Theory and Practice of the Mind

description.zh: 「心靈的理論與實踐」(The Theory and Practice of the Mind)旨在對人的心理各個層面，從不同的角度進行探討。課程將以理論講授與實際操作交替進行:我們將借重當代學術研究成果，如腦神經科學、心理學、哲學、神經生物學、社會學等等，以增進我們對人自身重要議題的認識。這些議題至少包括:心靈(Mind)、心流(Mental Flow)、情緒(Emotion)、選擇(Choice)、決定(Decision)、感官(Sensations)、直覺(Intuition)、自我分析( Self-Analysis)、單純性(Simplicity)、潛意識(Subconscious)、創新(Novelty)、洞察力(Insight)與意志力 (Willpower)等等。若時間允許，我們將在課上播放相關的科學影片與電影。
description.en: The course investigates several key aspects of human mind from different angles.  To achieve the goal, we shall discuss current topics and issues on the following subjects: Neuroscience, Psychology, Philosophy, Neurobiology, Sociology, etc.  The lecturing shall proceed from reading texts to practicing subjects and methods.  And the topics and issues will include at least: Mind, Mental flow, Emotion, Choice, Decision, Sensations, Intuition, Self-Analysis, Simplicity, Subconscious, Novelty, Insight, and Willpower, etc.  We may watch some relevant scientific films and movies in the class if time allows.

description.zh: 本課程探究文化保存的各項議題，包含有形無形文化保存的真實性、文化價值的差異與認定、詮釋與再現；同時透過國內外文化保存的實踐案例的分析與討論，思考未來文化保存的多元發展可能性。
description.en: This course aims to understand the concept of cultural preservation, and the methods of doing cultural preservation by examining different case studies in the world. Different issues related to cultural preservation are also discussed in this course, include the value and authenticity of cultural heritage, the representation and interpretation of culture, and reuse and management of cultural spaces. A creative practice of cultural preservation will be conducted in this course.

name.en: Theory and Praxis in Moving Images

description.zh: 本課程是動態影像的進階課程，不以歷史性發展為課程目的，旨在探究各類影像涉及的感官經驗以及所屬的文化意義，包含藝術電影、紀錄片、實驗電影與數位影像等，進而說明以動態經驗為基礎的混合現象，其涉及的美學、文化、技術與當代性。閱讀文本涵蓋電影、媒體與視覺文化評論。
description.en: This advanced moving images course aims to exam sensory experiences and cultural significances of various cinematic forms from art cinema, documentaries, and experimental images to the digital turn of VR films and beyond. However, the goal of the course is not to be a historical survey but instead an investigation of this hybrid moment and its relationship to aesthetics, culture, technology, and modernity. Readings cover topics in film theory, media theory, and visual cultural critical theory.

name.en: Paper’s Fiber Culture and Its Application

description.zh: 透過認識紙質、纖維實驗與材質研發的單元設計貫穿、活化課程，也由此串聯課程理念。達到培育美學素養、認識材質特性、應用紙藝與纖維文化。學生可透過選修這門課，養成美學素養、材質特色認識、紙藝與纖維文化應用。課程為理論與實務之結合，包含 : 1. 文化藝術與自然科學知識之傳授。2. 創意設計實作。後者(2)可做為檢視學生對前者(1)的學習與吸收狀況。作業訓練達到二項目標 : 1. 加強產學合作，強化實務教學。2. 培育紙質與纖維創意設計人才。
description.en: With the help of curricular components of paper qualities, fiber experiments as well as R&D on raw materials, the course essentials can thus be unified and the theme vitalized. WE aim to provide the course with aesthetical principles, knowledge of the raw materials, applied paper craftsmanship and fiber civilization—which will be comprehensively instilled into the course so that the students who take the course will be equipped with a good command on them. The course is made up of both aesthetical theory and practice, including a) knowledge on culture, arts and natural science and b) innovative & creative practice, with the later utilized as criteria to evaluate to what extent the students are successfully trained. The assigned homework is set so as to: 1. Enforce cooperation between industry and academics and strengthen course materials into practice; 2. Train and discipline more design talents in paper qualities and innovation in fiber.

syllabi.outline:
為了讓技職教育回歸「務實致用」的根本，導入產業能量，強化產學合作與實務教學，提高實作與實驗課程，加強基礎學科能力與人文素養。「紙質文化與應用課群」以「紙質文化」為主軸，分支三項課程核心理念，整合產業資源與專業師資，共同規劃課程內容，培育紙質專才。

  本課程的核心理念為「材質特性」，以加強技職生，尤其是設計學院和人文社會學院修課學生之基礎學科能力，奠定技職學生專業能力為要點。並由纖維、紙漿與化學變化為始，探討造紙原料的差異，進而分辨紙質種類的差異與特性，再讓學生創意發想，設計紙質特性實驗。課程邀請臺灣植物纖維專家、化學專家、紙漿研發專家、故宮博物院紙質修復師和紙質研究專家、纖維工藝與長春棉紙廠等業界權威共同授課，以多方專業聚焦紙質與纖維的基礎學科能力，最終透過實作，讓學生以材質知識為基底，體驗纖維與紙藝的無限可能。

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。

description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

syllabi.outline: This course is designed to develop students' ability to critically analyze and evaluate ethical issues in contemporary business settings, with a strong emphasis on real-world case learning. Through the study of current and high-profile corporate cases (such as Theranos, Volkswagen, Amazon, and Starbucks), students will learn to identify ethical dilemmas, apply key ethical principles, and use structured decision-making frameworks to propose responsible solutions. Topics include integrity, transparency, fairness, accountability, labor rights, environmental responsibility, AI ethics, and corporate social responsibility. The course encourages students to consider multiple stakeholder perspectives and reflect on moral conflicts through case-based discussions and role-play. In addition, students will be guided to use AI tools responsibly for research and idea generation while upholding academic integrity and digital ethics. By the end of the course, students will have developed a practical understanding of ethical leadership and be able to apply ethical reasoning in both professional and civic contexts.

description.zh:
本課程將由個人資料保護原則開始對個人資料保護作全面性的介紹，並說明《個人資料保護法》與《個人資料保護法施行細則》如何與個資保護原則互相呼應，期使學生瞭解目前個人資料保護的管理議題與實務考量，並且說明可參考的標準與指引，以強化學生對於個人資料保護的基礎概念。
藉由《個人資料保護法》及《個人資料保護法施行細則》的介紹帶入ISO/IEC 29100的個資保護框架、隱私衝擊評鑑(PIA)，接下介紹ISO/IEC 27701個資保護實作指引等相關國際標準，本課程以實際的案例以及國際標準讓學生這對於個人資料保護有更進一步的概念與瞭解。
description.en: This course will begin with a comprehensive introduction to personal data protection principles and explain in detail the "Personal Data Protection Act" and the "Enforcement Rules of the Personal Data Protection Act". Student will learn managerial and practical considerations of personal data protection. Relevant standards and guidelines, such as ISO/IEC 29100, ISO/IEC 27701, will be discussed to strengthen students' understanding of fundamental concepts of personal information management systems (PIMS). In addition, the process of a privacy impact assessment (PIA) and its related standard ISO/IEC 29134 will also be introduced in this course. All in all, this course aims to give students a solid understanding of personal data protection through cases studies and international standards.

description.zh: 本課程介紹資金管理的理論與實務應用。如何判斷一個交易系統好壞，使其不斷產生利潤? 我們將從理論出發，套用在實務交易模擬上，包含單一策略、多商品、多市場、多策略的運用。本課程將以R語言搭配模擬。
description.en: This course introduces the theory and practice of money management. How to determine a trading system is good or bad, how to continues to generate profits in a trading system? We will start from the theory, applied to the simulation of real trading market, including single strategy, multi-commodities, multi-markets, multi-strategies. This course will be run with R language.

description.zh: 區塊鏈和數位資產是未來金融和科技領域的重要趨勢之一，本課程將介紹區塊鏈以及數位資產的基本知識與原理，並探討如何利用區塊鏈以及比特幣技術搭建新型態的金融基礎設施與永續的生態系統，內容包含 (1) 區塊鏈基礎；(2) 比特幣運作原理；(3) 穩定幣等數位資產；(4) 比特幣進階，含閃電網路、側鏈、智能合約層、永續挖礦…等；(5) 實體世界資產 (RWA，Real World Asset)；(6) 區塊鏈分析；(7) 法規與監管…等，為參與課程的學生建立正確的區塊鏈與數位資產的觀念。
description.en: Blockchain and Digital Asset are one of the important trends in the future of finance and technology. This course will introduce the basic knowledge and principles of blockchain and digital assets, as well as explore how to use blockchain and Bitcoin technology to build a new type of financial infrastructure and sustainable ecosystem, the content includes (1) Blockchain basics; (2) Bitcoin operating principles; (3) Digital assets such as stable coins; (4) Bitcoin advanced including Lightning Network, Rootstock, Stacks, sustainable mining...etc. (5) Real World Asset (RWA); (6) Blockchain analysis; (7) Regulations and supervision... etc., to establish a correct concept of blockchain and digital assets for students participating in the course.

syllabi.schedule:
第 1 堂：課程簡介
●	課程大綱：每周課程內容說明。
●	評分標準：學期成績計算說明。
●	雙聯學制：與新加坡南洋理工大學區塊鏈碩士學程合作說明。
第 2 堂：區塊鏈與金融科技概論
●	金融科技版圖：集中式帳本 vs 分散式帳本，在支付、清算、融資裡的痛點。
●	區塊鏈基本結構：區塊、鏈、節點、共識與去中心化的直覺。
●	公鏈、私鏈、聯盟鏈在金融機構裡可能扮演的角色。
第 3 堂：密碼學基礎與公私鑰機制
●	雜湊函數、非對稱加密、數位簽章的基本概念與用途。
●	公私鑰、地址與授權：一筆交易「為什麼」代表資產所有人同意。
●	助記詞、私鑰生成與備份的實務風險（釣魚、惡意錢包、社工等）。
第 4 堂：帳戶模型、UTXO 與錢包實務
●	帳戶模型 vs UTXO 模型：餘額計算邏輯與代表公鏈。
●	交易輸入輸出範例，了解「找零」與 trace 資金流。
●	熱／冷錢包、硬體錢包、單簽、多簽、MPC 錢包的基本概念與使用情境。
第 5 堂：比特幣設計與金融定位
●	比特幣的設計目標：點對點電子現金與「數位黃金」敘事。
●	區塊結構、PoW 共識、挖礦與安全性（51% 攻擊等）的直覺。
●	比特幣在支付、價值儲存上的優缺點，與法幣、黃金、支付網路的比較。
第 6 堂：以太坊與智能合約入門
●	以太坊帳本與 EVM：EOA／合約帳戶、Gas 與交易結構。
●	智能合約的概念、常見應用（ERC-20、簡單治理合約等）。
●	DApp 架構：前端、合約、節點／RPC 的分工。
第 7 堂：國定假日
第 8 堂：DeFi 與穩定幣
●	DeFi 的定位：從 CeFi 到 DeFi，基礎設施與技術堆疊。
●	AMM 與 DEX：流動性池、價格曲線、滑價與無常損失的直覺。
●	借貸協議：超額抵押、清算機制與利率形成。
●	穩定幣在 DeFi 中的角色：抵押物、交易媒介、風險傳染來源。
第 9 堂：外部講師＿金融機構區塊鏈與數位資產策略
講者：銀行/金控數位金融部門、虛擬資產合規長、交易所高管。

第 10 堂：DeFi 高階應用與代幣經濟
●	衍生品協議：槓桿、永續合約、結構化產品等基本機制。
●	收益聚合、流動性挖礦與「Money Legos」組合性概念。
●	代幣經濟學：治理代幣、激勵設計、常見失敗模式（龐氏、死亡螺旋）。
第 11 堂：支付、跨境匯款與實務案例
●	公鏈跨境匯款流程與成本結構，與 SWIFT／傳統 remittance 的對照。
●	商戶收單、薪資發放、供應鏈金融等鏈上支付案例。
●	銀行與金控如何實驗 tokenized deposits、鏈上結算或區塊鏈投資產品。
第 12 堂：區塊鏈／DeFi 安全、監管與未來趨勢
●	常見攻擊：閃電貸攻擊、價格預言機操縱、智能合約漏洞、橋接攻擊。
●	合規與監管：VASP、交易所與 DeFi 協議涉及的 KYC／AML、證券／商品認定等。
●	DAO 與治理、L2、RWA、ZK 等未來趨勢的簡介與職涯／研究方向。

第 13 堂：外部講師＿DeFi／Web3 創業與產品實務
講者：DeFi 協議團隊、Web3 錢包 / 基礎設施創辦人或 PM、資安研究員。

第 14 堂：穩定幣發展趨勢與金融業策略應對
●	穩定幣的定義與基本概念。
●	穩定幣的發展歷史。
●	穩定幣的種類與央行的數位貨幣。
●	穩定幣的應與未來展望。
●	金融產業的策略應對。

第 15 堂：RWA 代幣化實戰應用設計工作坊(上)
●	RWA先備知識。
●	生成式AI應用方式及技巧。
●	國際應用案例解析。

第 16 堂：RWA 代幣化實戰應用設計工作坊(下)
●	RWA代幣化設計五大面向。
●	分組設計任務。
●	分組簡報與評分。

第 17 堂：期末分組專題報告(上)
第 18 堂：期末分組專題報告(下)

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹人工智慧（AI）領域包含各種機器學習的開發與實作，特別關注如何使用Python進行模型的開發與部屬。課程將涵蓋深度學習的基本概念、常見的AI框架（如TensorFlow、Keras），並深入探討如何利用Python編程語言來設計、訓練與優化AI模型。此外，課程也將重點討論人工智慧在開發與部屬過程中需要考量的安全性問題，從資料安全與可稽核性，AI透明度，模型加密與攻擊防範等，提供學生一套全面的安全檢核框架。學生將學習如何確保AI系統在實際應用中具備高度的安全性與可靠性，並瞭解如何在AI部屬的不同階段識別與解決潛在的安全風險。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the development and implementation of various machine learning techniques in the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI), with a particular focus on how to use Python for model development and deployment. The course will cover the fundamental concepts of deep learning, popular AI frameworks (such as TensorFlow and Keras), and will delve into how to use the Python programming language to design, train, and optimize AI models. Additionally, the course will emphasize the security considerations necessary during the development and deployment of AI systems, including data security and auditability, AI transparency, model encryption, and attack prevention. Students will be provided with a comprehensive security framework to evaluate these concerns. They will also learn how to ensure the high security and reliability of AI systems in practical applications, and how to identify and mitigate potential security risks at various stages of AI deployment.
