description.zh: 本課程將介紹環境、社會和治理(ESG)投資的概念。ESG投資，也稱為永續投資，是一種將ESG因素與基本面分析結合起來進行投資決策的投資策略。首先，我將介紹一些投資的基本概念，例如績效衡量和因子模型分析。接下來，我將介紹ESG因子，並從學術研究和實務觀點討論ESG投資。此外，我將為您提供有關ESG投資的另類觀點。最後，本課程將關注全球暖化和氣候變遷議題，並提供修課同學環境教育的重要概念。
description.en: This course introduces the concepts of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) investing. ESG investing, also referred to as sustainable investing, represents an investment strategy that incorporates ESG factors alongside fundamental analysis in investment decision-making. Initially, I will introduce some essential concepts of investment, such as performance measurement and factor model analysis. Next, I will review ESG factors and discuss ESG investing from both academic and practical perspectives. Furthermore, I will provide you with alternative viewpoints on ESG investing. Finally, I will focus on the issues of global warming and climate change, which are critical components of environmental education.

syllabi.outline:
This course provides an introduction to the fundamental concepts underlying Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) investing. ESG investing, also known as sustainable investing, is an investment strategy that incorporates environmental, social, and governance factors alongside traditional financial analysis in the investment decision-making process. We will begin by exploring traditional investment concepts. We then discuss ESG factors and examine why they are essential to consider in today's investment landscape. In addition, we will discuss alternative viewpoints to ensure a balanced perspective on this important topic. The scope of this course extends beyond merely ESG investing. In the concluding section, we will pay more attention to the issues of global warming and climate change, which constitute critical components of environmental education. 

本課程介紹環境、社會和治理 (ESG) 投資的基本概念。 ESG投資，也稱為永續投資，是一種在投資決策過程中將環境、社會和治理因素與傳統財務分析相結合的投資策略。我們將首先探討傳統投資觀念。接著，我們將討論 ESG 因素，並研究為什麼它們在當今的投資環境中至關重要。此外，我們將討論替代觀點，以確保對這一重要主題的平衡觀點。本課程的範圍不僅限於 ESG 投資。在結論部分，我們將更加關注全球暖化和氣候變遷議題，這是環境教育的重要組成部分。

description.zh:
本課程結合設計思考與深度學習技術,專為金融領域應用而設計。學生將學習設計思考的五個核心步驟:同理心、問題定義、創意發想、原型設計和測試,並運用這些步驟解決金融實際問題。課程內容涵蓋數據收集與清洗、特徵工程、深度學習模型構建與訓練,及模型部署與應用。
學生將使用 Pandas、NumPy、Keras、TensorFlow 等工具,進行數據處理和模型開發,並通過PBL 項目進行實務操作,體驗跨域合作的過程。
課程特別強調實務應用,涵蓋信用風險評估、股票價格預測、信用卡欺詐檢測等金融案例。學生將參與多次業界專家分享和企業參訪,了解最新的行業動態和實務經驗。本課程致力於培養具備前瞻性思維、創新能力和實務操作能力的金融科技專業人才。
description.en:
This course combines design thinking and deep learning techniques tailored for financial applications. Students will explore the five key steps of design thinking: empathy, problem definition, ideation, prototyping, and testing. These steps will be applied to solve practical financial challenges.
The course content includes data collection and cleaning, feature engineering, deep learning model building, training, and deployment. Students will work with tools like Pandas, NumPy, Keras, and TensorFlow for data analysis and model development. The learning process is enriched through PBL (Project-Based Learning) projects, offering hands-on experience in interdisciplinary teamwork.
By integrating technical skills and innovative thinking, this course aims to develop forward-thinking financial technology professionals equipped with practical expertise.

syllabi.outline:
課程簡介
本課程旨在引導研究所學生系統性地掌握深度學習的核心理論與實務技能。課程從神經網路的數學基礎出發，逐步深入卷積神經網路（CNN）、循環神經網路（RNN）、Transformer、生成對抗網路（GAN）及深度強化學習等主流架構，並透過金融領域的真實案例，培養學生解決實際問題的能力。

課程學習目標
修習本課程後，學生將能夠：

1	理解深度學習的數學基礎：掌握機率統計概念。
2	深入理解核心模型架構：包括 CNN、RNN、LSTM、Transformer、GAN 等模型的原理與適用場景。
3	具備模型訓練與調校能力：熟悉損失函數、優化器、正則化技術，並能診斷與解決過擬合等常見問題。
4	應用深度學習解決真實問題：能針對金融風控、時間序列預測、自然語言處理等領域，設計並實作深度學習解決方案。
5	完成專案開發與佈署：從問題定義、資料處理、模型訓練到部署，具備完整的專案執行能力。
syllabi.schedule:
第一部分：基礎建構
Week 1: 2/27放假
Week 2: 3/6 深度學習導論與開發環境	
- 理解深度學習的發展脈絡與應用領域；
- 建置 Python 開發環境（Colab/VS Code）	
- 深度學習 vs. 機器學習、監督式/非監督式/強化學習、神經網路發展史

Week 3: 3/13 數據處理與特徵工程	(作業1)
- 執行資料前處理、特徵工程與探索性資料分析（EDA）	
- 特徵標準化、缺失值處理、One-hot Encoding
- 資料不平衡處理（SMOTE、Class Weight）
-KDD 流程

Week 4: 3/20 神經網路基礎	 (作業2)
- 理解神經網路的運作原理，並能手動推導反向傳播	
- 感知器（Perceptron）、多層感知機（MLP）、
- 啟動函數（ReLU、Sigmoid、Tanh）、前向傳播、反向傳播演算法

Week 5: 3/27 模型訓練與優化	(作業3)
- 選擇適當的損失函數與優化器，並診斷訓練問題	
- 損失函數（交叉熵、MSE）、梯度下降（SGD）、Adam 優化器
- 學習率調整、過擬合與正則化（Dropout、Early Stopping、L1/L2）

第二部分：核心深度學習模型
Week 6: 4/3 放假

Week 7: 4/10 卷積神經網路（CNN）原理 	(作業4)
- 理解 CNN 如何提取影像特徵，並實作影像分類任務
- 卷積運算（Kernel、Stride、Padding）、池化層（Max/Average Pooling）
-特徵圖（Feature Map）、參數共享、平移不變性、Batch Normalization

Week 8: 4/17  CNN 進階架構與遷移學習 (作業5)
- 分析經典 CNN 架構的設計理念，並應用遷移學習 
-VGG、ResNet（殘差連接、Skip Connection）、梯度消失問題
- 遷移學習（Transfer Learning）、Fine-tuning
-資料增強（Data Augmentation）

Week 9: 4/24  循環神經網路（RNN）與序列模型	(作業6)
- 理解序列資料的建模方式，並實作時間序列預測	序列建模
- RNN 記憶機制、梯度消失/爆炸問題
-LSTM（遺忘門、輸入門、輸出門）
- GRU、時間序列預測

Week 10: 5/1 勞動節放假

Week 11: 5/8 注意力機制與 Transformer (作業7)	
- 理解 Self-Attention 機制與 Transformer 架構
-注意力機制（Attention）、Self-Attention、Multi-Head Attention
-位置編碼（Positional Encoding）、Transformer（Encoder-Decoder）
-Word Embeddings

Week 12: 5/15 生成對抗網路（GAN）	(作業8)
- 理解 GAN 的對抗訓練機制，並實作影像生成	
- 生成器（Generator）、判別器（Discriminator）
- 對抗訓練（Adversarial Training）、Min-Max Game、Mode Collapse、DCGAN

Week 13: 5/22 深度強化學習導論 (作業9)
- 理解強化學習的基本框架與深度強化學習方法
- 強化學習三要素（Agent、Environment、Reward）
-馬可夫決策過程（MDP）、Q-Learning、Deep Q-Network（DQN）
- Policy Gradient

第三部分：專題實作
Week 14: 5/29 專題提案與規劃 (Project 10%)
- 定義問題、選擇適當模型架構、規劃專案時程	
- 問題定義、技術選型、資料集評估、基準模型（Baseline）
Week 15: 6/5  模型優化與評估	
- 執行超參數調校，並使用多元指標評估模型效能	
- 超參數調校（Hyperparameter Tuning）、Grid Search、Random Search
-模型評估指標（Accuracy、Precision、Recall、F1-Score、AUC-ROC、Confusion Matrix）
Week 16: 6/12 期末專案發表	 (Project 20%)
- 展示專案成果、接受評審提問、反思學習歷程	
-技術簡報、成果展示、同儕互評、學習歷程反思

Week 17: 6/19 端午節放假
Week 18: 6/26 演講(線上)

description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度，切入虛擬實境產業的各種可能性。從教育應用、設計工具以及虛擬實境遊戲設計、虛擬實境互動式動畫製作等，進行探討。
description.en: The main objective of the program is taking from the application and design perspective, cutting into the possibilities of the virtual reality industry. Exploring from the educational applications, design tools and virtual reality games, to virtual reality interactive animation, etc.

syllabi.outline:
Virtual reality (VR) is a fusion of art and technology, widely applied across various fields, including transportation simulators (driver training), BIM-integrated applications (building maintenance training), immersive gaming (next-generation sports, rehabilitation), immersive storytelling (film, animation), factory simulation, museums, and product previews. This course on VR applications focuses on the impact of VR on future technology and daily life, while also exploring the interplay between immersion, imagination, interaction, and human cognitive perception. The course covers the concepts, principles, and implementation methods of VR/AR and interactive haptic technologies, including an introduction to computer vision techniques, to help students understand sensory perception and interaction mechanisms in virtual environments. To enhance practical VR applications, students will be guided in developing innovative and practical multimedia human-computer interaction systems, exploring and evaluating immersive interaction models. Through a combination of theoretical instruction and hands-on practice, this course aims to equip students with core VR/AR technologies, fostering innovation, cross-disciplinary integration, and creative applications, enabling them to contribute to the future development and advancement of immersive technology.

虛擬實境是一種藝術與科技的整合，廣泛運用在不同屬性的領域，如交通模擬器(司機員訓練)、BIM整合應用(建築養護訓練)、沈浸式遊戲(新型態科技運動、復健)、沈浸式敘事(電影、動畫)、工廠模擬、博物館、成品預覽等。本虛擬實境應用之課程內容，將專注於虛擬實境應用對於未來科技、生活等不同層面的影響，同時探討沈浸、想像、互動與人類心理認知的相互關係。課程內容涵蓋VR/AR 及其互動體感技術的概念、原理與實現方法(電腦視覺技術簡介)，幫助學生理解虛擬環境中的感知與互動機制。為強化 VR 技術的實務應用，本課程將帶領學生開發創新且實用的多媒體人機互動系統，探索與評估沉浸式的操作模式。透過理論講解與實作練習，本課程將培養學生掌握 VR/AR 核心技術，並培育其創新應用與跨領域整合能力，使其在未來科技發展中發揮創造力與影響力。

syllabi.outline:
This course explores the intersection of service design thinking and advanced technology through the rigorous lens of case study analysis. Students will move beyond surface-level observation to deconstruct complex service ecosystems. The curriculum focuses on how emerging technologies—specifically AI, VR, and advanced HCI—are reshaping services in critical sectors such as elderly healthcare, smart living, and education. By the end of the course, students will possess the analytical tools to evaluate existing services and the creative framework to propose innovative, human-centered service solutions.
By the completion of this course, students will be able to:
1. Master Case Study Methodology: Apply rigorous qualitative and quantitative methods to dissect service models, identifying core value propositions and operational flows.
2. Apply Service Design Principles: Utilize tools such as service blueprints, stakeholder maps, and customer journey maps to visualize and improve service experiences.
3. Critically Evaluate Technology: Assess the ethical, practical, and experiential impact of AI, VR, and IoT in real-world service scenarios.
4. Innovate: Synthesize analysis and theory to propose a redesign or a completely new service model for a complex societal challenge.
syllabi.schedule:
Phase I. Principles of Case Study Analysis
1, Methodology: Introduction to Robert K. Yin’s and Stake’s approaches to case study research.
2. Data Triangulation: Combining interviews, observations, and artifact analysis.
3. Deconstruction: How to reverse-engineer a service to understand its backend logic and frontend experience.

Phase II. Service Design Principles
1. The 5 Principles of Service Design: User-centered, Co-creative, Sequencing, Evidencing, and Holistic.
2. Systemic Thinking: Understanding services as living ecosystems rather than static products.
3. Touchpoint Orchestration: Aligning digital and physical interactions.

Phase III. Advanced Application Domains (Thematic Deep Dives)
1. AI in Elderly Healthcare: Predictive monitoring, companion robots, and ethical data usage.
2. Smart Living: Ambient intelligence, IoT ecosystems, and seamless home automation.
3. HCI & VR: Immersive training, therapeutic VR, and novel interaction modalities.
4. Education: Personalized AI tutors, gamified learning platforms, and hybrid classrooms.

syllabi.materials:
1. Case Study Methodology

Essential Book: Yin, Robert K. (2018). Case Study Research and Applications: Design and Methods (6th Edition). SAGE Publications.

Why: The gold standard for case study research. Focus on Chapter 2 (Designing Case Studies) for the distinction between single vs. multiple-case designs.

Academic Paper: Flyvbjerg, B. (2006). "Five Misunderstandings About Case-Study Research." Qualitative Inquiry, 12(2), 219-245.

Why: Critical for postgraduate students to defend the validity of qualitative case studies against quantitative criticism.

2. Service Design Principles

Essential Book: Stickdorn, M., et al. (2018). This Is Service Design Doing: Applying Service Design Thinking in the Real World. O'Reilly Media.

Why: It provides the practical "How-to" for Blueprints and Journey Maps.

Framework: The Double Diamond Design Process (Design Council UK).

Why: A standard industry framework to help students structure their innovation projects (Discover, Define, Develop, Deliver).

II. Thematic Deep Dives (Weeks 5-9)
Topic 1: AI in Elderly Healthcare
Academic Readings:

Paper: Khadraoui, et al. (2025). "Exploring Older Adults' Perspectives and Acceptance of AI-Driven Health Technologies: Qualitative Study." JMIR Aging.

Key Concept: Analyzing the "resistance" factor—why elderly users reject technically superior solutions due to lack of trust or human touch.

Paper: Moyle, W., et al. "Socially Assistive Robots for People with Dementia: A Systematic Review."

Key Concept: Ethical considerations of "deception" in care (e.g., is it ethical for a patient to believe a robot loves them?).

Real-World Case Examples:

Case A: Paro the Therapeutic Seal

Service Model: Non-pharmacological therapy.

Analysis Point: How a "low-tech" looking AI (zoomorphic design) bypasses the uncanny valley to provide emotional support.

Case B: StoriiCare (Care Management Software)

Service Model: B2B platform for care homes that connects staff, families, and residents.

Analysis Point: How AI aids "invisible care" (backend logic) by predicting falls or health declines before they happen, changing the service flow from reactive to proactive.

Topic 2: Smart Living & IoT
Academic Readings:

Paper: Harper, R. "The Connected Home: The Future of Domestic Life." (Reviewing how "smart" homes often fail due to social friction rather than technical failure).

Paper: Strengers, Y. "Smart Energy Technologies in Everyday Life."

Real-World Case Examples:

Case A: Songdo International Business District (South Korea)

Service Model: Ubiquitous City (U-City).

Analysis Point: A macro-level service design case. Analyze the friction between "efficient data collection" (waste disposal, traffic) and "lived human experience" (privacy, community feeling).

Case B: Amazon Sidewalk / Ring Ecosystem

Service Model: Neighborhood-as-a-Service.

Analysis Point: How individual product purchases (doorbells) transform into a community surveillance service, and the ethical design implications of "opt-out" models.

Topic 3: Advanced Human-Computer Interaction (HCI)
Academic Readings:

Paper: Ishii, H., & Ullmer, B. "Tangible Bits: Towards Seamless Interfaces between People, Bits and Atoms."

Key Concept: Moving UI beyond the screen—critical for designing services for the elderly or visually impaired.

Paper: Amershi, S., et al. "Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction." (Microsoft Research).

Key Concept: The specific 18 guidelines for designing services where AI is a partner, not just a tool.

Real-World Case Examples:

Case A: Google Project Jacquard (Levi's Commuter Trucker Jacket)

Service Model: Wearable ambient computing.

syllabi.outline:
This course is a continuation of a specialized research project, aimed at exploring topics related to interactive design, interactive media, and interactive art. The focus is on literature review, paper discussions, and case studies. Through intensive discussions, written reports, and the research and implementation of design projects, students can efficiently exchange ideas, gain deeper and broader experiences, and develop skills in research, analysis, and implementation.

The course integrates students from various fields, including electronics, mechatronics, humanities, design, and the arts, to cultivate professionals in interactive media design. Another primary learning objective of this course is to create a multidisciplinary learning environment. Following a project-oriented learning model, graduate students with expertise in design, art, information technology, and mechatronics can form teams to collaboratively conduct research on interactive media design projects or engage in case studies and creative projects in interactive media design.

The teaching methodology focuses on lectures, paper discussions and presentations, as well as project implementation. Assessment is based on reports, group discussions and presentations, and the practical implementation of projects.

name.en: Mission and System Design, Verification and Validation

description.zh: 本課程專注於太空系統設計、驗證和確認的基本概念與技術。本課程涵蓋了任務要求、系統架構、系統貿易研究、設計優化以及驗證和確認方法等主題。學生將學習如何設計符合特定任務要求的太空系統，同時確保系統具有可靠、安全和高效的特性。本課程還將向學生介紹各種驗證和確認性能的技術，包括模擬、測試和分析。
description.en: Mission and System Design, Verification and Validation is a course that focuses on the fundamental concepts and techniques used in the design, verification, and validation of aerospace systems. This course covers topics such as mission requirements, system architectures, system trade studies, design optimization, and verification and validation methods. Students will learn how to design aerospace systems that meet specific mission requirements while also ensuring the system is reliable, safe, and efficient. The course will also introduce students to various techniques for verifying and validating the performance of aerospace systems, including simulation, testing, and analysis. By the end of this course, students will have a deep understanding of the process of designing, verifying, and validating aerospace systems.

syllabi.outline:
本課程專注於航太系統設計、驗證和確認的核心概念與進階技術。課程內容涵蓋任務需求分析、系統架構設計、系統貿易研究、設計優化，以及驗證與確認的理論和實踐方法。學生將學習如何設計滿足特定任務需求的航太系統，並確保系統在可靠性、安全性和效能方面表現卓越。本課程還將深入介紹多種驗證與確認技術，包括模擬、測試、數據分析及建模工具。通過理論與實踐相結合，學生將全面掌握航太系統設計、驗證與確認的完整流程，為未來實際工程應用奠定堅實基礎。

This course focuses on the core concepts and advanced techniques involved in the design, verification, and validation of aerospace systems. Topics include mission requirements analysis, system architecture design, system trade studies, design optimization, and the theoretical and practical aspects of verification and validation. Students will learn to design aerospace systems that meet specific mission requirements while ensuring exceptional reliability, safety, and performance. The course also delves into various techniques for verifying and validating aerospace system performance, such as simulation, testing, data analysis, and modeling tools. Combining theory with hands-on practice, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end process of aerospace system design, verification, and validation, preparing them for real-world engineering challenges.

description.zh: 複雜系統專案管理是一種專門用於複雜項目的管理技巧。它使用分項管理方法，來預測和了解不斷變化的應用環境，確保複雜的工程項目的品質和成本，以及確保計劃準時完成。它由深入的規劃、品質管理、問題解決、進度及準確的檢測和調整所組成，並從團隊中運用整合協調和溝通管理，確保具備競爭優勢的項目順利達成。課程中包含，複雜系統專案概念，管理能力、架構、流程、方法等。
description.en: Project management of complex systems is a management technique specifically designed for complex projects. It uses an itemized management approach to predict and understand the different application environments, ensure the quality and cost of complex projects, and ensure that programs are completed on time. This course includes complex systems project concepts, management capabilities, structures, processes, and methodologies.

description.zh:
本課程屬於影像處理的進階課程，以遙測影像為主軸，聚焦於多光譜和高光譜影像分析與處理，並將涵蓋一般日常使用的彩色影像（多光譜影像的一種），分析各自不同的差異以及所需的影像處理技術。
課程內容將涵蓋多光譜和高光譜影像的基礎、各種影像於分析時所面臨的挑戰以及所需的影像處理技術，包括線性分解、資料降維與升維、光譜與空間上的特徵萃取、機器與深度學習演算法。 
選修本課程的學生需要具備基礎的信號處理、機率、線性代數和影像處理方面的背景。
description.en: This is an advanced course on image processing. The main focus of this course is the analysis and processing of multispectral and hyperspectral images. It will cover the general color images as a type of multispectral image based on remote sensing for analysis of their differences and corresponding image processing techniques. The scope of this course includes fundamentals of multispectral and hyperspectral imagery, challenges in image analysis, and corresponding image processing techniques, such as linear unmixing, dimensionality reduction, spectral and spatial feature extraction, and machine/deep learning algorithms. Students are expected to have a basic background in signal processing, probability, linear algebra, and image processing prior to taking this course.

syllabi.outline:
當高解析度的數位微波影像以成趨勢後，下一世代各國之間在遙測影像的競爭上已經不再局限於光學影像中。然而無論是光學或微波影像，都是以傳統的影像處理為基礎，然後再根據彼此間的數位訊號間的差異，而有不一樣的處理方法。在國際上，越來越多實務上的應用不再只局限於傳統的數位光學影像。利用更多輔助的數位影像資料，例如數位微波影像，能獲取更高效能、更高精度的結果。本課程會以數位微波影像發展趨勢與應用介紹起，並說明影像的特性、訊號模型與處理方法，並搭配實務上的操作，達到理論與實務兼具的目的。

When high resolution digital microwave image becomes the trend, the competition of remote sensing image among countries in the next generation is no longer limited to optical image. However, both optical and microwave images are based on the traditional image processing, and then have different processing methods according to the difference between digital signals. Internationally, more and more practical applications are no longer limited to traditional digital optical imaging. The use of more complementary digital image data, such as digital microwave images, can lead to more efficient and accurate results. This course will introduce the trends and applications of digital microwave imaging, explain the characteristics of the image, signal model and processing methods, and provide practical operation to achieve both theoretical and practical purposes.

description.zh: 太空工程實務專題課程旨在讓學生瞭解和掌握太空工程領域的實踐技能和實務知識，以及培養學生的團隊協作、問題解決和創新思維能力。學生將進行一個實際的太空工程設計項目，通過實踐瞭解太空工程的設計、測試、實施和管理流程，並透過報告、演示和評審等形式展示項目成果。通過此課程的學習，學生可以瞭解太空工程領域的最新發展，掌握相關的技能和知識，並提升團隊合作和項目管理能力。本課程可同時藉由產學合作設計進行實際演練。
description.en: The aim of the Space Engineering Practical Project course is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

description.en: This course discusses the design of transceivers for satellite communication systems and introduces the flow of data sent and received in communications between satellites and earth stations. Topics covered in the course include communication protocols, channel coding algorithms, modulation technology, multi-antenna design, software-defined radio technology, and the implementation of communication modem. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the techniques of satellite communication transceiver design and learn to implement communication modems using software-defined radios.

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在探討太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，與太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的專題演講與小組討論，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The aim of the Space Science & Technology Seminar is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

syllabi.outline:
太空科技應用課程旨在介紹太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，並探討太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的介紹，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
The Space Technology Application Course aims to introduce the application of space technology in various fields, and explore how space technology impacts human life and scientific research. The course covers topics including space exploration, Earth observation, communication and satellite navigation, space engineering and materials science, space biology and medicine, and space economy and business. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the application of space technology in various fields and future development directions, and be able to master relevant technologies and knowledge.

description.zh: 本課程目的為深入研究非地面通訊網路（NTN）的相關技術和應用。課程將首先介紹NTN的基本概念，包括其定義、特點以及在通訊領域中的角色。接著，將深入研究NTN網路的架構和應用，使學生了解NTN在不同場景中的實際應用情境。課程亦將探討3GPP對NTN網路的規劃和進展，使學生瞭解NTN在國際通訊標準中的地位與發展趨勢。此外，課程還將介紹不同類型的NTN，包括各種型態的應用範疇和特點。而隨著5G的發展，課程也將討論NTN在B5G/6G系統中的應用和相關標準化。學生將了解NTN如何融入未來通訊網路的發展趨勢，以應對更高效、更智能的通訊需求。最後，課程將深入討論NTN的重要議題，包括安全性、效能優化和未來發展方向等方面。透過課程，學生將獲得對NTN技術全面且深入的理解，並具備應用和解決相關議題的能力。
description.en: This course explores the technologies and applications of Non-Terrestrial Communication Networks (NTN). Starting with the basics, it introduces NTN's definition, characteristics, and role in communication. This course then investigates NTN network architecture and applications, offering practical insights. The course also covers 3GPP's planning for NTN networks, understanding NTN's global position and development trends. Different NTN types and their characteristics are introduced, along with discussions on NTN's applications in B5G/6G systems within the context of 5G development. The course concludes with an in-depth discussion on key NTN issues, including security, performance optimization, and future directions. Students will gain a comprehensive understanding of NTN technology and the capability to address relevant issues.

description.zh: 本課程介紹系統分析的基本概念與方法，以及如何從一個系統的角度來看待和設計複雜的資訊系統，從而提高系統的效率和效益。內容包含：系統分析、系統設計、系統建置、系統運轉、系統評鑑等之實施方式及步驟。學生需要學習使用一些專業工具，如統一塑模語言、資料流圖、結構化程式設計。
description.en: This course introduces the basic concepts and methods of system analysis, as well as how to approach and design complex information systems from a systemic perspective, in order to improve system efficiency and effectiveness. The content includes implementation methods and steps such as system analysis, system design, system construction, system operation, and system evaluation. Students are required to learn to use some professional tools such as Unified Modeling Language (UML), data flow diagrams, and structured programming.

4. Computational Complexity

Most examples taught in this class are based on the TensorFlow framework. We will cover many different fields including image classification, object detection, natural language processing, reinforcement learning and generative adversarial networks.

description.zh: 「鐵道車輛系統與維修基地」課程，乃為培養具有鐵路車輛分析設計及檢修技術操作能力之人員，掌握鐵道裝備設計製造、檢修的基礎知識與應用能力，具有鐵道車輛製造、檢修、運用、管理等綜合職業能力和創新精神的高素質技能型專門人才。本課程將從鐵道車輛基本結構開始介紹，並探討鐵道車輛與鐵道基礎之互制關係。而後導入各式特殊鐵道車輛設計之原理與用途，如：高速客車、傾斜式列車、自導向系統….等，並研討各種車型之行駛穩定性與脫軌風險計算方式。最後介紹鐵道車輛維修之概念與實務，並介紹維修基地之設計與配置，再導入先進預兆健康預防檢修法與AR技術於檢修之應用與發展。
description.en: This course of "Railway Vehicle System and Maintenance Depot" will cover the basic design criteria of the railway vehicle, its sub-systems and integration. We will discuss factors that affect the design, sizing, manufacturing and maintenance of the sub-systems of the railway vehicle, including their integration with other sub-systems to work as one complete train. Various factors affecting reliability, accessibility and maintainability will be addressed. Then several types of vehicle (high-speed-vehicle, tilting train, self-guide bogie will be introduced to determine the dynamic stability and derailment risk. Finally, the design of maintenance depot will be studied and the latest technologies (PHM, AR) on railway vehicle maintenance will be introduced.

syllabi.outline:
「鐵道車輛系統與維修基地」課程，本課程包括:世界各國高鐵的發展與其關鍵，台灣為何需要高鐵；高鐵的核心系統包括:列車，電力，架空線，集電弓，號誌及通訊系統；列車的特徵，要求及類型；列車的結構包括:車身，轉向架及煞車系統；列車的安全及所發生的事故，列車上的便利設施；列車的動力系統及馬達；高鐵的電力系統及變壓器；架空線及集電弓系統；歐美及日本的列車耐撞性規範；號誌及列車控制系統。台灣高鐵的事件自動通報系統，工程車路徑輔助系統；PLC替代繼電器專案計畫；通訊系統，地震預警系統及災害告警系統；高鐵車站所扮演的角色及車站空間需求設計；未來的磁浮高鐵系統及超導體技術之運用:高鐵維修機廠之布置及台灣高鐵工程及技術移轉之沿革；軌道經驗與分享。
This course includes: the development of high-speed rail (HSR) in various countries and its key factors, and why Taiwan needs high-speed rail; the core systems of high-speed rail, including: trains, power, overhead catenary, pantographs, signaling, and communication systems; the characteristics, requirements, and types of trains; the structure of trains, including: car body, bogies, and braking systems; train safety and accidents that occur, and the amenities on board; train power systems and motors; high-speed rail power systems and transformers; overhead catenary and pantograph systems; train crashworthiness regulations in Europe, America, and Japan; signaling and train control systems, Taiwan high-speed rail event automatic reporting system, and the work train route auxiliary system; the PLC replacement of relay project; communication systems, earthquake early warning systems, and disaster warning systems; the role of high-speed rail stations and station space requirement design; future magnetic levitation high-speed rail systems and the application of superconducting technology; the layout of high-speed rail maintenance depots, and the history of Taiwan high-speed rail engineering and technology transfer; railway experience and sharing.

description.zh: 本課程是研究所程度進階的巨量資料探勘與應用課程，主要介紹巨量資料探勘概念和原理、分散式計算基本架構、及各種應用包括: Link Analysis、Social Network Graph Mining、推薦系統等, 並且將介紹在處理巨量資料時常用的機器學習方法, 如: 類神經網路、SVM等，除了觀念的介紹外，透過平行化程式設計的練習以及期末專題，能讓學生認識實際巨量資料探勘的程式設計以及機器學習等工具的應用方式。
description.en: This course introduces the concepts in big data mining and advanced applications in machine learning. Topics include big data concepts, distributed computing infrastructure, and machine learning methods commonly used in processing big data, such as neural networks, support vector machines. In addition to concept introduction, parallel programming exercises and term projects are included to help students understand the processing steps and practical tools in big data anlaytics.

syllabi.outline:
本課程是研究所程度的進階課程，聚焦於巨量資料探勘與應用，涵蓋資料探勘理論及發展趨勢、技術與其在人工智慧及大數據領域中的創新應用。課程主要內容包括：資料科學的核心基礎(如資料倉儲與線上分析處理)、資料清理與前處理技術、頻繁樣式與關聯性分析、分類方法、群集分析及離群值偵測，並探討資料探勘中的前沿議題(如暗資料)。

本課程也將會深入介紹機器學習中常用的方法原理及分散式計算的基本架構，幫助學生掌握巨量資料處理技術。為加深學生的實作能力，課程安排了Python程式練習，結合資料科學模組（如NumPy、Pandas、Scikit-learn）進行資料探勘應用程式開發，並透過期中報告與期末專題的形式，培養學生分析資料、解決問題及團隊合作的能力。

透過本課程，預期同學將能夠學習到：
    1. 理解巨量資料探勘的基本概念、技術與應用場景(如鐵道系統應用)。
    2. 掌握資料清理、前處理、模型建立與評估等關鍵技能。
    3. 使用Python與相關工具進行資料分析與應用開發。
    4. 探索資料探勘在大數據與AI創新中的潛在發展方向，並培養研究與實踐能力。

This advanced graduate-level course focuses on big data mining and its applications, covering theories and developmental trends, as well as techniques and novel applications in the artificial intelligence and big data domains. The course covers fundamental topics like core foundations of data science (e.g., data warehousing and online analytical processing), data cleaning and preprocessing techniques, frequent patterns and association analysis, classification methods, cluster analysis, and anomaly detection. The course also covers cutting-edge topics in data mining, such as dark data.

This course also delves deeply into the principles of commonly used machine learning methods and the fundamental architecture of distributed computing, providing students with critical skills for handling big data. To improve hands-on skills, the course includes Python programming exercises that incorporate data science modules (such as NumPy, Pandas, and Scikit-learn) for developing data mining applications. Mid-term reports and final course projects will encourage students to analyze data, solve problems, and develop teamwork skills.

By finishing this course, students are expected to:
    1) Understand the fundamental concepts, techniques, and use cases for big data mining (e.g., railway system applications).
    2) Develop critical skills in data cleaning, preprocessing, model building, and evaluation.
    3) Use Python and related tools for data analysis and application development.
    4) Investigate potential developments in data mining for big data and AI innovations, while also developing research and practical skills.

description.zh: 當代都市議題經常為跨領域、開放性的複雜問題，在資料蒐集與分析上，需要整合地理空間、時間的維度；在分析與對策上，須平衡公部門、私部門、民眾等多重利害關係者的，是一門相當複雜但重要的學問。本課程從真實的都市議題出發，教導學生掌握地理空間資訊、資料分析、資料建模、資訊視覺化、策略論述等綜合能力，培養學生對於都市複雜議題的觀察與剖析，進而對真實環境提出洞見與創意。
description.en: Contemporary urban issues are complex, requiring the integration of geographical, and temporal dimensions in data collection and analysis. Balancing the interests of stakeholders like the public, and private sectors is crucial. This course focuses on real urban issues, teaching skills in geographical information, data analysis, modeling, visualization, and strategic discourse. It aims to cultivate students' ability to observe, analyze urban issues, and propose insights for real environments. It's an advanced course, requiring basic programming and GIS concepts. Through group projects, students learn API usage, geographic computation, model building, and data visualization. The course includes one midterm report and one final project report.

課程大綱： 

當代都市議題經常為跨領域、開放性的複雜問題，在資料蒐集與分析上，需要整合地理空間、時間的維度；在分析與對策上，須平衡公部門、私部門、民眾等多重利害關係者的，是一門相當複雜但重要的學問。本課程從真實的都市議題出發，教導學生掌握地理空間資訊、資料分析、資料建模、資訊視覺化、策略論述等綜合能力，培養學生對於都市複雜議題的觀察與剖析，進而對真實環境提出洞見與創意。 

 

本課程為進階課程，具備程式語言基礎、地理資訊系統概念為佳。透過分組操作實際都市議題，學習各類API使用、地理運算、模型選擇、模型建立、模型解讀、資料視覺化等應用。包含一次期中報告，與一次期末成果報告。

Balancing the interests of stakeholders like the public, private sectors is crucial. Through group projects, students learn API usage, geographic computation, model building, and data visualization. The course includes one midterm report and one final project report.

description.zh: 數理邏輯是理論計算機科學各領域重要的基礎。在本課程中，重點關注於數理邏輯在軟體程式驗證與機器可檢驗之證明等的應用。透過各種如SAT/SMT求解器與輔助證明工具Coq等，本課程將涵蓋以下主題：比例邏輯、一階邏輯、可滿足性模組理論、模型檢查與程式驗證。
description.en: Mathematical logic is an important foundation of various fields in theoretical computer science. This course focuses on its applications from software/program verification to machine-checkable proofs. Through various tools like SAT/SMT solvers and proof-assistant Coq, this course will cover the following topics: proportional logic, first-order logic, satisfiability module theory, model checking and program verification.

This course focuses on its applications from software/program verification to machine-checkable proofs. Through various tools like SAT/SMT solvers and proof-assistant Coq, this course will cover the following topics: proportional logic, first-order logic, satisfiability module theory, model checking and program verification.
syllabi.schedule:
The tentative schedule will cover

1) Program logics: reasoning principles for high-assurance software (9-10 weeks)
- the birth of program logics
- Haore logic
- separation logic
- concurrent separation logic
- some extensions of separation logic
- program logics for weakly-consistent memory
- logics for functional and higher-order languages

2) Selected topics on model checking (3-4 weeks)
- model checking
- SMT-based model checking
- BMC or SAT-based model checking
- automata-based model checking

3) Selected topics on language-based software security (3-4 weeks)
- typing and security
- compilation and security
- computing over encrypted or private data
- secure multi-party computation

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
最後，透過對於ESG與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

syllabi.outline:
課程旨在帶領學生於全球化多元的商業環境下，思維倫理在複雜的企業決策過程中所扮演之重要角色。引導學生認識企業倫理的內涵，並透過自編教材、教科書內容與個案探討，啟發學生對相關主題的興趣，體認企業倫理確實於日常生活中頻繁出現，而不僅為形而上的哲學觀。本課程擬藉由課堂的情境移轉，培養具有企業倫理的企業經理人。
本課程的目的將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任（如：產品綠化與環境保護），（2）消費者的保護（如：產品的安全性），（3）員工的權益（如：職業健康），（4）員工對公司的責任（如：利益衝突），（5）雇主與員工關係（如：性別平等）。
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate Social Responsibility (e.g., Green product and environmental protection), (2) Consumer protection (e.g., Product safety), (3) Employee's rights and benefits (e.g., Occupational health), (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms (e.g., Conflict of interest), and (5) Employer-employee relations (e.g., Gender equity).

syllabi.outline:
本課程透過創新科技之電腦，心理學，人機互動應用多學科類期刊文導讀，來建構學生對設計研究者在投稿專業期刊時所應具備的專業背景理論知識的探索，透過廣泛閱讀與師生討論的形式引導學生能夠對其感興趣的研究進行論文撰寫與期刊投稿。建構學生基本概念與專業技能，並引導其發展具有創意潛力的研究題目，訂立，與主題發展，最終引導到資料分析與評估，並讓學生能夠藉由對該研究主題的瞭解與實際操作進而具有撰寫國際頂尖一流期刊的專業能力。

1. 給予修課同學在收集、閱讀及分析學術期刊文獻上的訓練。 
2. 透過現場討論的方式培養積極參與學術活動的動機與辯證態度。 
3. 了解其他學術單位的成就及最新學術發展方向。

description.zh: 有機光譜鑑定特論是鑑定有機分子結構的必備學問，也是研究有機分子行為常用之工具，本課程的主要目的是讓同學了解各種光譜學的基本原理，分析與其常見之應用，並透過實例之光譜分析與解題技巧，奠定同學相關研究的基礎.
description.en: Organic Spectroscopy Special Topics is an essential knowledge for identification of organic molecular structures. It is also a very useful tool for researches on the behavior of organic molecules. This course is aimed to introduce the basic principles and applications of the organic spectroscopy to students. The students will also practice in the class on analyzing the sample spectra so that they can apply these techniques to their research work.

syllabi.outline:
課程兩個主要目標為光譜學方法及分離方法。光譜學方法內容含紫外、可見、紅光、核磁、x-ray等光譜法。電子譜及質譜也將被討論。分離方法方面有液層、氣層、膠層等層析法。分離後串聯之光譜分析也會學習。
Two major goals of this course are spectroscopy and separation methods. Spectroscopy methods include ultraviolet, visible, infrared, nuclear magnetic, and x-ray spectroscopies.Election and mass spectrometry are also included. Separation methods are: gas, liquid, and gel chromatographies. In addition, GC-MS,LC-MS, GC-IR, etc. will be studied.

name.en: Special Topics of Instrumental Analytical Chemistry

description.zh: 由量子化學及結晶化學等理論為基礎，討論一些分析儀器的原理，構造及應用。特別是原子光譜法，電化學分析法及離子層析儀及質譜儀等，針對無機物之分析方法。
description.en: Considering the theories of quantum and crystal chemistry, discuss the theories, structure and applications of some instruments.  Those are used for chemical analysis, especially for inorganic materials: atomic spectroscopy, electrochemical analysis methods, ion-exchange chromatography and mass spectroscopy.

syllabi.outline:
由量子化學及結晶化學等理論為基礎，討論一些分析儀器的原理，構造及應用。特別是原子光譜法，電化學分析法及離子層析儀及質譜儀等，針對無機物之分析方法。
Considering the theories of quantum and crystal chemistry, discuss the theories, structure and applications of some instruments.  Those are used for chemical analysis, especially for inorganic materials: atomic spectroscopy, electrochemical analysis methods, ion-exchange chromatography and mass spectroscopy.
syllabi.schedule:
Material Chemistry
Allotropes of carbon-fullerene (C60), 1D, 2D, and 3D carbon nanostructure, and graphene. Boron materials: borophene, and borospherene, Metals alloys, delafossite material, zeolites, Microporous, and mesoporous materials: Structure, properties, and application. semiconductors, superconductors, insulators, ceramics, and glass. 
Electrochemistry
Voltammetry: Cyclic voltammetry, linear sweep voltammetry, differential pulse voltammetry, amperometry, chronopotentiometry, oxidations, and reductions. Types of electrode and electrode reactions: Standard Electrode Potentials, Standard Hydrogen Electrode, Calomel electrode, Carbon electrodes, Microelectrodes, Ultra-micro electrodes, Ion-selective electrodes, porous electrodes, Semiconductor electrodes, Hydrodynamic/Rotating disk electrodes. Electrolytes, classification of electrolytes, liquid, solid electrolytes. Reversible, quasi-reversible, and Irreversible electrode processes, Characteristics of commonly used working electrodes such as glassy carbon, pyrolytic graphite, platinum, and reference electrodes. Liquid junction potential, salt bridge, conductometric and potentiometric titrations (acid-base).
Modified electrodes and their application, Electrochemical sensor: Fundamentals of electrochemical sensors, Electrochemical sensor for food and water analysis, Electrochemical DNA sensors. Design of third-generation electrochemical sensors. Electroanalytical chemistry in neuroscience. Electrochemistry sensors of biological molecules like glucose, insulin, and cholesterol. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and their application. Electrochemical quartz crystal microbalance and its applications. Electrochemical cell-redox reaction, electrode potential, EMF. Corrosion: Basics, chemical, and electrochemical principles corrosion, and electrodeposition. Electrochemical CO2 reduction, Electrochemical detection of environmental pollutants.
Electrochemical devices and techniques: Fundamental concepts of electrochemical energy conversion and storage, irreversible systems. Supercapacitors and their working principle. Electrochemical energy systems, lithium batteries, photocathode.  Fuel cells: Electrode materials, fuel cell research. Batteries: Principles of operation of cells and batteries; Electrochemical principles and reactions; Factors affecting battery performance; Battery design; Fundamentals of Primary cells and batteries, secondary batteries, Advanced lead-acid, Ni-based and lithium-ion batteries, next-generation batteries, materials for batteries, batteries electrode preparation, cell assembly, electrochemical performance analysis. Fuel cells: Introduction to fuel cells: working principle, direct methanol fuel cells, proton exchange membrane fuel cells, alkaline fuel cells, phosphoric acid, solid oxide, molten carbonate Fuel cells. 
Debye - Huckel - Onsager Equation, Kinetics- over-potential, Butler Volmer equation, Tafel equation, Nernst equation. Electrochemical cells: Galvanic cell, Daniel cell, Half-cell, Overpotential, Oxidation potential, Reduction potential. The rate of charge transfer, Current density, Ionic equilibria, Electro Kinetic Phenomena, Electrical double layer potential, Zeta potential, electro-osmosis, and sedimentation potential.

name.zh: 光電化學與太陽能電池

description.zh: 光電化學即利用太陽光能源或其他光源驅使一個完整的電化學氧化還原反應，並充分使用光電催化反應後產生的電子轉換為電力，即為太陽能電池，其中有機材料、無機材料與電解質為太陽光電池反應時主要的影響因素。本課程將會介紹光電化學原理與測定, 光電催化, 光電化學能轉移及儲存,不同材料發展出不同型態的太陽能電池，進而介紹光電化學如何應用於染料敏化太陽能電池。
description.en: The concept of photoelectrochemistry is to utilize the solar energy and other light sources to drive a complete electrochemical oxidation-reduction reaction where the photocatalytic electron reaction has been converted into electrical energy. Photovoltaic cells which also known as solar cells composed of organic and inorganic materials and electrolytes are the great example for the photoelectrochemical reactions. Here the proposed course is constructed to introduce and implement the basic photoelectrochemical principles, measurements, photoelectrocatalysis, photoelectrical charge transfer and the storage of chemical energy. Further the remaining section of this course will be focused on the detailed studies about the development of different inorganic, organic materials for the fabrication of dye-sensitized solar cells.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

syllabi.outline:
此課程旨在使學生理解自然界中常見的物理現象，進而領會物理-生活-科技之關聯。教學以工程背景學生所需要的物理基礎搭配實務探討來進行。主題涵蓋力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學等物理相關的觀念與應用。
This course aims to enable students to understand common physical phenomena in nature and then understand the connection between physics, life and technology. The teaching is based on the physical foundation required by students with engineering background and practical discussions. Topics cover physics-related concepts and applications such as mechanics, thermodynamics, acoustics, electromagnetism, and optics.

description.zh: 本課程的目的是為了：1.驗證物理理論之真實性，2.培養同學認真的科學態度與方法，3.培養同學數據處理的能力，4.啟發同學自行設計解決量度問題的方法。課程之施行分為上下兩學期，每一學期為一學分三小時。上學期的內容偏重力學、波動、熱力、流力之實驗，下學期的內容則偏重電磁、光學、近物之實驗。
description.en: In this course there will be 1 credit for each of two semesters, and 3 laboraborial hours per week. The first semester experiments involve mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, and waves, etc.. The second semester experiments contains electromagnetics, optics, and modern physics, etc.. The purposes of this course are 1: to identify the physical laws, 2:to cultivate the ability of data reduction of students, 4: to instruct the students solving the problems of measurements of measurements by self-designments.

description.zh: 介紹單位換算與有效數位，元素的原子結構、化學方程式平衡與計算，反應熱，氣體與氣體定律，大氣層與環境污染，週期表，化學鍵，化合物的分子結構，熱力學，動力學，反應機構，平衡常數，氧化與還原，酸鹼反應，電化學，混合物的分離及現代科技材料，奠定良好化學基礎。
description.en: The course is designed for chemical engineering major. The topics explore chemistry at a greater depth and with more emphasis on concepts, problems, and calculations. Topics include significant figures, thermochemistry, gases, quantum theory and the electronic structure of atoms, periodic relationships, chemical bonding, chemical reaction, oxidation-reduction reaction, chemical kinetics, chemical equilibrium, acids and bases, changes of states, synthetic polymer materials, electrochemistry.

description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領學生讀、理解並分析國際時事,提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

description.zh: 本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調機電專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
description.en: This course aims to provide pre-service Mechanical & Electrical Engineering students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

name.en: Advanced English for Science, Technology, and Engineering II

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生閱讀理解、字彙建構、以及語言解析能力。教材著重於科學、科技以及工程方面的文章，並藉由課堂延展活動增進學生於科學、科技以及工程領域的英語能力。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit, skill-based instruction in learning how to process and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skill development, vocabulary building, and language analysis. Selected readings will be centered around science, technology, and engineering. Extension activities are designed to improve students’ technical English skills to be used in the fields of science, technology, and engineering.

The course provides students with explicit, skill-based instruction in learning how to process and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skill development, vocabulary building, and language analysis. Selected readings will be centered around science, technology, and engineering. Extension activities are designed to improve students’ technical English skills to be used in the fields of science, technology, and engineering.

By the end of the course, students will be able to:
Proposal Memo: Write a proposal memo proposing a concrete change to an organization they belong to, using audience-aware tone, a clear problem–solution structure, and specific supporting reasons.
Negotiate in a structured role-play by stating interests, making at least one concession, and proposing one package deal or tradeoff to reach terms.
Technical Presentation: deliver a technical briefing that explains a system, process, or technology, and interprets relevant data.

description.zh: 本課程為學年課程的第二部分，旨在加強學生在科技背景下的英語能力，側重技術領域的真實場景應用。 學生應在各種科技情境及環境中應用基本的英語語言技能、詞彙、結構和科技英語風格。
description.en: This is the second part of the one-year course, aiming to strengthen students’ English competence in the context of technology, highlighting the real-world scenarios in the field of technology. Students are expected to apply basic English language skills, vocabulary, structures and styles of technology English in a variety of technology contexts.

syllabi.outline:
本課程培養學生提供在科技領域中使用英語的能力。 學生將獲得基本的英語語言技能、詞彙、結構和科技英語的風格。 此外，該課程還強調技術和工程領域的職場溝通能力。
The first part of the one-year / two-semester course aims to develop students’ basic English competence in the context of technology. Students are expected to acquire basic English language skills, vocabulary, structures and styles of technology English. In addition, the course also emphasizes workplace communication in the field of technology and engineering.

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領具進階英文能力學生讀、理解並分析國際時事，提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ advanced-level reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在 (1) 培養學生的批判性閱讀能力，(2) 拓展學生的全球視野，(3) 透過分析新聞頻道（例如 CNN、BBC 和 NBC）、新聞雜誌（例如《經濟學人》和《科學美國人》）以及報紙（例如《紐約時報》、《華盛頓郵報》和《衛報》）提供的各類英文新聞報道，豐富學生的知識面。學生將學習如何透過分析用詞、標題和引語進行批判性閱讀。本課程也將探討英文新聞中所包含的文學典故和文化典故，以進一步提升學生的英語語言能力。
This course is designed to (1) develop students’ critical reading abilities, (2) expand their global horizons and (3) broaden their knowledge by using diverse English news reports provided by news channels (e.g. CNN, BBC and NBC), news magazines (e.g. The Economist and Scientific American) and newspapers (e.g. New York Times, Washington Post and The Guardian). Students will learn how to read critically by analyzing word choice, headlines, and quotations. This course will also explore literary allusions and cultural references contained in English news in order to further enhance students’ English language competence.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將閱讀並討論聯合國2030年持續發展議程的議題，主題和做法。 藉由對全球繁榮，社會平等和環境可持續性共同藍圖的認識，學生能進一步參加全球活動，並在本地和跨域發展共同夥伴關係，以參與持續發展目標的行動。 此外，學生將能夠通過批判性閱讀和討論來強化英語能力，並為與可持續發展目標有關的更深入的交流做好準備。
This course (English for SDGs, Engineering Section) will read and discuss issues, topics, and practices of the UN’s 2030 agenda for sustainable development, adopted by all UN member states. With full insights and comprehensive views of the shared blueprint for global prosperity, social equality and environmental sustainability, students are expected to participate in global activities and form partnership locally and across borders to engage in SDGs actions. In addition, students will be able to enhance their English competence through critical reading and discussion, and will be prepared for more in-depth communication pertaining to the SDGs.

Learning Outcomes
By the end of the course, students will be able to:
1. Explain selected SDG issues clearly in English using key vocabulary and basic evidence (data, examples).
2. Participate actively in structured small-group discussions using discussion roles and sentence frames.
3. Connect global issues to Taiwan contexts using specific local examples and terms.
4. Evaluate SDG solutions by identifying tradeoffs, stakeholders, and feasibility.
5. Deliver short presentations with clear structure, intelligible delivery, and responsive Q&A.

Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

syllabi.outline:
本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.en: This course is designed for students to develop business communication skills. It aims to help students build fluency and essential skills needed to function and succeed in college and business. In this course, students will discuss topics, such as logistics and marketing, in order to enhance vocabulary and language skills for business communication.

syllabi.outline:
課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

syllabi.assessment:
Course Requirements
Students’ responsibilities in this class include:
1. Attendance and Participation – Regular attendance and active engagement in discussions are required.
2. Case Study Presentations
Each student (or group) will be assigned a business case focused on marketing and consumer markets. Presentations must include key insights, strategic challenges, and potential solutions. Students must provide a summary handout before their presentation.
4. Reflection Report
Students must submit a comprehensive case analysis report (4-7 pages) summarizing key takeaways and/or integrating insights from multiple case studies covered in class.

Semester Grading Policy
1) Topic Reading and Speeches 40% (Choose TWO for public speaking)
2) Debate 30% (Public Forum Debate)
3) In-Class Discussion & Reflection Paper 20%
4) Attendance 10%

Attendance Policy
Students are required to attend all class sessions on time.
Each absence will result in a 10% deduction from the final semester grade.
A university-approved leave document may waive one absence penalty per semester.
AWOLs (absences without leave) will be recorded and included in the penalty calculation if not rectified within two weeks.
The instructor reserves the right to modify this syllabus. Any changes to the grading policy will be discussed in class.

Students will learn how to write and present using professional English, with particular focus on design and cultural vocations majors. In addition to continued focus on vocabulary and grammar, this semester, we will work on correct punctuation. Students will also read Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (partially in class and partially on their own) and design an Alice-in-your-major project.

syllabi.schedule: In addition to supplemental material related to your majors, we will be working through chapters 7–12 of American Headway, which clearly explains a lot of the grammatical intricacies that often trip up non-native speakers. It is no problem if you have not taken the first half of the course (so long as you can get a copy of the textbook) as the topics taught are not cumulative. We will also read Alice's Adventures in Wonderland and do an Alice-in-your-major project. Students will also hold simulated company meetings with other students from their major.

syllabi.outline:
本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。
The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

syllabi.outline: This semester shifts focus from static textbook scenarios to the rapidly evolving world of Artificial Intelligence. Each week, we will analyze current events, news articles, and authentic media (podcasts/videos) related to how AI is reshaping society, ethics, and the field of Computer Science. Students will develop advanced English skills through debate, critical summary, and technical communication.
syllabi.schedule:
Syllabus Flexibility 
Please note that this syllabus serves as a guide. Topics may change based on breaking news in the tech world or the learning progress of the class.

Course Schedule (Tentative)

Week 1 (Feb 26 & 27): Course Introduction & The State of AI
Note: No class on Friday, Feb 27 (Peace Memorial Day Holiday).

Week 2 (Mar 5 & 6): Generative AI Mechanics (How LLMs Work)

Week 3 (Mar 12 & 13): AI in Education & Academic Integrity

Week 4 (Mar 19 & 20): Ethics of AI (Bias and Hallucinations)

Week 5 (Mar 26 & 27): Deepfakes & Media Literacy

Week 6 (Apr 2 & 3): AI Legal Issues (Copyright & Data Privacy)
Note: No class on Friday, Apr 3 (Children's Day / Tomb Sweeping Day Holiday).

Week 7 (Apr 9 & 10): AI Coding Assistants & GEPT Writing Prep

Topic: Copilot & Junior Developers

Activity: Introduction to GEPT Writing structure and practice prompts.

Week 8 (Apr 16 & 17): The Future of Creativity & GEPT Speaking Prep

Topic: AI Art & Music

Activity: GEPT Speaking practice

Week 9 (Apr 23 & 24): Midterm Week / Assessment Period

Possible GEPT Test Window (Date TBD).

Week 10 (Apr 30 & May 1): AI in Healthcare & Medicine
Note: No class on Friday, May 1 (Labor Day Holiday).

Possible GEPT Test Window (Date TBD).

Week 11 (May 7 & 8): Green AI (Energy Consumption & Sustainability)

Possible GEPT Test Window (Date TBD).

IMPORTANT NOTE Regarding Weeks 9–11:
The GEPT Speaking & Writing Test will take place during class time in one of these weeks (official date to be announced).

Duration: ~60 minutes (2 consecutive periods).

Week 12 (May 14 & 15): Emotional AI & Human-Computer Interaction

Week 13 (May 21 & 22): Cybersecurity (Prompt Injection & Safety)

Week 14 (May 28 & 29): Final Project Launch (The AI Startup)

Week 15 (Jun 4 & 5): Business Communication & Pitching Strategies

Week 16 (Jun 11 & 12): Project Workshop & Rehearsals

Week 17 (Jun 18 & 19): The Future of Work & Career Planning
Note: No class on Friday, Jun 19 (Dragon Boat Festival Holiday).

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生在全球化環境下的專業英語溝通能力，整合科技、商業、社會及文化觀點。學生將探索新興科技、國際商業及數位經濟等關鍵議題，學習分析資訊並於多元專業環境中有效溝通。本課程強調理解這些領域，以提升在全球職場的專業能力。
description.en: This course develops professional English communication for a globalized world, integrating technology, business, social, and cultural perspectives. Students explore key topics like emerging technologies, international business, and digital economies, learning to analyze information and communicate effectively in diverse professional contexts. The course emphasizes understanding these areas to enhance global workplace proficiency.

syllabi.outline:
This course is designed to:
(1) strengthen students' previously acquired knowledge of English by reviewing fundamental grammatical concepts and sentence structures through level-appropriate reading materials;
(2) develop reading skills through explanation of challenging vocabulary, phrases, and syntax, along with the analysis of fundamental writing techniques;
(3) familiarize students with practical conversational expressions and enhance their confidence in cross-cultural communication; and
(4) reinforce their competence and performance in listening, speaking, reading, and writing through consistent practice.

In addition, the course incorporates the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support language learning. Students will explore how AI-assisted platforms—such as grammar checkers, pronunciation analyzers, conversation simulators, and personalized vocabulary trainers—can be used to enhance autonomous learning, provide real-time feedback, and improve overall language proficiency.

本課程旨在：

(1) 鞏固學生既有的英語知識，透過符合其程度的閱讀教材，複習基本語法概念與句型結構；
(2) 發展閱讀能力，透過講解困難詞彙、片語與句法結構，並分析基礎寫作技巧，以提升理解與寫作表達；
(3) 使學生熟悉實用的會話用語，並增強其跨文化溝通的自信心；
(4) 透過反覆練習，加強聽、說、讀、寫四項語言技能的能力與表現。

此外，課程亦納入人工智慧（AI）工具於語言學習中的應用。學生將學習如何運用各類 AI 輔助平台——如文法檢查器、發音分析工具、模擬對話系統，以及個人化詞彙學習軟體——以提升自主學習成效，獲得即時回饋，並全面增進語言能力。

Attendance in Seat: Learning happens best when everyone is present. Please remain in your seat throughout the session, including the periods before and after the break. If you have an urgent need to step out, please let me know.

2. Classwork & Participation
Your classwork grade is designed to reward active participation. Please note that repeated disruptions or failure to follow classroom standards will result in a zero for that day’s classwork.

3. Assignments
To ensure fairness and timely feedback for everyone, late assignments will not be accepted. Please plan your schedule accordingly to meet deadlines.

4. Attendance & Grading Thresholds
Consistent attendance is vital for success in this course. Grade adjustments are based on "Incidents" (any combination of an absence, lateness, or a classwork zero):

3 Incidents: -10 points from the final grade.

4 Incidents: A failing grade will be assigned for the course.

5. Communication & Special Circumstances
I understand that life can be unpredictable. If you face an extraordinary situation (e.g., medical emergency or official university business), please contact me in advance with proper documentation. Issues discussed and approved beforehand will be handled with flexibility and will not count toward the penalty thresholds.

6. Professionalism Bonus
As an incentive for those who show exceptional commitment: students with perfect attendance and zero incidents throughout the semester will receive a bonus to their final course grade.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將透過每週的閱讀和課堂討論，幫助學生提升英語會話和閱讀能力。在練習這些技能的過程中，我們將聚焦在理解西方語言和文化的核心理念，進而深入理解西方文化中的人們（他們的價值觀、動機和原則）。 [本課程過去的主題包括：怪物與人；喜劇與幽默；善與惡的本質；西方英雄；棒球與社會；美的概念及其重要性；探索與發現]。透過研讀圍繞這些主題的文章和電影，我們將探討這些重要理念如何揭示西方社會及其人民的本質。
Through weekly readings and class discussion, this course will help develop students’ English conversation and reading skills.  In the course of practicing such skills, we will focus on an idea central to understanding the language and the culture of the West, and thus an idea central to understanding the people (their values, motivations, principles) of Western culture.   [Past topics for this course include: Monsters and the Human; Comedy and Humor; The Nature of Good and Evil; The Hero in the West; Baseball and Society; The Idea and the Importance of Beauty; Exploration and Discovery].   Examining essays and films centered around such a topic, we will consider what the significant idea tells us about Western society and its people.

description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

syllabi.outline: This course is specifically designed for international students with no prior knowledge of Chinese. It aims to enhance students' listening, speaking, reading, and writing abilities in Chinese, enabling them to meet basic communication needs in daily life. The course begins with the Pinyin and Zhuyin systems to help students learn accurate pronunciation, gradually building practical vocabulary and sentence patterns for use in various conversational contexts. Additionally, the course incorporates a variety of activities to strengthen Chinese language skills, foster an understanding of and interest in Chinese culture, and lay a solid foundation for further Chinese learning.

    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

syllabi.outline: This course is designed for international students with basic Chinese proficiency, aiming to further enhance their overall listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills. It helps students communicate more confidently and fluently in increasingly complex daily interactions. The course focuses on expanding vocabulary, strengthening sentence structure usage, and improving language comprehension and expression through reading and writing practice. Additionally, aspects of Chinese culture will be integrated to deepen students' understanding and appreciation, broadening and enriching their language learning experience.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

syllabi.outline:

(1)培養學生基礎體能及肢體協調能力。(2)瞭解運動保健常識。(3)瞭解自我體能狀況及限制。(4)培養自我鍛鍊方法。
教學大綱：
(1)健康體適能定義。(2)介紹健康體適能五大要素。(3)評估健康體適能。(4)瞭解自我體適能鍛鍊方法。(5)瞭解健康保健方法。

syllabi.outline:
本課程專為僑生、港澳生所設計，透過文學選讀、當代文本議題討論以及文學創意寫作，培養學生中文理解、溝通表達及鑑賞能力，同時也深化對於文化、世界及自我生命的認識。此外，課程也將結合實務應用，幫助學生提升職場中文應用能力。
This course is specifically designed for overseas Chinese and Hong Kong-Macau students. Through the study of literary works, discussions on contemporary textual issues, and creative literary writing, it aims to develop students' Chinese comprehension, communication, and appreciation skills while deepening their understanding of culture, the world, and their own lives. Additionally, the course incorporates practical applications to enhance students' proficiency in using Chinese in professional settings.

name.zh: 程式設計與人工智慧導論
name.en: Fundamentals of Programming and Artificial Intelligence

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹程式設計的基本概念和技術，以及人工智慧的發展和應用。課程內容涵蓋程式語言的基本語法，以及人工智慧的基礎觀念與理論，並藉由編程練習及AI工具操作來進一步了解人工智慧應用以及程式設計的潛在應用。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the fundamental concepts and techniques of programming, as well as the development and application of artificial intelligence. The course content covers basic syntax for the programming languages, along with the fundamental concept theories of artificial intelligence. Through programming practices and AI tool manipulations, the students can gain a further understanding of the artificial intelligence application and the potential application via programming.

description.zh:
1.簡介：概觀、資訊源、通道、通訊品質、數位通訊系統
2.信號與系統：傅立葉轉換、線性系統
3.類比數位變換：取樣、量化、脈碼調變
4.機率與隨機程序
5.基頻脈波傳送：相配濾波器、信號間干擾與脈波塑型、等化
6.數位通頻傳輸：ASK,PSK,QPSK,DPSK,FSK,QAM,MSK
7.多工與展頻技術：分頻多工、分時多工、直序列與跳頻分碼多工
8.源編碼：熵、資料緊縮、霍夫曼編碼、資料壓縮、JPEG
9.通道編碼：線性區塊碼、迴旋碼

description.en: For the purpose of enhance senior students' practical skill in design, the course is established to encourage students to intern in the industry for no less than 4.5 months. The student will then be evaluated by the industry, and by the lecturer through the examination of a written report and/or an oral presentation to demonstrate his/her effort.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得車輛產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。學生需每週40小時於企業實習，並於期末繳交實習報告。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 介紹各種車輛使用先進駕駛輔助系統(Advanced Driver Assistance Systems, ADAS)、自駕車及車聯網設備的感測器及其應用。自駕車及車聯網亦需要多種感測器之支援，皆需要對應的感測器系統。同時也介紹先進工業儀器設備的感測器及其連結網路，包含運動控制相關感測器、視覺相關感測器、力量相關感測器與製程監控相關感測器四大主軸。
description.en: This course introduces the sensors used in Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS), autonomous vehicle and car-interconnected devices. These systems need the corresponding sensors in the real implementation. The sensors used in the industrial instruments, for motion, vision, force detection and process monitor, are also included in this course.

description.zh:
本課程使學生對燃料電池的基本原理、關鍵技術、以及商品化發展與應用過程，有所瞭解並加以分析及探討。
燃料電池是一種電化學的發電裝置，其運作原理係利用電化學反應將燃料內之化學能直接轉換為電能，因其在能量轉換過程中並不經過熱機過程，因此能量轉換效率較高。本課程之授課綱要可分為以下幾項：
燃料電池簡介、燃料電池之效率、質子交換膜燃料電池、磷酸燃料電池、鹼性燃料電池、直接甲醇燃料電池、固態氧化物燃料電池、燃料電池的燃料供應、燃料電池之計算實例。
description.en:
This course enables students to fully understand the basic principles of the fuel cell, key technologies, and the commercialization of the development and the application process, and to analyze and discuss the design of fuel cell system.
Fuel cell is an electrochemical power generating device. It can directly convert the chemical energy of fuel into the electrical energy via the electrochemical reaction. Because it does not go through the process of thermal engine in the energy conversion process, and therefore a higher energy conversion efficiency. Teaching outlines of the course can be divided into the followings:
Introduction to fuel cell, Fuel cell efficiency, Proton exchange membrane fuel cell, Phosphoric acid fuel cell, Alkaline fuel cell, Direct methanol fuel cell, Solid oxide fuel cell, Fueling fuel cell, Calculation example of fuel cell.

syllabi.outline: This course introduces students to probability, random variables and fundamental statistics. Topics include fundamental probability theory, random variables, distribution functions, Bernoulli, binomial, negative binomial, geometric, hypergeometric, and Poisson distributions. The other continuous topics covered are uniform, exponential, normal, gamma and beta distributions; joint distributions; properties of expectation, central limit theorem, Chebyshev inequality, and law of large numbers; fundamental statistics.

syllabi.outline:
Human factors and ergonomics is dedicated to discover and survey human beings’ capability, limit, behavior and other features. And then apply it to the design of tools, facilities, systems, works and environments in order to enhance the quality of life and productivity. This course includes research and scientific approaches, physical design, human beings' sensory process and information process, human/machine interface, operating environments, and safety.
The aim of this course is to inspire students for human factors science through evidence-based approaches in improving products and systems by considering human capabilities and needs (also socio-technical factors) when interacting with products & systems. In this course we step from theory to practical implementation.

description.zh: 依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. Engineers must perform under a standard of professional behavior that require adherence to the highest principles of ethical conduct. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

syllabi.outline:

Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. Engineers must perform under a standard of professional behavior that require adherence to the highest principles of ethical conduct. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

第1週	課程介紹與工程倫理的重要性	Course Introduction & Importance of Engineering Ethics
