description.zh: 基本控制系統的動作方式、位置控制、比例控制、積分控制、微分控制、各種組合控制、氣壓控制裝置、電動及電子控制裝置、液壓控制裝置、空調設備上的各種控制包括溫度、壓力、風量、濕度等之控制。
description.en: To provide students with the concepts of control actions: two position control, proportional control, floating control, integral control, derivative control; to familiarize students with pneumatic control devices, fluid control devices, damper & valves, elementary control systems on HVAC & R systems, include: temperature control, humidity control, static pressure control, flow control and so on.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹冷凍工程，以及其設計，內容涵蓋如下：冷凍工程原理，冷凍系統之設備，各種冷凍系統之設計，冷凍負荷計算，冷媒管路之設計與計算，冷凍庫之設計。
description.en: This course introduces the refrigeration engineering and its system design; the contents cover the following topics: the principles of refrigeration engineering, the equipment and designs of different refrigeration systems, refrigeration load calculations, design and calculation of refrigerant piping, and refrigeration storage design.

name.zh: 永續能源與淨零碳規劃管理策略
name.en: Sustainable Energy and Net-Zero Carbon Planning and Management Strategies

description.zh: 本課程旨在為學生提供永續能源與淨零碳規劃管理的實務知識基礎，包括認識全球能源與環境的現況、掌握再生能源技術和能源效率提升的策略，並深入分析臺灣在永續能源發展上的政策、市場以及實際案例，並包含淨零碳規劃管理基礎概論與淨零碳盤查規範與程序概要，讓學生對於永續能源與淨零碳規劃管理策略有更詳盡的認知。本課程也將淨零碳規劃管理師考試流程和考試重點彙整至學習中，目標是協助學生通過淨零碳規劃管理師能力鑑定，使其能與產業接軌。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a practical knowledge base in sustainable energy and net-zero carbon planning and management. It includes understanding the current global energy and environmental landscape, mastering renewable energy technologies, and strategies for enhancing energy efficiency. The course offers an in-depth analysis of Taiwan's policies, market, and practical cases in sustainable energy development. It also covers the fundamentals of net-zero carbon planning and management, along with an overview of the standards and procedures for net-zero carbon auditing. The course integrates the examination process and key points of the Net-Zero Carbon Planning and Management Certification, aiming to help students pass the certification and connect with the industry.

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹期貨、選擇權與相關衍生性金融商品的理論基礎與實務概念，了解衍生性金融商品在套利、避險與投機策略上的應用。課程內容包含期貨與選擇權兩個部分：在期貨議題方面，主要介紹期貨市場的組織結構、期貨契約的理論價格、以及避險策略；在選擇權議題方面，則是涵蓋選擇權市場的介紹、選擇權的理論價格、交易策略、與市場資訊分析。藉由對期貨與選擇權理論基礎的建構，期望能強化同學對於衍生性金融商品的實務應用能力。
description.en: This course is designed to introduce students to the theoretical and practical aspects of financial futures, options, and other derivatives. Derivatives have become one of the most important tools of modern finance, from both the academic and the practical standpoint. They are used for compensation, speculation, yield enhancements of investments, and, most importantly, for risk management. This course consists of two parts. The first part of the course deals with futures issues including the structure of futures markets, pricing of futures contracts, and hedging with such contracts. The second part of the course deals with options issues including options markets, strategies, pricing, and hedging analysis. Students will learn about the theoretical underpinnings and the practical applications in real world of derivative securities.

This course introduces students to the theoretical and practical aspects of financial futures, options, and other derivatives. Derivatives have become one of the most essential tools in modern finance, from both academic and practical standpoints. They are used for compensation, speculation, investment yield enhancement, and, most importantly, risk management. This course consists of two parts. The first part of the course covers futures issues, including the structure of futures markets, the pricing of futures contracts, and hedging with such agreements. The second part of the course deals with options issues, including options markets, strategies, pricing, and hedging analysis. Students will learn about the theoretical underpinnings and practical applications of derivative securities in practice.

description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology.  Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.zh: 提供本校四技學生在本行以外，對其他領域的認識，以彌補其只鑽研專業課程的偏頗，訓練學生整合知識，使不致在知識爆炸的時代中迷失，促進各種專材的溝通，培養共識；培育人文素養，啟發人文關懷，使具有完整的人生觀。
description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須於學期中至相關機構連續實習18週，每週不得低於2.5天。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核，學生應於校外實習完成後一週內繳交校外實習報告，由實習輔導老師評定實習成績。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance students' on-job practical experiences. Students will work at an engineering related company or research organizations for 18 weeks (20 hours per week) during the semester. Through the program, students would learn the hands-on professional technology. Each student would be required to submit a written report right after the end of the internship for grading.

description.zh: 課程講授家具結構之專業知識與應用技術，理論與實務並重。內容包括開發流程、產品工程、基本力學、木材特性、複合板特性、木材接合、機械扣件、框類家具結構特性、板類家具結構特性、殼類家具結構特性等。
description.en: This course is introducing the knowledge and technique of furniture construction, both theory and practicing. The contents include R&D procedure, product engineering, basic mechanics, characteristics of wood, characteristics of composite board,, wood joints, mechanical fasteners, characteristics of frame type furniture, characteristics of panel type furniture, characteristics of shell type furniture etc.

description.zh: 讓學生瞭解木材機器加工原理及最新工業用木工機器之種類，並使學生熟悉家具製造技術，特別是製造家具需要用到的各種設備之加工能力，及其作業特性和刀具要件等方面之知識與實務。 介紹家具製造過程中所需之各種機器設備之種類及其加工性能。不論及機器本身之設計問題，而側重於機械之應用；不研究一種機器所能做出之各種巧妙的加工方法，而在討論量產作業時，如何利用最合適之機器及加工方法所應採用之標準操作方式。
description.en: Survey of furniture manufacturing technology emphasizing mass production equipment and its relationship to furniture product engineering. The course is directed toward the efficient use of equipment in the production of large lots. In addition, the course does not concern itself with ingenious ways to do a maximum variety of operations on one machine; however, it is interested in presenting the best machine and method for standard production operations.

description.zh: 本課程係提供學生有關家具的成本觀念，如何估算、分析和控制家具製品之成本。其講授內容有：成本結構、成本估算、材料成本、人工成本、製造費用、銷售費用、總成本及單位成本與產品報價等。
description.en: This course is to provide students with the concept of cost of furniture, how to estimate, analyze and control the cost of furniture products. Its teaching content includes: cost structure, cost estimation, material cost, labor cost, manufacturing cost, sales expense, total cost, unit cost and product quotation.

description.zh: 本課程之主旨為探討木質材料在生活產品上的設計應用，著重在傳統木工技藝、機械加工上的技能訓練，並培養學生在創新設計上的思維。更積極培養訓練學生以生活需求的觀點來創作木質材料產品，使學生能靈活運用各項木工基本機具設備製做各項木器產品。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to explore the design and application of wood materials in life products, focusing on traditional woodworking techniques, skills training on mechanical processing, and training students' thinking on innovative design. More active training and training students to create wooden materials from the perspective of living needs, so that students can use all kinds of woodworking basic machine equipment to make all kinds of wood products.

description.zh: 本課程教導學生了解木材塗裝專業知識與應用，主要包括: 1. 木材塗料的種類。 2. 木材塗裝方式的選擇，如何依照木材特性選用合適之塗裝方式。 3. 塗裝作業方式，塗料乾燥、固化及硬化方法。 4. 不同塗裝方式在木材外觀與維護上之影響。 5. 塗膜缺陷與對策。
description.en: This course will help students to understand what is wood coating and application, include : 1. Wood coatings category. 2. How to choose best way of wood coating process. 3. Coating process, curing, drying and hardening of paint. 4. The appearance and maintain in different finish. 5. Coating defects and solution.

description.zh: 探討木材之物理及機械性質對於家具構造與製造品質之影響，並讓學生瞭解材料之組織構造以熟識家具用材之鑑定。終其目標在使學生認識材料進而善用材料。 介紹以木質材料為主之家具材料。內容含蓋木材之外觀特徵，組織構造，材料鑑識及其物理與機械性質對於家具構造和製造品質其間之關係等。
description.en: The macrostructure and microstructure of wood. Identification and uses of common Softwoods and Hardwoods. Physical and mechanical properties in relation to wood processing. Properties of other wood based materials such as particleboard, fiberboard, plywood, laminated wood related to their use in furniture manufacture also included.

description.zh: 教導學生閱讀囊括全球議題的文章，並藉由文章的內容作技巧的訓練，字彙的建構，語言的解析，及思維的啟發。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology.  Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 本門課藉由濕空氣線圖討論空氣調節之過程，分析人體舒適與空氣品質之需求，及各種空調設備系統之設計。本門課在空調負荷計算原理與方法涵蓋輻射熱、熱傳導及熱儲存效應等之分析，系統設計包括送風與送水系統之計算與設計，及室內送風分佈之理論與設計。
description.en: Air-conditioning processes are discussed by using psychrometric charts. Thermal comfort and indoor air quality requirements are presented. Design of air-conditioning equipment and systems are introduced. Air-conditioning load analysis includes radiation, transfer, and heat storage effects. System design includes design and calculation air and water moving systems. Air distribution principles and design are also covered.

syllabi.outline:

Air-conditioning processes are discussed by using psychrometric charts. Thermal comfort and indoor air quality requirements are presented. Design of air-conditioning equipment and systems are introduced. Air-conditioning load analysis includes radiation, transfer, and heat storage effects. System design includes design and calculation air and water moving systems. Air distribution principles and design are also covered.

description.zh: 本科目將由不可壓縮流體在各種流動環境所產生之流體分子流動現象之認識，進而利用各種有關因次群，熟習包含可壓縮流體在內之實際應用上所必須具備之基礎方法；如雷諾數．伯努力方程式等。利用流利基礎分析，流體機械之流場與動力，及管路內流場與壓力之變化。
description.en: Introduction to flow phenomena of incompressible flow, discussion on the dimensionless groups and their applicants, derive the conservation equations such as the Bernoulli equation, using fluid mechanics to analyze the field and the dynamics of fluid machinery, pipe and duct flow are also discuss.

description.en: This course, off-campus practice, aims to provide practical training for undergraduate students through working in enterprise environments. During one semester, students go to enterprises or organization related to energy, air-conditioning and refrigerating industries and learn application-oriented skills. After completing the course, the organization for internship will provide training certifications and evaluate the score of students. The intern should write internship report and send the report to department office.

description.zh:
由於雲端運算的快速發展，大量資料收集與儲存技術已成瓶頸，大數據技術與管理提供一套具延展性與容錯能力的分散儲存與計算架構, 能有效處理大量複雜數據資料的儲存與運算。
本課程除介紹現有的大數據生態與趨勢，並針對目前軟硬體架構的處理瓶頸，提供系統組態與部署、服務層級協定、監控與管理等系統性規劃的解決方案，並導入跨領域的工程管理科學知識。課程簡扼論述大數據技術與管理的重要，並在Hadoop生態系統中，以Cloudera Hadoop為應用範例，實作說明其重要性。
課程內容包括：大數據的概念、應用生態與趨勢、Hadoop硬體規格與基礎架構規劃、叢集組態與部署、叢集服務層級協定、叢集監控與管理、相關生態技術、及概略介紹Hadoop認證與準備。
description.en: The course will introduce Apache Hadoop core technologies and administration with its major including: Big Data (BD) in demand and its application trend, Core technologies of Hadoop for BD management, Hadoop Administration and management tool, Hadoop cluster deployment,YARN applications plus MapReduce, Hadoop cluster hardware and software, Introduction of Hadoop ecosystem projects, HDFS configuration for high availability (HA), Hadoop security, Cluster resource scheduling and configuration, and Hadoop certification program, etc.

description.zh: 瞭解CMOS 超大型積體電路之電路元件特性及其組合電路之分析與設計方法，其內容包含：金氧半電晶體電路特性分析、電路性能評估、電路模擬、組合電路設計、序向電路設計、設計方法分析、測試與驗證、CMOS案例討論與Verilog HDL設計等課程內容。
description.en: This course covers the electric specification, circuit analyses, and design methods of the CMOS VLSI. The contents of this course include: Circuit characterization, performance estimation, Circuit simulation, Combinational circuit, Sequential circuit, Design methodology, Testing and verification, CMOS case study, and Verilog HDL design.

name.zh: 建築資訊模型與防救災及工程管理
name.en: Applications of Building Information Modeling for Disaster Prevention and Engineering Management

description.zh: 本課程將以BIM之觀點，介紹國內外建築資訊模型及建築資訊模型案例，包含建築資訊模型及探討BIM之設計與實作，希望學生能夠經由防救災或工程管理之需求分析開始，瞭解BIM建築資訊系統之架構與應用，進而設計一個BIM在防救災與管理之實務應用，其內容包括：BIM自動化防救災應用，BIM實務應用，國內外BIM案例探討，BIM應用之分析與設計，BIM系統設計與開發，BIM系統在防救災與工程管理之應用等內容。
description.en: Building Information Modeling (BIM) is increasingly important for applications disaster prevention and management recently. The course introduces the BIM use, modeling, design, development, and related applications for disaster prevention and engineering management. The course is a combination of lectures, readings, hands-on exercises, homework assignments, a midterm report and a final project. The course allows students to develop a BIM-related applications suitable to their own researches to meet disaster prevention or engineering management requirement.

description.zh:
為使土木營建背景的學生具備跨域學習與創用能力，本課程扣合當前重要時趨(如SDGs, ESG, LCA, ESDG/USR等)於土木與防災之低碳管理。擇採綠色與數位雙軸科技(如數位碳盤查與減碳之智化物聯網AIoT)作為課程雙核心編排，介紹內容如碳-水-環境足跡之盤查與減碳策略、綠-智-健康之數位雲平台、無線感測與低工耗遠域網路等專案開發的理與例，以符綠智營建之踐履，以臻永續經管之倡議。
為求哲科合一，課程亦將思與學之認識與方法作簡扼介紹(系統思考與問題導向學習)。
description.en:
To achieve interdisciplinary learning and innovative creativity for civil engineering students, this course presents the Carbon-Water-Environmental inventory associated with Artificial Intelligent/Internet of Things (AIoT) to meet sustainable development of civil engineering and disaster adaptation/mitigation. The contents in this class include sustainable development goals such as SDGs, ESG, LCA, ESDG/USR briefly, green-intelligent-healthy construction/maintenance and resilient projects, WSN (Wireless Network), LPWAN (Low Power Wide-Area Network), e-Cloud Management.
Meanwhile, Systems Thinking (ST) and Problem-based Learning (PBL) , which are crucial for philosophy of science, would be introduced for this holistic approach.

description.en: Steady-State Conduction-One Dimension, Steady-State Conduction-Multiple Dimensions, Unsteady-State Conduction, Principles of Convection, Empirical and Practical Relations for Forced-Convection Heat Transfer, Natural- Convection Systems, Radiation Heat Transfer, Condensation and Boiling Heat Transfer, Heat Exchangers, Special Topics in Heat Transfer.

syllabi.outline:
本課程的目的是教授基本和先進的解決方案技術，包括精確和近似的方法，以解決廣泛的傳導傳熱問題。 其中包括多維穩態和暫態分析，重點是與傳熱相關的基礎物理學和基礎數學。因此，本課程將通過各種形式的控制傳熱方程的形式化求解技術來強調能量平衡和邊界條件的概念。
The goal of this course is to teach basic and advanced solution techniques, including exact and approximate approaches, for a wide range of conduction heat transfer problems. Included are both multidimensional steady state and transient analyses, with emphasis on the fundamental physics and underlying mathematics associated with heat transfer. Accordingly, this course will stress the concepts of energy balance and boundary conditions with a wide range of formal solution techniques for the solution of governing heat transfer equations.

description.zh: 本課程針對目前通用之真空系統原理、設計及實務組裝等議題進行說明與分析。將先針對真空系統進行分類說明，並陳述真空系統實務組裝時所要考慮的事項，以及說明真空系統的抽氣概念與設計。真空腔體的設計原理將會詳細說明，並介紹中低真空、高真空及超高真空的系統設計。
description.en: This class explains and analyzes issues concerning the principle, design, and assembly of vacuum systems that are commonly used today. We will begin with the classification of the vacuum system, then goes into the cautions regarding the assembly of the vacuum systems, as well as the concept and design of the air extraction of the vacuum system. We will also discuss the design principles for the vacuum cavity, and the system design for medium-low, high, and super-high vacuum systems.

description.zh: 實驗是進行科學與工程研究不可或缺的工具，實驗方法的設計與實驗數據的分析更是決定實驗結果品質優劣的關鍵，本課程將介紹實驗過程所必須具備的各項知識，以數據的量測與分析為開始，並介紹量測各類物理量的感測元件，如壓力、溫度、流量及聲波等，以建立學生具備實驗量測的基礎。課程主要內容包含有基本量測、量測標準、量測單位、訊號讀取、資料簡報、數據的準確性與變異性、類比訊號量測、數位訊號量測、系統響應、感測器。
description.en:
Introduction of Experiment and Measurement Method
Experiment is the essential tool for the research of science and engineering. The design of experiment and the analysis of data are the keys of the high quality of experiment. The course will introduce the materials of experiment and measurement. The procedures of measurement and the analysis method of data will be detailed investigated. And then the sensors to measure the interested physical parameters of pressure, temperature, flow rate and acoustic will be introduced. The technology of measurement and analysis of experiment will be built up in the course. The contents of the course are basic measurement, standards of measurement, dimension of measurement, access data, data presentation, accuracy and uncertainty of data, analog signal measurement, digital signal measurement, system response, and sensors.

name.en: Philosophy of Technological and Vocational Education

description.zh: 本課程在探究技職教育的本質、目標、歷史發展及相關哲學思潮，期培養學生發展批判思考能力分析技職教育相關議題。
description.en: This course is designed to investigate the purpose, essence, history,    and related philosophical thinking of Vocational and Technological Technical Education (VTE)；to develop students forming critical thinking to analyze the current issues in VTE.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹技職教育之歷史發展與相關哲學思潮，綜採行歷史學、社會學、哲學與比較教育學的觀點，以專題討論的方式進行。期達成以下目標-
一、使學生瞭解技職教育的歷史發展與哲學理念
二、使學生瞭解台灣技職教育的變遷
三、使學生能比較及分析國內外技職教育之差異
四、使學生能以宏觀的視野與脈絡來透視技職教育問題並提出改革建議。

9..戰後台灣的技職教育發展（二）1966-1987
10.戰後台灣的技職教育發展（三）1988-迄今
11.全球化對技職教育研究的啟示
12.其他技職教育史哲相關文獻評論

name.zh: 教育訓練需求評估與規劃

description.zh: 教育訓練是人力資源的一環，本課程探討教育訓練的種類及評估訓練需求的方法與程序，並了解人力部門在規劃員工訓練計劃之前，如何對員工進行調查以確實地掌握員工的需求及意願，同時亦能掌握企業之發展目標。
description.en: Educational training is part of the human resources. This curriculum will discuss the categories of educational training and evaluate the methods and procedures of the training needs, and understand how the human resource department investigates the employee's needs and will, and know the development aim of the enterprise as well before the planning of the employee educational training program.

syllabi.outline: 教育訓練是人力資源的一環，本課程探討教育訓練的種類及評估訓練需求的方法與程序，並了解人力部門在規劃員工訓練計劃之前，如何對員工進行調查以確實地掌握員工的需求及意願，同時亦能掌握企業之發展目標。

name.en: Career Planning and Management for Employees

description.zh: （一）瞭解生涯規劃與經營的理論及實務；（二）探討生涯規劃與經營模式；（三）應用生涯規劃與經營模式。課程內容包括：生涯規劃與生涯管理的定義、內涵與功能、生涯探究指引、生涯目標設定、生涯策略、生涯評估、生涯管理議題、人力資源支持系統及組織生涯管理系統。
description.en: The course arms to (1) Understand the theory and application Of career planning and management. (2) Explore the model of career planning and management. (3) Apply the career planning and management model. It covers the definition, essence, and function of career planning and management, a guide to career exploration, career goal setting, career strategies, career appraisal, and contemporary issues in career management, human resource support system, and organizational career management system.

description.en: This course is designed for students who have taken one-year undergraduate organic chemistry course. It is divided into the three fundamental aspects of the study of organic chemistry:reactions, mechanisms and structure. A student who has completed this course should be able to approach the literature directry, with a sound knowledge of modern basic organic chemistry.

description.zh:
本課程以高分子加工時所遇到之問題，分單元講述，其內容包括：
(I) 高分子加工學之基礎(a)輸送現象(b)高分子黏彈學(c)高分子混煉。
(II)高分子加工學之應用(a)壓模法(b)沖模法(c)反應沖模法(d)絲線成形  等專題。
description.en:
The course focuses on the "trouble shooting" in the polymer processing . Both theoretical and practical topics will be included. The main contents are devided into the following units :
(I)Fundamental Studies:(a)Transport Phenomena (b)Viscoelastic Properties of  Polymer Melt (c)Polymer Compounding and Blending.
(II)Practical Studies:(a)Compression Molding (b)Injection Molding (c)Reaction Injection Molding (d)Fiber Formation (e)Membrane
      Formation.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹各種高分子加工成型技術及其相關知識，使同學瞭解各種高分子加工技術的特性，加工原理及方法。主要講授內容為高分子材料的特性、高分子製品各種性質的檢驗方法、高分子材料的流變性質、高分子材料的混合與摻合問題、介紹塑膠材料的各種加工成型技術及介紹纖維成型技術。
This course aims to introduce various polymer processing and molding technologies and related knowledge to understand the characteristics of various polymer processing technologies, processing principles, and methods of suitable polymer materials. The main lectures are the characteristics of polymer materials, the inspection methods of various properties of polymer products, the rheological properties of polymer materials, the mixing and blending of polymer materials, the introduction of different processing and molding technologies of plastic materials, and the introduction of fibers processing technology.

4.	Mixing and Blending (混合與摻合)
5.	Extrusion (擠壓成型)
6.	Injection Molding (射出成型)
7.	Blow molding (吹壓成型)
8.	Compression Molding (熱壓成型)
9.	Fiber Reinforced Plastics and Composites (纖維增強塑膠與複合材料)
10.	Fiber Spinning (纖維工藝)

name.en: Theory and Practice of Landscape Ecological Design

description.zh:
景觀生態學是以生態學理論來理解並建立一套可以認知景觀與其中的生物﹑非生物環境關係的學科。有關景觀的生態設計理論基本上是將這一系列景觀生態學模型或原理作為設計指標而形成的一套設計操作理論。景觀生態原理在景觀學科中具有極其根本的角色，不僅在景觀資源保育與管理上提供極具價值的參考；對於景觀規畫與設計實務者更提供了在不同尺度範疇狀況下三向度空間設計的形態準則。
因此，課程涵蓋了從區域、基地和細部設計三種尺度的設計內涵，講述及操作在基於不同目的的需求時，人為景觀如何介入自然環境，以及導入的人為景觀的設計準則。
1. 景觀生態與形態理論
2. 景觀生態設計理論
3. 景觀生態設計理論的應用 
   a. 都市地區和鄉村地區     
   b. 區域、基地和細部設計尺度
description.en:
Landscape ecology seeks for principles and models that contribute to dealing with conservation, management, and design in landscape practice. The course "Landscape Theory and Practice of Ecological Design" refers to those principles and models established in landscape ecology and then applies to landscape planning and design. Issues relates to this courses are listed as follows;
1. Landscape Ecology and landscape morphology
2.  Ecological design theory
3.  The application of ecological theory in landscape         practice 
    a. Urban region and countryside     
    b. Macro-sale, meso-sale, and micro-scale

syllabi.outline:
本課程係以生物多樣性保育及其對現代設計理念的跨領域思考為主軸，說明地表重要生態體系的功能與結構，及其所蘊育的生物，在物種演化、環境適應與生活史策略上的特色，輔以國內外案例介紹，探討如何將生態體系的運轉模式與永續理念，有效整合到人為工程的規劃、設計、施作、乃至後續監測維護過程中。此外，並將深入剖析近代動物園與水族館設計理念的發展，及討論既有公共工程，如道路、橋樑、護坡、農田水圳、攔水堰等設計，對環境與生物的影響，另搭配臺北近郊的生態工法案例介紹與研擬討論，期能激發同學對相關議題的興趣與實務經驗。
	This course will be focusing on biodiversity conservation and multidisciplinary thinking on modern design concepts. The functions and structures of important ecological systems on earth, and the organisms inhabit with their evolution, adaptation and life history strategies will be introduced. With domestic and foreign cases, how to effectively integrate the operation mode and sustainable concept of the ecological system into the planning, design, construction, and subsequent monitoring and maintenance of human engineering will be discussed. In addition, the development of modern zoo and aquarium design concepts, or the impact of existing public construction works, such as roads, bridges, slope protection, farmland canals, and weirs, to our environment will also be involved in a hope to stimulate students' interest in related topics and practical experience.

name.en: Special Topics on Sustainable and Resilient Cities

description.zh: 該課程將研究在全球化與氣候變化下的永續與韌性城市發展策略；內容包括永續城市、創意城市、智慧城市、宜居城市、全球城市和後工業城市的各種概念。課程將引導學生參與學術性討論和永續與韌性的城市發展實務理解；提供在不同經濟、體制和文化環境下，探索其規劃政策和設計概念，並以實際案例借鑒不同城市之韌性的回復力規劃，以及說明如何促進城市韌性回復能力，減少社會失序和提高當地應變災害能力的積極策略，因此課程的目標包括讓學生參與永續城市發展的學術討論和韌性城市實踐方法，發展相關知識與了解促進韌性城市和永續性的國際實踐案例，期能將這些概念和經驗應用於規劃設計所需的研究和技能。
description.en: The course will examine strategies for sustainable and resilient urban development in the globalization and climate change. It will engage students in academic discussions and the practice of sustainable and resilient development. Planning policies and design concepts will be explored in different economic, institutional and cultural environments. Case studies draw on best practices in urban resilience planning in different cities, and will illustrate positive strategies to promote urban resilience, reduce social disruption, and improve local ability to deal with pressure. The objectives are to engage students in sustainable urban development, develop knowledge and understand good international practices that promote urban resilience and sustainability, and develop the research and skills necessary to apply these concepts and ideas to actual planning projects.

syllabi.outline:
韌性城市是回應環境變化以尋求新穩定狀態的住宅建築與聚落。由於氣候變遷逐漸影響居住環境，加以城市發展，消耗的能源與資源，促使碳排放增加，破壞自然界的循環，加劇氣候變遷；台灣位處自然災害脆弱帶，將近3/4面積與人口處於地震、颱風與洪患之複合性災害地區，宜積極強化住宅建築與都市設計之減緩與調適作為。研究顯示藉由建構永續與韌性機制，有助於建築及都市基盤設施系統，有效因應環境變化。
本課程將研究在全球化與氣候變化下的永續與韌性城市發展策略與行動方案；內容包括永續宜居與韌性調適的理論與實務；以實際案例借鑒不同住宅、社區與城市之韌性規劃，減少社會失序和提高應變災害能力的積極策略和實踐方法。

name.en: Special topics on urban & culture revitalization

description.zh: 本課程以都市再生理念為中心，講述推動都市再生過程中面對相關文化資產保存議題之理論與實際操作架構。第一部份探討歷史文化保存相關理念手法。第二部份探討各國文化保存再生案例實踐之相關課題與借鏡，第三部份針對台灣本土都市更新過程中面臨歷史文化保存議題深入研討。
description.en:
This course regards urban revitalization as the central concept to discuss about the theory & implementation of history & culture conservation issues of urban revitalization. This course consisted of three parts. 
The first part is considered of relevant concepts & strategies of history and culture conservation. The second part is to survey different implemented examples of history and culture conservation of different country. The third part involves the regional issues by local-oriented issues of Taiwan. A few of cultural conservation topics are introduced to be further interpreted.

description.zh:
為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。本課程為第二階段之系列課程，其內容包括：
一.疫學：探討關於病態建築症候群的因素與特定外來的致病物質與疫之關聯。
二.家政事務：探討生活習慣、飲食生活的變化對環境、人體健康之影響。
三.醫療領域：探討病態建築症候群與化學物質過敏症的差異與因應對策。
四.日常領域：探討日常生活用品、居住行為對環境、人體健康之影響。
description.en: The main goal of this class is to pursue sustainable development and human health. In order to enhance the quality of residential and living environment in both existing and new-build dwellings, the course will cover important principles and topics in sick building environment, including medical, regulation, and architecture, chemical and biological. Specific contents include:(1)Immunology: to introduce the interactions between the immune system and the factors of sick building syndrome (SBS) and some specific pathogens.(2)Behavioral science: to investigate the influence of dietary and habit changes on environmental and human health.(3)Medical care: to introduce the difference and the response strategies between sick building syndrome (SBS) and Multiple Chemical Sensitivity (MCS)(4)Daily life: to investigate the influence of daily articles and resident behavior on environmental and human health.

description.zh: 同學們在修過第一年所開的所有的必修課之後，從第三個學期開始，在指導老師的引領下，必須開始著手準備碩士論文的撰寫: 選擇論文題目，收集資料，通過論文大綱審查，開始撰寫論文. . .等等的步驟。從第三個學期開始須修二期之「論文」課程。在論文口試委員們接受該論文並在文件上簽名後，同學們可同時拿到六個學分，完成本碩士課程"論文"這一項的要求。
description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters.  The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis.  After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

description.zh: 本課程目標在提供學生英漢與漢英口譯專業訓練。課程內容含括專業逐步與同步口譯技巧，以及口譯過程與訓練的學術理論。重點將置於重述、記憶訓練、數字與語法轉換、筆記與跟述練習，以累積逐步與同步口譯技巧。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with professional training in aspects of Chinese<->English interpreting. Course contents will cover both techniques in professional consecutive and simultaneous interpreting and academic research in the interpreting process and training. Emphasis will be placed on paraphrase, recall, numeric and syntactic conversion, note-taking and shadowing, which will lead to build-up skills in consecutive and simultaneous interpreting.

syllabi.outline:
The working languages of this course are Chinese and English. 

本課程為中英口譯基礎課程，讓學生了解各類型口譯實務。學生認識口譯員具備之技術與語言能力，以漸進方式學習基礎視譯與短逐步口譯。課程著重於強化學生公開演說能力、口譯聽力技巧、重述演練、一心多用與短期記憶重述運用以及基礎逐步口譯筆記與摘要之模擬演練。
This is an introductory course to Chinese-English interpreting. The course provides a practical insight into different modes of interpreting and introduces skills and aptitude integral to interpreting progressively. Students learn basics of sight translation and short consecutive interpreting. Topics include public speaking, active listening skills, paraphrasing, multitasking, recall and memory, and gist extraction followed by basic CI note-taking techniques.

name.zh: 文化故事與英語教學應用
name.en: Using Cultural Stories in ESL/EFL Classrooms

description.zh: 為增強ESL/EFL學生的整體的語文能力與跨文化溝通的軟實力，流傳各國的有名故事可採用來作為學生研讀、討論與從事再次創造的素材。這些故事包括人們鍾愛幾世紀的老故事，它們後來幾世代的版本，現代的改寫，與時尚的扭曲變種。依照不同主題被歸納成組(例如：灰姑娘情結，哀怨邪惡的後母，攀龍附鳳的赤貧男子等等)並以多媒體教學方法，藉由閱讀跨文化與跨世代的故事裡強化英語的教與學。
description.en: In both ESL and EFL classrooms, English serves not only as a means to conduct daily communication but also as a media to explore diversified subjects and fields. To build up students’ communicative competence, famous stories and popular tales prove to be resourceful because of their richness in linguistic, cultural, and psychological significance. In this course, multi-cultural stories (including archetypal tales, classic fairy tales, their modern counterparts, and their twisted revisions) are carefully selected and organized according to their main theme. For future teachers taking this course, the instructor will demonstrate how this approach can be actually practiced to best benefit ESL/EFL students. In the practicum section, future teachers are required to try their hands in using these stories.

syllabi.outline:
1. Every cultural group has stories that have been passed down through generations. Some reflect universal human themes, while others display unique cultural characteristics. In foreign language teaching, such stories can be used to broaden global perspectives, explore linguistic and cultural differences, and develop well-rounded English language skills. How can teachers incorporate these stories into their teaching? This is the central question that this course aims to explore.  
2. The course materials are chosen with two main purposes:  (1) To understand popular English novels (or short stories) and their film adaptations, analyzing how these stories relate to other well-known tales from around the world. The goal is to enhance graduate students’ language proficiency and intercultural competence.  (2) To explore ways of transforming the content of these popular stories into teaching materials and classroom activities, thereby increasing students’ motivation and effectiveness in learning language and culture.  
3. The course will include the following components:  (1) The instructor will assign and introduce one popular novel (or series) each week, guiding students through selected excerpts in English and showing key scenes from film adaptations.  (2) The instructor will present relevant teaching methods and lead students in practicing materials development and lesson design.  (3) Each graduate student will choose a popular novel of their own interest and give two oral presentations: one before the midterm and one before the final exam. Students will present their adapted teaching materials in the written final project.  
一. 人類各文化族群都流傳著歷久不衰的故事,有的表現出人類共同的主題、有的呈現本族獨有的特色,在外語教學的現場可用來增進全球視野、學習文化語文差異、以及磨練英語文的全方位的基本能力。老師們如何在教學上運用這些故事?這是本課程要探索的目標。
二.本課程所選擇之研習教材(1)了解當今正在流行的英語小說(或長短篇故事)與其改編的電影,分析該故事與其他世界各地有名故事的關聯,目標是充實碩士生本身的語文程度與跨文化涵養,(2)探索在教學現場如何將這些流行故事的內容轉化為教材與學習活動,以促進學生學習語言文化的興趣與效能.
三. 課程進行內容為(1)教授每周導讀並引介一本(或一套)流行小說,帶領碩士生閱讀原文小說精彩節選並觀賞改編電影精彩片段,(2)教授介紹相關教學法,帶領碩士生演練教材的編寫與教學活動的設計,(3)每位碩士生選擇一本自己喜歡的流行小說,期中考前與期末考前作兩次口頭報告,並在期末報告呈現自己改編的教材.

Unit One: Teaching Children’s and YA (i.e., Young Adult) Literature

syllabi.schedule:
1.     科技創新與管理總論 / 課程介紹與說明(一週)

2.     科技創新轉型的機會與挑戰(二.三週) 
2.1	全球再生能源發展大轉彎闡述與案例分享。
2.2	汙染疾病挑戰闡述與案例分享。
2.3	科技變革加速闡述與案例分享。
2.4	經濟產業價值創新闡述與案例分享。
2.5	製造者轉為使用者需求導向服務闡述與案例分享。
2.6	勞動力/少子高齡化日趨嚴重趨勢分析。
2.7	傳染疾病挑戰全球秩序闡述與案例分享。

3.	創新轉型案例分析(四.五週)
3.1	柯達-失敗商業轉型與戰略失敗分析。
3.2	諾基亞-失敗商業轉型與戰略失敗分析。
3.3	百視達-失敗商業轉型與戰略失敗分析。
3.4	富士底片-創新轉型案例分享與分析。
3.5	食品與智慧運輸-異業競爭案例分享與分析。
3.6	科技業與金融業合作發展之案例與分析。
3.7	科技創新轉型示範的挑戰與風險。
3.8	舊物種轉型新物種之挑戰闡述。

4.	創新轉型機會與挑戰分析(六.七.八週)
4.1	科技創新擴散與使用者翻轉模型趨勢分析。
4.2	科技變革滲透所有領域,激發各種新型態產業分析。
4.3	創新行動成功關鍵-創新金字塔。
4.4	國際石油企業於新能源佈局趨勢分析。
4.5	國際電力企業於新能源佈局趨勢分析。
4.6	下世代智慧醫療衝擊趨勢分析。
4.7	全球先進的港務公司新佈局趨勢分析。
4.8	各國車輛綠能化與車廠開發趨勢分析。
4.9	各國機車綠能化與車廠開發趨勢分析。
4.10	新需求促使商業模式轉換市場版圖重組趨勢分析。

5.	跨領域產業創新變革典範研討(九.十週)
5.1	環境變遷下個體競爭適應力之案例分析。
5.2	智慧港口五大應用範疇及技術推進趨勢分析。
5.3	新加坡港務集團PSA自動及智慧化創新案例分享。
5.4	荷蘭鹿特丹港貨櫃吞吐量統計資料視覺化呈現案例。
5.5	加速促成創新轉型之關鍵推動工作內容闡述。

6.     創新作業研討與互動教學 (十一.十二.十三週)
6.1	關鍵指標/練習指標量化思考,決策研討。
6.2	科技奧秘/思考科技的進步影響,討論心得。
6.3	創新前瞻目標規劃/討論短中期.長期目標規劃。
6.4	無人機/創新科技的應用心得研討
6.5   電機車能源模式案例比較/技術差異.商業模式。

7.	期末報告內容與討論(十四.十五.十六.十七.十八週)
7.1	技術創新專題報告研討說明。
7.2	創新轉型專題分組報告。
7.4	各組專題報告研討與講評。

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
最後，透過對於ESG與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在導引經理人員，建立「誠信正直」的核心價值，將智慧財產權戰略轉化為企業永續競爭力的關鍵基石。課程深度整合ESG治理、聯合國SDGs目標與商業倫理，透過30多個涵蓋專利、商標、營業秘密、生技健康及AI數據的全球經典案例，探討公平競爭、數位人權與社會責任。學員將學習如何在法治與道德的平衡點上做出卓越戰略決策，落實企業誠信經營並達成社會共榮。

This course is designed for executives to cultivate "Integrity" as a core value, framing Intellectual Property (IP) strategy as a cornerstone of sustainable competitive advantage. It integrates ESG governance and UN SDGs through 30s global case studies—ranging from patents and trade secrets to biotech ethics and AI data. Students will learn to navigate the complexities of fair competition, digital human rights, and social responsibility. The goal is to master strategic decision-making at the intersection of law and ethics, fostering corporate transparency and long-term societal prosperity.

description.en: Corporate governance is the combination of legal and political governance mechanisms external to the firm, along with monitoring and incentive governance mechanisms internal to the firm, linked and driven by the forces of investment markets, to produce value-increasing outcomes for firms' owners and, ultimately, society at large. In this course, we will survey corporate governance, taking the investor's point of view. By the end of the course, you should have a well-informed understanding of the basic corporate governance problem and the major issues in corporate governance, prominent proposed solutions to the corporate governance problem, the way the problem is actually addressed in a variety of companies and countries, and evidence on the prospects for and drawbacks of the various solutions. This course is therefore comprised of distinct intellectual components-the practice and the science-which are intertwined throughout the semester's activities.

name.zh: 數位轉型與創新商業模式
name.en: Digital Transformation and Innovative Business Models

description.zh: 本課程在於協助同學了解數位轉型的浪潮趨勢，以及適應新科技所改變的商業模式。課程將介紹創新的商業模式例如共享經濟、金融科技、線上至離線、使用者生成內容等平台模式應用。每個模式將會連結到實務中企業個案，以協助同學進一步深入了解與分析創新的模式概念。本課程將涵蓋數位轉型與創新模式的基本概念，以數位轉型與科技適應角度，透過實務案例來了解創新商業模式。
description.en: This course aims to help students understand the trend of digital transformation and technology adaption in business models. The innovative business models will be introduced such as sharing economy, FinTech, online-to-offline, user-generated content, and so on. The matched cases will be selected to elaborate and analyze the innovative business models. This course will provide comprehensive knowledge of innovative business models by digital transformation and technology adaption (information and communication technology).

syllabi.outline:
數位轉型是企業面對市場趨勢及消費人口喜好變遷的必然壓力。千禧 (Y)世代與Z世代躍居國內外民生消費市場的主力，現有市場結構已經 或正在被快速顛覆 。
本課程主要目的是了解何謂數位轉型、企業為什麼需要數位轉型、數位轉型的價值為何、數位轉型的理論與架構為何、數位轉型的導入程序與指標為何、數位轉型如何帶動企業新的商業模式等。企業數位轉型之案例分享與討論，另針對數位轉型所帶動的智慧製造做深入的探討。

name.en: Advanced Science and Technology Policy and National Competitiveness

description.zh: 本課程探討當今新科技產業發展趨勢與國家政策推動，進階觀察科技政策與國家競爭力的影響，並以全球化的產業觀點、現今前瞻新科技的運用發展及各國案例討論方式，幫助同學了解地緣政治、科技創新及科技與人文間之發展與國家推動策略，進而培養國際觀及全球化、區域化視野。課程內容注重理論與實務，會以演練及個案研究為主要教學內容。
description.en: This course explores the development trends of today's new technology industries and the promotion of national policies, and further observes the impact of technology policies and national competitiveness. It also uses a global industrial perspective, the application and development of current forward-looking new technologies, and case discussions from various countries to help students understand Geopolitics, technological innovation, the development between science and technology and humanities, and national promotion strategies, thereby cultivating international perspectives and global and regional perspectives. The course content focuses on theory and practice, with drills and case studies as the main teaching content.

syllabi.outline:
本課程探討當今新科技產業發展趨勢與國家政策推動，觀察科技政策與國家競爭力的影響，並以全球化的產業觀點、現今前瞻新科技的運用發展及各國案例討論方式，幫助同學了解高科技產業發展與國家推動策略，進而培養國際觀及全球化視野。課程內容注重理論與實務，會以演練及個案研究為主要教學內容。
This course discusses the development trend of today's new technology industry and the promotion of national policies, observes the impact of technology policies and national competitiveness, and helps students understand high technology with a global industrial perspective, the application and development of new technologies and case discussions in various countries Industrial development and national promotion strategies, and then cultivate an international outlook and a global perspective. The course content focuses on theory and practice, with drills and case studies as the main teaching content.

description.zh: 21世紀國際為確保環境、經濟、社會之永續發展，國際紛紛採取氣候變遷相關因應措施，低碳與淨零已成為全球之共同趨勢。本課程將介紹能源轉型/節能減碳與低碳經濟及社會之國際趨勢、國際溫室氣體減量與能源安全相關法規、我國溫室氣體減量與節能相關法規等，並介紹碳足跡、碳中和等概念，由國際相關案例看我國邁向低碳經濟與社會挑戰與機會。
description.en: To ensure the sustainable development of environment, economy and society, effective measures are gradually adopted by internationals. Low-Carbonization and Net-Zero Emission obviously becomes a global common tendency. This course will be introduced the international tendencies of “energy saving & carbon reduction” and “low-carbon society”. It will also be introduced with related regulations of international greenhouse gases reduction, energy security, Taiwan GHG reduction, energy saving. The above concepts and latter concepts of carbon footprints and carbon neutral will be introduced with international practical cases to refer to challenges as well as chances toward a low-carbon Economy and society in Taiwan.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在帶領學員從科學實證（IPCC 最新報告）出發，剖析全球應對氣候危機的行動軌跡。內容涵蓋國際國內相關法規（歐盟 CBAM）、，以及國家**「12項關鍵策略」**。透過案例分析，學員將掌握碳足跡、碳中和等核心工具，協助企業或組織在低碳經濟中化挑戰為商機。

▎課程目標
掌握國際脈動： 理解 COP30 之後的全球減碳新局勢與貿易壁壘。

熟悉我國推動： 深入了解淨零路徑架構。

實務工具應用： 區分碳盤查、碳足跡、碳抵換等專業概念，並符合 ISO 最新標準。

戰略思維建構： 評估能源與產業轉型對企業競爭力的影響。

▎教學單元設計
第一單元：氣候危機與全球共識 (The Scientific Basis)
IPCC AR6 到 AR7 的啟示： 升溫 1.5°C 的最後防線與極端氣候災難現況。

巴黎協定全球盤點 (GST) 之後： 為什麼「2030 減半、2050 淨零」是不可動搖的目標。

COP 28-30 最新進展： 脫離化石燃料 (Transitioning away from fossil fuels) 的實質路徑。

第二單元：國際綠色政經趨勢 (International Policy & Trade)

綠色供應鏈壓力： RE100、EV100 與蘋果/微軟供應鏈的 2030 淨零要求。

永續資訊披露： 從 ESG 報告書到 IFRS (S1/S2) 的強制揭露時代。

第三單元：臺灣淨零法律與政策 (Taiwan's Legal Framework)
《氣候變遷因應法》核心解析：

2050 淨零排放入法之意義。


第四單元：四大轉型與 12 項關鍵策略 (Implementation Strategies)
能源與產業轉型： 再生能源倍增計畫、氫能開發、高耗能產業的製程改善。

生活與社會轉型： 淨零綠生活推廣與公正轉型（確保弱勢群體與受衝擊產業的權益）。

案例研究： 臺灣中小企業如何透過經濟部補助資源達成低碳轉型。

第五單元：淨零管理實務工具 (Management Tools & Standards)
碳核算體系： ISO 14064-1 (組織盤查) 與 ISO 14067 (產品碳足跡) 實務應用。

碳中和宣告： 認識 ISO 14068 標準，辨識真正的減碳與「漂綠」的差異。

This is the English version of your updated syllabus, refined for a 2026 professional context. It balances the scientific foundations with the pragmatic realities of carbon pricing and international trade barriers currently facing Taiwan.

Course Syllabus: Global Net Zero Trends & Taiwan’s Strategic Transformation (2026 Updated)
Course Title: Navigating the Low-Carbon Economy: From Global Policy to Local Action

▎Course Description
Since the release of the IPCC AR6 report, the global conversation has shifted from "setting targets" to "enforcement and trade competitiveness." This course provides a comprehensive roadmap of the 2050 Net Zero goal. We will analyze the impact of the EU’s CBAM, Taiwan’s Climate Change Response Act, and the 2026 Carbon Fee collection. Participants will learn to utilize carbon management tools (ISO standards) to transform climate risks into sustainable business opportunities.

▎Learning Objectives
Interpret Global Trends: Understand the outcomes of recent COPs and the shift toward "fossil fuel transition."

Regulatory Proficiency: Master the mechanics of Taiwan’s Carbon Fee system and international carbon taxes.

Strategic Application: Align organizational goals with Taiwan’s 12 Key Strategies for Net Zero.

Technical Competency: Differentiate between carbon footprints, carbon neutrality, and net zero using the latest ISO 14068 standards.

▎Module Outline
Module 1: The Climate Crisis & Global Consensus
IPCC Legacy to AR7 Outlook: Analyzing the 1.5°C threshold and the irreversible nature of climate hazards.

The Post-Global Stocktake (GST) Era: Why "Net Zero by 2050" is now a legal requirement for survival, not just a CSR slogan.

COP 28-30 Key Outcomes: The global commitment to tripling renewable energy and doubling energy efficiency.

Module 2: Green Trade & Geopolitics
The CBAM Era: Detailed analysis of the EU’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism and its full implementation in 2026.

Supply Chain Decarbonization: Meeting the "RE100" and "Net Zero" requirements of tech giants (Apple
syllabi.schedule:
第一階段：基礎架構與國際視野 (第 1-3 週)
第 1 週：課程介紹與 2026 全球淨零路徑現況

IPCC AR6/AR7 核心重點回顧；升溫 1.5°C 的最後防線與危害。

課程要求、評分標準與分組討論。

第 2 週：低碳經濟與淨零路徑架構概論

經濟成長與溫室氣體排放「脫鉤」的科學數據與實務。

全球淨零排放路徑比較：IEA 藍圖與各國國家發展計畫。

第 3 週：綠領人才國際串連與永續職業發展

2026 年綠領人才必備職能；國際永續揭露準則（IFRS S1/S2）下的職位需求。

永續證照與國際人才移動趨勢。

▎第二階段：四大轉型國內外趨勢 (第 4-10 週)
第 4 週：產業轉型 I：綠色供應鏈壓力與 RE100

國際大廠（如 Apple, TSMC）的 2030 淨零供應鏈要求。

傳統高耗能產業（鋼鐵、水泥、石化）的減碳瓶頸與突破。

第 5 週：產業轉型 II：貿易壁壘與歐盟 CBAM 全面實施

2026 關鍵： 歐盟碳邊境調整機制（CBAM）正式申報與繳費實務。

臺灣出口導向企業的因應戰略。

第 6 週：生活轉型 I：循環消費與服務型經濟

從「擁有權」轉向「使用權」：產品服務化（PaaS）案例。

零廢棄零售與低碳飲食趨勢。

第 7 週：生活轉型 II：淨零綠生活與低碳建築

運輸工具電動化與智慧電力系統。

綠建築標準與生活型態改變的行為經濟學。

第 8 週：社會轉型 I：公正轉型與氣候正義

確保「不遺漏任何人」：能源轉型過程中的勞工轉職與弱勢補償。

氣候變遷法律訴訟與公民參與。

第 9 週：期中報告（分組口頭報告）

主題：針對特定產業之低碳轉型個案分析。

第 10 週：社會轉型 II：治理架構與臺灣 12 項關鍵策略

臺灣《氣候變遷因應法》下的跨部會協調與落實。

國際氣候外交與區域淨零合作。

▎第三階段：方法學、碳會計與綠色金融 (第 11-15 週)
第 11 週：生命週期評估 (LCA) 概論與方法學

從搖籃到墳墓（Cradle-to-Grave）的盤查邏輯。



第 12 週：產品碳足跡、淨零與 ISO 14068 標準

標準更新： 解讀 ISO 14068 (碳中和) 與 ISO 14067 (產品碳足跡)。

辨識「漂綠」行為：如何進行嚴謹的碳中和宣告。

第 13 週：綠色稅制 I：臺灣 2026 碳費徵收機制實務

核心內容： 臺灣碳費計算方式、自主減量計畫撰寫、優惠費率申請流程。

排碳有價時代對企業成本結構的影響。

第 14 週：綠色稅制 II：全球綠色新政與碳市場

強制性碳市場 vs. 自願性碳市場。

臺灣碳權交易所 (TCX) 之運作與國際碳權抵換原則。

第 15 週：綠色金融與 ESG 永續投資

綠色債券、永續連結貸款 (SLLs) 與綠色授信。

氣候相關財務揭露 (TCFD) 的演進與實務。

▎第四階段：科技轉型與未來展望 (第 16-18 週)
第 16 週：科技轉型 I：綠色化學與碳捕捉 (CCUS)

綠色化學十二原則在工業製程的應用。

碳捕捉、利用與封存 (CCUS) 科技的商業化進展。

第 17 週：科技轉型 II：前瞻能源與數位轉型

氫能經濟、前瞻地熱與海洋能。

AI 與大數據在能源管理系統 (EMS) 的應用。

第 18 週：期末報告（專案實作成果展示）

類神經網路具有universal approximation的特性（非線性函數近似器）；因此，其可被應用於控制器設計。另外，其也可被應用於解決分類/迴歸（函數近似）（時間序列建模與預測）問題。本課程內容包含：(1) 介紹，(2) 類神經網路，(3) 類神經網路應用於分類問題，(4) 類神經網路應用於迴歸（函數近似）問題以及(5) 應用。

name.zh: 綠能產業政策與經濟分析
name.en: Industrial Policy of Green Energy and Economic Analysis

description.zh:
在推動國家經濟發展，提升環境保護和創造國家競爭力，政府對於科技政策之擬定，及科技經費之持續支持十分重要，並以此培植科技人才、將科技研發成果加以推廣。為確保有限之科技資源能夠發揮其最高之效用，建立客觀及公正之績效評估制度實屬必要。本課程擬以最近影響人類生活環境甚巨之全球暖化現象( Global Warming )，及其引發之綠能科技投資為例，探討綠能科技政策之擬訂，以及綠能產業經濟分析。
綠色能源包括風能、太陽能、生質能、氫能與燃料電池、地熱能、海洋能與淨煤技術，發展綠能產業即具備「3E」平衡發展之功效，已成各國追求之目標。
本課程預計將涵蓋以下主題：
替代能源介紹（包括生質能源，如生質柴油與酒精汽油，以及氫能與燃料電池等）
再生能源介紹（包括太陽能、風能、水力發電、地熱及海洋能等）
二氧化碳捕捉與封存、淨煤專題
LED專題等
description.en:
Many scientists conclude that the increased greenhouse effect is already accelerating global warming and leading to the climate change. Worldwide government are taking measures to tackle this issue and outlining strategies to bring the greenhouse effect under control.
Greenhouse gas emissions in Taiwan are mainly from burning fossil fuels such as crude oil, coal and LPG and the energy imports have reached 99.22%. Therefore, the sustainable development in any country is to increase the proportion of self-generation of energy, reduce the emission of GHGs, and balance among Economic Growth, Environment Protection and Energy Supply.
Green energy (Renewable energy) covers the fields of solar and wind energy, biofuels which includes biodiesel and bioethanol, hydrogen energy and fuel cell, geothermal and ocean energy as well as clean coal combustion technologies (IGCC). Balancing development of '3E' can be achieved by developing green energy industries and which is also the goal every count

description.zh: 本課程將以近期著作權法著名案例的評析，培養學生關鍵的基礎能力，再導入若該著作為人工智慧自行創作或人類以人工智慧為輔具所創作之法律爭議，鼓勵學生從比較法考察及跨域科法整合之觀點，剖析立法、司法或行政所面臨的問題，並探求可能解決問題的具體措施或建議方案。
description.en: This course will analyze recent well-known copyright cases, expecting that relevant fundamental capability of students can be built.  Further, legal issues will be introduced in dealing with the copyright work created by AI itself, or created by human beings who are aided by AI.  Besides, efforts will be made to encourage students to analyze the problems encountered in legislative, judiciary, and administrative sectors, with considerations on comparative law and with viewpoints from integration of law and technology, and to propose concrete measures and suggestions that may help to solve the problems.

syllabi.outline: 著作權法之立法目的為保障著作人著作權益，調和社會公共利益，並促進國家文化發展。首先，本課程內容主要是介紹著作意義、概念及著作權法之規範。其次，本課程所介紹之著作權法規範，乃包括：著作權保護之範疇、得以被著作權法保護之著作種類、著作人獲得之權利、著作財產權之管理及著作侵權之救濟。尤其是，生成式AI衍生創作，是否被著作權保護？最後，本課程包含理論與實務之介紹，為讓學生深入了解著作權保護及生成式AI互動之議題。

name.zh: 專利程序審查與專利迴避設計
name.en: Patent Application Procedures and Patent Design Around

description.zh: 本課程將介紹申請專利的相關程序規定，以及辦理其他有關專利事項，例如：申請文件、分割與改請、專利權讓與、提起舉發等等，必須符合之程序要件；另外也將介紹專利迴避設計之觀念與實務練習。
description.en: This course will introduce the procedural regulations for patent applications and other patent-related matters, such as filing documents, divisional applications, amendments, patent assignments, and oppositions, along with the procedural requirements that must be met. Additionally, the course will cover the concept and practical exercises for patent design-around strategies.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將介紹申請專利的相關規定，以及辦理其他有關專利事項，例如：申請分割、申請改請、專利權讓與、提起舉發等等，必須符合之程序要件；另外也將介紹專利迴避設計之理論，以及利用專利迴避進行創新的專利說明書撰寫練習。

The contents involve the introduction of defining the design problems, selecting the quantitative or qualitative research methods and specific instruments, interpretation of research results, case studies, as well as writing a thesis. This course provides graduate students with the ability of fundamental concept and design creation or research thesis. These research methods two focus on qualitative research with the exploration of in-depth interview and participant observation. The details of content includes introduction, research process and appro92hes, research design, research methods, coding scheme, data collection and analysis, writing up and implication of innovation and design. name.en: Special Topics on Interactive Media Design (II)

description.zh: 本課程為一延續性的專題研究，其目標在於研討互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究，或是透過互動媒體設計個案研討、互動媒體設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
description.en: This special topic is a continuous course within two semesters. This course is to explore the fields of interaction design, interactive media and interactive art and focus on the literature study, paper discussion and case studies. With panel discussion, research report and design practice, graduate students can be able to learn the ability of research, analysis and practice by effectively exchange opinions and personal experience. The aim of graduate of interactive media design is to integrate different disciplines from computer science, mechatronics, human-culture and design and art so as to foster the professional of interactive media design. Therefore, one of the aims of this course is to construct a multi-disciplines learning environment which performs a topic-oriented study model. This study model formulates the graduate students of design, art, information and mechatronic disciplines to collaborate a interactive media design project.

課程目標
教導學生互動裝置的設計製作流程，包含概念企劃設計，裝置造型設計，程式設計等。並安排1-2堂課參觀業界公司與設計師。
課堂教學，會以兩個製作計畫為主軸，以實做的方式教導學生互動裝置的製作。

一、課程教授與討論

第1週.
  a. 課綱介紹
  b. 互動心智模型介紹
   i. 上癮迴圈

   b. 影像

   e. Face detection

第12週.
  AR的應用

description.zh: 課程分為兩主軸，技術成面以感知真實的角度循序討論數位呈現的相關技術。在研究理論方面則介紹相關之現有研究、研究工具、與研究方法，並討論與人互動之感知研究的理論與操作，心理物理學的實驗設計與受試者保護規範之實驗計畫書撰寫。
description.en: This course introduces research methods applicable in the field of design with particular emphasize on the human interaction. Topics including Psychophysics, perceptual study, HCI experiment design, hypothesis testing, and statistical analysis. The aim of this course is to help students in identifying a research topic in the field of interaction design, designing an experiment, and preparing the necessary documents including research proposal and consent form to recruit human subjects to participate in the experiment.

syllabi.outline:
課程分為兩主軸，技術成面上討論與人互動之設計領域研究的理論與操作。在研究理論方面則介紹人機互動相關之研究工具、研究方法、人機互動實驗設計、統計與假說驗證，以及受試者保護規範之實驗計畫書撰寫。
Technologically, this course reviews the recent developments on research-based interaction design. Theoretically, this course introduces the theories and methodologies of the research applications in the field of human-computer interaction and teaches how to design a HCI experiment.

name.en: Measurement and Analysis for Business Decision Making

description.zh: 本課程為學生提供商業決策背景下財務報告、分析和衡量問題的全面概述。學生將了解財務報表及其基本衡量標準。然後，他們將利用這種理解來使用財務比率進行分析。然後，學生將探索成本衡量、分配等在確定組織各部分的績效衡量方面的作用，以及它們與在各種商業環境中選擇和評估戰略的相互關係。他們將涵蓋諸如匹配策略與績效衡量、選擇和評估關鍵績效指標和平衡計分卡等問題。
description.en: This course provides students with a comprehensive overview of financial reporting, analysis and measurement issues in the context of business decision making. Student will gain an understanding of financial statements and their underlying measurements. They will then use this understanding to conduct analyses using financial ratios. Students will then explore the role of cost measurements, allocations, etc. in determining the performance measures of parts of the organization and their inter-relationship with both choosing and evaluating strategies in various business contexts. They will cover issues such as matching strategies to performance measures, choosing and evaluating key performance indicators and balanced scorecards, etc.

description.zh: 本課程將安排學生組團由學院教授帶領到境外EMBA專班或國外（含中國大陸）大學交流學習，瞭解該國地域性的產業型態與國家經濟政策，另安排到當地企業廠商做實地觀摩與考察。返校後由領隊教授引導主持，進行綜合討論，學生必須在返台灣後一個月內提交心得報告及建議。
description.en: The course will arrange the student group led by the college professor to the overseas EMBA class or foreign (including mainland China) universities to study and learn about the country's regional industrial type and national economic policy. They will then conduct the tours of local businesses. Upon returning, a seminar, facilitated by the professors, will be held to exchange views and opinions. Students are required to submit a final report with recommendations within one month after their return to Taiwan.

description.en: This course focuses on the theory and practice of leadership and management in organization. Its purpose is threefold: (1) To gain an understanding of what the content of organizational leadership and management is; (2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of leadership and organization management and empirical findings and discuss the discrepancies and implications; (3) to discuss practical implications for business management and (4) to apply the basic ideas of leadership and management in daily life.

description.zh: 策略管理主要是幫助製造業與服務業高階管理者作決策。一般而言，這門課程主要協助學員們具有策略思維與整合能力。學員可在策略管理學習過程活學活用，更能融合所學應用於管理決策中。此門課也採用適當的製造業與服務業個案研討來幫助學員學習、研讀與熟悉策略管理的運作，以達成此門課的目標。授課主題包括研討策略管理的本質與整體架構，瞭解組織所處環境 ， 分析外部環境之時機和危機， 剖析內部組織之優劣勢 ， 探討企業不同層次之應對策略，整合策略的執行與治理等。
description.en: Strategic management deals with the decision making in manufacturing and service industry at the top management level. Generally, this course provides students with strategic thinking and knowledge integration. With case studies in manufacturing and service industry, this course also helps students learn, study, and understand the process of strategic management well to achieve the goals of the course. Topics in this course include the essence and whole framework of strategic management, in what circumstances an organization has been, analyses on the opportunities and threats of external environment, the strengths and weaknesses of internal organization, application strategies of companies at different levels, implantation on integration strategies and so forth.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要在介紹高階管理的理論與實務。將透過學校老師與企業高階管理者與學生一起探討當前管理重要議題。本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。
This course focuses on the introduction and discussion of theories and practices of contemporary management topics. Besides university professors, renowned top manager will be invited to share the best practice experiences of the workplace in the lecture. The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.

description.zh: 隨著雲端運算服務的廣為使用及網際網路服務的發展，如何處理與儲存大數據，並探勘有用的知識是企業成功關鍵。本課程內容包括決策理論之基本觀念、如何處理與分析大數據、以及如何更進一步從大數據分析連接在真實世界裡相關決策問題應用。
description.en: With the development of cloud computing services and internet services, the ability to store big data and transform into applicable knowledge is critical. This course includes an overview of the basic concepts of decision theory, and how to handle and process big data with applications on the real-world decision problems.

This course includes an overview of the basic concepts of decision theory, and how to handle and process big data with applications on the real-world decision problems.

description.zh: 本課程設計為讓初學者了解並能分析在現今市場環境下，企業所面臨的財務問題。課程涵蓋企業資本評價的基本模型，包含企業金融資產的定價模式、實體資產評價與投資專案分析、資本結構分析，以及其他企業在資金管理與財務規劃預測的相關議題。再者，本課程以深入淺出方式介紹投資決策之基本觀念及理論架構。將財務投資的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的投資決策。透過本課程之學習，促使投資人能獲取合理的投資報酬或擊敗大盤，領先各基金之績效，以制訂出正確的長短期投資決策。
description.en: The course develops theoretical framework for understanding and analyzing major financial problems of modern company in market environment. The course covers basic models of valuation of corporate capital, including pricing models for primary financial assets, real assets valuation and investment projects analysis, capital structure and various types of corporate capital employed, derivative assets and contingent claims on assets. Furthermore, the major goal of this course is to help students understanding the basic principles and theories of investments. It can give students the skills to conduct a sophisticated assessment on investment decisions. Through the learning of this course, prompting investors to be able to obtain a reasonable return on investment or beat the market, ahead of the performance of each Fund, in order to work out the correct short and long term investment decisions.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要在介紹高階管理的理論與實務。將透過學校老師與企業高階管理者與學生一起探討當前管理重要議題。本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。
This course focuses on the introduction and discussion of theories and practices of contemporary management topics. Besides university professors, renowned top manager will be invited to share the best practice experiences of the workplace in the lecture. The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.

syllabi.outline:
公司治理已成為廿一世紀企業組織架構調整之重大議題，如何經由管理策略及法制設計使台灣企業經營回歸股東長期價值及利益，為政府、交易所與公會等自律機關、及企業經營者必須面對之問題。在法制上，獨立董事監察人、審計委員會之設置、公司自律守則之擬議、股東會之運作，均衝擊我國公司法、證券交易法及交易所規則現行管理架構及規範；在實務上，上市櫃公司如何順利接受公司治理之理念及管理規範，以提昇公司營運的外在評價與體質。
The corporate governance had been the enterprise framework adjustment of the main issue of the 21 century. How do the manage the corporate strategy and system of the law to make the profit for the shareholder, government and enterprise. The main purpose of the course to help the learner to understand the law of corporate and the practice of the enterprise.

description.zh: 金融科技是近年來新興的產業趨勢，影響的層面非常廣泛，不只是金融方面，更牽涉到新興科技與物聯網。本課程將從不同的角度分析金融科技的技術內容、應用領域及商業模式，並藉由國內外重要金融科技公司發展的經驗做一介紹，希望達到了解並運用此新興科技的目的。本課程內容包括:金融科技概論、金融科技商業模式、金融大數據、P2P 借貸、虛擬貨幣、雲端服務、第三方支付、群眾募資、區塊鏈、跨境電商、程式交易、機器人理財等主題。
description.en: FinTech includes two words: Finance and Technology. It is a new trend of industrial field. It has influences on lots of technical fields, not only finance, but also emerging technologies and IoT. This course will analyze FinTech from different angles, such as technology contents, application fields and business models. It also will utilize experiences of leading companies with FinTech to obtain decent knowledge of this new field. The contents of this course include introduction to financial technology, business models of financial technology, finance big data, P2P lending, virtual money, cloud services, third-party payment, crowd funding, blockchain, cross-border e-commerce, program trading, and robotic financial advisory etc.

The course emphasizes key economic and business concepts
(including analysis of demand and supply, production, cost, and profit; market power, strategic behavior, and pricing; international trade theories) that influence decisions.

description.zh: 本課程將安排學生組團由學院教授帶領到境外EMBA專班或國外（含中國大陸）大學交流學習，瞭解該國地域性的產業型態與國家經濟政策，另安排到當地企業廠商做實地觀摩與考察。返校後由領隊教授引導主持，進行綜合討論，學生必須在返台灣後一個月內提交心得報告及建議。
description.en: The course will arrange the student group led by the college professor to the overseas EMBA class or foreign (including mainland China) universities to study and learn about the country's regional industrial type and national economic policy. They will then conduct the tours of local businesses. Upon returning, a seminar, facilitated by the professors, will be held to exchange views and opinions. Students are required to submit a final report with recommendations within one month after their return to Taiwan.

description.zh: 本課程的主旨在研討資訊管理的發展及新趨勢，內容包含資訊策略管理、資料庫管理、網路管理、電腦硬體技術、系統分析、軟體工程、管理資訊系統、決策支援系統、商業智慧、資訊倫理、資訊安全、知識管理、社會網絡等。
description.en: The focus of this course is on research and discussion of the developments and novel trends of information management. The topics include information strategy management, database management, network management, computer hardware developments, system analysis, software engineering, management information systems, decision support systems, business intelligence, information ethics, information security, knowledge management, social networks, and so forth.

syllabi.schedule:
W1	系統思維與 2026 市場願景
W2	AI 革命：從預測型到代理型 (Agentic AI)
W3	數據驅動的消費者心理與精準行銷
W4	數位轉型下的永續發展 (SDGs) 實踐
W5	頂尖期刊議題與數位決策戰略
W6	期末戰略發表：2026 數位轉型藍圖
syllabi.assessment:
1.20% 課堂參與與深度貢獻：** 包含案例提問、跨產業經驗分享。
2.30% 每週小組快閃提案 (Rapid Prototyping)：** 每週課後互動環節的即席發表（5週共30%）。
3.20% 期中期刊研究反思報告：** 選讀一篇最新 MISQ 期刊論文，並撰寫其對公司現況的啟發（1,000字）。
4.30% 期末團體戰略報告：** 針對真實企業設計 2026 數位藍圖，需包含技術應用與分析。

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生在論文寫作以及企業研究方法上建立足夠的知識與技能。課程內容主要分為兩部分，第一部分將介紹論文架構，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、網路程序分析、TOPSIS、VIKOR、灰關聯法、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力撰寫論文並了解使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in thesis writing and business research methods. The content of the course can be divided into two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin with the introduction of different quantitative methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision-making tools through lectures, discussions, assignments, term-projects, and in-class practices. The main methods include AHP, ANP, TOPSIS, VIKOR, DEMATEL, Gray Relation Methods, Fuzzy Set Theory, Rough Set Theory, and some basic multivariate

description.zh:
近年來企業為面對市場的競爭與快速改變，其多以大型專案方式同時來執行幾個專案，如：產品研發、行銷規劃、生產製造及教育訓練等專案活動。大型專案管理要如何才能在企業統一的願景和策略下展開，來提升企業的競爭優勢與創造價值。因大型專案的時程較長且範圍較多，其不確定性和混淆性也較高，以致其成功的關鍵除須具備專案的執行的效率外，還須具有在於對變化的反應能力。
本課程內容將著重於介紹大型專案規劃流程中所使用的技能與工具說明外，並安排學生企業內大型專案實務案例做為課堂內探討。其目的在訓練學生如何面對高混淆性和高不確定性的大型專案，使企業內大型專案管理有系統的方法執行與圓滿完成。
description.en:
Recently, in order to face the challenges and rapid changes of the competition, enterprises often need have a large-scale project to execute several projects at the same time, such as product development, marketing planning, manufacturing, and education and training. How can large-scale project management be carried out under the unified vision and strategy of the enterprise? New capabilities and cultural consensus are needed to enhance the enterprise's competitive advantage and create value. Due to the long duration and large scope of large-scale project, its uncertainty and confusion are also high, so that the key to its success must be not only the efficiency of project execution, but also the ability to respond to changes.

syllabi.outline:
近年來企業為面對市場競爭的挑戰與快速改變，其經營管理活動多以專案方式來執行，以致企業各部門工作皆與專案管理息息相關，如：產品研發、行銷規劃、生產製造、教育訓練及企業經營管理等活動，多以專案方式來執行。 本課程將對於企業內全方位專案管理流程做一概述，並安排企業實例做為案例探討。課程針對研發、採購、行銷及行政專案管理等之五大流程 (起案、規劃、執行、監控、結案)及十大知識領域 (整合、範圍、時間、成本、品質、人資、溝通、風險、採購、關係人) 與各流程中所使用的技能與工具做說明與介紹。此課程之內容包含全面專案管理觀念知識的建立與應用，並著重企業全方位的相關專案實務案例講解。使其瞭解專案管理在產業界重要性，企業研究發展的正確方向，以達產學合一，並分享最新觀念與實務。
Recently, facing the marketing challenges and rapid changes, the company's business management activities are mostly carried out in a project-based manner, all departments are closely related to project management and carried out on a case-by-case basis. This course will provide an overview of the full-scale project management process within the company, and arrange enterprise practice as a case study. The course covers five major processes and ten areas of knowledge (integration, scope, time, cost, quality, human resources, communication, risk, procurement). The content of this course is based on the concept knowledge and focuses on the company's comprehensive (product R&D, marketing planning, manufacturing, and training program) case study. To make attendants understand the importance of project management in the industry to achieve the unity of production and learning, and to share the newest concepts and practices.

description.zh:
本行為經濟專題課程: 
1.	介紹全球總體經濟以及政經情勢探討: 從消費、投資、政府支出、進口、出口、外匯、利率、失業率、政府政策、地理位置等方面來分析經濟行為以及決策行為。
2.	介紹管理者或一般大眾在作決策時，會產生的心理偏誤。另外，也提供管理者或一般大眾如何避心理偏誤，並改善其決策程序，以心理學的角度來探討。
3.	從總體經濟數據中，找出可行投資方向。
4.	運用幾位諾貝爾經濟學獎得主之文章，來介紹公司(個人)行為決策
5.	公司或個人如何利用期貨選擇權來進行公司(個人)理財投資行為之介紹
description.en: The empirical and theoretical evidence for the efficient market hypothesis (EMH) has been challenged over the past two decades. Behavioural Economics starts from the premise that, in the real world, investors do not follow the rational assumptions which underlie the EMH. Behavioural Economics has developed to try to explain financial market anomalies which could effect the functioning of these markets.

The empirical and theoretical evidence for the efficient market hypothesis (EMH) has been challenged over the past two decades. Behavioural Economics starts from the premise that, in the real world, investors do not follow the rational assumptions which underlie the EMH. Behavioural Economics has developed to try to explain financial market anomalies which could effect the functioning of these markets.

description.zh: 本課程從品牌在公司經營中所應扮演的策略性角色，課程中以品牌理論來探討品牌行銷策略的重要關鍵議題。課程內容包含品牌特性、品牌權益、品牌行銷、品牌競爭、品牌策略。身為公司品牌經營者，面對國際化與多變化的行銷環境中，能做出最佳的品牌行銷決策。
description.en: This program is designed to help students learn about and apply the concepts and practices of branding as they are used in a wide variety of settings in product and service firms, consumer and business markets, organizations, business. The topics covered in this class include: The nature of brand, brand marketing, brand competition, brand strategy. After taking the course, the students should be able to make the best brand decisions under the internationalized and changeable marketing environment.

 13
	品牌行銷補充資料	廣告影片分析
 
 
14	行銷個案：內容角色品牌管理
 	哈佛商學院HBS: Case 1: Marvel
1.請問Marvel 的Vice Chairman Peter Cuneo應該要追求何種的策略方向？
2.為何Marvel 的轉型是成功的？你認為這個成功只是暫時的？還是會持續的？
3.請說明Marvel漫畫（comic books），玩具(toys)與授權(licensing)三個事業部的重要性？以及三者有何綜效？
4.你是否認為Marvel的成功只靠著蜘蛛人一個角色？Marvel是否該發展一些較不知名的角色？要如何做？
 
15
	行銷個案：平台式品牌
 	哈佛商學院HBS Case2: Uber
1.	請分析消費者在搭乘汽車的消費行為，並與Uber及其競爭者比較。
2.	請評估Uber之APP有何優缺點
3.	你對Uber的服務行銷有何建議?台灣與大陸市場有何建議?
4.	共享經濟的營運模式成功要素為何?
 
 
16	品牌行銷與廣告創意
  	哈佛商學院HBS: Case3: Mountain Dew
1.請分析Mountain Dew與其他競爭者的差異，定位有何不同?
2.你建議選擇最後五個中的哪些創意?
3.對投放在Super Bowl的廣告有何建議?
4.2000年非碳酸飲料崛起，你對Mountain Dew有何建議?
 
17	行銷個案：品牌與通路	哈佛商學院HBS: Case4: Longchamp
1.	Le Piage為何如此成功?它在Longchamp的角色為何?
2.你覺得要如何管理Le Piage的產品線?
3.你認為Lonchamp品牌定位如何?
4.你建議Longchamp的通路策略為何?

18	行銷個案：品牌全球化
	哈佛商學院HBS: Case3: AKB48:Going Global
1.	AKB48的品牌定位為何?
2.	AKB48目前遇到的問題為何?
3.	AKB48要如何往海外發展?

name.en: The Leadership Philosophy of Senior Manager

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹高階主管的領導理論與實務。課程目的有三個：(1)了解高階主管的領導與管理；(2)討論領導與組織管理的理論與實證發現之間的差異；(3)對實務界高階主管提供具體建議。
description.en: This course focuses on the theory and practice of senior manager’s leadership and management in organization. Its purpose is threefold: (1) To gain an understanding of what the content of organizational leadership and management is (especially for the senior managers); (2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of leadership and organization management and empirical findings and discuss the discrepancies and implications; (3) to discuss practical implications for senior managers’ leadership.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要在介紹高階主管的領導理論與實務。課程目的有三個：(1)了解高階主管的領導與管理；(2)討論領導與組織管理的理論與實證發現之間的差異；(3)對實務界高階主管提供具體建議。

請參閱課程簡介網址
 https://gamma.app/docs/-q5xowaon281ij3n
syllabi.schedule:
本課程由三位來自不同領域的專業教授與業界專家共同授課，並邀請重量級嘉賓演講，師資背景多元且實務經驗豐富 ：

1.陳建丞 老師（臺北科大經管系教授）
專長領域： 職場快樂學（提升員工幸福感）、員工激勵策略、人力資源管理 。
2.周婉茹 老師（中原大學心理學系副教授）
專長領域：文化與領導、組織中的差別對待、知覺屈就、教練控制行為 。
3.王榮春 老師（104人力銀行社會企業處副總經理）
專長領域： 組織心理學、領導學理論與實踐、人資管理、NGO與職涯導師 。
4.業界演講嘉賓
柯淑芬 副校長（龍華科大，前 Google Cloud 台灣區總經理）：預計於 3/27 演講 。
蔡緯昱 總經理（心念文創，DISC專家）：預計於 4/1 演講 。

課程特點與安排
理論與實務並重：
課程為期 18 週，全面涵蓋領導理論與實踐 。內容從基礎的「好老闆特性」與「職場快樂學」，深入至「組織心理」、「文化背景」以及「變革領導」等高階策略 。

跨領域學習：
結合管理學、心理學與業界實戰經驗，透過三位老師不同的專業視角，剖析領導的奧妙 。

重視互動與參與：
評分標準高度重視課堂參與，鼓勵學生積極參與討論與小組活動；期末則需進行報告，展示學期所學 。

這是一門結合學術理論、心理學視角與豐富業界經驗的領導力課程，非常適合希望提升管理思維的高階主管或未來領導者修習。

description.zh: 此課程旨在以人因觀點，探討智慧生活之產品與服務。授課主要以個案探討方式，使學生了解人因相關概念與方法，特別是使用者經驗與人本設計，以及如何將這些概念與方法導入組織中，並應用於相關產品與服務之開發與設計。
description.en: This course focuses on the products and services of smart living from the perspective of human factors. Courses will generally be taught through case studies. Students will learn the concepts and methods related to human factors, especially user experience and user centered design, and how these concepts and methods to be introduced into organizations and applied to the development and design of those products and services.

description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

syllabi.outline:
一、認知向度（知識理解）
學生能理解《戰國策》的文學特色、歷史背景與論辯藝術，辨識文本中語言策略與權力運作的關係，進而分析戰國時期政治結構與性別關係的呈現方式。
二、技能向度（思考與行動）
學生能運用文本分析與批判性思維，解構《戰國策》中所隱含的權力論述與性別刻板印象，並透過討論、角色扮演或情境模擬，培養溝通協商與觀點轉換的能力。
三、情意向度（價值與態度）
學生能在學習歷程中反思個人價值與社會責任，認同性別平等與公共倫理的重要性，並嘗試落實於生活情境中，展現主動參與與負責任的公民態度。

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

4.The design and debug of assembly language
5.ROM/RAM design
6.I/O design and control 
7.A/D, D/A design
8.PC interfacing design

syllabi.outline:
本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。
The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 提供本校四技學生在本行以外，對其他領域的認識，以彌補其只鑽研專業課程的偏頗，訓練學生整合知識，使不致在知識爆炸的時代中迷失，促進各種專材的溝通，培養共識；培育人文素養，啟發人文關懷，使具有完整的人生觀。
description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生家具視圖、製圖及空間想像能力，並以電腦繪圖進行家具設計、開發。透過電腦授課方式，以電腦設計軟體（AutoCAD）之學習，習得平面、三視圖、立體圖、剖面圖等之基本繪圖法，進而學習家具三視圖、家具剖面圖、家具結構圖和尺寸標註等之家具工程製圖畫法。
description.en: This course is to help students to develop skills on recognizing and Furniture drawing, as well as AutoCAD. Furniture engineering drawing includes Cross-sectional view, Structure drawing and Dimensioning.

syllabi.outline:
本課程教授全球知名的電腦繪圖軟體AutoCAD 2D與3D，
期盼將企業三十多年的產業輔導經驗，循序漸進培養學生練就AutoCAD 2D與3D紮實好功夫，培訓出一批最強的AutoCAD專業好手，更期許通過AutoCAD 2D&3D技能檢定，直接達成產業界要求的專業工程師實力。
※期許靈活用於家具設計、室內設計、工程繪圖或其他需要電腦繪圖的產業上※
※同步加強訓練手眼腦、邏輯思考、空間觀察與程式設計※
※讓未來充滿無限可能※

description.zh: 本課程教授商品化實務概念並由學生實際操作，如何以一貫作業完成市場銷售商品。由消費者洞察開始，教導學生如何從消費者行為找到需求，進而思考產品設計動機。設計過程中涵蓋專利，製造與營運思維，最後以實際商品設計呈現。
description.en: The purpose of this course is study the concept of commercialization and how to sale the products to marketing through the consistent process. It’ll ask student to find the consumer's requirements from observation, then think and confirm the design purpose. The design process will include patent, manufacture, operating thinking, and commodity design.

description.zh: 練習設計構想草圖速繪法；從基本幾何形體至複雜產品、空間循序漸進；常用材質（木質、金屬、透明材質、石材及皮革等）之表現技法；產品精描、透視圖法、三視圖、爆炸圖、組立圖等之精描，說明圖板及各種畫材（麥克筆、粉彩、色鉛筆及水彩）等之應用。
description.en: This course put emphasis on offering students having enough skills on :1.Abilities to sketch their idea visible to the others.2.Coloring design sketches to let the drawings have better comprehensibility.3.Good skill for Renderings. Medias for this course shall include markers, pastels water colors and color pencils.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之規劃係以培養學生了解基礎之表現技法，透過透視學以掌握正確之產品型態，並藉由學習產品之光影變化，得以透過麥克筆呈現出產品之立體透視，最後導入建模能力，了解產品渲染之技法及效果，並運用表版進行產品的詮釋，以作為未來設計溝通的過程當中之實務應用。

課程目標
1.掌握產品透視及光影變化
2.了解產品的模擬渲染
3.運用圖面呈現設計概念

description.zh: 傢俱塗裝為傢俱外觀重要的製程，本課程教導學生了解傢俱塗裝專業知識與生產規劃，主要包括: 1.傢俱塗料的種類。例如: 刷塗、噴塗、滾筒塗佈、簾幕式塗佈 2.傢俱塗裝方式的選擇。 3.傢俱塗裝作業方式，塗料乾燥、固化及硬化方法。 4.不同塗裝方式在外觀與維護上之影響。 5.塗膜缺陷與對策。 6.塗裝線規劃。
description.en: Furniture finish is an important part of appearance, This course will help students to understand furniture finishing and Manufacturing process, include 1. Furniture coatings category. ex: brushing、spraying、roller coating、curtain coating… 2. How to choose best way of coating process. 3. Coating process, curing, drying and hardening of paint. 4. The appearance and maintain in different finish. 5. Coating defects and solution. 6. Production planning.

description.zh: 本課程之目的為使學生瞭解生產計畫與管制的基本概念，訓練學生對於生產計畫與管制的各項方法，制度設計及改善等具有基本認識，並應用管理科學及作業研究於生產計畫與管制之研究發展。本課程包括下列主題：生產計畫與管制概論、產品設計與發展、預測、來源需求規畫、生產排程、總排程、存貨管理、豐田式管理、專案規畫與管理等。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to introduce the fundamental concepts of production planning and control. In addition, applications of management science and operations research in production control and planning are also provided. This course is consisted of the following subjects: introduction, product design and development, forecasting, resources requirement planning, production scheduling, total scheduling, inventory management, Toyota management, and project management.

The main purpose of this course is to introduce the fundamental concepts of production planning and control. In addition, applications of management science and operations research in production control and planning are also provided. This course is consisted of the following subjects: introduction, product design and development, forecasting, resources requirement planning, production scheduling, total scheduling, inventory management, Toyota management, and project management.

description.zh: 課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
