description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

syllabi.notes:
1.本課程對應SDGs指標：4.教育品質。課程確保學生學習國語文的機會與品質，經由課程進行，培養學生國語文書寫與表達的能力，提升學生文化知識與涵養，以為生活中施行與應用，進而終身學習，邁向幸福人生。

2.本課程為愛護臺灣之情感教育。藉由課程進行，希冀同學透過臺灣文學的解讀與探索，明瞭臺灣文學的內涵與風格特色，了解臺灣的自然地景與社會文化，進而愛護臺灣，守護臺灣，使臺灣的環境與文化能傳承永續。

3.本課程教學內容與方式，對應教育部創新品德教育6E教學方法之1.典範學習（Example）、2.啟發思辨（Explanation）、3.勸勉激勵（Exhortation）、4.環境形塑（Environment）、5.體驗反思（Experience）、6.正向期許（Expectation）。

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概
念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
description.en:
This course introduces to the students the basic computer programming concepts.
Syntax and semantics of the C and C++ programming languages will be introduced.
Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer
solutions, effective methods of program design using structured programming notions
of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

description.zh: 課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生建立足夠的知識與技能在論文寫作以及企業研究方法上。課程內容主要分為兩部分， 第一部分將首先介紹論文架構開始，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、TOPSIS、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力撰寫論文並了解使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in thesis writing and business research methods. The content of the course can be divided by two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin from the introduction of different quantity methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision-making tools through lectures, discussion, assignment, term-projects and in class practices.

syllabi.outline:
本課程期透過建立學生正確的研究觀念，以培養論文研究與寫作之基礎能力。根據論文寫作方法之需求，讓學生了解研究方法的本質、研究的意義、過程與方法，以及研究設計的基本概念與特性；進而瞭解如何進行質性與量化研究、資料蒐集、資料處理與統計分析，並瞭解論文格式及架構，學習撰寫研究論文並準備口頭報告，並透過課堂互動互動與分享，強化學習。
The objectives of this course are：1. To introduce the basic concept of research methodology that applies in academic and practical research. 2. To learn the methods of conducting research processes and preparing research proposals and reports. 3. To know how to obtain the required information through appropriate approaches in writing thesis or  research reports and solving management problems.

Graduate students who are chosen the fields of design creation should be developed creation principle, design process and pr92tical work. The results of design creation are considered as research thesis. Graduate students who are focus on the research of inter92tive media design should be undertaken the results of research as a thesis. The content of thesis includes introduction, literature review, research design and appro92hes, results and discussion, conclusion and suggestions. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

description.zh: 本課程提供學生學習資料分析與處理的基本技巧，包括資料管理、資料格式轉換、資料表格建立、數據模型及視覺化處理及實例應用之探討。本課程以物件導向程式語言為基礎做為資料分析之工具，並且實作各應用實例，修習本課程之學生需具備一定之程式及數學基礎。

description.zh: 粉末冶金是工業先進國家積極發展的重點科技之一，其內容涵蓋粉末製造、粉末成形固結以及燒結體的後處理等範圍，本課程即安排包括粉末製造、粉末特性與其測定、粉末混合與造粒、成形、燒結理論與實務、燒結體性質與其測定、燒結體的後處理等基礎項目。另外，再講述利用粉末冶金技術製造的材料與產品的實務應用項目等，以期讓學生能對粉末冶金技術能有基本上的認識。
description.en: Powder metallurgy is one of the most important highlighted high-tech in the developed countries, its content includes powder making,powder formation and condensing,and the final treatment of sintered body,etc.Thus, this course includes the fundamental items such as powder manufacturing, powder characteristics and its test, powder mixing and granulation, formation, sintering theory and practice, the property of sintering body and its test, the post-treatment of sintering body. Besides, it also lectures practice method like using powder metallurgy to manufacture material and product, in order to let students have basic knowledge about powder metallurgy.

description.zh: 本課程內容目的在介紹電化學之原理與其應用.一、在原理方面包括離子之作用及其平衡,電解質之導電性質,界面現象,電極電位,電化學電池和電極動力程序等內容.二、在應用方面則涵蓋溶液化學參數測量,電化學分析技術,電鍍,表面處理,金屬腐蝕防治,電池應用,和電合成等
description.en: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to principles of electrochemistry and its applications. In the principles which includes ionic interaction, ionic equilibrium, the conducting properties of electrolytes, interfacial phenomena, electrode potentials, electrochemical cells and electrode kinetic process. For the application covers determination of physical parameters in the solutions, electroanalytical techniques, electroplating, electrochemical sensors, surface finishing, metal corrosion prevention, cells, electrodialysis, and electrosynthesis etc.

syllabi.outline:
電化學工程的領域眾多，舉凡腐蝕現象與電泳作用的探討，電分析感測器或電池元件的製作，以及電鍍、拋光或鋁和氯氣的生產技術等均為電化學工程的範疇。本課程除了介紹基本的電化學原理外，另將著重於電化學分析方法在能源與生醫系統研究上的應用。
Electrochemistry includes many different phenomena (e.g., corrosion and electrophoresis, electroanalytical sensors and batteries devices, the electroplating of metals, and the large-scale production of aluminum and chlorine technologies……). In addition to an overview of the basic principles of electrochemistry, the main emphasis here is on applying electro-analytical methods to the study of energy and biomedical systems.

description.zh: 材料表面處理是各種製造工業不可或缺的過程，不論是傳統的工業或現代的高科技產業，表面處理都一直扮演著極重要的角色。本課程主 要是對表面處理技術在理論基礎，方法與應用等方面的講述，以期 培養學生的興趣與專業的知識。課程內容包括表面處理技術的基本 理論，前處理技術，各種表面處理的方法與相關知識，以及各種表面處理技術的應用等項目。
description.en: Surface coating and chemical surface treatment are the main subjects to be taught in this course. The phase composition of the each coating methods is introduced initially. Association of theses process with chemical pre-treatment of the material surface is reviewed next. Both experimental procedures and techniques base on concepts of electrode reactions and impedances are discussed during the entire presentation of this course.

description.zh: 隨著先進能源科技的快速進展，各種形態能源的生產、儲存、再生、與利用成為技術發展的重點。材料科技是提升能源效率的重要一環，本課程結合包括金屬、陶瓷、高分子、奈米等複合材料系統，討論材料在在包括儲氫合金、二次電池、燃料電池、太陽能電池、熱電、超電容等新型能源儲存或生產等裝置上的應用領域與其限制。
description.en: The demands for advanced energy requires the development of technologies for sustainable energy production, converting, and storage. Materials are key blocks to improved performance in new energy technologies. These new materials systems often combine the knowledge in the fields of metals, ceramics, polymer, and nano-materials. This course will discuss the applications and limits of materials in hydrogen storage, secondary batteries, fuel cells, solar cells, thermoelectric devices, and supercapacitors to give undergraduate students a basic understanding of energy-related materials.

name.zh: 太陽光電電池材料與開發

description.zh: 本課程目標在教授學生太陽能光電科技及能源產業之實務知識，及相關材料設計。課程設計將著重基礎太陽能光電科技知識的建立，首先介紹太陽能光電科技所應具備之基礎知識，並教授能源材料的基本特性及原理及目前應用之概況。藉由說明太陽能電池設計原理與效率提高準則為出發點，教導學生了解太陽能光電科技所應用到之材料基本特性及相關製作程序。本課程將由本校專任教師配合企業講師和技術實務專業教師演講，透過實例之講解及工廠參觀，引導學生了解應用領域及製造產業。期盼培育學生迅速進入太陽能光電及能源科技相關產業。
description.en: The course "Technical progress and future prospect on solar photovoltaic" aims to provide the core knowledge for the material development of solar energy technology. It intends to educate and train students with the fundamental theories and technical application of solar energy and solar-cell fabrication technology. The future prospect of photovoltaic will be revealed to help students understand strong demands in solar industries. The experienced industrial lectures will present the potential marketing, working principles of solar devices, and progress in commercialization of solar cells. Students will also be given opportunities to visit the solar-related industries.

syllabi.outline:
本課程針對大三學生，重點介紹太陽能電池的材料選擇、製程技術與開發實務。課程內容將從綠色能源基礎知識出發，結合表面及薄膜處理技術，詳述太陽能電池生產中不可或缺的沈積方法與前處理技術。此外，課程亦將討論加工製程與熱處理對太陽能電池材料組織與性質的影響，並引進產業案例分析以縮短學用落差。
This course is designed for third-year undergraduate students and focuses on the material selection, manufacturing processes, and development practices of solar cells. The course content will begin with fundamental knowledge of green energy, combined with surface and thin-film treatment techniques, detailing the deposition methods and pretreatment technologies indispensable in solar cell production. Furthermore, the course will discuss the impact of processing and heat treatment on the microstructure and properties of solar cell materials, and introduce industry case studies to bridge the gap between theory and practice.
syllabi.schedule:
第一至三週： 綠色能源基礎與世界能源利用現狀（太陽能直接利用與發電）。
第四至六週： 太陽能電池材料分類：單晶、多晶及薄膜材料之特性與應用。
第七至八週： 表面處理技術在太陽能領域之應用。
第九週： 期中考。
第十至十三週： 太陽能電池製程：PVD (Sputtering) 與製程實務介紹。
第十四至十六週：太陽光電模組製程(封裝材料、導電材料) 。
第十七週：Applications and Case Stories：產業案例分析與材料缺陷防治。
第十八週： 期末考。
Weeks 1–3: Foundations of Green Energy and Current Status of World Energy Utilization (Direct Solar Energy Utilization and Power Generation)
Weeks 4–6: Classification of Solar Cell Materials: Characteristics and Applications of Monocrystalline, Polycrystalline, and Thin-Film Materials
Weeks 7–8: Applications of Surface Treatment Technology in the Solar Energy Field
Week 9: Midterm Examination
Weeks 10–13: Solar Cell Manufacturing Processes: PVD (Sputtering) and CVD Process Practices
Weeks 14–16: Photovoltaic Module Manufacturing Processes (Encapsulation Materials, Conductive Materials)
Week 17: Applications and Case Stories: Industrial Case Analysis and Prevention of Material Defects
Week 18: Final Examination

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹薄膜製作有關的基礎理論與技術。講述內容包括真空技術，薄膜基礎，薄膜製作技術，蝕刻技術，薄膜評估方法以及薄膜技術的應用等。讓學生認識薄膜在高科技產業上的應用與其重要性，製作薄膜的方法與技術以及其未來的發展。
description.en: This course is a special topics of Thin films technology and Thin film materials science. 2. Vacuum science and technology 3. Thin film evaporation processes 4. Discharge, plasma, and ion-surface interaction 5. Plasma and ion beam processing of thin films 6. Chemical vapor deposition 7. Substrate surfaces and thin film nucleation 8. Film structure 9. Characterization of thin films and surface 10. Interdiffusion, reactions, and transformations in thin films 11. Mechanical properties of thin films.

syllabi.outline:
薄膜科技是當今各式高科技製造業最不可或缺的技術之一，相關技術影響範疇包含電子、光電、半導體製造業、表面工程、高硬度高強度、耐磨抗腐蝕、裝飾與保護等等。薄膜技術種類與相關配合技術繁多，隨產業發展各項技術亦不斷進化，本課程涵蓋相關薄膜成長概論與原理，並搭配實作課程，期望讓學生認識薄膜在科技產業上的應用，並了解其重要性及未來的發展。
本課程包含以下主題：
1.	薄膜沉積 (Thin film deposition)
2.	薄膜材料表面能、擴散行為、應力等介紹 (Review of surface energy, diffusion, and stress in thin films)
3.	薄膜的化學能與表面動態行為 (Chemical potentials and surface kinetic processes)
4.	同質磊晶與異質磊晶 (Homogenius epitaxy and heterogenius epitaxy growth)
5.	互擴散 (Interdiffusion)
6.	蕭基能障 (Schottky barrier)
7.	矽化物薄膜形成 (Silicide formation and thin film reaction)
8.	電遷移機制 (Electromigration)
9.     薄膜分析技術 (Thin film characterization)


Thin film science and technology have gone through a thorough development which results in numerous new materials and advanced applications. Thin film research shares the knowledge from multi-disciplines, such as materials science, chemistry, solid state physics, mechanics and etc.. This course is an introductory class for students who are interested in thin film technology. Lab or tour session(s) will be provided to promote teaching and learning.

The topics will cover:
1.	薄膜沉積 (Thin film deposition)
2.	薄膜材料表面能、擴散行為、應力等介紹 (Review of surface energy, diffusion, and stress in thin films)
3.	薄膜的化學能與表面動態行為 (Chemical potentials and surface kinetic processes)
4.	同質磊晶與異質磊晶 (Homogenius epitaxy and heterogenius epitaxy growth)
5.	互擴散 (Interdiffusion)
6.	蕭基能障 (Schottky barrier)
7.	矽化物薄膜形成 (Silicide formation and thin film reaction)
8.	電遷移機制 (Electromigration)
9.     薄膜分析技術 (Thin film characterization)

name.en: Analysis and strategic application of chemical engineering patents

description.zh: 專利文件是最具價值的技術研發資訊。課程除了介紹專利相關基礎知識之外，並以有效的專利檢索分析技藝洞悉未來技術趨勢，特別是針對化學工程、生物科技、生醫材料、智能程序工程、綠色能源、光電半導體、奈米材料等系所研究發展領域的專利文件。透過有系統的分析及視覺化的圖示呈現企業有用的專利情報(intelligence)，並找到其中潛在的商業利益。
description.en: Patent documents are the most valuable technology research and development information. In addition to introducing the basic knowledge of patents, the course also uses effective patent retrieval and analysis techniques to gain insight into future technological trends. The technical fields of patent documents are especially aimed at chemical engineering, biotechnology, biomedical materials, chemical process and intelligent engineering, green energy, optoelectronic semiconductors and nanomaterials. Present the useful patent intelligence of enterprises through systematic analysis and visual diagrams, and try to find the potential commercial benefits.

description.zh: 這門課除了教授傳統企業環境管理及相關實務之外，特別將著重在企業提升如何透過綠色創新來提升綠色競爭力的策略與做法；此外，課程另一重點將會是企業如何透過協助聯合國永續發展目標(UN SDGs)的達成，來創造企業的永續競爭力。學生將會深入探究金字塔底層(BOP)與創造共享價值(Creating Shared Value, CSV)之理論及實務做法，以及成為一個真正永續企業的策略。
description.en: In this course, traditional corporate environmental management and the strategies for improving green competitiveness will be taught. In addition, the strategies of corporate sustainability- how the corporate to create sustainable competitiveness by coping with the 17 goals of UN’s Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs) will also be taught. Theories and practices of Bottom of the Pyramid (BOP) and Creating Shared Value (CSV), as well as the strategies of being a true sustainable enterprise will be emphasized in the class.

syllabi.outline:
這門課除了教授傳統企業環境管理及相關實務之外，特別將著重在企業提升如何透過綠色創新來提升綠色競爭力的策略與做法；此外，課程另一重點將會是企業如何透過協助聯合國永續發展目標(UN SDGs)的達成，來創造企業的永續競爭力。學生將會深入探究金字塔底層(BOP)與創造共享價值(Creating Shared Value, CSV)之理論及實務做法，以及成為一個真正永續企業的策略。
This course explores win-win strategies that enable corporations to achieve both profitability and sustainability. Students will learn traditional business management and new strategies and practices for doing business in the emerging green and low-carbon economy. Students will be taught the characteristics and landscape of the new economy and how to help enterprises enhance their competitiveness in response to the megatrends of sustainability. In addition, the strategies of corporate sustainability- how the corporation creates sustainable competitiveness by coping with the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs) will also be taught. The latest practices and theories of corporate sustainability, including Net Positive, Net Zero, Bottom of the Pyramid (BOP), and Creating Shared Value (CSV), will be discussed in the class. Case studies and group discussions will be adopted in the class.

description.zh: 能源在日常生活中以很多型態呈現，大量的能源使用於汽車動力、食物與用水加熱、產品製造、發電及其他不同事務。使用傳統能源會排放空氣污染物，因而引起鄰近地區、區域、跨國境空氣污染問題，甚至是全球的環境衝擊效應。本課程將檢視能源使用現況及其衍生的環境議題，並且探討能源使用之趨勢。傳統能源(如煤、石油、天然氣、核能等)、及再生能源(如太陽能、水力、風能、地熱能等)及能源效率等內容，都將於課程中介紹
description.en: Energy enters our everyday lives in many ways. Prodigious amounts of energy are used to power automobiles, heat food and water, manufacture products, generate electricity, and perform various other tasks. The use of traditional energy will emit air pollutants that may result in regional air pollution problem as well as global effects. In this course we will look at the current energy situation, its environmental implications, and try to determine the patterns of energy use. We will look at energy use as coal, petroleum, natural gas, nuclear energy, and renewable energy, such as solar energy, hydroelectric

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹各種再生能源的原理與發展現況，包括太陽能、風能、波浪能、潮汐能、海流能、海洋熱能、鹽差能、生物能、水力能、地熱能、氫與燃料電池等，其有關的主要技術和成本、對環境造成的衝擊、來源的規模潛力及其未來前景。並檢視各種傳統能源如煤、石油、天然氣、核能等之使用現況及其衍生的環境議題。
Knowing the principle and development of each renewable energy, including solar energy, wind energy, ocean energy (wave energy, tide energy, ocean thermal energy, ocean salinity gradient energy), hydro energy, geothermal energy, biomass energy, and fuel cell. Realizing their potential, impact on the environment, and future perspective.

description.zh: 基於學生畢業後的生涯發展，本課程目標旨在提供學生清楚認知未來的生涯發展，進而規劃自己的進路。針對設計學生畢業後的發展可以從學術界與實務界兩方面考量，學術界以直升研究所或工作後再修讀在職專班，而實務界則以可從事的相關職場做介紹與分析各行業的特色與前途，可擔任的職務名稱包括：互動設計師、互動程式設計師、使用者介面設計師、互動廣告企劃等，以供學生參考。
description.en: Based on the personal career development,  the course aims to provide a clearly scope and knowledge of future career development. This career can be analyzed in two categories, one is academic field that provide the master program and in-job training program; the another is practical field which concerns about more related design job, such as interaction designer, interactive programmer, user interface designer and interactive advertisement planner. This course not only introduces the design-related job, but also analyzes their characteristics and future development route.

description.zh: 新興數位學習媒體的開發日新月異，再加上資訊存取的高效能數位化，使得科技輔助的數位學習之路更形寬廣、開闊。電子書於知識傳遞的介面上，扮演了關鍵性的角色。傳統上以行為理論推衍而來的人機介面學習模式已然過於狹隘，因為數位時代中的學習者角色已由被動轉為主動，由行為導向轉為認知導向、意義導向以及脈絡導向，而資訊的解讀與詮釋更從單一性、制式化轉為開放性、多元化。對於致力於創新數位學習科技的開發者而言，針對學習者的學習模式重新加以審視是極為迫切的，如此方能以嶄新的角度去開發新的學習潛能和發展性。本課程目的即是從心理學、認知科學及資訊處理的角度來探討新型數位學習模式以及其應用方法，並探討數位學習成效評估系統的建立方案，形塑電子書於知識鴻海的無限可能。
description.en: The rapid development of digital learning and emerging learning technologies, as well as effective information storage platforms, have made traditional learning theory insufficient and less productive in guiding instructional designs for contemporary educational development. New available learning technologies therefore call for the need to re-consider new learning theories. For that, the definitions and mechanism of learning and learners have become more multidimensional and open-ended, instead of being singular and standardized in conventional perception. For those who are devoted to create new technological applications for learning, it is no doubt critical to construct new mechanism of learning in current highly digitized era. This course will discuss relevant cognitive learning theories from research in psychology and education, and contemplate how new e-learning solutions can be evaluated.

description.zh:
以圖像語言的架構教授分析性繪圖 (Analytical Drawing Process) 的概念與操作，以及分析性繪圖在設計速寫上的應用。課程以課堂講解與實地速寫來進行，主題包括感知與理解層面的三維觀察與紀錄、圖解、與圖像筆記。
教學目標為：
1.介紹分析性繪圖與徒手草寫。
2.訓練以徒手草寫的過程來觀察、分析、與記錄結構、空間、與建成環境的三維特性。
3.熟悉感知與理解的圖學系統與速寫表現手法，能以圖像筆記來記錄設計主題。
description.en:
This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.
The objectives are:
1.Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2.Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3.Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

syllabi.outline:
Seeing is a creative process that involves our eyes and mind to transform what we see into what we know, but sometimes the process is reversed—we rely on what we know to interpret what we are seeing. To draw what we see can, therefore, be a process of the interaction of seeing and understanding. The goal of this course will focus on this seeing, thinking, and drawing interaction while drawing architecture on location. This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.

1. Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2. Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3. Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

description.en: This course is a special topics of Photo- Electronic Materials.

syllabi.outline:
本課程專為研究所設計，旨在排除製程干擾，深入探討材料科學理論在光電領域中的核心地位。課程將結合光波特性與半導體科學，解析光電材料在原子與電子層級的行為。內容聚焦於LED、雷射二極體與太陽能電池的材料分類、組織變態與強化機構。課程將特別探討金屬、陶瓷、高分子等奈米複合材料系統 如何影響光電元件的轉換效率。透過分析材料失效原因與防止方法，學生將能從材料本質出發，理解界面穩定性對元件壽命的影響。課程亦包含論文研讀，引導學生追蹤前沿材料研究趨勢。
Specifically designed for graduate students, this course focuses on the fundamental Material Science theories in the optoelectronic and semiconductor field, excluding thin-film manufacturing processes. The curriculum integrates thermodynamic and kinetic reviews to analyze the behavior of optoelectronic materials at atomic and electronic levels. The content focuses on the material classification, phase transformation, and strengthening mechanisms of LEDs, Laser Diodes, and Photovoltaics. We will specifically explore how composite material systems—including metals, ceramics, polymers, and nanomaterials—influence the conversion efficiency of optoelectronic devices. By analyzing reasons for material failure and prevention methods, students will understand the impact of interface stability on device longevity from a fundamental material perspective. The course also includes Paper Reading sessions to guide students in tracking frontier material research trends.

syllabi.outline:
Robotics course is offered to junior or senior undergraduate students interested in learning fundamentals of robotics. In addition to lectures on robotic manipulation, oral presentations and reports on robotics papers are required.  Main topics in the course are as follow.
機器人學適合對機器人領域有興趣的大三或大四大學生修習，除教授機器人學相關學習內容外，鼓勵修課同學閱讀相關論文並演示簡報與撰寫報告，課程相關主題如下：
1. Spatial descriptions and transformations 空間描述與數學轉換 
2. Manipulator kinematics 機械臂運動學 
3. Manipulator inverse kinematics 機械臂反向運動學 
4. EKF-SLAM 擴展卡爾曼濾波器同步定位與建圖  
5. Paper presentation and report 論文簡報與書面報告。

Course handouts will be available via iStudy web. A number of homework questions, based on problem sets in the textbook, will be assigned for students to complete in class in an open-book fashion. Each student is required to make an oral presentation and submit a report based on a technical paper in related topics. 
本課程於每週課前公布講義於北科i學園+，修課同學將於課堂中開卷完成特選作業問題，藉以評估作業及學習狀況。期末簡報應研讀相關論文、撰寫書面報告並於課堂上口頭報告。

description.zh: 本課程旨在為學生奠定紮實的英語文法與句型結構基礎，幫助學生掌握不完整句、連寫句、誤置修飾語、不連結修飾語、錯誤平行結構等關鍵文法知識。於此基礎上，課程將進一步培養學生的段落寫作技巧，包括敘述、描述、闡釋和論證等，使學生能撰寫條理分明、結構嚴謹之段落。
description.en: This course provides a solid foundation in English grammar and sentence construction, helping students master key grammatical elements like sentence fragments, run-on sentences, misplaced modifiers, dangling modifiers, and faulty parallelism. Building upon this grammatical foundation, this course further develops students’ paragraph writing skills through techniques such as narration, description, exposition, and argumentation, enabling students to craft well-structured paragraphs.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to help students learn the correct usage of English grammar and master the paragraph-length writing. It will develop students’ writing skills from expressing an idea into a complete English sentence to organizing ideas into a structured paragraph. Students are expected to be able to use effective definition, description, illustration, argumentation and narration in their paragraph writing. Plenty of discussion will take place in class and active participation is highly required of students.

name.zh: 新聞英語及聽力訓練（二）

description.zh: 本課程目的在啟發學生英語聽力，分析及思辨能力。本課程自報紙，雜誌及電視選取豐富的新聞及媒體教材, 以訓練聽力及筆記的技巧。 此外，在課堂上將討論一些有爭議性的或者有趣的議題，以培養學生獨立思辨能力。
description.en: The course aims to develop the student's techniques of listening, analyzing and critical thinking in English. A variety of journalistic and media texts will be selected from newspapers, magazines and T.V. to reinforce listening training and note-taking skills. Besides, some controversial or interesting issues will be discussed in class to encourage the student's independent and critical thinking.

syllabi.outline: Through listening comprehension of world news, this course aims to engage students in understanding the current international  issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on listening, understanding, discussing and doing news report on selected topics and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

description.zh: 本課程旨在引導學生閱讀英美短篇故事，探討其敘事技巧、情節、人物、觀點和語言等，如何在故事中建構意義，並著重故事所傳達的文化意涵。
description.en: This course will guide students to read short fiction written by British and American authors.  By reading a wide range of short stories, we will examine how such narrative techniques as plot, character, point of view and language construct meaning in stories.  We will also examine what these stories tell us about the cultures that produce them.

description.en: This current course is geared to empower students with the language, knowledge and views of technology industry in order to carry out their career goals. Ample opportunities are provided to understand technological and industrial developments through reading and discussions while building high-level of awareness and proficiency of the English language in use to address realistic scenarios in field industries. The course adopts an integrative approach to accommodate in-depth analysis of technological advances, issues and trends as well as real-life workplace scenarios in technology fields of work.

description.zh: 當代英美流行小說,例如:帶珍珠耳環的少女,時空旅人之妻,姊姊的守護者,暮光之城系列等等,主題推陳出新,內容扣人心弦,有的反應當前的文化議題,有的表現出創新的文學想像,在在都激發著同學們閱讀原文小說的興趣.又由於小說的書寫語言為當今英語世界所使用,沒有年代隔閡,所以原文流行小說也是優良的英語學習材料.在字彙,片語,句型,段落及文章結構,到故事情節發展與深入探討主題的每個層面上,都提供了豐富的素材,供同學們學習觀摩.因此,本課程將挑選不同類型之時下英美流行小說四本,每月一本,規劃進度,在課堂上進行導讀與討論,並加強字彙,句型,與文章結構上的分析,幫助同學們在英語書寫,閱讀技巧,跨文化了解與思辨能力上,獲得最大的進步!
description.en: Contemporary popular novels originally written in English, such as the Girl with a Pearl Earring, the Time Traveler's Wife, and the Twilight, have a strong appeal to readers worldwide, but non-native English speakers often enjoy these works in translated versions or film adaptations.  To encourage our students to read these popular English novels in the original language, the instructor will choose four novels of various subject matters and use them as effective teaching materials in the classroom. The objectives are (1) to enrich students' cultural background knowledge of the English speaking world today, (2) to cultivate students' life-long reading habit of keeping up contemporary materials, and (3) to strengthen their critical thinking as well as language skills, especially reading and writing, through line-by-line close readings in the context and guided discussions on the narrative structures of the whole fiction.

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to understand and analyze contemporary popular English fiction, including novels, novellas and stories, and their film adaptations. It seeks to enhance students’ language proficiency, cross-cultural awareness, and artistic appreciation. Through class discussions, the course also encourages students’ interest and effectiveness in acquiring language abilities and cross-cultural intelligences.
Course activities include:  
(1) Weekly guided reading and introduction of a popular novel (or series), with selected passages read in the original text and related film scenes viewed in class;  
(2) Each student selects a popular novel of their choice and gives two oral presentations: one before the midterm and one before the final exam. In the final project, students present their own analysis or creative reinterpretation.
本課程目的在於了解並分析當今正在流行的英語小說(或長短篇故事)與其改編的電影,以充實同學的語文程度,跨文化素養與藝術涵養,並截由討論促進同學學習語言文化的興趣與效能. 課程進行內容為(1)教授每周導讀並引介一本(或一套)流行小說,帶領學生閱讀原文小說精彩節選並觀賞改編電影精彩片段,(2)每位同學選擇一本自己喜歡的流行小說,期中考前與期末考前作兩次口頭報告,並在(3)期末書面報告呈現自己的解析或是再創作.
syllabi.schedule:
Syllabus:
Week 1: Course Introduction
(1) Introduction to course goals, requirements, and assessment.  
(2) Overview of contemporary popular fiction and film adaptation.  

Unit One: The World of a Child’s Heart  
Week 2: The Tale of Peter Rabbit 彼得兔的故事 by Beatrix Potter
(1) Reading: Selected passages from “The Tale of Peter Rabbit” and related animal stories
(2) Film: Selected clips from an animated or live-action adaptation.  
(3) Focus: Childhood curiosity, mischief, and moral lessons.  

Week 3: The BFG 吹夢巨人 by Roald Dahl
Focus: Child–adult relationships, imagination, and language play.  

Week 4: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland 愛麗絲夢遊仙境 by Lewis Carroll
Focus: Nonsense, fantasy, and the child’s perspective on adult rules.  

Unit Two: The Bravery of a Young Adult  
Week 5: The Maze Runner Series 移動迷宮系列 by James Dashner
Focus: Survival, leadership, and dystopian control.  

Week 6: The Divergent Series 分歧者系 by Veronica Roth
 Focus: Identity, faction systems, and resistance.  

Week 7: The Hunger Games Series 飢餓遊戲系列 by Suzanne Collins
Focus: Spectacle, violence, and political oppression.  

Week 8: The Fault in Our Stars 生命中的美好缺憾 by John Green
Focus: Illness, love, and the meaning of an “ordinary” life

Week 9: Midterm Presentations on the 1st half of student-chosen novel
(1) Each student presents the first half of their chosen contemporary popular Anglo/American novel.  
(2) Content: Author background, brief plot overview, main characters, and initial themes.  
(3) Format: 5 minute oral presentation plus Q&A (time may be adjusted).  

Unit Three: The Strengths of an Adult  
Week 10: The Danish Girl 丹麥女孩 by David Ebershoff
Focus: Gender identity, marriage, and self-discovery.  

Week 11: The King’s Speech 王者之聲 by Mark Logue & Peter Conradi
Focus: Disability, public voice, and political responsibility.  

Week 12: The Silver Linings Playbook 派特的幸福劇本 by Matthew Quick
Focus: Mental health, family, and optimism.  

Week 13: The Kite Runner 追風箏的孩子 by Khaled Hosseini
Focus: Guilt, redemption, and cross-cultural memory.  

Unit Four: Standing Up for Social Justice  
Week 14: The Help 姊妹 by Kathryn Stockett
(Focus: Race, gender, and domestic labor in the US South.  

Week 15: Hidden Figures 關鍵少數 by Margot Lee Shetterly
Focus: Black women mathematicians, NASA, and structural racism.  

Week 16: Pan’s Labyrinth: The Labyrinth of the Faun 羊男的迷宮) by Guillermo del Toro & Cornelia Funke
Focus: Fascism, childhood, and the power of fantasy.  

Week 17: Murder on the Orient Express 東方快車謀殺案 by Agatha Christie
Focus: Justice, truth, and moral ambiguity.  

Week 18: Final Presentations on the Second Half and Interpretation of Student-Chosen Novel
(1) Each student presents on the second half of their chosen novel.  
(2) Content: Development and resolution of plot and themes, comparison with film adaptation (if available), and personal analysis or creative reinterpretation (e.g., alternative ending, character diary, short script).  
(3) Format: 5minute oral presentation plus Q&A (time may be adjusted).
syllabi.assessment:
Percentile distribution of final grades 評分百分比:
1. Attendance and participation in classroom discussions:  50%
3. Midterm and final oral reports on the novel of your choice: 15% X 2 = 30%
4. Final project (written):  20% to be handed in at the last class


Details of the assessment  percentage 百分比細節 
1. Attendance and participation in class discussions 出席與課堂討論參與：50%
（1）Regular attendance (including being on time).  
（2）Active participation in whole-class and group discussions on the weekly readings and film clips.  
（3）Short in-class tasks (e.g., response notes, group summaries, mini language/culture activities).  

2. Midterm and final oral reports on a selfselected novel 期中與期末口頭報告：15% x 2 = 30%
(1) Midterm oral report (first half of the novel): 15%  
(2) Content: author background, context, brief plot of the first half, main characters, key themes.  
(3) Delivery: 5 minutes per student, plus brief Q&A.  

(1) Final oral report (second half + interpretation/creative work): 15%  
(2) Content: development and ending of the novel, theme analysis, comparison with film (if any), and personal analysis or creative reinterpretation.  
(3) Delivery: 5 minutes per student, plus brief Q&A.  

3. Final written project 期末書面作業：20% 
(1) A short analytical or creative paper (for example: thematic analysis, comparison of novel and film, character study, or creative rewriting from another character’s point of view).  
(2) Suggested length (undergraduate level):  
 Analytical paper: about 1,500–2,000 words.  
 Creative project: equivalent length plus a 500–800 word reflective commentary explaining your choices.  


Weekly Class Time 課堂時間規畫  
A possible weekly structure:  
(1) 50 minutes: Close reading of selected passages (language, narrative techniques, cultural elements).  
(2) 50 minutes: Film clips + guided discussion (adaptation choices, visual storytelling, comparison with text).  
(3) 50 minutes: Student centered activities (small-group discussion, short presentations, group worksheets, preparation for oral reports or written projects).

description.zh: 本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。課程內容包含（一）勞作教育理念介紹。（二）勞作教育實作。（三）課堂討論與反思。（四）期末成果分享。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

syllabi.outline:
目標：
期望學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，並從實作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，同時建立學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。

description.en: This course will be concerned with English speech sounds and stress patterns, the use of phonetic symbols for transcribing pronunciation and identifying pronunciation problems. The general principles of English phonology will be introduced.

syllabi.outline: The course provides an introduction to English phonetics. We will focus on the basic acoustic and articulatory properties of English vowels and consonants and learn to transcribe these speech sounds using the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA). This course also covers the general prosodic patterns in English, such as stress, intonation, and rhythm. Upon completion of this course, students will be able to identify their own pronunciation problems and apply this practical experience to English pronunciation teaching.

description.en: This course aims at giving an approach to the study of television, popular music, popular literature such as magazines and best sellers, fashion and movies, as well as an examination into the influence of all aspects of our daily lives on our basic beliefs and values. It involves the use of methodologies from both the humanities and the social sciences in the effort to interpret expressive cultural forms. Students are encouraged to participate in discussion over selected topics from contemporary issues.

syllabi.outline:
在20世紀末和21世紀初，電影、漫畫、電子遊戲等另類藝術形式對我們的文化和日常生活產生了日益深遠的影響。

我們將以電影、電視以及其他流行文化形式（如流行音樂和漫畫）為例，探討流行文化在西方和東方的本質和意義。我們將提出的問題包括：流行文化與學校通常教授的傳統或「優雅」文化有何不同？評價此類作品的標準是什麼？我們是否應該像評價經典作品一樣評價流行文化作品？流行文化作品有好壞之分嗎？流行一定是好的嗎？流行一定是好的嗎？

In the late 20th and early 21st centuries, alternative forms of art – movies, comic books, video games – became increasingly influential in shaping our culture and our daily lives.

Looking at films, television, and other forms of pop culture like pop music and comic books, we will consider the nature and significance of pop culture in the West and in the East.  Among the questions we will ask:  How does pop culture differ from traditional or “high” culture normally studied in schools?  What are the standards for evaluating such works?  Should we value pop culture works in the same way as classic works?  Is there a difference between good and bad pop culture:   Can what is popular be good? Must what is popular be good?

description.en: This is an introductory course aiming to familiarize students with basic concepts, skills and principles of Chinese-English translation. Moreover, the relevance of Chinese-English contrastive analysis to translation practices will be introduced, and students will learn how to apply the linguistic knowledge to practical work. By the end of the course, student will develop useful and appropriate translation strategies to deal with a range of translation tasks.

syllabi.outline: This is an introductory course aiming to familiarize students with basic concepts of translation, including qualifications of good translators, the procedure of translation, use of references & electronic tools and the idea of translation equivalence. Also, the relevance of contrastive studies between English and Chinese to translation will be introduced. A guided application of the linguistic knowledge to practical work will be provided, in the interest of assisting students in formulating suitable and appropriate translation strategies and techniques. This course is intended to prepare students for more specialized translation training.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹英語全球化、不同種類英語的出現，以及英語作為通用語言之發展、相關概念與論述。經由閱讀與課堂討論，學生將有機會檢視與英語全球化和全球英語相關的重要議題。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with an overview of the spread of the English language around the world, the emergence of English varieties, and the development of the popularization of English as a lingua franca. Through readings and class discussion, students will have the opportunity to examine key issues arising from the spread of English as well as the development of Global Englishes.

description.zh: 本課程介紹常用的統計與數據分析方法。課程設計著重跨領域的問題解決能力，學生將學習如何蒐集、處理與詮釋資料，根據具體的案例進行數據分析與報告撰寫，並使用AI工具進行文本分析與數據視覺化。課程結合現代AI技術與語言學的應用，為學生提供跨領域的專業發展，提升其在全球化市場中的競爭力。完成本門課程的學生將能熟悉資料科學領域中主要的統計分析技術，並同時掌握透過編寫程式的方式執行數據分析的能力。
description.en: This course introduces common statistical and data analysis methods, focusing on interdisciplinary problem-solving skills. Students will learn how to collect, process, and interpret data, applying these techniques to real-world case studies. They will engage in data analysis and report writing, utilizing AI tools for text analysis and data visualization. The course combines modern AI technology with linguistic applications, providing students with professional development in interdisciplinary fields. Upon completion, students will be familiar with key statistical analysis techniques in data science and will be able to conduct data analysis through programming.

syllabi.outline: This course introduces students to the practical use of artificial intelligence (AI) for cross-disciplinary data analysis and presentation. Students will learn how to leverage AI tools to collect, analyze, visualize, interpret, and present data in professional and personal contexts. Emphasis is placed on hands-on projects, ethical considerations, and translating AI outputs into actionable insights.

description.zh: 本課程廣泛介紹社會語言學的各個次領域，目的在引導學生瞭解此領域早期的基礎研究與現代的關注議題。學生可藉此認識英語在社會上的運用以及各種社會變因對於語言運作的影響。修完本課程後，學生有能力辨認現代英語的不同語體、解釋語言使用所牽涉到的社會因素、運用社會語言學中適切的研究方法完成語言研究，並能將社會語言學的概念應用到語言教學。
description.en: This course provides a comprehensive overview of sociolinguistic subcategories with the goal of introducing students to both early foundational work and current issues in this field. It provides students with valuable knowledge in the use of the English language in society and the effects of intricate social variables on language operation. Upon completion of this course, students will be able to identify the social varieties of English spoken in the present world, to explain the social factors involved in language use, to use appropriate methodology in sociolinguistics to conduct linguistic research, and to apply sociolinguistic knowledge to language teaching.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以「語言如何產生社會意義」為核心問題，探討語言使用與社會之間的關係。課程聚焦於變異、風格與指涉性（indexicality）、身份與立場的建構，以及語言與權力與意識形態的互動，並透過經典研究與當代個案分析，理解語言如何在實際互動中運作。修課學生將習得語言形式如何指涉不同社會意義，並將相關概念應用於真實語料與當代語言現象的分析。

This course examines how language produces social meaning. Rather than treating language as a neutral system, it focuses on how variation, style, and indexicality are used to construct identity, stance, and social relations. The course draws on both classic studies and contemporary case analyses to explore how language operates in real interaction across different contexts. Students will learn to analyze how linguistic forms index social meanings and how language use reflects and shapes identity, positioning, and power.

description.zh: 生物電化學可以獲得更多先進的訊息，其中包括生化反應、形態學，以及物理、化學和電學等相關性質。運用相關的技術方法，例如電化學工具，可用以研究異相與均相反應，亦可獲得諸多界面間的化學活性和圖譜以利用於微裝置的發展。對生物分析而言，生物電化學感測器具有最大的再現性，並能夠成功的引用於電活性生化物種、母體材料，以及其規格上。生物電分析方法包括最先進和有用的方法，其中大部分皆建立在此領域的的基礎上。
description.en: Bioelectrochemistry can be investigated to get more and more advanced information about biochemical reaction, morphology, and physical, chemical, and electric properties. The techniques have been used in a variety of ways, for example, as an electrochemical tool to study heterogeneous and homogeneous reactions, for high-resolution imaging of the chemical reactivity and topography of various interfaces, and for microfabrication. For bioanalysis, bioelectrochemistry sensors have maximum reliability and can be successfully employed in electroactive biomaterials, matrix materials, and their size. Bioelectroanalysis include descriptions of the most advanced and successful methods, which in large part build on the fundamentals will be described.

Syllabus: This course will teach students kinematic analysis methods, trajectory motion technologies, dynamic analysis methods, and force control methods for manipulators and robot arms. It will enable students to perform robotics research and develop applications in the future. This course first introduces the architectures and industrial applications of various fix-based manipulators and robot arms. Subsequently, this course will cover detailed methods and technologies including kinematic analysis, path and trajectory planning, dynamic analysis, and control design and analysis.

description.zh:
本課程旨在利用電腦模擬與計算工具，深入探討化學工程領域的核心知識，主要涵蓋單元操作及輸送現象（一）至（三）中應用於化工程序設計的兩大重點領域：分離程序與熱整合。

在分離程序部分，本課程以單元操作與輸送現象（三）為理論基礎，通過化工模擬軟體Aspen Plus操作各種單元模型，設計化工廠常見的分離單元。課程內容包含氣體吸收塔、氣提塔，以及連續式與板式蒸餾塔的操作與內部設計，並涵蓋實際案例模擬與數據分析。進階部分將以膜分離為主，介紹客製化模組的設計。

在熱整合方面，課程以單元操作與輸送現象（一）與（二）為理論基礎，通過Aspen Plus模擬實際上的能源再利用及廢熱回收程序，計算常見程序中單元之間的作工與耗能，並介紹熱交換器的單元設計。

此課程對化工系學生而言，將深化單元操作與輸送現象的核心知識，強化單元設計與模擬能力，為頂石課程中的化工程序設計奠定堅實基礎。對於非化工專業學生，本課程則提供通過電腦模擬與計算理解化學工程核心概念的機會，為跨領域學習鋪設基礎。
description.en:
This course aims to utilize computer simulation and computational tools to explore core knowledge in the field of chemical engineering, focusing on two key areas of chemical process design applied in unit operations and transport phenomena (I to III): separation processes and heat integration.

In the separation processes section, the course is based on the theoretical foundations of Unit Operations and Transport Phenomena (III) and uses Aspen Plus to operate various unit models, designing common separation units in chemical plants. The content includes the operation and internal design of gas absorption columns, stripping columns, continuous and plate distillation columns, as well as practical case simulations and data analysis. The advanced section will focus on membrane separation, introducing the design of customized modules.

In the heat integration section, building on the theory from Unit Operations and Transport Phenomena (I and II), the course will use Aspen Plus to simula

syllabi.outline:
課程定位與適修對象：
本課程歡迎化工系大二至大四學生選修，作為加強核心科目理解與研究所考試複習的實用課程。課程也特別歡迎其他理工科系學生跨域選修，透過電腦模擬的方式，直觀理解化學工程中複雜而抽象的理論與系統概念。

本課程不需任何程式或理論先備知識，所涉及的內容皆會重新以淺顯易懂的方式重新講解。針對數位工具與程式不熟悉的學生，將提供ChatGPT 輔助教學與學習策略，引導學生克服學習障礙，發展數位素養與跨領域問題解決能力。

課程目標：
(1) 以電腦模擬與生成式AI工具（ChatGPT） 為輔助，學習化學工程三大核心領域：熱力學、反應工程、單元操作（含熱整合）。
(2) 結合理論與實務，讓學生能透過程式撰寫、圖像化資料分析與模擬介面，直觀理解參數空間與模型本質。
(3) 使用 Aspen Plus 化工模擬軟體進行實際操作與應用模擬，涵蓋分離、反應、熱交換等程序模組。
syllabi.schedule:
此課程設計部分保留彈性，會依學生組成與教學節奏調整：
上學期主題：分離程序（質傳、蒸餾、吸收）

上學期聚焦於分離程序的核心觀念，內容包含：

(1) 質傳現象基本概念（mass transfer fundamentals）
(2) 蒸餾的原理與操作理解
(3) 吸收塔之操作機制與設計直覺
(4) 以自撰程式進行簡化模型推導與可視化
使用 Aspen Plus 進行蒸餾與吸收單元之模擬、比較與敏感度分析

下學期主題：熱傳與熱整合（Heat Transfer & Heat Integration）
下學期聚焦於能量回收與熱整合設計，內容包含：
(1) 熱傳三模式之核心概念與典型應用
(2) 熱交換器操作與基礎設計（LMTD、NTU 方法）
(3) 熱整合的直覺概念與基本流程（如 pinch analysis 入門）

name.zh: 藥用及化妝用高分子材料

description.zh: 本課程在教授學生藥用及化妝用高分子材料之相關產業製程及配方技術的實務知識，課程設計將首先介紹高分子材料的基本合成方法、物理化學性能、界面活性劑、乳化膠體及生物分解安全性。並教授高分子材料之應用區分為兩大類：其一是指在製藥之劑型加工時所用的和為改善藥物傳輸性能而採用的輔助材料(Excipients)，例如稀釋劑、潤滑劑、黏合劑、崩解劑、助流劑、緩和劑、穩定劑、保濕劑、膜包衣及膠囊殼等。藥用及化妝用輔助材料本身並不具有藥理作用，只是在藥品及化妝品的製造和使用中起從屬或輔助的作用。另一類高分子藥物則不同於前一類，它依靠連接在聚合物分子鏈上的藥理活性基團或高分子本身的藥理作用，進入人體後，能與機體組織發生生理反應，從而產生醫療美容或預防性效果。
description.en: The course is to provide the core knowledge for the development of pharmaceutical and cosmetic technology. It aims to educate and train students with the fundamental principles and applications of biodegradable polymers, surfactants, colloids, emulsions and their related physico-chemical properties. Then potential prospects of pharmaceutical and cosmetic polymers will be taught in two parts to help students understand the future frontiers in polymer science and technology. The first part of lectures will cover the wide range of polymer excipients such as diluents, lubricants, binders, disintegrants, glidants, demulcents, stabilizers, humercants, coatings, and capsules etc, which are inactive pharmaceutical ingredients used for assisting drug delivery. The second part will focus on polymer drugs, which are active pharmaceutical ingredients conjugated to polymer matrices such as polymeric micelles, liposomes, colloidosomes, and solid phase nanoparticle

本課程涵蓋:
化妝品實際上是各種學識的利用，除了製造之化學須了解之外，還要知道相關領域的知識，又因皮膚學的發展，對化妝品的安全性、有效性已成為關注的重點。所以有關於化妝品之學識在求學過程有必要更深入的和更專業的了解與討論。化妝品研究的方法、理論依據以及最新的研究結果介紹都是本教學的目的所在。

The main goals of this course are contained the introduction of research methods, basic theory and the newest studied results.

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋了基於各種檢測模式(如化學修飾、電化學、光學與半導體科技)的化學與生醫感測器的基礎知識以及利用電子元件感測生理訊號。 主題包括感測原理、常見的化學感測器、生物感測器、選擇策略、元件設計以及醫療保健、環境監測和工業等領域的應用。課程安排除了感測器文獻之相關課堂討論之外，也會安排學者講座。學生參加所有講座和參加課堂討論是課程的必修部分。
description.en: This course covers the fundamentals of chemical sensors and biosensors based on chemical modifications, electrochemistry, spectroscopy, semiconductor technologies, and physiological electrical signal measurements. Topics include sensing principles, commonly used sensors, strategies for achieving selectivity and adequate limits of detection, design of devices, and applications in health care, environmental monitoring, industry, and military areas. Articles from the current literature are discussed. We will also invite researchers to introduce current research. Active student participation is expected as an integral part of the course.

syllabi.outline:
本課程涵蓋了基於各種檢測模式(如化學修飾、電化學、光學與半導體科技)的化學與生醫感測器的基礎知識以及利用穿戴軟性電子元件感測生理訊號。 主題包括感測原理、常見的化學感測器、軟性電子元件、生物感測器、元件設計以及醫療保健、環境監測和工業等領域的應用。課程安排除了感測器文獻之相關課堂討論之外，也會安排學者講座與幾周的穿戴元件實驗課程。
This course covers the fundamentals of chemical sensors and biosensors based on chemical modifications, electrochemistry, spectroscopy, semiconductor technologies, and physiological electrical signal measurements. Topics include sensing principles, commonly used sensors, strategies for achieving selectivity and adequate limits of detection, design of devices, and applications in health care, environmental monitoring, industry, and military areas. Articles from the current literature are discussed. We will also invite researchers to introduce current research. Active student participation is expected as an integral part of the course.

syllabi.outline: 本課程主要講述切換式電源電路之分析與設計，包含各式電路架構操作原理分析、電路及元件之挑選與設計、PWM控制電路設計以及回授控制器之設計。所分析與設計的電路涵蓋一般的直流-直流轉換器以及具有電氣隔離之轉換器架構、乃是諧振式轉換器等。在課程中亦講述各種交流-直流轉換的功率因數修正器之分析與設計，闡述各種功率因數修正法則以及相關的控制方式。修習本課程之後，期望學生能夠瞭解切換式電源的整體架構以及相關的分析及設計，在畢業進入職場時可以與產業快速接軌。

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to introduce the fundamental concepts and technologies of smart grids, covering the structure, functions, and applications of smart grids in modern power systems. Students will learn about smart meters, renewable energy integration, smart grid standards, and monitoring systems, among other core topics. Through case studies, students will deepen their understanding of smart grids.
本課程旨在介紹智慧電網的基礎概念與技術，涵蓋智慧電網的結構、功能及其在現代電力系統中的應用。學生將學習智慧電錶、再生能源整合、智慧電網標準及監控系統等核心議題，並透過案例研究加深對智慧電網的理解。

description.zh: 本課程就電磁波應用在微波遙測領域做介紹，內容包含電磁波散射理論，隨機散射，輻射轉移方程及分層介質，進而延伸到應用層面對雪地，植披，土壤粗糙面及海洋模型的探討。
description.en: This course introduces the application of electromagnetic waves in the field of microwave remote sensing. The content includes electromagnetic wave scattering theory, random scattering, radiative transfer equations, and layered media, extending to the application aspects of models for snow, vegetation, soil, and ocean.

Week 1~Week4 Scattering and Absorption by a Single Particle (Rayleigh scattering, Born Approximation, Disks and cylinders, Mie scattering)
Week 5~Week8 Fundamentals of Random Scattering (Specific Intensity, Phase Matrix, Passive Remote Sensing)
Week 9 Mid-term
Week 10~Week13 Radiative Transfer Theory (Vector Radiative Transfer Theory, Multiple scattering, Rough surface boundary conditions, Reciprocity)
Week 14~Week17 Rough Surface Scattering g (Small Perturbation method, Perfect Electric Conductor, Dielectric Surfaces)
Week 18 Final

description.zh: 資料探勘是從大量資料中尋找有用的資訊，是一個跨越統計、資料庫和人工智慧的學門。本課程著重在從資料庫的觀點來看資料探勘的意義，並深入探討幾種資料探勘功能及其技術，最後並以實例討論來驗證資料探勘的應用價值。探討議題包括資料探勘概念、資料探勘功能、資料探勘步驟、資料倉儲、決策樹分析集群分析、關聯分析與購物籃分析等。
description.en: The data mining (DM), which involves in Statistics, Database and Artificial Intelligence fields, prospects to seek Useful information from a great deal of data. This course emphasizes at the view of the database, besides go deeply into several data mining techniques. Finally, the practical case studies will also be discussed. The topic includes the concept of DM, the function of DM, the step of DM, data warehouse, Decision Trees Analysis, Clustering Analysis, Association Rule and Basket Analyzes, etc.

syllabi.outline:
Scope: This course is to introduce useful data mining techniques for students. We hope that students can learn more fundamental and advanced skills in the competitive mobile commerce world.
“Necessity is the mother of invention”—Data mining—Automated analysis of massive data sets.
Data mining (knowledge discovery from data) : Extraction of interesting (non-trivial, implicit, previously unknown and potentially useful) patterns or knowledge from huge amount of data.

description.zh:
駭客是一門非常廣泛的學科，涵蓋了廣泛的主題。 本課程將提供駭客攻防的各種概念，並解釋如何在即時環境中使用它們。
本課程將包括駭客的類型，駭客的優勢/劣勢，駭客的目的，駭客的工具，駭客的技能，駭客的流程等。
description.en:
Hacking is a very broad discipline, which covers a wide range of topics. This course will provide the various concepts of Ethical Hacking and explain how you can use them in a real-time environment.
This course will include the type of hacking, advantage /disadvantage of hacking, the purpose of hacking, tools of hacking, skill of hacking, process of hacking, etc.

syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 – Course Overview & Network Foundations
Introduction to network architecture, layering principles, performance metrics (delay, throughput), and system abstraction.

Week 2 – Network Abstractions and Design Principles
Protocol layering, encapsulation, end-to-end argument, and system design trade-off.

Week 3 – Framing and Error Detection
Framing techniques, error detection (CRC), reliable transmission over point-to-point links.

Week 4 – Media Access Control and LAN Technologies
Multiple access protocols, Ethernet, switching, and wireless LAN fundamentals.

Week 5 – Switching and Forwarding
Packet switching fundamentals, store-and-forward, queueing basics.

Week 6 – Routing Algorithms
Distance-vector and link-state routing; shortest-path algorithms.

Week 7 – Internet Protocol (IP)
IP addressing, subnetting, CIDR, IPv4/IPv6, ARP.

Week 8 – Internet Routing and BGP
Interdomain routing, BGP fundamentals, Internet architecture.

Week 9 – Midterm Examination

Week 10 – Transport Layer Fundamentals
End-to-end communication, multiplexing, UDP and TCP overview.

Week 11 – Reliable Data Transfer
Sliding window protocols, flow control, TCP mechanisms.

Week 12 – Congestion Control Mechanisms
TCP congestion control algorithms (slow start, AIMD, fast recovery).

Week 13 – Resource Allocation and QoS
Fairness, scheduling algorithms, quality of service principles.

Week 14 – Distributed Systems and Data Delivery
RPC, distributed storage concepts, content distribution.

Week 15 – Network Security Fundamentals
Threat models, cryptographic foundations, secure channels (TLS).

Week 16 – Application Layer Protocols
HTTP, DNS, email protocols, application design patterns.

Week 17 – Emerging Topics and System Integration
Cloud networking, SDN overview, performance evaluation, student presentations (if applicable).

Week 18 – Final Examination

description.en:
Object-oriented programming languages such as C++ and Java have become the main stream in modern software development. Object-orientation makes flexibility and reuse possible through its characteristics of abstraction, encapsulation, delegation, inheritance, and polymorphism. However, as the scale of software increases, software engineers need an even more powerful tool of abstraction and reuse. Design patterns have been established as the main design techniques to achieve reusable object-oriented design. This course aims to establish this core capability. The student is expected to complete a term project that involves 150 to 200 hours of work off class. 
    The following topics are covered: 
1	Principles of object-oriented programming 
2	Unit testing
3	Design patterns
4	Principles of pattern-oriented design
5	Case studies in pattern-oriented design
6	Pattern languages
7	Case studies in Pattern languages
8	Term project in pattern-oriented design

description.en:
This course aims to guide students understanding cloud environments and IoT systems and their corresponding security requirements. In addition to introducing basic concepts of cloud environment and IoT system, the course contents will focus on OWASP's cloud security and IoT security. All practical techniques will be explained. Students are able to analyze various potential security threats in the cloud and Internet of Things environments, and to learn security protection capabilities for cloud and IoT systems. Course contents including:

●Introduction to cloud technologies
●Introduction to cloud security
●Security standards for cloud services 
●Introduction to IoT technologies
●Potential threats of industrial IoT systems
●Industrial Cyber Security introduction
●IoT security detection
●IoT security standards
●Information security and privacy protection

syllabi.outline:
This course will introduce Google Cloud Computing related technologies and provide students with a comprehensive understanding of Google Cloud platform, architecture, services, and programming through the application of machine learning and IoT in railway systems. The course content includes: 1. Google cloud system architecture, storage network and virtualization technology, 2. Google cloud storage technology, 3. Google cloud scheduling technology, performance and security, 4. Google virtualized data center construction, 5. Google cloud services and enterprise applications, 6. Introduction to IoT technology 7. IoT standards and applications 8. Introduction to Industrial IoT network 9. IoT security and privacy protection 10. IoT internship courses and special projects. Therefore, before the midterm exam, we will mainly introduce the Google cloud system architecture. After the midterm exam, we will start to introduce the Internet of Things and its development trends. In the 11th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security issues and trends. In the 12th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security detection technology. In the 13th week, we will make a special topic at the end of the 14th week. In the 15th week, we will make a special topic at the end of the 16th week. In the 17th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security detection technology and practice. In the 18th week, we will make a special topic report at the end.

description.en: Advanced understanding on color theories and color studies. Cognitive effect and emotional aspect of colors. Discussion on color scheme and color harmonies.

syllabi.outline:
本課程為全英語授課EMI，討論及簡報均需以英語呈現。
色彩的運用在各類設計領域中皆扮演關鍵角色。本課程將介紹色彩理論的基礎，並循序深入探討色彩的基本應用與互動心理。透過案例分析與分組實作活動，學生將更深入理解色彩應用背後的邏輯與思考方式。
課程將以實作為核心，輔以電腦繪圖工具，呈現色彩之間的互動關係。在基本原則的引導下，學生可發揮創意於作品中，展現色彩的互動性與視覺效果。

The application of color plays a crucial role in various design fields. This course will introduce the basics of color theory and progressively cover foundational applications of color and interactive psychology. Through case studies and group hands-on activities, students will gain a deeper understanding of the logic behind color application.
The course will primarily focus on hands-on practice, supplemented by computer graphics to present the interactive relationships between colors. Within basic guidelines, students will infuse creativity into their work, showcasing the interactions and effects of colors.

永續規劃設計是格外需要跨學術領域訓練的過程，因此本課程將提供下列設計專業者必須學習的訓練：
1.	成長與浪費的觀念
2.	生態解法的設計
3.	永續文化與景觀的設計
4.	以設計體現與強化價值的規劃
5.	複合化社會系統的設計
6.	社區營造與健康的設計
7.	省能、輕量、減廢的設計
8.	生產力、土地與交通效能
9.	營建與環境法規
10.	規劃、設計與方案評估
description.en:
Sustainable planning and design is an exceptionally transdisciplinary process. Therefore, This course will provide the following trainings which design professionals must learned:
1.	The concepts of growth and waste
2.	Designing for eco-solutions
3.	Permaculture and landscape design
4.	Values embodied in and reinforces by design
5.	Design within complex social systems
6.	Design for community building and health
7.	Design with less energy, materials and waste
8.	Productivity, land and transport efficiency
9.	Construction and environmental regulation
10.	Planning, design and project assessment

name.en: Special Topics in VLSI Processing Technology

description.zh: 本課程探討現今積體電路製程相關議題，並討論解決方法與技術發展趨勢。內容由淺入深包含製程模組如：晶圓製備、氧化、黃光微影、擴散、蝕刻、薄膜沉積、後段製程等，並深入探討為因應元件持續微縮而提出之先進製程整合技術。學生可了解半導體產業的應用，以作為進入半導體、光電、感測器等相關產業的先備知識。

description.zh:
現代能源工程技術，決定製程成本，故如何統合有效率的能源管理技術是決定產品競爭力的關鍵，本課程主要內容為：
    1.能源成本控制
    2.區域型電力能管理策略
    3.能源系統的經濟性設計概念
    4.冷暖系統的檢測與分析
    5.總合能源操作的工程化資料收集
    6.新能源系統的生態模組化設計
description.en:
At the completion of this course, students will be able to.
1.Compare and contrast the various forms of energy eonversion.
2.Examine the techmologies used to convert chemical energy into mechanical energy.
3.Apply the concepts of electrical converters.
4.Evaluate the major types of energy storage.
5.Deformine how human values affect the success of energy conservation.
6.Analyze the methods in which energy can be conserved with in the various energy sectors of society.

description.zh: 本課程提供所有博士生共同參與研究討論的園地。將進行設計專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。
description.en: This course is a joint seminar for all the doctoral students, which will be progressed by paper presentation of special topics on design issues, giving lectures, and group meeting.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供所有博士生共同參與研究討論的園地。將進行設計專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。論文撰寫、投稿及專題報告
1.人數：全部博士生參與，與授課老師協商指導，需於本學期末之前投稿，提交投出證明，方才取得學分。
2.論文投稿範圍：以最近5年內與論文相關之SCI、SSCI、EI、A＆HCI、TSSCI（如科技部2014年通過之相關TSSCI名單：戶外遊憩研究、地理學報、住宅學報、建築學報、都市與計劃、運輸計劃季刊、運輸學刊、台灣土地研究、歐美研究、藝術教育研究…）或該領域經審查後出版之學術性期刊文章；或國內外研討會。
3.語文：中英文皆可，需於本學期末之前投稿，提出證明，方才取得學分；並請準備演講或報告摘要給同學參考。
4.時間：論文進行定期全班報告，由授課老師共同排定時間；其餘週次，各組帶開，由授課教師進行論文討論。
5.作業討論繳交：論文題目確定、撰寫過程與分組授課老師討論。論文投出後學期結束前，以E-mail繳交全文及投稿證明給所長，由全體授課老師評分。未完成繳交視同期末考缺考，不得補交，成績不及格論。

本課程透過創新科技之電腦，心理學，人機互動應用多學科類期刊文導讀，來建構學生對設計研究者在投稿專業期刊時所應具備的專業背景理論知識的探索，透過廣泛閱讀與師生討論的形式引導學生能夠對其感興趣的研究進行論文撰寫與期刊投稿。建構學生基本概念與專業技能，並引導其發展具有創意潛力的研究題目，訂立，與主題發展，最終引導到資料分析與評估，並讓學生能夠藉由對該研究主題的瞭解與實際操作進而具有撰寫國際頂尖一流期刊的專業能力。

1. 給予修課同學在收集、閱讀及分析學術期刊文獻上的訓練。 
2. 透過現場討論的方式培養積極參與學術活動的動機與辯證態度。 
3. 了解其他學術單位的成就及最新學術發展方向。

本課程之目標為增進研究生之英文表達能力。包含:
1. 此課程主要分成三大部分：(1) 簡報前準備工作和簡報注意要點；(2) 簡報開場、結尾、內容表達技巧；(3) 個人簡歷報告和表達技巧。 2. 課堂中引導學生於課程中探討與分析簡報技巧，比較不同說法的優缺點，同時找出適合自己的表達方式。 3. 除了解說中規中矩的開場簡報說法外，同時分享吸引聽眾注意的開場簡報技巧。 4. 本課程強調「實用性」與「創造性」，為了加強學習過程和效率，將以引導方式讓學生在課堂中有充分練習機會，加深學習印象。

syllabi.outline:
本門課程旨在提供給博士生熟悉並掌握最先進的資料分析技術，以具備與國際頂尖研究型大學博士生相當甚至超越的資料分析能力。課程的第一部分將介紹準實驗設計，幫助博士生掌握因果關係的理念與技術，第二部分將介紹自然語言處理，幫助博士生掌握文字等非結構性資料，並從中獲得寶貴訊息，第三部分將介紹公開資料取得的技術，以掌握全世界的數位足跡以作為研究素材之用，第四部份將介紹人工智慧在數據分析技術上的應用，熟悉並掌握人機協同合作的數據科學家的日常工作，第五部分將介紹LLM在模擬社會科學上的潛力，包括代理人模型等。本課程最終將打開本所博士生的視野，奠定日後在數據科學以及人工智慧時代成為第一流社會科學研究人員的堅實基礎。
This course is designed to provide doctoral students with the opportunity to become familiar with and master cutting-edge data analysis techniques, enabling them to acquire data analysis capabilities comparable to, or even surpassing, those of doctoral students at leading international research universities. The first part of the course introduces quasi-experimental designs, helping doctoral students grasp the concepts and techniques of causal inference. The second part covers natural language processing, equipping students with the skills to analyze unstructured data such as text and extract valuable insights. The third part focuses on techniques for accessing open data, enabling students to harness global digital footprints as research materials. The fourth part explores the application of artificial intelligence in data analysis, training students to understand and master the daily practices of data scientists working in human–AI collaboration. The fifth part introduces the potential of large language models (LLMs) in simulating social sciences, including applications such as agent-based modeling. Ultimately, this course aims to broaden the horizons of doctoral students, laying a solid foundation for them to become first-rate social science researchers in the era of data science and artificial intelligence.

Through the study of this course, students will be able to express their opinions and attitudes towards specific issues through academic paper, and attempt to seek ways to investigate/answer academic research questions.

description.en: To make students able to carry out independent study in master level. Students will be assigned a research topic. An independent experimental design, data analysis, doctoral thesis writing, and paper publication are necessary for this course.

description.zh: 同學們在修過第一年所開的所有的必修課之後，從第三個學期開始，在指導老師的引領下，必須開始著手準備碩士論文的撰寫: 選擇論文題目，收集資料，通過論文大綱審查，開始撰寫論文. . .等等的步驟。從第三個學期開始須修二期之「論文」課程。在論文口試委員們接受該論文並在文件上簽名後，同學們可同時拿到六個學分，完成本碩士課程"論文"這一項的要求。
description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters.  The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis.  After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

description.zh: 研究生在教授的指導下，針對工業設計相關特定研究主題進行研究，並將研究成果寫成論文。其內容包括研究方法、理論分析及研究結果﹙含結論與建議﹚。本課程主要目的在提供學生開啟個人對於工業設計領域相關議題的獨立研究能力。因此，本課程將包含如何建構研究設計、寫作與參考文獻的能力。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete specific research topic under the restriction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis. The thesis focuses on the fields in "industrial design", and includes research methodology, theory background and conclusive result or findings. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. Therefore, the course includes a training of developing research, writing and bibliographic skills.

The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

syllabi.schedule:
Weeks 1-2: Introduction to Presentation Skills for Postgraduates
Overview of the course objectives

Self-assessment of current presentation skills

Adapting presentations for different audiences

Weeks 5-6: Structuring Effective Presentations

Weeks 7-8: Visual Design and Support

Weeks 11-12: Data Visualization and Interpretation

Strategies for engaging and maintaining audience interest

Weeks 17-18: Final Project and Review
Participants create a comprehensive presentation on their research or a relevant topic
Final presentations with peer evaluations
Review of key concepts and skills, with an emphasis on continuous improvement

description.zh: 全球化製造體系的形成，使得合約製造商必須以更積極的態度，從策略面出發，藉由各種電腦與網路的技術，整合內部與外部的流程與資訊，打造數位化工廠。數位化製造的目的，是希望藉由資訊透明化，提升整個製造體系的競爭優勢。課程的設計，是以概念介紹的方式，說明數位製造的應用現況與相關技術。本課程的內容包括：數位化製造概論、數位化製造實例說明、商業模型分析、知識管理、企業知識入口網站、產品資料管理、交易系統、資料倉儲、企業資訊入口網站、工作流程管理、最新數位化相關技術介紹。
description.en: Globalization has lead contract manufactures more active on seeking new strategies to survive. To increase competition, new technologies, such as computer and network technology, have applied. Computer and network technology can integrate internal and external information to establish a so-called "e-factory." This course covers different issues related to e-Manufacturing, such as Concept of e-Manufacturing, Case Study, Business Model Analysis, Knowledge Management, Enterprise Knowledge Portal (EKP), Product Data Management (PDM), Concept of Trading Systems, Concept of Data Warehousing, Enterprise Information Portal (EIP), Workflow Management, State of the Art Technologies, etc.

name.zh: 高等材料性質學與實習
name.en: Advanced Properties of Materials and Related Practice

description.zh: 本課程將深入的討論材料之光電及表面性質，並經由實習實驗量測各種相關特性。尤其是在材料電子理論的應用方面。所涵蓋的主題包括有：電子理論、光學特性、繞射理論、表面科學、以及材料之磁性與熱力學性質。
description.en: After successfully completing this subject a student should be able to: (i) explain the fundamental aspects of electrical properties of materials, (ii) describe and understand energy method, (iii) describe and discuss nanoscale properties of materials, (iv) apply advanced properties of materials to engineering design problems, and (v) execute related measurements.

syllabi.outline:
＊提醒:本課程為全英語授課，對學生英語程度要求高，需要經常以英語回答問題，口頭報告並與外籍生互動，期末考也需以全英語作答。 無法達成上述要求可導致無法順利通過本科目。

＊本課程在一般授課時間外，每位同學也需經常到實驗室做實驗，並在課堂上討論實驗結果做為平時成績。


＊Reminder: This is an international students friendly course. Domestic students are required to use full English to answer questions, do the presentation and write exam sheets.

＊In addition to regular class hours, this course requires frequent laboratory experiments. The experimental results will be discussed in class and will count towards the continuous assessment.
syllabi.schedule:
week 1: Introduction and review of constitutive modeling fundamentals
week 2: Introduction to biochar: Production, properties, and composite applications
week 3: Lab work: Biochar sample preparation and SEM/XRD characterization
week 4: Lab work: FTIR, TGA, and BET surface area analysis for biochar
week 5: MATLAB coding: Data processing for characterization results
week 6: MATLAB coding: Visualization and statistical analysis of biochar properties
week 7: Subroutine code: Material property database design
week 8: Implementation of characterization data into FE material models
week 9: Midterm exam
week 10: Introduction to tensile testing: ASTM/ISO standards and specimen preparation
week 11: PDE constitutive equations for tensile behavior (elastic-plastic response)
week 12: PDE constitutive equations for tensile behavior (damage and fracture)
week 13: MATLAB coding of constitutive equations for tensile behavior
week 14: MATLAB coding of constitutive equations 2 (parameter identification)
week 15: Subroutine code for tensile constitutive models
week 16: Implementation of subroutine code to FE (tensile simulation)
week 17: Summary of course / Repetition
week 18: Final exam(after exam, there will be online discussion)試後線上授課討論
syllabi.assessment:
labwork, research paper writting, inclass report 50%
midterm exam 25%
final exam 25%

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意。
奈米科技與工程的發展、現況與未來。奈米科技現況、奈米工程發展、奈米材料、奈米材料
製程、奈米微粒檢測、奈米材料應用、奈米元件、以及奈米材料之安全性。
description.en:
The subject's purpose is to provide an introduction of Nanoscience, Nanoengineering
and Nanotechnology; Physics and Chemistry and mechanical properties and applications 
of Nanomaterials; Nanofabrication of Nanopowder, Nanopartical, Nanofluid,
functional Nano-Sensing Materials and Nanodevice; development of Nanomaterial 
testing system; as well as the safeties of the Nanomaterial application.

syllabi.outline: 本課程分三單元，包括：(1)奈米薄膜製程與檢測技術：奈米薄膜之定義、種類，奈米薄膜特性與應用，奈米薄膜製程，物理蒸鍍法，化學蒸鍍法，超微結構之觀察、微區/微量之化學組成分析，微奈米材料之機械性質檢測，微奈米材料之磁性、光、電性檢測，微奈米材料檢測所需試片之加工技術。(2)奈米生物科技：細胞生物學，分子細胞生物學，病毒，DNA與蛋白質操控，光電生物技術，奈微米製程技術，生物高分子監測系統整合實例介紹，專題報告。(3)矽奈米電子元件：奈米矽技術簡介，奈米矽元件前瞻物理，各種奈米電子元件可能之應用，奈米矽元件之電特性量測，專題報告。
syllabi.schedule:
第一週    奈米科技簡介
第二週    奈米科技原理及特性
第三週    奈米材料特性—小尺寸效應、體積效應、表面效應、量子效應
第四週    奈米材料性質—光催化性、磁性、光學、熱學及力學
第五週    奈米材料製備方法
第六週   奈米材料加工
第七週   奈米材料檢測分析
第八週   奈米科技在電子、資訊、及光電方面的應用
第九週   期中考試
第十週   奈米科技未來展望
第十一週 奈米科技之應用
第十二週 奈米科技實例分析
第十三週 奈米科技資料蒐集與趨勢分析
第十四週 奈米尺度製程技術
第十五週 奈米級積體電路之製程、電子電路組裝及封裝
第十六週 奈米科技資料蒐集與趨勢分析
第十七週  奈米科技文獻蒐集與未來展望
第十八週  期末考試

name.en: The Software of Electrical Design Automation

description.zh: 本課程在使學生熟悉自動化設計軟體之環境，方法及設計原則，（如高階語言程式設計及電腦輔助電路設計自動化軟體），內容包含（1）VB程式語言介紹 （2）VB之自動化設計領域之應用 （3）spice與pspice電腦輔助電路設計軟體之介紹及應用  （4）電路佈局自動化設計軟體之介紹及應用  （5）期末專題
description.en: This course is let students to familiarize the environments, methodologies and design principle of automation design software ( High level programming language and the automation software of computer-aid circuit design). They are including :1. Introduction to VB programming language. 2. The application of VB in automation design area. 3. Introduction and application for computer-aid circuit design software(spice & pspice). 4. Introduction and application for design automatic software of circuit layout. 5. Final project.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在培養學生以程式語言進行 Web-based 軟體設計與開發的能力。為提升學習成效，本課程與「資料分析與處理」（課號：359221）課程相互結合，本課程內容重點放在程式設計實作與專案開發。透過系統化的訓練與實例開發，學生將能在自動化科技領域中更有效掌握資料分析方法，並培養獨立應用與技術創新的能力。
syllabi.schedule:
Week1: Holiday (no class)
Week2: 課程介紹、Web-based 軟體設計概念、開發環境建置
Week3: 高階程式語言特性與 Web 應用架構概觀
Week4-5: 前端基礎回顧 (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+)
Week6-7: 後端基礎 (Node.js / Python Flask 簡介)
Week8-9: 模組化程式設計與封裝
Week10-11: RESTful API 設計與實作
Week12-13: 前後端整合案例 (AJAX / Fetch / Axios)
Week14-15: 前端框架應用 (React)
Week16: 專題規劃與分組討論
Week 17-18：專題成果展示與測試
