description.zh: 地球自生成以來，其組成與結構一直在改變。今日的岩體即是這種長期改變的結果。地質學是研究岩體組成與結構變化的科學，目的在於掌握這種變化的軌跡，而構造地質學是地質學裡專門研究岩體結構變化的一分科。所謂的岩體結構（即地質構造）是指一個岩體的形狀、尺寸及其內部組成顆粒的排列情形。要了解結構的變化，無論是定性或定量，先要了解岩體的原始結構，從而才能了解現在所觀察到的岩體結構是否發生過變化。雖然構造地質學的目的是由現在既成的結構去了解地球的結構變化，但是就現在地球的結構，我們所能觀察到的岩體結構，大多被植生或土壤所覆蓋，即使偶有露出，也僅是其立體結構的某一表面而已，因此如何利用這些零星有限且是平面的岩體結構去推論地殼整體的結構，是必須首先解決的問題。面對這樣的問題，研究構造地質學應從大處著眼、小處著手，先從了解一個地區某一個露頭的現在結構開始，並由理論及實驗所得的結果推論這個岩體的結構變化過程，再由這些零星露頭的結構及其結構變化過程的資料，去推論、去拼湊涵蓋這些露頭地區的結構，由點而線、由線而面，終而包括整個地殼。
description.en: Structural geology is a branch of earth science. It has developed rapidly over the past decade. The reason for the recent advances in structural geology has been the realization that naturally deformed rocks seen in field outcrops contain a fantastic range of small-scale features which relate directly to large-scale orogenic deformation systems. The other reason has been the realization that rock deformation, like any other form of deformation, obeys well-defined physical and chemical laws. Base on this situation, this course is intended to serve as an accompaniment to techniques-based courses in structural geology or as an accompaniment to the laboratory portion of a postgraduate course. Systematic study of this advanced structural geology course includes several topics: mechanic proporties and deformation behaviors of rocks, strain analysis, ductile geologic structures, brittle geologic structures, and applied structural geology.

Structural geology is a branch of earth science. It has developed rapidly over the past decade. The reason for the recent advances in structural geology has been the realization that naturally deformed rocks seen in field outcrops contain a fantastic range of small-scale features which relate directly to large-scale orogenic deformation systems. The other reason has been the realization that rock deformation, like any other form of deformation, obeys well-defined physical and chemical laws. Base on this situation, this course is intended to serve as an accompaniment to techniques-based courses in structural geology or as an accompaniment to the laboratory portion of a postgraduate course. Systematic study of this advanced structural geology course includes several topics: mechanic proporties and deformation behaviors of rocks, strain analysis, ductile geologic structures, brittle geologic structures, and applied structural geology.

syllabi.outline: 地球自生成以來，其組成與結構一直在改變。今日的岩體即是這種長期改變的結果。地質學是研究岩體組成與結構變化的科學，目的在於掌握這種變化的軌跡，而構造地質學是地質學裡專門研究岩體結構變化的一分科。所謂的岩體結構（即地質構造）是指一個岩體的形狀、尺寸及其內部組成顆粒的排列情形。要了解結構的變化，無論是定性或定量，先要了解岩體的原始結構，從而才能了解現在所觀察到的岩體結構是否發生過變化。雖然構造地質學的目的是由現在既成的結構去了解地球的結構變化，但是就現在地球的結構，我們所能觀察到的岩體結構，大多被植生或土壤所覆蓋，即使偶有露出，也僅是其立體結構的某一表面而已，因此如何利用這些零星有限且是平面的岩體結構去推論地殼整體的結構，是必須首先解決的問題。面對這樣的問題，研究構造地質學應從大處著眼、小處著手，先從了解一個地區某一個露頭的現在結構開始，並由理論及實驗所得的結果推論這個岩體的結構變化過程，再由這些零星露頭的結構及其結構變化過程的資料，去推論、去拼湊涵蓋這些露頭地區的結構，由點而線、由線而面，終而包括整個地殼。

description.zh: 本華語課程規劃為三年制教學，共分三個階段。第一年以基礎華語教學為主，重點包括：發音訓練、基礎字彙、句型與語法，以及日常生活會話。第二年在延續第一年內容的基礎上，強化段落閱讀與書寫能力，並擴展識字量。第三年則著重提升學生的聽力理解、口語表達與語境掌握能力，並融入華人社會與文化的相關內容。
description.en: This Chinese language courde is designed as a three-year curriculum, structured into three progressive stages. In the first year, the focus is on foundational Chinese instruction, including pronunciation training, basic vocabulary, sentence patterns and grammar, as well as daily conversational skills. The second year builds upon the first by strengthening paragraph reading and writing skills, and expanding character recognition. In the third year, the emphasis shifts to enhancing students’ listening comprehension, oral communication, and contextual understanding, while integrating topics related to Chinese society and culture.

description.zh: 本課程提供外籍生所需之商用華語學習，內容聚焦於職場與商務情境，涵蓋求職、面試、會議、書信、人際互動及商業溝通等主題。學生將學習與這些情境相關的常用詞彙、短語與慣用表達，並透過課堂中的實際練習與模擬互動，深化對台灣職場文化與人際關係的理解，培養在職場中有效溝通所需的語言能力與寫作技巧。
description.en: This course is designed to provide international students with essential training in Business Chinese. The content focuses on workplace and business-related scenarios, covering topics such as job searching, interviews, meetings, correspondence, interpersonal interactions, and business communication. Students will learn commonly used vocabulary, phrases, and expressions relevant to these contexts. Through practical classroom exercises and simulated interactions, the course aims to deepen students’ understanding of workplace culture and interpersonal dynamics in Taiwan, while developing the language skills and writing techniques necessary for effective professional communication.

name.en: Development of Simulation Tools  for Engineering

description.zh:
電腦模擬是解決現今工程問題不可或缺之工具，但常用的商業模擬軟體不但價格昂貴，其功能常不足以應付前瞻研究所需。本課程旨在培養學生設計專業領域之模擬程式與分析工具的能力，強化軟體開發工程實務的素養。

課程訓練分兩階段進行：
第一階段確認學生具備基本程式設計能力。首先使其熟悉 Linux 平台及開源軟體的使用，運行不須理論基礎的簡易粒子模擬，針對收集到的數據進行統計分析，資料視覺化，資料定量分析及洞察等任務。以任務導向的學習方式，刺激同學針對特定問題和需求而快速擬定演算法，系統性地解決問題。
第二階段將模擬工具開發的能力應用在各科系的專業上。在進行短暫的文獻回顧後，與修課學生討論其專業領域中可用模擬解決或加速的學術研究及產業問題。針對主題制定計畫內容後，以選定的程式語言撰寫相關的應用程式，並以開發成開源軟體為最終目標。
註一、課程函授上以 GNU Fortran 和 Python3 為主要程式語言選擇，但學生可自由選擇所熟悉的語言作為工具。
註二、修課基本條件為修畢工程學院各系一年級程式設計相關之基礎課程，且具基本撰寫程式的能力。
description.en:
This course aims to provide complete training for developing modeling and simulation tools in engineering applications. Students will obtain the ability to analyze problems, formulate algorithms, write code, and implement the developed 
open-source programs in their fields of study. 
The first part of the training focuses on task-oriented coding experiences. Students will get familiar with the Linux platform and open-source programs. They will perform simple, particle-based simulations. The collected data will be analyzed, visualized, and interpreted based on the programs written by students.
The second part of the training applies the coding knowledge to students’ fields of study. After the literature survey, students will select the topic based on theirexpertise, where research or industrial problems can be accelerated by computer modeling. The final goal is to create software based on the course project.

syllabi.outline:
本課程著重學術研究能力的培養，為降低跨領域學習門檻，已大量去專業化，各系同學皆可選修。但為避同學程式基礎差異過大，不建議電資學院同學選修本門課。

電腦模擬是解決現今工程問題不可或缺之工具，但常用的商業模擬軟體不但價格昂貴，其功能常不足以應付前瞻研究所需。本課程旨在培養學生設計專業領域之模擬程式與分析工具的能力，強化軟體開發工程實務的素養。

本課程依循探究式教學的架構，分兩階段進行：

第一階段先簡介工程模擬的概念，引導同學思考自身專業裏需要解決的問題，以及如何以工程模擬輔助問題的解決。每週會選讀各專業裡工程模擬論文，並批判性思考論文提供資訊的可信度和影響性。最終將會提出一個簡短的報告書，說明想要研究的題目，需要使用的模擬軟體，預計要進行的分析和結果。

第二階段確認學生具備基本程式設計能力。首先使其熟悉 Linux 平台及開源軟體的使用，運行不須理論基礎的簡易粒子模擬，針對收集到的數據進行統計分析，資料視覺化，資料定量分析及洞察等任務。接著就進行各組所決定之特定的模擬軟體，以任務導向的學習方式，刺激同學針對特定問題和需求而快速擬定演算法，系統性地解決問題。在此階段亦會導入生成式AI的使用，減少撰寫程式或腳本所需的時間。

1. 課程介紹及分組 (week 1)
2. 模擬在工程上的應用 (week 2)
3. 文獻選讀和討論 (week 3 4 5 6)
4. 計劃書撰寫與討論 (week 7 8)
5. 期中報告 (week 9)
6. WSL平台介紹，Linux基本指令，開源軟體及生成式AI使用 (week 10)
7. 模擬實作 (week 11)
8. 開發程式實作 (week 12)
9. 計畫相關模擬及分析 (week 13 14 15 16 17)
10. 期末成果報告 (week 18)

期末成果報告: 30%

syllabi.notes:
化工系同學可配合本課程完成一份系所規定的專題報告。可於大三上先向授課老師簽署專題指導三聯單，並於大三下選修本課程。須注意：若未達成本課程的最低要求，課程學分與專題學分皆可能無法取得（確實有前例）。

若同學有意申請研究所，建議至規模較大的研究室進行系統性的研究。本課程所配合完成的報告較偏向啟發性，並非完整研究任務，加上模擬技術門檻較高，不易作為研究所甄試的書審資料。

相關問題可於選課前與老師討論，確認符合自身需求後再決定是否選課及進行專題。

另外，為避對本人以教學資源挹注研究有所疑慮，特此聲明：本課程的唯一目的在於培養學生獨立研究的能力。本課程所有學生的研究題目皆由學生自主決定，並會先了解學生未來希望加入本校或他校的哪個研究室，再依該領域安排電腦輔助的研究學習。本人從未將本課程學生的學習成果用於論文發表或計畫申請。

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養工程領域學生對數值方法的基本概念與實作能力，並透過 MATLAB 軟體實際應用數值計算技術，為後續工程模擬與專業計算奠定基礎。課程內容涵蓋單變數與聯立方程組之數值解法、內插與曲線擬合、數值微分與積分，以及常微分方程與邊界值問題的數值方法。學生將學習如何運用計算機解決工程上的數值分析問題，並建立數值方法與工程應用的連結，提升對模擬計算的理解與應用能力。本課程適合作為工程數學後的延伸，適用於未來進行專業計算、研究或產業應用。
description.en:
This course introduces numerical solution techniques for nonlinear equations, systems of equations, curve fitting, calculus, and differential equations, which are essential for solving engineering problems. The MATLAB software serves as a platform for implementing numerical methods, enabling students to develop computational skills applicable to engineering analysis and simulation.
Students will gain hands-on experience in applying numerical techniques to real-world problems, bridging the gap between theoretical mathematics and practical engineering applications. This course provides a foundation for advanced computational methods used in engineering research and industry.

syllabi.outline: 本課程教授工程領域常用之數值方法與原理，包含非線性方程式、聯立方程式、曲線配適、微積分及微分方程式等之數值解答技巧，並在電腦輔助下（使用MATLAB）解決工程上之問題。
syllabi.schedule:
第1週: 數值方法緒論
第2-3週: MATLAB軟體使用簡介
第4-6週: 單變數方程式之數值解與最佳化
第7-8週: 聯立方程式之解
第9週: 期中考
第10週: 非線性聯立方程式數值解
第11-12週: 曲線配適與內差法
第13-14週: 微分與積分
第15-16週: 常微分方程式的數值解
第17週: 微分方程之邊界值問題解法
第18週: 期末考

name.zh: 人工智慧與工程應用實作
name.en: Artificial Intelligence for Engineering Applications in Practice

description.zh: 本課程探討人工智慧(AI)與工程應用相關議題，並討論其解決方案與技術發展趨勢。內容由淺入深，包含基礎python程式設計、資料預處理、資料探索、機器學習、深度學習、AI工程應用介紹(分子性質預測、設備預測性維護、混凝土強度預測，PM2.5預測、房價預測等案例應用分析)及專題製作。在本課程中，學生可了解AI之基本原理及AI在工程上的應用，本課程也藉由AI程式撰寫的實作實習，提昇工程背景學生撰寫與理解AI應用程式設計的技能，以幫助學生將人工智慧導入產業應用實務中。
description.en: This course will introduce artificial intelligence (AI) and its applications in engineering fields. Topics covered include basic python programming, data prepossessing, data exploration, machine learning, deep learning, AI applications in engineering fields (e.g. predicting molecular properties, predictive maintenance predicting compressive strength of concrete, prediction of PM2.5, and prediction of house price, etc.) and final project. Students can learn about the basic principles and engineering applications of AI. Coding will be required to improve their programming competence in AI. The course intends to help the students implement AI concepts in their industrial practices.

syllabi.outline:
在人工智慧與機器學習技術飛越成長的當代，人工智慧應用已經普及到了民間，其不再具有技術與設備上的高度門檻與進入障礙，只要擁有入門等級的程式語言基礎，以及尚佳的電腦硬體設備，再加以自備的資料集合，人人都能夠應用人工智慧來解決各式各樣的問題。

本課程以工學院的應用角度出發，先以數週進行基礎python程式語言的訓練，再逐步以案例及實作讓修課學生體驗各種基於影像、文字或結構化資料的人工智慧應用。讓修課學生能夠理解基礎的深度學習理論，標記自己準備的資料集合，並且善用python程式語言進行資料的前處理，完成訓練、進行預測與評估成果。

In recent years, with the rapid advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, AI applications have become widespread among the general public. People no longer have barriers on techniques and equipment. With basic programming skills and affordable computer hardware, along with self-prepared datasets, anyone can leverage AI to solve a variety of problems.

From the perspective of engineering applications, this course begins with fundamental Python programming training. After that, through case studies and hands-on projects, students will experience various AI applications based on images, text, or structured data. The course aims to enable students to understand fundamental deep learning theories, label their own datasets, and effectively use Python for data preprocessing, training models, making predictions, and evaluating results.

7-10     資料的前處理：結構化資料、文字與圖像	
9	期中提案報告
10-17    python人工智慧套件應用（散佈在10-17週，每週0.5-1小時）
11-12	CNN：捲積神經網路與其衍生模型
12-13	RNN：循環神經網路與其衍生模型
14-15	seq2seq與Encoder/Decoder
16-17	Attention機制與Transformer
18	期末報告

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋了基於各種檢測模式(如化學修飾、電化學、光學與半導體科技)的化學與生醫感測器的基礎知識以及利用電子元件感測生理訊號。 主題包括感測原理、常見的化學感測器、生物感測器、選擇策略、元件設計以及醫療保健、環境監測和工業等領域的應用。課程安排除了感測器文獻之相關課堂討論之外，也會安排學者講座。學生參加所有講座和參加課堂討論是課程的必修部分。
description.en: This course covers the fundamentals of chemical sensors and biosensors based on chemical modifications, electrochemistry, spectroscopy, semiconductor technologies, and physiological electrical signal measurements. Topics include sensing principles, commonly used sensors, strategies for achieving selectivity and adequate limits of detection, design of devices, and applications in health care, environmental monitoring, industry, and military areas. Articles from the current literature are discussed. We will also invite researchers to introduce current research. Active student participation is expected as an integral part of the course.

description.zh: 熱傳學主要內容是研究由於溫度梯度所造成能量傳遞之一門學問﹐為一般冷凍、空調、食品冷藏及各類型熱交換器設計之基本知識程,其他大如各類發電廠，小如電腦微晶片散熱亦有密切關係。本課程之安排以奠定學生在熱傳方面之智能，作為未來進入冷凍、空調與能源相關學門之踏腳石。
description.en:
1.	熱傳導定律之推導
2.	一維及多維的穩態與暫態熱傳分析，
3.	散熱片之設計，利用數值方法解熱傳導問題，
4.	對流原理之推導
5.	強迫對流方面的分析及應用-層流邊界層，管道內層流熱傳
6.	自然對流方面的分析及應用-管道外與封閉空間內自然對流        熱傳
7.	紊流的基本性，紊流邊界層，管道內紊流
8.	具相變化的熱對流:凝結與沸騰
9.	熱交換器設計介紹
Advanced Heat Transfer  Credit: 3 

Course Outline
1.	Derivation of heat conduction principles 
2.	One and multi-dimentional steady and transient heat         conduction analysis
3.	Heat transfer from extended surfaces, numerical heat         conduction analysis
4.	Derivation of convection principles 
5.	Forced convection - laminar boundary layers and     laminar heat transfer in ducts
6.	Nature convection over external surfaces and in internal enclosures 
7.	Fundamentals of turbulence, turbulent boundary layers, turbulent flow in ducts
8.	Heat transfer with phase change: boiling and condensation
9.	Introduction to heat-exchanger design

description.zh: 本課程著重冷凍系統和空調系統能源的分析，探討構成系統的主要元件－壓縮機、蒸發器和冷凝器的耗能，和各泵、冰水盤管、空調箱及風／水管路系統的能源耗損，進而對整個系統運轉時的效率予以檢討。最後提出各種改善方法，節約能源和減少電力契約容量的技術，以使學生具有節能省電的正確理論觀念和實務技術。
description.en:
This lesson is focused on the energy analyses of refrigeration systems and air-conditioning systems. The operating defects of compressors, evaporators and
condensers are to be investigated. Also the energy consumption's of pumps, fan coils air-handling units and duct/water systems are studied. The over all performance of the entire system is thus discussed. Several methods to improve the shortages and the techniques to energy conservation and electricity demand cut-down will be proposed.
The students should understand correctly the theory of energy conservation and the
technology to improve the systems.

description.zh: 本課程將有系統的介紹專業英文論文的寫作格式，以及文件編修的技巧，且用深入淺出的例子作為示範，並輔以實際寫作練習與錯誤訂正。學員學習研究論文組織寫作，包含修改本身論文結構之基本技巧﹐正確組織文章的各個片段，避免口語用字寫字的陋習，使所作之文章能掌握其涵意，亦即能更有效率的利用英文寫出科技論文之佳作。
description.en: The goal of English Technical Writing is to help students developing the writing skills through the manipulation of scientific and technical data. Students will learn a variety of rhetorical principles that guide the writing process, apply these principles to scientific and technical writing, and write papers in their own academic fields. Lectures on the writing principle, students' presentations on the reading sections and follow-up activities, pair and individual work on writing practice will be the major activities in the class.

This course aims to provide students with a practical foundation in environmental engineering and the management of international standards, establishing core concepts of relevant ISO environmental frameworks. Through regulatory analysis and practical exercises, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of facility environmental governance and corporate net-zero transformation. The goal is to equip students with practical skills in environmental engineering management, enabling them to align with industry sustainability development needs.

description.zh: 衛星遙測應用與實作的課程主要介紹衛星遙測技術的基本原理、應用場景和實作方法。課程內容通常包括以下幾個方面：衛星遙測基礎知識，衛星遙測數據來源和平臺，衛星遙測數據處理與分析，衛星遙測應用案例，衛星遙測應用實作。本課程一半以上的時間將為實作，學生將熟習在遙測分析軟體上分析真正的衛星資料，並在學期末遞交對自選主題之一研究報告。
description.en: The course of "Applications of Satellite Remote Sensing" mainly introduces the basic principles, application scenarios, and practical methods of satellite remote sensing technology. The course content usually includes the following aspects: basic knowledge of satellite remote sensing, satellite remote sensing data sources and platforms, satellite remote sensing data processing and analysis, satellite remote sensing application cases, and satellite remote sensing application practices. More than half of the time in this course will be spent on practical exercises, where students will become proficient in analyzing real satellite data using remote sensing analysis software. At the end of the semester, students will submit a research report on one of their self-selected topics.

衛星遙測應用與實作的課程主要介紹衛星遙測技術的基本原理、應用場景和實作方法。課程內容通常包括以下幾個方面：衛星遙測基礎知識，衛星遙測數據來源和平臺，衛星遙測數據處理與分析，衛星遙測應用案例，衛星遙測應用實作。本課程一半以上的時間將為實作，學生將熟習在遙測分析軟體上分析真正的衛星資料，並在學期末遞交對自選主題之一研究報告。
The course of "Applications of Satellite Remote Sensing" mainly introduces the basic principles, application scenarios, and practical methods of satellite remote sensing technology. The course content usually includes the following aspects: basic knowledge of satellite remote sensing, satellite remote sensing data sources and platforms, satellite remote sensing data processing and analysis, satellite remote sensing application cases, and satellite remote sensing application practices. More than half of the time in this course will be spent on practical exercises, where students will become proficient in analyzing real satellite data using remote sensing analysis software. At the end of the semester, students will submit a research report on one of their self-selected topics.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to Satellite Remote Sensing
Course introduction, grading criteria, and syllabus overview.
Fundamentals of Satellite Orbital Mechanics (LEO, MEO, GEO).
Introduction to the Electromagnetic Spectrum.Distinctions between Passive (Radiometer) and Active (Radar) remote sensing systems.

Week 2: Microwave Signal Theory (I) - Propagation and Channel
Maxwell’s Equations and mechanisms of electromagnetic wave propagation.
Calculation of Free Space Path Loss (FSPL).Atmospheric Absorption, Atmospheric Windows, and Polarization effects.

Week 3: Microwave Signal Theory (II) - Signals and Waveforms
Baseband vs. Passband signals: Principles of complex signals (I/Q Data).
Analog and Digital Modulation techniques (AM/FM, ASK/FSK/PSK).
Radar Waveform Design: Pulse and Linear Frequency Modulation (LFM/Chirp).

Week 4: Transmitter and Receiver Architectures
RF Front-end Architectures: Superheterodyne and Zero-IF (Homodyne).
Analysis of Key Components: Low Noise Amplifier (LNA), Mixer, and Power Amplifier (PA).
Practical calculation of Link Budget.

Week 5: Antenna Theory and Remote Sensing Applications
Antenna Parameters: Gain, Beamwidth, and Directivity.
Fundamentals of Array Antennas.
Geometric principles and resolution formulas of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR).

Week 6: Midterm Analysis Report (Case Study)
Group Presentations: Reverse engineering and simulation analysis of microwave parameters for active remote sensing satellites (e.g., Sentinel-1, FORMOSAT-5/7).
Review, feedback, and discussion.

Week 7: Instrumentation Lab (I) - Signal Generator
Instrument interface operation and safety regulations.
Lab 1: Generating standard Continuous Wave (CW) and Pulse Modulated signals.
Lab 2: Simulating satellite channel effects (Multipath Fading and Doppler Shift).

Week 8: Instrumentation Lab (II) - Spectrum Analyzer
Principles of frequency domain measurement (RBW, VBW settings).
Lab 3: Analyzing Signal Harmonics and Spurious emissions.
Lab 4: Measuring Occupied Bandwidth (OBW) and Carrier-to-Noise Ratio (C/N Ratio).

Week 9: Instrumentation Lab (III) - Vector Network Analyzer (VNA)
Understanding Microwave Network Parameters (S-Parameters).
Lab 5: Performing Calibration and S-parameter measurement.
Lab 6: Antenna impedance matching measurement and Bandpass Filter frequency response testing.

Week 10: Midterm Technical Assessment (Hands-on Exam)
Practical Exam: Utilizing the three instruments mentioned above to perform complete specification verification and data logging for a designated microwave module (e.g., a specific LNA or Filter).

Week 11: Introduction to Software Defined Radio (SDR)
Analysis of SDR Hardware Architectures (AD9361 / PlutoSDR / USRP).
Development Environment Setup: GNU Radio Companion (GRC) and MATLAB/Simulink SDR Support Package.

Week 12: SDR Signal Acquisition Implementation
Lab 7: FM Broadcast Demodulation (The "Hello World" of SDR).
Lab 8: Satellite Signal Practice — Receiving NOAA weather satellites or simulated laboratory Beacon signals and observing I/Q Constellation diagrams.

Week 13: FPGA Fundamentals and Digital Logic DesignFPGA Internal Architecture (LUTs, Flip-Flops, DSP Slices, BRAM).
Quick review of Verilog HDL syntax and Finite State Machine (FSM) design.
Introduction to the Vivado development flow.

Week 14: Digital Signal Processing (DSP) on FPGA
Lab 9: Concepts of Parallel Processing and Pipeline Design.
Lab 10: Implementing Digital Filters (FIR Filter) on FPGA.
High-speed ADC/DAC interface control and Data Buffer (FIFO) design.

Week 15: SDR and FPGA Integrated Implementation (I)
Zynq Architecture (PS + PL) Data Flow Design.
Lab 11: Implementing Digital Down Converter (DDC).
Lab 12: Implementing Hardware-Accelerated Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) modules.

Week 16: SDR and FPGA Integrated Implementation (II)
Deployment of Advanced Algorithms.
Lab 13: Impl

description.zh:
為培養土木工程系大學部學生瞭解設計圖中內容，本課程採用實務的教學方式，以工程師實際面對的建築設計圖、結構設計圖、土木設計圖及機電設計圖等，加以解說圖面內容並引導學生理解設計涵義及實作演練。並結合工程知識、營建工程實務操作及專案管理領域整合的能力，使學生畢業後與業界無縫接軌。本課程主要內容如下:
1.熟悉一個工程或建案中必備之完整圖面內容
2.熟悉設計圖上各種符號、線條之用處及表示的意義
3.結構標準圖、配筋圖與施工規範之解說
4.如何依設計圖進行工程品質之查驗
5.其他與勞工安全相關知識等
description.en:
To improve undergraduate civil engineering students to understand the design drawings reading ability.  This course provides a set of design drawings, such as building, structural, civil and MEP design drawings, for instructors to explain the meaning of the design drawing, and guide the students to read the related drawings. The course also includes practical exercise for students to read the drawings, and to understand the information in the drawings. The course will also involves the knowledge of engineering to enhance the integration ability of all the design drawings for the students. The contents of this  course are listed as below:
1.To familiar with the whole set design drawings.
2.To familiar with the meaning of symbols, lines and expression in the design drawings.
3.To understand general notes, general drawings, reinforcement and specification in structural design drawings.
4.How to inspect the construction quality by the design drawings.
5.Other topics about labor-safety

description.en: Economics can be said to be satisfaction of wants by the allocation of scarce factors. Construction economy introduces various methods of financial cash flow to analyze the priority of infrastructures. Moreover, it provides a systematic framework for evaluating the economic aspects of competing design solutions.

syllabi.outline: This course builds a conceptual understanding of economic decision-making for civil engineering projects. It introduces selected microeconomic ideas that support engineering choices and develops the core reasoning framework of engineering economy for evaluating and comparing alternatives. Realistic civil engineering examples are used to reinforce decision logic and interpretation.

description.zh: 本課程旨在學習運用AI資料分析與生成技術，結合文化內容設計與產業案例研究，發展具策略性的文化創意提案。課程內容涵蓋文化議題研究、AI應用方法與數據敘事技巧，並透過探討AI驅動的行銷活動，培養學生在文化產業與社群溝通中的影響力。
description.en: This course aims to develop students’ ability to apply AI-based data analysis and generative technologies in combination with cultural content design and industry case studies to create strategic cultural and creative proposals. The curriculum covers cultural issue research, AI application methods, and data storytelling techniques. By examining AI-driven marketing practices, the course fosters students’ capacity to enhance their influence in cultural industries and community communication.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在運用生成式 AI 進行文化議題研究、資料分析、敘事創作與策略制定，引導學生從文化觀點出發提出具創意與意義的文化內容提案。課程內容涵蓋 AI 輔助的文化資料蒐集、文化洞察萃取、視覺與影音生成、策略地圖建立與競賽實作。學生將以 A+ 文化資產競賽為核心任務，完成文化創意作品之策略分析、企劃與呈現，並於期末發展升級版文化創意提案。
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
This course introduces the application of generative AI in cultural research, data analysis, narrative creation, and strategic development. Students will learn how to integrate AI-assisted cultural data collection, insight generation, visual and video content creation, and strategic mapping into cultural creative proposals. Centered on preparing submissions for the A+ Cultural Heritage Competition, the course guides students in producing culturally grounded creative works supported by analytical strategies. By the end of the course, students will present an enhanced cultural innovation proposal demonstrating their capability in AI-driven cultural storytelling and strategic communication.

name.en: The technology and application of solar thermal energy system

description.zh: 本課程目的為訓練學生獲得在太陽熱能系統與製程應用領域上高階智識理論。課程教材含蓋數種太陽熱能轉換系統用以產生電能、熱水、冷暖氣與照明等用途，主要內容包括太陽輻射幾何學、追日型太陽能聚光器、太陽能史特靈發電系統、太陽能熱水器、太陽能冷暖氣系統、太陽能海水淡化、太陽能照明系統等等章節。期使學生未來能實際應用於各種不同太陽熱能轉換系統之規劃與設計。
description.en: This course aims to give graduate student a resource on the advanced principles and application of solar thermal energy system and processes. The material presented in the course covers several technologies for the conversion of solar thermal energy to provide electricity, hot water, heating, and desalination. The course outline mainly includes analysis of solar geometry and radiation, performance of sun-tracking solar concentrating collectors, solar stirling power system, solar water heating system, solar space heating and cooling system, solar optical lighting system. It hops that the student can apply the learned knowledge to the plan and design of many types of variable solar thermal energy system in year to come.

syllabi.outline:
太陽能熱能工程應用，是一門利用太陽能之能量來提供人類能源之科學，太陽能為取之不盡用之不絕，且為乾淨又穩定之來源，在油價高漲且地球環境保護需求日益殷切的今日，太陽能之能源應用，已成為今日最熱門之學科。本學科之教學目標，在使學生了解基本之太陽能轉換為熱能、電能及照明之基本原理，並且經實際之能量轉換過程,以及熱力學之運用, 使學生對以太陽能為熱源之機械設備,如太陽能熱水器、太陽能冷凍空調設備、太陽能發電機、太陽能電池、太陽能照明設備等之應用，作深入之瞭解與認識，並可對相關產品做能量之計算及規劃設計,以使學生日後能為相關產業提供基礎人才。
本科目將由認識太陽、地球與太陽互動關係、地球上太陽能之基本熱輻射理論，結合各種不同形式之利用太陽能源有效裝置，討論太陽能之有效利用方式及相關系統技術。以期在既有太陽能利用技術上，發揮更有效率的太陽能源工程系統設計，奠定未來21世紀太陽能源利用之高效率化基礎。本門課主要為太陽能應用的原理分析及系統設計，課程內容包括太陽熱能系統的熱力熱傳及流體力學分析與系統設計、成本分析(為主)；太陽能光電系統的組成與設計分析(為輔)。

The application of solar thermal energy engineering is a science of using solar energy to provide human energy. Solar energy is inexhaustible, and it is a clean and stable source. Today, when oil prices are rising and the demand for environmental protection is increasing, The energy application of solar energy has become the most popular subject today. The teaching goal of this subject is to enable students to understand the basic principles of the conversion of solar energy into heat, electrical energy and lighting, and through the actual energy conversion process and the application of thermodynamics, to enable students to understand mechanical equipment that uses solar energy as a heat source, such as solar energy. In-depth understanding and understanding of the application of water heaters, solar refrigeration and air conditioning equipment, solar generators, solar cells, solar lighting equipment, etc., and energy calculation and planning and design of related products, so that students can provide for related industries in the future Basic talents.
This subject will discuss the effective use of solar energy and related system technologies by understanding the sun, the interaction between the earth and the sun, and the basic thermal radiation theory of solar energy on the earth, combining various effective devices for using solar energy sources. It is hoped that in the existing solar energy utilization technology, more efficient solar energy source engineering system design will be used to lay the foundation for the high efficiency of solar energy source utilization in the future 21st century. This course is mainly for the principle analysis and system design of solar energy applications. The content of the course includes thermal heat transfer and fluid mechanics analysis of solar thermal energy system and system design, cost analysis (mainly); composition and design analysis of solar photovoltaic system (secondary)

description.zh: 基礎地盤若是軟弱土壤(例軟粘土,泥炭土,鬆砂土填土等)所構成時,則無法安全承載其上面建築物結構物,土堤等之載重,並且受交通車輛,機械振動地震等之動力作用亦最容易發生剪力破壞,滑動破壤及過大沈陷等安全問題.因此,對於這些軟弱土壤之工程性質要加以改善的必要. 1.軟弱地盤之定義,種類與影響 2.軟弱地盤之調查目的及調查種類 3.軟弱地盤之調查方法與步驟 4.軟弱土壤性質之測定 5.軟弱地盤之改良方法(包括夯實工法,排水工法,預載重方法,動力壓 密工法,爆破工法,振動揚實工法,注入工法,石灰穩定工法及其他穩定工法).
description.en: Soil Improvement is very important for embankments and foundations in construction engineering.This course deals with the following subjects:1.definition of soft ground 2.types of soft soil.3.investigation methods of soft soils. 4.improvement methods of soft ground(include compaction method,dewatering method,preloading method,dynamic consolidation method,vibrofloation method,injection method and soil-lime stabilization method.)

syllabi.outline: Ground improvement plays a crucial role in enhancing the stability and performance of problematic soils in construction engineering. This course explores key concepts, including ground improvement measures such as compaction, dewatering, preloading, vibroflotation, soil grouting, and soil-lime stabilization, all of which are essential for strengthening weak soils and ensuring the safety and longevity of construction projects.

description.zh: 給水及污水工程介紹自來水及汙水工程及其操作系統所需之原理、設計工具。其主要應用到流體力學、水文學、水處理及相關之設計及計算。主要的議題包含水質參數、地表水及地下水處理、自來水處理過程、汙染物移除、管網設計、汙水處理、生物處理、下水道建設、自來水及下水道操作及維護。
description.en: The Water Supply and Sewerage provides students with engineering principles and tools for designing and operating water and sewerage systems. It facilitates application of knowledge acquired in fluid mechanics, hydrology, water quality, design and computing. Key topics include water quality parameters; groundwater and surface water treatment; water treatment process technologies; nutrient removal; simplified sewerage; decentralised water and sanitation systems; biosolids management; and operation and maintenance of water supply and sanitation infrastructure.

syllabi.outline:
給水與污水工程是土木與環境工程中重要的基礎工程課程。給水工程為自來水工程，從水源取水、導水、淨水到配水，包含一連串的工程技術與方法。污水工程則是將廢污水淨化處理，至符合國家放流水標準後排出的過程。兩者處理對象與目的不同，但其中淨水處理有相似的技術與方法。本課程著重在淨水工程部分，也是兩者的核心技術。而給水工程中的取水與輸配水屬於水利工程，本課程僅簡要介紹。淨水處理包含物理、化學、生物處理技術，根據廢污水特性以及處理目的可選擇不同的淨水方法，或者相互搭配使用以達到效率與成本等要求。本課程將說明各種處理技術的核心理論以及計算，使學生未來具有污水處理設計之能力。
Water supply and wastewater treatment engineering is the core course in the civil and environmental engineering. Water supply engineering includes series technologies from water intake to allocate water to citizens. To determine the place to intake water, to transport water, to purify water and to allocate the clean water are the missions of water supply engineers. Wastewater treatment engineering is to treat wastewater to the required concentration standard. The two engineering have different subjects and different goals. However, the water purification and wastewater treatment has the similar methods, which is the core technology in the two engineering and also the core content in this course. The methods about water withdraw and transportation belong to hydraulic engineering and is briefly introduced in this course. The wastewater treatment methods can be divided to physical, chemical, and biological methods. The use of these methods to achieve legal requirement and minimum cost and high efficiency is the mission of engineers. In this course, the theorem of the treatment methods and the associated calculations will be explained, in order to equip the student to capable of designing wastewater treatment.

description.zh: 由於重大工程建設陸續開發，對環境之衝擊也日益明顯，因此環境影響評估制度之建立與執行也極為迫切，環境影響評估確能有效抑制開發工程中所可能形成的污染行為，本課程之目的即在介紹環境影響評估制度的演進、各國相關之評估法制、環境影響評估之應用、評估方法（專家委員法、圖形重疊法、矩陣法及網路法）、評估流程及環境影響評估之追蹤考核等單元，期使選修者，對環境影響評估建立正確和科學的認知。

name.en: Start to APP Design and Application

description.zh:
學習相似於Microsoft Power Point 的「拖-拉-點-選」操作方式，再加上一小部份的 Low Code程式編碼，即可以設計與製作出:「專業級的 APP」 !
本課程運用學校內的雲端平台: AgilePoint NX，改變了以往撰寫APP 的模式，不再需要撰寫複雜的程式碼，讓學生專注於 APP的邏輯流程與UI(使用者介面)，進而發展貼近市場裡的商業模式，設計出精彩的APP!
課程的教學，採用傳統臺北工專的黑手工程師訓練模式:
「由經入史」:先講解理論架構，進而延伸到產業的實務運用。
嚴格要求上課同學動手實做，達成每週的設定目標。課堂上講師所示範的範例非常豐富，下課後會有一定份量的Homework(實作型作業)。
經此系統化訓練，在APP的設計與製作上，將擁有踏實的內涵與技術，增強在校學生，未來在職場上的競爭力。
「讓不懂IT(資訊工程)、非理工背景的學生，更能設計出高人氣的APP! 」
description.en: Learn the "Click and Drag" operation method, as like Microsoft Power Point, and adds some Low-Code, you can design and create: "Professional APP"!This course uses the cloud platform in the school: AgilePoint NX, which changes the mode of writing APP in the past, no longer needs to write complex code, let students focus on the logic flow of the APP and UI (user interface), and then close to the market requirement. This course uses the Taipei Tech Practical-Engineer training method:"From Theory to Practical": First explain the theoretical structure, and then extend to the practical application of the industry. Through this systematic training, in the design and production of APP, we will have practical connotation and technology to enhance the competitiveness of students in college and the future in the workplace."Let students who don't understand IT (information engineering) and non-technical backgrounds can design great and popular APPs!"

Through this systematic training, in the design and production of APP, we will have practical connotation and technology to enhance the competitiveness of students in college and the future in the workplace."Let students who don't understand IT (information engineering) and non-technical backgrounds can design great and popular APPs!"

description.zh: 生命科學概論，重心放在人體生命科學，並強化醫學的角色。此外，中西醫結合的觀點，詮釋抗老、防癌。以身心靈養生的方式，強化預防醫學。並從人類疾病的本源性病因，根本探討。當然，如何增強免疫力，袪除自由基是主軸。在探究人體潛能、身心靈養生或疾病的本源性原因時，都必須重視「經絡」系統。總之生命是非常奧妙的，不僅只物質面，更要重視心靈層面，中西醫整合方向，必是廿一世紀的主流。
description.en: This course focuses on human life science and emphasizes the roles of medicine on improving the life quality of human beings. It also uses the point of view of integration traditional Chinese and western medicine to interpret how to prevent the aging of body and occurrence of cancers. This course also focuses on how to keep the body, mind and spirit in the best conditon in order to prevent the occurrence of human diseases. In addition, it deeply discusses the eseential etiology of human disease and teaches audiences how to enhance the body immunity and how to get rid of free radicals. The importance of meridian system of the human body and its relationships to human potentiality, body, mind spirit and diseses are also discussed. Life is marvelous. The completeness of life depends on the saisfaction of not only the material but also menetal and spiritual needs. Integration of the traditional Chinese and western medicine to improve the life quality of human beings is the main issue.

syllabi.outline:
The knowledge of life sciences is closely related to us. College students should have basic knowledge of the life sciences. There are all kinds of living things on the earth we live in, each consisting of basic life units-the cells, which evolve into various organisms to form diverse biological species. Human beings appear to be “advanced” in some way; however, we share many similarities to other creatures, including cell structures, biochemical and physiological pathways, nutrient acquiring processes, disease production manner, etc. Studying the science of life help us to learn how to make a better way to live on, for example, diagnosis and treatment of diseases, drug invention. Another important point is, we must respect other species as the earth is shared by everyone.
107-2 Study goal 本課程的學習目標

2. To study various areas of the life science 生命科學的各種領域
3. New scopes on life science 生命科學的新發展

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。

description.zh: 本課程將帶領同學從兒童詩、繪本、小說、電影來品味兒童文學的真、善與美，藉此喚醒被世俗蒙塵的沉睡心靈，以重返純真的赤子心境。 教學方式以互動為主，期待藉由討論兒童文學名著，閱讀相關論文，來帶領同學進入兒童文學的殿堂。 除了閱讀與討論之外，還會教導同學創作；創作的內容含括了兒童詩及手工繪本製作。希望透過作品的完成，來喚起學生的創作興趣，並建立學生創作的信心。
description.en: This course will lead the students to read the poems, picture books, novels and films of children literature, and hope to find out the beauty of the children's world. Wish in this way can help the sleeping soul to wake up, and return to pure childhood state. This course will try to lead the classmates to appreciate the children's literature by discussing and questioning the masterpieces, hope in this happy way to help the students to get enter the children's literature. Besides reading and discussing, the course will also teach students how to write. The content of writing course would include the poem and the story which would ask the students to finish the work by themselves. Hope through the works, can arouse students' creation interest, and build up students' confidence of creation.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將帶領同學從兒童詩、繪本來品味兒童文學的真、善與美，藉此喚醒純真的赤子之心。 教學方式以互動、活潑的方式進行，除了閱讀與討論之外，還會教同學創作；創作的內容含括了兒童詩及手工繪本製作。這學期的主題會聚焦在情緒繪本，希望同學在能透過閱讀繪本來梳理自己的情緒。看見情緒、陪伴情緒，然後以健康的方式來回應，避使用責備或疏離的應對。期待在這小班級的共創中，大家都能自然而然地產生情緒療癒。

This course guides students to appreciate the truth, goodness, and beauty of children’s literature through children’s poetry and picture books, awakening the innocence and clarity of a childlike heart. The class will be conducted in an interactive and lively manner. In addition to reading and discussion, students will also engage in creative work, including composing children’s poems and producing handmade picture books.

This semester’s theme centers on emotion-focused picture books, encouraging students to use reading as a way to sort through and understand their own emotions. By learning to notice and accompany their feelings—and to respond in healthy, compassionate ways rather than with blame or emotional withdrawal—students will cultivate emotional awareness and resilience. Through the collaborative spirit of this small seminar, the course hopes to naturally foster emotional healing and growth.

syllabi.outline: This course provides a focused treatment of short-circuit analysis for modern power systems. Students will learn how to model system capacity, evaluate short-circuit currents, and apply multiple analytical techniques for fault studies. Emphasis is placed on comparing classical methods, interpreting system behavior through per-unit and MVA approaches, and reinforcing concepts with practical industrial examples. The course is intended to strengthen analytical capability so that even simplified calculations can produce reliable system assessments. Applications include three-phase and single-line-to-ground fault studies, fault-level estimation during transient conditions, and the use of computational tools for fast system evaluation.

syllabi.outline:
高等資料庫系統是一門深入探討資料庫設計、開發及管理的課程，旨在提供學生一個全面性的資料庫知識。課程從基本的實體關係模式開始，逐步介紹關聯模式、關聯代數和關聯計算等資料庫設計理論。隨後，課程將深入探討SQL的應用，包括資料定義語言、資料處理語言和資料控制語言，讓學生掌握實際操作資料庫的技能。同時，課程也會涵蓋資料庫正規化、功能相依性等重要概念，以確保學生的資料庫設計能力。在課程中期，課程將引入更進階的主題，如NoSQL資料庫、分散式資料庫和儲存技術，以及複雜的資料類型。此外，課程也會探討其他類型的資料庫系統，如物件導向資料庫、XML資料模型與語言等，並介紹檔案結構和索引技術，與交易管理、並行控制和資料庫回復技術等議題。在課程的最後階段，學生將根據自己的興趣和能力進行一個期末專題的設計和開發，並展示他們的作品。本課程融合理論和實務，讓學生獲得全面的資料庫知識和實際操作能力，為未來的資料庫管理和開發工作做好準備。
Advanced Database System is a course that provides an in-depth exploration of database design, development, and management, aiming to offer students a comprehensive understanding of database systems. The course begins with fundamental concepts such as the Entity-Relationship (ER) Model, and progressively introduces database design theories, including the Relational Model, Relational Algebra, and Relational Calculus. Subsequently, the course delves into the practical use of SQL, covering DDL, DML, and DCL, enabling students to acquire hands-on skills in database operations. Important concepts such as database normalization and functional dependencies are also addressed to strengthen students’ database design capabilities.
In the middle stage of the course, more advanced topics are introduced, including NoSQL databases, distributed databases, storage technologies, and complex data types. The course also explores other types of database systems, such as object-oriented databases and XML data model and languages, and covers file structures and indexing techniques, as well as transaction management, concurrency control, and database recovery techniques.
In the final stage of the course, students will design and develop a final project based on their individual interests and skill levels, and present their work. By integrating both theoretical foundations and practical experience, this course provides students with a broad database knowledge and practical skills, preparing them for future employment in database management and development.

description.en: This course is designed for practical application of robotics and artificial intelligence (AI). It adopts the project-based learning model inspired by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). The course combines lectures, discussions, practical applications, and case studies to provide students with an in-depth understanding of AI and robotics technology. Students will have the opportunity to engage in group projects, apply their knowledge in real-world scenarios, and gain hands-on experience with machine learning tools and robot platforms.

The course covers the subjects on Hill-Climbing Algorithm, Simulated Annealing, Genetic Algorithm, Particle Swarm Optimization, Artificial Bee Colony and so on.

syllabi.outline:
自然界的進化行為一直人類賦予計算機智慧學習的對象，但仿效自然界中生物間的適應性過程，建構出的龐大模型，一直是在一項艱鉅的挑戰，但不諱言的他的回報也是巨大的。進化計算便是基於生物遺傳學、自然選擇和出現的適應性行為等進化機制，建立出來的智慧型模型，以利智慧系統的建立。本課程將介紹各項演化計算方式，並以實作的方式實際了解彼此間的差異。
The evolutionary behavior of nature has always been the object of learning that man has endowed computer intelligence with. However, the construction of huge models that emulate the adaptive processes among organisms in nature has been a difficult challenge, but the rewards have been enormous. Evolutionary computation is an intelligent model based on evolutionary mechanisms such as biological genetics, natural selection, and emergent adaptive behaviors to facilitate the establishment of intelligent systems. This course will introduce the various evolutionary computation methods and provide a practical understanding of the differences between them in a hands-on manner.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹美國專利制度與美國專利法。由於美國為案例法國家，故除介紹美國專利法之35 U.S.C. §§101-103 and §112等重要法規外，並以相關case law說明美國專利法的實質內涵與精神。修習本課程之學生，於逐步學習到閱讀法律英文之方法後，期於完成本課程時，具有獨力閱讀美國專利案例之能力。
description.en: This course will introduce the U.S. Patent Act and cases, including 35 U.S.C. §101-103, 112, as well as the patent system. Students are expected to read assignments before the class, so that they can answer questions and join discussions in class. Students are expected to learn how to read legal English durning the course and able to read patent cases on their own.

syllabi.outline:
授課對象：法律與非法律碩士生
教學目標： 
1. 精準解構美國專利法（35 U.S.C.）核心實體要件。
2. 掌握法律英文閱讀法。
3. 培養拆解聯邦法院判決書與長篇法學評論（Law Review）之邏輯分析能力。
本課程將介紹美國專利制度與美國專利法。由於美國為案例法國家，故除介紹美國專利法之35 U.S.C. §§101-103 等重要法規外，並佐以相關case說明美國專利法的實質內涵與精神。
本課程將分成I、II，而以兩個學期之時間，對美國專利法做普遍性的閱讀。於每次上課前，將指定相關法規與案例，學生需自行於課前閱讀，並於上課時參與討論與回答問題。
syllabi.schedule:
第一階段：法律淵源與專利說明書結構 (Weeks 1-4)
第 1 週：Introduction to U.S. Legal System
Stare Decisis、聯邦法院位階（District, CAFC, SCOTUS）。
第 2 週：美國憲法淵源 (Constitutional Foundation)
第 3 週：專利行政與 AIA 改革 (USPTO & AIA)
第 4 週：專利說明書結構解析 (Anatomy of a Patent)
第二階段：專利要件「案例」深度導讀 (Weeks 5-11)
第 5 週：可專利客體 (§ 101 Subject Matter Eligibility)
第 6 週：新穎性與現有技術 (§ 102 Novelty - Part I)
第 7 週：新穎性之阻卻與預期 (§ 102 Novelty - Part II)
第 8 週：非顯而易見性基礎 (§ 103 Non-obviousness - Part I)
第 9 週：非顯而易見性之演進 (§ 103 Non-obviousness - Part II)
第 10 週：揭露要件之書面敘述 (§ 112 Written Description)
第 11 週：揭露要件之據以實施 (§ 112 Enablement)
第三階段：法學評論 (Law Review) 研討 (Weeks 12-17)，聚焦學術爭論與政策影響。
第 12 週：§ 101 適格性之學術辯論
第 13 週：§ 102 AIA 法案與現有技術界定
第 14 週：§ 103 法律虛構人物 PHOSITA 之分析
第 15 週：§ 112 揭露義務與生技創新平衡
第 16 週：制度批判：專利質量與「理性忽視」
第 17 週：AI 時代與全球專利法未來

2、本課程將從專利基礎觀念開始出發，故沒有專利基礎、其它系所同學，仍可選修此課。上課主要內容為英文文獻，雖不禁止同學使用AI工具於課堂上或課餘，然於本學期結束，期望同學即便無AI協助下，仍具有獨力閱讀英文案例與分析能力。

description.zh: 為保障著作人著作權益，調和社會公共利益，促進國家文化發展，國家特制定著作權法；本課程重心在於介紹我國著作權法之內涵，包含該法所保護之「著作」範圍、權利人及著作權範圍、著作權管理及權利侵害之救濟等，除講授理論外，同時搭配案例解析，以期讓同學對著作權法有最完整之了解。
description.en: Copyright Act is specifically enacted for the purposes of protecting the rights and interests of authors with respect to their works, balancing different interests for the common good of society, and promoting the development of national culture. This course introduces the main meanings, concepts and contents of the Copyright Law. Including the scope for copyright protection, the kinds of works that qualify for copyright protection, the rights granted to copyright owners, the management of copyright, and remedies for right infringement. The discussion in the course covers theory and examples, to enhance a deeper understanding of Copyright for the students.

description.zh: 本所與美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院，已於112年5月10日簽署國際學術交流MOU，而本所為響應學校推動國際化之政策，特別增開1門1學分之國際雙師課程。本課程乃由美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院院長Megan Carpenter教授、該學院智慧財產權中心主任Micky Minhas教授親自來台密集授課，主要提供給欲深入了解美國法律制度、美國智慧財產權法律體系之本所學生、校外實務界人士或欲對赴美留學有興趣人士來選修。而本課程之內容，共分成兩個部分，前半部將以美國法律(包括法院、普通法、各部門法律等)之介紹為主，至於後半部則詳細介紹美國智慧財產權各部門法律(包含著作權法、專利法、營業秘密法、資料保護、商標法等)。而本課程之開課時間，以每學年度上學期之10月上旬，並為期1週為原則。當然，本課程開設之目的，乃以增強學生實際應用英語之能力，並以加強學生美國智慧財產權法律之知能為主，除了強化本所與美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院之學術交流關係外，更能夠擴展休課學生之國際人脈及視野。
description.en: Graduate Institute of Intellectual Property, National Taipei University of Technology (hereafter called this institute) had made a MOU of international academic cooperation with Franklin Pierce School of Law, University of New Hampshire on May 10, 2023. description.zh: 以案例解析為主的方式，探究我國著作權法的重要課題，藉以協助同學了解審判實務適用法律的依據、判準或論證等，並適時補充國外相關學理、判決及著名案例等，以增進同學對國內外相關重要著作權案例之思辨及評析的能力。
description.en: This is a course focused on case analyses, in studying important issues relating to Taiwanese Copyright Act. Graduate students joining this course may find help on comprehension of the basis, rules or argumentation to the laws applied in trial practice.  Together with timely supplementation of relevant foreign academic interpretations, adjudications and noted cases, students may improve their ability of contemplation and analysis on related and significant copyright cases home and abroad.

description.en: This course is mainly aimed at introducing the data structures commonly used in programming languages which include ADT (abstract data type) and complexity, static structures and their storage representations, arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, recursion, sorting, and searching.

name.en: The Study of Intellectual Property Crime

description.zh: 本課程主要係以「與貿易有關之智慧財產權協定(Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights，TRIPS) 」的內容為基準，分別再以比較法的觀點，探討我國專利法除罪化的問題；商標法、著作權法及營業秘密法如何以刑事罰適切保護智慧財產的課題，藉以釐清及調和違反智慧財產權的刑、民事責任。
description.en: Conducted on the basis of “Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights, TRIPS,” the course will probe into the issue of exemption of punishment among the Patent Act of Taiwan from different viewpoints of Trademark Act, Copyright Act, and Trade Secret Act. To clarify and mediate the criminal and civil liabilities originated from the violation of intellectual property right, the proper method to protect intellectual property with criminal punishment will be further discussed.

syllabi.outline: Copyright Act is specifically enacted for the purposes of protecting the rights and interests of authors with respect to their works, balancing different interests for the common good of society, and promoting the development of national culture. This course introduces the main meanings, concepts and contents of the Copyright Law. Including the scope for copyright protection, the kinds of works that qualify for copyright protection, the rights granted to copyright owners, the management of copyright, and remedies for right infringement. In particular, what are copyright protections applied with AI? The discussion in the course covers theory and examples, to enhance a deeper understanding the exchanges between copyright protections and AI for the students.

description.zh: 區塊鏈和數位資產是未來金融和科技領域的重要趨勢之一，本課程將介紹區塊鏈以及數位資產的基本知識與原理，並探討如何利用區塊鏈以及比特幣技術搭建新型態的金融基礎設施與永續的生態系統，內容包含 (1) 區塊鏈基礎；(2) 比特幣運作原理；(3) 穩定幣等數位資產；(4) 比特幣進階，含閃電網路、側鏈、智能合約層、永續挖礦…等；(5) 實體世界資產 (RWA，Real World Asset)；(6) 區塊鏈分析；(7) 法規與監管…等，為參與課程的學生建立正確的區塊鏈與數位資產的觀念。
description.en: Blockchain and Digital Asset are one of the important trends in the future of finance and technology. This course will introduce the basic knowledge and principles of blockchain and digital assets, as well as explore how to use blockchain and Bitcoin technology to build a new type of financial infrastructure and sustainable ecosystem, the content includes (1) Blockchain basics; (2) Bitcoin operating principles; (3) Digital assets such as stable coins; (4) Bitcoin advanced including Lightning Network, Rootstock, Stacks, sustainable mining...etc. (5) Real World Asset (RWA); (6) Blockchain analysis; (7) Regulations and supervision... etc., to establish a correct concept of blockchain and digital assets for students participating in the course.

syllabi.schedule:
第 1 堂：課程簡介
●	課程大綱：每周課程內容說明。
●	評分標準：學期成績計算說明。
●	雙聯學制：與新加坡南洋理工大學區塊鏈碩士學程合作說明。
第 2 堂：區塊鏈與金融科技概論
●	金融科技版圖：集中式帳本 vs 分散式帳本，在支付、清算、融資裡的痛點。
●	區塊鏈基本結構：區塊、鏈、節點、共識與去中心化的直覺。
●	公鏈、私鏈、聯盟鏈在金融機構裡可能扮演的角色。
第 3 堂：密碼學基礎與公私鑰機制
●	雜湊函數、非對稱加密、數位簽章的基本概念與用途。
●	公私鑰、地址與授權：一筆交易「為什麼」代表資產所有人同意。
●	助記詞、私鑰生成與備份的實務風險（釣魚、惡意錢包、社工等）。
第 4 堂：帳戶模型、UTXO 與錢包實務
●	帳戶模型 vs UTXO 模型：餘額計算邏輯與代表公鏈。
●	交易輸入輸出範例，了解「找零」與 trace 資金流。
●	熱／冷錢包、硬體錢包、單簽、多簽、MPC 錢包的基本概念與使用情境。
第 5 堂：比特幣設計與金融定位
●	比特幣的設計目標：點對點電子現金與「數位黃金」敘事。
●	區塊結構、PoW 共識、挖礦與安全性（51% 攻擊等）的直覺。
●	比特幣在支付、價值儲存上的優缺點，與法幣、黃金、支付網路的比較。
第 6 堂：以太坊與智能合約入門
●	以太坊帳本與 EVM：EOA／合約帳戶、Gas 與交易結構。
●	智能合約的概念、常見應用（ERC-20、簡單治理合約等）。
●	DApp 架構：前端、合約、節點／RPC 的分工。
第 7 堂：國定假日
第 8 堂：DeFi 與穩定幣
●	DeFi 的定位：從 CeFi 到 DeFi，基礎設施與技術堆疊。
●	AMM 與 DEX：流動性池、價格曲線、滑價與無常損失的直覺。
●	借貸協議：超額抵押、清算機制與利率形成。
●	穩定幣在 DeFi 中的角色：抵押物、交易媒介、風險傳染來源。
第 9 堂：外部講師＿金融機構區塊鏈與數位資產策略
講者：銀行/金控數位金融部門、虛擬資產合規長、交易所高管。

第 10 堂：DeFi 高階應用與代幣經濟
●	衍生品協議：槓桿、永續合約、結構化產品等基本機制。
●	收益聚合、流動性挖礦與「Money Legos」組合性概念。
●	代幣經濟學：治理代幣、激勵設計、常見失敗模式（龐氏、死亡螺旋）。
第 11 堂：支付、跨境匯款與實務案例
●	公鏈跨境匯款流程與成本結構，與 SWIFT／傳統 remittance 的對照。
●	商戶收單、薪資發放、供應鏈金融等鏈上支付案例。
●	銀行與金控如何實驗 tokenized deposits、鏈上結算或區塊鏈投資產品。
第 12 堂：區塊鏈／DeFi 安全、監管與未來趨勢
●	常見攻擊：閃電貸攻擊、價格預言機操縱、智能合約漏洞、橋接攻擊。
●	合規與監管：VASP、交易所與 DeFi 協議涉及的 KYC／AML、證券／商品認定等。
●	DAO 與治理、L2、RWA、ZK 等未來趨勢的簡介與職涯／研究方向。

第 13 堂：外部講師＿DeFi／Web3 創業與產品實務
講者：DeFi 協議團隊、Web3 錢包 / 基礎設施創辦人或 PM、資安研究員。

第 14 堂：穩定幣發展趨勢與金融業策略應對
●	穩定幣的定義與基本概念。
●	穩定幣的發展歷史。
●	穩定幣的種類與央行的數位貨幣。
●	穩定幣的應與未來展望。
●	金融產業的策略應對。

第 15 堂：RWA 代幣化實戰應用設計工作坊(上)
●	RWA先備知識。
●	生成式AI應用方式及技巧。
●	國際應用案例解析。

第 16 堂：RWA 代幣化實戰應用設計工作坊(下)
●	RWA代幣化設計五大面向。
●	分組設計任務。
●	分組簡報與評分。

第 17 堂：期末分組專題報告(上)
第 18 堂：期末分組專題報告(下)

description.zh: 資訊安全保險相關事故的理賠調查，使得數位鑑識在金融或資訊領域的重要性日益提升。數位鑑識與調查課程主要說明如何找到入侵或犯罪留下的可能的足跡，並介紹如何在合法與符合鑑識程序規範的前提下蒐集足夠的證據並保護這些有用的證據，以做為未來訴訟有效的佐證。在課程的設計上將以數位鑑識相關國際證照的領域與內容為主，除了教授學生數位鑑識的專業知識外，期能輔導學生取得數位鑑識相關證照。
description.en: The cyber security incident investigation for the cyber insurance has made digital forensics more and more important in the financial or information industry. This course focuses on identifying possible footprints of intrusions or crimes and collecting sufficient evidence and protect such useful evidence in order to be effective in future litigation. In the design of the course, the domain and content of the digital forensics international certification licenses will be mainly used. In addition to teaching the professional knowledge of digital forensics, it can also help the students obtain digital forensics certification in the future.

name.zh: 文化研究與跨文化溝通

description.zh: 文化研究以文學，社會批評，通俗文化，人類學、科學、女性主義和種族批評等觀點，對文化現象做深入的觀察、思考、及批判。本課程著重應用文化研究之豐碩成果，啟發學生認識文化問題，並培養其觀察，思考，及批判能力。不僅能因之促成社會進步，更重要的是能藉由對本國及異國文化差異及價值觀的深入瞭解，將知識應用在跨文化溝通上，協助本國企業成功地國際化。
description.en: Cultural studies is emerging as one of the most inspiring and exciting fields in and out of the academy.  Drawing its energies from literary and social criticism, popular culture, anthropology and the sciences, feminism and critiques of race, cultural studies involves an infinite number of ingenious, politically contingent, and often popularly amusing subjects.  Hopefully, students taking this course are trained to become independent, critical thinkers who are able to observe, analyze, criticize, and ameliorate culture.  By addressing diverse cultural issues, students can not only deepen their understanding of different cultural values but also apply this knowledge to improve cross-cultural communication.  One of the practical purposes of this course is to enable students to help local enterprises boost their business on the global stage of commerce.

description.zh: 本課程設計為讓初學者了解並能分析在現今市場環境下，企業所面臨的財務問題。課程涵蓋企業資本評價的基本模型，包含企業金融資產的定價模式、實體資產評價與投資專案分析、資本結構分析，以及其他企業在資金管理與財務規劃預測的相關議題。目的在讓參與者對『財務決策對公司表現和價值的影響』有更深刻的認識。
description.en: The course develops theoretical framework for understanding and analyzing major financial problems of modern company in market environment. The course covers basic models of valuation of corporate capital, including pricing models for primary financial assets, real assets valuation and investment projects analysis, capital structure and various types of corporate capital employed, derivative assets and contingent claims on assets. It provides necessary knowledge in evaluating different management decisions and its influence on corporate performance and value.

syllabi.outline:
本課程設計為讓初學者了解並能分析在現今市場環境下，企業所面臨的財務問題。課程涵蓋企業資本評價的基本模型，包含企業金融資產的定價模式、實體資產評價與投資專案分析、資本結構分析，以及其他企業在資金管理與財務規劃預測的相關議題。另外，為了讓企業經理人了解衍生性金融商品，本課程亦以深入淺出方式介紹選擇權之基本觀念、交易實務與決策應用。本課程目的在讓參與者對『財務決策對公司表現和價值的影響』有更深刻的認識，培育理論與實務兼備之財務管理人才

The course develops theoretical framework for understanding and analyzing major financial problems of modern company in market environment. The course covers basic models of valuation of corporate capital, including pricing models for primary financial assets, real assets valuation and investment projects analysis, capital structure and various types of corporate capital employed, derivative assets and contingent claims on assets. In addition, in order to let corporate managers understand the derivatives, this course introduces the basic concept of option, transaction practice and decision-making applications. The purpose of this course is to provides knowledge in evaluating different management decisions and its influence on corporate performance and value, so as to cultivate financial management talents with both theoretical knowledge and practical skills.

description.zh: 新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。 新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。 課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en: Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously. The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

syllabi.outline: 在現今產業激烈競爭與利潤微薄之階段，落實執行"突破創新"以增加競爭力之唯一生存之道，但鮮少有企業真正瞭解與實際地徹底執行它。不僅工程或服務技術要創新，管理思維更要突破創新，以有效迅速解?錯綜複雜的研發、工程與管理之諸多矛盾問題。本課程以創新構思問題解?法(TRIZ)為基礎，詳細介紹工程技術如何落實創新與管理實務創新如何執行。本課程適用於自有品牌業者、ODM或OEM製造業者、服務業者與學術單位教學研究，特點如下:完整詳實闡述TRIZ理論並輔以大量簡單案例說明TRIZ概念、工程TRIZ實務案例10餘個與TRIZ工程與管理之參數與創新原則說明簡例約800餘個，管理實務案例20餘個，包含研發管理、服務業管理、專案管理與生產管理等。案例與簡例最多，創新執行力可快速上手與實施應用。本課程TRIZ研發、工程與管理兼顧，製造業與服務業高層、中層與基層員工皆符合讀者條件，使"突破創新"輕易實務執行並成為企業文化，亦適用於大學與研究所之工管、企管(經營管理)、工商管與工程相關科系，可自行按需求選擇性深入教授講解某些章節，也替產業界事先磨練一群創新思維之活力新血，可長久伴隨您在職場(或未來進入職場)解決研發、工程與管理之困難矛盾問題。

description.zh: 本課程將對公司治理做系統性的介紹。公司治理係指公司可以透過一系列的內部和外部公司治理機制設計來降低公司代理問題、提升公司價值。修課同學可以藉由閱讀指定參考文獻及教材並且在課堂上進行口頭報告，可以培養同學撰寫碩士論文及口頭報告的能力。
description.en: This course aims to present the concept of corporate governance. Corporate governance involves a series of mechanisms designed to mitigate agency problems within a corporation and enhance its value. We will cover both internal and external aspects of corporate governance. Students in the class are required to present a journal article and other assigned readings. All the training is intended to help students learn how to conduct their master thesis and improve their confidence in oral presentations.

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to present the concept of corporate governance. Corporate governance involves a series of mechanisms designed to mitigate agency problems within a corporation and enhance its value, which is an invaluable asset for a firm seeking funding from capital markets. Throughout the course, we will discuss several key issues in corporate governance, including (1) ownership structure, (2) board of directors, (3) executive compensation, and (4) external corporate governance. We will emphasize communication skills, critical thinking, decision-making skills, and real-world issues in corporate governance. Students in the class are required to present a journal article and finish other assignments. All the training is intended to help students learn how to conduct their master thesis and improve their confidence in oral presentations. 
本課程將對公司治理做系統性的介紹。公司治理可以透過一系列的內部和外部公司治理機制設計來降低公司代理問題、提升公司價值，這對於希望能在資本市場籌資的公司來說是一項重要的資產。在整個課程中，我們將討論公司治理的幾個關鍵問題，包括(1) 股權結構、(2) 董事會、(3) 經理人薪酬，以及 (4) 外部公司治理。我們將強調溝通技巧、批判性思考、決策技巧和現實世界中的公司治理議題。修課同學可以藉由報告學術文章及完成其他課堂作業，培養撰寫碩士論文及口頭報告的能力。

description.zh: 本課程專注在培養高階經理人在全球組織的領導決策、組織變革、以及有效溝通與談判的關鍵議題。聚焦在不同時空的國際經營環境中，企業經營者如何因應政府的政策與財經情勢改變，能夠快速回應與彈性應變的領導思維與決策。透過本課程將能夠理解高階主管面對政經環境的調整能有效因應變化，並且提升領導與溝通的技能與創造市場優勢之創新能力。
description.en: This course focuses on developing senior executives to lead decision-making, organizational change, and key issues for effective communication and negotiation. By focusing on the international business environment of different time and space, how senior executives can respond quickly and flexibly to leadership thinking and decision-making in response to changes in government policies and financial situations. Through this course, students will be able to understand how senior executives can effectively respond to changes in the political and economic environment, and improve their leadership and communication skills and innovation capabilities to create market advantages.

1. 領導力、變革推動與溝通管理的實務經驗與案例分享：以專題演講形式，透過實務經驗與案例分享，理解領導力如何在變革推動與溝通管理中發揮影響力。

2. 學生併購個案報告與討論：以學生併購個案報告與討論為主，練習從領導力、變革推動與溝通管理角度分析併購問題並提出策略。

3. (遠距) 併購的法律規畫：從併購的法律規畫切入，說明領導力如何在變革推動中處理制度整合、利害關係人與溝通管理議題。

4. (遠距) 併購的案例分享：透過併購案例分享，分析領導者在併購變革中的決策方式，以及跨組織溝通管理的成功與失敗關鍵。

description.zh: 本課程旨在使學生熟悉零售策略的基本概念，了解目前的零售產業之環境分析及零售趨勢之分析，探討零售行銷之區隔與定位，進而將零售策略如何應用於管理理論與實務分析。零售業包含百貨業、連鎖店、超市、超商等，與人們的關係極切，本課程主在探討如何經由零賣出使顧客滿意的商品。 內容：零售業概論、配銷通路、行銷研究、產品管理策略、定價策略、促銷策略、賣場規劃、零售業經營策略、顧客滿意 1.具備零售管理學相關知識與概念。 2.掌握零售業環境與趨勢之分析能力。 3.具備零售業行銷區隔與定位的分析能力。 4.具備零售策略應用於理論與實務之分析能力。
description.en: This masters-level course is designed to provide the student with a deeper understanding of retailing strategic management. Topics include: the world of retailing, electronic and no store retailing, the retail customer behavior, retail market strategy, retail location, merchandise management and store management. Retail management is mainly to discuss to sell goods through channels and satisfy them. The content of the course: Retail concept, physical distribution, market research, product management strategy, pricing strategy, promotion strategy, retail strategy and customer satisfaction.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹領導與組織管理的理論與實務。課程目的有四個：(1)了解組織領導與管理的內涵；(2)討論領導與組織管理的理論與實證發現之間的差異；(3)對實務界人士提供具體建議；(4)將領導與管理的技巧應用到生活面。
description.en: This course focuses on the theory and practice of leadership and management in organization. Its purpose is threefold: (1) To gain an understanding of what the content of organizational leadership and management is; (2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of leadership and organization management and empirical findings and discuss the discrepancies and implications; (3) to discuss practical implications for business management and (4) to apply the basic ideas of leadership and management in daily life.

syllabi.outline:
本課程聚焦於**領導力與組織管理**的核心理論與實務應用，涵蓋領導風格與自我覺察、組織結構與文化、溝通與決策機制、團隊建立與績效管理，以及變革與衝突管理等主題。透過案例分析、情境討論與實務演練，引導學員理解如何在不同組織情境中有效領導成員、整合資源、提升組織效能，並培養具備策略思維與人本關懷的現代領導者。
This course focuses on the core theories and practical applications of **Leadership and Organizational Management**. It covers leadership styles and self-awareness, organizational structure and culture, communication and decision-making, team building and performance management, as well as change and conflict management. Through case studies, scenario-based discussions, and practical exercises, participants will develop the ability to lead effectively in diverse organizational contexts, integrate resources, enhance organizational performance, and cultivate strategic, people-centered leadership capabilities.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要在介紹高階管理的理論與實務。將透過學校老師與企業高階管理者與學生一起探討當前管理重要議題。本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。
This course focuses on the introduction and discussion of theories and practices of contemporary management topics. Besides university professors, renowned top manager will be invited to share the best practice experiences of the workplace in the lecture. The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.

description.zh: 新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。 新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。 課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en: Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously. The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

name.zh: 生成式人工智慧於企業實務之應用
name.en: Application of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Enterprise Practice

description.zh: 隨著科技不斷進步，人工智慧技術逐漸成熟，無論在生產流程、企業管理及分析決策等方面都陸續開始導入生成式AI工具，應用場景橫跨企業營運、數據應用以及產品與服務創新等。本課程將介紹生成式人工智慧原理並結合實作方式，透過實際案例和演練來教授生成式AI技術和應用。課程內容包括人工智慧的基礎知識，如深度學習、自然語言處理、圖像處理、推薦系統、預測分析等，並導入人工智慧在企業管理和決策、金融、數據分析、智慧製造等領域等應用案例。課程中將結合Azure OpenAI雲端服務資源，並以人工智慧跨域應用學習模式來跨域應用至數據分析、智慧運算、智慧製造及物流、商情預測、經營管理、金融等領域，以培育學生具備領先同儕之人工智慧跨域應用專業能力。
description.en: This course introduces the principles of generative artificial intelligence and combines practical exercises regarding the technology and applications of generative AI through real case studies and drills. The course covers fundamental knowledge of AI, such as deep learning, natural language processing, image processing, recommendation systems, predictive analytics, and introduces the application cases of AI in enterprise management and decision-making, finance, data analysis, intelligent manufacturing, among others. The course will also utilize Azure OpenAI cloud service resources and cross-domain application learning mode to cultivate students’ technical abilities in AI cross-domain applications, spanning across data analytics, intelligent computing, intelligent manufacturing and logistics, business forecasting, management, finance, etc., leading them to stand out among their peers.

syllabi.outline:
隨著雲端運算服務的廣為使用及網際網路服務的發展，如何處理與儲存大數據，並探勘有用的知識是企業成功關鍵。本課程內容包括決策理論之基本觀念、如何處理與分析大數據、以及如何更進一步從大數據分析連接在真實世界裡相關決策問題應用。
With the development of cloud computing services and internet services, the ability to store big data and transform into applicable knowledge is critical. This course includes an overview of the basic concepts of decision theory, and how to handle and process big data with applications on the real-world decision problems.

syllabi.outline:
隨著科技不斷進步，人工智慧技術逐漸成熟，無論在生產流程、企業管理及分析決策等方面都陸續開始導入生成式AI工具，應用場景橫跨企業營運、數據應用以及產品與服務創新等。本課程將介紹生成式人工智慧原理並結合實作方式，透過實際案例和演練來教授生成式AI技術和應用。課程內容包括人工智慧的基礎知識，如深度學習、自然語言處理、圖像處理、推薦系統、預測分析等，並導入人工智慧在企業管理和決策、金融、數據分析、智慧製造等領域等應用案例。課程中將結合Azure OpenAI雲端服務資源，並以人工智慧跨域應用學習模式來跨域應用至數據分析、智慧運算、智慧製造及物流、商情預測、經營管理、金融等領域，以培育學生具備領先同儕之人工智慧跨域應用專業能力。
This course introduces the principles of generative artificial intelligence and combines practical exercises regarding the technology and applications of generative AI through real case studies and drills. The course covers fundamental knowledge of AI, such as deep learning, natural language processing, image processing, recommendation systems, predictive analytics, and introduces the application cases of AI in enterprise management and decision-making, finance, data analysis, intelligent manufacturing, among others. The course will also utilize Azure OpenAI cloud service resources and cross-domain application learning mode to cultivate students’ technical abilities in AI cross-domain applications, spanning across data analytics, intelligent computing, intelligent manufacturing and logistics, business forecasting, management, finance, etc., leading them to stand out among their peers.

syllabi.outline:
在管理決策中，要如何做行銷管理才能使得公司的產品賣得出去並增加公司收入。要如何做資金管理才能使得公司可以正常營運並將資金做適當的管理決策配置。透過國內外相關公司案例的討論，讓學生可以瞭解消費者行為、市場區隔、產品策略、通路、數位(含AI)行銷等議題，以及對財管的投資、融資、營運資金、公司理財等議題有進一步的理解，讓高階經理人可以有更全面的策略營運方針。
In management decisions, how should marketing management be conducted to ensure that a company's products sell and increase company revenue? How should financial management be handled to ensure the company operates smoothly and makes appropriate management decisions regarding the allocation of funds? Through discussions of relevant domestic and international company cases, students can gain an understanding of topics such as consumer behavior, market segmentation, product strategy, distribution channels, and digital (including AI) marketing, as well as develop a deeper understanding of financial management topics like investment, financing, working capital, and corporate finance. This will enable senior managers to develop more comprehensive strategic operational guidelines.

description.zh: 本課程之主要目的在於教授都市設計的基本分析理論與方法，除透過課堂案例的介紹與討論外，學生還將以分組方式進行觀察研究與運算分析。案例介紹與討論之重點在於認識影響都市空間環境品質的關鍵要素，而分組研究之目的則在於讓學生藉由各種現場觀察與數位分析工具的應用，進一步探索這些關鍵要素在都市空間形構過程的交互影響過程。
description.en: This course aims to introduce students to key theoretical and methodological approaches in urban design. The main content will be delivered through a series of case study discussion and project-based research practice. In specific, the case study is to review and identify key factors shaping the physical environment of cities; while through collaborative research projects, students are expected to engage in a step-by-step process of on-site observation and computational analysis, examining how the factors are interacting with each other.

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to introduce students to key theoretical and methodological approaches in urban design. The main content will be delivered through a series of case study discussion and project-based research practice. In specific, the case study is to review and identify key factors shaping the physical environment of cities; while through independent research projects, students are expected to engage in a step-by-step process of on-site observation and computational analysis, examining how the factors are interacting with each other.

Note: Competency in the basic use of computer is required. In class, the instructor will provide tutorials about how to use the computational analysis tool (Space Syntax).

description.zh: 循環型建築專題旨在深入探討循環經濟理念如何融入建築領域，結合搖籃到搖籃（cradle to cradle)的理論和「以終為始」的設計方法，學習分析國內外成功的循環型建築案例，掌握再生建材選用、模組化設計等相關技術應用，系統性地探討如何在建築設計、材料選擇與建築全生命周期管理中，實現資源的高效利用與廢棄物的最小化，並運用環境評估工具量化建築的環境效益，引導學生多元領域學習，在建築設計中提出兼具環境、社會與經濟平衡之構想，以及創新的建築設計解決方案，最終培養其在循環經濟框架下的永續建築設計能力。
description.en: The course aims to explore in depth how the principles of the circular economy can be integrated into the field of architecture. By combining the *Cradle to Cradle* theory with the "designing from the end" approach, students will analyze successful cases of circular architecture from both domestic and international contexts. They will gain proficiency in key technical applications, such as the selection of recycled materials and modular design. The course systematically examines how to achieve efficient resource utilization and minimize waste across architectural design, material selection, and building lifecycle management. Students will also learn to apply environmental assessment tools to quantify the environmental benefits of buildings. By fostering interdisciplinary learning, the course encourages students to propose architectural concepts that balance environmental, social, and economic considerations.

description.en: The purpose of this course is to explore the interaction relationships between human and environment, introducing the development and theory of environmental psychology. Via observing and evaluating the behavior of present living environment, enhance our knowledge about environmental psychology through various approaches to theories and experiences. The course includes:1. Introduction  2. Research methods and theory framework 3. The built environment from home environment to city space 4. Social behavior and the physical environment 5. The natural environment and behavior 6. Post-occupancy evaluation 7. Conclusion

description.zh: 服務設計的方法乃是透過相關資源做適當的規劃與組織，已提昇使用者與服務提供者間之服務及互動的品質。其主要的架構與方法乃在於了解使用者的行為、需求及動機後，創造具友善性、競爭性、及相關性的使用者經驗。本課程將以服務設計的概念與方法為核心，以使用者需求及經驗的創造為基礎，探討並分析不同的互動技術的適用情境及其發展與應用領域。
description.en: Service design is the activity of planning and organizing related resources of service in order to improve its quality and the interaction between service provider and users. The backbone of service design methodologies is to understand the behavior of the users, their needs and motivations, so that to create user-friendly, competitive and relevant service to the users. The service design concepts and methodologies and user experience analysis are used in this course for discussing the developments and applications of interactive technologies in the aspects of various scenarios and application fields.

description.zh:
「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul Saffo

未來思考與趨勢前瞻，有助於讓每一位同學思索未來社會可能轉變得新趨勢和新的需求。無論同學希望學習或專精的技能為何，如何應用 該技能，提前 選擇一個在未來對社會或個人更可能有所助益的方向練習、實作，不斷繼續前進，才能夠將個人的意義進一步投射至未來的社會價值中；如此一來，未 來社會也將會給給予你應有的報酬。

未來思考的課程，將師承奇點大學客座教授，同時也是美國史丹佛大學設計學院特聘助理教授 Paul Saffo 的 Forecasting 課程，內容將有 - 現況觀察、趨勢分析、未來事件辯論、未來趨勢矩陣圖、前瞻思考經典賞析（包含文章與電影） 等。
description.en:
「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul Saffo

Future Studies & Forecasting will be more and more important skill for every young generation students. What will the future look alike? What is the driving forces pushing us from current to the future? How many pace layers of future arrivals?

In this class, we will discuss Stanford consulting prof. Paul Saffo’s Future Studies & Forecasting methods, by – Observing current trends, future event debate, Matrices and Axes of Uncertainty, future mindset developing, etc.

syllabi.outline:
「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul Saffo

Future Studies & Forecasting will be more and more important skill for every young generation students. What will the future look alike? What is the driving forces pushing us from current to the future? How many pace layers of future arrivals?
In this class, we will discuss Stanford consulting prof. Paul Saffo’s Future Studies & Forecasting methods, by – Observing current trends, future event debate, Matrices and Axes of Uncertainty, future mindset developing, etc.

Overview
Futures Research is a survey course about the methods and tools that professional futurists use to help people anticipate and influence the future. It is a core course in the Futures Studies program. It covers methods and tools used by forecasters in general as well as by professional futurists. It also covers the techniques that futurists use more than others to forecast the future, particularly creating scenarios of the future, and the techniques used by futurists and consultants alike to help people influence the future, particularly visions, strategic plans, and change management programs.
Objectives

The student will understand and become familiar with: 
•	the framework approach to forecasting
•	critical thinking and other approaches to challenging assumptions
•	leading creativity tools and approaches and how they apply to futures
•	how to develop and evaluate scenarios
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 Introduction 
•	Become familiar with course objectives, expectations, and procedures
•	Become familiar with the learning platform. 
•	Introduce yourself to your classmates. 
•	State of the Art in Strategic Foresight

UNIT 1 FRAMEWORK FORECASTING: (Weeks 2 –5) 

Week 2 Environmental Scanning
•	Understand an approach to environmental scanning
•	Practice that approaches and assess how well each we and others are using it

Week 3 Research
•	Understand the futures forecasting process, including frameworks, monitoring, and scanning 
•	Present futures information in a logical order for forecasting alternative futures using the framework process 

Week 4 Interviews & Questionnaires 
•	List how people find out about other people's information, attitudes, expectations, and preferences for the future. 
•	Understand the differences among those ways, including the advantages and disadvantages of each. 
•	Practice the skills of preparing, administering, analyzing, and drawing inferences from an open-ended interview. 
•	Learn about questionnaire design and construction 
•	Learn about related topics, such as measurement, sampling, and the Delphi survey technique 
•	Practice the skills of preparing, administering, analyzing, and drawing inferences from a structured questionnaire. 

Week 2 Forecasting
•	Understand the nature of forecasting, its assumptions, its utility, and its difficulties

UNIT 2 CHALLENGING ASSUMPTIONS: (Weeks 6 –7) 

Week 6 Causal Layered Analysis
•	Understand and apply the causal layered analysis method
•	Become familiar with the concept of "depth" in futures work

Week 7 Critical Thinking
•	Learn a process for investigating the support for an inference, such as a forecast 
•	Conduct a critical analysis of a forecast in the published literature 
UNIT 3 CREATIVITY: (Weeks 8 –9) 
Week 8  Creativity Approaches
•	Become acquainted with key concepts, terms, and approaches to creativity
Week 9 Creativity Tools
•	Learn a standard approach to creative problem solving
•	Become familiar with a variety of creativity techniques
•	Practice applications of two principal creativity tools
UNIT 4 SCENARIOS: (Weeks 10 –12) 
Week 10  Scenario Theory
•	Become acquainted with key concepts, terms, and criteria of scenarios 

Week 11  Scenario Methods
•	Compare the strengths and weaknesses of various scenario approaches
•	Learn how to analyze and evaluate scenarios

Week 12 Scenario Cases 
•	Acquire an in-depth understanding of a leading practitioners approach to scenarios

UNIT 5 CONCLUSION: (Weeks 13 –15) 
Week 13 Draft Portfolio
•	Prepare draft portfolio for instructor feedback

Week 15 - 18 Final Portfolio
•	Submit the final portfolio
