name.zh: 使用者經驗研究與實務

description.zh:
UX（User Experience）使用者經驗設計師，是一種特別需要橫向與縱向技能的設計師。本課程從物件 (objects) 、流程 (processes)、體驗 (experiences)、敘事 (narratives) 四個不同的脈絡切面，讓學生了解使用者經驗設計師的必備知識、技能與工具。學生將學會結合使用者研究的質性和量化方法及其工具來塑造實體與數位產品或服務的資訊架構。另一方面，本課程也深入探討UX於學術研究上的趨勢，讓學術與實務層面兼備。
此外，學生將掌握如何利用簡報和視覺化溝通來促進組織內的設計決策，並學習Prototype設計規劃與實施易用性測試，使用實體與遠端工具。課程中也將介紹如何運用生成式AI輔助UX研究與設計。
description.en: User experience designers are designers who particularly require horizontal and vertical skills. This course allows students to understand the necessary knowledge, skills, and tools of user experience designers from four different aspects: objects, processes, experiences, and narratives. Students will learn to combine qualitative and quantitative methods and tools of user research to shape the information architecture of physical and digital products or services. In addition, students will master how to use briefings and visual communication to promote design decisions within the organization and learn to prototype design planning and implement usability testing using physical and remote tools. The course will also introduce how to use generative AI to assist UX research and design. On the other hand, this course also profoundly explores the trends of UX in academic research, integrating both academic and practical aspects.

syllabi.outline:
The "User Experience Research and Practice" course is designed to equip master's students with comprehensive UX design knowledge and practical skills. By utilizing an open-access online textbook, the course covers a broad spectrum of topics, from the fundamentals of interaction design to cutting-edge subjects. Through reading, reflection, and class presentations, students will explore key areas of UX design, including human-computer interaction, visual design, affective computing, and usability evaluation. The course emphasizes the integration of theory and practice, encouraging students to apply concepts from the textbook to real-world design challenges.

A distinctive feature of the course is integrating interdisciplinary knowledge from fields such as neuroscience, anthropology, and philosophy into UX design. Students will learn to apply theoretical frameworks like phenomenology and semiotics to deepen their understanding of user experience and translate these insights into innovative design solutions. The course also covers emerging areas like social computing and open-user innovation, providing students with a broader perspective on the societal implications and opportunities within UX design. Ultimately, this course aims to develop UX professionals with critical thinking, innovative spirit, and interdisciplinary perspectives, ready to create products and services that meet user needs and drive technological and societal progress.

Students will learn…
1. Master core UX design theories and apply interdisciplinary knowledge to solve complex design problems.
2. Utilize various UX research methods, such as contextual design and user story mapping.
3. Integrate theories from neuroscience and phenomenology to deepen the understanding of user experience and design.
4. Learn techniques to evaluate and measure user experience, optimizing design solutions and decision-making processes.
5. Explore emerging UX fields like social computing and open innovation to expand design perspectives.
6. Cultivate critical thinking by integrating UX design into broader social and technological contexts.

description.zh:
數據無處不在。隨著真實世界和數位世界交互影響，越來越多的設計決策有望得到數據分析的支持。本課程旨在培養設計師的數據素養技能。首先介紹對個性化產品和服務的需求，是如何從認知及情感面來創造更好的使用者經驗，並將數據資訊轉換為產品知識/服務設計/系統決策。大部分課堂時間將以研究導向的設計專題方式進行。完成本課程後，您將能夠：
1.區分批量生產及個性化設計
2.了解如何將數據科學納入設計流程
3.描述由不同來源（例如人類、機器或環境）生成的數據特徵和形式
4.應用合適的工具/軟體來解釋小型或大型數據集
5.了解在設計過程中使用數據的倫理與關鍵原則
description.en:

Hence, this course aims to build your data literacy skills as a designer. The course will begin by introducing the need for personalized products and services to create a better user experience. syllabi.outline:
本課程整合量化與質性研究方法,培養設計研究生的數據思維與實踐能力。從數據收集、分析到視覺化呈現,學習如何運用數據驅動設計決策。課程涵蓋使用者研究方法、統計分析基礎、資料視覺化工具應用,以及生成式 AI 在數據分析中的應用。透過實際專案演練,學生將學習如何從數據中洞察使用者需求、驗證設計假設,並以數據說服利害關係人。強調設計思考與數據分析的結合,培養學生成為具備數據素養的新世代設計研究者。

學生學習目標：

-建立以數據驅動設計決策的思維模式與方法論
-掌握質性與量化研究方法在設計專案中的應用
-熟悉統計分析基礎概念與設計領域常用分析方法
-運用資料視覺化工具有效呈現研究發現與設計洞察
-整合生成式 AI 工具於數據收集、分析與詮釋流程
-培養批判性思考能力,評估數據品質與分析結果的可信度
-完成一個完整的數據驅動設計專案,從研究到提案呈現

name.zh: 產品企劃個案研究專題

description.zh: 產品企劃對於一家公司來說非常重要，因為如果做得好，它可以減少資源支出，增加收入並創造利潤。新產品開發時，產品企劃的嚴謹與洞見為影響產品成敗的重要因素，本課程將介紹產品企劃的基本觀念、產品開發流程、產品策略、產品生命週期、市場區隔與企畫書的撰寫等。本課程以實際產品企劃案例作為教材，導入情境式教學，讓學生融入產品企劃個案之實境，於課堂上共同討論如何擬定個案的處理方式與企劃方法，達到理論與實務充分的對話。
description.en: Product planning is very important to a company because, when done properly, it can reduce resource expenditures, drive revenues, and generate profitability. In the development of new products, Product planning is an important factors affecting the success or failure of products. This course will introduce the basic concepts of product planning, product development process, product strategy, product life cycle, market segmentation, and Product planning book. This course takes real product planning cases as teaching materials, import situational teaching, and integrates students into the realities of product planning cases. We will discuss how to formulate the right decision-making and planning methods in class to achieve a dialogue between theory and practice.

name.zh: 設計與生活型態研究(二)

description.zh: 本課程以「中世紀到工業革命」為主軸：將探索中世紀、文藝復興、啟蒙時代與工業革命期間，人類社會如何在科技、經濟與文化變遷下，發展新的生活型態與設計方式。課程內容包括中世紀的宗教建築與工藝技術、文藝復興時期的美學與人文思想對設計的影響、啟蒙時代的科技發展，以及工業革命帶來的大規模生產與都市化現象。學生將分析從手工製作到機械生產的轉變如何影響產品設計、家具設計與建築風格，並探討此時期的設計理念如何延續至今日。
description.en: This course centers on the theme "From the Middle Ages to the Industrial Revolution," exploring how human societies adapted their lifestyles and design approaches in response to technological, economic, and cultural transformations during the Middle Ages, the Renaissance, the Enlightenment, and the Industrial Revolution. Course topics include religious architecture and craftsmanship in the Middle Ages, the influence of aesthetics and humanist thought on Renaissance design, technological advancements of the Enlightenment, and the large-scale production and urbanization brought by the Industrial Revolution. Students will analyze how the transition from handcrafted to mechanized production impacted product design, furniture design, and architectural styles, as well as how design concepts from this period continue to influence the present day.

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生在論文寫作以及企業研究方法上建立足夠的知識與技能。課程內容主要分為兩部分，第一部分將介紹論文架構，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、網路程序分析、TOPSIS、VIKOR、灰關聯法、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力撰寫論文並了解使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in thesis writing and business research methods. The content of the course can be divided into two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin with the introduction of different quantitative methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision-making tools through lectures, discussions, assignments, term-projects, and in-class practices. The main methods include AHP, ANP, TOPSIS, VIKOR, DEMATEL, Gray Relation Methods, Fuzzy Set Theory, Rough Set Theory, and some basic multivariate

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生在論文寫作以及企業研究方法上建立足夠的知識與技能。課程內容主要分為兩部分，第一部分將介紹論文架構，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、網路程序分析、TOPSIS、VIKOR、灰關聯法、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力撰寫論文並了解使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in thesis writing and business research methods. The content of the course can be divided into two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin with the introduction of different quantitative methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision-making tools through lectures, discussions, assignments, term-projects, and in-class practices. The main methods include AHP, ANP, TOPSIS, VIKOR, DEMATEL, Gray Relation Methods, Fuzzy Set Theory, Rough Set Theory, and some basic multivariate

description.zh: 公司治理已成為廿一世紀企業組織架構調整之重大議題，如何經由管理策略及法制設計使台灣企業經營回歸股東長期價值及利益，為政府、交易所與公會等自律機關、及企業經營者必須面對之問題。在法制上，獨立董事監察人、審計委員會之設置、公司自律守則之擬議、股東會之運作，均衝擊我國公司法、證券交易法及交易所規則現行管理架構及規範；在實務上，上市櫃公司如何順利接受公司治理之理念及管理規範，以提昇公司營運的外在評價與體質。

name.zh: 生成式人工智慧於企業實務之應用
name.en: Application of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Enterprise Practice

description.zh: 隨著科技不斷進步，人工智慧技術逐漸成熟，無論在生產流程、企業管理及分析決策等方面都陸續開始導入生成式AI工具，應用場景橫跨企業營運、數據應用以及產品與服務創新等。本課程將介紹生成式人工智慧原理並結合實作方式，透過實際案例和演練來教授生成式AI技術和應用。課程內容包括人工智慧的基礎知識，如深度學習、自然語言處理、圖像處理、推薦系統、預測分析等，並導入人工智慧在企業管理和決策、金融、數據分析、智慧製造等領域等應用案例。課程中將結合Azure OpenAI雲端服務資源，並以人工智慧跨域應用學習模式來跨域應用至數據分析、智慧運算、智慧製造及物流、商情預測、經營管理、金融等領域，以培育學生具備領先同儕之人工智慧跨域應用專業能力。
description.en: This course introduces the principles of generative artificial intelligence and combines practical exercises regarding the technology and applications of generative AI through real case studies and drills. The course covers fundamental knowledge of AI, such as deep learning, natural language processing, image processing, recommendation systems, predictive analytics, and introduces the application cases of AI in enterprise management and decision-making, finance, data analysis, intelligent manufacturing, among others. The course will also utilize Azure OpenAI cloud service resources and cross-domain application learning mode to cultivate students’ technical abilities in AI cross-domain applications, spanning across data analytics, intelligent computing, intelligent manufacturing and logistics, business forecasting, management, finance, etc., leading them to stand out among their peers.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在概述人工智慧的應用及其對製造業和物流業的影響。 隨機器學習、深度學習、啟發式演算法和其他人工智能方法的發展，相關新興技術的應用越來越多地被應用於製造和物流行業以提高決策能力。本課程將通過介紹人工智慧的基礎知識和實際應用之案例研究闡述使用人工智慧技術對於產業決策之幫助。學生將深入了解人工智慧技術及其在製造和物流領域如需求預測、生產計劃、調度、質量控製或運輸的潛在應用，課程內容亦將應用ChatGPT做為開發製造物流問題求解方法之輔助工具。通過本課程，學生將了解人工智慧對製造和物流系統之影響及現況，評估使用人工智慧之益處和局限性，並了解人工智慧對於相關產業之改善。
This course provides an overview of AI application and its impact on manufacturing and logistics. Emerging technologies like machine learning, deep learning, heuristics are being utilized to enhance decision-making capabilities. The course covers the fundamentals of AI, practical case studies, and its benefits. Latest AI technologies and their potential applications in manufacturing and logistics such as demand forecasting, production planning, scheduling, quality control, or transportation will be introduced. ChatGPT will be used as an auxiliary tool for developing problem-solving methods. The course develops the ability to analyze the impact of AI on manufacturing and logistics systems, assess benefits and limitations, and evaluate AI improvement for related industries.

name.zh: 企業數位轉型與優化研討
name.en: Seminar on Enterprise digital transformation and optimization

description.zh: 世界各區域經濟快速發展，面對高度競爭的趨勢，數位轉型是項關鍵議題。本課程將使EMBA學生了解數位轉型與優化相關趨勢，並透過一些成功案例探討數位轉型對企業產生之效益，希望透過本課程之研討，EMBA學生可以將成功案例經驗及所學應用至所屬公司或企業。
description.en: With the expeditious development in regional economic activities and more competition across countries, enterprise digital transformation is an important topic. The aim of this course is to comprehend the latest digital transformation issues and potential benefits to enterprise. Case studies and experience sharing are critical in this course.

name.zh: 永續發展與淨零碳管理
name.en: Sustainable Development and Net Zero Carbon Management

description.zh: 這門課將深入探討從巴黎協定到Net Zero的全球淨零碳排發展歷程，並闡述碳訂價政策工具的概念與國際主要實踐。透過企業淨零實務分享，學生將了解目標訂定、策略制定、管理制度建立以及追蹤管理等步驟。課程還涵蓋ISO 14064碳盤查和ISO 14067產品碳足跡的概念與實作，並結合企業減碳經驗分享。最後，課程將介紹數位轉型在碳管理上的應用，包括資訊治理和低碳轉型等技術，旨在培養學生對於全球氣候行動及企業永續發展的深刻理解與實踐能力。
description.en: This course explores the evolution towards global net-zero carbon emissions, from the Paris Agreement to Net Zero, along with the concept and implementation of carbon pricing policies. Through real-world examples, students learn how companies set goals, develop strategies, and establish management systems for achieving net-zero emissions. Additionally, the course covers carbon footprint verification and product carbon footprinting practices, alongside insights from businesses reducing carbon emissions. Finally, it examines the application of digital transformation in carbon management, fostering understanding of climate action and corporate sustainability.

name.en: Application of Investment Decision and Information

description.zh: 為因應瞬息萬變的金融投資環境，期許學生具備宏觀的投資管理知識，本課程主要本課程結合資訊工具與軟體運用、以深入淺出方式介紹投資決策之基本觀念及理論架構，並搭配財務軟體、財金資料庫、與財金資訊網站的應用。藉由這些資訊工具與技術，將財務投資的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的投資決策。課程內容架構包括：(1) 財務與投資學原理；(2) 資料庫的使用；(3) 財務軟體的操作；(4) 財務與投資個案分析。透過本課程之學習，促使投資人能獲取合理的投資報酬或擊敗大盤，領先各基金之績效，以制訂出正確的長短期投資決策。
description.en: In response to the rapidly changing environment of financial investments, expecting that students have knowledge of macro investment management, this course combines information and software tools to use, the major goal of this course is to help students understanding the basic principles and theories of investments. By mixing explanation and implementation using financial software and database, it can give students the skills to conduct a sophisticated assessment on investment decisions. The major topics include the following: (1) principles of investments, (2) financial database, (3) financial software, and (4) case study in investments. Through the learning of this course, prompting investors to be able to obtain a reasonable return on investment or beat the market, ahead of the performance of each Fund, in order to work out the correct short and long term investment decisions.

description.zh: 本課程目的在瞭解國際金融科技的發展趨勢，並探討台灣目前金融科科技產業發展情形與因應作為。課程內容除了理論基礎介紹外，將邀請金融科技產業企業領袖與專業菁英演講，與學生交流互動，學生也須進行實作加深學習效果，希望藉此課程能讓學生掌握當前國際與台灣金融市場金融科技最新之實務脈動，分析並預測未來可能之發展。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to understand the development trends of international financial technology and to explore the current situation and responses of Taiwan's financial technology industry. In addition to introducing theoretical foundations, the course will invite leaders and professionals from the financial technology industry to give lectures and interact with students. Students will also engage in hands-on practice to deepen their learning. Through this course, it is hoped that students will gain insight into the latest practical trends in international and Taiwanese financial markets, and analyze and predict potential future developments in financial technology.

name.zh: UX設計師的練功房和他的武器室
name.en: Mastering UX: The Designer's Dojo and Armory

description.zh: UX（User Experience）使用者經驗設計師，是一種特別需要橫向與縱向技能的設計師。本課程從物件 (objects) 、流程 (processes)、體驗 (experiences)、敘事(narratives) 四個不同的脈絡切面，讓學生了解使用者經驗設計師的必備知識、技能與工具。並隨著生成式AI的趨勢，介紹生成式AI如何輔助UX設計師進行使用者研究與設計。同時，培養學生未來能在特定專業領域持續發展使用者體驗設計師職能的視野和態度，以及UX設計師在職場上的角色定位。 學生將學會結合使用者研究的質性和量化方法及其工具來塑造實體與數位產品或服務的資訊架構。此外，他們將掌握如何利用簡報和視覺化溝通來促進組織內的設計決策。課程將涵蓋UX、LEAN UX、Agile UX與Scrum等不同設計開發流程的實踐。學生也會學習Prototype設計規劃與實施易用性測試，使用實體與遠端工具。課程中也將介紹如何運用生成式AI輔助UX研究與設計。
description.en: UX (User Experience) designers require both broad and specialized skills. This course provides students with a comprehensive understanding of the necessary knowledge, skills, and tools for UX designers through the context of four different aspects: objects, processes, experiences, and narratives. Students will learn to integrate qualitative and quantitative user research methods and tools to shape the information architecture of both physical and digital products or services. Additionally, they will master how to use presentations and visual communication to facilitate organizational design decisions. The course covers practical processes of various design development workflows, such as UX, LEAN UX, Agile UX, and Scrum. Students will also learn prototype design planning and how to conduct usability testing with both physical and remote tools. The course will also illustrate the use of generative AI in assisting UX research and design.

syllabi.outline: UX（User Experience）使用者經驗設計師，是一種特別需要橫向與縱向技能的設計師。本課程從物件 (objects) 、流程 (processes)、體驗 (experiences)、敘事(narratives) 四個不同的脈絡切面，讓學生了解使用者經驗設計師的必備知識、技能與工具。並隨著生成式AI的趨勢，介紹生成式AI如何輔助UX設計師進行使用者研究與設計。同時，培養學生未來能在特定專業領域持續發展使用者體驗設計師職能的視野和態度，以及UX設計師在職場上的角色定位。

description.zh: 日常生活中，科技和化學伴隨著人類的成長，除了吃、喝、玩樂外，[用]也是很重要的一部份，例如我們時時刻刻在用的洗面乳、洗髮乳、沐浴乳、洗碗精、洗衣精等等的民生用品。探討這些化學對於環境的影響，並透過簡易的化學實驗來了解到民生化學用品與環境的關聯。了解日常生活中拋棄的廢棄物，如何轉換成有效的資源，達到綠色循環的經濟概念。
description.en: In our daily lives, science and chemistry develop and progress along with people.  However, life is not just about eating, drinking, playing, and entertainment.  "Usage" is also very important, specifically when it comes to the facial cleansers, body washes, dish and laundry detergents, and other cleaning supplies that we use.  From simple tests to determine the effects of chemicals on the environment, we understand how discarded daily articles can be transformed into effective resources, thus putting into practice a green recycling economy.

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生成為具有深度文化視覺的科技人。從認識本土文化為起點，進而認識世界文化。引導學生如何探究文化現象，並且深入文化的精神境界，物質境界，瞭解文化價值與文化傳統，讓文化觀點充分融入個人的思維內涵。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to develop the cultural cultivation of our technology majored students. Starting with the culture of our own land and extending to world-wide culture. The teachers would guide the students to explore the phenomena of the culture, and try to find out both the spirit and the material of the culture. Through the understanding of the worth and the tradition of the culture, the students might merge the cultural cultivation into their personal thinking.

description.zh: 介紹日常生活中所經常遭遇到的案例使學生認識法律上之常識，培養學生珍惜法律上所賦予之權利，並及時行使庶免讓權利睡著了，致蒙受意外損害。並督促學生善盡法律上之責任，蔚為人人知法，人人守法的風尚，導致社會祥和。授課內容：按民法總則、債篇、物權、親屬、繼承各篇之順序，選擇與日常生活關係最密切之案例，逐一介紹，並對解決之道詳加說明。有觸及民間權益者，例如民間互助會，使用票據之常識，海峽兩岸婚姻，汽車肇事與保險責任及軍人及其家屬優待條例等均一併介紹。
description.en: This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

syllabi.outline:
1、民法是一切法律之基礎，更與生活息息相關, 人的一生，從出生到死亡，均與民法脫離不了關系，且民法為一切法律修習之基礎，其重要性可見一斑。
我國民法共分為：民法總則、債篇總論、債篇各論、物權、親屬、繼承等五篇，以及為數甚多的民事特別法，如公寓大廈管理條例，消費者保護法、土地法等等。
2、本課程除了廣泛介紹民法的相關重要概念外，期能法律理論與實務並重，並對於同學日常生活有可能遇到的相關法律問題, 含憲法、民法、刑法、行政法、智慧財產權法、法哲學、兩性平等（Gender Equality）、校園霸凌、藥物濫用等）亦為教學之重點，希望同學能在課堂上學習到解法律問題的能力，以期保護自身之權益。
另外，時事法律分析討論，以及老師律師執業經手有趣且重要的司法案件，都是上課教材，以期讓同學上課不會因法條枯橾而覺得無趣，能理論與實務相結合，而有所收益。
3、本課程鼓勵同學隨時發問，或回答問題（但均不會強迫點名哪位同學發言）。
4、本課程並相當重視同學的分組報告，以訓練同學搜尋資料、消化資料及報告、演說、論辯之能力（原則上會以分組報告取代期中、期末考。
syllabi.schedule:
第一週    上課方式、評分方式、老師自我介紹、民法概要通識課程建議的學習態度，民法概要之重要性。
第二週    法律體系介紹、民法在法律位階中的地位，民法與羅馬法、憲法、刑法、行政法、智慧財產權法的關係。
第三週    形式意義的民法、一般民法、特別民法介紹。
第四週    民法總則概論。
第五週    法例、民法三大原則、私法自治。
第六週    權利主體、權利客體。
第七週    時效與期間。
第八週    權利行使與權利濫用。
第九週    兩性平權（Gender Equality）、校園霸凌、藥物濫用之法律與案例分析。
期中考週(以期中法律報告代替考試)。
第十週    債篇總論、契約自由原則與例外。
第十一週  契約之成立、生效，撤銷與終止，分組報告（一）。
第十二週  無因管理、不當得利、侵權行為，分組報告（二）。
第十三週  車禍法律事件專題、僱用人侵權行為責任分析專題，分組報告（三）。
第十四週  物權篇總論、用益物權、擔保物權、抵押權，分組報告（四）。
第十五週  親屬篇、繼承篇總論，婚姻法律制度之介紹，分組報告（五）。
第十六週  結婚、離婚、父母與未成年子女的關係，遺囑，分組報告（六）。
期末考週  (以期末心得報告代替期末考)。

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

description.zh: 生態與環境保護是廿世紀的新課題，也是人類目前及未來所面臨的最大考驗。因為環境問題是超越國界的，因此環境的保護是每個人都必須瞭解的，也是每個人應盡的責任。本課程首先在了解生態環境與生活素質的關係，並了解環境污染問題的產生及其分類，再就台灣環境問題之所在分析其根源，最後了解台灣環境實施之現況後，並共同研究解決之道。
description.en: Introduction to Ecology and Environmental Protection is a brand new issue of the 20th century; also, it is the biggest challenge of all human beings and our offspring. Because environmental protection is an international issue, everyone got to realize its importance and take some action. This lesson is designed to help students understand the connection between our ecological environment and our living condition, the environmental pollution problems and their classification, the environmental problems in Taiwan, and the solution to Taiwan's environmental problems after the situation introduction.

syllabi.outline: 課程旨在讓學生了解環境問題的來源與影響，探索氣候變遷、能源使用、水資源管理及廢棄物處理等議題，並學習相關政策與技術如循環經濟、再生能源與綠色技術。課程涵蓋全球與在地環保議題，強調永續發展與企業社會責任，結合案例討論與分享，幫助學生培養環保意識與意願，成為面對永續未來的推動力量。

description.en: This course intends to introduce the mathematical principles and practices that today's engineers need to know. The course contents are 1. Vector Algebra and Vector Analysis: Matrices and Determinants, Eigenvalue problems. 2. Fourier Series, Integral and Transforms. 3. Partial Differential Equations and Boundary Value Problems.

syllabi.outline: This course will introduce the mathematical principles in engineering, including following topics: Matrices, Vectors, Linear Systems, Determinants, and Matrix Eigenvalue Problems in Linear Algebra; Vector Differential and Integral Calculus; Fourier Series and Fourier Integral; and Partial Differential Equations and Boundary Value Problems.

15	Even and Odd Functions in Fourier Series & Fourier Integral. 
16	Basic Concepts of PDEs & Vibrating String, Wave Equation Modelling.

18	Final exam.

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

上課週數：2

二、我國國家安全環境與戰略
上課週數：2
單元主題：全球安全情勢概述、大國角力場—亞太地區情勢概述、我國戰略地位、我國國家安全戰略
三、兩岸關係與大陸政策
上課週數：4
單元主題：1949年以來的兩岸關係概述、我國大陸政策的演變、影響中共對臺政策的因素、我國大陸政策與中共對臺政策之現況、中共對臺威脅以及我國反制之道
四、我國國防政策與軍事戰略
上課週數：4
單元主題：我國國防政策、我國軍事戰略與建軍規劃、兵力整建與兵役轉型、國防武力、國防資源與災害防救
五、兵役實務與募兵制生涯規劃
上課週數：2
單元主題：我國的兵役制度沿革、徵兵處理程序、國軍志願役班隊簡介

上課週數：2

七、測驗
上課週數：2

1. National Defense and Politics
Weeks: 2
Unit Topics: Basic concepts of national defense and politics, definition of public policy and national defense policy, national strategy, and the relationship between national defense policy and military strategy.
2. National Security Environment and Strategy of Our Country
Weeks: 2
Unit Topics: Overview of global security situation, great power competition in the Asia-Pacific region, strategic position of our country, national security strategy of our country.
3. Cross-Strait Relations and Mainland China Policy
Weeks: 4
Unit Topics: Overview of Cross-Strait relations since 1949, evolution of our country's Mainland China policy, factors influencing the Chinese Communist Party's (CCP) policy towards Taiwan, current status of our country's Mainland policy and CCP’s policy towards Taiwan, threats posed by the CCP towards Taiwan and our country's countermeasures.
4. National Defense Policy and Military Strategy of Our Country
Weeks: 4
Unit Topics: Our national defense policy, military strategy and military planning of our country, military force development and military service transformation, national defense capabilities, national defense resources, and disaster prevention and rescue.
5. Military Service Practice and Career Planning under the Volunteer Military System
Weeks: 2
Unit Topics: Evolution of our country’s military service system, conscription procedures, introduction to the volunteer military service units of the National Armed Forces.
6. Patriotic Education
Weeks: 2
Unit Topics: Understanding our country, the mission of the national military, beliefs of soldiers and patriotic actions of modern youth, the 70th anniversary of the victory in the War of Resistance against Japan and Taiwan’s recovery—“Flesh and Blood Great Wall,” “Heroes Immortal.”
7. Tests
Weeks: 2

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

syllabi.schedule:
一、國防與政治
上課週數：2
單元主題：國防與政治的基本概念、公共政策與國防政策的定義、國家戰略、國防政策與軍事戰略之間的關係
二、我國國家安全環境與戰略
上課週數：2
單元主題：全球安全情勢概述、大國角力場—亞太地區情勢概述、我國戰略地位、我國國家安全戰略
三、兩岸關係與大陸政策
上課週數：4
單元主題：1949年以來的兩岸關係概述、我國大陸政策的演變、影響中共對臺政策的因素、我國大陸政策與中共對臺政策之現況、中共對臺威脅以及我國反制之道
四、我國國防政策與軍事戰略
上課週數：4
單元主題：我國國防政策、我國軍事戰略與建軍規劃、兵力整建與兵役轉型、國防武力、國防資源與災害防救
五、兵役實務與募兵制生涯規劃
上課週數：2
單元主題：我國的兵役制度沿革、徵兵處理程序、國軍志願役班隊簡介
六、愛國教育
上課週數：2
單元主題：認識我們的國家、國軍使命、軍人信念與現代青年的愛國行動、對日抗戰勝利暨臺灣光復70週年專題—血肉長城、英烈千秋
七、測驗
上課週數：2

1. National Defense and Politics
Weeks: 2
Unit Topics: Basic concepts of national defense and politics, definition of public policy and national defense policy, national strategy, and the relationship between national defense policy and military strategy.
2. National Security Environment and Strategy of Our Country
Weeks: 2
Unit Topics: Overview of global security situation, great power competition in the Asia-Pacific region, strategic position of our country, national security strategy of our country.
3. Cross-Strait Relations and Mainland China Policy
Weeks: 4
Unit Topics: Overview of Cross-Strait relations since 1949, evolution of our country's Mainland China policy, factors influencing the Chinese Communist Party's (CCP) policy towards Taiwan, current status of our country's Mainland policy and CCP’s policy towards Taiwan, threats posed by the CCP towards Taiwan and our country's countermeasures.
4. National Defense Policy and Military Strategy of Our Country
Weeks: 4
Unit Topics: Our national defense policy, military strategy and military planning of our country, military force development and military service transformation, national defense capabilities, national defense resources, and disaster prevention and rescue.
5. Military Service Practice and Career Planning under the Volunteer Military System
Weeks: 2
Unit Topics: Evolution of our country’s military service system, conscription procedures, introduction to the volunteer military service units of the National Armed Forces.
6. Patriotic Education
Weeks: 2
Unit Topics: Understanding our country, the mission of the national military, beliefs of soldiers and patriotic actions of modern youth, the 70th anniversary of the victory in the War of Resistance against Japan and Taiwan’s recovery—“Flesh and Blood Great Wall,” “Heroes Immortal.”
7. Tests
Weeks: 2

description.zh: 半導體晶片封裝及微電子元件構裝技術是將積體電路和其它電元件，依設計聯結在一系統中，再以構裝材料將晶片、基座及釘架封包。本課程將介紹陶瓷構裝和高分子構裝、及其相關技術、與工業現況。
description.en: Semiconductor chip packaging and microelectronic packaging is the critical technology to allow the chips be incorporated into an individual protective package, mounted with other components in hybrid or multichip modules, or connected directly onto a printed circuit board. This course will introduce both ceramic packaging and polymer packaging and their corresponding technology.

syllabi.outline:
半導體構裝技術是將積體電路和其它電元件，依設計聯結在一系統中，再以構裝材料將晶片、基座及釘架封包。本課程將介紹陶瓷構裝和高分子構裝、及其相關技術、與工業現況。
Semiconductor packaging facilitates the chips be incorporated into an individual protective package, mounted with other components in hybrid or multi-chip modules, or connected directly onto a printed circuit board. This course will introduce both ceramic packaging and polymer packaging and their corresponding technology. It covers the topics in any electronic system, including electrical design for power, signal, and EMI; thermal design by conduction, convection, and radiation heat transfer; thermo-mechanical failures and reliability; advanced packaging materials at micro and nano-scales; ceramic, organic, glass, and silicon substrates.

Week 6-8 Polymers in packaging
Week 9 Mid-term examination

Week 13-15 Package Sealing and Encapsulation
Week 16-17 Advanced packaging in micro and nanoscales
Week 18 Final examination

syllabi.outline:
物件導向程式設計是一種以物件為中心的程式設計方法. 本課程以Java為主, C++為輔. 讓同學們從實做中學習物件導向的開發概念, 此外近年AI寫程式能力大幅進步, 課程上使用AI進行協同開發. 課程大綱包括:
1. 類別(Class)介紹, 2.物件導向與資料抽象化, 3.類別與方法, 4. .繼承, 5. 靜態與動態繫結, 6. 多型性, 7. Java開發環境及工具, 8. 各種設計模式介紹(Design Patterns), 9. 使用Java開發小遊戲, 10. 訓練AI玩遊戲 

Class website: http://www.aiotlab.org/teaching/oop.html 

Object-oriented programming (OOP) is a programming paradigm based on the concept of "objects", which usually defined as “class” in programming language like C++ and Java. In this class we will introduce the basic concepts of OOP, such as object, class, encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. Java is the primary language used in the class, but we will also cover OOP in C++. We hope this class will help you understand OOP concepts as well as be ready for developing high-quality software.

．國家希望工程、國家環境保護計畫

The course is designed as the one in which all courses in the undergraduate program in the Department of Civil Engineering can be finally integrated. The aim is to help students integrate knowledge learned from the fundamental and advanced courses and to evaluate the performance of students based on the core abilities required in the program. Students can accomplish engineering practice design or project in a form of team work based on their specific interests, and can present their results. This training can strengthen the development of professional knowledge and skills of students to attain the program educational objectives and to meet the needs for engineering practice.
The engineering practice design or project in this course include:
(1) Structural and material engineering practice design or project
(2) Geotechnical engineering practice design or project
(3) Construction management practice design or project
(4) Ecological engineering and disaster prevention practice design

本課程透過使用者體驗與實踐導向的方法，引導學生學習服務設計與創新。課程以服務科學思維作為基礎，將設計思維從"產品開發"拓展至"服務體驗與系統設計"層面。其中採用「工作理論」(Jobs-to-be-Done, JTBD)作為創新的核心分析框架。

This course introduces service design and innovation through an experience-centered and practice-oriented approach. Designed for industrial design graduate students, the course expands design capability from product-focused thinking to service experiences and systems. Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD) is used as the core framing logic for innovation.

description.zh:
設計方法隨著技術演進逐步發展。本課程將介紹從Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) 到 Design for X (DFX) 的設計方法。在創造具有複雜幾何形狀的產品時，3D列印(又稱積體製造additive manufacturing) 是具備潛力的設計工具，特別是對於定制符合人體工程學的設備。本課程將透過專題實作與討論，讓學生探索設計方法對於3D列印的影響。完成本課程後，您將能夠：
1.描述設計方法的演變
2.討論藝術家、設計師和工程師之間的差異
3.了解不同3D列印技術的製程優勢和限制
4.分解從藝術到零件的 3D 工作流程
5.使用數位設計工具來優化 3D 零件的應用要求
description.en:
Design methodologies can evolve with the emergence of advanced technologies. This course will introduce a historical account of design methodologies from Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) to Design for X (DFX). In this regard, additive manufacturing (AM), also known as 3D printing, has great potential for creating products with complex geometric, particularly for custom-fit ergonomic devices. Project-based activities will be carried out for students to explore the effects of good and bad designs for 3D printing.
Upon completing this course, you will be able to:
1.Describe the evolution of design methodologies 
2.Discuss the differences between an artist, a designer, and an engineer   
3.Identify the key advantages and process-specific constraints of AM technology
4.Breakdown the 3D workflow from art to part  
5.Use computational design tools to optimal application requirements for 3D parts

syllabi.outline:
隨著製造技術持續演進，設計方法已不再僅是解決問題的工具，而逐步轉化為一種設計研究與實驗的框架。本課程將介紹 Design for Manufacturing and Assembly（可製造性和可組裝性設計，DfMA）、Design for X（卓越設計，DfX） 與 Circular Design（循環設計） 等設計方法，並探討數位製造如何重塑當代設計思維、材料實踐與空間生成方式。

課程以 3D 列印技術（加法製造，Additive Manufacturing）作為核心媒介，關注其在複雜幾何、材料行為與原型系統生成上的設計潛力。不同於將製造視為純技術流程，本課程將 3D 列印視為一種設計驅動的探索工具，引導學生從形式、結構、材料與循環策略等面向進行實驗與反思。

透過相關技術發展的講授、實作導向的工作坊，以及以設計為核心的研究型專題，本課程強調反覆試作（iterative prototyping）、材料測試，以及從概念意圖到材料落實之間的轉譯過程。學生將在數位工具的輔助下，將建築與藝術構想轉化為具備製造可行性、同時保有批判與實驗性的設計原型。

完成本課程後，學生將能夠：（1）理解「設計—製造」方法在設計研究脈絡中的演進與意涵；（2）辨析藝術家、設計師與工程師於數位工具使用上的差異，並探索跨領域合作的可能性；（3）分析不同 3D 列印製程於形式生成、材料實驗與空間應用上的潛力與限制；（4）將「設計—製造」流程視為設計決策與研究反思的重要場域，進行拆解與回饋；（5）運用計算式與數位設計工具，發展、測試並優化回應概念、材料與環境議題之 3D 列印構件與原型。

——
As manufacturing technologies evolve, design methodologies have expanded from problem-solving tools into critical frameworks for inquiry and experimentation. This course introduces key approaches including Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA), Design for X (DFX), and Circular Design, and examines how digital fabrication reshapes design thinking and material practice.

Focusing on 3D printing, or Additive Manufacturing, the course positions fabrication as a design-driven medium rather than a purely technical process. Students explore complex geometries, material behaviors, and prototypical systems through iterative experimentation.

Through lectures, hands-on fabrication workshops, and design-led research projects, students engage digital tools as mediators between conceptual intent and material realization. Emphasis is placed on iterative prototyping, material testing, and critical reflection within the design-to-manufacturing workflow, enabling students to translate architectural and artistic ideas into manufacturable yet speculative artifacts.

description.en: This course aims to teach postgraduate students to understand the basic theory and practice of medical design. Learn about the health and medical products/ systems/ services from the discovery of medical and user needs to the design of innovative healthcare products, which include the topics of how to generate the design concepts, understand the user and market needs, develop the engineering technologies and prototype, design pre-clinical testing and clinical trials, obtain medical certification and plan industrial management. To enable students to master the principles of interdisciplinary medical design, and teach them how to use innovative product design and development approach to guide professionals in medical backgrounds and design backgrounds to understand the key issues in developing successful health medical products in the market and address the needs of clinical services, propose innovative solutions for health care, and develop innovative health and medical products.

syllabi.outline: The purpose of this course is to provide students with a better understanding of both the theoretical and practical aspects of medical design. Through the course, students will learn how to approach the design of healthcare products, systems, and services, taking into account medical requirements and user needs. The curriculum covers topics such as developing design concepts, introducing and implementing engineering design, prototyping, preclinical testing, clinical trials, medical certification, and project management. Students will also gain a deep understanding of the principles of cross-disciplinary medical design and innovative product design and development methods. The course will teach students how to collaborate with medical and design professionals to develop successful healthcare products that meet the needs of clinical services. Ultimately, the goal is to produce innovative healthcare products that provide innovative solutions to healthcare.
syllabi.schedule:
Upon completion of this course, students will have achieved the following primary learning objectives:
•	Gain a comprehensive understanding of the product, system, and service development process geared towards elderly health and medical care to promote healthy ageing.
•	Familiarize themselves with the regulatory approval process and the key regulators involved in the development of new products, systems, and service portfolios.
•	Acquire knowledge of the technical and commercial factors essential for the successful development of ageing-related products.
•	Develop an awareness of the ethical, social, and cultural considerations involved in the introduction of new ageing health medical products.
•	Explore emerging medical product categories for senior health.
•	Analyse and critique real-life cases of the development of medical products designed for the elderly.
At the end of the course, students will have created a visionary concept and a commercialisation strategy for a new geriatric health product.

description.zh:
《數位影像處理實務》是一門以基礎理論結合實作應用為核心的課程，內容涵蓋影像處理中最重要且最常用的技術。本課程從影像基本概念與系統介紹開始，依序講解點運算、鄰域運算、離散傅立葉轉換與頻率域分析。接續介紹影像增強、影像復原以及影像分割等核心主題。

課程著重於以程式實作理解演算法原理，搭配 MATLAB 或 Python 完成影像處理任務，使學生能夠掌握空間域與頻率域的實作技巧。本課程特別適合修過《訊號與系統》與修過或正在修習《數位訊號處理》的學生，作為進入電腦視覺與人工智慧／機器學習影像領域的基礎。
description.en:
Digital Image Processing Practice is a hands-on course focusing on fundamental techniques widely used in modern image processing systems. The course begins with an overview of digital imaging concepts, followed by point processing, neighborhood processing, and Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT)-based frequency-domain analysis. Students will also learn essential methods for image enhancement, image restoration, and image segmentation.

The course emphasizes understanding algorithms and practical implementation through programming exercises using MATLAB or Python, covering both spatial-domain and frequency-domain processing techniques. This course is especially suitable for students who have taken Signals and Systems and who have taken or are currently taking Digital Signal Processing. It provides an essential foundation for entering the fields of computer vision and Artificial Intelligence/Machine-Learning-based image processing.

description.en:
This course covers optoelectronics combine with biomolecular of knowledge. We will focus on discussing how the DNA, RNA, protein or cells related with optoelectronic application.
Optoelectronics is the study and application of electronic devices that source, detect and control light, usually considered a subfield of photonics. The light often includes invisible forms of radiation such as gamma rays, X-rays, ultraviolet and infrared, in addition to visible light, which is based on the quantum mechanical effects of light on semiconducting materials. A biomolecule is any organic molecule that is produced by a living organism, including large polymeric molecules such as proteins, polysaccharides, and nucleic acids as well as small molecules such as primary metabolites, secondary metabolites, and natural products. As organic molecules, biomolecules consist primarily of carbon and hydrogen, nitrogen, and oxygen, and, to a smaller extent, phosphorus and sulfur.

syllabi.outline:
一、	Course Objective
Understanding international business management from the global perspective, students will learn the role of international monetary institutions as well as political and economic factor that influence foreign direct investments.。
In addition, this course provides insight into factors that influence internationalization, entry strategies into foreign markets such as exporting, licensing, joint-ventures and tools to manage and evaluate risks and changes of international operations. This course has an interdisciplinary approach by providing insights on how the international political environment affects business decisions such as internationalizing or global production. MBA students are very welcome to attend this course

description.en: This course will read and discuss issues, topics, and practices of the UN’s 2030 agenda for sustainable development, adopted by all UN member states. This course (English for SDGs, Section A) will read and discuss issues, topics, and practices of the UN’s 2030 agenda for sustainable development, adopted by all UN member states. With full insights and comprehensive views of the shared blueprint for global prosperity, social equality and environmental sustainability, students are expected to participate in global activities and form partnership locally and across borders to engage in SDGs actions. In addition, students will be able to enhance their English competence through critical reading and discussion, and will be prepared for more in-depth communication pertaining to the SDGs.

Learning Outcomes
By the end of the course, students will be able to:
1. Explain selected SDG issues clearly in English using key vocabulary and basic evidence (data, examples).
2. Participate actively in structured small-group discussions using discussion roles and sentence frames.
3. Connect global issues to Taiwan contexts using specific local examples and terms.
4. Evaluate SDG solutions by identifying tradeoffs, stakeholders, and feasibility.
5. Deliver short presentations with clear structure, intelligible delivery, and responsive Q&A.

name.zh: 全端網頁軟體系統實作

description.zh: 伴隨全球資訊網(Web)普及應用，可讓不同裝置、系統運行相同網路服務的網頁平台儼然成為當下資訊系統的主要潮流，過去網頁系統的建構可區分成1.網頁前端(Front-end)：主負責使用者看見的瀏覽器端，以及2.網頁後端(Back-end)：主負責運算、儲存資源的伺服器端，不同面向的軟體人才必須熟悉不同軟體實作技巧，然而，面臨物聯網(Internet of Things)、第5代行動通訊(5G)的挑戰，產業需要能夠同時精通前端與後端之軟體實作技術，並進一步延伸支援外部系統整合與介接的全端(Full Stack)軟體人才，本課程主旨為教授網頁前端、後端軟體實作技巧，並結合新一代網路協定，以及外部感測裝置，建構出全方位之網頁系統軟體。
description.en: With the growth of World Wide Web, the web platform can let different devices and systems operate the same network service. Thus, the web platform has become the key foundation of modern software implementation. In the past, it can be divided into (1) front-end, which represents the user-side browser, and (2) back-end, which represents the server of data processing and storage. Programmers need to learn different front-end or back-end techniques. However, regarding 5G and Internet of Things, industries need full-stack software programmers. The goal of this course is to teach the front-end and back-end software implementation. Furthermore, the course would introduce how to integrate new network protocols and connect embedded sensors. After learning in this course, students are expected to implement one comprehensive web software system.

description.zh:
在過去的60年裡，生物醫學工程學科發展已成為明確的，多樣化的，內容無所不包的領域；包括生物電現象、生物信息學、生物材料、生物力學、生物儀器、生物傳感器、生物信號處理等領域，以及生物技術、計算生物學和複雜多樣性、基因組學、醫學影像學、光學和雷射激光、輻射影像、組織工程等。
本課程主要將適用於工程學門學生，且已完成物理、化學或生物學基礎課程為佳。此基礎在大二或大三的學生應該已可做好充分的準備。本課程將學習人體解剖學、生理學、生物物理學和生物醫學工程。整合了一系列知識，以幫助修課同學瞭解生物訊息和醫學儀器，並可以用來監測這些生物醫學現象。課程的學習主要是將這些生物醫學現象，運用其基礎於電力、壓力和流量的物理現象加以說明，並將這些生物醫學現象經由電子及工程的特殊條件和應用系統而呈現。在這種學習中，課程涵蓋了相關醫學和生物學領域、化學、物理、工程的知識和方法，期使將其成功及適當應用於多種生物醫學儀器。本課程將主要研習人體結構（解剖）及其功能系統（生理學），但這些原則同樣也可能適用於其它所有生命系統。
經由醫學背景引導進入此領域，結合工程及材料師長的經驗及參與，將可含括主要生醫工程及組織工程領域的基礎
description.en: Over the past sixty years, as the discipline of biomedical engineering has evolved, it has become clear that it is a diverse, seemingly all-encompassing field that includes such areas as bioelectric phenomena, bioinformatics, biomaterials, biomechanics, bioinstrumentation, biosensors, biosignal processing, biotechnology, computational biology and complexity, genomics, medical imaging, optics and lasers, radiation imaging, tissue engineering, moral and ethical issues. This course will be designed primarily for engineering students who have completed physical equations and a basic course in statics of chemistry and biology.  Students in their sophomore year or junior year should be adequately prepared for this course.  This course will be learning about human anatomy, biophysics, physiology, and biomedical engineering. syllabi.outline:
人體結構複雜且脆弱，容易罹患各類疾病，包括關節、神經及肌肉損傷。隨著年齡增長，身體組織逐漸退化並喪失重要功能。透過研究人體運作機制，生物醫學科學家、工程團隊、臨床醫師及其他科學家正站在開發新型人類疾病治療與預防方法的最前線。
生理學研究從分子、細胞到組織及個體層面，探討支配生物系統運作的複雜機制。運用多元創新技術與尖端工具，不僅解析具治療潛力的疾病機制與路徑，更致力開發與優化組織及器官再生工程技術。
國立臺北科技大學的生理學研究融合基礎、臨床與轉譯研究，秉承「實驗室到病床」與「病床到實驗室」的深厚傳統。研究涵蓋細胞、組織及動物模型，並運用創新遠端生理監測工具，在實驗室與日常生活中同步進行人類研究。
全球學生最愛生理學教材《蓋頓與霍爾醫學生理學 (Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology)》以獨特易懂的形式呈現複雜知識。這部暢銷教材的第十五版（2025年）內容全面更新，清晰涵蓋臨床、臨床前及生物醫學工程學生最需掌握的核心知識。獨特編排確保複雜概念的最大化學習與記憶效果：核心資訊以加大字體呈現，輔助內容則採用小字體並以淡藍色標示——便於快速瀏覽重點或深入鑽研。
• 聚焦核心內容與人體維持健康穩態的機制，強調有助日後臨床與工程決策的關鍵原理。
• 新增生理學與生物醫學工程領域資訊，並涵蓋生理實驗室數值中具臨床重要性的性別差異。

syllabi.outline:
Engineering problems always involve complicated mathematics. Traditionally, solving mathematical equations requires elaborating process of derivation and induction of formula which require students to spend a long time to learn and master the skills and still not every student can achieve the level of expertise to solve these complicated equations. Moreover, many of these equations are not able to solve analytically. With the advance of computing technologies, an ordinary student, when helped by suitable software, can solve those equations which only gifted students could solve before. Not only that, those equations not solvable analytically can be solved today numerically. The purpose of this course is to train undergraduate students to solve engineering problems by using computers. Students will learn not only the theoretical background of numerical methods but also the popular engineering software MATLAB in this class. The choice of MATLAB instead of programming language like FORTRAN, C, or C++ is because MATLAB not only provides an abundant repertoire of programs for solving all kinds of engineering problems but also is a programming language that students use to create his own programs. This will equip students with a powerful tool no matter for higher study or an engineering career in the future. The contents include the following topics.
1.	Introduction to numerical method and MATLAB: give introductory examples, useful background material, identification of some basic issues and an introduction of computation and programming with MATLAB.
2.	Roots of Equations: deals with finding the zeros of a nonlinear function of one variable, as well as methods for minimization of such a function.
3.	Linear Algebra and Matrices: treat topics from numerical linear algebra. Include solving systems of linear equations, factorization of matrices and matrix inversion.
4.	Curve Fitting: deals with finding an equation that fits a set of points by linear least-square and nonlinear regression. Include polynomial regression, multiple linear regression, general linear least-square regression, QR factorization and the backslash operator, and nonlinear regression.
5.	Interpolation: include Newton interpolation, Lagrange interpolation and splines.
6.	Numerical Integration: give the formula for integrating a function that can not be analytically integrated. Include Newton-Cotes formula, the trapezoidal rule, Simpson’s rule, Romberg integration and Gauss quadrature.
7.	Ordinary Differential Equations: many engineering problems are solved in ODE form. This is always the most difficult parts of numerical methods. This chapter gives the technique for solving ODE. Include Euler’s method, Runge-Kutta method, multi-step method. 
8.	Eigenvalues: gives the technique for finding eigenvalues. Include polynomial method and power method.

name.en: Core Network System Architecture and ORAN

description.zh: 本課程的目的在深入探討地面核心網路系統結構和Open Radio Access Network (ORAN)的實務應用。課程內容包括地面核心網路技術、架構設計原則，以及相關技術的實作。學生將透過理論探討和實際操作，深入瞭解地面核心網路在通信系統中的關鍵角色，並學會設計、建置和維護這些系統。同時，課程聚焦於ORAN的實際應用，提供學生實務操作的機會，使其能夠理解並應用ORAN標準於實際網路環境。學生將學習ORAN的基本原理、架構，以及與傳統基地台技術的比較。透過專題實作，學生有機會參與ORAN的設計和實施，強化他們的實務能力。藉由此課程，學生將建立堅實的理論基礎，同時習得實際應用的經驗，為他們未來在通信科技領域的職業發展打下穩固基礎。
description.en: This course explores the practical applications of ground network system architecture and Open Radio Access Network (ORAN). Topics include ground network technologies, design principles, and hands-on implementation. Students will gain a deep understanding of the vital role of ground networks in communication systems and develop skills in designing, building, and maintaining these systems. The course also focuses on practical ORAN applications, offering students hands-on experience to understand and apply ORAN standards in real network environments. Through projects, students will engage in the design and implementation of ORAN, enhancing their practical skills and establishing a strong foundation for future careers in communication technology.

name.zh: 人體生物學及生物物理學

description.zh:
在過去的60年裡，生物醫學工程學科發展已成為明確的，多樣化的，內容無所不包的領域；包括生物電現象、生物信息學、生物材料、生物力學、生物儀器、生物傳感器、生物信號處理等領域，以及生物技術、計算生物學和複雜多樣性、基因組學、醫學影像學、光學和雷射激光、輻射影像、組織工程等。
本課程主要將適用於工程學門學生，且已完成物理、化學或生物學基礎課程為佳。此基礎在大二或大三的學生應該已可做好充分的準備。本課程將學習人體解剖學、生理學、生物物理學和生物醫學工程。整合了一系列知識，以幫助修課同學瞭解生物訊息和醫學儀器，並可以用來監測這些生物醫學現象。課程的學習主要是將這些生物醫學現象，運用其基礎於電力、壓力和流量的物理現象加以說明，並將這些生物醫學現象經由電子及工程的特殊條件和應用系統而呈現。在這種學習中，課程涵蓋了相關醫學和生物學領域、化學、物理、工程的知識和方法，期使將其成功及適當應用於多種生物醫學儀器。本課程將主要研習人體結構（解剖）及其功能系統（生理學），但這些原則同樣也可能適用於其它所有生命系統。
經由醫學背景引導進入此領域，結合工程及材料師長的經驗及參與，將可含括主要生醫工程及組織工程領域的基礎

syllabi.outline:
人體結構複雜且脆弱，容易罹患各類疾病，包括關節、神經及肌肉損傷。隨著年齡增長，身體組織逐漸退化並喪失重要功能。透過研究人體運作機制，生物醫學科學家、工程團隊、臨床醫師及其他科學家正站在開發新型人類疾病治療與預防方法的最前線。
生理學研究從分子、細胞到組織及個體層面，探討支配生物系統運作的複雜機制。運用多元創新技術與尖端工具，不僅解析具治療潛力的疾病機制與路徑，更致力開發與優化組織及器官再生工程技術。
國立臺北科技大學的生理學研究融合基礎、臨床與轉譯研究，秉承「實驗室到病床」與「病床到實驗室」的深厚傳統。研究涵蓋細胞、組織及動物模型，並運用創新遠端生理監測工具，在實驗室與日常生活中同步進行人類研究。
全球學生最愛生理學教材《蓋頓與霍爾醫學生理學 (Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology)》以獨特易懂的形式呈現複雜知識。這部暢銷教材的第十五版（2025年）內容全面更新，清晰涵蓋臨床、臨床前及生物醫學工程學生最需掌握的核心知識。獨特編排確保複雜概念的最大化學習與記憶效果：核心資訊以加大字體呈現，輔助內容則採用小字體並以淡藍色標示——便於快速瀏覽重點或深入鑽研。
• 聚焦核心內容與人體維持健康穩態的機制，強調有助日後臨床與工程決策的關鍵原理。
• 新增生理學與生物醫學工程領域資訊，並涵蓋生理實驗室數值中具臨床重要性的性別差異。

description.zh: 機器學習探討如何能由觀測到的資料中自我學習，自我進化，而能自動增進其處理效能。例如進行預測，特徵擷取，分類，模式辨認，決策，各種訊號處理，甚至建立人工智慧等等。本課程將介紹機器學習的基礎演算法、理論及工具。並讓學生嘗試在各種領域中實際實踐這些技術。課程內容包括：(a) 監督式學習（例如參數和非參數演算法、支持向量機和類神經網路等），(b) 無監督學習（例如群聚、降維和深度學習等）與 (c) 機器學習應用實例（例如語音信號處理，影像訊號處理，音訊訊號處理與自然語言處理，資訊擷取與資料搜尋等）。
description.en: Machine learning studies how to automatically learn from observed data to improve the performance of prediction, information extraction, clustering, pattern recognition, decision making, signal processing and even artificial intelligence. This course will introduce fundamental algorithms, theories and their practical applications. The content will cover (a) supervised learning, such as parametric and non-parametric algorithms, super vector machines and neural networks, (b) unsupervised learning, for example, data clustering, dimension reduction and deep learning and (c) practical applications on speech, image, audio signal and natural language processing or information retrieval and search, etc.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在讓學生掌握MATLAB的基本操作與機器學習技術，內容涵蓋數據導入與處理、知識發掘、回歸分析、分類演算法、聚類方法及人工神經網路等主題。此外，課程強調模型效能的優化與實務應用，透過結合理論講解與實作練習，幫助學生培養解決實際問題的能力，最終能夠獨立完成機器學習專案。This course is designed to equip students with fundamental MATLAB operations and machine learning techniques. The content includes data importing and processing, knowledge discovery, regression analysis, classification algorithms, clustering methods, and artificial neural networks. Furthermore, the course emphasizes model performance optimization and practical applications. By combining theoretical instruction with hands-on exercises, students will develop the ability to solve real-world problems and eventually complete independent machine learning projects.

name.zh: 系統級封裝之雛型設計與應用

description.zh:
本課程的目標在於使學生學習完整的系統級封裝(SiP)之雛型設計。介紹SIP生產中使用的系統設計技術，分割、整合、覆晶、線接合、多層堆疊、高密度黏著技術和量測方法；再介紹訊號與電源完整分析。使得SiP 應用基材特性與電路佈局的概念能完成SiP設計。本課程之大綱如下所示：
1.SiP設計簡介
2.晶片互連技術
3.晶圓級堆疊封裝技術
4.覆晶技術   
5.線接合技術 
6.多層堆疊技術 
7.高密度黏著技術量測方法
8.訊號完整分析
9.電源完整分析
10.設計實例
description.en:
The goal of this course is that the students will learn SiP prototyping design and Applications. This course will introduce the systematic design methodology of the SiP technologies, partitioning, integration, Flip-Chip, wire bonding, muti-stacks, high density sticking, measurement. Moreover, the signal and power integrity analysis will be introduced here. Therefore, the students can use the properties of SiP substrate and schematics layout concept to implement the SiP design. The outline of this course are shown as follows:
1.Basic Principle of SiP Design
2.Interconnection Technologies Between Chips
3.Packing Technology of Die-level Stack
4.Flip-Chip Technologies
5.Wire Bonding Technologies
6.Muti-stacks Technologies
7.High density Sticking Technologies
8.Measurement Methods
9.Signal Integrity
10.Power Integrity
11.Design Case Study

syllabi.outline:
System packaging employs multilayer structures to provide power to chips. However, power delivery networks are affected by factors such as parallel-plate resonance and switching noise resulting from coupling between parallel plates and transmission lines, which can cause power integrity issues. This course will introduce the causes of the aforementioned problems from an electromagnetic field perspective and utilize circuit theory to establish models and perform simulation analysis. Finally, improved design methods will be introduced through practical examples to enhance the power quality of power distribution networks. This enables understanding of analog circuit design and integrated system packaging for power and signal design, thereby establishing a foundation for the research and development of high-speed digital systems.

系統構裝使用多層結構提供晶片電源，然而，電源遞送網路會受到平板共振、以及平板與傳輸線耦合的切換雜訊等因素影響，造成電源完整度的問題。本課程將從電磁場的角度介紹上述問題的成因，並利用電路的理論進行模型的建立及模擬分析，最後且以實例介紹改良設計方法，使電源分佈網路的電源品質可以改善，以了解類比電路設計及整合系統構裝的電源及訊號設計，進而建立研發高速數位系統的基礎。

description.zh: 如何藉由商務模型的分析，建置數位化協同產品設計與開發環境，並說明資料管理、構型管隨著網路時代的來臨，不但造成數位化協同產品設計與開發觀念的興起，也造成數位化協同平台技術逐漸成熟，並且將同步工程觀念的實現更往前邁進一大步。本課程是從數位化協同產品設計與開發概念之介紹開始，使學生明白數位化協同產品設計與開發在現代製造業中的重要性，接著介紹理與工作流程管理等相關實務應用觀念。
description.en: Information and network technologies have promoted the traditional concurrent engineering to the next generation. The collaborative e-design and e-development concept has been more popular in industries. This course is introduced from the concept of collaborative product design and development to help students understanding the importance of collaborative e-design and e-development in modern industries. Furthermore, the business model analysis method is provided to construct the collaborative environment of e-design and e-development. In addition, some real cases of data management, configuration management, and workflow management are mentioned.

name.en: Understand the basic structure of programming languages.

description.zh: 瞭解程式語言的基本結構，並以C語言為主要實習對象，其內容包含：1. 程式語言簡介：介紹各種程式語言及其特性，並對C語言之發展沿革架構及持點詳加討論，2. 資料型態：介紹C語言之資料型態及各種運算子，3. 基本輸入：介紹各種輸出入函數及輸出入實習，4. 流程控制：介紹指定指述，選擇敘述及迴圈敘述，並做實習，5. 前置處理：介紹前置處理觀念及程式實作，6. 函式：介紹主副程式及實作，7. 陣列與字串：介紹各種陣列之特性及字串與陣列之關係，並做實習，8. 結構型態：介紹結構，列舉及同位資料型態及應用實習，9. 指標：介紹指標之觀念及應用實習，10. 位元運算：介紹位元運算及應用實習，11. 檔案處理：各種檔案之介紹及檔案輸出入函數，12. 鍵盤與游標控制：介紹鍵盤、游標之控制及字元之特性，並作相關實習，13. 繪圖與音樂：介紹文字模式及繪圖模式函數，並作實習，14. C語言與物件導向：介紹C++與物件導向之關係，及物件與類別之基本定義，並作相關實習。
description.en: Understand the basic structure of programming languages. C language is used for the practice. The course includes: 1. Introduction to programming languages: introduce various programming languages as well as their properties and discuss the history, the structure and advantages of C language. 2. Data types: introduce the data types and operators of C language. 3. Basic Input and Output: introduce various input and output functions and work on their practices. 4. Processes Control: introduce assignments, select statements and loop statements and work on their practices. 5. Preprocess: introduce the concept of the preprocess and work on the programming practice. 6. Functions: introduce the main program and subroutines. 7. Array and strings: introduce the properties of various arrays as well as the relations between strings and arrays and work on their practices. 8. Structure data types: introduce structure data types and work on the practices. 9. Pointers: introduce the concept of pointe

description.zh: 瞭解電路元件之基本特性及其組合電路之分析方法，內容包含：1.電路元件：電壓及電流源，主動元件，2.電路特性：歐姆定律，柯希荷夫電壓與電流定律等，3.一階及二階電路：電路之微分方程描述及各種輸入信號之響應，4.穩態分析與頻率響應：分析電路之頻域，5.電腦輔助電路分析：如使用 SPICE 工具。

description.zh: 本課程內容包括邏輯閘的特性與功能測試，能利用積體電路完成各種基礎邏輯電路的組裝及設計，並能利用電子儀器進行量測、檢修。探討最佳化組合邏輯之演算法，可規劃邏輯元件，組合邏輯之VLSI設計，使用MSI與標準電路元件設計多層邏輯，使用閘陣列設計，循序邏輯之元件，循序邏輯之分析與合成，VLSI之設計與測試技巧，各種CAD軟體工具介紹。基礎邏輯閘實驗、組合邏輯實驗、加法器及減法器實驗、組合邏輯應用實驗、正反器邏輯實驗、循序邏輯電路應用實驗。
description.en: 1.Properties and function tests of logic gates. 2. Combinational logic application experiments. 16. Flip-flop experiments. 17. Sequential circuit application experiments.

name.en: Course in English language Proficiency Tests

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.

description.en: This course utilizes actual case studies of chemical process accidents to discuss the root causes and process safety design concepts, and then explores the relevant theoretical background based on chemical engineering principles. The courses contains11 units, including Unit 1: Lab safety, Unit 2: Static sparks, Unit 3: High temperature hydrogen attack, Unit 4: Uncontrolled reaction, Unit 5: Runaway reaction, Unit 6: Human error, Unit 7: Improper design and change, Unit 8: Dust explosion, Unit 9: Hazard of water, Unit 10: Confined space and Unit 11: Hot work hazards.

name.en: Advanced Topics and Practices in Applied Microbiology

description.zh: 這門課程涵蓋應用微生物的理論與實作，基礎部分將由淺入深，著重在於微生物的基本知識的補強，包含分類、特性與代謝，同時能顧及非生物背景的學生對微生物基本生理與生態的理解。特論部分將分別討論微生物在現代生技、醫藥、農業與環保等領域的發展與應用，例如益生菌，益生原，益生質的差異以及各自的發展與應用，微生物發酵產物在醫學上的應用，微生物在土壤改良及病蟲害防治上的發展與應用，以及微生物在各種人造污染的清理上的發展與應用。實作方面，實務操作微生物基本操作及設備簡介，菌種分離，菌種鑑定，各種抑菌效果分析測試，以及產生抗生物質的微生物篩選。(中文/英文 上課)
description.en: This course covers both the theoretical and practical aspects of applied microbiology. The foundational section progresses from basic to advanced topics and emphasizes reinforcement of essential microbiological knowledge, including classification, characteristics, and metabolism. Instruction is designed to accommodate students without a biological background, ensuring understanding of basic microbial physiology and ecology. The advanced-topic section examines the development and applications of microbiology across modern biotechnology, medicine, agriculture, and environmental remediation. Examples include the differences in development and use of probiotics, prebiotics, and postbiotics; medical applications of microbial fermentation products; applications of microbes in soil improvement and pest/disease control; and the use of microorganisms for the remediation of various anthropogenic pollutants. The practical component covers hands-on microbiology techniques, an introduction to stand

syllabi.outline: 本課程主要在使學生懂得基本的微生物學外，更將引導學生練習閱讀一些國外期刊的最新研究，內容包括：微生物分子遺傳、微生物疫、微生物生理及微生物與藥物等知識。實作的部分將訓練學生基本微生物操作，菌種分離，鑑定，以及抗菌測試!

description.zh:
本課程介紹環境之物理及人因相關因素對人員生理及肌肉骨骼系統之影響。內容包括噪音與噪音防治、氣溫等大氣狀況、振動與加速度、環境照明、人體計測與工作/工作空間設計等相關內容。課程目的在使修課學生了解工業環境與作業負荷對於人員之影響，進而於職場建立有效之因應對策。使學生能夠
a. 瞭解工作場所主要人因工程危害因子(包括採光照明、噪音振動、極端溫濕環境、異常氣壓等物理因子及肌肉骨骼危害因子)、法規要求、量測/計算方法、評估與控制策略、以及相對應的預防措施。
b. 具有評估及分析工業環境物理性與肌肉骨骼危害因子及擬訂其控制及預防對策的能力。
description.en: This course introduces physical and musculoskeletal effects of various environmental and ergonomic factors on humans. Lectures cover topics of noise and noise control, environmental temperature, vibration and acceleration measurements, environmental illumination, and work design. This course aims to cultivate students to identify different types of ergonomic risk factors (e.g. luminance, extreme temperatures, abnormal pressure, noise, vibration, musculoskeletal hazards) that can present in the work environment and to learn the related regulation requirements, risk assessment tools, and hazard control strategies.

syllabi.outline: This course introduces students to the process of data science, covering problem formulation, data acquisition, modeling and analysis, and presentation and integration into action. Students will learn useful skills as well as basic statistical methods by completing several hands-on problems focused on real-world data. This course starts with a brief introduction to multivariate data analysis and data summarization including visualization. Then it extends to focus on using data to develop predictive capabilities using supervised and unsupervised machine learning models (regression, classification, clustering, PCA, etc.).

Week 15-17	Unsupervised learning (Clustering, k-means)

description.zh:
隨著網際網路的盛行，電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，使得傳統的商店與行銷環境受到衝擊。資訊科技改變了消費習慣與行銷通路，電子商務的效應已經開始影響商業活動的每個層面，從新產品的開發、銷售、到售後服務均受影響，為企業帶來了無限商機。根據資策會的報告顯示，網際購物市場目前正進入高成長期。網際網路的消費觀念逐漸普及，消費者端的網路交易市集，亦成為未來重要的網路商機。不僅B2C市場（企業對消費者）極具潛力，網友個體戶的開店創業風潮（C2C）更是在蓬勃發中。
在台灣，擁有十個以上員工的公司有86%有自屬的企業網站，而擁有自屬網站的頁有近七成聘僱網頁設計師進駐公司任職，面對網路商業的來臨，有著大量的網路商業的人才需求。只要有正確的網路商業經營獲利模式，網路是一個可以賺到大錢的管道，尤其低門檻、低成本的網路拍賣場更是最佳踏板。本課程講授網路創業及網路商業的必要實務經營能力，讓同學在本課程裡學得如何快速的以最少成本來DIY速成個人事業及就業的能力
description.en: Following the prevailing of the internet, the vigorous development e-commerce has given great impacts on traditional tangible stores and the whole marketing environments. Information Technology has not only changed our lives, but also changed consumers' behavior and marketing channels; and the e-commerce effect has already started to permeate into every stratum of business activities, including the exploitation, marketing, and after-sales service of new products, brings the industries infinite business chances. According to the reports of Institute for Information Industry, the market of internet shopping is going into its high development period, and there are a lot of chances to establish a new enterprise on the internet. So this course will teach about the internet entrepreneurial management.

syllabi.outline:
With the development of internet technology, vigorous internet entrepreneurship has challenged traditional physical stores and provided huge opportunities in the modern business environment. new digital technologies and mobile devices do not only change our lives but also change consumers' behavior and communication channels. This course combines innovation and entrepreneurship with the business environment in the digital age, including business strategy, innovative thinking, and entrepreneurship. This course will introduce online entrepreneurship concepts, approaches, and practices. learning objectives mainly include:
1. Identify the online business opportunities in digital times.
2. Understand innovative concepts and business models.
3. Discuss online business operations and marketing.
4. Learn to write an online business plan.
5. Prepare to participate in entrepreneurship competitions.

description.zh: 本課程引入生活性的學習方法來誘發學生學習動機，並培養可在社會與職場運用的四項英文基本技能。課程目標在幫助學生在生活實境習得英文，為他們裝備可溝通表達於日常、社交活動，並提升職涯的整合性英文技能。每堂課程都注重在以學生為中心的學習活動中帶入全真、應用性高的英文技巧。課程設計涵蓋的功能包括課堂分享與作業、日常互動英文以及專業英文練習。主要課題包括溝通，簡報與談判技巧，應用閱讀與寫作，聽力技巧運用，語言與文化。
description.en: This course introduces real-world based learning approaches for students to raise their learning aspirations and to develop four essential English skills that are applicable in social and professional encounters. This course aims to help students practice English in most real-life settings and to equip them with integrated skills to advance their careers. Every class session focuses on bringing authentic and applied English in student-centered leaning activities. The class design covers the functions like information sharing and task-based activities, social interactions, and professional English practices. Essential topics include communication, techniques of negotiation and presentation, applied reading and writing, strategies for developing listening skills and language learning across cultures.

description.zh:
超低溫冷凍通常指進行在-100℃以下特定低溫範圍之冷凍技術應用，譬如高能能物理同步輻射冷卻，生物醫學胚胎冷凍保存，大型超低溫冷能氣化發電廠與中、長程飛彈推進系統冷卻技術等，現代微系統科技多方面高層次應用上之必要技術。故如何進行實質而有效整合超低溫系統技術，是決定未來國力競爭之主要關鍵項目。本課程主要內容將涵蓋：
1. 多段多元化自動冷卻系統技術。
2. .超低溫循環冷媒特性。
3. 生物基因晶化冷凍技術應用。
4. 系統裝置之材料選擇。
5. 電子微觀系統應用。
6. 超低溫冷卻劑之檢測與分析。
description.en:
At the completion will have learned of this course:
1. Multiple stage and cascade refrigeration systems technology.
2. Refrigerant characteristics for low-temperature cycle.
3. Biomedical applications of cryogenic refrigeration.
4. Choice of low-temperature materials for refrigeration systems.
5. Research applications of electron microscopy.
6. Refrigerant properties of super low-temperature coolants.

description.zh: 本課程旨在瞭解世界地域文化中，因人、因時、因地制宜的建築生產過程，及其涉入空間行為因時間積累而呈現的特殊環境型態、類型與結構；即在探討地方自然地理環境，如何經由人類行為的涉入，呈現出富鄉土涵構的人文景觀。
description.en: This course is to understand the relations between human, behavior, material and the environment of architecture in the world. And try to introduce the vernacular characters of the World architecture by the discussion of some special architectural themes.

syllabi.outline: 本課程為「風土建築」的理論、環境與構築實踐，課程內容將重新定義「風土建築」為動態的永續知識體系。前半段奠定理論根基，從 AlSayyad 的傳統批判與 Oliver 的全球視野出發，建立嚴謹的研究倫理，剖析權力、文化與現代化如何影響建築變遷。課程核心聚焦於「環境—材料—構造」的技術落實，包括（1）物理調節： 解構氣候與地形的設計約束，分析「風、光、水、熱」的被動式節能智慧。（2）材料構築： 探討在地材料的物性轉化、工匠隱性知識的傳承，以及外殼防禦極端氣候的構造邏輯。最終透過類型學分析與性能優化，討論在法規與災害衝擊下，如何將風土智慧轉化為當代永續居住系統的「再生設計」方案。
syllabi.schedule:
第一階段：理論、思想與變遷概要
    [單元 1]：風土的定義與權力觀 (AlSayyad & Bronner) ：探討「傳統」並非靜止，而是由權力與文化共同定義的動態過程。釐清研究者的位置，避將風土浪漫化，理解建築作為一種社會授權的產物。
    [單元 2]：跨文化的風土百科 (Paul Oliver 遺產) ：建立全球視野下的風土建築分類學。理解不同族群如何在地理限制下，透過世代累積的知識體系，發展出獨特的居住智慧。
    [單元 3]：現代化、全球化與變遷邏輯 (Vellinga 觀點)：分析在觀光化、都市化與法規衝擊下，風土建築如何從「傳統資產」轉向「現代再生」。探討混合形式（Hybridity）與文化認同的演變。
________________________________________
第二階段：自然環境與被動式設計
    [單元 4]：地理約束與設計回應 (Amos Rapoport 觀點) ：解讀氣候、地形與災害如何形成設計的「硬約束」。分析建築如何作為人類與自然環境之間的精密濾網。
    [單元 5]：微氣候調節：風、光、熱的物理學 深入探討被動式環境策略，如熱質量（Thermal Mass）、自然通風誘導與採光邏輯，學習不依賴機械設備的節能智慧。
    [單元 6]：極端環境下的韌性構造 (Ian Davis 觀點) ：分析應對颱風、地震、洪水等自然災害的防禦性構造。研究傳統工法如何在災後重建中提供低技術、高適應性的方案。
________________________________________
第三階段：材料物性與構築語彙
    [單元 7]：在地材料的轉化與結構系統：
探討土、木、石、竹等材料的力學特徵與耐久性。分析材料如何從資源採集、加工到形成樑柱與牆體的構造邏輯。
    [單元 8]：工法傳承與匠藝知識 (Trevor Marchand 觀點)：
以學徒制與工匠體系為例，探討「隱性知識」如何透過構築行動傳承，確保技術與在地材料特性的完美耦合。
    [單元 9]：屋頂與外殼的防護邏輯 (Meir & Roaf 觀點) ：解構建築外殼在防雨、防雪、隔熱上的細部處理。探討如何運用現代工具優化傳統構造的物理性能。
________________________________________
第四階段：總結與未來實踐
    [單元 10]：永續居住系統的再生設計：結合類型學與參與式設計，討論如何將風土智慧整合進現代建築教育與災後重建。將風土視為可持續進化的「活系統」。

name.en: Special Topics on Indoor Environment Quality

description.zh:
本課程主要在教導學生深入探討最新的室內環境議題與人體健康間的關係，使學生具備創造健康室內環境的相關知識及操作能力，主要授課要點如下：
1.以單一類型的建築室內環境為探討主題；
2.探討環境影響人體健康之最新研究議題；
3.進行跨領域合作提出共同改善之策略及方法；
4.學習各項環境量測儀器之原理、操作與判讀能力；
5.具備診斷與改善特殊室內環境議題之專業知識及操作能力。
description.en:
In this course students are going to be taught how to discuss the relationship between indoor environment quality and human healthy in order to promote students' recognition and abilities to create healthy indoor environment.
Contents :
1. The indoor environment of single type of building.
2. The relationship between the artificial environment and human health.
3. Providing some strategies and methods to improve indoor environment quality through cooperating with other science field.
4. Learning how to use instruments to evaluate indoor environment quality.
5. Learning how to diagnose and improve the special topics of indoor environment quality.

syllabi.outline:
為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。
本課程為第二階段之系列課程，其內容包括：一、疫學：探討關於病態建築症候群的因素與特定外來的致病物質與疫之關聯。二、家政事務：探討生活習慣、飲食生活的變化對環境、人體健康之影響。三、醫療領域：探討病態建築症候群與化學物質過敏症的差異與因應對策。四、日常領域：探討日常生活用品、居住行為對環境、人體健康之影響。

name.en: THE EVALUATION FOR BUILDING'S CARBON FOOTPRINT

description.zh: 本課程是在講述建築生命週期碳足跡的評估法。藉由標準化、透明化的建築資訊，一步步剖析建築生命週期各階段對環境的影響。本課程得評估整棟建築生命週期的碳足跡、甚進一步提出減碳熱點，了解建築物的節碳潛力所在。
description.en: This course evaluates the carbon footprint of a building's life cycle. Through standardized and transparent building information, the impact of various stages of the building life cycle on the environment is analyzed step by step. This course not only evaluates the carbon footprint of the entire building life cycle but also further identifies carbon hotspots and provides carbon reduction strategies, hence understanding carbon savings potential of buildings.

syllabi.outline: 國際能源署(IEA)呼籲全球國家訂定淨零碳排路徑，國內也發佈「台灣 2050 淨零路徑及策略」，具體宣告了淨零碳排的目標期程與行動方案，針對建築部門納入低碳(低蘊含碳)建築評估(Low Embodied-carbon Building Rating System, LBERS)，藉由標準化、透明化的建築資訊來剖析建築生命週期各階段對環境的影響，以培養永續淨零概念並具備評估整棟建築生命週期的碳足跡、甚進一步提出減碳熱點，了解建築物的節碳潛力所在。了解國內外淨零碳排路徑策略、具備建築物生命週期的整體流程概念、具備建築碳足跡計算操作能力。
syllabi.schedule:
1-3 國內外建築碳足跡趨勢
4-5 LEBR方法學、建築構件的評估範疇、建築構件生命週期與更新次數標準
6-8 建築構件碳排標準資料庫、建築構件碳排標準資料庫
9 期中考/期中報告
10-14 主結構碳排計算法、製造運輸與更新修繕兩階段碳排計算法、施工階段碳排計算法、拆除廢棄階段碳排計算法
15-16 低碳循環建材與低碳工法之認定事宜
17-18 期末考/期末報告

description.zh: 專題討論照明與視覺心理等課題，期能對於照明相關知識能有深刻了解，並能藉課堂的研討與文獻閱讀等方法提出見解。課程內容包括永續發展之綠色照明、照明與色彩、眩光之評價、光源之新發展、燈具之美、高齡者之照明環境、防災照明、視覺與輝度分布、照明耗能評估指標與基準、晝光利用、照明之控制、道路照明與安全、戶外照明與都市環境、光污染等。
description.en: The topic is discussed with lighting and visual psychology that expect to understand some knowledge about lighting, by the method of discussion and technical literature reading to provide an opinion about lighting. The course are including green lighting for sustainable development, lighting and color, the evaluation of glare, the new tendency of lighting source, the beauty of luminair, lighting for venerable age, lighting for fire control, visual and luminance distribution, evaluation index and base of lighting energy, the advantage of daylight, lighting control, road lighting and safety, outdoor lighting and urban environment, lighting pollution.

description.zh: 臺灣建築史的發展大約可分成受到漢民族影響的傳統建築，以及日本和西方世界影響的近現代建築，本課程主要探究臺灣近現代建築發展的歷程。本課程係以時間為軸，將台灣近現代建築分為三個主題：(1) 臺灣近現代建築的背景、(2) 臺灣殖民時期、(3) 二次大戰之後的臺灣建築。
description.en: This course mainly discusses the development of modern Taiwanese architecture since the Japanese colonial period. The historical development of Taiwanese architecture could be divided into traditional Han architecture and modern architecture with Japanese and western influences. Based on the timeline, three themes will be introduced: (1) the background of Taiwanese modern architecture, (2) Taiwanese architecture during the colonial period, (3) Taiwanese architecture after the Second World War.

2.	Detail of "Participation"
Each participant needs to prepare a brief introduction to the (non-architectural) social background of one cultural period of time. This will be the tuned in of the class of the day for 20 minutes.
(Week 02) Dutch and Spanish Empires in the 17th Century (relationship with the world)
(Week 03) 17th. C. to 19th. C. China (relationship with the rest of the world)
(Week 04) Japan before 1895 (westernization)
(Week 05) Japanese colonial power in Taiwan and China 
(Week 10) social background in the first half of the 20th-century China
(Week 11) Japanese architecture after WWII 
(Week 12) global modernist architecture esp. after WWII
(Week 13) ideology of Chinese origin before and after 1945 (from 1940s to 1960s)
(Week 14) global trends of architectural regionalism
(Week 16) from postmodern architecture to Deconstructivism in the world

3.	Detail of "	Mid-term presentation": proposal for the final report 20%
In the first half of the courses, students have to outline their interests of Taiwanese architecture in certain approaches. They might be architectural styles (ex. Regionalism, modernism, etc.), structural systems, materials (ex. Brick, RC, etc.), particular types of architecture, one or two individual architects, etc. Students should present their plans of their final reports in the mid-term class about 10 minutes, in order to collect some feedback from colleagues and class instructor for further develop to achieve the final report.

4.	Detail of "	Research thesis": 30%
One should submit his/her thesis by 6/25 12:00pm to Dr. Wu. The words of the thesis should not be less than 3000 words. It should be in thesis format (word) instead of brief presentation format (power point).
The final report should present the development and influences from the past to the present (or particular period).

name.zh: 創新技術、設計思考、與社區設計
name.en: Innovative Techniques, Design Thinking, and Community Design

description.zh: 近年於規劃設計領域，因伴隨創新技術的發展，越來越多的決策與設計過程皆納入例如大數據分析、混成實境技術、生成式AI等技術，似乎降低了相關專業訓練的進入門檻，提升跨領域合作的可能性。然而若仔細觀察實務應用領域的情況，因為這些技術仍未普及，最終的操作還是容易掌握在特定專業人士手上，並且過度依賴抽象的數據和技術，與使用者產生隔閡，進一步影響設計成果。基於這個前提，本課程計畫藉由引進強調使用者為核心價值的「設計思考」方法作為橋樑，搭配創新科技的運用，於選定的社區針對特定議題進行參與規劃和空間設計操作，以此探索面向未來的社區設計方法。由於本課程之方法強調跨領域協作，並涉及創新創業及大學社會責任的內涵，故本課程除提供建築系大學部三、四年級選修外，也鼓勵校內其他科系同年級的學生選修。
description.en: Recent advances in planning and design have led to the integration of tools like big data, mixed reality, and generative AI into decision-making processes. While this trend lowers barriers for professional training and fosters interdisciplinary collaboration, these technologies remain limited in practical use, with final decisions often still in the hands of specific professionals. Moreover, over-reliance on abstract data can create a disconnect between designers and users. To address this, the course introduces "Design Thinking," a user-centered approach, alongside innovative technologies, to facilitate community design. Since this course emphasizes interdisciplinary collaboration and incorporates the concepts of innovation, entrepreneurship, and university social responsibility, it is offered as an elective for third- and fourth-year students in the Department of Architecture, while also encouraging students from other departments at the same level to enroll.

description.zh:
設計的溝通扮演著如何將設計理念成功地傳達以及讓使用者清楚的理解設計本意的重要角色。
本課程將透過設計思考過程藉由文字、口說、圖面等達到設計溝通之目的及訓練，經由了解設計領域應用之文字搭配口說及圖面進而增進設計者說明設計概念的溝通能力。
課程內容包含設計溝通的基本原則、技巧及策略，以及如何利用不同的溝通媒介及工具來傳達設計理念。
課程操作包含案例分析搭配實際的簡報演練及口說訓練讓同學們累積應用經驗。
description.en:
Design Communication plays an important role in how to successfully deliver design concepts and have users understand the design intention clearly. 
This course will practice and reach the goal of design communication through design thinking by vocabulary uses, verbal speeches, and image presentations.  From understanding the proper application of design language including vocabularies and diagrams in various design fields, designers may improve their skills of concept presentation and communication.  
The course content includes basic principles, techniques, and strategies in design communication as well as how to use different media and tools to deliver design concepts.
Course activities include case studies with presentation practice and oral speech to help students have experiences in actual application.

description.zh: 目前建築工程營建產業多賴以圖文資料溝通，文件易有失誤，會提高成本、工期延長、甚至於爭議之狀況。BIM 工具之運用，可有效提升營建產業生產力。各國政府已紛紛推出 BIM 的審照制度，我國近年來於公共工程招標已要求BIM技術之整合運用。本課程針對BIM運用於建築生命週期中各產業間的介紹及效益、實例分享，並於課程中指導同學針對BIM軟體基礎工具使用。
description.en:
Architectural engineering construction industry on which 2D graphic data communication, the file is easy to form mistakes, will increase the cost of the extension of time, even controversial situation. The use of Building Information Modeling (BIM) software tools, which can effectively enhance the productivity of the construction industry. Governments around the world have now launched the BIM audit system.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在協助學生學習撞球各項基本技巧，並學習球場禮儀及比賽規則。且在有效的學習過程中獲得成就感，同時達到鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。
教學目標：
1. 學習正確撞球基本技巧，避動作錯誤造成運動傷害。 
2. 學會欣賞撞球運動賽事，提升對於此項目之興趣。
3. 了解撞球運動的基本規則與禮儀。
4. 培養規律運動習慣，進而達到強身體魄之效果。
5. 培養團隊合作與運動家的精神。
6. 透過模擬對抗累積比賽經驗。
