description.zh:
所有人際圈都有倫理問題。家庭有家庭倫理，學校有學習倫理，在職場中則存在著職場倫理關係，有待個人學習理解、奉行。職場倫理是人與工作(生產)組織之間的關係，也可以?就是在職場中的人際關係，其牽涉幾個層面，包括正確的工作態度、正確的價值觀念以及正確的人際關係。
職場倫理牽涉到職場中個體或群體對於人際互動判定對錯是非的?為觀?，若不具備或不健全的職場倫理觀念將會導致職場人際圈秩序混亂或被破壞，引來觸犯法律規定底限之懲處不利後果。因此，企業懲戒法律案例形同職場倫理負面教材，可藉之推演人際互動規則、體會個案經驗，來思考合宜的人際往來互動的拿捏取捨。
職場倫理議題牽涉禮貌、法律與溝通技巧等多元問題面向。本課程除從理論面演繹職場倫理內涵，亦採企業懲戒個案探討方式，來協助學生習得適應融入職場生活所需之人際相處知識。
description.en: All kinds of relationship involve ethic issue. Ethic of workplace is the relationship between individuals and organizations, meaning a social relationship of workplace. It involves several aspects, including correct work attitudes, values, and personal relationships. Workplace ethic involves ideas individuals and groups hold in workplace to judge right or wrong about behavior. Without correct or sound ethic in workplace may result in chaos or destruction of order among social networks, or offend the legal baseline. Thus, enterprise punishment cases equal negative examples for workplace ethic. Workplace ethic involves topics of manners, laws and communication skills. This course provides not only theoretical perspective to reason nature of workplace ethic, but also raises cases of enterprise punishment for discussions to help students learn knowledge of interactions in workplace to adapt career life.

description.zh: 大眾傳播與人類社會的關係，正隨科技的進步而日益擴大它的影響力。根據學者研究發現，人類的思想、態度與價值觀念受大眾傳播的影響日漸加深，大傳媒介不但塑造人的思想，同時也影響人們的行為及價值；然而從傳播的功能言，大眾傳播同時具有正面與負面的社會功能，故大眾傳播的發展與過程，殊值重視與探討。本課程兼顧理論與實例的探討，包括傳播特性與要素、大眾傳播的能及效果、新聞守門人理論等，並以實例分析新聞的公正客觀性、新聞自由與國家安全、媒體與選舉等傳播爭議性問題。修習本課程可培養學生閱讀新聞的正確性，不玫人云亦云，受媒體報導所擺佈；同時亦可增強學生人際溝通的技巧與能力。

syllabi.outline:
本課程以社會科學與認知心理學為基礎，探討大眾媒體與數位科技如何影響個人認知、社會互動與文化意義的建構。課程內容涵蓋大眾媒體理論、廣告效果、框架理論與議題設定、刻板印象的形成、污名化與去污名歷程，以及社群媒體中權力關係的轉變。隨著數位科技的發展，本課程亦關注演算法、過濾氣泡與假訊息對公共論述與社會認知的影響，並探討科技使用與身心健康之間的關係。本課程也涵蓋文化文本分析，包括影視作品、動漫、次文化與電動及網路遊戲，藉此理解媒體如何形塑身份認同、價值觀與文化想像。

本課程旨在培養學生的媒體素養、批判性思考能力與社會敏感度，使其能辨識媒體訊息背後的權力運作與影響機制。教學方式採學生中心取向，結合講授、案例分析、小組討論與文本解析，引導學生將理論應用於日常媒體經驗，深化其對媒體、科技與社會之間關係的理解。

This course is grounded in the social sciences and cognitive psychology and examines how mass media and digital technologies shape individual cognition, social interaction, and cultural meaning. Course topics include theories of mass media, advertising effects, framing and agenda-setting, the construction of stereotypes, processes of stigmatization and destigmatization, and shifts in power relations within social media environments. In response to the growing influence of digital technologies, the course also explores algorithms, filter bubbles, and the spread and correction of misinformation, as well as the relationship between technology use and mental and physical well-being. In addition, the course engages with contemporary cultural texts such as film and television, animation and subcultures, and digital and online games to analyze how media representations influence identity formation, values, and cultural imagination.

The objectives of this course are to develop students’ media literacy, critical thinking skills, and social awareness, enabling them to critically evaluate media messages and understand the social and cultural implications of media technologies. A learner-centered approach is adopted, incorporating lectures, case studies, group discussions, and media text analysis to encourage active engagement and the application of theoretical concepts to everyday media experiences.

description.en: The legal specialty called Labor Law can be define as “the legal regulation of the labor market , individual labor relations and collective employer-employee relations. “labor market” pertains to market in which employers and workers exchange labor . Through this course , students can not only get correct concepts of " Labor Law " , but learn to protect their / others' rights in work place.

name.zh: 創業之品牌管理與行銷
name.en: The Brand Management and Marketing of Entrepreneurship

description.zh: 創業者在新創事業時，同時須考慮新創事業之品牌建構，如果能在創業之初建構一個定位明確的品牌，可使新創事業立即享有良好的品牌權益，提高創業成功的機會。品牌建構完成後，須設計行銷方案，對消費者進行行銷活動，向消費者推銷新創公司之品牌，以塑造良好的品牌權益。此時，消費者對新創公司之品牌會有良好形象之認知，進而提升顧客對新創公司品牌忠誠度，增加創業者創業成功之機會。
description.en:
When entrepreneurs are building a startup company, they also need to consider its brand building. If they can construct a clear positioning of the brand in the beginning, they are able to have their new business with a better brand equity immediately, and improve entrepreneurial chances of success.
After the completion of construction of the brand, entrepreneurs need to design marketing programs for consumer marketing activities, and promote its brand to create good brand equity. In the meantime, consumers will have a better brand awareness of these new companies, enhancing customer loyalty and increasing opportunities for entrepreneurs’ entrepreneurial success.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在培養創業者所須具備的經商視野與格局，並認識品牌與行銷之整體概念。包括認識經商環境與商業模式、了解如何善用品牌與行銷的觀念拓展市場，搭配實務案例之研討，期讓同學能在理解相關商業常識與品牌、行銷的觀念後，進而能發展符合消費者需求的行銷能力，順利拓展市場。

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

syllabi.outline: 新創公司財務規劃良窳往往決定一家公司能否走得長遠，公司財務管理制度不健全導致週轉不靈倒閉的案例比比皆是，其中更是不乏資質良好的公司。本課程首先介紹創新商業模式，再教授創業應注意之基本知識，最後指導同學新創企業財務管理。

description.zh:
因是在大專教藝術欣賞的課程，我在設計課程上，即考慮雖同學們不是藝術本科學生，但秉持"雖創作，但會欣賞的原則"，我的課程安排將從上古時代人類的美術創作活動進而引導解釋什麼是人類的美感經驗。讓他們明瞭東方藝術之同與不同，再介紹東西方的繪畫潮流，如西方：從文藝復興至寫實主義，印象主義，至超印象主義，東方：從漢的畫象磚開始至中國畫，書法之演進，中西繪畫之比較，內容是繁而多的。但我將用簡潔扼要的"重點教學法",寓教於樂的方式，讓同學不再懼怕"Art'，甚至可以簡單的分辨出藝術品的年代，作者，及欣賞藝術作品的要領，這是我給此門課所訂的目標。
另一個教學重點是："理論和實際併重"。在每一單元中，我將設計一項簡的[自己動手做]大概祇花 20-30 分鐘讓學生體會和真正看見，明白，藝術家製造藝術品的過程。
很希望能帶學生至博物院或美術館一趟，或至鶯砍參觀陶工廠。總之，一切課程計劃，乃配合學生之程度與興趣。
description.en: Because most students taking this course are not art major; therefore, I adhere to the principle of "Although not creation, appreciation will be instructed."  On course design, my class starts from the artistic creation of human beings in prehistoric time and further introduces the experience of beauty sensed by man and understand the similiar and difference of eastern and western art.  Moreover, I will introduce the fashion of priniting of eastern and western culture.  For example, the western culture: from the Renaissance to realism, impressionism and super impressionism.  Western culture: from a portrait stone of Han Dynasty to Chinese painting, the develpment of calligraphy and comparison of Chinese and western paintings. The teaching content is complicated, but I will simply it and highlight teaching way to let my students enjoy it.

syllabi.outline:
課程結構與規劃：以藝術欣賞的形式為課程的主要架構，.內容包括中西名家繪畫與藝術品欣賞、中國文字之美、台灣美術欣賞、台灣生態、原住民藝術，建築與雕塑之美及國際性的藝術博覽會，如義大利威尼斯雙年展(La Biennale di Venezia)，香港的Art  Basel 等。課程內容規劃結合藝術欣賞與藝術概論，並融合藝術與生活、藝術與社會、藝術與歷史、藝術與宗教、藝術與人文關懷、藝術與設計和藝術與生態環境之間的交相連結所造成的多元關係。
課程目標與期許：
培養敏銳的觀察力及繪畫欣賞的素養和對藝術的喜愛及推廣；藉由報告及校外參觀的形式，提供「在旅行中發現文化、在旅行中發現藝術」的學習機會，親身經歷及探尋週遭的在地文化，認識和欣賞是關心和行動的開始，啟發關懷社會、關懷自然環境、愛鄉、愛國之情操。藝術不惟形而上只是少數人的範疇，應該走入社會、大眾化、生活化，並有啟示成教化、助人倫之功效，期望參與的學生能具有多元視野的藝術觀。

description.zh:
所有人際圈都有倫理問題。家庭有家庭倫理，學校有學習倫理，在職場中則存在著職場倫理關係，有待個人學習理解、奉行。職場倫理是人與工作(生產)組織之間的關係，也可以?就是在職場中的人際關係，其牽涉幾個層面，包括正確的工作態度、正確的價值觀念以及正確的人際關係。
職場倫理牽涉到職場中個體或群體對於人際互動判定對錯是非的?為觀?，若不具備或不健全的職場倫理觀念將會導致職場人際圈秩序混亂或被破壞，引來觸犯法律規定底限之懲處不利後果。因此，企業懲戒法律案例形同職場倫理負面教材，可藉之推演人際互動規則、體會個案經驗，來思考合宜的人際往來互動的拿捏取捨。
職場倫理議題牽涉禮貌、法律與溝通技巧等多元問題面向。本課程除從理論面演繹職場倫理內涵，亦採企業懲戒個案探討方式，來協助學生習得適應融入職場生活所需之人際相處知識。
description.en: All kinds of relationship involve ethic issue. Ethic of workplace is the relationship between individuals and organizations, meaning a social relationship of workplace. It involves several aspects, including correct work attitudes, values, and personal relationships. Workplace ethic involves ideas individuals and groups hold in workplace to judge right or wrong about behavior. Without correct or sound ethic in workplace may result in chaos or destruction of order among social networks, or offend the legal baseline. Thus, enterprise punishment cases equal negative examples for workplace ethic. Workplace ethic involves topics of manners, laws and communication skills. This course provides not only theoretical perspective to reason nature of workplace ethic, but also raises cases of enterprise punishment for discussions to help students learn knowledge of interactions in workplace to adapt career life.

syllabi.outline:
所有人際圈都有倫理問題。家庭有家庭倫理，學校有學習倫理，在職場中則存在著職場倫理關係，有待個人學習理解、奉行。職場倫理是人與組織之間的關係，也就是在職場中的人際關係，其牽涉正確的工作態度、正確的價值觀念以及正確的人際關係。
職場倫理涉及到職場中個體或群體對於人際互動判定對錯是非，若不具備或不健全的職場倫理觀念將會導致職場人際圈秩序混亂或被破壞，引來觸犯法律規定底限之懲處不利後果。因此，企業懲戒法律案例形同職場倫理負面教材，可藉之推演人際互動規則、體會個案經驗，以思考合宜的人際往來互動的拿捏取捨。
職場倫理議題牽涉禮貌、法律與溝通技巧等多元問題面向。本課程除從理論面演繹職場倫理內涵，亦採企業懲戒個案探討方式，來協助學生習得適應融入職場生活所需之人際相處知識。

description.en: The legal specialty called Labor Law can be define as “the legal regulation of the labor market , individual labor relations and collective employer-employee relations. “labor market” pertains to market in which employers and workers exchange labor . Through this course , students can not only get correct concepts of " Labor Law " , but learn to protect their / others' rights in work place.

description.zh: 以攝影來進行社會介入的創作作品，在當代藝術的領域中已經不再陌生，而這樣的發展也促成在社會學領域中越來越多關於攝影與社會的討論。本課程主要分為兩大部分，第一部分將從攝影史發展脈絡，來談攝影的社會使用，第二部分則是探討在當代藝術中，如何將攝影作為一種社會實踐的方式。除課堂講解和集體討論外，本課程也將透過實作討論同學的攝影計畫和作品，期使讓同學對於攝影，可以產生新的社會性思考，並開始進行影像與社會介入的嘗試。
description.en: In the field of contemporary art, photography has been developing into a way of social intervention. This trend also contributes to triggering more dialogues concerning “photography and society” in the discipline of sociology. The course mainly includes two parts: photography history and the photography as a social practice. In the first section, along with the history of photography, the social usages of photography will be introduced. In the second section, how photography art can be a social practice and what kinds of practice have been explored will be . In addition to class lectures and group discussions, the course requires all students to complete their individual photo project in the end of semester and their works will be presented in class.

syllabi.outline: 以攝影來進行社會介入的作品，在當代藝術的領域中已經不再陌生，而這樣的發展也促成了越來越多關於攝影與社會的討論。圍繞著攝影與社會這個主軸，本課程以結合攝影史和社會學知識領域的方式，來講述不同攝影類型，以及如何以影像來表現其社會性的思考。除此之外，本課程也將引導同學透過個人與團體作業練習和評圖過程，進入當代攝影創作與社會參與的對話。

name.en: The Brand Management and Marketing of Entrepreneurship

description.zh: 創業者在新創事業時，同時須考慮新創事業之品牌建構，如果能在創業之初建構一個定位明確的品牌，可使新創事業立即享有良好的品牌權益，提高創業成功的機會。品牌建構完成後，須設計行銷方案，對消費者進行行銷活動，向消費者推銷新創公司之品牌，以塑造良好的品牌權益。此時，消費者對新創公司之品牌會有良好形象之認知，進而提升顧客對新創公司品牌忠誠度，增加創業者創業成功之機會。
description.en:
When entrepreneurs are building a startup company, they also need to consider its brand building. If they can construct a clear positioning of the brand in the beginning, they are able to have their new business with a better brand equity immediately, and improve entrepreneurial chances of success.
After the completion of construction of the brand, entrepreneurs need to design marketing programs for consumer marketing activities, and promote its brand to create good brand equity. In the meantime, consumers will have a better brand awareness of these new companies, enhancing customer loyalty and increasing opportunities for entrepreneurs’ entrepreneurial success.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在培養創業者所須具備的經商視野與格局，並認識品牌與行銷之整體概念。包括認識經商環境與商業模式、了解如何善用品牌與行銷的觀念拓展市場，搭配實務案例之研討，期讓同學能在理解相關商業常識與品牌、行銷的觀念後，進而能發展符合消費者需求的行銷能力，順利拓展市場。

description.zh: 本課程是為非專業學生所設計的哲學概論，介紹西洋哲學的起源、西洋哲學的問題，以及哲學與人生的關係。哲學的問題意識起自人類的自覺，人類意圖認識自己，為宇宙人生尋求解答，哲學的發生本自人類天賦的求知欲，即其本性中對於智慧的追求與愛慕。這種愛慕智慧的精神是希臘文明留給西方世界的遺產，對於知識能持客觀批判的精神，對於真理能存認真熱切的態度，對於人生能有超克苦難的修持。在國際化的世代，我們對西方的認識應更深入其精神層面，此乃本課程規劃的初衷。
description.en: This course is designed for student who is not disciplined in philosophy. As an introduction, we begin at the origin of western philosophy, the philosophical questions and finally, the relationship of human life and philosophy. Philosophy takes place when human being thinking of himself. Man by nature desire to know himself as well as the external world. And due to this love of wisdom, men can be critical to knowledge and be passionate toward truth. Eventually, grasping the sprit of western philosophy , we can view our life in quite a different view. In our time, facing the world of international, we should better understand the western culture, which is rooted in philosophy.

description.zh:
本課程首先說明人在宇宙中的定位、生命的可貴、一生的方向；接著說明如何鍛鍊自己成為生命的勇士；最後強調如何與天地萬物和諧相處和真愛的永不止息。
課程進行方式是透過體驗活動、交流分享和有次第的講授人類共同的智慧，並安排數次的校外教學，以深入瞭解社會脈動，並運用多媒體影片教學以提升學習效果，學生每天做身心觀察學習紀錄，更可以看到生命進步的軌跡。
description.en:
This course covers topics such as: the role of human beings in the universe, the dearness of life and the pursuit of life-long goals. We then discuss ways to train the students to become brave and to harmonize human beings with the nature, leading to an access to the discovery of true love.
The course is realized through activity involvement, experience sharing and lectures on human wisdom. We have some extramural visits in order to understand social pulses. Multimedia teaching materials are fully utilized to enhance the teaching and learning effects. We request that all the students take note of their mental and physical improvements on a daily basis so that they could examine the progressive path of life.

syllabi.outline:
人為萬物之靈，你相信嗎?本課程開啟思考與論辯的交流，希望一起面對人類最重要的問題，一起尋求解方。從認識自己和在乎別人開始，尋找此生的定位，認識人性的尊嚴、生命的可貴、一生的方向；接著說明如何鍛鍊自己成為生命的勇士；最後強調如何與別人對談連結，與萬事萬物和諧相處，讓真愛永不止息。

課程進行方式是透過體驗活動、交流分享和有次第的講授人類最精純的智慧，並安排人物訪談和分組活動，以深入瞭解別人的思維，運用多樣化教學以提升學習效果，學生每週做學習心得紀錄，更可以看到生命進步的軌跡。

description.zh: 婚姻是一般人所必經的過程，家庭是生活的場所，關係著人生的幸福與美滿。本課程強調美滿婚姻與幸福家庭是一門學問，因此，課程內容包括：對婚姻與家庭有正確的認知、積極的態度、完整的規劃，並培養有認真努力去實踐的方法與能力。如何追求真正的快樂與幸福？除了在婚姻與家庭中追求平等化、合理化、自由化、公平化外，自我成長、相互尊重都是本課程的學習目標，以協助學生思考婚姻與家庭的終生大事。
description.en: Marriage is a process that most people will go through.  Family is where you belong to, and where the satisfaction and happiness come from. We believe that it is a kind of scholarship to have a high-quality marriage and a wonderful family.  The contents of this course include having the correct understanding of marriage and family, cultivating positive attitude, developing complete plans, and realizing them with all efforts. This course will help students think totally about marriage and family, learn to pursue equality, reasonableness and liberty, keep growing and respect each other, so that we can obtain the real delight and happiness.

description.zh:
每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。
本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。
在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。
本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。
description.en:
Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.
In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

syllabi.outline:
生命週期涵括人生全期，而黃金階段泛指20~35歲之青年期，雖然已經是法定之成年人，但卻是成年人之最早階段，人生之重大基礎皆在此探索與樹立的。其中，情感、愛情、性事、性別傾向也是在此階段被合理地期待著發展，但往往生涯才是被過度地觀注和投入，在離開校園進入社會之前，給自己一個探索性情愛的機會吧。
本課程末後階段則說明性別平等與性犯罪等相關法規，如家庭暴力防治法、性騷擾防治法、跟蹤騷擾防治法等等，提供務實法規之理解。

Life circle is the understanding of whole human being and golden age is between 20 to 35. It's the important base of life. You need to explore your feeling, loves, sex and gender for yourselves. We hope you can reduce the only duty of career development and increase understanding of intimate relationships. otherwise, we will introduce the Taiwanese regulations of gender equality in the end of courses.

親密關係是人際關係的核心問題，它關係著交友的態度、婚姻生活的幸福與社會的祥和。本課程由對兩性差異性的了解為基礎，以尊重為原則，在平等互助的精神中，建立兩性關係的和諧。本課程內容包括理論與實際的配合，儘量以生活化的內容貫穿其間，並注重課程內容的可實踐性，以協助學生處理兩性關係的難題。
另從生命週期之青年任務、家庭親子關係、世代背景來討論青年現時狀態，所面臨之獨立自主與發展自我和生涯的課題，也需要學習認識伴侶與相處，以及進入愛情的情感歷練，理解親密與界線，經歷分手與再追尋，在青年的黃金十年之中，探索自我生涯、人際關係、現實世界與親密關係的定位。

In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves and partners. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

description.zh: 透過一系列的資料採集、參考與互動，包含經驗分享、影片欣賞等，帶領修課同學探索創新（Innovation）、創業（Startup）以及最重要的 – 創業家創新精神（Entrepreneur Innovative Thinking）之本質。無論是工作上的創造，學習上的創造，或者是(創)事業上的創造，都必然需要一定程度的創新，才能在全球化競爭以及指數型科技（Exponential Technology）發展的趨勢下存活，最終獲得勝利、創造價值。
description.en: Through series of classes to train students embracing the innovative thinking and gradually internalize it to become innovative entrepreneurship. Since the generation is changing so rapidly, the competitors are no longer came from local land but from everywhere in global village. Under this highly competitive world, every one of us need to fully embrace the true value of innovation, and incubate our own entrepreneurship with hack spirit, which will lead us to an island of innovation.

syllabi.outline:
面對快速變化的世界與社會問題，唯有「創新」能抵擋甚至超越變化。「創新思考」能幫助我們從不同視角認識問題，甚至解決問題。
本課程將從何謂創新、創新從何而來、創新的兩難、創新的擴散等重要的理論視角開始，多面向地「思考創新」。還要認識技術創新、產品創新、市場創新、通路創新、服務創新與社會創新等創新的不同面向，並藉由多元的案例分析激發學生思考。除了創新的經典理論與案例分析之外，我們還要一起學習和練習「創意思考的方法」。最後請同學靈活運用先前學過的創新理論與方法，提出一個你想改變或解決的創新企劃。
syllabi.schedule:
1.  課程導論：介紹課程與評量方式；自我介紹與修課動機。何謂創新？
2.  思考如何創新？創新從何而來？創新者的基因
3. 組織與經濟領域的創新：破壞式創新、創造性破壞
4. 創新的類型：技術創新、4P創新、服務創新、社會創新
5. 產品/設計創新：設計思考
6. 產品/市場創新：紫牛行銷、藍海策略
7. 通路創新：長尾、平台經濟、共享經濟 
8. 服務創新：體驗經濟、訂閱經濟 
9. 社會創新：美麗新世界
10. 個人創新提案：Ideas (討論)
11. 個人創新提案：Ideas (討論與分組)
12. 創意方法+提案撰寫
13. 創新的擴散：KOL的原理
14. 期中考
15. 創新思考練習：產品/通路/ 服務/社會創新Ｘ創意方法＋創新擴散 ＝提案撰寫分組討論
16. 期末報告：Plan, 創新計畫報告分享
17. 期末報告：Plan, 創新計畫報告分享
18.  期末報告：Plan, 創新計畫報告分享
syllabi.assessment:
1. 課堂參與：出席率、回答問題或主動提問。20%
2. 期中考試：選擇題，基本理論概念與定義。20%
3. 個人作業：創新提案，提出一個你想運用創新思考來解決或改變的問題，以及對此的基本分析。20%
4. 小組報告：展開一個創新計畫，企劃書中必須運用創新理論。2-5人一組。40%（注：創新計畫中若包含公益、企業社會責任、永續發展等品德內涵會適度加分。）

description.en:
Period: From the Japanese sovereighty to the 1980's; emphasizing the history of the vernacular literature. 
Topics: The movement of the language revolution; the first controversy of folk literature; the second controversy of folk literature; analysis of the literary localization movement and the study of selected works.
Requirements: One term paper and a final exam.

description.zh: 人際關係是探討對自我的了解及對人的認知，包括性格、態度、魅力、溝通、壓力、挫折和情緒等重要課題的處理；幫助同學學習與各種不同品味、信念、立場與生活方式的人作有效率的溝通，開放的表達出自己的感覺與想法，以建立良好的合作關係，從而開發潛能、爭取更好的發展機會。
description.en: Interpersonal Relationship is to discuss about self-understanding and perception of other people, including how to handle key issues related to character, attitude, attractiveness, communication, pressure, frustration and emotion.  It helps students to learn effective communication, open their minds to express personal feeling and thought, and try to communicate with other people having different tastes, convictions, standpoints and ways of living so as to establish a harmonic and cooperative relationship and furtherly to develop personal potential and strive for better opportunity of development.

syllabi.outline:
人際關係是探討對自我的了解及對人的認知，包括性格、態度、魅力、溝通、壓力、挫折和情緒等重要課題的處理；幫助同學學習與各種不同品味、信念、立場與生活方式的人作有效率的溝通，開放的表達出自己的感覺與想法，以建立良好的合作關係，從而開發潛能、爭取更好的發展機會。
(EMI)  Interpersonal relationships involve understanding oneself and others, including character, attitude, charm, communication, pressure, setbacks, and emotions. It helps students communicate effectively with people of different tastes, beliefs, perspectives, and lifestyles. It encourages open expression of feelings and thoughts to establish cooperative relationships and develop personal potential for better opportunities.

description.zh:
每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。
本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。
在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。
本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。
description.en:
Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.
In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

syllabi.outline:
生命週期涵括人生全期，而黃金階段泛指20~35歲之青年期，雖然已經是法定之成年人，但卻是成年人之最早階段，人生之重大基礎皆在此探索與樹立的。其中，情感、愛情、性事、性別傾向也是在此階段被合理地期待著發展，但往往生涯才是被過度地觀注和投入，在離開校園進入社會之前，給自己一個探索性情愛的機會吧。
本課程末後階段則說明性別平等與性犯罪等相關法規，如家庭暴力防治法、性騷擾防治法、跟蹤騷擾防治法等等，提供務實法規之理解。

Life circle is the understanding of whole human being and golden age is between 20 to 35. It's the important base of life. You need to explore your feeling, loves, sex and gender for yourselves. We hope you can reduce the only duty of career development and increase understanding of intimate relationships. otherwise, we will introduce the Taiwanese regulations of gender equality in the end of courses.

親密關係是人際關係的核心問題，它關係著交友的態度、婚姻生活的幸福與社會的祥和。本課程由對兩性差異性的了解為基礎，以尊重為原則，在平等互助的精神中，建立兩性關係的和諧。本課程內容包括理論與實際的配合，儘量以生活化的內容貫穿其間，並注重課程內容的可實踐性，以協助學生處理兩性關係的難題。
另從生命週期之青年任務、家庭親子關係、世代背景來討論青年現時狀態，所面臨之獨立自主與發展自我和生涯的課題，也需要學習認識伴侶與相處，以及進入愛情的情感歷練，理解親密與界線，經歷分手與再追尋，在青年的黃金十年之中，探索自我生涯、人際關係、現實世界與親密關係的定位。

In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves and partners. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

description.zh: 本課程透過各國電影來介紹從聯合國的十七項永續發展指標 (SDGs)，結合社會學、經濟發展、環境治理與文化發展等課題，透過前導介紹、影片放映與映後討論與講座，啟發學生從不同層面對永續議題的關注與認識。
description.en: This course introduces the UN 17 sustainable development goals (SDGs) through a series of films. Combining sociology, economic development, environmental governance and cultural development, it is expected to inspire students to understand and further study the various lessons about sustainable development by integrating pre-introduction, film screening, and post-screening discussions and lectures.

syllabi.outline: 本課程以聯合國永續發展目標（Sustainable Development Goals, SDGs）為整體框架，透過紀錄片觀影、議題討論與場域參訪，引導學生從臺灣在地社會經驗出發，理解永續發展的多重面向。課程由 SDGs 基本概念介紹開始，逐步延伸至居住權、社會平等、能源與勞動、環境治理、水資源以及城鄉永續等核心議題，培養學生以跨域視角思考永續發展，並拓展其公共觀察與理解能力。

4.《城中一座島》專題講座：社子島聚落生活與城鄉永續的對話
5. 《飛羽之間：在城市與山海之間看見鳥》攝影展參觀
6. 社會平等的觀看：從《角力的孩子》理解階級與不平等
7. 從《迷霧中的孩子》思考性別與文化差異
8. 族群、性別與移動經驗：從《菲蒂雅的小房間》探索全球永續
9. 期中考周

description.zh: 個人或國家都無法自外於當今的國際社會；政治、經濟、社會、文化各層面皆受到國際間互動的影響下，為增進知識青年具備國際化的視野與認知，以因應時代發展趨勢，在強化技術研究的基礎上，拓展國家、社會與個人的發展空間。本課程內容包括基本理論與國際關係的動態，涵蓋國際社會的結構與演變、國際行為的類型及支配此行為的各種力量、國際事務的現象、本質及因果關係。
description.en: An individual or a country may not keep alien to today's internatonal community. Owing to internationally interactive influence with respect to politic, economy, society and culture, the purpose of the course is to equip intellectual youths with internaitonalized sight and awareness to keep pace with the develolpment trend of times, and to expand the space for national, social and individual development on basic of reinforced technical research. The contents of the course include basic theory and the situation  of international relations, covering the structure and changes in the international community, the type of international behavior, and various forces dominating such behavior, the phenomenon, essence, cause and consequence of international affairs.

syllabi.outline:
全球化時代，無論是個人或是國家都無法自外於國際結構而不受其影響；因此，我們必須對國際現況有基本了解，對於國際結構發展趨勢應該有所掌握。課程規劃前五週著重建構國際大圖像與鋪墊國際關係理論基礎；六至十三週以議題型式為主，輔以當週或當月國際重要事件，帶入國際關係觀察角度；十四至十七週重點放在亞州區域情勢，從中美競爭的各面向、印太戰略到台灣議題皆包含在內。課程深入淺出，隨著各種議題擴展國際視野的同時客觀地建立國際關係系統性認知，培養同學獨立且多元思考，以及正確解讀資訊的能力。
An individual or a country may not keep alien to today's internatonal community. Owing to internationally interactive influence with respect to politic, economy, society and culture, the purpose of the course is to equip intellectual youths with internaitonalized sight and awareness to keep pace with the develolpment trend of times, and to expand the space for national, social and individual development on basic of reinforced technical research. The contents of the course include basic theory and the situation  of international relations, covering the structure and changes in the international community, the type of international behavior, and various forces dominating such behavior, the phenomenon, essence, cause and consequence of international affairs.

description.zh: 藥膳在中醫理論指導下，將中草藥與實務相配合，運用傳統烹調技術和現代加工方法製成味、色、形俱佳的、更有保健和治療作用作之食品，其內容廣泛，迄今已有三千年之歷史。所謂藥食同源更是集中而深刻的體現了藥膳之重要性。本課程共分：湯膳概論、穀物湯膳、蔬菜湯膳、果品湯膳、畜肉湯膳、海鮮湯膳、藥草湯膳和美容養生湯膳等。

syllabi.outline:
膳食是生活上一件非常重要的事， 所謂「 You are what you eat.」，「今日的飲食造就明日的細胞組成」，都明白闡述出飲食習慣對個人健康具有直接的影響力。現代人生活上還面臨著各項挑戰，例如我們經常要面對各式各樣的壓力，以及生活環境遭受污染充斥著各種毒素等問題，因此我們必須先瞭解如何避食品毒物，再藉由選擇正確的食物與良好的飲食習慣來維持身體的健康。
本課程前半部先探討近期台灣近期發生的食品安全事件，藉由事件來瞭解如何避開毒物；後半部介紹食物內各種營養素的功能，再進一步探討如何選擇有益的食物來調整身體機能，並促進健康。

description.zh: 工業化導致人口從鄉村往都市遷徙，其後果不只是在人類生活環境的改變或者是流行病學問題。都市化過程也造成自然環境改變，生物棲地減少的問題。該課程希望透過了解都市中生態棲地的改變，如何影響鳥類以及其他生物的生存，使學生意識到人類的都市化，對其他物種的衝擊。並從中思考，在便利的都會社會生活之外，該如何在都市生活中建設生態友善的校園。
description.en: Industrialization brings about domestic migration from rural areas to cities. The consequences include not only environmental changes for human life or related epidemiological issues. The process of urbanization also causes changes of natural environment, reducing habitat for wildlife. This course aims to provide students a scope to aware how habitat changes in urban areas impact birds and other wildlife and to design environment-friendly campus in additional to convenient urban social life.

syllabi.outline:
工業化導致人口從鄉村往都市遷徙，其後果不只是在人類生活環境的改變或者是流行病學問題。都市化過程也造成自然環境改變，生物棲地減少的問題。該課程希望透過了解都市中生態棲地的改變，如何影響鳥類以及其他生物的生存，使學生意識到人類的都市化，對其他物種的衝擊。並從中思考，在便利的都會社會生活以及休閒活動之外，該如何在都市生活中建設生態友善的校園。
Industrialization brings about domestic migration from rural areas to cities. The consequences include not only environmental changes for human life or related epidemiological issues. The process of urbanization also causes changes of natural environment, reducing habitat for wildlife. This course aims to provide students a scope to aware how habitat changes in urban areas impact birds and other wildlife and to design environment-friendly campus in additional to convenient urban social life and leisure activities.

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在解析創業者在財務領域須具備的觀念與常識，教學內容係依據教師過去在金融業所看過的業界案例、及曾擔任投資公司財務長、與跨國集團投資與信用管理主管之職場經驗所設計。
透過了解企業財務領域之運作，期培養學生在創業時能運用相關的財務基礎觀念與常識，相關財務知識也可做為個人投資理財參酌。

1. 認識金融機構與投資理財工具
2. 認識利率及其應用、投資計畫報酬估算
3. 認識匯率與外匯市場
4. 認識財務報表與運用
5. 企業的基本面分析與經營策略
6. 創業籌資(兼述股票上市之路)
7. 創業營業計劃與財務評估要點釋例
8. 財務預測與投資計劃評估實例展示

The goal of this course is to help students understand the application of smart manufacturing in the factory and to learn to build a so-called digitalized enterprise.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在深入探討現代車廠的經營與管理，從戰略規劃到生產流程、財務管控、行銷策略、全球化布局等多維度進行全面分析。課程涉及實際案例與行業分析，幫助學生建立全面的車廠管理能力。
This course aims to provide an in-depth exploration of the operation and management of modern automakers, offering a comprehensive analysis from multiple dimensions, including strategic planning, production processes, financial control, marketing strategies, and globalization. The course incorporates real-world case studies and industry analysis to help students develop comprehensive automaker management skills.
syllabi.schedule:
第1週:車廠經營與管理課程說明
第2週:車廠經營概述與產業趨勢分析
第3週:企業戰略規劃：如何制定車廠的長期發展戰略
第4週:車廠的產品開發與創新管理
第5週:車廠的生產管理與精益生產
第6週:供應鏈管理：車廠如何選擇與管理供應商
第7週:人力資源管理：車廠的人員招募與培訓
第8週:車廠的財務管理與成本控制
第9週:期中測驗
第10週:車廠的市場行銷策略：品牌定位與消費者行為
第11週:車廠的全球化與本地化市場策略
第12週:車廠的數位轉型與智能製造
第13週:環境與可持續發展：車廠的綠色管理
第14週:法律與政策：車廠的合規性管理
第15週:車廠的客戶服務與售後管理
第16週:車廠的危機管理與風險控制
第17週:未來車廠的運營模式：自動駕駛與共享出行
第18週:期末測驗

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得車輛產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。學生需每週40小時於企業實習，並於期末繳交實習報告。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 本課程的特色是希望藉由管弦樂音樂的播放，與實體樂器的展示、示範演出，互相結合，使同學在欣賞高水準的音樂之餘，更能實際接觸到平常接觸不到的實體樂器，實際的觀察樂器的構造，近距離的欣賞到樂器，能聽到實際上發出的聲音，從而對材料機械，科技與樂器聲響之間的關係，有一個真實而全新的認識，進而引發對音樂的認識以及興趣。
description.en: The feature of the course is that, through playing music, physical instrument display an demonstration of performances, the students come into contact with the usual musical instruments. Observing the instrument configuration and listening the sound in close distance lead to a true and a new understanding of the relationship between material mechanics and musical sound, and thus trigger and interest in music.

description.zh: 人際關係是探討對自我的了解及對人的認知，包括性格、態度、魅力、溝通、壓力、挫折和情緒等重要課題的處理；幫助同學學習與各種不同品味、信念、立場與生活方式的人作有效率的溝通，開放的表達出自己的感覺與想法，以建立良好的合作關係，從而開發潛能、爭取更好的發展機會。
description.en: Interpersonal Relationship is to discuss about self-understanding and perception of other people, including how to handle key issues related to character, attitude, attractiveness, communication, pressure, frustration and emotion.  It helps students to learn effective communication, open their minds to express personal feeling and thought, and try to communicate with other people having different tastes, convictions, standpoints and ways of living so as to establish a harmonic and cooperative relationship and furtherly to develop personal potential and strive for better opportunity of development.

description.zh:
面對科技發展日新月異，社會急驟變遷的新世紀，只習得專業上的一技之長，已不足以和協圓滿地實踐有意義的人生。有鑑於此，乃以生涯發展與生涯諮商的理論與研究為基礎，配合學生的發展，希翼能透過教育的歷程，使學生的專業知識能和未來的工作與生活規劃，產生有意義的聯結，進而為學生提供一個短程與長程的生涯發展與選擇的準備與指引。
授課內容包括生涯理念介紹、興趣、性格、價值觀探索，生
涯決定因素，生涯技巧，生涯角色調適，生涯選擇與規劃技
巧，生涯訪談，生涯高原調適，轉型期調適，性別、職業歧
視，雙生涯家庭，就業準備等主要生涯課題的研討與習作。
description.en: In face of a new century with continuous scientific development and rapid social changes, to learn one single professional skill is not enough to fulfill a meaningful life in a harmonic and satisfactory manner. In view of this, based on the theory and research of career development and consultation in association with the development of students,  it is hoped to produce a meaningful linking between their professional knowledge and job and life planning through the course of eucation, and further to provide them a preparation and guide for short and long-range career development and choice. The contents of the course include the discussion and exercise related to major career topics such as introduction to the concept of career, the discussion of interest, character and value, decisive factors of career, skills of career, role adjustment in career, career choice and planning skill, career interview, uphill adjustment in career, adjustment in transit period, sex and occupation.

description.zh: 科技發展為促進人類社會進步的主要動力。現今，科技發展中的性別議題與性別政治也漸漸受到國際社會的重視。本課程首先讓學生意識到在科學教育中性別失衡的現象與其成因。之後從社會學、人類學與性別學切入當前性別科技發展中的各項議題。最後將會以全球視角與永續發展指標(SDGs)來檢視科技發展中的性別政治，給予學生更宏觀和深入的分析，培養未來具人文關懷的科技專業人才。
description.en: Science and technology development is the main driving force to promote the progress of human society. Nowadays, gender issues and gender politics in the development of science and technology have been paid more and more attention by the international community. In this class, firstly, students will be aware of the phenomenon of gender imbalance in science education and its causes. Secondly, I am going to talk about current development of gendered technology from perspectives of sociology, anthropology and gender. Finally, I will lead students to examine gender politics in science and technology from a global perspective and sustainable development indicators (SDGs). This class aims to give students a more macro- and in-depth analysis and cultivating future talented humanities and technology professionals.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將以幾波全球化為背景，首先指出性別與科技如何相互建構，接者分析機器與男性氣質的關聯性。以此為基礎，帶領同學認識性別與交織分析如何解決科技研究的盲點，最後反思工程文化的性別議題。The course will be contextualized within several waves of globalization. It will start by examining how gender and technology mutually construct each other, followed by an analysis of the correlation between machinery and masculine traits. Building upon this foundation, it will guide students to understand how gender and intersectional analysis address blind spots in technological research. Finally, it will encourage reflection on gender issues within engineering culture.

description.zh: 現代科技文明進展得非常迅速，這使得一般人日常生活中，可能經常享受到這些科技所帶來的便利，但卻習以為常，以為天生下來就是這樣的，這些現代的科技，可能是關於電機的、物理的、化工的、光電的、材料的......，更有可能同時涉及了其他許多個領域，更可能有許多人希望能夠了解這些科技的來龍去脈，一窺其究竟，人類在沒有土木工程學之前，早已能建築萬里長城和金字塔，許許多多的科技是由嘗試錯誤，經驗的累積逐漸得來的，當然，隨著知識的不斷窮究其理，"知而後行"的高科技也就會越來越多，我們在這裡也試圖去追蹤各項科技的演進史與現況方面讓大家知道羅馬不是一天所造成的，另一方面也讓大家有從另一個角度重新思考的機會，也許這些科技進化到現在，還稱不上成熟的階段，您也許可以找出另一種更好的方法來改進它們！
description.en: Modern technology is growing fast. People thus enjoy the convenience in company with the technology—which they do and they just take it for granted to do. It may have something to do with electrical engineering, physics, chemical engineering, electro-optical engineering, materials…Some problems involves more than one field. People are curious about the technology and willing to know how to solve the problems. Human beings are able to build the pyramids and the Long Walls before they know anything about civil engineering—knowledge actually piled up by trial and error or accumulated experience. As knowledge expands, hi-end technology which requires “know-how” becomes more popular. In this course, we try to trace the history and the current situations: “Rome was not built in a day.” On the other hand, we might take another chance to RE-think a deeper problem: technology evolves without getting to maturity. Human beings will be enforced to find some other ways to improve it.

syllabi.outline: 現代科技文明進展得非常迅速，這使得一般人日常生活中，可能經常享受到這些科技所帶來的便利，但卻習以為常，本課程介紹各項科技技術的入門技術與發展歷史，引導同學以批判性思考角度省思科技產業發展，培養對科技發展相關議題（倫理、環保、商業等等）獨立思考的能力；另外本課程也準備數週的專題討論，特別討論能源相關議題，因為無論何種科技，均與能源使用有關，本課程一方面介紹節能科技，另一方面也討論綠能（包含太陽能、風能、生質能與其他新能源）的開發及使用。

description.zh: 現代人的健康問題50％以上導因於生活型態與行為模式，傳統以疾病治療為主的醫療模式已無法因應目前民眾的健康需求，健康促進、危急救護等觀念正被廣泛應用，本課程內容包含三大部分，包括「健康及其影響因素」、「健康促進相關議題」、「安全教育與急救」，藉由系統性健康教育與資訊傳播，使學生能習得正確健康知能及技能，幫助學生建立健康行為模式，使其健康能獲得更好的自我控制。
description.en: More than 50% of modern men’s health problems attributes from living style and behavior. The tradition way for curing illness has failed to fulfill people’s requirements. Conceptions such as health promoting and emergencies dealing are now being wildly used. This course mainly focuses on three issues, including “health and its affected cause,” “related issues on health promotion”, and “safety education and emergency treatment.” Through systematical health education and information spreading, students acquire the correct health knowledge and skills, to help students lead a healthy life and to get a better self-control on own health.

description.zh: 透過一系列的資料採集、參考與互動，包含經驗分享、影片欣賞等，帶領修課同學探索創新（Innovation）、創業（Startup）以及最重要的 – 創業家創新精神（Entrepreneur Innovative Thinking）之本質。無論是工作上的創造，學習上的創造，或者是(創)事業上的創造，都必然需要一定程度的創新，才能在全球化競爭以及指數型科技（Exponential Technology）發展的趨勢下存活，最終獲得勝利、創造價值。
description.en: Through series of classes to train students embracing the innovative thinking and gradually internalize it to become innovative entrepreneurship. Since the generation is changing so rapidly, the competitors are no longer came from local land but from everywhere in global village. Under this highly competitive world, every one of us need to fully embrace the true value of innovation, and incubate our own entrepreneurship with hack spirit, which will lead us to an island of innovation.

syllabi.outline:
面對快速變化的世界與社會問題，唯有「創新」能抵擋甚至超越變化。「創新思考」能幫助我們從不同視角認識問題，甚至解決問題。
本課程將從何謂創新、創新從何而來、創新的兩難、創新的擴散等重要的理論視角開始，多面向地「思考創新」。還要認識技術創新、產品創新、市場創新、通路創新、服務創新與社會創新等創新的不同面向，並藉由多元的案例分析激發學生思考。除了創新的經典理論與案例分析之外，我們還要一起學習和練習「創意思考的方法」。最後請同學靈活運用先前學過的創新理論與方法，提出一個你想改變或解決的創新企劃。

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

syllabi.outline:
This is a history course of western classical music, of which the definition, according to The New Harvard Dictionary of Music and The Oxford Dictionary, is "art music” or "serious music", that written in a Western musical tradition, using an established form. "Classical music is generally considered to be serious and to have a lasting value.”
The styles of various periods will be introduced, from the Medieval, Renaissance, Classical, Romantic, to the Contemporary eras. The goal of this course is helping students to equip a general comprehension of Classical Music in terms of basic elements of musical art, technical theory, historical, social and cultural background extends to related arts and humanities. 
In addition, basic elements of music notation reading and theory will also be made known to the students.
Other genres such as Alternative Rock and related fields will be interlaced with the Classical Music. 

In order to pursue the most accurate references and info, the major key-points and terminology used in this course will be in English or original European text.
(There are requirements to fulfill this course such as Midterm & Final Exams, as well as in-class presentation or performance. If you're not interested in serious music genre, please DO NOT take this course.)
此門課程為西洋藝術音樂史，即古典音樂歷史。根據「新哈佛音樂辭典」 ( New Harvard Dictionary of Music) 與 「牛津字典」 的詮釋，所謂古典音樂為「嚴肅藝術」音樂，以嚴謹成型的作曲公式創作音樂，經過歷史洗練的時間藝術。透過此課程學生對西洋古典音樂會有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及社會人文背景，從音樂美感構成與相關人文藝術和文化歷史的議題作連結。
syllabi.schedule:
1. 古希臘藝術與人文, 信仰: 古歐洲在基督教傳入前的文化, 音樂, 文學, 戲劇, 跟人文背景	
1st week: Introduction to Western Art Music—Greek origin as the foremost culture before Christianity entered Europe

2. 從基督教傳入, 到中世紀: 古歐洲承襲希臘時代以來的傳承, 展現於壁畫, 以及基督教傳入歐洲後對文化及藝術的影響; 音樂記譜方式, 表演方式,天主教會對社會的影響; 拜占庭建築到哥德式大教堂, 中世紀歐洲社會與歷史
2nd week: The Medieval Period--folk music, church music in relation to arts and culture

3. 中世紀到文藝復興音樂的演變(舞蹈與民謠): 庶民文化與音樂
3rd week: From Medieval to Renaissance period--Madrigals, church music, dance music.

4. 文藝復興時期: 宗教音樂由單一旋律演化為複音音樂, 作曲家 雕塑家. 畫家介紹. 以義大利為首的時代. 此時期受歡迎的樂器介紹; 源於德, 法, 蘇格蘭宗教改革與英國王室的關聯
4th week: Renaissance period--from Monophony to Polyphony; Introduction to Italian composers, artists, and some of the most popular musical instruments; the Reformed Church and Martin Luther that not only changed the society and belief system but also aethesticism in arts. 

5. 巴洛克時期: 法國巴洛克--英國巴洛克與法國巴洛克比較, 王室音樂跟庶民音樂介紹; 法王路易十四世與凡爾賽宮
5th week: Baroque--Louis XIV and his influence on French music,in comparison to English Baroque

6. 巴洛克時期:	義大利式協奏曲介紹; 巴洛克時代小型管弦曲; 宗教信仰不同形成南歐與北歐教堂建築文化迴異
6th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends--Corelli, Lully and Couperin, Introduction to Concerto Grosso

7. 巴洛克時期:	基本舞曲, 組曲形式--宮廷舞步與巴洛克芭蕾
7th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends continues--Vivaldi, Scarlatti, and Rameau--Court Dance and French Ballet

8. 巴洛克時期: 德意志巴洛克--韓德爾, 泰雷曼, 巴赫
8th week: Baroque--Comparison among Handel, Telemann, and J.S.Bach

9. 巴洛克時期: 深度探討巴赫生平與作品
9th week: Baroque--J.S. Bach in-depth--his string works, orchestral music, choral music, keyboard music, and Fugues.

10. 	期中報告	
10th week: Midterm Report

11. 古典時期: 啟蒙時代崛起, 腓特烈二世 (普魯士) 對德意志音樂藝術的影響. 波次坦忘憂宮介紹; 盧梭之民約論, 丹麥王室實現其理念; 俄羅斯凱撒琳大帝對藝術的貢獻—聖彼得堡冬宮博物館介紹
11th week: Classical period (Classicism)--The Age of Enlightenment--Frederick the Great as a passionate patron of music and art; Danish royal house contributing Jean-Jacques Rousseau's ideology in Denmark; Catherine the Great and The Hermitage

12. 古典時期: 德奧樂派 (第一代維也納樂派); 葛路克與哈布斯堡家族及其小公主,後來為法國波旁王朝最後的皇后瑪麗．安東尼; 海頓, 莫札特, 貝多芬(前期)
12th week: The First Viennese School; Gluck and Habsburg family; Marie Antoinette

13. 浪漫派時期: 從貝多芬中期開啟德奧浪漫派
13th week: Romantic period--Beethoven and the beginning of Romantic era; how Schubert was influenced by Beethoven 

14. 浪漫派時期: 法國, 北歐, 波西米亞--區域性的不同風格
14th week: The pinnacle of Romantic era--Chopin, Schumann, Brahms, Liszt, Tchaikovsky, to the late Romantic period

15. 浪漫派時期: 國民樂派, 俄羅斯音樂與十九世紀俄國芭蕾
15th week: A counterpart of Romantic style with Naionalism--Music by Bohemian and Russian composers; 19th Century Russian ballet and music

16. 二十世紀現代樂派: 法國印象樂派, 第二代維也納樂派; 法國印象畫派與樂派的相輔相成; 包浩斯學院, Art Deco (裝飾風藝術) Art Nouveau (新藝術運動) 介紹
16th week: Impressionist Music, The Second Viennese School and related art styles in the period
17. 後現代主義: 音樂學界的實驗性音樂;	Phillip Glass獨創的極簡樂風; 電腦與傳統樂器結合
17th week: The Contemporary Music--from Twelve- tone music (The 2nd Viennese School) to Existentialism, music of Minimalism, and experimental music; comparison with other genres 

18:	期末考
18th week: Final Exam.

description.zh: 本課程以當代華文及國際重要科幻作家的代表作品為核心，帶領學生在閱讀與討論中探索人類面臨的科技、文化與社會挑戰。學生將透過選讀小說，探討各種議題並訓練批判思考與多角度解讀的能力。課程亦融入影像、專題討論與小組合作，鼓勵學生跨領域思考，並發表閱讀心得與創意成果。藉由閱讀科幻小說，學生不僅能理解文學如何反映時代焦慮與願景，也能思考自我與世界的未來可能。
description.en: This course centers on representative works by contemporary Chinese and internationally renowned science fiction writers. Through reading and discussion, students will explore the technological, cultural, and social challenges faced by humankind. By engaging with selected novels, students will examine diverse issues and develop skills in critical thinking and multidimensional interpretation. The course also integrates visual media, thematic discussions, and group projects to encourage interdisciplinary thinking and creative expression. Through the study of science fiction, students will not only understand how literature reflects the anxieties and aspirations of its time but also contemplate the possible futures of both the self and the world.

description.zh: 此門課程主要在於瞭解社會學的意涵，並藉由跨領域的學習，讓不同學科能有對話的空間。課程涵蓋的範圍會兼顧理論與實用性，讓學生能思考當今的社會，理解到產生因素的多元性，並進而使個人眼界能更加開拓。期望學生於課程學習中能夠擁有更多對於整個社會的不同思維，以強化本身學科之所需，不但具有理論性深入的洞察力，也能引用到管理上實質的層面。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to understand sociology. It covers theory and practicability, and make students consider the current society, and understand the generated factors of diversity . Expect students' study can have more for the community as a whole different way of thinking, in order to strengthen their academic needs, not only has the theoretical depth of insight, but also on the substance applied to the management level.

syllabi.outline:
本堂課透過社會學理論的知識與實踐，向同學們引介理解社會的觀點與方法。
極大多數人的生活，都處在「社會」當中。我們必須不斷地與人、與環境互動，才能維繫生命與生活。人們的各種關係在社會中相互構成，影響了社會資源的生產方式、分配與消費。
因此，掌握人們分析社會的方式，才有可能知道社會關係與結構是怎麼運作起來的。藉由本課程所涉及的多樣議題，讓同學們接觸生活圈內及舒適圈外的不同樣貌，並據此反身質問：我們如何參與及想像社會？社會又如何影響著我們的言行與思考？

description.zh: 本課程透過各國電影來介紹從聯合國的十七項永續發展指標 (SDGs)，結合社會學、經濟發展、環境治理與文化發展等課題，透過前導介紹、影片放映與映後討論與講座，啟發學生從不同層面對永續議題的關注與認識。
description.en: This course introduces the UN 17 sustainable development goals (SDGs) through a series of films. Combining sociology, economic development, environmental governance and cultural development, it is expected to inspire students to understand and further study the various lessons about sustainable development by integrating pre-introduction, film screening, and post-screening discussions and lectures.

syllabi.outline: 本課程以聯合國永續發展目標（Sustainable Development Goals, SDGs）為整體框架，透過紀錄片觀影、議題討論與場域參訪，引導學生從臺灣在地社會經驗出發，理解永續發展的多重面向。課程由 SDGs 基本概念介紹開始，逐步延伸至居住權、社會平等、能源與勞動、環境治理、水資源以及城鄉永續等核心議題，培養學生以跨域視角思考永續發展，並拓展其公共觀察與理解能力。

syllabi.outline:
食物是人類持續生命的重要元素，在人的一生中扮演重要的角色。人們的生活中也因為有飲食相關文化與習慣相伴，而顯得精采與豐富。因此，飲食與生活有著密不可分的關係。
本課程由營養與健康的觀點切入飲食，培養學生具備有關飲食營養與健康的知識，以度過健康的一生。

description.zh: 現代人的健康問題50％以上導因於生活型態與行為模式，傳統以疾病治療為主的醫療模式已無法因應目前民眾的健康需求，健康促進、危急救護等觀念正被廣泛應用，本課程內容包含三大部分，包括「健康及其影響因素」、「健康促進相關議題」、「安全教育與急救」，藉由系統性健康教育與資訊傳播，使學生能習得正確健康知能及技能，幫助學生建立健康行為模式，使其健康能獲得更好的自我控制。
description.en: More than 50% of modern men’s health problems attributes from living style and behavior. The tradition way for curing illness has failed to fulfill people’s requirements. Conceptions such as health promoting and emergencies dealing are now being wildly used. This course mainly focuses on three issues, including “health and its affected cause,” “related issues on health promotion”, and “safety education and emergency treatment.” Through systematical health education and information spreading, students acquire the correct health knowledge and skills, to help students lead a healthy life and to get a better self-control on own health.

syllabi.outline:
現代人的健康問題50％以上導因於生活型態與行為模式，傳統以疾病治療為主的醫療模式已無法因應目前民眾的健康需求，健康促進、危急救護等觀念正被廣泛應用，本課程內容包含三大部分，包括「健康及其影響因素」、「健康促進相關議題」、「安全教育與急救」，藉由系統性健康教育與資訊傳播，使學生能習得正確健康知能及技能，幫助學生建立健康行為模式，使其健康能獲得更好的自我控制。
More than 50% of modern men’s health problems attributes from living style and behavior. The tradition way for curing illness has failed to fulfill people’s requirements. Conceptions such as health promoting and emergencies dealing are now being wildly used. This course mainly focuses on three issues, including “health and its affected cause,” “related issues on health promotion”, and “safety education and emergency treatment.” Through systematical health education and information spreading, students acquire the correct health knowledge and skills, to help students lead a healthy life and to get a better self-control on own health.

SDG2：消除飢餓；第3週授課主題「飲食與健康」對應SDG2中的發展國民飲食營養相關指引及素材。
SDG3：健康福祉；第2-7週授課主題「健康促進」「癌症防治」「傳染病的認識與預防」「物質濫用防制」對應SDG3的推動第四期國家癌症防治計畫；積極推動多元愛滋篩檢與諮詢服務、感染者診斷即刻服藥、以及暴露愛滋病毒前預防性投藥（PrEP）等防治政策，15-49歲愛滋感染新增人數持續下降；持續透過多元管道推動慢性呼吸道疾病防治工作，以降低慢性呼吸道疾病過早死亡機率；提高藥、酒癮治療服務涵蓋率。
SDG 5：性別平等；第6週授課內容愛滋病、HPV、猴痘、病毒性肝炎，從傳染病談性教育與性傳染病防治。

description.zh: 透過一系列的資料採集、參考與互動，包含經驗分享、影片欣賞等，帶領修課同學探索創新（Innovation）、創業（Startup）以及最重要的 – 創業家創新精神（Entrepreneur Innovative Thinking）之本質。無論是工作上的創造，學習上的創造，或者是(創)事業上的創造，都必然需要一定程度的創新，才能在全球化競爭以及指數型科技（Exponential Technology）發展的趨勢下存活，最終獲得勝利、創造價值。
description.en: Through series of classes to train students embracing the innovative thinking and gradually internalize it to become innovative entrepreneurship. Since the generation is changing so rapidly, the competitors are no longer came from local land but from everywhere in global village. Under this highly competitive world, every one of us need to fully embrace the true value of innovation, and incubate our own entrepreneurship with hack spirit, which will lead us to an island of innovation.

syllabi.outline:
面對快速變化的世界與社會問題，唯有「創新」能抵擋甚至超越變化。「創新思考」能幫助我們從不同視角認識問題，甚至解決問題。
本課程將從何謂創新、創新從何而來、創新的兩難、創新的擴散等重要的理論視角開始，多面向地「思考創新」。還要認識技術創新、產品創新、市場創新、通路創新、服務創新與社會創新等創新的不同面向，並藉由多元的案例分析激發學生思考。除了創新的經典理論與案例分析之外，我們還要一起學習和練習「創意思考的方法」。最後請同學靈活運用先前學過的創新理論與方法，提出一個你想改變或解決的創新企劃。
syllabi.schedule:
1.  課程導論：介紹課程與評量方式；自我介紹與修課動機。何謂創新？
2.  思考如何創新？創新從何而來？創新者的基因
3. 組織與經濟領域的創新：破壞式創新、創造性破壞
4. 創新的類型：技術創新、4P創新、服務創新、社會創新
5. 產品/設計創新：設計思考
6. 產品/市場創新：紫牛行銷、藍海策略
7. 通路創新：長尾、平台經濟、共享經濟 
8. 服務創新：體驗經濟、訂閱經濟 
9. 社會創新：美麗新世界
10. 個人創新提案：Ideas (討論)
11. 個人創新提案：Ideas (討論與分組)
12. 創意方法+提案撰寫
13. 創新的擴散：KOL的原理
14. 期中考
15. 創新思考練習：產品/通路/ 服務/社會創新Ｘ創意方法＋創新擴散 ＝提案撰寫分組討論
16. 期末報告：Plan, 創新計畫報告分享
17. 期末報告：Plan, 創新計畫報告分享
18.  期末報告：Plan, 創新計畫報告分享

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

syllabi.schedule:
第一週：課程導論、欣賞音樂的角度與方法 
第二週：中世紀音樂 - 音樂織體、教會調式、大小調性、葛利果聖歌、複音聖歌
第三週：文藝復興時期音樂 - 複音音樂、模仿對位、對位法概論；Lute Song 介紹（Green Sleeves 欣賞)；巴洛克早期 - Monterverdi（歌劇的誕生 Orfeo）
第四週：巴洛克早期音樂 - Lully 作品（La Roi Danse 電影介紹）
第五週：巴洛克時期音樂 - Henry Purcell (Dido und Aneas 歌劇介紹）、Bach
第六週：巴洛克時期音樂 - Handel （Farinelli 電影介紹）
第七週：古典時期音樂 - 功能和聲概論、Haydn, 單主題奏鳴曲
第八週：Mozart、非原調再現的奏鳴曲式 (Amadeus 電影介紹）
第九週：期中報告
第十週：Beethoven、動機發展、奏鳴曲式之材料運用、
第十一週：浪漫樂派 - Schubert、Chopin（Chopin - Desire for Love 電影介紹)
第十二週：浪漫樂派 - Schumann、Brahms（Beloved Clara 電影介紹）
第十三週：浪漫樂派 - Liszt（Song without End 電影介紹）, Wagner、Puccini （La Boheme 歌劇介紹） 
第十四週：印象樂派 - Debussy, Ravel
第十五週：現代音樂 - Schoenberg, Webern, Berg、電子音樂、頻譜主義 
第十六週：美國當代音樂劇 - 百老匯名曲賞析、變身怪醫、版本比較
第十七週：跨界音樂作曲家、歌手、歌曲介紹 - 李泰祥、齊豫（古典、民歌）、Sara Brightmen、迪瑪希、鄭雲龍、阿云嘎 （音樂劇、古典、流行歌）Úyanga Bold、薩頂頂 （民族音樂、流行歌）。期末報告。
第十八週：期末報告

若修課人數較多時，期中報告會在 9-11 週。期末報告會在 16~18 週。原課程內容將配合同學們報告所佔用時間，做部分刪減與調整。

指標對應授課內容: 音樂自古以來就被公認為具有安撫心靈的作用。本課程全部內容引導學生學習欣賞音樂，故有助於學生透過音樂來抒發情感、或安定心神，能提升「健康福祉」。此外，本課程引到學生聆聽並分析古典音樂，能訓練學生同時以理性與感性進行音樂賞析，可提升學生的人文素養，並陶冶身心，進而提高「教育品質」。

description.zh: 鋼琴擁有寬廣的音域，無論獨奏或合奏，鋼琴都能恰如其分地奏出悠揚音樂。這門課程將介紹鋼琴的起源與構造、各個時代的經典鋼琴作品與著名的鋼琴家，並且讓同學體驗彈奏鋼琴短曲的樂趣。期許能透過欣賞與實作，讓同學更深刻地理解鋼琴音樂之美，培養終身的興趣。
description.en: The piano possesses a broad tonal range, and whether in a solo or ensemble context, it adeptly delivers enchanting music. This course will provide an introduction to the piano's origins and construction, classic piano compositions spanning different periods, and celebrated pianists. Moreover, it will afford students the opportunity to relish the pleasure of playing short piano pieces. By engaging in both appreciation and hands-on practice, students are anticipated to enhance their comprehension of the beauty of piano music and develop a lifelong interest.

name.en: The Development of Taiwan Technology History

description.zh: 台灣科技發展史將討論二十世紀前半（1900-1950）部份重要技術引入台灣後，造成的影響與社會變遷。依時間先後，先從農業技術的變革-綠色革命。其次研讀有關電力與水利的技術發展，然後進入工業化初期的台灣社會變遷，以及二次大戰期間軍需工業所引導出的初期重化工業。除了這些技術與產業變革之外，也將兼論及技術人物群像與職業教育的開端。
description.en: The main topics for class will discuss the important technology how to influence Taiwan society during 1900-1950. This class includes some important developments: Green revolution -it discuss about agriculture development; the technology development of electricity and water conservancy. In some topic we discuss about Taiwan society change in early days industrialization and chemical industry during world war II. Except those topics, technologists and the beginning of professional education in Taiwan will be introduced.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將討論二十世紀後半(1950-1990)台灣重要科技產業與經濟發展的關聯性，同時也將從日常生活科技與社會的角度分析科技物設計的緣由，最後再帶入工程文化的認識與反思。This course will discuss the relationship between technology and industrial development in Taiwan during the second half of the 20th century (1950-1990). It will also analyze the reasons behind the design of technological objects from the perspectives of everyday life technology and society. Finally, it will delve into the understanding and reflection of engineering culture.

description.zh: 以視覺藝術為探討重點，研究藝術起源以及原始美術、民俗與大眾藝術分野。探究式覺元素和設計原理以及應用媒材、使用技巧，涵蓋素描、水彩、油畫、版畫、混合媒材、雕塑、建築，廣告、包裝、服裝設計、工業產品設計及攝影等。配合幻燈教學，使同學對於視覺藝術有整體性、概括性的認識，以奠定將來從事藝術鑑賞和研究創造之基礎。
description.en: The focus of this course is the exploration of visual arts.  Students will study the origin of art and the distinction among primitive art, folk and popular art. This course also provides students with visual elements, design principles, applied media material, and techniques including charcoal drawing, water-colored painting, oil painting, graphic art, compound material, sculpture, architecture, advertisement, packaging, fashion design, industrial design, and photography. Slide teaching is adopted to give students a comprehensive and general understanding on visual art in order to foster students to appreciate, study, and create art.

syllabi.outline:
課程理念為「美學素養」與藝術史，以奠定技職學生人文涵養為要點，從藝術起源為始，帶領同學領悟西方美學與藝術風格流派，以此累積學生的美學涵養，轉化深藏藝術史中「美」的價值。
The curriculum concept is "aesthetic literacy" and art history. It focuses on laying the foundation for the humanistic cultivation of vocational students. Starting from the origin of art, it leads students to understand Western aesthetics and art styles and schools, so as to accumulate students' aesthetic cultivation and transform the value of "beauty" hidden in art history.

description.zh: 為了讓學生有機會學習有系統的瞭解、接納自己，體諒父母、尊長，關愛別人，回饋社會，進而發揮潛能，自主自在的過一生，乃設計此種10～15人的獨特小團體，運用團體動力，以「交流分析」(Transactional Analysis,TA)為主要理論架構，採理論與實務、個別與團體並重方式，在師生積極參與中，討論、分享、成長。課程內容主要包含交流分析概述，人格結構與功能分析，自我圖，關愛經濟，愛的證言，交流方式分析，時間結構分析，心理遊戲分析，心理劇本分析的理論與習作等。
description.en: In a systematic way, this course will help students understand themselves, accept themselves, and understand their parents and elders.  Also, it teaches students how to care for other people and have contributions to society with a view to promoting students' potential and live their life self-confiently and freely.  The class is to be desinged into groups composed of 10 to 15 students in each section in order to make use of group interactions, to encourage students to actively participate in class discussion and experience sharing.  On the basis of Transactional Analysis(TA), both theory and practice, individual and group activities are emphasized.  Through such a focus, students will go through various stages leading to personal growth.  The contents of this course include: an introduction to TA, an analysis on personality, self-realization, caring and love experiences, transactional analysis, psychological tests, and game analysis, theory and exercise on psychological plays.

syllabi.outline:
主題：美好關係探索與實踐(請耐心看完說明)

本課程從家庭關係開啟自我探索、情緒舒展、自我擁抱到關係開展，融入簡單的理論概念，透過繪本、影片、體驗、互動、討論分享、塗繪、書寫等表達性藝術，在舒緩的氣氛中，引導同學逐步建構自我與人我關係發展的力量。

●溫馨提醒：
這門課從社會教育出發，僅提取部分心理學基礎概念，非學理性課程，亦非單向式講授，注重體驗互動，屬生活應用與實踐性質，課中常需跨出腳步與人互動連結，是一趟向內也向外的心靈探險，採類工作坊模式進行，請審慎評估再選課；第一堂須出席。

◎選課提醒：
●如非課程需要，上課禁用3C。
●如非身體不適，上課禁止睡覺。
●第一堂即分組，若無法準時出席請勿選課。
●課堂中常需與人互動分享，若還未有此心理準備請暫勿選課。
●課中多有表達性創作體驗，需自備物材：
  剪貼簿、A4紙或A4空白筆記本、12色粉蠟筆、膠水、剪刀、每組一張全開
  大書面紙、雜誌圖片等)。

syllabi.notes:
SDGs
第3項良好健康與社會福利：著重在良好心靈健康
每堂課皆以建構心靈健康為設計，如自我內在關係、家人關係、情緒釋壓、人我關係連結等，第一週到第十七週皆然。
第4項優質教育：確保包容和公平的教育
課堂互動中，以邀請與鼓勵取代勉強與責罰，尊重學生。課程引導尊重個人差異，欣賞不同特質展現，並提供多元且開放式的參與機會。
如：第四週：同理裝備：如何聽、怎麼說？
第七週：與人連結：自在的做自己  
第十六週：向內探索：從隱藏我到未知我
第5項性別平等
本課程從廣義的尊重性別平等出發，提取性別權力關係與互動，並延伸情感教育的溝通協商與處理情感挫折的能力，融於第十二週：愛的存款與表達練習、第十三週親密關係：愛、差異與界線、第七週：與人連結，自在的做自己課程，進行體驗式學習。

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹中華民國憲法、探討憲政體制的運作、人民權利義務的規範及相關法律的適用等問題。期能使學生認知國家民主法治的實施狀況，維護社會秩序與個人基本權利，進而體現人性尊嚴的價值。
description.en: This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要在引介我國憲法的要義、探討憲政體制的運作、研析權利義務的實務及詮釋相關法律的適用等，期能使學生掌握國家憲政體制運作的實況、認識憲法與人權保障之間的關係，進而體現人權立國與人性尊嚴的價值。
This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

syllabi.notes:
*課程對應SDGs指標：
本課程將涉及廣義的SDG4：教育品質，SDG 10：減少不平等，以及SDG 16：和平與正義制度。
*指標對應授課內容：
在總論部分，第一～八週，著重在立憲主義的基本理解，其中，第六週～第七週的「現代憲法的基本特性」，以及第八週的「憲法與增修條文」，將涉及廣義的SDG 10：減少不平等的核心目標：體現人權立國與「人性尊嚴」的價值，以及廣義的SDG 16：和平與正義制度的核心目標：「促進和平社會，確保司法平等」。
在各論部分，第十～十五週，聚焦在人權保障的關鍵議題，其中，第十週的「人權保障的基本理解」與第十一週的「人權保障的基礎權利」，將涉及廣義的SDG4：教育品質中的「推動人權教育」，及廣義的SDG 10：減少不平等的核心目標：體現人權立國和「人性尊嚴」的價值；另外，第十二週～十五週各論的理論與實務部分將涉及廣義的SDG16：和平與正義制度的核心目標：「促進和平社會，確保司法平等」。
*本課程融入問題導向精神，著重師生互動，善誘學習動機，教學進程中將涉及憲法與人權相關議題之啟發思辨（Explanation）項目。

description.zh: 人的身體一接觸自然界，便開始各個器官的功能，人不如機器，無法汰換零件，加上身體機能遇到問題之後，許多人往往不知如何處理應對，甚至身體出現徵兆也渾然不知。所以此科目最主要的目的是希望藉由對醫學的認識，讓大學生們更瞭解自己的身體，進而保護並時時自我偵測身體是否正常運作，要培養健全的大學生，而不是只會讀書的大病貓。
description.en: Once the human body contacts the natural environment, the organs of the body begin to function.  But the human body can not change it's organizational like machine.  So when our body's function is in trouble, we always have no idea how to solve it, either to find out.  One of these course's objection is to let college students understanding their own body by learning some important medical concepts.  We hope that our country both has excellent and healthy college students,  and not all sick.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以「大學學生的身體與生活」為核心，探討高等教育環境如何影響學生的身心健康與生活福祉。大學階段雖是知識與自我成長的重要時期，卻同時伴隨壓力累積、不良生活型態及健康風險，其影響往往超越校園，延續至成年生活。

課程將從生活型態醫學的觀點，系統性分析大學生常見的健康議題，包括心理壓力與情緒障礙、睡眠不足、運動量不足、飲食失衡、酒精與藥物濫用，以及校園中的食物與經濟不安全感。透過探討大腦、肝臟與消化系統等關鍵生理機制，說明壓力與生活選擇如何對身體造成長期影響。

此外，課程亦將批判性檢視校園文化中對「忙碌」、「高壓」與酗酒的常態化與美化現象，並討論其對學生健康與學習成效的潛在危害。課程最後將引導學生理解個人、校園與政策層級在促進學生健康中的角色，培養學生建立健康生活能力與自我照護意識，為其學業成功與長期福祉奠定基礎。

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en:
The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.
The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

name.en: The Development of Taiwan Technology History

description.zh: 台灣科技發展史將討論二十世紀前半（1900-1950）部份重要技術引入台灣後，造成的影響與社會變遷。依時間先後，先從農業技術的變革-綠色革命。其次研讀有關電力與水利的技術發展，然後進入工業化初期的台灣社會變遷，以及二次大戰期間軍需工業所引導出的初期重化工業。除了這些技術與產業變革之外，也將兼論及技術人物群像與職業教育的開端。
description.en: The main topics for class will discuss the important technology how to influence Taiwan society during 1900-1950. This class includes some important developments: Green revolution -it discuss about agriculture development; the technology development of electricity and water conservancy. In some topic we discuss about Taiwan society change in early days industrialization and chemical industry during world war II. Except those topics, technologists and the beginning of professional education in Taiwan will be introduced.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將討論二十世紀後半(1950-1990)台灣重要科技產業與經濟發展的關聯性，同時也將從日常生活科技與社會的角度分析科技物設計的緣由，最後再帶入工程文化的認識與反思。This course will discuss the relationship between technology and industrial development in Taiwan during the second half of the 20th century (1950-1990). It will also analyze the reasons behind the design of technological objects from the perspectives of everyday life technology and society. Finally, it will delve into the understanding and reflection of engineering culture.

name.zh: 當代藝術與文化創意產業
name.en: Contemporary Art and Creative Industries of Culture

description.zh: 這門課的目標是介紹並討論當代人文思潮與創作的關係與研究。18星期的課程包括一次課外教學，以及邀請演講者和學生對話與討論，並有一套精選的幻燈片和錄影帶配合講授課程。
description.en: This course is to introduce a basic understanding of prevailing trend of contemporary thought and research of its relation of contemporary creation. An 18 weeks program including one field trips and possible some discussions with guest speakers. A concise selection of slides and videotapes are applied with lectures.

syllabi.outline: 藝術不僅是審美與表達的載體，更是創新思維的催化劑。本課程探索當代藝術如何與科學、產業、社會議題交匯，我們從藝術與科學的對話出發，探討視覺藝術如何受到不同科學的影響，當代藝術如何拓展博物館與文化產業的邊界。同時，課程也關注當代藝術的社會參與，包括環境永續、身份認同與潮流文化等，並透過經典的當代藝術作品、以及跨領域與藝術融合等知名創作，剖析創意如何形塑未來。課程鼓勵同學從跨域的視角理解藝術，培養跨域與文化創新的思維模式。

name.zh: 二十世紀中國現代文學與文化建構
name.en: The modern literature and cultural construction in twentieth century China

description.zh: 本課程關注的焦點將以都市文學和民族/文化/現代建構為基底，以“五四”文學以來的總體概述為起始的一個發現之旅。課程將以夏志清的中國現代小說史為起點，進而以李歐梵對於民國初年出版商和作家和他們的貢獻作為對照，來做為現代城市文化風景的呈現。課程中將以安德森”想像的共同體”為背景，解釋它被各種文化論述所引用的觀點，以各種面向來看待文學作品對於民族建構的貢獻。
description.en: We arrange the course that is based on urban literatures, with issues about the race, culture and the construction of the modern world. The students in the course will be guided into a tour of discovery, which is summed up and initiated from “May 4th Movement”. The progress of course will be mapped out from “A History of Modern Chinese Fiction” compiled by C. T. Hsia (夏志清), and then the analysis from Leo Lee, and other writers, will be compared to exhibit the style and features of modern urban literatures. According to the theory of “Imagined Communities” which is authored by B. Anderson, we will also explain the viewpoints from different cultures, and comment on the analyses to the race construction with varied points of view.

syllabi.outline:
This course adapts a genealogy perspective and begins with a general overview of modern Chinese literature as a journey of discovery. The course will start with an introduction of A new literary history of modern China edited by Wang David Der-wei Wang (王德威), and then review how Wang succeeded Chih-tsing Hsia’s (夏志清)   work to present a new, diversify, and historically poetic version of Chinese literature history. This course will take these authors as cases for discussion, mapping Lu Hsun (魯迅)and Eileen Chang (張愛玲). With further navigating their positions in the literary genealogy, the lecturer aims to address how their literary works construct contemporary culture. In addition, two films, Spring in a Small Town and New Women, will be discussed in order to understand the cultural situation at that time.
本課程將以華語譜系為視角，以中國現代文學的總體概述為起始，進行一場發現之旅。課程將以王德威的《哈佛新編中國現代文學史》切入，介紹王德威如何繼承夏志清的工作，呈現新格局、輻射的、「史蘊詩心」的中國文學史呈現。課程中將著重介紹魯迅、張愛玲的文學地位，解釋他們在文學系譜上承前啟後的位置，以各種面向來看待文學作品對於當代文化建構的貢獻。此外，也將特別探討《小城之春》與《新女性》兩部電影，以了解當時的文化情境。

description.zh: 鋼琴擁有寬廣的音域，無論獨奏或合奏，鋼琴都能恰如其分地奏出悠揚音樂。這門課程將介紹鋼琴的起源與構造、各個時代的經典鋼琴作品與著名的鋼琴家，並且讓同學體驗彈奏鋼琴短曲的樂趣。期許能透過欣賞與實作，讓同學更深刻地理解鋼琴音樂之美，培養終身的興趣。
description.en: The piano possesses a broad tonal range, and whether in a solo or ensemble context, it adeptly delivers enchanting music. This course will provide an introduction to the piano's origins and construction, classic piano compositions spanning different periods, and celebrated pianists. Moreover, it will afford students the opportunity to relish the pleasure of playing short piano pieces. By engaging in both appreciation and hands-on practice, students are anticipated to enhance their comprehension of the beauty of piano music and develop a lifelong interest.

description.zh: 為了讓學生有機會學習有系統的瞭解、接納自己，體諒父母、尊長，關愛別人，回饋社會，進而發揮潛能，自主自在的過一生，乃設計此種10～15人的獨特小團體，運用團體動力，以「交流分析」(Transactional Analysis,TA)為主要理論架構，採理論與實務、個別與團體並重方式，在師生積極參與中，討論、分享、成長。課程內容主要包含交流分析概述，人格結構與功能分析，自我圖，關愛經濟，愛的證言，交流方式分析，時間結構分析，心理遊戲分析，心理劇本分析的理論與習作等。
description.en: In a systematic way, this course will help students understand themselves, accept themselves, and understand their parents and elders.  Also, it teaches students how to care for other people and have contributions to society with a view to promoting students' potential and live their life self-confiently and freely.  The class is to be desinged into groups composed of 10 to 15 students in each section in order to make use of group interactions, to encourage students to actively participate in class discussion and experience sharing.  On the basis of Transactional Analysis(TA), both theory and practice, individual and group activities are emphasized.  Through such a focus, students will go through various stages leading to personal growth.  The contents of this course include: an introduction to TA, an analysis on personality, self-realization, caring and love experiences, transactional analysis, psychological tests, and game analysis, theory and exercise on psychological plays.

syllabi.outline:
主題：美好關係探索與實踐(請耐心看完說明)

本課程從家庭關係開啟自我探索、情緒舒展、自我擁抱到關係開展，融入簡單的理論概念，透過繪本、影片、體驗、互動、討論分享、塗繪、書寫等表達性藝術，在舒緩的氣氛中，引導同學逐步建構自我與人我關係發展的力量。

●溫馨提醒：
這門課從社會教育出發，僅提取部分心理學基礎概念，非學理性課程，亦非單向式講授，注重體驗互動，屬生活應用與實踐性質，課中常需跨出腳步與人互動連結，是一趟向內也向外的心靈探險，採類工作坊模式進行，請審慎評估再選課；第一堂須出席。

◎選課提醒：
●如非課程需要，上課禁用3C。
●如非身體不適，上課禁止睡覺。
●第一堂即分組，若無法準時出席請勿選課。
●課堂中常需與人互動分享，若還未有此心理準備請暫勿選課。
●課中多有表達性創作體驗，需自備物材：
  剪貼簿、A4紙或A4空白筆記本、12色粉蠟筆、膠水、剪刀、每組一張全開
  大書面紙、雜誌圖片等)。

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹中華民國憲法、探討憲政體制的運作、人民權利義務的規範及相關法律的適用等問題。期能使學生認知國家民主法治的實施狀況，維護社會秩序與個人基本權利，進而體現人性尊嚴的價值。
description.en: This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要在引介我國憲法的要義、探討憲政體制的運作、研析權利義務的實務及詮釋相關法律的適用等，期能使學生掌握國家憲政體制運作的實況、認識憲法與人權保障之間的關係，進而體現人權立國與人性尊嚴的價值。
This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

syllabi.notes:
*課程對應SDGs指標：
本課程將涉及廣義的SDG4：教育品質，SDG 10：減少不平等，以及SDG 16：和平與正義制度。
*指標對應授課內容：
在總論部分，第一～八週，著重在立憲主義的基本理解，其中，第六週～第七週的「現代憲法的基本特性」，以及第八週的「憲法與增修條文」，將涉及廣義的SDG 10：減少不平等的核心目標：體現人權立國與「人性尊嚴」的價值，以及廣義的SDG 16：和平與正義制度的核心目標：「促進和平社會，確保司法平等」。
在各論部分，第十～十五週，聚焦在人權保障的關鍵議題，其中，第十週的「人權保障的基本理解」與第十一週的「人權保障的基礎權利」，將涉及廣義的SDG4：教育品質中的「推動人權教育」，及廣義的SDG 10：減少不平等的核心目標：體現人權立國和「人性尊嚴」的價值；另外，第十二週～十五週各論的理論與實務部分將涉及廣義的SDG16：和平與正義制度的核心目標：「促進和平社會，確保司法平等」。
*本課程融入問題導向精神，著重師生互動，善誘學習動機，教學進程中將涉及憲法與人權相關議題之啟發思辨（Explanation）項目。

name.zh: 勞動影像與當代台灣社會
name.en: Labor Images in Contemporary Taiwan Society

description.zh: 本課程與台北市勞動局合作，以歷年來勞動金像獎獲獎作品以及勞動局推出的勞動紀錄片為主要影像教材，從勞動社會學的觀點出發，對當代台灣社會的勞動相關議題進行介紹。課程涵蓋範圍兼顧理論與實務，除了以影片來進行課程講授與集體討論外，並指導同學以拍攝短片的方式，於學期末呈現他們對於日常生活裡的勞動議題觀察。
description.en: This course is intended to employ the award-winning works of the "Labor Awards" and the "Labor Documentary" launched by the Department of Labor, Taipei City Government over the years to introduce labor-related issues in Taiwan society from the perspectives of labor sociology. In cooperation with the Department of Labor, teaching with film and collective discussion constitute the main methods in this course which covers both the theory and the practice dimensions. In addition, students will be instructed to make a short film to present their observation on labor issues in daily life.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將從認識職業災害出發，闡述當代台灣社會的勞動課題。課程進行除透過相關勞動影片賞析與座談，進行職災與勞動地景的討論外，並將結合實地踏查與桌遊等活動，期以深化對台灣職業安全問題以及勞動權益的探索與認識。

name.en: Introduction to Intellectual Property-Oriented Entrepreneurship Models

description.zh: 本課程旨在提供學生對創業過程中智慧財產應用與商業模式設計的基礎理解。內容涵蓋創新研發與智慧財產權的關聯、商業模式構成要素、價值主張設計、以及智財行銷與授權策略。課程結合理論講授與案例討論，引導學生認識如何將創意構想轉化為具競爭力與保護力的營運模式，適合有志於創業、智慧財產管理或高科技產業實務應用的學生修習。
description.en: This course provides a foundational understanding of how intellectual property (IP) plays a strategic role in entrepreneurship and business model design. Students will explore key concepts such as innovation commercialization, IP protection and valuation, and the structure of business models that leverage IP assets. Through lectures, case studies, and project-based learning, students will gain insights into how to transform technical ideas into competitive and sustainable business strategies. The course is ideal for students interested in entrepreneurship, IP management, and innovation-driven industries.

description.zh:
性、性別是人類與生俱來的課題，其與各時代之政治體系、法律規範及社會變遷有密不可分的關係法律中的性別議題，既是法律問題也是社會問題，需要結合法律領域與社會領域的知識，作跨領域教學與學習。
本課程配合性別平等教育政策趨勢，分就不同面向的法律規範中的相關性別議題，來讓學生了解近年來性別平等之相關法律意涵希望能在認知、情意、行動等層面，讓學生習得正確的性別權利意識，進而在國家公私領域中運用相關知識落實性別平等，以促進多元文化之下兩性平權發展。
description.en:
Sex and gender are inherent issues of human beings, and they are inseparable from the political system, legal norms and social changes of all ages. Gender issues in the law are both legal and social issues and need to be combined with the legal field and society Domain knowledge for cross-domain teaching and learning.
This course is in line with the gender equality education policy trend, and divides the relevant gender issues in different aspects of legal norms to let students understand the relevant legal implications of gender equality in recent years. Hopefully, students can learn from the levels of cognition, affection, and action. Correct awareness of gender rights, and then apply relevant knowledge to implement gender equality in the public and private sectors of the country, so as to promote the development of gender equality under multiculturalism.

description.zh:
中國的崛起正在改變全球的政治、經濟和文化，而台灣與港澳都是已然成型的大中華經濟圈成員，吾人必須要趁早了解中國市場崛起的原因，並開始作好準備。
 
本課程帶領學生深入瞭解中國崛起的背景、所代表的意義、以及如何去面對隨之而來的新挑戰。課程中並將描繪出世界的未來走向、美國霸權的逐日衰退、和各種產業即將面臨的威脅/挑戰/機遇。
 
中國已經成為世界最大的經濟體，未來台灣的企業、經濟前景、甚至個人生活都會感受到巨大的衝擊。中國的經濟成長何以會影響到所有的全球性產業和消費者，並分析許多工作即將面臨的威脅。
 
本課程由總體宏觀角度出發，逐步進入細部剖析，期末再以全球觀點回顧大中華經濟圈的發展，並對未來趨勢提出分析。
description.en:
This is an introductory level course on the rise of China as a major power and the emergence of the Greater China Economic Circle. Through intensive reading and in-class discussion, the students are expected to gain an in-depth understanding of the developmental causes, path, and trajectory of the GCEC.

Both positive and negative factors will be critically examined in the assigned readings. The role of Taiwan in the development of GCEC will also be reviewed.

syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 二二八放假
Week 2 大中華經濟圈的崛起與衝擊：挑戰、壓力、機遇、前景

Week 4 獨特又矛盾的經濟體：讀懂中國經濟
Week 5 中國發展的匱乏：經濟性、社會性、政治性匱乏
Week 6 清明放假
Week 7 中國特色社會主義與共同富裕
Week 8 從中國的亞洲夢到人類命運共同體：BRI、GDI、GSI、GCI

Week 10 勞動節放假
Week 11 「百年馬拉松」與「中國威脅論」: 「韜光養晦」、「和平崛起」、「區域霸權」、「中國夢」
Week 12 中美博弈: 科技戰、貿易戰、金融戰，新冷戰 vs. 熱戰
Week 13 注定一戰：「修昔底德陷阱」的歷史教訓
Week 14 中美大對抗：中國贏了嗎？
Week 15 當中國買下全世界: 中國的銳實力
Week 16 與中國打交道：跨國企業的經驗
Week 17 端午放假

評分標準與課程要求:
(1)「上課出席聽講及參與狀況」占學期總成績 40%。每學期無故缺席 3 次者以不及格論。缺席 2 次者扣減學期總成績 30%。課程進行中嚴禁玩手機與平板，手機 一律設為靜音或振動模式，經多次警告後仍不改進者，一律扣減學期總成績 30%。請假必須以電子郵件寄交課程助教，並於下一週提出請假證明。
(2)學期末繳交一篇個人報告，占學期總成績 60%。題目另行擇期公佈。本課程的報告絕對禁止「抄襲、剪貼」，所有期末報告必須附上「Turnitin 學術論文原創性比對系統」之對比報告，與其他論文或出版品的雷同比例不得高於 20%。否則一律以「不及格」論。
(3)所有選課與經過本人同意的旁聽同學必須以實名加入課程群組。

description.zh: 民主政治為法治政治，凡政府各項施政均需有法令依據。行政法，乃是國家各行政機關所適用之各種法令規章之總稱，其內容含蓋國家行政機關之組織、職權、作用、程序及爭訟等事項之法規，範圍至為廣泛，且與人民之權利、義務息息相關。本課程將以系統化、生動化，並輔以實例之方式講授，以啟發同學學習興趣。同學修習本課程，除可增進法治知能與素養外，並可對日常生活之權益維護有重大裨益。
description.en: Democracy is regarded as rule by law nowadays. All official policies that are implemented by government must be based on law. Administrative law is a general term of all kinds of regulations and laws that are suitable for administrative organizations. The content includes of administrative organization in this country. The course serves as extensive rules that are related to people is rights and obligations. The principle emphasis of the course is on the systematic instruction with specific examples enlighten students learning interest, furthermore not only promoting knowledge and professional training in law but also effective in daily life.

description.zh:
「民事訴訟法」第一個部分，此部分旨在向修課同學作民事訴訟法之概括介紹，而此一介紹包含下列三個重點： 一、民事訴訟法之立法背景 二、民事訴訟法之理論 三、民事訴訟法之解釋方法 參與此部分乃理解民事訴訟法之關鍵一步，修課同學將受益匪淺。
第二個部分，此部分會聚焦在民事訴訟法之細節上，尤其是下列三個重點：
一、對於民事訴訟法之進一步闡述
二、民事訴訟法於案例事實之適用
三、民法與民事訴訟法之結合
於此部分課程結束時，修課同學應有能力依據民事訴訟法來處理常見之民事法律問題。
description.en:
“Civil Procedure Law” the first part of this course, is aiming to give participants a general introduction to the Civil Procedure Law, and the introduction contains the following three points: 1. The legislative background of the Civil Procedure Law. 2. The theories of the Civil Procedure Law. 3. The interpretive methods of the Civil Procedure Law. Attending the part is the critical step to understanding the Civil Procedure Law and benefits participants a lot.
The second part of this course, is focusing on the details of the Civil Proce-dure Law, especially the following three points: 
1. Further elucidation of the Civil Procedure Law.
2. Application of the Civil Procedure Law to the facts.
3. Combination of the Civil Law and the Civil Procedure Law.
At the end of the part, participants are supposed to be able to deal with common civil legal problems according to the Civil Procedure Law.

syllabi.outline:
不論是一般之契約或車禍事件，或者是跨國之高科技侵權案件，我們生活中之大小事均與民事訴訟程序息息相關，無論是否從事法律業，皆有學習民事訴訟法之必要，以維護自己的權益。本課程即旨在以淺顯易懂之方式，介紹民事訴訟法之基礎理論及規範，並輔以案例來加以說明，俾使修課同學能對於民事訴訟建立基本之了解，並進而能作初步之實務應用。
本課程除了民事訴訟法的規定本身外，也會教授相關的民法規定，故即使無民法基礎的同學亦歡迎修課。

description.zh: 以講授刑法基本概念的犯罪論、罪數論及刑罰論為主軸；並輔以相關案例的檢討、分析，以使同學對於抽象的概念及學理，得以理解及適用。目的除在強化同學對維護個人、社會、國家等法益的體認外，亦在奠定學習刑法各論的基礎。
description.en: The course focuses on the introduction to the fundamental ideas of the criminal law such as the criminal theory, crime arithmetic and punishment theory. Many relevant cases are presented in the class for further discussion and analysis. The ultimate objective of the course is not only to enhance the students a deeper understanding of the rights granted to individuals, society and nations, but also to equip them with a wider knowledge base ready for a further studying on each specific section of the Criminal Law.

description.zh: 商標法係為保障商標權及消費者利益，維護市場公平競爭，促進工商企業正常發展所制定之法律。商標得以文字、圖形、記號、顏色、聲音、 立體形狀或其聯合式所組成，並應足以使商品或服務之相關消費者認識其為表彰商品或服務之標識，藉以與他人之商品或服務相區別。凡因表 彰自己之商品或服務，欲取得商標權者，應依該法申請註冊。本課程將兼顧實例與理論進行探討，來深化同學對於商標法的瞭解。
description.en: Trademark Act is formulated to safeguard trademark rights and consumers' interest, maintain fair competitions of markets, and facilitate normal development of industries and commerce.A trademark may be composed of a word, design, symbol, color, sound, three-dimensional shape or a combination thereof.A trademark as defined above shall be distinctive enough for relevant consumers of the goods or services to recognize it as identification to those goods or services and to differentiate such goods or services from those offered by others.A person who wishes to obtain trademark rights in order to distinguish its goods or services shall apply for trademark registration as provided under this Act.The discussion in the course covers theory and examples，to enhance a deeper understanding of Trademark Act for the students.

description.zh: 導引學生了解現今社會不同的科技公司所可能面對的智慧財產權訴訟相關議題，以此提高各公司對於智慧財產權之保護與運用，進而讓各科技公司在這全球化競爭的市場下，能夠更了解自己的優勢與權益。本課程將由不同的智慧財產權法律基礎開始介紹，內容包括權利取得要件與申請過程程序。透過了解基礎概念後，將此知識應用到訴訟實務上，包括各類智慧財產權法的訴訟程序問題與訴訟技巧。
description.en: To educate students about intellectual property rights litigation issues that may be faced by different technology companies in today's society in order to improve the protection and use of intellectual property rights by companies, thereby enabling technology companies to compete in a globalized marketplace. Understand their own advantages and interests. This course will start with a different legal basis for intellectual property rights, including elements of rights acquisition and application process procedures. By understanding the basic concepts, this knowledge will be applied to litigation practice, including various types of intellectual property law litigation procedures and litigation skills.

syllabi.outline:
一、課程內容：智慧財產權於21世紀已成為各國研究創新與文化發展所不可或缺的基石，故我國不論於法律或制度上格外重視。而私人企業上在研究創新、增加競爭條件與產品附加價值上，尤賴此相關之法律保護。本程課內容主要將包括專利權、商標權、著作權、營業秘密法、競業禁止、與新近AI等智慧財產權議題，並佐以近年著名案例，以提高同學的學習興趣。
二、教學目標：期使同學於期末，對於智慧則產權之相關法律觀念，能有一般性的基礎觀念，並可立即應用於職場上。
三、授課對象：本課程雖為科技法律學程之一。
四、實施方式：主要為教師講授，其中並有分組討論的議題，並預計有三次的單元考試。
