description.zh: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。
description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. The goal of this course is to help students realize their ideas and create actionable business solutions that can change the society.

syllabi.outline:
為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。

如果你想體驗創業前該具備的專業與過程，如果你想學習在未來不論是升學(簡報設計、創業計畫書)或就業(Wix網站、Line官方帳號)或探索自己(行銷、財務)，任何一項能力都能讓你在未來年薪百萬甚至創業，因此這堂課絕對不是輕鬆可及的營養學分，但絕對是你人生經歷中的營養學分。

To encourage and help students use technology or business models, collaborate with school teachers or cross-school classmates, and jointly solve social or business problems through business methods, this course will be conducted in a sprint class format. We will invite teachers and industry professionals with entrepreneurial experience to help students progress weekly through workshops and entrepreneurship competition drills. The goal is to help students implement their entrepreneurial ideas, apply them to society, and bring about change.

If you want to experience the professional skills and processes required before starting a business, or if you want to learn skills that will be valuable whether you pursue further education (presentation design, business plan writing), employment (Wix website, Line official account), or self-exploration (marketing, finance), any of these abilities can help you earn a million-dollar annual salary in the future or start your own business. Therefore, this course is not an easy elective but a valuable life experience.

name.zh: 企業最愛：高質感簡報溝通力
name.en: Corporate's Favorite: High-quality Communication and Presentation Ability

description.zh: 課程將以體驗式教學訓練，提升學員表達技巧、舞台技巧、臨場反應。本課程主要目的在教授學生以設計思考思維與策略，運用主題式課程實戰小組簡報及個人簡報，快速釐清簡報製作及表達過程中重點，提升修課學員個人簡報製作能力及表達能力，幫助學生在未來創業及就業上以出色之個人簡報能力獲得面試者及投資者的青睞，領先於起跑點取得優勢。
description.en: The course will use experiential teaching training to improve students' expression skills, stage skills, and on-the-spot reactions. The main purpose of this course is to teach students establishing design thinking strategies. During the course practice group presentations and personal presentations training students to quickly clarify the key points in the process of presentation production and presentation, to improve the students' personal presentation production and presentation skills. Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. Students who finished this course will be favored by interviewers and investors with his excellent personal presentation skills. And he will gain an advantage over the starting point.

syllabi.outline:
為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。

如果你想體驗創業前該具備的專業與過程，如果你想學習在未來不論是升學(簡報設計、創業計畫書)或就業(Wix網站、Line官方帳號)或探索自己(行銷、財務)，任何一項能力都能讓你在未來年薪百萬甚至創業，因此這堂課絕對不是輕鬆可及的營養學分，但絕對是你人生經歷中的營養學分。

To encourage and help students use technology or business models, collaborate with school teachers or cross-school classmates, and jointly solve social or business problems through business methods, this course will be conducted in a sprint class format. We will invite teachers and industry professionals with entrepreneurial experience to help students progress weekly through workshops and entrepreneurship competition drills. The goal is to help students implement their entrepreneurial ideas, apply them to society, and bring about change.

If you want to experience the professional skills and processes required before starting a business, or if you want to learn skills that will be valuable whether you pursue further education (presentation design, business plan writing), employment (Wix website, Line official account), or self-exploration (marketing, finance), any of these abilities can help you earn a million-dollar annual salary in the future or start your own business. Therefore, this course is not an easy elective but a valuable life experience.

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在教授學生創新創業的實務，讓學生實際組成團隊進行創業，並有老師全程指導實踐創業，學校並提供基本創業基金與創業場地，輔導學生實際體會創業的過程。課程內容包括：創新創業精神、創新思考、自我了解、團隊組成、經營模式建立、創業財務、創業專題進行、創業競賽等。
description.en: This course is to instruct students to practice the entrepreneurship and innovation. Students will form an entrepreneurship team. Teacher will guide the students throughout the entrepreneurship processes. University will offer students initial funds and incubation assistances. Students will gain practical experiences on how to establish entrepreneurship. The contents include entrepreneurial thoughts and actions, design thinking, self-understanding, team formation, business model development, entrepreneurship finance, entrepreneurship practices, entrepreneurship contests, and so on.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為培養學生將點子成功轉化為可行性募資提案，以柏克萊新創加速營模式，培養學生新創募資相關知識及提案簡報技能。課程內容包括：創新創業精神、創新思考、自我了解、團隊組成、顧客導向產品設計、提案規劃、簡報表達、募資、行銷、創業相關法律知識等。
description.en: The primary goal of this course is to equip students with the ability to successfully transform ideas into feasible crowdfunding proposals. Using the Berkeley startup accelerator model, the course helps students develop knowledge related to startup fundraising and presentation skills for proposals. Course content includes topics such as entrepreneurial spirit, innovative thinking, self-awareness, team formation, customer-oriented product design, proposal planning, presentation skills, fundraising, marketing, and legal knowledge related to entrepreneurship.

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

description.zh: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。
description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. The goal of this course is to help students realize their ideas and create actionable business solutions that can change the society.

syllabi.outline:
為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。

如果你想體驗創業前該具備的專業與過程，如果你想學習在未來不論是升學(簡報設計、創業計畫書)或就業(Wix網站、Line官方帳號)或探索自己(行銷、財務)，任何一項能力都能讓你在未來年薪百萬甚至創業，因此這堂課絕對不是輕鬆可及的營養學分，但絕對是你人生經歷中的營養學分。

To encourage and help students use technology or business models, collaborate with school teachers or cross-school classmates, and jointly solve social or business problems through business methods, this course will be conducted in a sprint class format. We will invite teachers and industry professionals with entrepreneurial experience to help students progress weekly through workshops and entrepreneurship competition drills. The goal is to help students implement their entrepreneurial ideas, apply them to society, and bring about change.

If you want to experience the professional skills and processes required before starting a business, or if you want to learn skills that will be valuable whether you pursue further education (presentation design, business plan writing), employment (Wix website, Line official account), or self-exploration (marketing, finance), any of these abilities can help you earn a million-dollar annual salary in the future or start your own business. Therefore, this course is not an easy elective but a valuable life experience.

description.en: The course will use experiential teaching training to improve students' expression skills, stage skills, and on-the-spot reactions. The main purpose of this course is to teach students establishing design thinking strategies. During the course practice group presentations and personal presentations training students to quickly clarify the key points in the process of presentation production and presentation, to improve the students' personal presentation production and presentation skills. Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. Students who finished this course will be favored by interviewers and investors with his excellent personal presentation skills. And he will gain an advantage over the starting point.

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在教授學生創新創業的實務，讓學生實際組成團隊進行創業，並有老師全程指導實踐創業，學校並提供基本創業基金與創業場地，輔導學生實際體會創業的過程。課程內容包括：創新創業精神、創新思考、自我了解、團隊組成、經營模式建立、創業財務、創業專題進行、創業競賽等。
description.en: This course is to instruct students to practice the entrepreneurship and innovation. Students will form an entrepreneurship team. Teacher will guide the students throughout the entrepreneurship processes. University will offer students initial funds and incubation assistances. Students will gain practical experiences on how to establish entrepreneurship. The contents include entrepreneurial thoughts and actions, design thinking, self-understanding, team formation, business model development, entrepreneurship finance, entrepreneurship practices, entrepreneurship contests, and so on.

description.zh: 教學目標為幫助學生瞭解多國企業所面對的國際財務管理的議題、其理論及實務。內容包括外匯市場、國際套利、外匯衍生性商品、外匯風險暴露管理、境外市場及國際投資組合管理。
description.en: The goal is to help students understand the theory and practice of the international financial management issues faced by multinational corporations. The course includes the following topics: foreign exchange, foreign exchange arbitrage, foreign exchange derivatives, risk exposure management, offshore market, and the international portfolio management.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以國際財務管理為核心，系統性介紹國際收支、國際融資與國際籌資三大主軸。課程內容涵蓋國際貿易與金融服務、跨國銀行體系運作，以及企業透過海外證券市場進行籌資之制度與實務。透過理論講授與實例說明，培養學生理解全球資金流動、金融制度與企業財務決策之能力，並建立分析國際金融環境對企業與經濟影響的整體視角。
This course provides a systematic introduction to international financial management, focusing on three core themes: balance of payments, international financing, and international fund raising. Topics include international trade and financial services, cross-border banking systems, and corporate fund-raising through overseas capital markets. Through theoretical discussion and practical illustrations, students will develop the ability to analyze global capital flows, financial institutions, and their implications for corporate financial decisions.

description.zh: 本課程授課主要內容分為三部分：第一部份為都市防災概論，此部分主要針對國內外文獻作一回顧，進而瞭解都市防災整體架構，區分為（1）文獻回顧；（2）防災基本計畫；及（3）防災整體架構等。期使國內都市計畫能逐步邁向防災都市計畫，以建立『安全都市』為目標。此部分的主要內容區分為：（1）都市災害風險理念的形成；（2）防災都市計畫與地區防災系統規劃；（3）都市計畫防災系統規劃原則；（4）都市計畫防災作業準則內容架構；（5）都市計畫防災作業準則；（6）安心都市計畫的形成與實現。第三部分為實務操作部分，以草屯鎮為例，藉九二一大地震的實例，深入探討災情調查的方法，實際調查狀況及研訂災後重建的程序與計畫內容，期望成為國內都市重建計畫的範例，主要內容區分為：（1）緒論；（2）重建理論；（3）草屯鎮現況發展；（4）災情調查方法與重建程序之建立；（5）災情調查分析與重建計畫內容研訂等。
description.en: The subject will be presented in three partsPart One - (1) Literature retrospection; (2) Fundamental planning for disaster prevention; (3) An integrated disaster prevention organization.Part Two -The major contents to be addressed include (1) Formation of urban disaster cataclysm and risk; (2) Urban disaster prevention plan and regional disaster protection system planning; (3) Principles for planning disaster prevention system in urban plan; (4) Operational standards and organization for urban disaster prevention; (5) Operational guidelines for urban disaster prevention; (6) Realization and formation of trouble free urban plan.Party Three -. The major contents are (1) Introduction; (2) rehabilitation theory; (3) Current development in Tsaotun City; (4) Establishment of damage survey method and rehabilitation procedures; (5) Detail analysis of damage survey report and preparation of rehabilitation plan content.

description.en: The primary goal of this course is to equip students with the ability to successfully transform ideas into feasible crowdfunding proposals. Course content includes topics such as entrepreneurial spirit, innovative thinking, self-awareness, team formation, customer-oriented product design, proposal planning, presentation skills, fundraising, marketing, and legal knowledge related to entrepreneurship.

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

name.zh: 統計在營建管理之應用
name.en: Applications of Statistics in Construction Management

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹統計分析方法於營建管理之應用，協助學生培養數據導向思維，以提升專案決策與管理效能。課程內容涵蓋問卷調查設計與信效度分析、變異數分析、複迴歸分析、因素分析及品管七大手法，並配合統計軟體進行資料處理與分析。透過案例研討與實務操作，學生將具備辨識與解決營建管理問題的能力，進而強化專案規劃、執行與控制之專業素養。
description.en: This course introduces the application of statistical analysis methods in construction management, aiming to cultivate students’ data-driven thinking and enhance their project decision-making and management effectiveness. The course covers survey design and reliability/validity analysis, analysis of variance (ANOVA), multiple regression analysis, factor analysis, and the seven quality control tools. Statistical software will be used for data processing and analysis. Through case studies and practical exercises, students will develop the ability to identify and solve problems in construction management, thereby strengthening their professional competence in project planning, execution, and control.

syllabi.outline:
本課程聚焦於多變量統計分析在營建管理中的實務應用，適合期望將統計工具應用於研究、專題或決策的研究生修習。課程以問卷設計與資料分析為基礎，透過 SPSS 統計專用軟體操作，教授因素分析、主成份分析與複迴歸等常用方法，協助學生系統性分析營建管理議題中的關鍵因素。
為強化統計結果的解釋力，課程輔以質化研究方法作為詮釋與補充工具，並介紹品管七大手法，加深學生於營建現場的問題診斷與改善規劃能力。課程強調實作導向與資料邏輯推理，不重數學推導，修課後學生將具備以數據支持營建管理決策的專業素養與研究能力。
This course introduces the practical application of multivariate statistical analysis in construction management. Topics include questionnaire design, data analysis using SPSS, and widely used techniques such as factor analysis, principal component analysis (PCA), and multiple regression. To strengthen the interpretation of statistical results, qualitative research methods and the seven basic quality control tools are also integrated. The course emphasizes applied skills and data reasoning over mathematical derivation, preparing students to support research and decision-making in construction management with data-driven insights.
syllabi.schedule:
單元1 變數概念與研究衡量基礎
1、變數類型與衡量尺度
2、李克特量表之設計原則與應用
3、變數間之函數關係與統計模型建構
單元2 統計專用軟體(SPSS)的介紹
1、資料登錄、變數設定與資料類型
2、統計基本工具應用
單元3 問卷分析於營建管理之應用
1、問卷設計與題目發展
2、問卷調查與資料蒐集
3、專家審題與問卷修正
4、信度與效度分析(李克特量表品質檢驗)
單元4 多變量統計方法於營建管理之應用
1、因素分析：萃取影響營建管理議題之關鍵因素
2、主成份分析：建構整體代理指標分數
3、複迴歸分析：檢驗關鍵因素之影響程度
單元5 質化研究方法於營建管理研究之應用
1、質化研究方法之基本概念
2、專家深度訪談設計與執行
3、質化資料於量化研究結果之補充與解釋(作為管理策略研擬之依據)
單元6 營建管理實務補充單元：品管七大手法
1、品管七大手法之原理與工具介紹
2、品管工具於營建管理實務之問題診斷與改善應用

＊＊ 以上課程內容得視學生研習與實際上課情形進行調整。

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

By the end of the course, students will be able to hold a simple conversation in Korean, comprehend basic Korean texts and write about their everyday lives.

name.en: Development of global perspective: Japanese Ⅱ

description.zh: 本課程為日語與文化(一)之進階課程，提供學生養成進階日語聽說讀寫技能，並能夠面對在各種情境下，表達出適當的日語，足以應付日常生活簡單狀況。此外，並運用多媒體等工具，介紹日本文化，歷史，人文等多種面向，讓學生能更多元地了解日本，有效提升學習興趣及效率。
description.en: This course is designed for students who has basic Japanese knowledge or who passed the language course: Japanese (I) in the previous term. This course provides a comprehensive approach to developing the four basic language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing) in order to cultivate your overall Japanese language ability to a level sufficient for various occasions and everyday life. In addition, using multimedia to introduce a variety of Japanese culture, history , and humanities. The students can learn more about Japan in many different perspectives, and effectively enhance interest in the learning process.

syllabi.outline: 本課程為大學通識人文藝術課程，旨在培養同學欣賞與描述書法作品美感的基本能力，並能辨識不同書體在筆法、結構與氣韻上的差異。課程內容涵蓋篆書、隸書、魏碑、楷書與行書等主要書體，透過名碑帖鑒賞與書體比較，引導同學理解各書體在文字造形、線條運用與視覺美感上的特色。同時，藉由楷書與行書的書寫體驗，使同學實際感受書法作為藝術表現形式的內涵與魅力，進而培養穩定而長久的欣賞能力。

第1週  課程導論
第2週  書法美感的基本語言（筆法、結構、章法）
第3週  書體演變與歷史脈絡（篆、隸、楷、行、草）
第4週  篆書—線條與對稱的秩序
第5週  隸書—波磔與橫向的視覺美感
第6週  楷書—結構與穩定
第7週  行書—流動與節奏
第8週  草書—速度與情感
第9週  期中考
第10週 五種書體比較與鑑賞
第11週 書法與篆刻
第12週 書法與裱褙
第13週 書法與當代生活
第14週 歷代名書法家作品賞析 (一)
第15週 歷代名書法家作品賞析 (二)
第16週 書法書寫個別指導 (一)
第17週 書法書寫個別指導 (二)
第18週 期末考

description.zh: 本課程介紹生成式人工智慧（AI）的基本概念與應用，包括生成式AI模型（如生成對抗網路、變分自編碼器、擴散模型、Transformer模型等）和在語言生成、多媒體生成、行為生成及創作等方面的應用。同時涉及流程管理、AI代理人以及在蛋白質設計和化學合成中的應用。學生將學習提示工程（Prompt Engineering）、辦公室流程自動化（RPA）、大型語言模型（LLM）、LangChain技術及其應用、以及RAG檢索式增強生成的基本概念與實踐。透過使用軟體機器人來執行重複性任務，可以減少錯誤、節省時間、降低成本、提升生產力並優化辦公室流程，使機器人能更準確地執行指定任務並加速語言相關工作。課程將詳細介紹包括基本工具的使用、資料處理及企業案例實作。透過本課程，學生將具備使用生成式AI技術解決實際問題的能力，並理解AI在各行業中的應用與挑戰。除了文字生成，生成式AI在蛋白質設計和化學合成領域，通過深度學習生成新型蛋白質結構和化學化合物，推動醫藥研發和材料科學的創新。此技術也廣泛應用於虛擬角色創建、智慧城市規劃、環境模擬和自動駕駛等領域。
description.en:
This course covers the basics and applications of generative AI, including
models like GANs, VAEs, Diffusion Models, and Transformers. It explores AI
applications in language generation, multimedia creation, and protein design.
Students will learn about Prompt Engineering, RPA, Large Language Models,
LangChain technology, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). The
course emphasizes using AI to automate tasks, enhance productivity, and
optimize office processes. It also includes practical tools, data handling, and
business case implementation. Students will understand AI applications and
challenges across various industries, including pharmaceutical research, virtual
characters, and smart cities.

description.zh: 本課程運用問題分析能力，以企業實際問題為基礎，採用問題導向學習（PBL）模式，進行人工智慧跨域專題實作。課程的目的是幫助學生理解如何運用人工智慧技術來解決現實世界中的問題。透過學習機器學習、光學檢測、影像辨識、生成式AI、自然語言處理等AI技術，學生將能跨域應用這些知識於數據分析、高速通訊、資訊安全、專案管理、企業管理與決策、金融商業服務、智慧製造、無人載具、國防太空、智慧農業、醫療、法律、半導體、藝術創作、環境監測等領域。本課程將培養學生實際操作人工智慧的能力，提升其問題解決和創新思維，並培育具有創業和創新精神的人才，讓學生了解在AI轉型和導入過程中產業所面臨的挑戰與困難。
description.en:
This course uses a problem-based learning (PBL) approach to tackle real-
world business issues, guiding students through interdisciplinary AI projects. It
aims to teach students how to apply AI technologies such as machine learning,
image recognition, and natural language processing across various domains
like data analysis, healthcare, and smart manufacturing. Students will gain
practical skills, enhance problem-solving abilities, and develop innovative
thinking. The course prepares students to handle AI projects, understand
industry challenges, and cultivate entrepreneurial and innovative spirits.

syllabi.outline:
This course is based on the management problems that students encounter at work, including operation research (OR), production planning and management, financial analysis, etc., and explores the technical principles of using machine learning, as well as the feasibility and scalability of application in these fields. The discussion scope of the machine learning will not only cover the most basic concepts and principles of convolutional neural networks (CNN),  self-attention, transformer, generative model, large language models (LLM), linear programming, and probabilistic programming, but also guide students to understand the importance of one or more of these architectures.
In terms of teaching aids, in response to the trend of the times, the programming development environment will be combined with the LLM approach to make it easier for students to quickly get started with programming languages. While looking at their own examples to achieve their own results, they will have a higher sense of accomplishment. The students also can accept the meaning of LLM’s most popular prompt engineering and parameter quantities. 
In addition, we will discuss some AI case studies, including applications of AI in medical, verbal communication, autonomous driving, education, and in multiple fields. Students will be able to apply AI technology to various fields.

description.zh: 課程目標在於教授 CG 軟體於多媒體產業上的應用， 並使學生具備建置素材庫 (Game-Ready Models)之能力。透過專案式教學,讓學生了解建模、材質、綁定、渲染的進階應用及銜接遊戲引擎的工作流程，並搭配Unity Animator、UML、C#， 去完善模型素材在遊戲引擎中的控制呈現，讓學生具備銜接設計端與程式端的技術，並為後續客製化虛擬實境應用的素材做出準備。  CG 軟體教學將著重在視覺化程式工具的使用, 讓學生利用程式思維、節點編程加速專案的進行；程式教學部分將使用Unity Animator、C#以完成遊戲Assets的設置。最終評量將以期末的專案呈現為主要評分方式。
description.en:
The course objective is to teach the application of CG software in the multimedia industry and equip students with the ability to build a material library (Game-Ready Models). Through project-based learning, students will understand advanced modeling, texturing, rigging, rendering, and the workflow of integrating with game engines. Together with Unity Animator, UML, and C#, they will refine the control and presentation of model materials in game engines, enabling students to connect design and programming skills and prepare for customizing virtual reality applications.
The CG software instruction will focus on the use of visual programming tools, enabling students to accelerate project progress using programming thinking and node programming. The programming instruction will use Unity Animator and C# to configure game assets. The final assessment will primarily be based on the presentation of the end-of-term project.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在教授動畫與遊戲引擎（Unreal）於多媒體產業中的應用，並培養學生建置遊戲引擎可用素材（Game-Ready Models）的能力，內容涵蓋美術設計與基礎程式製作。
課程採專案導向教學，帶領學生熟悉建模、材質設定、綁定等進階應用，並銜接遊戲引擎的整體製作流程。學生將實作使用 Unreal Blueprint、State Machine、State Tree 與 HLSL 等程式工具，有效控制素材於引擎中的呈現方式，建立設計與技術整合的能力。

This course introduces the use of animation and Unreal Engine in the multimedia industry, focusing on developing students’ ability to create Game-Ready Models for engine integration. The content covers both visual design and fundamental programming.
Through project-based learning, students will explore advanced workflows in modeling, texturing, and rigging, as well as how to integrate these assets into a game engine. They will work with tools such as Unreal Blueprint, State Machine, State Tree, and HLSL Code to gain hands-on experience in controlling and presenting assets within the engine, bridging design and programming skills.
The final assessment will be based on the completion of a simple game project.

name.zh: 校務研究：教育場域數據分析實作
name.en: Institutional research: the application of data science in education

description.zh: 校務研究是教育數據分析在教育場域的應用，在真實的教育場域中應用所學的教育數據分析技術，並針對所服務的教育機構，提供有科學意義且淺顯易懂的數據分析報告，以支持教育機構進行校務運作與教學活動的改善。本門課程首先讓學生認識各職能部門的核心項目及衍伸的校務研究議題；其次瞭解教育場域中因應各項校務與教學活動所出現的數據結構類型；接著教授學生使用教育場域中的真實數據，執行包括數據清理、數據調處、數據水平與垂直整併等步驟，以獨立生成有意義的數據結構；最後則聚焦在教育方案的效果分析，以及將數據分析資料視覺化，輔以淺顯易懂的數據解讀報告，增加學員對於數據分析結果的瞭解。
description.en: Institutional research is the field where the data science can apply in the education. In the educational field, institutional researchers must use their knowledge and techniques in the educational data analytics, providing the scientific report in a friendly manner to their affiliation. Those scientific report is aimed to improve the institutional operation and the teaching activities. This course would first introduce the function of each office at the university and the institution research topic those offices have interest. Then, the data structure which is commonly seen in the educational field would be introduced followed by a series of training on the data manipulation. Last, this course will teach the students how to conduct the educational program evaluation, data visualization, data analysis and the result interpretation.

syllabi.outline:
校務研究是教育數據分析在教育場域的應用，在真實的教育場域中應用所學的教育數據分析技術，並針對所服務的教育機構，提供有科學意義且淺顯易懂的數據分析報告，以支持教育機構進行校務運作與教學活動的改善。本門課程首先讓學生認識各職能部門的核心項目及衍伸的校務研究議題；其次瞭解教育場域中因應各項校務與教學活動所出現的數據結構類型；接著教授學生使用教育場域中的真實數據，執行包括數據清理、數據調處、數據水平與垂直整併等步驟，以獨立生成有意義的數據結構；最後則聚焦在教育方案的效果分析，以及將數據分析資料視覺化，輔以淺顯易懂的數據解讀報告，增加學員對於數據分析結果的瞭解。

Institutional Research (IR) serves as the vital intersection of data science and higher education. In this field, researchers leverage advanced analytics to transform complex data into accessible, evidence-based reports that guide institutional decision-making and enhance pedagogical effectiveness. This course provides a comprehensive foundation in IR, beginning with an overview of university administration and the specific research priorities of various campus offices. Students will then explore educational data structures and develop essential skills in data manipulation and cleaning. The final phase of the course focuses on practical application, training students to conduct program evaluations, create compelling data visualizations, and perform rigorous statistical analyses with meaningful result interpretation.

week 14: 社會網絡分析 (SNA)Social Network Analysis

week 16: 代理人基礎模型 (ABM)Agent-Based Modeling

week 17: 互動式儀表板與資料產品Shiny Dashboards

name.zh: 應用人工智慧於教育專題製作
name.en: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Educational Data Analysis Projects

description.zh: 本課程主要透過人工智慧相關技術主題的介紹與業界實例之分享，包括: 知識表達、機器學習、深度學習等，並實際運用機器學習工具如: TensorFlow、Keras、PyTorch等，並整合校務研究資料於專題課程，參與校務分析研究：考量資安的個資議題，擬將校內部份去識別化後之資料，經過編碼變造處理後於課堂使用，以教育相關大數據進行專題實作與分析。透過分組討論以及專題實作競賽，讓學生實際應用人工智慧工具與方法於教育資料分析。
description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce the technical topics and share industrial examples related to artificial intelligence, including: knowledge representation, machine learning, and deep learning. The students are required to utilize machine learning tools such as: TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch, to participate in the institutional repository research and analysis of related data in term projects. In consideration of privacy issues of personal information, the data will go through de-identification process for the usage purpose of educational big data analytics in term projects. With group discussions and project competition, students will be able to apply artificial intelligence tools and methods in educational data anlaysis.

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生具備建築設備節能設計的專業知識與實務能力，涵蓋冷凍空調、照明、給排水、能源管理與智慧建築等領域。透過案例分析、設計計算與實務專題，學生將學習如何評估建築能效、應用節能技術與設計低碳永續建築設備系統。
description.en: This course aims to equip students with professional knowledge and practical skills in energy-efficient design for building systems. It covers areas such as HVAC, lighting, plumbing, energy management, and smart buildings. Through case studies, design calculations, and hands-on projects, students will learn how to assess building energy performance, apply energy-saving technologies, and design low-carbon, sustainable building systems.

syllabi.outline:
建築物勘測，建築設備能源需求估算，負荷計算實例實做，風管與水管路系統製圖，節能設計實例實做與電腦分析，設備安裝－位置選定、基礎、避震及噪音控制，工程估價實例。
Building survey, building equipment energy requirement estimate, case study- load calculation, air duct system schematic drawing, and water piping system schematic drawing. Energy conservation design case study and computer analysis. Basic equipment installations-layout, foundation, vibration & noise control planning. Engineering cost estimation and analysis.

SES (Subway Environment Simulation Computer Program)程式以隧道通風理論基礎，所發展出之一套一維地鐵模擬程式；並經由BART、Montreal Metro及美國其他城市捷運系統之驗證，而廣泛用於地鐵通風系統之設計模擬。
1.根據不同之隧道系統、
2.不同之車輛型式及各種不同之環控條件，
3.依設計者所需之各種運轉狀況模擬；
4.並提供連續之風速、風量、溫溼度、隧道壓損等數據，
5.以讓設計者評估設計之地鐵系統優劣，作為設計改進之依據。

name.zh: 離岸風機工程調查與施工
name.en: Engineering investigation and construction for offshore wind turbines

description.zh: 1. 台灣海域的地質概述, 2. 海域的工程地質調查, 3. 不同環境下的風場結構, 4. 海流特性的調查與評估, 5. 波浪特性的調查與評估, 6. 鋼結構施工, 7. 風機之運輸與安裝, 8. 灌漿工程, 9. 離岸變電站與基礎, 10. 風機葉片之製作、安裝、維護與維修11. 海纜鋪設工程 12. 構材防蝕技術 13. 沖刷防治 14 基樁鑽掘與噪音降檢
description.en: 1. Offshore geology description nearby Taiwan, 2. Offshore geotechnical site investigation, 3. Wind farm structures under different environmental conditions, 4. Investigation and evaluation of current properties, 5. Investigation and evaluation of wave properties, 6. Construction of steel structure, 7. Transportation and installation of wind turbines, 8. Grouting engineering, 9. Offshore substation and foundation , 10. Fabrication, installation, maintenance and repair of wind turbine blades, 11. Laying procedures of subsea power cables, 12. Corrosion-proof technologies, 13. Scouring-proof technologies, 14 Pile drilling and noise reduction

syllabi.outline:
離岸風電為重要之綠色能源，離岸風電工程與傳統陸上工程具有極大差異。本課程介紹離岸風電工程，涵蓋規劃、調查、設計、製造、運輸與施工等各階段之關鍵課題，並介紹引用之國際標準，其知識可應用於各種離岸工程。期能啟發學生對海洋工程之興趣。

Offshore wind power is an important form of green energy, and offshore wind engineering differs greatly from traditional onshore engineering. This course introduces offshore wind engineering, covering key topics in each phase, including planning, site investigation, design, manufacturing, transportation, and installation, as well as the international standards referenced throughout. The knowledge gained can be applied to various types of offshore engineering. The course aims to inspire students' interest in marine engineering.

name.en: Monitoring and Analysis for Environmental Pollutants

description.zh: 本課程著重於環境污染物之微量監測與分析內容，此包括有機有毒物、重金屬之儀器分析原理、化學理論及分析方法。修習本課程宜有化學基礎。
description.en: The course introduces monitoring and analysis for environment pollutants. It focuses the micro quantity analysis based on chemical theory. Modern instruments with high sensitivity will be also discussed.

syllabi.outline: 本課程著重於環境污染物之監測與分析內容，包括空氣品質監測、環境影響評估監測、移動污染源監測、氣象監測、噪音監測、氣液固相物質採樣分析、遙測等，涵蓋基礎化學與物理之採樣分析方法，並安排一次空氣品質監測站參訪，熟悉操作常見的氣膠分析儀器。修習本課程建議有基礎環境物理化學基礎。

name.en: Topkey Lecture Series on Sustainability, Technology, and the Humanities

description.zh:
課程旨在引導學生在就學期間提前規劃未來的學習與發展方向，透過跨領域的專題演講與交流，學生將接觸最新的科技應用、理解永續發展的重要性，並在多元人文視野中培養創新與社會責任感。課程涵蓋：
 1. 永續願景：與國際接軌，使永續成為大學社會責任的行動。
 2. 科技與人文並進：透過跨領域講座，深化學生在科技與創新、智慧與文化間的連結度。
 3. 深耕跨領域人才培育：課程類型將包含，講座、工作坊、企業參訪、博物館走讀、合作研究等建構跨領域人才之行動策略。
description.en: This course equips students to shape their academic and professional careers by exploring the vital intersection of technology, humanities, and sustainable development. Through an interdisciplinary framework, students will be exposed to the latest technological applications, cultivate a strong sense of innovation, and integrate social responsibility grounded in diverse humanistic perspectives. Practical aspects, such as expert speeches, company visits, workshops, and projects, are included to cultivate workplace-ready, interdisciplinary talents.

description.zh: 課程為可程式控制基礎課程之延伸，著重於 PLC 進階應用與自動化控制系統整合。內容涵蓋電控系統設計、I/O規劃、先進梯形圖程式撰寫、感測器與致動元件整合、氣壓控制應用、以及設備除錯與優化。透過實務導向的專題製作，使學生能利用 PLC、人機界面、工業配線與控制邏輯等技術，完成小型自動化控制系統之開發。課程強調 學、做合一，以考取勞動部機電整合丙級技術士技能檢定為主要訓練目標。
description.en: This course is an extension of the introductory programmable control course and focuses on advanced PLC applications and automation system integration. The course content includes electrical control system design, I/O planning, advanced ladder logic programming, integration of sensors and actuators, pneumatic control applications, as well as troubleshooting and optimization of equipment. Through practice-oriented project implementation, students will apply PLC programming, HMI development, industrial wiring, and control logic techniques to develop small-scale automated control systems. The course emphasizes learning by doing and aims to prepare students for passing the Level C Mechatronics Integration Technician Skill Certification administered by the Ministry of Labor.

name.en: Cross-Disciplinary Project Implementation of Artificial Intelligence

description.zh:
本課程整合微軟Azure Open AI雲端服務資源，運用問題分析能力進行實作與相關應用，以企業出題學生解題PBL模式導入人工智慧跨域專題實作，目的在幫助學生瞭解如何運用人工智慧技術來解決現實世界中的問題。
本課程透過導入人工智慧在企業管理和決策、金融、數據分析、智慧製造等領域等應用案例，並以通用人工智慧跨域應用學習模式來跨域應用至數據分析、智慧運算、智慧製造及物流、商情預測、經營管理、金融等領域。透過本課程的修習，學生將獲得實際的跨學科專題實作能力，掌握人工智慧技術的應用和發展趨勢，養成專業職能和研發實力，並培育具有創業與創新精神人才，了解產業在數位轉型中，所面臨的困難與挑戰。
description.en:
This course integrates resources from Microsoft Azure's Open AI cloud services, utilizing problem analysis skills for practical implementation and related applications. It introduces an industry-proposed, student-solved Project-Based Learning (PBL) model into the interdisciplinary project implementation of artificial intelligence. The aim is to help students understand how to apply AI technology to solve real-world problems.
Through the introduction of artificial intelligence applications in enterprise management and decision-making, finance, data analysis, and smart manufacturing, the course enables students to gain practical interdisciplinary project implementation skills. This course also helps students understand the difficulties and challenges faced by industries in digital transformation.

name.zh: 金融科技創新專題實作

description.zh: 「金融科技創新專題實作」課程旨在結合理論與實務，培養學生於金融科技領域的創新思維與跨域應用能力。課程將引導學生運用人工智慧、大數據分析、區塊鏈、數位支付等新興技術，解決實際金融問題並發展具創新性的解決方案。透過專題導向學習方式，學生需組成團隊，從問題定義、技術選擇、原型設計到成果展示，完整經歷一個金融科技創新專案的開發流程。課程過程中將邀請業界專家進行實務分享與技術指導，並安排期中與期末專案簡報，以強化學生的表達與簡報能力。最終目標是提升學生的實作經驗與創業潛能，為未來投身金融科技相關職涯奠定堅實基礎。
description.en: This course combines theory and practice to cultivate students’ innovative and interdisciplinary skills in financial technology. It explores the application of artificial intelligence, big data analytics, blockchain, and digital payments in solving real-world financial problems. Through project-based learning, students work in teams to complete the full FinTech project lifecycle, from problem identification to prototype development and presentation. Industry guest lectures and project presentations enhance practical experience, communication skills, and readiness for careers in the FinTech sector.

name.zh: 比特幣系統與去中心化金融專題
name.en: Bitcoin System and Decentralized Finance Projects

description.zh: 本課程旨在結合理論與實務，深入探究比特幣區塊鏈的核心技術、在傳統金融以及去中心化金融（DeFi）的創新應用。課程分成三大主軸：1.技術基礎：深入解析比特幣的核心技術架構，包括共識機制、加密算法、去中心化網絡等關鍵技術原理；2.金融生態：探討比特幣在傳統金融與去中心化金融中的創新應用，分析其對現有金融體系的潛在衝擊。結合理論與實務，研究區塊鏈技術在跨境支付、實體資產代幣化（Real World Asset Tokenization）等領域的具體應用案例；3.專題實作：通過專題實作模組，學生將運用所學設計並開發基於比特幣區塊鏈或 DeFi 的創新應用，從需求分析、技術設計到實際開發，完成一個具實用價值的專案。專題成果將通過展示與技術審查檢視，並輔以市場分析與報告撰寫，提升學生的實務能力與創新思維。本課程不僅幫助學生掌握比特幣區塊鏈與去中心化金融的理論與技術，還著重於培養解決問題的能力，並為學生在區塊鏈與數位資產領域的職業發展奠定堅實基礎。
description.en: This course integrates theory and practice to examine Bitcoin blockchain technology and its applications in traditional finance and decentralized finance (DeFi). It introduces Bitcoin’s core architecture, including consensus mechanisms, cryptography, and decentralized networks, and explores use cases such as cross-border payments and real-world asset tokenization. Through project-based learning, students design and implement Bitcoin- or DeFi-based applications. Assessment includes technical reviews, presentations, and analytical reports, preparing students for careers in blockchain and digital asset ecosystems.

syllabi.schedule:
本課程由台積電訓練中心(位於台中)提供課程設備，實際授課內容視該期可用設備由台積電調整。每一梯次受訓四天，本學期為寒假班次，每天課程範例如下：
Day 1
1.System overview
2.Mainframe configuration
3.Process module
4.Utility connection
5.Sub system
6.Safety
7.Tool on site inspection

Day 2
1.RF delivery system
2.Gas delivery system
3.Pressure servo system
4.ESC system
5.Backside He system
6.Temperature system
7.Chamber design evolution
8.EPD system introduction
9.Software operation overview

Day 3
1.S/W operation main platform
2.S/W operation processmodule
3.S/W operation data access
4.Mainframe outline
5.Mainframe service function
6.Mainframe maintenance
7.Maintenance practice and certification

Day 4
1.Chamber outline and PM preparation
2.Process kits disassembling
3.Process kits cleaning and inspection
4.Process kits installation
5.PM practice

原則上周六早上6點由本校出發，課程結束約六點由台中出發返校。統一提供交通運輸。遲到無法等待，視同缺課。

description.en: This course contents the following subjects: the physical properties of gases, the first law, second law and third law of thermodynamics, enthalpy change in chemical reaction, chemical kinetic and the phase equilibria in a system.

syllabi.outline:
The course is designed to provide the knowledge on quantum chemistry which will cover quantum mechanics, atomic structure, molecular orbitals, and molecular spectroscopy. This includes Schrodinger Equation, harmonic oscillator, angular momentum, hydrogen atom, theorems of quantum mechanics, electron spin and the Pauli Principle.
Outline:
1.Introduction to Modern Physics: Quantum Theory and Atomic Structure
2.	The Particle in a Box, Harmonic Oscillator, Angular Momentum, and Hydrogen Atom
3.	Theorems of Quantum Mechanics
4.	The Variation Method
5.	Perturbation Theory
6.	Electron Spin and The Pauli Principle
7.	Many-Electron Atoms
8.	Molecular Spectroscopy

description.zh: 本課程旨在講授互動式廣告的規劃與製作原理，包括互動式媒體的特性、廣告製作可如何掌握、發揮互動式媒體的特性，以及建置、設計、發展、與維護互動式廣告所需的相關概念、科技與技能。本課程亦教導同學如何應用電腦影像（computer imaging）與多媒體的科技與技術，來製作互動式廣告。
description.en: This course is mainly about the planning and principles of interactive advertisement production such as features of interactive media, how can advertisement production control and develop the features of interactive media, as well as the related concepts, technology, and skills needed in order to build, design, develop, and maintain interactive advertisement. Students will learn how to use computer imaging and the technology and techniques of multi-media to make an interactive advertisement.

syllabi.outline: This course explores the theories, practices, and evolving forms of interactive advertising in digital and social media environments. The course examines how interactivity, user participation, and social media dynamics reshape contemporary advertising communication.Key topics include the development of interactive advertising, social media interactivity, online advertising evolution, online community user behavior, and meme marketing. Through lectures, case studies, discussions, and presentations, students will develop analytical and research-oriented perspectives on interactive advertising phenomena.

name.en: The applications of TRIZ creative method

description.zh: 在現今產業激烈競爭與利潤微薄之階段，落實執行"系統化創新"是企業不可或缺的競爭策略及唯一的生存之道，但鮮少有企業真正瞭解與實際地應用。本課程以TRIZ創新方法為基礎，詳細的介紹系統性創新理論及實務的解題手法及落實創新方法之實務應用，可以很有系統地帶領學生們拓展革新思維，有效及系統化之應用於各種產業。讓學生也有機會應用於生活問題的解決。
description.en: Nowadays, enterprises in the phase of violating competence and decreasing profit. To make it survival, enterprises need to implement a systematic innovation technique, but only few companies really understanding and implement. The aim of this course is based on the applications of TRIZ creative method in detail which including the theory of systematic innovation and application, and also leading students to learn how the TRIZ works, and practice to solve their real life and various industries problems.

description.zh: 以視覺藝術為探討重點，研究藝術起源以及原始美術、民俗與大眾藝術分野。探究式覺元素和設計原理以及應用媒材、使用技巧，涵蓋素描、水彩、油畫、版畫、混合媒材、雕塑、建築，廣告、包裝、服裝設計、工業產品設計及攝影等。配合幻燈教學，使同學對於視覺藝術有整體性、概括性的認識，以奠定將來從事藝術鑑賞和研究創造之基礎。
description.en: The focus of this course is the exploration of visual arts.  Students will study the origin of art and the distinction among primitive art, folk and popular art. This course also provides students with visual elements, design principles, applied media material, and techniques including charcoal drawing, water-colored painting, oil painting, graphic art, compound material, sculpture, architecture, advertisement, packaging, fashion design, industrial design, and photography. Slide teaching is adopted to give students a comprehensive and general understanding on visual art in order to foster students to appreciate, study, and create art.

syllabi.outline:
課程理念為「美學素養」與藝術史，以奠定技職學生人文涵養為要點，從藝術起源為始，帶領同學領悟西方美學與藝術風格流派，以此累積學生的美學涵養，轉化深藏藝術史中「美」的價值。
The curriculum concept is "aesthetic literacy" and art history. It focuses on laying the foundation for the humanistic cultivation of vocational students. Starting from the origin of art, it leads students to understand Western aesthetics and art styles and schools, so as to accumulate students' aesthetic cultivation and transform the value of "beauty" hidden in art history.

description.zh: 本課程提供大一學生必備之英語文語言技巧，強調專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分，並整合英語文之聽、說、讀、寫之能力，提升英語文在專業領域的應用。
description.en: This course equips first-year students with essential English language skills, focusing on developing their communication abilities in specific professional fields. The content is customized to each college's discipline and integrates the four language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing), thereby enhancing the application of English in professional contexts.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調設計與人文專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
This course aims to provide pre-service design and cultural business students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

description.zh:
本模組透過適切尺度與解析度的建築設計操作，引導學生培養進階的設計能力、批判意識與空間辯證思考。課程鼓勵學生投入特定的設計專長領域，採取創新且具批判性的概念生成方法，並在回應基地與脈絡時，深化材料、形式與敘事策略，使學生得以在設計過程中建立多層次的建築思辨能力。
課程以工作室為主要教學形式，置於專題式設計單元中運作。學生將依據高階設計議題，提出具備概念整合度、技術成熟度與空間解析度的建築方案。為此，本課程的訓練聚焦於培養進階建築設計所需的深度與廣度，包含概念推演、空間辯證、構築策略、材料與敘事之間的整合、以及環境條件對建築設計的影響。學生將透過研究、分析、模型與原型測試、技術模擬與反覆的設計修正，在動態的設計過程中形成更具批判性與自主性的設計思考。學生亦需在整個學期中透過專業圖面、模型、文本敘事與口頭簡報等方式，清晰溝通其設計過程與成果。
透過此課程，學生將能在複雜條件、多元限制與跨領域脈絡下，提出具有批判性、創新性與技術深度的建築設計方案，並培養成熟的設計判斷與面向國際的專業能力。

This course focuses on advanced architectural design through the synthesis of scale, spatial resolution, materiality and tectonic strategies. Students will develop critical methods to address complex site contexts and formal problems.

syllabi.schedule:
The Intimate Whole: 
between exterior rooms and the monument	

Originally established in 1914 as a Japanese-era winery (Taihoku Winery), Huashan 1914 Creative Park is a primary remnant of Taipei’s industrial heritage. Its historic factory fabric exists at the intersection of two divergent urban logics: the axes of a colonial industrial past and the rigid grid of modern Taipei’s infrastructure collide at an awkward angle. This axial misalignment has produced a residual urban void—a “leftover” plaza that fails to invite the public. From the scale of the boulevard, the historic factory buildings appear fragmented and remote, lacking a clear sense of arrival and the spatial tension necessary to define their place in the contemporary city. The task is to design a Visitor and Cultural Center that operates as a precise architectural threshold, mediating between these conflicting geometries and transforming this ambiguous vacancy into a meaningful Urban Room.

The intervention focuses on the precise definition of exterior space, sensitively negotiating mass and void along with facades to redefine the character of the site. Rather than merely occupying the empty open space, the new building must define the surrounding void, giving a sense of place to the dormant amphitheater and the open plaza. By carefully placing the program—information, an urban archive, a bookstore, and a cafe—the project must recalibrate the visitor’s perception of the existing heritage and create a new dialogue between the street and the old factories. While the intervention primarily addresses the ground, the below-ground level may also be utilized to expand the architectural possibilities. Through this careful placement and scaling, the project aims to bridge the temporal and formal gap between the industrial past and the modern city, integrating the fragments of Huashan currently in “distant friction” into a single, coherent whole.

by euihaing lee

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在深入學習無線網路技術，從基本概念到進階應用，全面涵蓋網路架構中的實體層、媒體存取層、網路層與傳輸層技術議題。課程內容將引導學生探索通訊網路的基礎理論，了解訊號傳遞的特性及頻譜與調變技術，並掌握多重存取方法的原理與應用。此外，課程將深入探討無線區域網路、藍牙、ZigBee等短距離通訊技術，並延伸至即時網路環境中的Ad hoc路由設計。在應用層上，學生將學習無線感測網路的架構與應用，以及定位系統的設計。課程亦探討行動網路的原理與發展，並涵蓋近期的技術進展與創新，幫助學生掌握無線網路技術的現狀與未來趨勢，進一步提升應用能力與實務經驗。

(2) 無線通訊實體層議題

(7) 行動通訊網路系統
(8) 近期技術發展

This course provides an in-depth exploration of wireless network technology, from foundational concepts to advanced applications. It covers key topics across the physical, media access, network, and transport layers, including signal transmission, spectrum, modulation, and multiple access methods. Students will study short-range communication technologies such as WLAN, Bluetooth, and ZigBee, as well as Ad hoc routing in real-time networks. The course also addresses wireless sensor networks, positioning system design, mobile network principles, and recent advancements. Emphasis is placed on practical skills and understanding future trends in wireless networking.

(1) Introduction
(2) Wireless Physical Layer
(3) Wireless MAC
(4) Wireless Local Area Networks
(5) Wireless Person Area Networks
(6) Wirelss Application and Localization
(7) Mobile Communication Networks
(8) Recent Advances

name.en: Intelligent Applications of Internet of Things

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在教授學生機器學習、大數據等人工智慧技術，並使用在物聯網的創新與應用上。課程內容包括：人工智慧概論、大數據方法、機器學習方法、資料探勘方法、最佳化方法、物聯網概論、影音處理、雲端技術、物聯網系統實作等。
description.en: This course is to instruct students the basics of artificial intelligent methods and apply these methods to innovative applications of Internet of Things. The contents include introduction to artificial intelligence, machine learning methods, data mining methods, optimization methods, introduction to internet of things, video and audio processing, cloud computing, and innovation project implementation.

syllabi.outline:
本課程的主要目的在教授學生機器學習、大數據等人工智慧技術，並使用在物聯網的創新與應用上。課程內容包括：人工智慧概論、大數據方法、機器學習方法、資料探勘方法、最佳化方法、物聯網概論、影音處理、雲端技術、物聯網系統實作等。
Internet of Things (IoT) serves as the framework for collecting data and control devices in real-life, while artificial intelligence (AI) provides many algorithms that enable machines to think. As a result, AI and IoT are inseparable when building an intelligent system. This course will introduce the components of IoT and AI through hands-on experiments, covering the use of edge devices, sensor information collection, device actuation, and sensor data analysis, ultimately leading to the creation of an AIoT application. Furthermore, this course is project-oriented, and students will need to use the knowledge gained from lab experiments and develop a project that involves virtual computing and physical interaction.

description.zh:
協助學員在完成課程後：
1.對於TFT-LCD的製程有基礎認識

description.en:
Students achieve the following learning outcomes upon completing the course:
1.Develop a fundamental understanding of the TFT-LCD manufacturing process.
2.Gain basic concepts of the design principles, operation, and maintenance of TFT-LCD machine equipment and components.
3.Understand the concept of applying intelligent production technology in the TFT-LCD manufacturing industry.
4.Generate creative ideas for applying theoretical knowledge learned in school to industry practices.

description.zh: 本課程介紹企業整合年度經營策略與財務規劃，並指導同學編製營業、生產、財務等完整預算體系，掌握各部門預算協調、預算控制方法，如彈性預算以及績效評估與差異分析實務，使大家能運用關鍵績效指標有效監控企業經營目標。
description.en: This course introduces the integration of annual business strategies and financial planning for enterprises, and guides students in developing a complete budget system for sales, production, and finance. Students will master methods for coordinating and controlling budgets across departments, such as flexible budgeting, and practical skills in performance evaluation and variance analysis, enabling them to effectively monitor business objectives using key performance indicators.

name.zh: 比特幣系統與去中心化金融專題
name.en: Bitcoin System and Decentralized Finance Projects

description.zh: 本課程旨在結合理論與實務，深入探究比特幣區塊鏈的核心技術、在傳統金融以及去中心化金融（DeFi）的創新應用。課程分成三大主軸：1.技術基礎：深入解析比特幣的核心技術架構，包括共識機制、加密算法、去中心化網絡等關鍵技術原理；2.金融生態：探討比特幣在傳統金融與去中心化金融中的創新應用，分析其對現有金融體系的潛在衝擊。結合理論與實務，研究區塊鏈技術在跨境支付、實體資產代幣化（Real World Asset Tokenization）等領域的具體應用案例；3.專題實作：通過專題實作模組，學生將運用所學設計並開發基於比特幣區塊鏈或 DeFi 的創新應用，從需求分析、技術設計到實際開發，完成一個具實用價值的專案。專題成果將通過展示與技術審查檢視，並輔以市場分析與報告撰寫，提升學生的實務能力與創新思維。本課程不僅幫助學生掌握比特幣區塊鏈與去中心化金融的理論與技術，還著重於培養解決問題的能力，並為學生在區塊鏈與數位資產領域的職業發展奠定堅實基礎。
description.en: This course integrates theory and practice to examine Bitcoin blockchain technology and its applications in traditional finance and decentralized finance (DeFi). It introduces Bitcoin’s core architecture, including consensus mechanisms, cryptography, and decentralized networks, and explores use cases such as cross-border payments and real-world asset tokenization. Through project-based learning, students design and implement Bitcoin- or DeFi-based applications. Assessment includes technical reviews, presentations, and analytical reports, preparing students for careers in blockchain and digital asset ecosystems.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在修完學期校外實習(一)之後，在畢業之前希望能獲得較長期體驗車輛產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation after semester practical training (1). Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，修課學生必須至化學、化工相關機構實習，參與校外合作工廠所提供之實質訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，於次一學期註冊後，再由指導教師依據學生之心得報告，加以檢核、指導撰寫成實習成果報告，彙交系上保存，可供其他同學參考。

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生利用整學期到工業工程與管理相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告。須在同一機構連續實習4.5月，學生應全職於實習機構實習。
description.en: The course is developed to increase on-job practice capability of students. Participants practice and learn the real operation of the industrial engineering and management related fields in one of the corporative industrial engineering company during one semester. A practice intern and a well-prepared report must be completed to the course requirement. It is necessary to practice in one corporative industrial engineering and management company full-time at least 4.5 months.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須於學期中至相關機構連續實習18週，每週不得低於2.5天。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核，學生應於校外實習完成後一週內繳交校外實習報告，由實習輔導老師評定實習成績。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance students' on-job practical experiences. Students will work at an engineering related company or research organizations for 18 weeks (20 hours per week) during the semester. Through the program, students would learn the hands-on professional technology. Each student would be required to submit a written report right after the end of the internship for grading.

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋有關建築與哲學、當代建築理論、設計理論、建築批評、構築術、建築存有學與本體論等相關主題的探究，從選讀的文本閱讀攝取建築的觀念與理念，同時以建築作品的導讀作為前述形上與物質本體的交互探索範疇與核心。
description.en: The class composed of reading and discussion of contemporary multiple topic on the field of architecture and relevant philosophy, contemporary architectural theory, design theory, criticism, tectonic, and ontological approach to architecture, etc.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要以對於當代建築具有啟發性和創新性的建築經典著作 (或文學、哲學) 為範圍，透過修課者的精讀、研討交流、對話，以窺探形塑當代建築的重要觀念與內涵，結合與之相對應的建築作品進行作品的閱讀與詮釋。

        本課程希望訓練建築研究者理解建築學的物質和非物質面兩者係互為一體，培養研究生進一步的建築抽象性思考和分析能力，並期望研究生藉此拓展建築觀念。

        課程非以授課方式進行，而由修課者每周進行指定或非指定的閱讀，於上課時間進行閱讀報告與心得之討論，授課老師進行導讀，並就討論內容提出分析比較與歸納。

為培養學生自主學習能力，透過學生自發性蒐集資料擬定研究主題，由學生自行建構課程內容，從中學習規劃與執行專案實務，培育學生在特定主題研究中，學習到團隊合作、溝通表達、思考批判與問題解決等能力，由教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。本課程的評量以書面報告或口頭報告進行。
To help students cultivate the ability of self-learning, this course allows students to engage themselves in developing course content, to plan and to execute a real-world project. "Active learning" encourages students to learn by interaction, communication, collaboration, critically analyzing arguments, and problem-solving. Instructors will assist to guide and to support in the process of learning. Students are expected to develop a process to solve real-life problems collaboratively. Written reports and oral presentations are required for course evaluation.

為培養大學部學生自主學習能力，由學生主動積極創造並實現自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題之創造與實現中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。

description.en:
This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it. 
 
In this course, students are required to draw up self-learning plans based on their own interests and capabilities and then submit their plans to the departmental office for approval by the beginning of the semester.

syllabi.schedule:
主題:  英語檢定-雅思

1:
2月23日 - 3月15日
奠定基礎與診斷性測試：聽力與讀力重點在於熟悉考試題型（如：填空、選擇、配對），並進行一次完整的計時模擬測驗，找出主要弱點。寫作練習撰寫 Task 1
(圖表描述) 的基本架構，同時累積常用替換詞彙。說話部分則著重於 Part 1 日
常主題的流暢度訓練，嘗試錄音並自我評估發音與語調。每日至少學習兩小時，
確保四項技能皆有涉獵，特別針對模擬考表現最差的一項投入額外時間。此階
段目標是建立對雅思的全面理解並掌握基礎解題方法。
透過《劍橋雅思真題集》進行診斷測試，利用線上資源（如：BBC Learning English）加強聽力理解，並從《IELTS 寫作範文》中學習基本結構。

2:
3月16日 - 4月6日
核心技巧突破與閱讀/聽力精進：聽力進行密集式精聽練習，針對不同口音和速
度進行訓練，並提高筆記的準確性。讀力著重於文章類型（學術/一般）的策略調整，練習迅速定位關鍵信息（Scanning & Skimming）。寫作 Task 2 進入架構訓練，學習如何提出論點、提供證據與反駁論證。說話則開始準備 Part 2 的主題卡片，練習在兩分鐘內組織連貫的內容。持續累積各項技能的詞彙與同義詞替
換。此階段目標是將聽讀分數穩定提升至中高水平，並掌握寫作論證的基本流
程。
閱讀與聽力使用《劍橋雅思真題集 15-18》，寫作參考《雅思高分寫作指南》；口說則利用 App 或語言交換夥伴進行 Part 2 的計時練習。

3:
4月7日 - 4月28日
寫作/口說結構化與進階練習：寫作將進行 Task 1 和 Task 2 的整合訓練，特別
專注於邏輯連貫性和進階語法結構（如：複雜句、倒裝句）。每週至少完成兩篇計時寫作並進行自我或同儕互評。說話則進入 Part 3 的抽象討論，練習表達複雜觀點和進行比較與對比，擴充高頻學術主題詞彙。聽力與讀力則保持每週進行
一次計時單項測試，鞏固已學策略。同時，針對四項技能中錯誤率最高的項目，
進行額外的弱點專項訓練，如聽力選擇題或閱讀段落標題配對。此階段目標是
讓寫作和口說的流利度和準確性達到可接受的考試標準。
寫作使用線上語法校對工具和高分範文對比，口說參考《雅思口語萬用主題詞彙》，並尋求專業老師或母語人士進行模擬面試與反饋

4:
4月29日 - 5月19日
全面整合與弱項聚焦衝刺：此階段將著重於模擬考試情境，每週進行兩次完整
的四小時全套模擬測驗。每次測驗後，進行深入的錯誤分析：聽力與讀力分析錯
誤的題型分佈與原因；寫作與說話則根據評分標準進行細緻調整。特別針對個
人最大的弱點（無論是聽、說、讀、寫）投入50%以上的練習時間。例如，如果寫作 Task 2 時間管理不佳，則密集練習縮短審題與大綱時間。此外，說話持續進行陌生主題的 Part 3 討論，聽力與讀力則著重於難度較高的題組。此階段目標是將整體表現穩定在目標分數±0.5分範圍內。
集中使用最新的《劍橋雅思真題集》進行計時全真模擬測試，並利用個人錯題筆記進行弱點回顧與密集訓練

5:
5月20日 - 6月6日
考前總複習與狀態調整：最後階段停止進行新的全套模擬測驗，重點放在聽力
與讀力的高頻詞彙、同義詞替換的快速複習。寫作則回顧所有 Task 1 與 Task 2
的高分範文和個人寫作大綱，以確保考試時能迅速切換架構。說話則進行所有
已準備主題的快速回顧，保持英語的語感與流利度。不再學習新知識，而是專注
於強化已掌握的內容。保持充足的睡眠和規律的作息，進行適度的放鬆活動。6
月6日為緩衝日，進行最後的心態調整與考試用品確認。此階段的關鍵是穩定發
揮、保持自信、避過度疲勞。
快速翻閱個人整理的筆記、詞彙表，以及高頻錯誤集錦，觀看雅思官方網站的考前提示，並進行輕度英語閱讀以維持語感。

description.zh:
(1)	藉由學生主動實現自己有興趣之主題，培養自我學習能力。
(2)	於特定的主題當中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。
(3)	教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習與成長。 
(4)	學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定學習計畫，並於開學前提出申請，由專任教師指導，審查及評核學期成績。
description.en:
(1)	Develop self-learning skills by actively implementing topics of interest to students.
(2)	Among the specific topics, the ability to think critically and solve problems is learned.
(3)	Teachers act as mentors and guide students to learn and grow from practice.
(4)	Students set up learning plans according to their own interests and abilities, and apply before the school starts. They are supervised by full-time teachers to review and evaluate semester performance.

description.zh:
為培養大學部學生自主學習能力，由學生主動積極創造並實現自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題之創造與實現中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。
    學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定自主學習計畫，向指導教師提出計畫審查。指導教師同意後，學生於加退選週結束前向系辦公室登記申請。
description.en:
This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it. 

In this course, students are required to draw up self-learning plans based on their own interests and capabilities, and submit to their instructors for approval. With instructors’ approval, they need to make registration to the departmental office for application by the end of the add/drop course selection weeks of the semester.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得短期體驗光電產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a electric-optic engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.en: This is the extended course to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a electric-optic engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期、或寒假(可跨學期)至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之校外研發機構的實務研究總累計時數不得低於320小時(於(跨)學期中、暑期、或寒假期間)，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究心得報告予指導教授，指導教師依據研究生之實務研發紀錄及心得報告，指導研究生撰寫成實務研究成果報告，彙交所屬系所保存，並作為成績核定之依據。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占50%，研究生指導教授占50%，各系所得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the regular semester term or the summer/winter break, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on site research. The students are urged to take an active part in the training programs as well as observe and emulate the genuine research and development operations in respective manufacturers. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours (during the regular semester term and/or the summer/winter break). After the students finish the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site.

description.en: Graduate students are required to complete specific research topic under the restriction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis. The thesis focuses on the fields in "industrial design", and includes research methodology, theory background and conclusive result or findings. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. Therefore, the course includes a training of developing research, writing and bibliographic skills.

description.zh: 學生與教授討論擬定之研究題目,在教授個別指導下,進行實驗之研究,以培養學生尋找相關資料,文獻及獨立研究的訓練,並將其研究成果撰寫成博士論文及發表於國際期刊。
description.en: To make students able to carry out independent study in master level. Students will be assigned a research topic. An independent experimental design, data analysis, doctoral thesis writing, and paper publication are necessary for this course.

During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
